turns.zh:
这辆车是基于2015年在东京车展上推出的一款名为
“RX-VISION”的汽车。

它由一部四转子引擎提供动力，而且你可以从车的外形
上看出来，这是一款前置引擎后轮驱动的汽车。

在当时，这是对转子发动机跑车的未来展望。

而如今，这款RX-VISION终于被改成了一辆赛车。
引擎是被命名为SKYACTIV-R的四转子自然进气引擎。

整车重量为1250kg，引擎功率为570ps。
看到它，就让人觉得传奇的787B跑车以前置引擎、后轮
驱动的形式王者归来了！
turns.speaker: Chris

This is a truly historic car, and an extremely valuable one.

Érik Comas became Driver Champion behind the wheel of a GT-R at the 1999 All Japan GT Championships.

In fact, the Pennzoil car finished in the points in every race that season...

...and claimed four podium finishes out of seven races that year.

It was also the last GT-R powered by the RB26DETT engine to claim the title in the GT Championships.

turns.zh:
这可是一台历史悠久的车了……而且极其珍贵。
埃里克·科马斯就是坐在这辆GT-R赛车里夺得1999年
全日本GT锦标赛车手总冠军的。
这辆Pennzoil赛车在那个赛季的每站比赛中都获得了积分，

并在当年的7场比赛中4次登上领奖台。

这也是最后一辆搭载RB26DETT引擎获得该项赛事冠军的GT-R。

Érik Comas became Driver Champion behind the wheel of
a GT-R at the 1999 All Japan GT Championships.
In fact, the Pennzoil car finished in the points
in every race that season...

...and claimed four podium finishes out of seven races that year.

It was also the last GT-R powered by the RB26DETT engine
to claim the title in the GT Championships.

This is a definitive Porsche—a sportscar that makes absolutely no compromises.

After 2008, the 997 GT3 produced double the downforce it previously did.

In addition, the engine and brakes were made even more powerful.

No question about it, this one's a real gem.

turns.zh:
这是一辆不折不扣，毫不妥协、绝对纯粹的Porsche跑车。
2008年之后的997 GT3的下压力提高了一倍，

不仅如此，它所使用的发动机曲轴箱是从风冷技术时代
就不断积累研发的赛车用版本。
毫无疑问，这既是一颗璀璨的宝石。

However, many enthusiasts favored the Levin.

The Levin, with its fixed headlights, was approximately <5kg> lighter than the Trueno.

In a car this light, an extra <5kg> over the front axle could make a noticeable difference in handling.

This rare beauty is an icon of Italian car manufacturing.

The FIAT 500 made its debut in 1957.

It is considered one of legendary FIAT car designer Dante Giacosa's most enduring masterpieces.

Giacosa contributed to the fabulous engineering legacy of FIAT for many, many years.

At under <3m> in length, it's compact in nature, but can snugly fit four people thanks to a space-saving rear-engine.

It is celebrated to this day for its undeniable charm.

You can see where the modern FIAT 500 got its good looks from!

turns.zh:
这款稀世珍品诠释了意大利汽车制造业的外在之美。
FIAT 500于1957年问世。

被认为是极富传奇色彩的FIAT汽车设计大师但特·吉奥科萨的
代表作之一，这款车型久盛不衰，是永恒的经典。

吉奥科萨为FIAT设计多年，留下许多非凡的作品。
这款车总长不到3m，是紧凑型汽车，但由于
配置了省空间的后置引擎，因此可以容纳4人。
这款车的魅力毋庸置疑，因而久负盛名……
我们一眼就能看出具备现代感的
FIAT 500外观有多吸睛！
turns.speaker: Chris

This is a first-generation Honda Civic Type R.

What's really special about this car is its specially-tuned 1.6L naturally-aspirated straight-four engine.

Just wait till you hear its thrilling roar and exhaust note— you'll think you're driving a genuine racing car!

The effect is really amazing, especially when you go from the <6000rpm> to over <8000rpm>.

Since it was based on a front-wheel drive car, the Type R was originally marketed at an affordable price.

But nowadays its value has been reassessed owing to its exceptional performance.

turns.zh:
这是第一代Honda Civic Type R。
这款车的独到之处在于配备专门调校过的
1.6L自然吸气直列四缸引擎。
当你听到这辆车亢奋的引擎声和排气声时，你会以为
自己在开一辆真正的赛车！

具备惊人的性能，特别是从6000rpm
加速到8000rpm以上时，效果更为震撼。
Type R是前轮驱动的车款，因此起初的定价相当实惠。

但如今，由于其优异的性能，所以已经重新定价了。
turns.speaker: Chris

turns.raw:
Simply put, the Honda Integra Type R is one of the meanest compact cars in the world. It is a true race car for the road.

At its release, this first-gen Integra Type R came with a price tag that was affordable to young enthusiasts.

It served as a tool for young drivers to hone their skills as only a Type R could.

The Integra Type R's naturally-aspirated engine was a pumped-up version used in the base model...

...producing <20ps> more output.

The car also featured a strengthened chassis and boasted more than <40kg> in weight reduction.

It serves as a true showcase of 1990s Japanese automotive engineering.

�
turns.en:
Simply put, the Honda Integra Type R is one of the meanest
compact cars in the world. It is a true race car for the road.
At its release, this first-gen Integra Type R came with a
price tag that was affordable to young enthusiasts.

It served as a tool for young drivers to hone their
skills as only a Type R could.
The Integra Type R's naturally-aspirated engine was a pumped-up
version used in the base model...

...producing 20ps more output.
The car also featured a strengthened chassis and boasted
more than 40kg in weight reduction.
It serves as a true showcase of 1990s Japanese automotive
engineering.
turns.zh: 不用多说，本田Type R提供了迅疾而流畅的驾驶体验。 完全是款名副其实的公路赛车。 第一代形格Type R发售时，由于其定价对于年轻车主来说 并非不可接受…… 因此吸引许多人将其作为入门车型， 用来体验驾驶Type R的乐趣。 其自然吸气引擎比起基础车型 更加强劲有力。 因此在功率上提升了20ps。 形格Type R还采用了强化底盘，并减轻了40kg以上的整体车重上。 这款车是上世纪90年代日本汽车制造业中当之无愧的代表杰作。
turns.speaker: Chris

Simply put, the Honda Integra Type R is one of the meanest compact cars in the world. It is a true race car for the road.

At its release, this first-gen Integra Type R came with a price tag that was affordable to young enthusiasts.

It served as a tool for young drivers to hone their skills as only a Type R could.

The Integra Type R's naturally-aspirated engine was a pumped-up version used in the base model...

...producing <20ps> more output.

The car also featured a strengthened chassis and boasted more than <40kg> in weight reduction.

It serves as a true showcase of 1990s Japanese automotive engineering.

turns.en:
Simply put, the Honda Integra Type R is one of the meanest
compact cars in the world. It is a true race car for the road.

price tag that was affordable to young enthusiasts.

It served as a tool for young drivers to hone their
skills as only a Type R could.
The Integra Type R's naturally-aspirated engine was a pumped-up
version used in the base model...

...producing 20ps more output.
The car also featured a strengthened chassis and boasted
more than 40kg in weight reduction.
It serves as a true showcase of 1990s Japanese automotive
engineering.
turns.zh: 不用多说，本田Type R提供了迅疾而流畅的驾驶体验。 完全是款名副其实的公路赛车。 第一代形格Type R发售时，由于其定价对于年轻车主来说 并非不可接受…… 因此吸引许多人将其作为入门车型， 用来体验驾驶Type R的乐趣。 其自然吸气引擎比起基础车型 更加强劲有力。 因此在功率上提升了20ps。 形格Type R还采用了强化底盘，并减轻了40kg以上的整体车重上。 这款车是上世纪90年代日本汽车制造业中当之无愧的代表杰作。

turns.raw:
Without a doubt, the Mini is one of the world's most popular compact cars.

It was introduced in Britain in 1959.

Its outward appearance was left largely unchanged over the course of its 40-year production history.

In 2001, it was reborn in the form of the next-generation Mini we see here.

Although double the size of its classic predecessor, its handling and styling were pure Mini.

Although the original Mini was British, these modern iterations were actually developed by BMW.

The German manufacturer did a commendable job maintaining the spirit of the original car.

The German manufacturer did a commendable job

turns.zh:
Mini毋庸置疑是全世界最畅销的车型之一。
1959年在英国问世……

经过长达40年的生产历史，
外观大体未变。
直到2001年才推出新一代Mini，
也就是我们目前见到的这一款。

尽管尺寸上比历史悠久的前代车型大了两倍，
其操控性和风格仍维持地道的Mini水准。
Mini本是英国车，但其新一代车型出自BMW之手。

制造商的变动，在其响应迅速的转向及
卓越的刚性上得到淋漓尽致的体现。

Although the original Mini was built as a compact car for the masses, it possessed a high level of performance.

That was the company that created this sporty Mini Cooper S.

The car shined in in races and rallies of the day, leaving behind a lasting legacy.

This model, with an improved engine displacement of <970cc>, is especially prized within the series.

turns.raw:
When it comes to speedy little road rockets, the first thing that comes to mind is this Mini.

Although the original Mini was built as a compact car for the masses, it possessed a high level of performance.

The first to notice the Mini’s potential was the car constructor Cooper, of Formula 1 fame.

That was the company that created this sporty Mini Cooper S.

The car shined in in races and rallies of the day, leaving behind a lasting legacy.

This model, with an improved engine displacement of <970cc>, is especially prized within the series.

e

turns.zh:

但其性能仍然不可小觑。

对，就是以F1闻名的传奇人物。
他的团队是这款运动型Mini Cooper S的
幕后推手。

这款车在竞赛和拉力赛中取得的光辉战绩，
成就了一代传奇。
这款车型引擎排量提升高达970cc，
是该系列中弥足珍惜的一款。

turns.raw:
Combining a light, compact body with a responsive rear-wheel drive chassis...

And a peppy 1.8L straight-four engine—this S13 Silvia is one well-balanced FR sports car.

Not only does it strike an elegant pose when parked, but it looks great tearing around a corner, too!

Nowadays, these cars are really something special. In fact, the S13's best qualities are priceless!
turns.en:
Combining a light, compact body with a responsive
rear-wheel drive chassis...
And a peppy 1.8L straight-four engine—this S13 Silvia
is one well-balanced FR sports car.
Not only does it strike an elegant pose when parked, but it
looks great tearing around a corner, too!
Nowadays, these cars are really something special.
In fact, the S13's best qualities are priceless!
turns.zh:
这轻巧紧凑的车身与响应迅速的后轮驱动底盘相结合……
加上强劲的1.8升直列四缸引擎，这台S13 Silvia
简直是面面俱到的前置后驱跑车。
不仅停放时姿态优雅，转弯时同样美得让人窒息。
现如今，这款车确实非同寻常。
老实说，S13本身就是无价之宝！
turns.speaker: Chris

turns.raw:
While the standard 208 GTi was undeniably small and light, it did offer loads of fun to the driver.

This Peugeot Sport-engineered version takes the driving experience to a whole other level.

Its exquisite chassis is stable and responsive.

On even extremely twisty mountain roads, the car was an absolute pleasure to drive.

In fact, its amazing chassis is reason enough to add this car in your collection.

K

While the standard 208 GTi was undeniably small
and light, it did offer loads of fun to the driver.

experience to a whole other level.

In fact, its amazing chassis is reason enough to add this car
in your collection.
turns.zh:
虽然标准规格的208 GTi无疑是一款小而轻巧的车型，
驾驶起来却趣味无穷……
这款Peugeot Sport精心设计的款式，更将驾驶体验
带到了一个全新的高度。
精细的底盘设置给人以无与伦比的稳重感……

即便是行驶在最蜿蜒的山间道路上，
都能让人尽享驾驶妙趣。
老实说，仅凭其优秀的底盘，
就值得你去收藏这辆车了。
turns.speaker: Chris

turns.raw:
The Ford Mustang has been celebrated as a legendary American sports car ever since it hit the market in 1964.

One look at this exceptional seventh-generation model just might entice you to shout "Mustangs rule!"

Incorporating the essence of its predecessors...

...it boasts a proud lineage without relying too heavily on retro design cues.

The star of the show is undoubtedly the the V-8 engine found in this GT.

For a car with so much power, it came with an astonishingly reasonable price tag.
turns.en:
The Ford Mustang has been celebrated as a legendary American
sports car ever since it hit the market in 1964.

just might entice you to shout "Mustangs rule!"

The star of the show is undoubtedly the

For a car with so much power, it came with an
astonishingly reasonable price tag.
turns.zh:
自1964年上市以来，Ford Mustang一直被誉为是
美国跑车的一代传奇。
只要你看到这款卓尔不群的第七代车型，
你一定会欢呼“Mustang！”
凝聚了之前历代车型中的精髓……

从骨子里就流淌着厚重的历史底蕴，
不需要刻意攀附浮夸的复古风。
毋庸置疑，这款GT车继续搭载最优良的
V8引擎。

对于一款充满肌肉感的跑车而言，
其价格确实相当公道。

turns.raw:
Are you familiar with the term "muscle car?"

They were large American machines from the 1960s known for their large displacement and enormous power.

The first-generation Camaro Z28 was one of the more notable models from that era.

Its V-8 engine was developed especially for the Trans Am racing series, meaning it was highly potent.

Instead having tons of torque like other large-displacement eengines, it offered plenty of top-end power.

With awesome straight-line speed, the race version of the Z28 took home several victories in Trans-Am races.

Known as the last of the Z28s, this 1969 model has been coveted for generations.

�
turns.en:
Are you familiar with the term "muscle car?"

They were large American machines from the 1960s known for
their large displacement and enormous power.
The first-generation Camaro Z28 was one of the more notable
models from that era.

Its V-8 engine was developed especially for the Trans Am racing
series, meaning it was highly potent.
Instead having tons of torque like other large-displacement
eengines, it offered plenty of top-end power.

With awesome straight-line speed, the race version of the
Z28 took home several victories in Trans-Am races.
Known as the last of the Z28s, this 1969 model has been
coveted for generations.
turns.zh:
你熟悉“肌肉车”吗？

这类车以其大排量和强劲动力而闻名，
是60年代美国跑车文化的典型特征。
第一代Camaro Z28就是在该文化浪潮中诞生的传奇车型之一……

但其专为Trans Am系列赛研发的
V8引擎，也同样令人惊叹。
不像大部分的大排量引擎那样强调扭矩，
而是主打高转速。

不但能在日常行驶中派上用场，还是让Camaro Z28
在Trans Am竞赛获胜的幕后功臣。
这款1969年车型是Z28最后的改款，
其每代车款都令人着迷不已。
turns.speaker: Chris

This sixth-generation ZL1 may be the most valuable Camaro of all time.

Taking its engine from the Corvette Z06, the ZL1 is capable of an output of over <650ps>.

What’s more, this '1LE Package' has been outfitted for track performance needs.

Incredibly, it completed a lap of the Nürburgring Nordschleife in 7:16:04!

That's a super-car-level time, mind you!

And yet it's about 1/3 the price of your average super car, meaning it offers more bang for your buck!

There's nothing like an M car from BMW. The first-generation M3 is mostly associated with racing.

The final model was this "Sport Evolution," which was quite popular.

It is distinguished by its upgraded 2.5-liter engine and rear spoilers.

Oh yeah, these cars were impressive indeed.

Not too many of the original M3s were produced, so you can expect their prices will increase with time.

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_ExpertOldMan1_normal_r32_gtr_v2_94_1303104
turns.raw:
Of all the Nissan Skyline GT-Rs, this R32 stands out as truly special.

From the late 1960s to the early 1970s, the Skyline seemed unstoppable on the Japanese race circuit.

However, Nissan halted production of the Skyline GT-R in response to the 1973 oil crisis.

In 1989, the GT-R name was revived with this R32 Skyline GT-R.

Nissan poured all of its technical know-how into its development.

The hard work paid off, as the R32 dominated the competition from the get-go, winning the hearts of motorsport fans.

I can only imagine that its value will continue to increase over time.


turns.en:
Of all the Nissan Skyline GT-Rs, this R32 stands out
as truly special.
From the late 1960s to the early 1970s, the Skyline seemed
unstoppable on the Japanese race circuit.

However, Nissan halted production of the Skyline GT-R
in response to the 1973 oil crisis.
In 1989, the GT-R name was revived with this
R32 Skyline GT-R.
Nissan poured all of its technical know-how into
its development.
The hard work paid off, as the R32 dominated the competition
from the get-go, winning the hearts of motorsport fans.

I can only imagine that its value will continue to increase
over time.
turns.zh:
在日产Skyline GT-R系列车型中，这款R32
脱颖而出，成为一代变革之作！
从20世纪60年代末到70年代初，Skyline在日本赛道上
大杀四方，几乎势不可挡。

然而，为应对1973年的石油危机，日产中断了
该车型的生产。
1989年，GT-R这个代号因这款R32 Skyline GT-R车型
而再次响亮于赛场之上。

日产在研发这款车型时倾注了其
所有的技术积累。
辛勤努力最终有了回报，R32一出现就称霸了
整个赛场，赢得了众多赛车铁杆粉的青睐。

我推测，随着时间的累积
这款车将持续升值。
turns.speaker: Chris

Of all the Nissan Skyline GT-Rs, this R32 stands out as truly special.

From the late 1960s to the early 1970s, the Skyline seemed unstoppable on the Japanese race circuit.

However, Nissan halted production of the Skyline GT-R in response to the 1973 oil crisis.

Nissan poured all of its technical know-how into its development.

The hard work paid off, as the R32 dominated the competition from the get-go, winning the hearts of motorsport fans.

I can only imagine that its value will continue to increase over time.

turns.raw:
The Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution is an iconic turbocharged 4-wheel-drive Japanese sports car.

It's affectionately known as the "Evo."

The early Evos have won the hearts of countless fans thanks to their stellar performance at world rally championships.

Although Mitsubishi has not competed in a world rally competition since 2005...

...the Evo's popularity only continues to grow.

Historically speaking, this Evo X "Final Edition" was the last production car to be produced of the series.

It featured a tuned-up engine capable of outputting an astounding <313ps>.

You can bet that its value on the international market will only continue to appreciate with time.

turns.zh:
三菱蓝瑟翼豪陆神是标志性的日本
四轮驱动涡轮增压跑车。
车迷都称这辆车为“翼豪陆神”……

由于这一系列车型在世界拉力赛中表现出众，
赢得了无数粉丝的喜爱。
虽然自2005年以来，三菱和翼豪陆神
一直没有参加世界拉力赛……

但这款翼豪陆神的热度却不减反增。
回顾其发展史，翼豪陆神X的“终极版”车型是这系列的
最后一款量产车型。

这个版本的车型搭载更强大的引擎，
输出功率高达令人震惊的313ps。

可以保证，这款车型将来
在国际市场上的价值只会越来越高。
turns.speaker: Chris

The Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution is an iconic turbocharged 4-wheel-drive Japanese sports car.

It's affectionately known as the "Evo."

The early Evos have won the hearts of countless fans thanks to their stellar performance at world rally championships.

Although Mitsubishi has not competed in a world rally competition since 2005...

...the Evo's popularity only continues to grow.

Historically speaking, this Evo X "Final Edition" was the last production car to be produced of the series.

It featured a tuned-up engine capable of outputting an astounding <313ps>.

You can bet that its value on the international market will only continue to appreciate with time.



三菱蓝瑟翼豪陆神是标志性的日本
四轮驱动涡轮增压跑车。
车迷都称这辆车为“翼豪陆神”……

由于这一系列车型在世界拉力赛中表现出众，
赢得了无数粉丝的喜爱。
虽然自2005年以来，三菱和翼豪陆神
一直没有参加世界拉力赛……

但这款翼豪陆神的热度却不减反增。
回顾其发展史，翼豪陆神X的“终极版”车型是这系列的
最后一款量产车型。

这个版本的车型搭载更强大的引擎，
输出功率高达令人震惊的313ps。

可以保证，这款车型将来
在国际市场上的价值只会越来越高。
turns.speaker: Chris

turns.raw:
This E92 M3 is the fourth instalment in the BMW M3 series that began with the E30.

Its pride is in its engine...

As it is the only generation of M3 to haul a howling V8.

At the time of its development, BMW was powering its other cars with V10 engines built for F1 racing...

But the sense of speed and torque achieved by this high-precision V8 are not to be sniffed at.

What’s more, you'll be surprised at how light it is compared to its straight-six predecessor.

Indeed, this incredible car is worth having for its engine alone!
turns.en:
This E92 M3 is the fourth instalment in the BMW
M3 series that began with the E30.
Its pride is in its engine...

As it is the only generation of M3 to haul a howling V8.
At the time of its development, BMW was powering its other
cars with V10 engines built for F1 racing...

But the sense of speed and torque achieved by
this high-precision V8 are not to be sniffed at.
What’s more, you'll be surprised at how light it is
compared to its straight-six predecessor.

Indeed, this incredible car is worth having for
its engine alone!
turns.zh:
这款E92 M3是BMW M3车系
继E30后的第四款车。
这款车最引以为傲的是其引擎……

是M3系列中唯一搭载高亢V8引擎的一代车型。
在研发这款车型时，BMW仍采用V10引擎
打造其他F1比赛的车型……

但是，这台高精度V8引擎所实现的速度和扭矩
不容小觑。
更令人惊讶的是，相比于其前代搭载的直列六缸引擎，
这具引擎是如此轻巧。

确实，单纯就冲那引擎，
这款突破想象的车型就值得拥有！
turns.speaker: Chris

turns.raw:
If you're seeking thrills that only a German GT car can offer, then the BMW M3 is for you!

This E46 M3 came powered by a mighty S54B inline-6.

This engine delivered high revs and a power output that was simply out of this world.

It is without a doubt an icon among icons.

The E46 also exhibited the exceptional FR handling that drivers have come to expect in BMW cars.

Indeed, more and more people will be singing its praises in the years to come, you'll see.
turns.en:
If you're seeking thrills that only a German GT car
can offer, then the BMW M3 is for you!
This E46 M3 came powered by a mighty S54B inline-6.

This engine delivered high revs and a power output that was
simply out of this world.

It is without a doubt an icon among icons.
The E46 also exhibited the exceptional FR handling that drivers
have come to expect in BMW cars.

Indeed, more and more people will be singing its praises
in the years to come, you'll see.
turns.zh:
如果你追求只有跑车引擎才能提供的刺激感，
那么选BMW M3系列肯定没错！
这款E46 M3搭载S54B直列六缸引擎……

产生的极高转速和强大的动力输出，简直让你感觉飞出天际。

这款车毫无疑问是经典中的经典。
E46也展现出了BMW跑车向来优异的
前置后驱操控性能。

可以肯定的是，
会有越来越多的人迷上这款车。
turns.speaker: Chris

turns.raw:
The Alfa Romeo 4C is a car with plenty of charm.

First and foremost, it's impressively light, weighing a mere <895kg>!

This is rather astounding when one considers the design trends of the 2010s.

Its innovative carbon-fiber body really paid off in this respect.

Although powered by a small turbocharged 1.8-liter engine, the car's lightweight nature made it accelerate like a super car.

Moreover, its mid-engine sports car proportions made it a sight to behold.

It even pays homage to Alfa Romeo's historic Tipo 33 Stradale.
turns.en:
The Alfa Romeo 4C is a car with plenty of charm.
First and foremost, it's impressively light,
weighing a mere 895kg!

This is rather astounding when one considers the design
trends of the 2010s.
Its innovative carbon-fiber body really
paid off in this respect.
Although powered by a small turbocharged 1.8-liter engine, the
car's lightweight nature made it accelerate like a super car.
Moreover, its mid-engine sports car proportions
made it a sight to behold.

It even pays homage to Alfa Romeo's historic
Tipo 33 Stradale.
turns.zh:
4C这款车极具魅力……
首先，它轻巧之极，整车仅重895kg
，令人印象深刻！

考虑到2010年那时的设计趋势，
这是相当让人惊愕的。
创新的碳纤维车身，
对轻量化有极大帮助。
虽然只搭载了1.8L涡轮引擎，但轻盈的车身
让这辆车能飙出超跑的速度。
此外，中置引擎的跑车设计
确实令人耳目一新。

这样的设计，是在向Alfa Romeo史上具有
非凡意义的Tipo 33 Stradale致敬。
turns.speaker: Chris

There's no doubt about it, this hot hatch defined the 2000s.

It's a truly refined machine, from its graceful design to its amazing on-road performance.

The styling in particular brings to mind the 8C Competizione.

Now, this is a true icon! A modern take on the Ford GT40 of Le Mans fame.

It was built to commemorate Ford's 100th anniversary.

In terms of design, it conjured up memories of the beautiful race cars that played a big role at Le Mans in the 1960s.

Under the sheet metal, however, it was completely revamped, with an innovative aluminum space frame.

Also, in a brilliant move, it combined a supercharged mid-mounted V8 engine...

...with a 6-speed manual gearbox.

Honestly, I can't imagine the value of this beauty ever going down.
turns.en:

turns.zh:
现在这款车可以说是真的经典！
因勒芒耐力赛而闻名的现代版Ford GT40……

为庆祝Ford成立100周年而制造。
从设计上来看，令人回忆起那些在20世纪60年代
大放异彩的赛车。
至于内装，则完全改头换面，
采用全新研发的铝制空间车架。
这款车另一项高明的设计是搭载
中置V8机械增压引擎……

并配备六速手动变速箱。
坦白说，我觉得这款尤物的价值
不可能下降。

Ford's F-Series is the most popular line of pickup trucks in North America.

And the Raptor is by far the highest performance model of the bunch.

One design objective was to optimize it for off-road racing, therefore, the truck possesses sports-car-like handling.

The Raptor boasts a wide body, reinforced suspension and a 6.2-liter V-8 capable of producing more than <400ps>.

turns.raw:
This car taught the world the true meaning of "Turbo". Even today it is often referred to as simply "Turbo."

Porsche poured all of its the engineering expertise into the turbocharger that powered this Type 930 911.

Compared to the 1978 model, the flat-6 engine had more displacement, at 3.3 liters, and an output of <300ps>.

Because the 911 is a rear-engine car, more load is placed on the rear tires, giving it superior traction.

Add to this a turbocharger, and you've got a machine that can really get up and go!

This 930 holds its own among Porsche's many masterpieces and belongs in every enthusiast's collection.
turns.en:
This car taught the world the true meaning of "Turbo".
Even today it is often referred to as simply "Turbo."
Porsche poured all of its the engineering expertise into the
turbocharger that powered this Type 930 911.

Compared to the 1978 model, the flat-6 engine had more
displacement, at 3.3 liters, and an output of 300ps.
Because the 911 is a rear-engine car, more load is placed on
the rear tires, giving it superior traction.

Add to this a turbocharger, and you've got a machine that
can really get up and go!
This 930 holds its own among Porsche's many masterpieces
and belongs in every enthusiast's collection.
turns.zh:
这辆车让世界领教到了“涡轮”的真正含义。
即使在今天，这辆车也会经常被提起。
Porsche汇集了他们所有的涡轮设计经验，
然后将其倾注到了这台930型911的涡轮上。

相比79年版，这款车的排气量提升到了3.3升，动力也增加至了300ps。
由于911是一辆后置引擎的跑车，其后轮承受的重量更多，
产生的抓地力也更大。

在这些基础上，涡轮增压器更是大幅增加了这辆车的进气量！
这辆930在Porsche众多杰作中占有一席之地，非常有收藏价值。
turns.speaker: Chris

Now, there's a beauty! This isn’t just any Supra, you know.

It's known as a "homologation model," meaning it was developed primarily as a race car.

Toyota's reason for creating it was to win the Group A title in the Japanese Touring Car Championship.

To ensure it was battle-ready, the engineers performed various mechanical upgrades.

These included a turbine and intercooler, as well as parts for naturally-aspirated and turbocharged engines.

As a result, the Turbo A produced <30ps> more than the base model.

With production capped at 500 units, this homologation model sold out in the blink of an eye.

Aside from the wheel color and bumper shape, it doesn’t look too different from its forebear.

However, those in the know will instantly recognize its worth.

With production capped at 500 units, this homologation model

turns.zh:
天啊！这可不是一辆普通的Supra……

这是一辆为竞赛而生的“赛事认证”型。
丰田当时想用这辆车夺得日本房车锦标赛的A组别桂冠。

为了准备这项赛事，这辆车得到了多处机械升级。
这些升级包括一台涡轮机和中冷器，以及
自然吸气和涡轮增压发动机的部件。
这些升级使这辆车的马力比基础车型提高了30ps。
由于生产上限是500辆，“赛事认证”型转眼间就卖光了。

除了轮毂颜色和保险杠形状之外，
它的外形与基本型完全一样。

然而，有眼光的人
肯定一眼就能看出它的价值！

The 300 SL, which was introduced in the 1950s, is considered a masterpiece of Mercedes-Benz engineering to this day.

This SLS AMG brings that legendary vehicle to the 21st century.

And, it revives the most iconic feature of the 300 SL, which are those gullwing doors!

The GR Yaris was developed by Toyota as a rare example of a fully in-house sports car.

It featured a carbon-fiber roof and a highly rigid body structure designed specifically for this model.

Its engine and all-wheel-drive system were also purpose-built.

The car was engineered from the ground up to compete in the World Rally Championship (WRC).

It delivered an exceptionally engaging driving experience, with performance that rivaled far more expensive cars.

It stands as a model likely to leave a lasting mark in automotive history.

The Jaguar XJ220 is celebrated the world over as one of the most unique super cars of the 1990s.

It began as a pet project for several Jaguar engineers and designers...

...who, together, worked off the clock.

It is for this reason that the team that made the XJ220 came to be known as "The Saturday Club."

You might say that this car represented the free expression of lofty ideals held by Jaguar employees.

Once the prototype was unveiled, it attracted attention everywhere, leading to official development and production.

Combining the beauty of Jaguar’s legendary 1960s race cars...

...with the performance of its 1990s race machines...

...built by the experts at England’s most storied luxury car builder, the XJ220 was a car like no other.

turns.zh:
捷豹XJ220被全世界车迷誉为
二十世纪九十年代最独具魅力的超级跑车。
这款车最初只是几名捷豹工程师和设计师的私人项目……

在工作之余进行研发。
正因如此，打造XJ220的团队也后人被称为“星期六俱乐部”。

可以说，这辆车充分地代表了捷豹员工
对于自己理念的自由表达。
这台原型车甫一亮相，便立刻在全世界范围内造成了轰动，
也让公司下定决心，开启正式研发并投产。
这台车结合了品牌六十年代传奇赛车的优雅造型……

以及九十年代赛车的超强性能……
还有英格兰那历史悠久的豪华车制造专业知识，
可以称得上是绝无仅有的珍宝。
turns.speaker: Chris

The Giulia Sprint is one of the most popular cars that Alfa Romeo ever produced.

Because the Sprint also came as a 4-door sedan, this car was also called the Giulia coupe.

It became a world-famous sports car, penned by genius car designer Giorgetto Giugiaro.

Alfa Romeo had its start building super-fast race cars to compete in grand prix races.

So, they’ve long had the technical know-how to build high-performance engines.

This Giulia Sprint may be small, but it’s powered by a mighty inline-4 engine with a DOHC head.

Combined with a rear-wheel-drive layout, it’s an absolute thrill to ride.

And, it served as the base for a super-lightweight GTA model, too.

I

The Giulia Sprint is one of the most popular cars that
Alfa Romeo ever produced.
Because the Sprint also came as a 4-door sedan,
this car was also called the Giulia coupe.

It became a world-famous sports car, penned by genius car designer
Giorgetto Giugiaro.
Alfa Romeo had its start building super-fast race cars
to compete in grand prix races.

So, they’ve long had the technical know-how
to build high-performance engines.
This Giulia Sprint may be small, but it’s powered
by a mighty inline-4 engine with a DOHC head.

And, it served as the base for a super-lightweight
GTA model, too.
turns.zh:
朱丽叶竞速是阿尔法罗密欧旗下的最受欢迎的汽车之一。
由于竞速所属的车系下还有一台四门轿车，所以
它也被称为“朱丽叶轿跑”。

这是一辆世界闻名的跑车，由天才汽车设计师
乔盖托·乔治亚罗操刀设计。
阿尔法罗密欧从创立之初就致力于制造用于参加
大奖赛的高速赛车。

因此长期积累了制造高性能引擎所需的技术知识。

turns.zh:
打从降生的那一刻起，这台阿斯顿马丁Valkyrie已经具备了
成为传奇的素质。

它是英国百年老牌跑车制造商和红牛车队携手合作的产物。
它的空气动力学元素由F1历史上最伟大的设计师之一
——阿德里安·纽维操刀设计。
但是别以为这就完了，听听它那6.5升自然进气V12引擎的轰鸣……

它能在10500rpm下产生高达1000ps的动力！
你可以说这是一台跨界引擎，就算安装在F1赛车上也毫不逊色。
而且，信不信由你，这车居然还能合法上路！

它是目前与F1专业知识结合得最完美、最棒的跑车。
turns.speaker: Chris

Ah, 1953—an unforgettable year! That was the year that gave us the "C1," or first-gen Chevrolet Corvette.

And so began the age of mass-production sports cars in the United States of America.

While sports cars were already stateside, they were mostly European—and if not, they were rare and costly.

In other words, a truly "American" sports car had yet to be born.

Then General Motors released the Chevrolet Corvette.

From 1953 on, this roofless 2-seater pretty much underwent yearly upgrades, each time promising more and more power.

This C1 Corvette is from 1958, and is well-known for its major design overhaul.

Two headlights became four, and the hood was given a number of fake louvres.

By the time 1960 rolled around, GM was selling many C1s, a sign of its enduring popularity.

To this day, the Corvette remains�synonymous with American sports car culture...

...making it one of the most important sports cars in automotive history.

turns.zh:
啊，1953——令人难忘的一年！
在这一年，“C1”，也就是第一代的雪佛兰科尔维特诞生了。

这也标志着美国量产跑车时代的开端。
虽然当时跑车在美国已不少见，但这些跑车大多数来自欧洲。
而非欧洲跑车车型就更加凤毛麟角，而且价格高昂了。

换句话说，真正“美国”产的跑车还没有诞生。
就在此时，通用汽车发布了雪佛兰科尔维特。

从1953年开始，这辆无顶双座跑车几乎每年都要进行更新，
而且每次的动力都变得愈发强大。
这辆C1科尔维特来自1958年，因其设计上的重大更改而闻名。

两枚大灯增加到四枚，引擎盖上增加了几处伪百叶格栅。

到了1960年，通用汽车的C1产量仍然可观，可见该车型
经久不衰的人气。
直至今日，科尔维特仍然是美国跑车文化的代名词……

这令它成为了汽车历史上最重要的跑车之一。
turns.speaker: Chris

turns.raw:
This here is the 7th generation of the Civic Type R.

I hear it set a fabulous time at the notoriously tough Nürburgring track in Germany.

Speaking of Honda sports cars and the Nürburgring...

...the first-generation NSX was test-driven there during its development.

Rumor has it, after its first test run, the test driver came back with a curious complaint.

Apparently, the car had not performed very well "in the air."

Now, the Nürburgring is known for its elevation changes and many "jumps."

Still, when the Honda engineers heard the news, they were shocked.

Honda later built its own test track based on the Nürburgring in Hokkaido, Japan.

The track is known as Takasu Proving Ground.

This new Type R was developed at the Takasu Proving Ground and the Suzuka Circuit.


turns.en:
This here is the 7th generation
of the Civic Type R.

I hear it set a fabulous time at the notoriously tough
Nürburgring track in Germany.
Speaking of Honda sports cars and the Nürburgring...

...the first-generation NSX was test-driven there
during its development.
Rumor has it, after its first test run, the test driver
came back with a curious complaint.

Apparently, the car had not performed very well
"in the air."

Now, the Nürburgring is known for its elevation changes
and many "jumps."

Still, when the Honda engineers heard the news,
they were shocked.
Honda later built its own test track based on
the Nürburgring in Hokkaido, Japan.

The track is known as Takasu Proving Ground.
This new Type R was developed at the Takasu Proving Ground and the Suzuka Circuit.
turns.zh:
这是第七代思域Type R。

我听说它在德国以挑战难度最高而著称的纽博格林赛道上
创下了惊人的圈速记录。
说到本田的跑车和纽博格林赛道……

第一代NSX在研发期间就选择了在那里试驾。
传闻称，在首次试跑之后，试驾员给出了
一个“奇特”的负面评价，

说这辆车在“空中”的表现不佳。

这并不让人意外，因为纽博格林赛道以其起伏的路面
和许多“飞越”而闻名。

然而，当本田的工程师们听到这个消息时，还是感到十分震惊。
之后，本田在日本北海道建造了一条以纽博格林赛道为原型
的测试赛道，

该赛道被命名为“鹰栖试车场”。
这款新的Type R就是通过在鹰栖试车场和铃鹿赛道
不断测试而开发的。
turns.speaker: Chris

turns.raw:
This here is the 7th generation of the Civic Type R.

I hear it set a fabulous time at the notoriously tough Nürburgring track in Germany.

Speaking of Honda sports cars and the Nürburgring...

...the first-generation NSX was test-driven there during its development.

Rumor has it, after its first test run, the test driver came back with a curious complaint.

Apparently, the car had not performed very well "in the air."

Now, the Nürburgring is known for its elevation changes and many "jumps."

Still, when the Honda engineers heard the news, they were shocked.

Honda later built its own test track based on the Nürburgring in Hokkaido, Japan.

The track is known as Takasu Proving Ground.

This new Type R was developed at the Takasu Proving Ground and the Suzuka Circuit.

的测试赛道，

该赛道被命名为“鹰栖试车场”。
这款新的Type R就是通过在鹰栖试车场和铃鹿赛道
不断测试而开发的。

turns.raw:
This here’s a legend of American stock car racing.

In stock car racing, production-model cars are raced pretty much as-is.

The Superbird’s large rear wing and long front nose were essential tools...

...for winning NASCAR races, the top tier of stock car racing in the United States.

Basically, they were special racing parts for a production car.

In its effort to meet NASCAR homologation, the Superbird was sold for but one year...

...and few were ever produced.

Afterwards, stock car races began to feature more and more pure race cars.

Indeed, this car is from an age when street cars and race cars greatly resembled each other.

car racing in the United States.

In its effort to meet NASCAR homologation,

Afterwards, stock car races began to feature more

turns.zh:
这一辆是美国改装赛车比赛中的传奇。
在改装赛车比赛中，量产型的车辆通常是以原始的出厂配置的状态直接参与竞速。

这辆Superbird的大号后翼和长车鼻都是竞速利器……

能够帮助它赢得美国的顶级改装赛车赛事——纳斯卡赛车。

事实上，这些车身部件都是专门服务于量产型车辆的特殊竞速部件。
为了满足纳斯卡赛车的赛事资格认证条件，
Superbird仅对外销售一年……

总产量也不多。

在那之后，改装赛车比赛开始涌入越来越多种类的赛车。
的确，这款车来自于那个公路车和赛车
相似度极高的时代。
turns.speaker: Chris

例如P1800和1800ES之类的经典Volvo车型！

turns.raw:
The Unimog—a versatile, multi-purpose truck with a storied legacy has been a legend among enthusiasts for decades.

Its remarkable history traces all the way back to 1945.

It was originally designed as an agricultural workhorse.

And, it first entered production in 1948.

The 411 you see here belongs to the second-generation series from 1956.

In addition to boasting a more powerful engine than the 401, it was equipped with a wide array of specialized attachments.

It was the most well-rounded of the early Unimogs. Its endearing design has captured the hearts of countless tractor enthusiasts.

has been a legend among enthusiasts for decades.
Its remarkable history traces all the way back to 1945.

It was originally designed as an agricultural workhorse.

And, it first entered production in 1948.
The 411 you see here belongs to the second-generation
series from 1956.

In addition to boasting a more powerful engine than the 401, it
was equipped with a wide array of specialized attachments.
It was the most well-rounded of the early Unimogs. Its endearing
design has captured the hearts of countless tractor enthusiasts.
turns.zh:
作为多功能卡车界的“活化石”，Unimog
数十年来一直是车迷心中的机械传奇。
事实上，它的传奇历史甚至可以追溯到1945年！

最初被设计为农用机械的它……

于1948年正式量产。
眼前这台411属于1956年诞生的第二代车型。

相较401型，不仅引擎功率大幅提升，更配有
整套专业级拓展套件。
作为早期Unimog家族最全能的成员，其独特设计
征服了无数拖拉机爱好者。
turns.speaker: Chris

turns.raw:
Nismo is the name of Nissan’s in-house works team.

They are famous for building production cars packed with racing know-how.

In 2004, to mark its 20th anniversary, Nismo introduced this R34 GT-R Z-tune.

Of all the Nismo products, this one takes the crown.

At the time of its release, the R34 Skyline GT-R was already retired.

This meant that the Z-tune had to be based on used cars. Naturally, only those deemed excellent by Nismo were used.

The engines and bodies were disassembled and reengineered with racing technology.

Today, R34 GT-Rs are celebrated as prized collector’s cars across the globe.

But none more than the legendary Z-tune!

Nismo is the name of Nissan’s in-house works team.

They are famous for building production cars packed
with racing know-how.
In 2004, to mark its 20th anniversary, Nismo introduced
this R34 GT-R Z-tune.

Of all the Nismo products, this one takes the crown.
At the time of its release, the R34 Skyline GT-R was
already retired.

This meant that the Z-tune had to be based on used cars.
Naturally, only those deemed excellent by Nismo were used.

The engines and bodies were disassembled and reengineered
with racing technology.
Today, R34 GT-Rs are celebrated as prized collector’s cars
across the globe.

But none more than the legendary Z-tune!
turns.zh:
Nismo是Nissan自家厂队的名称，

以打造出结合诸多赛车技术的量产车而闻名。
2004年，为纪念成立20周年，Nismo推出了
这款R34 GT-R Z-tune。

在所有Nismo作品中，这款车堪称巅峰之作。
在它发布之时，R34 Skyline GT-R已经停产退役……

这意味着Z-tune必须以旧款车型为基础来进行打造。
自然，只有那些被Nismo评定为极品的车辆才会被选用。

引擎和车身随后被拆解，并运用赛车技术
进行重新改造。
如今，R34 GT-R被全世界奉为收藏珍品。

而其中最珍贵的莫过于Z-tune！]

Nismo is the name of Nissan’s in-house works team.

They are famous for building production cars packed with racing know-how.

In 2004, to mark its 20th anniversary, Nismo introduced this R34 GT-R Z-tune.

Of all the Nismo products, this one takes the crown.

At the time of its release, the R34 Skyline GT-R was already retired.

This meant that the Z-tune had to be based on used cars. Naturally, only those deemed excellent by Nismo were used.

The engines and bodies were disassembled and reengineered with racing technology.

Today, R34 GT-Rs are celebrated as prized collector’s cars across the globe.

But none more than the legendary Z-tune!

Lancia of Italy had long been a dominant force in the World Rally Championship.

This Group A rally version of the Delta stands as a testament to Lancia’s many triumphs.

From 1987 to 1992, the marque secured six consecutive manufacturers’ championships.

It was a legendary achievement—one that remains unmatched in the history of the world’s premier rally series.

This Group A Delta rally car stands as an undeniable testament to Lancia’s dominance in the sport.

Even the production car version, built for Group B homologation...

...is the envy of car collectors everywhere!

~

in the World Rally Championship.

turns.zh:
意大利的Lancia在很长一段时间里都是
世界拉力锦标赛统治级的存在。

这款Delta Group A拉力赛版本正是其荣耀传承中的闪耀瑰宝。
从1987年到1992年，Lancia豪取六连车厂冠军头衔……

这项传奇成就在世界顶级拉力赛事中至今无人能复刻。
这台Delta Group A拉力赛车无疑是Lancia成功的见证。
即便只是作为为了满足Gr.B组别认证而打造的
量产版车型……

也令全球汽车藏家艳羡不已！
turns.speaker: Chris

turns.raw:
Renault is famous for its minivans, especially the Espace.

This Avantime may resemble a minivan, but it was really intended to be a two-door coupe.

A truly unique car, if I may say so.

It was designed by none other than Patrick le Quément, chief designer at Renault from the 1980s to the 2000s.

Released in 2001, it had a remarkably brief production run of two short years.

A shame, really, as it’s a car overflowing with character, inside and out. Indeed, I feel there’s nothing quite like it.

No wonder it continues to attract fans all over the world. It’s another shining achievement in Renault’s long history.

turns.en:
Renault is famous for its minivans, especially the Espace.
This Avantime may resemble a minivan, but it
was really intended to be a two-door coupe.
A truly unique car, if I may say so.

It was designed by none other than Patrick le Quément,
chief designer at Renault from the 1980s to the 2000s.
Released in 2001, it had a remarkably brief production run
of two short years.

A shame, really, as it’s a car overflowing with character,
inside and out. Indeed, I feel there’s nothing quite like it.
No wonder it continues to attract fans all over the world.
It’s another shining achievement in Renault’s long history.
turns.zh:
雷诺以其打造的多功能乘用车而闻名，特别是Espace。
虽然这款Avantime看起来像多功能乘用车，但实际上
它是按照双门轿跑车的标准打造的。
实话实说，这确实是一款独一无二的车。

它的设计师正是帕特里克·勒·奎芒，
他在1980年代至2000年代期间担任雷诺的首席设计师。
该车于2001年发布，生产周期却异常短暂，
仅仅持续了两年时间。

这实在令人惋惜，因为这是一款由内到外都充满个性
的汽车。说真的，我觉得再也找不到如此特立独行的车型了。
难怪它至今仍吸引着世界各地的车迷。
这又是雷诺悠久历史中的一项辉煌成就。

turns.raw:
This is the successor to the legendary original Skyline GT-R, or "Hakosuka," as it was affectionately known in Japan.

This car earned its nickname from an ad campaign featuring a charming young couple known as “Ken” and “Mary.”

Among Skyline fans, it has forever been remembered by that name —the “Kenmeri GT-R.”

The Hakosuka rose to prominence in Japanese touring car racing, earning a fearsome reputation for being unstoppable.

Naturally, the Kenmeri was expected to carry the torch passed down by its proud predecessor. But fate had other plans.

The 1970s ushered in a new era of strict emissions regulations, cutting short the Kenmeri’s racing legacy before it began.

Because of these regulations, building cars with high-performance engines like the GT-R became impossible.

And so, just four months after the Kenmeri went on sale,� production ended, leaving behind only 197 units ever built.

Although it never had a chance to compete in any races...

...its tragic fate and small production run have made it—in the eyes of enthusiasts—a legend all its own.

,

turns.zh:
此车是传奇初代天际线GT-R的继承者，
后者在日本被亲切地称为“箱型”……

而本车的昵称则源自一则流行广告，在广告中出现了
一对名为“肯”与“玛丽”的可爱年轻情侣。

因此，在天际线车迷圈中，如今人们都称这款车为
“肯·玛丽GT-R”。
前辈“箱型”在日本房车赛事中声名鹊起，
赢得了不可战胜的美誉。

按理说，“肯·玛丽”本应延续其前辈铸就的辉煌……

然而时运不济，1970年代恰逢严格的排放法规
开始实施的时代。
这些法规导致GT-R这类搭载高性能引擎的车型
无法继续生产。
因此，“肯·玛丽”在上市仅四个月后便宣告停产，
最终产量定格在197台。

虽然它从未有机会踏上赛场……
但悲情的命运与稀有的产量，反而成就了
其独特的传奇地位。
turns.speaker: Chris

虽然它从未有机会踏上赛场……
但悲情的命运与稀有的产量，反而成就了
其独特的传奇地位。

turns.raw:
The Toyota Land Cruiser is the vehicle that effectively wrote the first chapter of Japanese off-road history.

Released in 1960, the “40” marked the third-generation model.

In Japan, fans affectionately call it the “Yonmaru,” a nickname drawn from the Japanese pronunciation of its model number.

A commercial vehicle built to haul goods in agriculture and farming, it also served first-responders in times of emergency.

Above all else, it was created with one purpose in mind— to be a true “working vehicle."

From its ladder-frame chassis to its suspension, every component was engineered with durability in mind.

Well-built and dependable, it embodied all the qualities that made the Land Cruiser a legend.

With an impressive production run that has lasted 24 years...

...this best-selling SUV has made the Land Cruiser a household name all over the world.

turns.zh:
丰田Land Cruiser是真正开创

这款1960年发布的“40系”是第三代车型。

它被日本车迷亲切地称为“四丸”，

从梯形车架底盘到悬挂系统，

制造精良且可靠耐用，它完美体现了
Land Cruiser的所有优秀特质。

凭借长达24年的辉煌生产周期……
这款畅销车型让Land Cruiser之名
享誉全球，家喻户晓。

turns.raw:
The Espace F1 was unveiled in 1994 at the Paris Motor Show.

More than 30 years have passed since then, yet it remains as astonishing as ever.

Based on the wildly popular family car, the Renault Espace...

...the Espace F1 was powered by a Renault V-10 engine from the 1992 Formula 1 champion machine, the Williams FW14B.

It was transplanted amidships in true race-car fashion.

At the time, Renault and Williams were the dominant duo in Formula 1 racing.

But no one expected them to install an F1 engine in a minivan! It was, indeed, a fantastical concept.

Although it never reached production, it remains a brilliant star in Renault’s history.

�
turns.en:
The Espace F1 was unveiled in 1994
at the Paris Motor Show.

More than 30 years have passed since then,
yet it remains as astonishing as ever.
Based on the wildly popular family car,
the Renault Espace...

...the Espace F1 was powered by a Renault V-10 engine from the
1992 Formula 1 champion machine, the Williams FW14B.

It was transplanted amidships in true race-car fashion.
At the time, Renault and Williams were the dominant duo
in Formula 1 racing.

But no one expected them to install an F1 engine in a
minivan! It was, indeed, a fantastical concept.
Although it never reached production, it remains a brilliant star
in Renault’s history.
turns.zh:
Espace F1于1994年在巴黎国际车展首次亮相。

三十余年后的今天，这款车型依然令人叹为观止。
基于风靡全球的家用车型Renault Espace打造……

Espace F1搭载的Renault V10引擎
源自1992年F1冠军赛车，Williams车队的FW14B……

并依照赛车规格采用中置布局。
当时Renault和Williams堪称
一级方程式赛场的黄金组合。

但谁也未曾料想，他们竟会将F1引擎
植入一台家用MPV！这无疑是天马行空的创举。
虽未量产上市，此车始终是Renault品牌史上
璀璨夺目的传奇之作。@
turns.speaker: Chris

Since its debut in 1980, this first-gen Fiat Panda went on to become a best-seller with a 20-year-plus production run.

The basic car par excellence, it remains beloved by drivers all over the world.

The original Panda is perhaps the car most associated with the world-class car designer Giorgetto Giugiaro.

Fiat entrusted him with designing the next generation of the compact car.

The objective was a car combining intuitive handling with cost-effective production.

Drawing on his deep knowledge of automotive design, Giugiaro came up with solutions to all sorts of problems...

...such as the economical use of flat glass for all of the car's window surfaces.

Indeed, this masterpiece is simply brimming with hallmarks of his inimitable genius!

turns.zh:
自1980年问世以来，这款初代菲亚特Panda
以长达二十余年的生产周期成为常青车型。

作为极致简约却性能卓著的经典代表，
至今仍深受全球车迷喜爱。
初代Panda可谓是与世界级设计大师
乔盖托·乔治亚罗最具渊源的车型。

菲亚特将这款紧凑车型的换代设计全权委托于他。
设计计划书要求打造兼具直观操控体验
与亲民制造成本的车型。
凭借深厚的汽车设计造诣，
乔治亚罗采用创新方案解决了诸多难题……

诸如全车玻璃表面均采用成本更有优势的平板玻璃。
毫无疑问，这件杰作处处闪耀着
大师独一无二的设计智慧！
turns.speaker: Chris

纽博格林耐力系列赛的第8轮比赛中！
它在排位赛中获得总成绩第二名，在决赛中获得总成绩
第五名。作为初出茅庐的新车，这个成绩还不错吧？
因为这款车还没正式上市销售，所以它作为测试车参加
SPX级的比赛。
总而言之，R8 LMS Evo从一开始就完全展示了它的肌肉。

之后也继续在世界各地的超级跑车比赛中再创佳绩。

It went on to compete successfully in GT racing series around the world.

在2019年巴黎车展上公布后仅3天，这辆车就出现在
纽博格林耐力系列赛的第8轮比赛中！
它在排位赛中获得总成绩第二名，在决赛中获得总成绩
第五名。作为初出茅庐的新车，这个成绩还不错吧？
因为这款车还没正式上市销售，所以它作为测试车参加
SPX级的比赛。
总而言之，R8 LMS Evo从一开始就完全展示了它的肌肉。

Have you ever heard of the German ADAC GT Masters?

It's a race where each car has a pair of drivers, one amateur and one pro.

For the 2016 ADAC Masters, Chevrolet entered a Corvette C7 FIA-GT3.

The following year, they claimed both driver and team championships.

This is a car that an amateur can handle, but which can also withstand any punishment a pro can throw at it.

Yep, in terms of performance, this Corvette C7 Gr.3 machine is quite something.

turns.raw:
Lamborghini actually never really got into motorsports as a manufacturer over the years

But when it developed an FIA-GT3 car based on the Huracán in 2015...

...the company finally sent a works machine into the circuit!

It made its debut at the 2015 Blancpain Endurance Series.

And it totally left the other cars in the dust, finishing winning by a margin of 30 seconds.

The car was actually disqualified at one point because of a rule violation in the team's refueling equipment.

But the team appealed and won, and so did the GT3's in its debut race.
turns.en:

as a manufacturer over the yearsBut when it developed an FIA-GT3 car based on the
Huracán in 2015...

And it totally left the other cars in the dust,
finishing winning by a margin of 30 seconds.The car was actually disqualified at one point
because of a rule violation in the team's refueling equipment.
But the team appealed and won,
and so did the GT3's in its debut race.
turns.zh:
你知道么？Lamborghini作为一家制造商，其实很多年
都没有真正参加过赛车运动了。
但他们积极做出了改变，在2015年基于Huracán打造了
这款FIA-GT3，

终于把它们的车送上了赛道！
它在2015年的宝珀耐力系列赛上首次亮相，

就让它的对手们完全望尘莫及，以比第二名快了30秒的
成绩夺得了冠军。
实际上，他们在比赛中一度被取消了资格，因为赛会判
定他们的加油设备出现了违规。

但是他们的上诉成功了，最终在首秀中就赢得了冠军。
turns.speaker: Jeremy

...the company finally sent a works machine into the circuit!

It made its debut at the 2015 Blancpain Endurance Series.

And it totally left the other cars in the dust, finishing winning by a margin of 30 seconds.

The car was actually disqualified at one point because of a rule violation in the team's refueling equipment.

But the team appealed and won, and so did the GT3's in its debut race.

You know, the R33 GT-R always reminds me of Le Mans in 1995.

At the time, regulations prevented cars from entering if a four-door version existed in the lineup.

So, Nissan developed a special 2-door “NISMO GT-R LM."

It was registered in the U.K. to meet homologation requirements.

And Nissan succeeded in entering the car at Le Mans.

It showed just how determined team manager, Kozo Watanabe was...

...to see the GT-R compete in the race.
turns.en:

a four-door version existed in the lineup.

turns.zh:
说起R33 GT-R，总是让我想起
1995年的勒芒24小时耐力赛。
因为当时的勒芒规则明确规定：
若某车系拥有四门版本，则其赛车不得参赛。

为此，Nissan特别打造了一辆双门版的Nissan NISMO GT-R LM，

在英国注册并通过了赛事认证，
这才成功将这辆车送上了勒芒的起跑线。

由此可见，这辆GT-R的研发主管渡边衡三

让其参加勒芒24小时耐力赛的意愿是何等强烈！
turns.speaker: Jeremy

Ah, Car No. 1, this one brings back memories.

It’s the Pennzoil NISMO GT-R that competed in the 1999 All Japan GT Championship.

Érik Comas drove the No. 23 Pennzoil GT-R to victory...

...earning the No. 1 designation for the following season.

Oh, and here’s a bit of trivia, if you’re interested.

Many Nissan GT race cars carry the number 23, right?

That number comes from the Japanese pronunciation of 2-3 (ni-san).

It’s a long-standing tradition for Nissan race cars to wear this number, seen well before 1999.

这样的成绩完全显示出了GR Supra的卓越性能。

turns.raw:
Ah, so this is the GR Supra that entered the Nürburgring 24 Hour race just a month after it went on sale...

Did you know the driver for the first stint of the final was none other than Toyota President, Akio 'Morizo' Toyoda?

Basically, the man who brought the GR Supra to life!

The car was basically the retail model, with the bare minimum safety equipment needed to race.

Still, it managed to claim 41st place overall, and was third in its class.

It totally showed how good a performer the GR Supra really is.

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_RaceEnthusiast_normal_castrol_toms_supra_97_1500704
turns.raw:
Japan's GT Championship in the late 1990s was a three-way battle between the Nissan Skyline, Honda NSX and the Toyota Supra.

The battles amongst Japan's three major car manufacturers was one for the ages!

By the final round, which was run in the pouring rain, all three teams were still in contention for the title.

Even after the checkered flag was waved, it wasn't certain who had won the series.

That's because two teams were tied for the top spot, and their 2nd-place finishes were also even.

This meant the tiebreaker came down to the number of 3rd-place finishes they had recorded over the season...

In the end, the Tom's Supra Number 36 came out on top in the historic 1997 season.



between the Nissan Skyline, Honda NSX and the Toyota Supra.
The battles amongst Japan's three major car manufacturers
was one for the ages!

By the final round, which was run in the pouring rain,
all three teams were still in contention for the title.
Even after the checkered flag was waved, it wasn't
certain who had won the series.
That's because two teams were tied for the top spot, and
their 2nd-place finishes were also even.

This meant the tiebreaker came down to the number of 3rd-place

In the end, the Tom's Supra Number 36 came out
on top in the historic 1997 season.
turns.zh:
二十世纪九十年代末，日本房车锦标赛呈现的是三足鼎立
的态势：日产天际线、本田NSX和丰田Supra。
这辆Tom's Supra在1997年夺冠的那一役，
堪称一场真正的悬念大戏！

战至大雨滂沱的最后一轮比赛中，
竟仍有4支车队保有夺冠可能！
甚至在方格旗落下之后，冠军归属仍然扑朔迷离。
因为有两支车队积分持平、并列第一，就连他们在赛季中获得亚军
的次数也完全相同。

最后为了决定胜负，竟要追溯这两支车队
在整个赛季中获得季军的次数！
而这辆36号Tom's Supra正是从那场扣人心弦的
1997年冠军决战中脱颖而出的最终王者！
turns.speaker: Jeremy

turns.raw:
The Yaris WRC is a car that totally dominated the World Rally Championships.

It claimed the Manufacturers' title in 2018...

and in 2019 it took the Drivers' title as well, with a record six wins.

Sure enough, the GR Yaris was developed specifically with the goal of total domination of the WRC in mind.

Initially, a competition car was developed for the WRC, with a commercial car planned for homologation.

In any case, for a real motorsports fan, there aren't many cars on the road that are quite this exciting!

the World Rally Championships.

It claimed the Manufacturers' title in 2018...

and in 2019 it took the Drivers' title as well,
with a record six wins.

Sure enough, the GR Yaris was developed specifically
with the goal of total domination of the WRC in mind.
Initially, a competition car was developed for the WRC,
with a commercial car planned for homologation.
In any case, for a real motorsports fan, there aren't
many cars on the road that are quite this exciting!
turns.zh:
Yaris WRC是一款彻底统治了世界拉力锦标赛的赛车。

它在2018年获得了制造商冠军，

在2019年则取得创纪录的6场胜利，摘下车手冠军的桂冠。

我们可以确定的是，这辆GR Yaris是专为统治世界拉力
锦标赛而研发的！
他们先是制造了一台能在锦标赛上夺冠的比赛机器，
然后再规划量产车型，接受赛事认证。
不管怎么说，对于一个真正的赛车迷来说，这是少数几
辆能令人兴奋到不能自己的公路车！

turns.raw:
This third-generation GT-R Skyline played a lead role in reviving interest in Japanese touring car races!

A major hit upon its release in 1989, it's said to have sold some 43,000 units despite its high price tag.

A race-ready version was developed shortly after.

This car claimed a pole-to-win victory in the 1990 Japanese Touring Car Championship!

Following this great achievement, the race GT-R boasted 29 consecutive wins over the course of four years.

turns.zh:
这辆第三代GT-R Skyline是让日本房车赛
再次火爆起来的导火索车型！

但仍售出了43000辆左右。

并在1990年的日本房车大奖赛中以头位取胜。
在达成这一伟大成就之后，
它还在四年之内取得了29连胜。

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_RaceEnthusiast_normal_r34_gtr_v2_nur_02_1501004
turns.raw:
The fifth-generation Skyline GT-R went by the codename R34.

The man responsible for its development was Kozo Watanabe.

A graduate of Tokyo University, Watanabe earned a degree in automotive engineering.

The R34 was his follow-up to the R33.

A longtime admirer of race car development...

Watanabe wanted to go to Britain to develop Formula 1 cars.

But fate ialised and he began working for Nissan, which was then racing the R380 and the R381.

When Watanabe was tasked with developing the R33 Skyline GT-R...

...he swore he'd build a car that would exceed the speed of the R32.

It turned out, he kept his word. On a test run, the R33 set a lap time of 7:59 at the Nürburgring!

This time was 21 seconds faster than the fastest lap set by the R32.

The R33 then led to the R34, śhich carried on the spirit of its predecessor.

The fifth-generation Skyline GT-R went by the codename R34.
The man responsible for its development was
Kozo Watanabe.

A graduate of Tokyo University, Watanabe earned
a degree in automotive engineering.
The R34 was his follow-up to the R33.
A longtime admirer of race car development...

Watanabe wanted to go to Britain to develop Formula 1 cars.

But fate ialised and he began working for Nissan,
which was then racing the R380 and the R381.
When Watanabe was tasked with developing the R33
Skyline GT-R...

...he swore he'd build a car that would exceed the speed
of the R32.

It turned out, he kept his word. On a test run, the R33
set a lap time of 7:59 at the Nürburgring!
This time was 21 seconds faster than the fastest lap
set by the R32.

The R33 then led to the R34, śhich carried on the
spirit of its predecessor.
turns.zh: 这辆R34是第五代的Skyline GT-R。 这辆车的设计者是渡边衡三。 他毕业于东大汽车工程系。 R34是R33的后继车型。 渡边早对赛车开发早就心痒不已…… 他本想前往英国去设计F1赛车。 由于这个目标未能实现，他进入了 当时正在使用R380和R381竞赛的日产工作。 当渡边接到了设计Skyline GT-R R33的任务时…… 他曾发誓要造一辆比R32更快的车。 您猜怎么着？在试跑时，R33在纽博格林赛道上 跑出了7:59的单圈时间！ 比R32的记录快了21秒。 当然了，它的后继者R34身上也继承了这种精神。

The fifth-generation Skyline GT-R went by the codename R34.

The man responsible for its development was Kozo Watanabe.

A graduate of Tokyo University, Watanabe earned a degree in automotive engineering.

The R34 was his follow-up to the R33.

A longtime admirer of race car development...

Watanabe wanted to go to Britain to develop Formula 1 cars.

But fate ialised and he began working for Nissan, which was then racing the R380 and the R381.

When Watanabe was tasked with developing the R33 Skyline GT-R...

...he swore he'd build a car that would exceed the speed of the R32.

It turned out, he kept his word. On a test run, the R33 set a lap time of 7:59 at the Nürburgring!

This time was 21 seconds faster than the fastest lap set by the R32.

The R33 then led to the R34, śhich carried on the spirit of its predecessor.

The Pikes Peak Hill Climb is a race held in Colorado, USA.

It is a race in which drivers compete for the fastest time up a long and treacherous mountain road.

The course measures <20km>, climbing <1440m> to the finish at <4302m>—higher than Mount Fuji in Japan!

This Audi S1 shattered records with its victory at the storied event.

Based on a WRC machine, it featured large wings at the front and rear, ensuring maximum downforce.

But who was the driver behind the wheel on that winding “Race to the Clouds?"

Why, it was none other than WRC champion Walter Röhrl!

turns.zh:
派克峰爬坡赛是在美国科罗拉多州举办的比赛。

这是一场车手们需要在漫长而险峻的山路上
达成最快时间记录的赛事。
这条赛道长达20km，海拔始于1440m，终于4302m——比日本的富士山还要高！
这辆奥迪S1以破纪录的成绩在这场著名赛事中获得了胜利。
基于一辆世界拉力锦标赛赛车，这辆车前后
都配备了巨大的定风翼，以获得最大的下压力。
那么驾驶这辆车，沿着蜿蜒的山路，
勇敢地“冲上云霄”的人是谁呢？

这个人正是世界拉力锦标赛的冠军沃尔特·罗尔！
turns.speaker: Jeremy

turns.raw:
Audi made its Le Mans debut in 1999.

Up to 2016, it competed in the LMP1 class, where it performed exceedingly well.

In fact, it had podium finishes for eighteen consecutive years!

But in its final race, Audi's R18 was stuck in 4th place for most of the race.

People feared that Audi would finish out of the top three, breaking its long streak of podium finishes

But with ten minutes to go, the race leader, Toyota, experienced a mechanical problem.

This allowed the R18 to move into 3rd place and establish its record of 18 consecutive podium finishes!

Ultimately, the streak came to an end when Audi announced its withdrawal from Le Mans the following year.

K
turns.en:
Audi made its Le Mans debut in 1999.
Up to 2016, it competed in the LMP1 class,
where it performed exceedingly well.

In fact, it had podium finishes for eighteen
consecutive years!
But in its final race, Audi's R18 was stuck in 4th place
for most of the race.
People feared that Audi would finish out of the top three,
breaking its long streak of podium finishes

But with ten minutes to go, the race leader, Toyota,
experienced a mechanical problem.
This allowed the R18 to move into 3rd place and establish
its record of 18 consecutive podium finishes!

Ultimately, the streak came to an end when Audi announced
its withdrawal from Le Mans the following year.
turns.zh:
Audi在1999年首次亮相勒芒。
一直到2016年，Audi在LMP1级别的比赛中表现得非常出色。

事实上，Audi已经连续18年登上领奖台了！
但就在去年，R18在比赛终段时仍然是第四名。
大家都觉得Audi今年登台无望了。

然而，距离比赛结束还有10分钟时，领头的丰田出现了机械故障！
这让R18挤进了第三位，站上了领奖台，
并达成了连续18年登上领奖台的记录。

最终，由于Audi宣布从那年的勒芒赛事中退出，
他们的连胜纪录也就此终结。
turns.speaker: Jeremy

Audi made its Le Mans debut in 1999.

Up to 2016, it competed in the LMP1 class, where it performed exceedingly well.

In fact, it had podium finishes for eighteen consecutive years!

But in its final race, Audi's R18 was stuck in 4th place for most of the race.

People feared that Audi would finish out of the top three, breaking its long streak of podium finishes

But with ten minutes to go, the race leader, Toyota, experienced a mechanical problem.

This allowed the R18 to move into 3rd place and establish its record of 18 consecutive podium finishes!

Ultimately, the streak came to an end when Audi announced its withdrawal from Le Mans the following year.

“Rotary engines are notorious for their poor fuel economy, making them ill-suited for endurance races.”

At least, this is what people in the racing world had believed.

But the engineers at Mazda took a different view.

So, they got together and created the R26B engine, which emphasized horsepower over torque.

This decision effectively made it a durable and fuel-efficient engine.

The 4-rotor engine found a home in the now-legendary 787B.

It was the first Japanese car to claim the overall title at Le Mans in 1991.

Jonny Herbert, the driver who drove the final three stints...

...was so dehydrated after the race that he was unable to make the podium.

As for the engine, when Mazda's engineers took it apart, they apparently saw that it could have gone another 500 km!

转子引擎的油耗高得吓人，所以不适合耐力赛。”

赛车界曾是这样看待转子引擎的。

但是马自达的工程师们却不这么认为！
他们努力的结晶便是将重点放在马力上，
而不是扭矩上的R26B引擎。

这项明智的决定使这台引擎不仅可靠，而且省油。
这台传奇的发动机就装在了这台787B上。

于1991年，它成为了第一台在勒芒夺冠的日本车。
不幸的是，约翰尼·赫伯特在开完最后三段后……

由于严重脱水，无法站上领奖台。
赛后，当马自达的工程师将引擎拆开时，
他们发现这台引擎还能再跑500km！

turns.raw:
Porsche has contributed greatly to motorsport over the years, as a manufacturer and seller to privateers.

Even in the world's fastest racing category, which is the sports prototype class...

It entered races as a factory team while also selling its race cars to privateers.

Indeed, Porsche's widespread support of race culture is an integral part of its legacy.

This is evidenced by the history of the 956 and 962, two Group C models from the early 1980s.

Although the 962’s factory team withdrew from competition in 1988...

...the cars continued racing for private teams.

It's said that Porsche manufactured 150 examples of the 956 and 962 for competition.

turns.zh:
多年来，Porsche作为制造商和私人销售商，
对汽车运动做出了巨大贡献。
即使在参与世界上最快的赛事，运动原型赛事的同时……

他们在把赛车卖给私人的同时，还在运营着一支工厂队伍。
事实上，保时捷对赛车文化的广泛支持已经成了其遗产的一部。

这一点可以从956和962这两款
80年代初的C组别车型的历史中看出来。
虽然962的工厂队伍在1988年退出了竞技舞台……

私人车队却仍然在使用那些车竞赛。
据说，在Porsche的赛车生涯期间，
他们一共生产了150辆956和962。
turns.speaker: Jeremy

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_RaceEnthusiast_normal_raybrig_nsx_concept_gt_16_1501504
turns.raw:
This second-generation NSX-GT race car appeared in 2014.

Does that sound odd to you?

It should, because the second-generation NSX production car was released two years later in 2016.

There's simple explanation to this.

The race NSX wasn't based on the production NSX, but on the NSX Concept...

...which was unveiled ahead of the production version in 2014.

However, it was this concept car that took the GT name.

In mid-2016, the second-generation NSX production car was officially released.

Because of this, the competition car was also called the NSX-GT.

This car came in 3rd place in Round Five of the Super GT in Japan.

This second-generation NSX-GT race car appeared in 2014.

Does that sound odd to you?
It should, because the second-generation NSX production
car was released two years later in 2016.
There's simple explanation to this.

The race NSX wasn't based on the production NSX, but on
the NSX Concept...
...which was unveiled ahead of the production version
in 2014.

However, it was this concept car that took

In mid-2016, the second-generation NSX production car

This car came in 3rd place in Round Five of the
Super GT in Japan.
turns.zh:
这台第二代NSX-GT于2014年首次亮相。

听起来不觉得有些奇怪吗？
毕竟，它的基本车型，第二代NSX，在2016年才开始销售。
实际上，这辆车既是NSX，也不是NSX。

这是因为，它的原型车是一辆叫做NSX Concept的车……
那辆车是在本田于2014年，在其生产型出现前公布的。

然而，继承GT名号的依然是一辆赛车！
2016年中，第二代NSX正式发布。

因此，这款赛车也被称为NSX-GT。
作为概念时代的最后一款特规车型，
这款车在日本Super GT第五轮比赛中获得了第三名。
turns.speaker: Jeremy

turns.raw:
When it comes to R35 GT-R race cars, the Nissan MOTUL AUTECH GT-R is perhaps the best of them all!

It won two consecutive Super GT championships in the GT500 class, starting in 2014.

It also began the 2016 season in unbelievable form.

It took the first two races, at Okayama and the Fuji International Speedway, respectively.

These victories made it the odds-on favorite to win ithird series champion in a row.

The car was atop the rankings going into the final race...

However, because of the ballast it was required to carry, it could only manage a 7th-place finish in the race.

This meant that it ended the season in 3rd place for the series.

The MOTUL Autech team did give it all it had, but just came up a little short.

The drivers were Tsugio Matsuda and Ronnie �uintarelli.

They showed amazing speed all season long, and today, they're still at it and still winning races!

说起R35 GT-R赛车的话，
日产MOTUL AUTECH GT-R绝对是其中的王者。
从2014年开始，这辆车已经在GT500级别的
Super GT锦标赛中连续获胜了两次。
它在2016赛季中的开局也是势不可挡……

在冈山的第一场和富士赛道的第二场中接连获胜！

在当时看来，这辆车拿下第三个锦标赛冠军已经是板上钉钉的事了。
在赛事进行到最后一场时，它在排名中依然名列前茅……

但是沉重的压舱物使它在这场比赛中惜败，只获得了第七名。
这意味着，这辆车在这个季度中仅以第三名完赛。

他们没能上演帽子戏法，真是太可惜了！
不过，松田次生和罗尼·昆塔雷利的老司机团队无疑是非常快的！

他们俩现在�8�已步入四十，但却依然没有一丝慢下来的迹象！ ,

turns.raw:
I don't care what anyone else says, I think this is the world's most beautiful race car!

I just can't get enough of that bodywork, especially the wheelhouses and fenders.

It's not just a nice looking car, though.

It won the 24 Hours of Daytona on its first try in 1967.

In fact, the 330 P4 occupied all the podium positions.

Seeing three 330 P4s cross the finish line together... well, that was enough to bring a tear to my eye.

The 330 P4 won the 1000 Kilometers of Monza that same year as well!

Formula 1 drivers Lorenzo Bandini and Mike Parkes piloted the Ferrari in that race.

The car was then entered in the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_RaceEnthusiast_normal_gt40_mk1_66_1501904
turns.raw:
This is the road version of the Mark I that raced at Le Mans in 1966.

The Ford GT40 Mk I was introduced in 1964.

It was developed specifically to beat Ferrari at Le Mans, where the Italian company had dominated.

Three Mk Is participated in the 1964 Le Mans race, but they all retired without making it to the finish line.

In 1965, Ford put Carroll Shelby in charge of everything from development to strategy, with the same result...

Then, Shelby completely overhauled the chassis and engine, creating the Mk II in 1966.

Eight Mk IIs and five Mk Is waged war at Le Mans that year.

It was an overwhelming show of strength in numbers!

This determination brought home the Le Mans title for Ford, finally putting an end to Ferrari's run.

turns.zh:
这辆车是参加了1966年勒芒耐力赛的Mark 1的公路版。

福特GT40 Mark 1公布于1964年。

这辆车是专门为了超越当时称霸勒芒的法拉利而开发的。
1964年，有三辆Mark 1参加了勒芒耐力赛，但全部中途退赛了。

1965年，福特任命卡罗尔·谢尔比负责从开发到战略的一切工作，
但比赛结果还是一样……
1966年，对底盘和发动机进行了完全改造的Mark II开发完成。

一共八辆Mark II和五辆Mark I参加了当年的勒芒耐力赛。
那可是压倒性的数量优势！

因此，福特也毫无意外地在那年首次夺得了勒芒耐力赛冠军宝座！
turns.speaker: Jeremy

It was developed specifically to beat Ferrari at Le Mans, where the Italian company had dominated.

Three Mk Is participated in the 1964 Le Mans race, but they all retired without making it to the finish line.

In 1965, Ford put Carroll Shelby in charge of everything from development to strategy, with the same result...

Then, Shelby completely overhauled the chassis and engine, creating the Mk II in 1966.

Eight Mk IIs and five Mk Is waged war at Le Mans that year.

It was an overwhelming show of strength in numbers!

This determination brought home the Le Mans title for Ford, finally putting an end to Ferrari's run.

The 1988 24 Hours of Le Mans was one for the history books.

Jaguar fans from the UK were showed up in force, with Union Jack flags waving all around the track.

It was a sight I'll never forget.

This is the car that brought Jaguar the victory that day.

It finally got the better of the Porsches that had dominated Le Mans for so long.

It certainly put a smile on the legions of British fans.

But they first had to endure a stressful race.

It wasn't until the end that Jaguar was able to put away the Porsche that was applying pressure all race.

Just thinking of it now sends a chill down my spine.

赛道上的米字旗四处可见。

我永远也忘不了那番景象！
而那天为Jaguar赢得胜利的，正是这辆车……
他们在那天终于打败了称霸勒芒已久的Porsche。

这也让英国车迷充满了自豪和喜悦。
萨森赛车场那时热闹非凡！
那场比赛非常激烈，获胜的Jaguar到最后
都一直面临着身后Porsche的压力！

光是想想那场景就让我背脊发凉！

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_RaceEnthusiast_normal_stratos_73_1502104
turns.raw:
The Stratos, designed by Marcello Gandini...

...was created to accomplish just one goal.

And what was that, you ask? To win rally races.

Legend has it that the car was a handful to drive owing to its short wheelbase.

In fact, only a handful of drivers could ever really master it.

One of them was the legendary rally driver Sandro Munari.

He controlled the Stratos like it was a part of his body.

His view on the matter was:

"If you find driving this car difficult, then your skills just aren't good enough."

turns.zh:
Stratos的设计者是马塞罗·甘迪尼……

他设计这辆车的目的只有一个。
那个目的是？在拉力赛中获胜。

传说这辆车非常难驾驭……
实际上，真正驾驭了这辆车的人也就那么几名车手。
传奇拉力车手桑德罗·穆纳利便是这些车手之一。

对他来说，操纵Stratos就像是操纵玩具车那样易如反掌！
他对此的看法是：

“如果您觉得这车难开，那只能说明你还欠火候！”i

This is a McLaren F1 that has seen some track action. Many consider this car to be the perfect sport car.

This race spec version first made an appearance in 1994.

And in 1995, it made its Le Mans debut, going on to grab the overall title!

Incidentally, the victorious McLaren F1 GTR was once driven by former Formula 1 driver JJ Lehto...

...and Japanese driver Masanori Sekiya.

It was the first time that a Japanese driver had won at Le Mans.

He was also the fastest driver on the team, even when rain fell during the night at the Circuit de la Sarthe.

turns.raw:
This is a race car version of Mercedes-Benz's luxury sedan, the 300 SEL.

The 300 SEL caught the eye of Mercedes-Benz tuner, AMG...

Who tweaked it to racing spec by increasing the engine displacement to 6.8L.

It made its race debut in July 1971...

...in a European Touring Car Championship race at Spa- Francorchamps in Belgium.

It won its class there, and finished in a very impressive 2nd place overall.

Pretty amazing for a large, 4-door sedan!

This result put AMG on the map, and gave it worldwide prominence.

AMG would go on to play a key role in Mercedes-Benz's race teams at the DTM and elsewhere.

turns.zh:
这是梅赛德斯-奔驰的豪华轿车300 SEL的赛车版本。

梅赛德斯-奔驰的改装商AMG慧眼发掘了300 SEL。
AMG将其调整为赛车规格，引擎排量增加到了6.8升。
它于1971年7月首次在比赛中亮相……

在比利时斯帕弗朗科尔尚赛道举行的欧洲房车锦标赛中，
它不仅赢得了本级别的比赛，并获得了总成绩第二名，
令人印象深刻。

对于一辆大型四门轿车来说，这是很了不起的成就。
这一成就也使AMG声名鹊起，并在全世界范围内为人所知。
在那之后，他们在梅赛德斯-奔驰旗下的各支赛车队伍中、
在包括德国房车大师赛的各项赛事中发挥了关键作用。

AMG将其调整为赛车规格，引擎排量增加到了6.8升。
它于1971年7月首次在比赛中亮相……

在比利时斯帕弗朗科尔尚赛道举行的欧洲房车锦标赛中，
它不仅赢得了本级别的比赛，并获得了总成绩第二名，
令人印象深刻。

对于一辆大型四门轿车来说，这是很了不起的成就。
这一成就也使AMG声名鹊起，并在全世界范围内为人所知。
在那之后，他们在梅赛德斯-奔驰旗下的各支赛车队伍中、
在包括德国房车大师赛的各项赛事中发挥了关键作用。

Renault is a company that loves to compete.

It has been involved in many forms of motorsport, including Formula 1.

It was also formidable in the rallying world, alongside cars such as the Gordini and the Alpine from the 70s.

The 1980s, though, the company was all about this R5 Turbo.

One of its early drivers, Jean Ragnotti, mentioned that the car suffered from terrible handling.

He also confessed that misjudgments on narrow roads would always cause the rear of the car to hit objects.

This is because the rear of the R5 Turbo was wider than the front.

It's amusing to hear seasoned pros complain about aspects of a car they don't like.

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_RaceEnthusiast_normal_gtr_nismo_gt3_13_1502504
turns.raw:
I was pretty surprised when I heard about the car Nissan were entering into Le Mans in 2015!

This GT-R LM NISMO.

The designer, Ben Bowlby, opted for an FF layout, and worked hard on the aerodynamics.

Unfortunately, however, these innovations didn't pay off.

In qualifying, the car was 20 seconds slower than its fastest rival.

Worse still, in the race itself, two of three cars had to retire, so only one was able to reach the finish line.

However, even this finisher didn't complete enough laps, and was officially judged not to have finished!

E
turns.en:
I was pretty surprised when I heard about the car Nissan
were entering into Le Mans in 2015!

This GT-R LM NISMO.
The designer, Ben Bowlby, opted for an FF layout, and worked
hard on the aerodynamics.
Unfortunately, however, these innovations didn't pay off.

In qualifying, the car was 20 seconds slower than its
fastest rival.
Worse still, in the race itself, two of three cars had to
retire, so only one was able to reach the finish line.

However, even this finisher didn't complete enough laps,
and was officially judged not to have finished!
turns.zh:
听说Nissan要在2015年参加勒芒比赛时，我非常惊讶！

在这辆GT-R LM NISMO上，
设计师本·鲍尔比选择了前置前驱布局，并在空气动力学
方面下了很大功夫。
不幸的是，这些创新并没有得到回报。

在排位赛中，该车比第一名慢了足有20秒。
雪上加霜的是，参加正赛的三辆车中有两辆不得不退赛，
这意味着只有一辆车最终到达了终点。

而且，就连这位通过终点线的车手也因为没有完成足够
的圈数而被判定为未完成比赛！
turns.speaker: Jeremy

What happened in June 1972 was pretty unusual by anyone's standards.

It was the second race of the popular Fuji Grand Champion Series, which took place on the Fuji International Speedway.

And, despite being up against Gr.6 and Gr.7 race cars...

...a lower-level machine based on a production model managed to emerge victorious!

The car was a Fairlady 240ZG, and its driver was Japan's Haruhito Yanagida.

The race took place in heavy rain, and the 240ZG performed exceptionally against its higher-ranked rivals.

And yes indeed, it beat all of the other entries.

The event became known in Japan as the "Z in the Rain" race, and remains one of the most legendary moments in motorsports.

一辆基于零售车型改装的低级别汽车却杀出重围、斩获

表现得异常出色……

最终以第一名的成绩冲过终点线！
这场比赛在日本被称为“雨中的Z”，是赛车运动中最具
传奇色彩的时刻之一。

The Tour de Corse?

Well, it's a famous rally event that takes place on the French island of Corsica.

The 1964 Tour de Corse was a particular classic.

Only eight cars out of 79 managed to complete the race!

What's more, Renault's R8 Gordini claimed first, third, fourth and fifth place!

It was quite the remarkable achievement.

Gordini was an engine manufacturer, originally, established by the Italian driver and engineer Amedeo Gordini.

The R8 Gordini came about through a collaboration with Renault.

turns.zh:
科西嘉岛拉力赛？

嗯，这是一项著名的拉力赛事，在法国的科西嘉岛上
举行。
1964年的科西嘉岛拉力赛特别经典。

79辆参赛汽车中只有8辆成功完成了比赛！
而Renault的R8 Gordini就囊括了第一、第三、第四和第五名！

这是相当了不起的成就。
Gordini是一家引擎制造商，由意大利车手和工程师阿
梅戴·戈蒂尼一手创办。

R8 Gordini就是其与Renault合作的产物。;
turns.speaker: Jeremy

turns.raw:
Are you familiar with the WRC?

It stands for "World Rally Championship," and features rally races that take place on a variety of road surfaces.

It was formed in 1973 when rally championships held in various countries were unified.

The new international race series was christened the World Rally Championship, and the rest is history.

This is the Alpine A110, the winner of the very first WRC series.

Its compact body came with an <1800cc> engine mounted at the rear, ensuring excellent traction.

The A110 won the first race of the 1973 season, held in Monte Carlo.

In fact, Alpine A110s took all three podium places, defeating entries form Porsche and Lancia.

The car now occupies a page in the history books as the car that won the first WRC race and series.

]

turns.zh:
你对世界拉力锦标赛熟悉吗？

在公共道路上举行拉力
赛是其独有的特色。

它设立于1973年，将在不同国家举行的拉力锦标赛整合
到了一起。
这就是世界拉力锦标赛的开端，并延续至今。

这一辆阿尔派A110正是第一届世界拉力锦标赛的冠军。
它的车身紧凑，后置发动机确保
后轮产生足够的牵引力。

它在蒙特卡洛赢下了1973年赛季的第一场比赛。

事实上，阿尔派A110一路上击败了保时捷和蓝旗亚，
包揽了领奖台！
A110就此踏上了赢得世界拉力锦标赛首季比赛的道路，并通过比
赛造成巨大的轰动效应！
turns.speaker: Jeremy

turns.raw:
For drift fans, this car is instantly recognizeable as Dai's car.

Daijiro Yoshihara is a Japanese race driver who specializes in drifting.

He was the series champion of the 2011 Formula DRIFT Championship Series.

For the 2018 season, his car was this one, based on the Subaru BRZ.

It packed a turbocharged 7.8-liter V-8 under the hood.

The engine produced a massive <1000ps> of power!

Unfortunately, it didn't carry him to the championship that year.

Still, the BRZ was impressive nontheless.

turns.zh:
提到这辆车，人们就会联想起吉原大！

吉原大二郎是一位日本赛车手，专业从事漂移运动。
他是2011年漂移方程式锦标赛系列赛的冠军。
后来，他驾驶一辆基于Subaru BRZ的赛车继
续参加了2018年的系列赛。
在车辆的引擎盖下安装的是一台7.8L V8涡轮增压引擎。

能够产生1000ps的巨大动力！
虽然这台引擎并不足以让他赢得冠军，

但是，BRZ+V8仍然是一个令人振奋不已的组合！
turns.speaker: Jeremy

turns.raw:
The development of the Toyota 86 started at the Nürburgring in 2011.

The first time the development drivers encountered the 86, it was nothing special.

As such, one of them noted that 'we realised we had to rebuild the car from scratch'.

The retail and race spec versions of the 86 were both developed at the same time...

And the racing car was entered into races such as the Nürburgring 24 Hours.

The experiences from those races were used to improve the retail car—and that's the 86 you see before you.

In fact, the developers ended up referring to this one as the 'ultimate 86'!

t
turns.en:
The development of the Toyota 86 started at the Nürburgring
in 2011.
The first time the development drivers encountered the 86,
it was nothing special.

As such, one of them noted that 'we realised we had to
rebuild the car from scratch'.
The retail and race spec versions of the 86 were both
developed at the same time...

And the racing car was entered into races such as the
Nürburgring 24 Hours.
The experiences from those races were used to improve the
retail car—and that's the 86 you see before you.

In fact, the developers ended up referring to this one as

turns.zh:
Toyota86的开发始于2011年的纽博格林赛道。
开发测试车手与86的第一次邂逅，并没有擦出火花。

其中一位车手指出，“我们意识到我们必须从头开始重新
打造这辆车”。
86的零售和比赛规格版本的开发是同期进行的……

赛车版被用于参加纽博格林24小时耐力赛等比赛。
通过比赛积累的经验又被用来改进零售版——也就是你
面前的这台86。

事实上，开发人员最终将这款车称为“终极86”！
turns.speaker: Jeremy

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_RaceEnthusiast_normal_ts050_hybrid_16_1503104
turns.raw:
Toyota has been entering hybrid racing cars into Le Mans since 2012...

...with its first victory coming in 2018.

While its cars displayed impressive performance year after year, they couldn't quite translate those speeds into victories.

There were some close calls, though. In 2016, one of its cars stopped at the front of the pack, with just one lap to go!

The victorious Porsche team couldn't believe its luck.

In any case, this just made Toyota’s 2018 victory sweeter. I remember it clearly—I was so happy!

What's more, Toyota would go on to win five in a row, its most recent win being in 2022!
turns.en:
Toyota has been entering hybrid racing cars into Le Mans
since 2012...

...with its first victory coming in 2018.
While its cars displayed impressive performance year after year,
they couldn't quite translate those speeds into victories.
There were some close calls, though. In 2016, one of its cars stopped
at the front of the pack, with just one lap to go!

The victorious Porsche team couldn't believe its luck.
In any case, this just made Toyota’s 2018 victory sweeter.
I remember it clearly—I was so happy!

What's more, Toyota would go on to win five in a row,
its most recent win being in 2022!
turns.zh:
自2012年以来，丰田一直致力于将混合动力赛车投入
到勒芒的比赛当中……

他们的首个胜利直到2018年才姗姗来迟。
在此之前，这些赛车每每都展现出令人惊叹的速度，
但却始终无法将这种速度转化为胜利。
不过，期间也有过几次胜利触手可及的时刻——2016年，
领跑车阵的丰田却在离终点只剩下一圈时抛锚了！

就连捡漏的保时捷车队都不敢相信自己的好运气。
不过，这些挫败只是让2018年的胜利变得更加甘美。
我清楚记得当时的感受——我当时高兴坏了！

更激动人心的是，丰田在之后的五年里连战连捷，
其中也包括2022年新鲜出炉的一胜！
turns.speaker: Jeremy

turns.raw:
Here's a legendary car from the early days of Japanese motorsports.

I've heard all about how it used to race around the newly built Suzuka Circuit.

If you were to ask me which race by this car nicknamed "Yota-Hachi" was the finest...

...I would have to say that it was the one at Funabashi Circuit in July 1965.

The event was the All-Japan Club Championship, and the driver was Tojiro Ukiya.

Ukiya broke his fender in a collision early in the race, dropping him to 16th place.

After that incident, however, he staged a stunning comeback, moving up through the field to win the race!

There was something almost divine about the performance he displayed that day.

p

我听说过它是如何在新建成的铃鹿赛道上飞驰的！
如果你要问我“丰田八”有史以来最精彩的比赛是哪一场……

那一定是1965年7月在船桥赛道举行的那场比赛。

这是全日本俱乐部锦标赛的一站，车手是浮谷东次郎。
在比赛前期的一次碰撞中，浮谷撞坏了他的挡泥板。车
辆修复后，他的位置跌到了第16位。

然而，在那之后他上演了一场惊人的反击战，在一路高
歌猛进，最终取得了第一名的好成绩
他在那天表现出的速度简直如有神助！

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_RaceEnthusiast_normal_tundra_trd_pro_19_1503304
turns.raw:
This is no ordinary pickup truck. It's a super truck, capable of dominating on dirt tracks and oval circuits.

Any mention of a Tundra makes me think of the Baja 1000 desert race.

It's an all-night race that takes place on a 1,600 km course in the Mexican desert.

It's a challenging race, with more than half the cars entered never seeing the finish line.

Toyota took on the Baja with this Tundra tuned by TRD, and the truck won in its class.

And, did you known that the Tundra TRD also raced on oval race tracks?

In 2019, it entered a survival event in Daytona, winning a race in which only nine out of 32 cars finished.

�
turns.en:
This is no ordinary pickup truck. It's a super truck,
capable of dominating on dirt tracks and oval circuits.
Any mention of a Tundra makes me think of the Baja 1000
desert race.

It's an all-night race that takes place on a 1,600 km
course in the Mexican desert.
It's a challenging race, with more than half the cars entered
never seeing the finish line.

Toyota took on the Baja with this Tundra tuned by TRD,
and the truck won in its class.
And, did you known that the Tundra TRD also
raced on oval race tracks?

In 2019, it entered a survival event in Daytona, winning a
race in which only nine out of 32 cars finished.
turns.zh:
这不是一辆普通的皮卡车。这是一辆真正的超级卡车，
在泥地赛道和椭圆赛道上都占据着统治性的地位！
一提到坦途，我就会想到巴哈1000沙漠越野赛。

这场在墨西哥沙漠举办，赛程长达1600km的比赛
全部在夜晚举行。
这是一项艰苦卓绝的赛事，每次都有半数以上的参赛车
辆会因为各种原因退赛。

Toyota公司带着这辆由丰田赛车开发中心改装过的坦途参加了比赛，
并在本级别中揽获冠军。
此外，你知道坦途丰田赛车开发中心也曾在椭圆赛道上比试过吗？

2019年，它参加了在戴通纳举行的生存赛，在一场32辆
汽车中只有9辆完赛的比赛中取得最终的胜利。
turns.speaker: Jeremy
