capable of dominating on dirt tracks and oval circuits.
Any mention of a Tundra makes me think of the Baja 1000
desert race.

It's an all-night race that takes place on a 1,600 km
course in the Mexican desert.
It's a challenging race, with more than half the cars entered
never seeing the finish line.

Toyota took on the Baja with this Tundra tuned by TRD,
and the truck won in its class.
And, did you known that the Tundra TRD also
raced on oval race tracks?

In 2019, it entered a survival event in Daytona, winning a
race in which only nine out of 32 cars finished.
turns.zh:
这不是一辆普通的皮卡车。这是一辆真正的超级卡车，
在泥地赛道和椭圆赛道上都占据着统治性的地位！
一提到坦途，我就会想到巴哈1000沙漠越野赛。

这场在墨西哥沙漠举办，赛程长达1600km的比赛
全部在夜晚举行。
这是一项艰苦卓绝的赛事，每次都有半数以上的参赛车
辆会因为各种原因退赛。

Toyota公司带着这辆由丰田赛车开发中心改装过的坦途参加了比赛，
并在本级别中揽获冠军。
此外，你知道坦途丰田赛车开发中心也曾在椭圆赛道上比试过吗？

2019年，它参加了在戴通纳举行的生存赛，在一场32辆
汽车中只有9辆完赛的比赛中取得最终的胜利。
turns.speaker: Jeremy

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_RaceEnthusiast_normal_dbr9_gt1_10_1503404
turns.raw:
Do you know when Aston Martin started participating in international races?

It was way back in the 1920s!

They also competed at Le Mans until the 1950s, but the marque then took a long break from motorsports after that.

In fact, they were absent from the racing scene for 30 years, until it returned in 2005.

It was a triumphant return as well, with Aston Martin claiming victory at Sebring.

The winning car that day was a DBR9 GT1. Beautiful, isn't it?

It would prove to be the start of a nice run for the DBR9.

In 2007, it was the first Aston Martin to finish in the top five at Le Mans in 48 years. It also won the GT1 class.

Six Aston Martins entered Le Mans that year.

All six cars finished the race, showing that they had reliability as well as speed.

It was defini�ely good to have Aston Martin's cars back in racing and to see them perform so well!

At the 2008 Le Mans race, a DBR9 was entered wearing the legendary Gulf Oil livery.

It beat the Chevrolet Corvette to claim the GT1 class for the second straight year.

那要追溯到20世纪20年代！

在那之后，他们做出了长期诀别赛车运动的决定。
当他们在2005年重返赛车运动时，已经是阔别赛场的
30年后了。

阿斯顿马丁在他们回归的第一场比赛中就在赛百灵赛
道获得了胜利，为这次回归奏响了凯旋之歌！
当天获胜的赛车是一辆DBR9 GT1。它很美吧？
这场比赛是DBR9写下壮丽篇章的开端。

2007年，它成为48年来第一辆在勒芒比赛中跻身前五的
阿斯顿马丁！它还赢得了GT1级别的冠军。
那年共有六辆阿斯顿马丁参加了勒芒比赛。

所有车辆都完成了比赛，为其可靠性和�;�度做出证明。
也因此，阿斯顿马丁迅速找回他们对赛车的热情就不奇怪了！

在2008年的勒芒比赛中，一辆DBR9以传奇的海湾石油
涂装参赛。

它击败了强劲对手雪佛兰科尔维特，连续第二年赢得
了GT1级别的冠军！

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_RaceEnthusiast_normal__155_v6ti_dtm_93_1503504
turns.raw:
Among Alfa Romeo’s more recent contributions to motorsports was this car, which turned many heads in its day.

The street-legal 155 was styled by the Italian design house I.DE.A Institute in 1992.

And a year later, in 1993, the race-ready 155 2.5 V6 TI was born.

The improvements made to the car were nothing short of amazing.

Consider this: The car took 12 wins in the DTM series.

This was an incredible feat indeed.

Behind its wheel were former F1 drivers Nicola Larini and Alessandro Nannini.

In the series, Larini took 10 checkered flags, while Nannini claimed two.

Nannini was involved in a terrible helicopter accident in 1990, where his arm was severed and needed to be reattached.

To facilitate his return to racing, the 155 was specially modified.

And, he was still able to win two races!

It really said something about the skill and competitiveness of a former F1 driver.

A

turns.zh:
在阿尔法罗密欧近来对赛车运动的贡献中，
这辆车无疑让所有人眼前一亮。
1992年，意大利设计事务所I.DE.A Institute
设计了街道版155跑车。

一年后，即1993年，比赛规格的155 2.5 V6 TI
诞生了。

基于街道版的改装将车型打磨得至臻完美！
事实上，这款赛车总计获得了12场德国房车大师赛冠军，

真是了不起的成就！
实现这一壮举的功勋车手是前F1车手尼古拉·拉里尼和
亚历山德罗·纳尼尼。

尼古拉取得了10场胜利，而亚历山德罗则贡献了另两个
冠军领奖台。
在1990年，亚历山德罗不幸遭遇一场可怕的直升机事故，

turns.raw:
Ah, this is the "long nose/long tail" McLaren F1 GTR, which made its debut in 1997.

Its engine was built by BMW Motorsport.

While the McLaren F1 won the overall title at the 1995 Le Mans 24 Hours…

...the Porsche 911 GT1 took the win the following year.

Desperate to reclaim its title, McLaren set to work on this 1997 F1 GTR race car.

Its effective aerodynamic design suggests that this car was designed to blast down the long straights of Le Mans.

Alas, it fell just shy of accomplishing its goal in 1997, finishing in 2nd place behind the Porsche.

Two years later, BMW settled the score in a way with its own Le Mans victory.

But that’s a story for another day.

turns.zh:
啊，这就是1997年首次亮相的“长鼻”+“长尾”
迈凯伦F1 GTR，

它的发动机来自宝马赛车运动。

虽然迈凯伦F1在1995年勒芒24小时耐力赛中
取得了胜利……

但第二年就被保时捷911 GT1抢走了冠军宝座。
不愿服输的迈凯伦开始着手打造这辆1997款F1 GTR赛车。

通过其高度特化的空气动力学设计不难看出，
它是为了在勒芒的大直道上跑出最高速度而生的。
令人遗憾的是，它在1997年的比赛中并没能跟上
保时捷的速度，最终屈居第二……

两年后，宝马亲手拿下了勒芒冠军，某种程度上算是报
了一箭之仇！

关于这个故事，我们就留到下次再讲了。
turns.speaker: Jeremy

designed to blast down the long straights of Le Mans.
Alas, it fell just shy of accomplishing its goal in 1997,
finishing in 2nd place behind the Porsche.

Two years later, BMW settled the score in a way
with its own Le Mans victory.

But that’s a story for another day.
turns.zh:
啊，这就是1997年首次亮相的“长鼻”+“长尾”
迈凯伦F1 GTR，

它的发动机来自宝马赛车运动。

虽然迈凯伦F1在1995年勒芒24小时耐力赛中
取得了胜利……

但第二年就被保时捷911 GT1抢走了冠军宝座。
不愿服输的迈凯伦开始着手打造这辆1997款F1 GTR赛车。

通过其高度特化的空气动力学设计不难看出，
它是为了在勒芒的大直道上跑出最高速度而生的。
令人遗憾的是，它在1997年的比赛中并没能跟上
保时捷的速度，最终屈居第二……

两年后，宝马亲手拿下了勒芒冠军，某种程度上算是报
了一箭之仇！

关于这个故事，我们就留到下次再讲了。

turns.raw:
Trust me, you’re not likely to forget a car like this.

This is the Chaparral 2J, which was built for the 1970 Can-Am Series.

What makes it original is found at the rear of the car.

There, you'll find two fans powered by a <274cc> engine.

These fans suck the car to the ground to generate downforce.

They expel the air between the underbody and the road, creating a suction effect.

For this reason, the 2J is sometimes referred to as the "fan car.".

Thanks to this ingenious piece of engineering, the car can take corners at speeds that defy all logic.

The Chaparral 2J set incredible lap times in all four of the races it entered.

In fact, it even took pole position.

Its Achilles Heel was reliability.

But before it could run a full race, the FIA changed the rules on aerodynamics...

...deeming the fan system illegal.

One can only imagine what this car could have achieved, had it been given time to develop.

这辆Chaparral 2J是专为1970年加拿大-美国挑战杯系列赛制造的。
在它的身后，你会发现……

两台通过274cc单缸发动机驱动的风扇。

这些风扇将空气从车身下方排出，以产生下压力……

这使它看起来好像直接吸在地面上一样。

也因此，它常被人称为“风扇车”。
它甚至能够以违反物理常识的高速过弯……

在它参加的所有四场比赛中，
Chaparral 2J都创下了令人难以置信的单圈记录！

确切地说，它包揽了所有四场比赛的杆位。
当然了，它的稳定性另当别论……

在创下纪录后，它未能获准参加后续的比赛。
因为国际汽联针对性地更改了关于空气动力学的规则……

直接将“风扇车”排除在比赛之外。
这样的遗憾也引来了人们的不断遐想。
如果在当时有机会继续改进这辆车，它可以取得什么样的成就！`
turns.speaker: Jeremy

turns.raw:
This is the Jaguar D-Type from 1954. It was introduced as the evolutionary successor to the C-Type.

Like its predecessor, it was specifically built to win at Le Mans.

Although it set a top speed record at the 1954 race, it was forced to retire.

But in 1955, after being involved in a horrendous accident, it took the overall win with Mike Hawthorn behind the wheel.

The car won again in 1956 and 1957, giving Jaguar an incredible three wins in a row.

By the way, did you know that hydrodynamic principles were applied to the D-Type’s curved body?

At the time, it signaled the start of adopting advanced aerodynamic principles to increase performance.

turns.en:
This is the Jaguar D-Type from 1954. It was introduced as
the evolutionary successor to the C-Type.

Like its predecessor, it was specifically built
to win at Le Mans.
Although it set a top speed record at the 1954 race,
it was forced to retire.

But in 1955, after being involved in a horrendous accident,
it took the overall win with Mike Hawthorn behind the wheel.
The car won again in 1956 and 1957, giving Jaguar an
incredible three wins in a row.

By the way, did you know that hydrodynamic principles
were applied to the D-Type’s curved body?
At the time, it signaled the start of adopting advanced
aerodynamic principles to increase performance.
turns.zh:
这是1954年出厂的捷豹D-Type。
作为C-Type的继任者，它得到了全面进化。

与它的前辈一样，D-Type是专门为在勒芒比赛中获胜而制造的。
尽管它在1954年的比赛中创造了速度纪录，但没能完成比
赛就退赛了。
在1955年，迈克·霍索恩驾驶D-Type在躲过一次可怕的碰撞事
故后，取得了最终胜利。

在56年和57年，D-Type连番卫冕，实现了惊人的勒芒三连冠。

值得一提的是，你知道D-Type的弧线车身设计考虑了流体力
学原理吗？
在当时，这标志着对抗空气阻力的军备竞赛正式开始！
turns.speaker: Jeremy

This is the Jaguar D-Type from 1954. It was introduced as the evolutionary successor to the C-Type.

Like its predecessor, it was specifically built to win at Le Mans.

Although it set a top speed record at the 1954 race, it was forced to retire.

But in 1955, after being involved in a horrendous accident, it took the overall win with Mike Hawthorn behind the wheel.

The car won again in 1956 and 1957, giving Jaguar an incredible three wins in a row.

By the way, did you know that hydrodynamic principles were applied to the D-Type’s curved body?

At the time, it signaled the start of adopting advanced aerodynamic principles to increase performance.

Want to know why Porsche is so popular among gearheads?

One reason is that the company makes its cars available to the masses.

This is true not only of their production cars, but also their top prototypes.

Take the once-retired 908 and 917 models, for example.

Porsche later sold them to private teams.

And when these teams took to the track with these cars...

...Porsche offered them the same level of support of its own factory teams.

After all, when a Porsche wins, whether for the factory or a private team…

...it’s still a win for Porsche.

Beginning with John Wyer Automotive...

...the Porsche 917 was raced by several Austrian and American teams.

And who can forget 917K’s appearance in the 1971 film "Le Mans," starring the legendary Steve McQueen!

turns.zh:
为什么车迷们都这么喜欢保时捷？

其中一个原因是，保时捷没有敝帚自珍，将赛车都留为己用。
这不仅仅指的是量产赛车，也包括他们的顶级原型车。

以退役的908和917赛车为例，
保时捷后来把它们出售给了私人车队。

而当买家将这些车重新带入比赛时……

保时捷为他们提供了与原厂车队同等的技术支持。

毕竟，当一辆退役的保时捷在私人车队中再次获胜时……

这仍然是属于保时捷的胜利，不是吗？
从约翰·怀尔汽车公司开始……

有多支奥地利和美国车队曾驾驶保时捷917参赛。
在1971年上映的电影《勒芒》中见识过史蒂夫·麦奎因的
精彩表现后，还有谁能忘记917K的风采呢？
turns.speaker: Jeremy

turns.raw:
Porsche is a mainstay of the WEC, which is short for the World Endurance Championship.

Currently, Porsche's entry in this series is the 911 RSR.

The car competes in both the LMP1 and LM-GTE classes.

As you can imagine, the 911 is a force to be reckoned with because of its speed and reliability.

While contesting for overall victories in the LMP1 class, it also looked to grab the top spot in the GT class.

This particular 911 RSR competed in the WEC and IMSA in 2017.

It received a bit of backlash from Porsche enthusiasts, however.

That’s because its engine is mounted amidships, and not at the rear.

Therefore, many hardcore enthusiasts cried foul, saying that it wasn't a real 911.

Still, the new engine location did improve the car’s stability at high speed.

And the resulting change in weight distribution is said to have dramatically reduced tire friction.

Seen in this light, the alterations make sense. Porsche is there to win, after all.

]

turns.zh:
一贯以来，保时捷都是世界耐力锦标赛，即“世界耐力锦标赛”的冠军有
力争夺者之一。

其发布的911 RSR同时参加了

勒芒原型车1级和LM-GTE两个级别的比赛。
如您预想得到的，作为保时捷毋庸置疑的旗舰，

911在追求勒芒原型车1级级别的全面胜利的同时，也向GT级别的头名
发起了挑战。
这辆911 RSR在2017年参加了世界耐力锦标赛和国际汽车运动协会的一系列比赛，

但也受到了保时捷车迷群体的一些质疑。

这是因为它的引擎被安装在车体中部，而不是后部。
很多硬核车迷们会说，“真正的”911必须是后置引擎。

但不得不说，中置布局确实改善了赛车的高速稳定性……

而且，据说这样的重量分配调整极大地减少了轮胎摩损。
从这个角度来看，这些改变是可以理解的。毕竟，
保时捷就是为了赢得比赛而生的。
turns.speaker: Jeremy

turns.raw:
The V12 Vantage GT3 made its first appearance in 2012, at the British GT Championships.

Now, how do you think it performed on its home turf?

Well, over 67 races, across seven seasons, it had a podium finish nearly every time!

And what’s more, in over 30% of its races, it came in first place!

Needless to say, it will be remembered as a legendary production racing car in the annals of GT3 history.

Indeed, up until 2019, when it passed the baton to its V8-mounted successor...

This incredible car enjoyed a long career at the forefront of GT racing.



turns.zh:
V12 Vantage GT3在2012年的
英国GT锦标赛上初露峥嵘。
你来猜猜它的主场表现如何？

在七个赛季的67场比赛中，它几乎每次都能登上领奖台。
更夸张的是，它在超过三成的比赛中
站上了最高领奖台！

毋庸置疑，这是一台
值得被铭记在GT3历史中的传奇赛车。
事实上，直到2019年，它才把接力棒
传给它的V8车型继任者……

这辆了不起的赛车将其漫长的职业生涯都献给了GT赛事
的最前线。
turns.speaker: Jeremy

turns.raw:
This Audi R8-based GT3 was unveiled at the Geneva Motor Show in March 2015.

If you consider yourself an Audi fan, you should know about this car's illustrious history.

Only two months after it was introduced, the R8 LMS competed at the Nürburgring 24-hour race.

This was its first competition, and as you probably guessed by now, it won the race.

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_RaceEnthusiast_normal_m6_gt3_m_power_16_1504304
turns.raw:
When designing a race car, the natural impulse is to build something small and light.

But this M6 GT3 breaks the mold, with a total length that is <5cm> longer than that of the production model.

The wheelbase has also been extended.

Many wondered if the extra length of the car would diminish its handling ability.

That concern was wiped clean when racers first drove the car.

They praised it for its precise balance and smooth turning feel.

And their findings were soon backed up by results.

The M6 GT3 drove to a magnificent win on the narrow Macao GP circuit in 2018.

At the wheel then was Japanese touring-car ace Seiji Ara.

It was a truly incredible race to behold.

*
turns.en:
When designing a race car, the natural impulse
is to build something small and light.

But this M6 GT3 breaks the mold, with a total length that is
5cm longer than that of the production model.
The wheelbase has also been extended.

Many wondered if the extra length of the car would
diminish its handling ability.

That concern was wiped clean when racers first
drove the car.

They praised it for its precise balance and
smooth turning feel.
And their findings were soon backed up by results.

The M6 GT3 drove to a magnificent win on
the narrow Macao GP circuit in 2018.
At the wheel then was Japanese touring-car
ace Seiji Ara.

It was a truly incredible race to behold.*
turns.zh:
说到赛车设计，人们很自然地会想到小而轻的竞速机器。

但是这辆M6 GT3却反其道而行之——
它的车身长度比量产车型还要长出5cm！
它的轴距嘛，当然也很长！

这样的设计让人不由地担心起它的过弯能力来。

然而，开过它的车手却不是这么说的……

他们对车辆的精确操控和平顺过弯能力赞不绝口。
你还是不相信？

那我告诉你一个事实，日本房车赛传奇车手荒圣治驾驶着它
于2018年在狭窄的澳门大奖赛赛道上
取得了一场辉煌的胜利……

这是一场令人难以置信的比赛，精彩程度令人叹为观止！
turns.speaker: Jeremy

Wow, Ferrari builds really amazing race cars.

In fact, the company even has its own one-make series called the "Ferrari Challenge."

It’s an upscale event that brings together gentlemen drivers from all over the world.

But don’t get me wrong, these are genuine race machines.

A sibling of the 458 GT3 called the Ferrari 458 GTC has competed in the GTE class at the WEC...

...and claimed an incredible victory in the GTE-Pro class at the Le Mans 24 Hours in 2012.

An FIA-GT3-compliant model of the 458 GT3 even competed in the Blancpain GT Series.

赛车。

这辆Ferrari 458 GTC是458 GT3的姐妹车型，
曾经参加过世界耐力锦标赛GTE组别的赛事……

还在2012年的勒芒24小时耐力赛的
GTE-Pro组别中拿下了异常精彩的一胜。
另外还有一款符合FIA-GT3规格的458 GT3车型
甚至参加了Blancpain GT系列赛。<

Beginning in 1966, the first-generation Ford GT claimed four consecutive wins at Le Mans.

Thirty-six years later, in 2005, a reproduction model was released to celebrate Ford’s centennial.

About 1,500 units of this reproduction model were sold as road cars.

But what if this car were to race at Le Mans today?

Developed for Gran Turismo, this Ford GT LM Race Car Spec II tries to answer that question.

Just wait until you see its speed on the straights!

?

turns.raw:
At the 1966 Le Mans, the first-generation Ford GT beat its archnemesis, Ferrari.

This victory made the Ford GT the first American car to win the 24-hour race.

Fast-forward 50 years to 2016.

The Ford GT returned to beat Ferrari once again at Le Mans.

It was an amazing feat 50 years in the making. It’s what makes racing so much fun!

Indeed, the long history of motorsports is filled with such iconic battles.

S

turns.zh:

成为了第一辆赢得这项24小时耐力赛的美国车。
我们将时针快拨50年，来到2016年……

Ford GT又回到了勒芒的赛场上，再次将Ferrari斩落马下！
这是一场跨越半个世纪的伟大胜利！也再次展现了赛车
运动的精彩与乐趣！
在赛车运动漫长的历史中，永远不缺乏这样的经典之战。,
turns.speaker: Jeremy

turns.raw:
A Gran Turismo Championship icon and the ultimate race car....

...inaugural series champion Igor Fraga and 2019 champion, Mikail Hizal...

...raced this machine at the 2018 GTC finals in Monaco to a near dead heat.

I’ll never forget the electrifying energy in the venue when the winner was announced!

The responsiveness of its 3.0-liter NA engine is incredible...

...and its exhaust note is like music!

Because of its sharp handling, it requires comprehensive driving skill to master.

But if you can tame this beast, you’re well on your way to becoming Gran Turismo royalty!


turns.en:
A Gran Turismo Championship icon
and the ultimate race car....
...inaugural series champion Igor Fraga and
2019 champion, Mikail Hizal...

...raced this machine at the 2018 GTC finals in Monaco
to a near dead heat.
I’ll never forget the electrifying energy in the venue
when the winner was announced!
The responsiveness of its 3.0-liter NA engine is incredible...

...and its exhaust note is like music!

Because of its sharp handling, it requires
comprehensive driving skill to master.
But if you can tame this beast, you’re well on
your way to becoming Gran Turismo royalty!
turns.zh:
它是GT锦标赛的传奇，也是终极的赛车。
首届锦标赛冠军伊戈尔·弗拉加和2019年度冠军
米迦勒·希扎尔……

驾驶着这款比赛机器在摩纳哥举行的2018年总决赛中杀得
难解难分。
我永远不会忘记最后宣布冠军那一刻赛场里迸发的热烈
气氛！
3升自然进气引擎的响应速度十分傲人……

它的排气声响听起来也极其美妙！

灵敏的操控意味着你需要拥有全面的驾驶技术才能够驾
驭它。
如果你能够驯服这头猛兽，相信你的跑车浪漫旅比赛传奇之路
会一路畅通！
turns.speaker: Jeremy

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_RaceEnthusiast_normal_epson_nsx_08_1504904
turns.raw:
Did you know that there is a full-scale paper model of this EPSON NSX?

It's true. EPSON commissioned Japanese paper artist Hitoshi Shinozaki to build one.

It’s entirely made of cardboard, including the tires and all of the other intricate parts.

It looks like the real thing, as if it could drive off at a moment’s notice.

But I digress.

The real NSX competed under EPSON colors in Japanese GT races from 2004 to 2009.

At the time, the All Japan Grand Touring Championship was evolving into the Super GT Series.

The EPSON NSX competed in the latter half of the 2008 season, where it came in 2nd place in Round 8 race.

z

It looks like the real thing, as if it could

in Japanese GT races from 2004 to 2009.

turns.zh:
你知道吗？这款ESPON NSX居然还有一套全尺寸的纸模呢。

这是真的，是Epson委托日本纸模艺术家筱崎仁帮他们打造的。
这个纸模全部由硬纸板做成，甚至连轮胎和其他的圆形
部件也不例外。

这个纸模看上去足以以假乱真，就好像可以随时上路一般！

……咳咳，不好意思跑题了。
Epson涂装的NSX真车参加了2004年到2009年期间的
全日本GT赛事。

当时正是全日本GT锦标赛向国际Super GT系列赛转型的阶段。
这款EPSON NSX参加的是2008年系列赛的后半段赛程，并在第8
轮中跑出了第二名的好成绩。
turns.speaker: Jeremy

turns.raw:
In 1955, Mercedes-Benz pulled out of all motorsports events.

It wasn’t until 1988 that it officially made its return.

And it did so with this car, the Sauber-Mercedes.

Because it was painted all silver, the car was called the "Silver Arrow."

Actually, there’s a story behind the name. Would you care to hear it?2
turns.en:
In 1955, Mercedes-Benz pulled out
of all motorsports events.

It wasn’t until 1988 that it officially
made its return.

And it did so with this car, the Sauber-Mercedes.
Because it was painted all silver, the car was called
the "Silver Arrow."

Actually, there’s a story behind the name.
Would you care to hear it?
turns.zh:
在1955年，Mercedes-Benz选择从汽车运动赛事中抽身。

直到1988年，他们才正式推出这辆Sauber-Mercedes，

并用它上演了一出王者归来！
因为采用了通体银色的车身，它得到了“银箭”的称号。

其实这个名字背后还有一段故事。你想要听吗？
turns.speaker: Jeremy

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_RaceEnthusiast_normal_sauber_mercedes_c9_89_1505105
turns.raw:
It all goes back some 90 years, to the Eifel race of 1934.

Back then, the all-white Mercedes F1 was deemed <1kg> too heavy for competition.

To reduce its weight, a mechanic scraped off the car's paint, exposing its aluminum body.

It was this silver-colored car that ended up winning the race.

This car was dubbed the "Silver Arrow," instantly becoming a symbol for racing excellence.

Since then, silver has been Germany’s national racing color.

Of course, sponsorship liveries are much more common today.

And race cars painted in their national colors are very much a thing of the past.

But if you’re interested in racing history, you should look into the national race colors of other countries.

turns.zh:
这个故事要说回到90多年前，那是1934年的埃菲尔比赛……

当时的那辆全白色梅赛德斯F1赛车因为超重1kg，无法参加比赛。

为了减重，一名机械师直接刮掉了喷漆，露出了铝制的
赛车车身。
最终，这辆原色梅赛德斯赛车还赢下了比赛！

于是赛车运动历史上最传奇的名称之一“银箭”便诞生了！
自那之后，银色就成为了德国的赛车运动主色调！

当然，今天的赛车运动中赞助商涂装已经非常普及。

采用国家官方配色的赛车已经成为了历史。
不过，如果你对F1的历史感兴趣，
不妨多了解一下其他国家的官方配色！
turns.speaker: Jeremy

Incredibly, it crossed the finish line and won the competition...

turns.raw:
Toyota introduced this Lexus SC430 as the successor to...

The 80 Supra for the Super GT racing series.

The 2008 series in which it debuted was a heated contest right down to the last race!

But when the Petronas Tom’s car crossed the finish line and took the team title...

It established itself as a champion car for the history books.

By the way, did you know that the base SC430 wwas a vario-roof convertible?

To get it battle-ready, Toyota built a reinforced roof that combined a roll cage and carbon panels...

and fit it over the original.

In other words, the SC430 GT500 is in fact built upon a coupe body!

j
turns.en:
Toyota introduced this Lexus SC430 as the successor to...

The 80 Supra for the Super GT racing series.
The 2008 series in which it debuted was a heated contest
right down to the last race!

But when the Petronas Tom’s car crossed the finish line
and took the team title...

It established itself as a champion car
for the history books.
By the way, did you know that the base SC430
wwas a vario-roof convertible?

To get it battle-ready, Toyota built a reinforced roof
that combined a roll cage and carbon panels...

and fit it over the original.
In other words, the SC430 GT500 is in fact
built upon a coupe body!
turns.zh:
这辆雷克萨斯SC430是丰田为……

参加Super GT赛事的80 Supra推出的继任者。
在这辆车出道的2008年，系列赛的每一场厮杀都十分激烈，
悬念一直留到了决赛！

最终，这辆Petronas Tom’s赛车越过终点线，
为车队夺得了冠军……

自己也作为冠军之车被载入了史册。
顺带一提，你知道SC430的基础车其实是一辆折叠硬顶敞篷车吗？

为了让它能够参赛，丰田专为它打造了以防滚车架
和碳纤维面板制造的强化车顶……

安在原先的车辆上。
换句话说，这辆SC430 GT500其实是基于双门轿跑的车身而打造的！
turns.speaker: Jeremy

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_RaceEnthusiast_normal__908_hdi_fap_peugeot_sport_10_1505404
turns.raw:
This Peugeot 908 HDi FAP really shot past the competition at the 2010 Le Mans 24 Hours!

After taking down reigning champ Audi at the 2009 race...

Peugeot approached the 2010 race eager for another win, and set to improving their 908.

And of the four 908s that competed, all four placed in the top qualifying positions!

What’s more, the fourth-place Peugeot beat the fifth-place Audi by over two seconds.

But you know, it’s no easy feat to win a 24-hour endurance race.

All of the Peugeot’s 908s experienced trouble on the track, and were forced to retire.

Which goes to show that endurance races are really not just about speed but also the strength to carry on.

'

turns.zh:
在2010年度的勒芒24小时耐力赛上，
标致908 HDi FAP宛如一支离弦之箭，速度快到惊人！

在2009年的勒芒比赛中击败卫冕冠军奥迪后……
标致继续精益求精，改良他们的908。
他们已经迫不及待地想要在2010年的赛场再度蝉联冠军。

后来，参赛的四辆908直接包揽了排位赛的前四！

而且就连第四名的标致都领先第五名的奥迪整整两秒以上。
然而，要赢得24小时耐力赛并不是那么轻而易举的事。

事与愿违，标致的所有参赛车都在赛道上
遭遇了困难，最终被迫退赛。
这也表明了一点——在耐力赛中，重要的不仅仅是速度，
坚持到底的耐久力也非常重要。
turns.speaker: Jeremy

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_RaceEnthusiast_normal_mercedes_amg_gt_gt3_16_1505504
turns.raw:
The AMG GT3 is renowned for its reliable strength at FIA GT3 races around the world.

It is doubtless the star player among GT3 machines.

In 2016, when the second-generation AMG GT3 was handed over to private teams...

It showed off its strength and speed, dominating the top positions at the 24 Hours Nürburgring in its debut year.

Also, while road-going AMG GTs were powered by a 4L twin-turbo V8...

This was not always the case with their racing counterparts.

For the SLS AMG GT3 was the first to be equipped with a race-tested 6.3L naturally-aspirated model.
turns.en:
The AMG GT3 is renowned for its reliable strength
at FIA GT3 races around the world.

It is doubtless the star player among GT3 machines.
In 2016, when the second-generation AMG GT3 was
handed over to private teams...

It showed off its strength and speed, dominating the top
positions at the 24 Hours Nürburgring in its debut year.
Also, while road-going AMG GTs
were powered by a 4L twin-turbo V8...

This was not always the case with
their racing counterparts.

For the SLS AMG GT3 was the first to be equipped
with a race-tested 6.3L naturally-aspirated model.
turns.zh:
AMG GT3以其在世界各地的国际汽联GT3比赛中表现出的
可靠性而在业界闻名。

在GT3组别的参赛车辆当中，它无疑是一位明星选手。
2016年，是第二代AMG GT3交付给私人车队使用的第一年……

在出道当年，它就表现出无与伦比的实力和速度，
成为纽博格林24小时耐力赛的顶流。
AMG GT的公路版本通常配备4升的双涡轮V8引擎……

但该引擎并未被应用到赛车版本上。

SLS AMG GT3是首款配备了一台经过比赛考验的
6.3升自然吸气引擎的车型。
turns.speaker: Jeremy

turns.raw:
In touring car races and rallies...

Renault has long been represented by the compact R5 and its successor, the Clio.

Ah, the WRC Gr.B R5 Turbo and the F2-class Clio Williams! Those were some great cars!

But what about the somewhat larger Mégane? Well...

They certainly pulled out all the stops for this Mégane Trophy!

Despite the outward resemblance to its road-going variant...

It is in fact a one-make racer, powered by a midship 3.8L V6 courtesy of Nissan!

It was originally built to compete in the popular Renault Sport Series, which takes place in Europe.

——Renaul Sport系列赛。

turns.raw:
Carroll Shelby made it his life’s mission to trounce Ferrari at the Le Mans 24 Hours.

The first attempt he made was, of course, in the famed Shelby Cobra.

However, as the open-bodied Cobra was lacking in terms of high-speed aerodynamics...

Shelby turned to designer Pete Brock for a body overhaul.

In return, Brock handed him back the Shelby Cobra Daytona Coupe.

However, by then, Shelby had given his attention to the development of the Ford GT40.

So this Cobra Daytona Coupe really only raced for a fleeting two years...

In 1964 and ’65.

Only a few Shelby Cobras were ever produced--I'm jealous of anyone who gets their hands on one!

]

turns.zh:
卡罗尔·谢尔比毕生的宿愿
就是在勒芒24小时耐力赛中完胜法拉利。

他的第一次尝试当然就是这辆声名斐然的Shelby Cobra。
显然，Cobra的敞篷车身缺乏高速时所需的空气动力学性能……

于是，谢尔比向设计师皮特·布洛克求助，
对车身进行了大幅修改。

布洛克交付给他的便是这台Shelby Cobra Daytona Coupe了。
只不过，此时谢尔比的注意力已经转向了福特GT40的开发。

因此这辆Cobra Daytona Coupe的赛车经历
只有短短的两年……

即1964和65年。
Shelby Cobra的制造数量极为有限——
真是嫉妒那些能搞到一辆的幸运儿！'
turns.speaker: Jeremy

turns.raw:
This SF19 was built for Japan’s top formula racing series, the Super Formula Championship.

The Super Formula is the preeminent formula racing event in all of Asia…

And is considered the quickest motorsport after F1.

In Super Formula races, drivers tend to show their skill through overtaking manoeuvres.

By the way, are you familiar with overtaking systems?

It is a system that allows a driver momentarily increases the flow of fuel to the engine for increased speed!

It requires plenty of control and the utmost technique!

This Honda-powered SF19 conjures up memories of Alex Palou’s record victory.

Palou later went on to compete in the IndyCar series, a formula racing series held in the USA.

turns.zh:
这辆SF19是为日本顶尖的方程式系列赛
——超级方程式锦标赛而开发的。

放眼整个亚洲，超级方程式都是最卓越的方程式比赛……

也被视为是仅次于F1的最快汽车赛事。
在超级方程式比赛中，车手们倾向于
通过超车来展现个人技巧。

顺带问一句，你对超级方程式的超车系统有了解吗？

它可以通过短暂提高注入引擎的燃料量，以提升车速！

同时也需要车手大量的操控和纯熟的技巧才能驾驭！
这辆本田出品的SF19见证了亚历克斯·帕卢
创下纪录的胜利。

在那之后，帕卢又转战印地系列赛，
那是在美国举办的另一项方程式赛车系列赛。

turns.raw:
Well, if it isn’t an SF19, built for Japan’s top formula race series, the Super Formula Championship.

Pop quiz! Do you know who supplies the SF19's engines?

The answer is: Toyota and Honda.

This machine here is powered by a Toyota engine, and it was raced by Kazuki Nakajima and Kamui Kobayashi.

That’s right, two racers that Toyota trained for the F1 Grand Prix!

Although it produces about half the power of an F1 car, it’s small, light, and possesses great aerodynamics.

Thanks to their F1 experience, the drivers were able to push the car to its limits.

Nick Cassidy was the series champion when this machine made its debut in 2019.

Well, if it isn’t an SF19, built for Japan’s top formula
race series, the Super Formula Championship.

Pop quiz! Do you know who supplies the SF19's
engines?

The answer is: Toyota and Honda.
This machine here is powered by a Toyota engine, and it was
raced by Kazuki Nakajima and Kamui Kobayashi.

That’s right, two racers that Toyota trained
for the F1 Grand Prix!
Although it produces about half the power of an F1 car,
it’s small, light, and possesses great aerodynamics.

Thanks to their F1 experience, the drivers were able
to push the car to its limits.
Nick Cassidy was the series champion when this machine
made its debut in 2019.
turns.zh:
哎呀，这不是SF19，专门为日本顶尖的方程式系列赛，
超级方程式锦标赛而打造的赛车吗！

突击小测验！你知道为SF19提供引擎的是哪个厂家吗？

答案就是……丰田和本田！
这一台车里用的是丰田的引擎，
而驾驶它参加比赛的分别是中岛一贵和小林可梦伟。

没错，这两位可都是丰田旗下参加过F1大奖赛的车手！
虽然SF19的动力只有F1赛车的一半，但它也更小巧而轻量，
并且空气动力学性能相当不赖。

得益于两位车手的F1经验，能将此车的潜能发挥到极限。
在SF19亮相的2019年，尼克·卡西迪赢得了当年的系列赛冠军。
turns.speaker: Jeremy

turns.raw:
Well, if it isn’t an SF19, built for Japan’s top formula race series, the Super Formula Championship.

Pop quiz! Do you know who supplies the SF19's engines?

The answer is: Toyota and Honda.

This machine here is powered by a Toyota engine, and it was raced by Kazuki Nakajima and Kamui Kobayashi.

That’s right, two racers that Toyota trained for the F1 Grand Prix!

Although it produces about half the power of an F1 car, it’s small, light, and possesses great aerodynamics.

Thanks to their F1 experience, the drivers were able to push the car to its limits.

Nick Cassidy was the series champion when this machine made its debut in 2019.

g
turns.en:
Well, if it isn’t an SF19, built for Japan’s top formula
race series, the Super Formula Championship.

Pop quiz! Do you know who supplies the SF19's
engines?

The answer is: Toyota and Honda.
This machine here is powered by a Toyota engine, and it was
raced by Kazuki Nakajima and Kamui Kobayashi.

That’s right, two racers that Toyota trained
for the F1 Grand Prix!
Although it produces about half the power of an F1 car,
it’s small, light, and possesses great aerodynamics.

Thanks to their F1 experience, the drivers were able
to push the car to its limits.
Nick Cassidy was the series champion when this machine
made its debut in 2019.
turns.zh:
哎呀，这不是SF19，专门为日本顶尖的方程式系列赛，
超级方程式锦标赛而打造的赛车吗！

突击小测验！你知道为SF19提供引擎的是哪个厂家吗？

答案就是……丰田和本田！
这一台车里用的是丰田的引擎，
而驾驶它参加比赛的分别是中岛一贵和小林可梦伟。

没错，这两位可都是丰田旗下参加过F1大奖赛的车手！
虽然SF19的动力只有F1赛车的一半，但它也更小巧而轻量，
并且空气动力学性能相当不赖。

得益于两位车手的F1经验，能将此车的潜能发挥到极限。
在SF19亮相的2019年，尼克·卡西迪赢得了当年的系列赛冠军。
turns.speaker: Jeremy

turns.raw:
A second-generation Swift Sport!

Thanks to its high base specs, this car can compete without much modification.

In fact, it was even entered as a junior rally car at the World Rally Championship!

Having taken the title twice, Suzuki has proved...

The great potential of this machine.

Manufacturing credit goes to Monster Sport, a Japanese company headed by Nobuhiro Tajima.

Speaking of Tajima-san...

His impressive career includes six consecutive wins at the Pikes Peak International Hillclimb.

Monster Sport has also built legendary hill climbers based on the Suzuki Cultus and Escudo.

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_RaceEnthusiast_normal_gr_supra_racing_concept_18_1506104
turns.raw:
The GR Supra Racing Concept was revealed at the Geneva Motor Show in March 2018.

When I saw it, I immediately thought to myself, "The Supra is back at the track!"

Truly, Toyota is an incredible company!

Prior to the GR Supra’s release in 2019...

They had developed models built to LMGTE and FIA GT-4 specifications.

Its debut race on Japanese soil was the first round of the 2020 Super GT, at Fuji Speedway.

And of the six Supras that apparently competed, five swept the top finishing positions!
turns.en:
The GR Supra Racing Concept was revealed at the
Geneva Motor Show in March 2018.
When I saw it, I immediately thought to myself,
"The Supra is back at the track!"
Truly, Toyota is an incredible company!

Prior to the GR Supra’s release in 2019...

They had developed models built to LMGTE and
FIA GT-4 specifications.
Its debut race on Japanese soil was the first round
of the 2020 Super GT, at Fuji Speedway.

And of the six Supras that apparently competed,
five swept the top finishing positions!
turns.zh:
GR Supra Racing Concept是于2018年3月在日内瓦车展上亮相的。
当我看到它的时候，
我就在心里对自己说，“Supra又回来比赛了！”
Toyota真的是一家让人惊艳的公司！

在2019年，GR Supra还没推出之前……
他们就开发过LMGTE和FIA GT-4级别规格的Supra。
此车在日本本土的出道首战是在富士赛车场
举行的2020 Super GT第一轮。

六辆参赛的Supra中，就有五辆车包揽了完赛前五名的名次！
turns.speaker: Jeremy

turns.raw:
This is the car that kick-started Honda’s near 60 years of Formula 1 Grand Prix history.

After a rough start in 1964, Honda was back in 1965, with this RA272.

It took the checkered flag at the Mexican Grand Prix in the final round of the season.

That year happened to be the last one in which F1 machines were powered by 1.5-liter naturally-aspirated engines.

And let me tell you, the engine that powered this RA272 was something special!

It was a V-12 with <1495cc> of displacement and capable of a whopping 230 horsepower!

Surprisingly, the displacement per cylinder was a mere <125cc>, something that reflected Honda's motorcycle engines.

What’s more, weighing in at <215kg>, this super compact engine was mounted horizontally amidships!

Have you ever heard of such a thing being done on a Formula 1 car?

But if you give it some thou�ht, you’ll see that it actually made a lot of sense.

By mounting an engine on its side, you can shorten the wheelbase and put less stress on the gearbox.

Compact and easy to handle, Honda’s early attempt at an F1 machine was an amazing display of engineering.

The track on which the Mexico Grand Prix takes place is <2300m> above sea level.

The low air pressure typically gives engines some trouble generating power.

In designing the RA272’s powerplant, former aircraft engineer and Honda’s F1 team leader Yoshio Nakamura...

...made sure it would function at high altitudes, giving the RA272 an edge over its rivals.

The driver of the winning car was Richie Ginther, one of the most skilled drivers of his day.

All these ingredients came together in Honda’s first F1 win. And with that, a glorious history was in the making!

turns.zh:
这款车是本田近60年的F1大奖赛历史的先行者。

在经历了1964年的艰难起步之后，本田在1965年
携这款RA272卷土重来……

它在本赛季的最后一站，即墨西哥大奖赛上取得了冠军。
1965年也是赛会允许F1赛车使用
1.5升自然吸气引擎的最后一个赛季。

事实上，为这台RA272提供动力的引擎有点本事！
这台排量为1495cc的V12引擎能够产生惊人的230马力！

更令人惊讶的是，单个汽缸的排量仅有125cc，
让人不禁联想到本田摩托车引擎的传承。

除此之外，这台超级紧凑的引擎重量仅为215kg，
而且横向安置在车体的中部！

你可曾听说过这样的事情发生在一台F1赛车上？
但是细细思量，你就会发现这样的设计实际上颇为合理。

通过将引擎横向放置T��可以缩短轴距，
减轻变速箱所承受的压力。

本田的初次试水获得了立竿见影的成效，
他们的F1赛车因尺寸紧凑而易于操控。
由于墨西哥大奖赛所处的赛道高于海平面，2300m

低气压通常会给引擎的动力输出带来一些影响。

在设计RA272的引擎时，前飞机工程师
兼本田的F1车队负责人中村良夫……

就确保了它能在高海拔地区正常运转，
使RA272在竞�9对手前抢占了先机。
而坐在获胜赛车中的车手里奇·金瑟尔，
也是一位真正专业的赛车大师！

所有的致胜因素在本田的第一个F1冠军头衔中
汇集到了一起。就这样，一段光辉的历史诞生了！
turns.speaker: Jeremy

In 1983, after a 15-year break, Honda returned to Formula 1 racing.

For the next 10 years, until it retired again in 1992, it dominated the competition like no other.

In 1984, a year after its comeback, a Honda-Williams machine claimed a victory at the American Grand Prix.

The driver of that car was none other than Keke Rosberg, winner of the 1982 F1 Drivers’ Championship.

Man, did he look super cool when it came time for him to ascend the podium.

In any event, the successor of Honda-Williams’ impressive machine was this McLaren MP4/4.

McLaren began powering its machines with Honda engines in 1988.

And with drivers Ayrton Senna and Alain Prost, it claimed the championship that year.

The man responsible for designing the MP4/4 was genius race-car designer Gordon Murray.

In addition to having a low center of gravity, the McLaren MP4/4 was equipped with Honda's 1.5-li�er RA168E engine.

This turbocharged engine normally produced at 685 horsepower, but it could be boosted to a maximum 1500 horsepower!

Apparently, the car had trouble with fuel economy, but Honda’s brilliant engineers found a way to deal with that.

Indeed, they managed to produce the best F1 engine of the day.

McLaren’s F1 results for the 1988 season were nothing short of astounding.

To start, they won 15 of 16 races that year!

They al�o claimed 15 pole positions, ten 1-2 finishes, and ten fastest laps.

And with 199 Constructors’ points, they finished 139 points ahead of the second-place team.

When it came to Drivers’ points, Prost had 87 and Senna had 90, handing him his first Drivers’ title.

This historic win for Senna took place at the Suzuka Circuit in the Japanese Grand Prix.

It was such a glorious win Soichiro Honda supposedly said, “If only every day could be this greatv”

turns.zh:
1983年，阔别赛场15年之后，本田回到了F1的赛场。

在接下来的十年里，本田彻底主宰了赛道，
直到1992年再次退出。

1984年，在本田归来一年后，本田-威廉姆斯车队的赛车
在美国大奖赛上取得了胜利。

夺冠车手正是1982年F1世界锦标赛总冠军得主——科克·罗斯伯格。

天啊，那位老兄登上领奖台的样子酷得不行。
紧随其后，延续本田-威廉姆斯优雅胜利
的是这辆迈凯伦MP4/4。

迈凯伦在1988年开始选用本田引擎作为他们赛车
的动力单元……

并与两位车手埃尔顿·塞纳和阿兰·普罗斯特一起，
一鼓作气夺得了制造商冠军。
负责设计这台MP4/4的人是F1天才工程师戈登·穆雷。

除了低重心设计外，迈凯伦MP4/4
还搭载了1.5升本田RA168E引擎。

这台涡轮增压引擎的标准功率就]��685马力，
但还可以通过增压提升到最大1500马力！

显然，这辆车的油耗会是个难题——
但本田出色的工程师们迎难而上，成功克服了这项艰巨的任务。

事实上，他们制造出了当时最出色的F1引擎。
迈凯伦在1988年赛季取得的成绩惊天动地。

这么说吧，他们赢下了那年16场比赛中的15场！

他们还拿下了15个杆位，在10场比赛中完成一二带回，�
以及创造了十次最快圈速。

最终，他们获得了199分的制造商积分，
足足领先第二名139分！

在车手积分方面，普罗斯特拿下87分，而塞纳拿下90分，
获得了他的第一个世界冠军。
塞纳的这次历史性胜利就发生在日本大奖赛的铃鹿赛道上。

这场胜利是如此的辉煌，以至于我仿佛还能听到
本田宗一郎说：“如果每天都能如此精彩就好了！”P
turns.speaker: Jeremy

turns.zh:
1983年，阔别赛场15年之后，本田回到了F1的赛场。

在接下来的十年里，本田彻底主宰了赛道，
直到1992年再次退出。

1984年，在本田归来一年后，本田-威廉姆斯车队的赛车
在美国大奖赛上取得了胜利。

夺冠车手正是1982年F1世界锦标赛总冠军得主——科克·罗斯伯格。

天啊，那位老兄登上领奖台的样子酷得不行。
紧随其后，延续本田-威廉姆斯优雅胜利
的是这辆迈凯伦MP4/4。

迈凯伦在1988年开始选用本田引擎作为他们赛车
的动力单元……

并与两位车手埃尔顿·塞纳和阿兰·普罗斯特一起，
一鼓作气夺得了制造商冠军。
负责设计这台MP4/4的人是F1天才工程师戈登·穆雷。

除了低重心设计外，迈凯伦MP4/4
还搭载了1.5升本田RA168E引擎。

这台涡轮增压引擎的标准功率就]��685马力，
但还可以通过增压提升到最大1500马力！

显然，这辆车的油耗会是个难题——
但本田出色的工程师们迎难而上，成功克服了这项艰巨的任务。

事实上，他们制造出了当时最出色的F1引擎。
迈凯伦在1988年赛季取得的成绩惊天动地。

这么说吧，他们赢下了那年16场比赛中的15场！

他们还拿下了15个杆位，在10场比赛中完成一二带回，�
以及创造了十次最快圈速。

最终，他们获得了199分的制造商积分，
足足领先第二名139分！

在车手积分方面，普罗斯特拿下87分，而塞纳拿下90分，
获得了他的第一个世界冠军。
塞纳的这次历史性胜利就发生在日本大奖赛的铃鹿赛道上。

这场胜利是如此的辉煌，以至于我仿佛还能听到
本田宗一郎说：“如果每天都能如此精彩就好了！”P

Ah, the 1973 Porsche 911 Carrera RS... What a legend! What a treasure!

This precious gem was designed to compete in touring car races.

Touring car races are specifically for modified production cars.

The extent to which a car can be modified is heavily restricted by FIA guidelines.

But transforming high-performance road cars into pure race cars...

...is serious business for many automakers, and it has led to the some really special machines.

These cars are known as homologation models, which means they meet FIA requirements for competition.

When the FIA revised its world championship regulations in 1973...

...Porsche was approved to compete in Group 4 (Gr.4) of the Grand Touring competition.

The 911 Carrera RS was the homologation model designed to conquer this Gr.4 class.

The road-going car was made lighter and more powerful than the standard 911...

...and served as the base for the competition-tuned 911 Carrera RSR!

When the 911 Carrera RSR made its debut in March 1973 at the 12 Hours of Sebring in Florida...

...it turned heads with a dazzling 1-2 finish!

After that, it continued to perform well at the world championship series!

It even came out on top against more powerful rivals at major races like the Daytona 24 Hours and Targa Florio.

That season was simply mag�ificent, as it scored a well-deserved world championship title!

turns.zh:
啊，1973款保时捷911 Carrera RS……
好一个传奇！好一颗瑰宝！

这款保时捷的掌上明珠是专为参加房车赛而设计的，
后者是专为公路车改装赛车设立的比赛。

尽管其改装程度受到了国际汽联准则的严格限制……

但打造一台可以轻易改装为符合
赛事规格赛车的高性能公路车……

依然有许多汽车制造商将其视为工作的重点。
也因此，许多出类拔萃的高性能车应运而生。

这类汽车被称为“赛事认证车型”，
代表它们符合国际汽联的比赛规格要求。
当国际汽联在1973年修订其世界锦标赛规则时……

保时捷被批准参加房车赛组别4（Gr.4）级别的比赛。

这台911 Carrera RS正是为征服组别4级别赛事而设计的赛事认证车型。
这款改装后的公路跑车比标准版911更轻、动力也更强劲��
并成为了竞赛规格的911 Carrera RSR的原型！

911 Carrera RSR于1973年3月在佛罗里达州的
赛百灵12小时耐力赛上首次亮相……

就以包揽前两名的惊人战绩让所有人眼前一亮！

此后，它继续在世界锦标赛的各项系列赛中发挥出色！
它甚至在戴通纳24小时耐力赛和塔格·佛罗热等重大比赛中
力压性能更强大的对手并脱颖而出。<p/�
对于保时捷来说，这是一个辉煌的赛季，
也是属于当之无愧的世界冠军的胜利！
turns.speaker: Jeremy

The Honda S series will always be remembered for the bold way it tore up the race track!

It was Honda’s first mass-produced car and a true racer that was active before its official release.

In 1963, a year before its debut, it took part in a famous European rally called the Marathon de la Route.

A year later, the Honda S600 pulled off a stunning GT1-class victory at the Japanese Grand Prix.

In the same year, it also competed in world endurance races, such as the Nürburgring 500 km, where it won best-in-class.

Around this time, Honda was also performing well in Formula 1 and had established itself as a major player in motorsports.

The year 1966 saw this S800, powered by a <791cc>-engine.

This car became the vanguard of Japanese racing well into the 1970s.

At the time, Honda had plans to establish a motorsports support department for S seri�s competition racers.

This initiative would later result in the creation of the Racing Service Center (RSC).

Today, RSC is known as Honda Racing Corporation (HRC), a division of Honda overseeing motorsports activities.

Indeed, the S series is an indispensable part of Honda and Japan’s racing history!

turns.zh:
本田S系列将永远被人们铭记，因为它曾经以不羁
的风格征服了赛道！

它是本田的第一辆量产车，也是一款真正的
赛道机器，在其正式发售之前就活跃在赛场上。
1963年，在其正式发布的前一年，它就参加了
鼎鼎大名的欧洲拉力赛——84小时马拉松汽车耐力赛。

一年之后的1964年，在首次亮相后，本田S600
又在日本大奖赛的GT1级别中取得了惊人的胜利。
同年，它还参加了世界耐力赛，
在纽博格林500km赛事上战胜了同级别最强大的对手！

在本田S系列大放异彩期间，本田在F1锦标赛中也屡有出色表现，
从而在赛车运动领域确立了自己的重要地位。
1966年，这款由791cc引擎驱动的S800发布。

并且一直到1970年代都处于日本赛车的先锋地位。

当时�7本田就计划为参加S系列比赛的赛车手们
建立一个赛车运动支持部门。

这一提案在后来推动了赛车服务中心的创建……
也就是今天的本田赛车公司——专门统管其赛车活动的部门。
可以这么说，S系列是本田和日本赛车历史中
不可缺少的一部分！
turns.speaker: Jeremy

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_RaceEnthusiast_normal_rs_5_dtm_19_1506604
turns.raw:
This is the Audi RS5 Turbo DTM, the legendary double-title winner of the 2019 Deutsche Tourenwagen Masters (DTM)!

First held in 1984, the DTM is a race series predominantly featuring German automakers.

While DTM regulations have varied from time to time, the 1990s were known for race cars with crazy top speeds.

Heavily modified cars and the latest technology made the series “the fastest touring car race in the world.”

In 2019, Class 1 regulations were introduced, which were near-identical to those of Japan’s Super GT GT500 class.

This Audi RS5 Turbo DTM was one machine built to meet the new Class 1 regulations.

The plan at the time was to unify the DTM and Super GT technical regulations...

...and in 2019, joint-series races between the two organizations were actually held!

Afterwards, the DTM switched to a GT3-formula, bringing an en� to a truly unified series with Super GT.

In any event, this Class-1 Audi RS5 Turbo DTM from 2019, which competed in those joint-series races...

...is, without a doubt, one of the most notable cars in DTM’s history.

turns.zh:
这是一辆传奇般的奥迪RS5 Turbo DTM，2019年
德国房车大师赛的双料冠军！
德国房车大师赛首办于1984年，主要由德国汽车制造商参赛。

尽管德国房车大师赛的规则在其漫长的历史上经历了无数次变更，但到了
九十年代，这项赛事主要以其疯狂的高速获得世人关注。

高度改装的汽车配合顶尖科技，使这项赛事
成为了“全世界最快的房车赛”。
在2019年，这项赛事引入了“组别1”规格，
与日本Super GT的GT500组别规格相仿。

这辆奥迪RS5 Turbo DTM就是专门为
符合“组别1”组别所打造的比赛机器。

当时的目标就是统一德国房车大师赛和Super GT的技术规格……

而且在2019年，这两项赛事甚至真的举办了联合赛事！
在那之后，德国房车大师赛转变为GT3形式，放弃了
与Super GT合并的计划。
尽管如此，这辆在举办联合赛事的2019年推出的
组别1奥迪RS5 Turbo DTM……

毫无疑问是德国房车大师赛历史上最重要的冠军车之一。
turns.speaker: Jeremy

尽管德国房车大师赛的规则在其漫长的历史上经历了无数次变更，但到了
九十年代，这项赛事主要以其疯狂的高速获得世人关注。

高度改装的汽车配合顶尖科技，使这项赛事
成为了“全世界最快的房车赛”。
在2019年，这项赛事引入了“组别1”规格，
与日本Super GT的GT500组别规格相仿。

这辆奥迪RS5 Turbo DTM就是专门为
符合“组别1”组别所打造的比赛机器。

当时的目标就是统一德国房车大师赛和Super GT的技术规格……

而且在2019年，这两项赛事甚至真的举办了联合赛事！
在那之后，德国房车大师赛转变为GT3形式，放弃了
与Super GT合并的计划。
尽管如此，这辆在举办联合赛事的2019年推出的
组别1奥迪RS5 Turbo DTM……

毫无疑问是德国房车大师赛历史上最重要的冠军车之一。

Heavily modified cars and the latest technology made the series “the fastest touring car race in the world.”

In 2019, Class 1 regulations were introduced, which were near-identical to those of Japan’s Super GT GT500 class.

This Audi RS5 Turbo DTM was one machine built to meet the new Class 1 regulations.

The plan at the time was to unify the DTM and Super GT technical regulations...

...and in 2019, joint-series races between the two organizations were actually held!

Afterwards, the DTM switched to a GT3-formula, bringing an en� to a truly unified series with Super GT.

In any event, this Class-1 Audi RS5 Turbo DTM from 2019, which competed in those joint-series races...

...is, without a doubt, one of the most notable cars in DTM’s history.

turns.raw:
The Porsche Carrera GTS is hailed as one of the most beautiful cars of the 1960s.

It is also known as the Porsche 904.

A mass-produced sports car, its design and mid-engine chassis were clearly built to win races.

As soon as it rolled off the production line in 1964, it set out to dominate in every race it entered.

Its performance at the famous Targa Florio in Italy is well known.

The Targa Florio was a road endurance race in Sicily consisting of a 72km track that was lapped ten times.

Competing in the Targa Florio’s GT2 class in April 1964, the Carrera GTS...

...bested its rivals Ferrari, Alfa Romeo and Ford, claiming an impressive overall victory.

The drivers who piloted the Carrera GTS were Antonio Pucci from Italy, and Colin Davis from England.

In the same year, the Carrera GTS also won class victories� at Sebring and Le Mans.

A year later, in 1965, it won again at the Targa Florio and elsewhere.

*

turns.zh:
保时捷Carrera GTS被誉为二十世纪六十年代
最美的汽车之一。

它还有另一个名字——保时捷904。
作为一款量产跑车，它的设计和中置引擎底盘
很明显是为了赢得比赛而设计的。
当这款车在1964年开下生产线后，它立刻
就向全世界证明了自己的实力。

这辆车在意大利的塔格·佛罗热大赛上的杰出表现举世闻名。
塔格·佛罗热大赛是一项在意大利西西里举行的公路耐力赛，
需要跑完十圈共计72公里。

这辆Carrera GTS于1964年4月参加了
塔格·佛罗热大赛的GT2组别……

击败了法拉利、阿尔法罗密欧和福特等对手，光荣地赢得了总冠军！

完成这一伟大成就的车手是来自意大利的安东尼奥·普基
和来自英格兰的科林·戴维斯。
在�+�一年，Carrera GTS还赢得了赛百灵12小时耐力赛
和勒芒24小时耐力赛的冠军。

一年之后的1965年，它又气势汹汹地杀回塔格·佛罗热大赛
和多项其他比赛，并再度夺魁！_
turns.speaker: Jeremy

turns.raw:
The Porsche Carrera GTS is hailed as one of the most beautiful cars of the 1960s.

It is also known as the Porsche 904.

A mass-produced sports car, its design and mid-engine chassis were clearly built to win races.

As soon as it rolled off the production line in 1964, it set out to dominate in every race it entered.

Its performance at the famous Targa Florio in Italy is well known.

The Targa Florio was a road endurance race in Sicily consisting of a 72km track that was lapped ten times.

Competing in the Targa Florio’s GT2 class in April 1964, the Carrera GTS...

...bested its rivals Ferrari, Alfa Romeo and Ford, claiming an impressive overall victory.

The drivers who piloted the Carrera GTS were Antonio Pucci from Italy, and Colin Davis from England.

In the same year, the Carrera GTS also won class victories� at Sebring and Le Mans.

A year later, in 1965, it won again at the Targa Florio and elsewhere.

*

turns.zh:
保时捷Carrera GTS被誉为二十世纪六十年代
最美的汽车之一。

它还有另一个名字——保时捷904。
作为一款量产跑车，它的设计和中置引擎底盘
很明显是为了赢得比赛而设计的。
当这款车在1964年开下生产线后，它立刻
就向全世界证明了自己的实力。

这辆车在意大利的塔格·佛罗热大赛上的杰出表现举世闻名。
塔格·佛罗热大赛是一项在意大利西西里举行的公路耐力赛，
需要跑完十圈共计72公里。

这辆Carrera GTS于1964年4月参加了
塔格·佛罗热大赛的GT2组别……

击败了法拉利、阿尔法罗密欧和福特等对手，光荣地赢得了总冠军！

完成这一伟大成就的车手是来自意大利的安东尼奥·普基
和来自英格兰的科林·戴维斯。
在�+�一年，Carrera GTS还赢得了赛百灵12小时耐力赛
和勒芒24小时耐力赛的冠军。

一年之后的1965年，它又气势汹汹地杀回塔格·佛罗热大赛
和多项其他比赛，并再度夺魁！_

turns.raw:
The Porsche 959 is perhaps best remembered for its performance at the Paris-Dakar Rallies of the 1980s.

The Paris-Dakar Rally...

...was a race that stretched for more than 10,000km, from Paris, France, to Dakar, Senegal.

A course spanning vast deserts and mountainous terrain, it was considered the toughest rally in the world.

Porsche’s first success at the event was in 1984, a year before the 959’s official debut.

Driver René Metge pulled off a marvelous overall victory in a 911 fitted with a developmental 4WD system.

A year later, in 1985, Porsche entered the race with a 959, which combined 4WD and a twin-turbo engine.

However, it wasn’t until ’86 that the 959 had an overall victory at the rally, once again thanks to René Metge!

turns.zh:
保时捷959最值得铭记的大概就是它在二十世纪八十年代的
巴黎-达喀尔拉力赛上的杰出表现。
巴黎-达喀尔拉力赛……

是一项从法国巴黎前往塞内加尔的达喀尔，
行程超过10000公里的拉力远征。

其赛道横跨广阔的沙漠和山脉地形，
被誉为世界上最艰苦的拉力赛。
保时捷在这项赛事中拿到的首冠是在1984年，
959正式亮相的前一年……

当时雷内·梅杰驾驶着一辆安装有实验性四驱系统的911，
英勇地夺下了总冠军。
一年之后的1985年，保时捷终于派出了959参赛，
同样采用四轮驱动系统和双涡轮增压引擎的搭配。

不过959要等到1986年才拿到了总冠军，
而这一次夺魁的车手还是雷内·梅杰！
turns.speaker: Jeremy

turns.raw:
This is the SF23, a car developed for the Super Formula series, Japan's top-level formula race competition.

All teams participating in Super Formula must use a race car with the same chassis.

Teams are also restricted to a turbocharged 2.0-liter 4-cylinder engine built by either Toyota or Honda.

That effectively makes Super Formula a one-make race series.

In such a contest, victory is largely decided by a combination of individual skill and team strategy.

This is one of the major draws of Japanese Super Formula races.

Super Formula machines are distinguished by their aerodynamic design...

...which is meant to limit air resistance at the rear and sides of the body.

Because these machines are so similar in capability, the race becomes a test of a driver’s skill.

The SF23 pushes this concept to new heights,� promising more dramatic wheel-to-wheel action!



turns.zh:
这辆SF23是专为日本的顶级方程式系列赛事
——超级方程式所打造的赛车。
所有参与超级方程式的车队都必须
使用同一款底盘开发的赛车。

并且，所有车队也只允许采用由丰田或本田所开发的
两款规格一致的2升4缸涡轮增压引擎之一。

因此超级方程式本质上也是一项单一车种方程式赛事。
在这样的比赛中，胜利在很大程度上是由
车手个人和车队策略所共同决定的。

这也是日本超级方程式系列赛的主要魅力之一。
超级方程式赛车拥有非常独特的空气动力学设计……

致力于尽量降低车身两侧和后部的空气阻力。

由于赛车的性能旗鼓相当，因此这项赛事
也成为了车手操控技术的比拼。
到了今年，这款SF23又将这一理^��拔高到了全新高度，
保证可以为车迷们带来更激动人心的白刃战场面！"
turns.speaker: Jeremy

This is the SF23, a car developed for the Super Formula series, Japan's top-level formula race competition.

All teams participating in Super Formula must use a race car with the same chassis.

Teams are also restricted to a turbocharged 2.0-liter 4-cylinder engine built by either Toyota or Honda.

That effectively makes Super Formula a one-make race series.

In such a contest, victory is largely decided by a combination of individual skill and team strategy.

This is one of the major draws of Japanese Super Formula races.

Super Formula machines are distinguished by their aerodynamic design...

...which is meant to limit air resistance at the rear and sides of the body.

Because these machines are so similar in capability, the race becomes a test of a driver’s skill.

The SF23 pushes this concept to new heights,� promising more dramatic wheel-to-wheel action!

turns.raw:
Ever since it was introduced, the Mercedes AMG GT3 has been hailed as one of the fastest and fiercest GT3 race cars.

The original AMG GT3 made its debut in 2016.

At its first Nürburgring 24 Hours race, it did the unthinkable, achieving an amazing 1-2-3 finish!

This machine is the updated AMG GT3, which was introduced in 2019.

It featured aerodynamic improvements that generated greater downforce than before.

Also, an all-new braking system placed less stress on the tires.

While these performance upgrades resulted in faster lap times...

...a more durable engine gave the AMG GT3 increased reliability. And, a vastly improved parts management system...

...as well as several other tweaks made setting up and servicing the car easier for race mechanics.K

has been hailed as one of the fastest and fiercest GT3 race cars.

While these performance upgrades resulted in

...a more durable engine gave the AMG GT3 increased reliability.
And, a vastly improved parts management system...
...as well as several other tweaks made setting up and servicing the car easier for race mechanics.
turns.zh:
自初代型号发布以来，梅赛德斯AMG GT3一直被誉为
最强最速GT3赛车。
初代AMG GT3在2016年首次登上赛车舞台。

在参加的第一场纽博格林24小时耐力赛里，
它令人震惊地包揽了前三名，创下了永垂史册的壮举！
我们面前的这款赛车是升级后的AMG GT3，
于2019年首次亮相。

经过全面强化的空气动力性能
确保可以提供超强的下压力！

而全新的刹车技术则有效降低了轮胎磨损的压力。
除了这些性能升级带来的更出色的单圈时间外……

这辆AMG GT3还配备了更耐用的引擎、
一套大幅升级的零部件管理系统……
以及多项精细调整，从而帮助车队在赛道上更加风驰电掣。
turns.speaker: Jeremy

Most every rally-racing enthusiast knows about the "Evo." The Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution is really that historic.

This is the Evo III, the third-generation model. It's a car with a storied history.

It helped Mitsubishi ace driver Tommi Mäkinen win his first WRC drivers title in 1996.

Mäkinen then went on to win four consecutive drivers titles piloting different iterations of the "Evo."

He was truly a legendary rally driver.

And, the car that put him on his path to history was a rally car based on this Mitsubishi Lancer Evo III.

Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution就是有这么出名。
这台是Evo III，第三代车型，有着一段传奇的历史……
当Mitsubishi的王牌车手，托米·马基宁在96 WRC上
赢得首个车手冠军时，驾驶的便是这辆车。

此后，马基宁驾驶着不同迭代版本的“Evo”
拿下了车手冠军四连胜！

他是拉力赛史上的传奇车手！
而助他走上荣耀之路的正是基于这台
Mitsubishi Lancer Evo III开发的拉力赛车。

The Maserati MC20 is a mid-engine sports car from 2020.

The letters in its name stand for "Maserati" and "Corse," meaning "race," along with its introduction year.

You can think of it as a successor to the MC12, that legend built to compete at the 2004 FIA GT Championship.

Since its founding in the early-20th century, Maserati has been known for its race cars.

From F1 machines like the 250F to sports cars like the A6GCS, there is no limits to the company's achievements.

Now, while Maserati hasn’t been racing much these days...

...this MC20-based machine marked its glorious return to the track!

turns.raw:
Why, this is the Garage RCR Civic, the winner of the Gran Turismo Award at SEMA 2017!

Garage RCR refers to a body shop in Phoenix, Arizona, and the Civic, which this car is based om, is the 1992 EG.

The custom parts are genuine JDM!

From its widebody kit to its hood, a wealth of Japanese tuning parts have been expertly used.

Built to excel at time attacks, its chassis, engine and transmission were tuned to perfection.

You’ll be blown away by its 5-speed sequential gearbox and 400ps of turbocharged power.

I hear that Phil Robles, the owner of this car...

...built it piece-by-piece with his son Jesse.

A
turns.en:
Why, this is the Garage RCR Civic, the winner of the Gran
Turismo Award at SEMA 2017!
Garage RCR refers to a body shop in Phoenix, Arizona,
and the Civic, which this car is based om, is the 1992 EG.

The custom parts are genuine JDM!
From its widebody kit to its hood, a wealth of
Japanese tuning parts have been expertly used.
Built to excel at time attacks, its chassis, engine and
transmission were tuned to perfection.

You’ll be blown away by its 5-speed sequential gearbox
and 400ps of turbocharged power.
I hear that Phil Robles, the owner of this car...

...built it piece-by-piece with his son Jesse.
turns.zh:
哇，这就是那台Garage RCR思域，
2017年美国汽车用品改装车展览会跑车浪漫旅大奖的得主！
“Garage RCR”指的是亚利桑那州凤凰城的一家车身工厂，
“思域”则是指这辆改装车的原型车'92 EG思域。

它所有的定制部件都是纯正的JDM（为日本国内市场生产）！
从宽体套件到前引擎盖，都是从品类丰富的日本改装件中
专业甄选出来的。
为了在计时赛中获得出色的成绩，它的底盘、引擎
及变速箱都经过了精心调校。

五速序列变速箱和高达400马力的涡轮增压引擎
绝对震撼。
据说这辆车是由它的主人飞利浦·罗伯斯与
他的儿子杰西一起……

逐个零件亲手组装起来的！
turns.speaker: Jeremy

This Mercedes-Benz CLK-LM from 1998 is a legend of that GT1 category.

It was the successor to the CLK-GTR, which was built in only 128 days...

...to compete in the 1997 championship.

Despite its short production time, the CLK-GTR really tore up the track!

At the championship in 1997, it won six of 11 races, earning it the coveted series title.

Appearing in the middle of the 1998 series was the CLK-GTR’s evolution model—the CLK-LM.

With these two cars, Mercedes-Benz went on to win every race of the GT Championship that year!

turns.raw:
Do you remember when the Toyota GT-One competed at Le Mans in 1998 and 1999?

Well, I remember those spectacular races like it was yesterday!

And while Toyota may not have taken the overall victory it was hoping for...

...it was doubtless the team that everybody expected to see on the podium in 1999.

That year, Toyota entered three GT-Ones at Le Mans, and they thoroughly impressed during qualifying!

Two of its cars took the 1st and 2nd positions, while the 3rd started in P8.

The performance of the cars were simply awesome.

However, at the start of the race, the top two GT-Ones had to retire—a reminder that anything can happen on the track.

This left Toyota with only the No. 3 car...

...driven by Toshio Suzuki, Ukyo Katayama, and Keiichi Tsuchiya.

Having lost its top two cars, Toyota bet the farm on this last hope of winning.

Initially racing on the defensive, Car No. 3 quickly changed its tactics, going on the offensive.

Picking up its pace, it miraculously set a course record in the final part of the race.

Before long, it climbed to 2nd place, with the race-leader, BMW, in its crosshairs.

But then—it burst a rear tire while traveling at more than 300 km/h!

An attempt was made to continue, but an emergency pitstop dashed Toyota’s dream of an overall victory.

After � tire change, Car No. 3 raced to a 2nd-place finish that had all the world holding its breath.

This is why the GT-One has a special place in my heart, even if Toyota has now become a Le Mans champion.

�

你还记得丰田GT-1在1998年和1999年
参加勒芒24小时耐力赛时的飒爽身姿吗？

嗯，那几场精彩的比赛让我记忆犹新！
尽管丰田没能获得期待中的总冠军……

但毫无疑问，每个人都相信这支车队
是99年的夺冠热门。

在那一年，丰田将三辆GT-1赛车带到了勒芒，
并以风驰电掣的速度一路碾压排位赛阶段！

三辆车中的两辆分别夺得了第一和第二名，
而第三辆车排在第8名。

每辆车跑出的时间都不容轻视。

然而决赛甫一开始，两辆领先的GT-1赛车就被迫退赛，
也证明了赛道上一切意外皆可能发生。
于是丰田车队只剩下了一辆赛车……

由片山右京、铃木利男和土屋圭市驾驶的3号GT-1。
在损失了两辆前排赛车之后，丰田将赌注全部下
在了这台唯��的希望上。

3号赛车最初采取了守势，但很快便转守为攻……

并且不断加速，在比赛最后阶段奇迹般地
创下了赛道纪录。

很快它就攀升到了第二名，并将目标锁定在了
领先的宝马赛车上……
但接下来发生的事情让所有人惊掉了下巴
——在超过<300 km/h>的时速下，它的一个后轮发生了爆胎！

他们选择顽强坚持，但被迫紧急进站也剥夺了
他�赢得总冠军的梦想！

在更换轮胎后，3号赛车奋力追赶，让全世界
都屏住了呼吸，最终仍旧以第二名完赛。
这就是为什么即便现在丰田已经成为了勒芒冠军，
GT-1依然在我心中占据了非常特殊的地位。
turns.speaker: Jeremy

turns.raw:
Do you remember when the Toyota GT-One competed at Le Mans in 1998 and 1999?

Well, I remember those spectacular races like it was yesterday!

And while Toyota may not have taken the overall victory it was hoping for...

...it was doubtless the team that everybody expected to see on the podium in 1999.

That year, Toyota entered three GT-Ones at Le Mans, and they thoroughly impressed during qualifying!

Two of its cars took the 1st and 2nd positions, while the 3rd started in P8.

The performance of the cars were simply awesome.

However, at the start of the race, the top two GT-Ones had to retire—a reminder that anything can happen on the track.

This left Toyota with only the No. 3 car...

...driven by Toshio Suzuki, Ukyo Katayama, and Keiichi Tsuchiya.

Having lost its top two cars, Toyota bet the farm on this last hope of winning.

Initially racing on the defensive, Car No. 3 quickly changed its tactics, going on the offensive.

Picking up its pace, it miraculously set a course record in the final part of the race.

Before long, it climbed to 2nd place, with the race-leader, BMW, in its crosshairs.

But then—it burst a rear tire while traveling at more than 300 km/h!

An attempt was made to continue, but an emergency pitstop dashed Toyota’s dream of an overall victory.

After � tire change, Car No. 3 raced to a 2nd-place finish that had all the world holding its breath.

This is why the GT-One has a special place in my heart, even if Toyota has now become a Le Mans champion.

�

你还记得丰田GT-1在1998年和1999年
参加勒芒24小时耐力赛时的飒爽身姿吗？

嗯，那几场精彩的比赛让我记忆犹新！
尽管丰田没能获得期待中的总冠军……

但毫无疑问，每个人都相信这支车队
是99年的夺冠热门。

在那一年，丰田将三辆GT-1赛车带到了勒芒，
并以风驰电掣的速度一路碾压排位赛阶段！

三辆车中的两辆分别夺得了第一和第二名，
而第三辆车排在第8名。

每辆车跑出的时间都不容轻视。

然而决赛甫一开始，两辆领先的GT-1赛车就被迫退赛，
也证明了赛道上一切意外皆可能发生。
于是丰田车队只剩下了一辆赛车……

由片山右京、铃木利男和土屋圭市驾驶的3号GT-1。
在损失了两辆前排赛车之后，丰田将赌注全部下
在了这台唯��的希望上。

3号赛车最初采取了守势，但很快便转守为攻……

并且不断加速，在比赛最后阶段奇迹般地
创下了赛道纪录。

很快它就攀升到了第二名，并将目标锁定在了
领先的宝马赛车上……
但接下来发生的事情让所有人惊掉了下巴
——在超过<300 km/h>的时速下，它的一个后轮发生了爆胎！

他们选择顽强坚持，但被迫紧急进站也剥夺了
他�赢得总冠军的梦想！

在更换轮胎后，3号赛车奋力追赶，让全世界
都屏住了呼吸，最终仍旧以第二名完赛。
这就是为什么即便现在丰田已经成为了勒芒冠军，
GT-1依然在我心中占据了非常特殊的地位。
turns.speaker: Jeremy

turns.raw:
The NSX is a Japanese GT racer! This was proved at the 2000 All Japan Grand Touring Championship (JGTC).

The NSX made its first appearance in the JGTC’s GT500 class during the 1996 season.

Despite putting up a good fight...

It was unable to beat such powerful opponents as the Nissan Skyline GT-R and Toyota Supra.

However, come 2000, the NSX took a great evolutionary leap forward.

In this year, a team of five NSXs won four of seven races...

With Ryo Michigami, in the No.16 Castrol MUGEN NSX, winning the driver’s title.

This was the first time an NSX won in JGTC history.

�
turns.en:
The NSX is a Japanese GT racer! This was proved at the 2000
All Japan Grand Touring Championship (JGTC).

The NSX made its first appearance in the JGTC’s GT500 class
during the 1996 season.
Despite putting up a good fight...

It was unable to beat such powerful opponents as the Nissan
Skyline GT-R and Toyota Supra.

However, come 2000, the NSX took a great evolutionary
leap forward.
In this year, a team of five NSXs won four of seven races...
With Ryo Michigami, in the No.16 Castrol MUGEN NSX,
winning the driver’s title.
This was the first time an NSX won in JGTC history.
turns.zh:
这辆NSX是参加全日本GT锦标赛的赛车啊！它的实力已经在2000年
全日本GT锦标赛中得到了充分证明。

NSX在1996赛季全日本GT锦标赛的GT500组别中首次亮相。
尽管拼尽全力……

仍然无法撼动如日产Skyline GT-R和丰田Supra
这样的强大对手。

不过当时间来到2000年，NSX得到了飞跃般的进化。
在这个赛季，总共五辆NSX组成的参赛阵容拿下了
七场比赛中的四场胜利……
而驾驶16号嘉实多无限NSX赛车的道上龙
更是赢下了车手冠军头衔。
这也是NSX在全日本GT锦标赛的历史上首次夺魁。
turns.speaker: Jeremy

What a way to win the series title!

And the way it stood up to those mighty European cars— how cool is that!

turns.raw:
More than anything, I associate the Volvo 240 series with racing.

The 2-door sedan turbo model made a big splash at European and German touring car championships.

So much so that its hallmark boxy shape earned it the nickname ‘the Flying Brick.’

Racing performance aside, this Estate model is a legend among legends.

Between 1974 and 1993, the Volvo 240 series sold some 2.7 million units...

Of which, 950,000 were the Estate model. Now, more than thirty years after its retirement...

It remains the classic estate car that people all over the world still love to this day!

turns.zh:
在我心目中，Volvo 240系列都堪称非常优秀的赛车。
其中的2门轿车涡轮增压版本曾在欧洲和德国的房车
赛事中引起了巨大轰动。

由于影响力巨大，乃至于其方块状外形
为它赢得了“飞砖”的昵称。
除了比赛表现之外，这款Estate车型在市场上也堪称
传奇中的传奇。

在1974到1993之间，Volvo 240系列总共售出了
大约270万台……

其中95万台都是Estate型号。即便在停产超过三十年的
现在……
它依然是全世界车迷所深爱的一款经典旅行车！
turns.speaker: Jeremy

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_RaceEnthusiast_normal_w196r_monopost_55_1508004
turns.raw:
The W 196 R was an F1 powerhouse that took the international racing scene by storm!

It made its debut in 1954, during the French Grand Prix, or Race 4 of the World Championship of Drivers.

It was piloted by none other than Juan Manuel Fangio, who had raced for Maserati up to Race 3…

...before he decided to join the newly arrived Mercedes-Benz works team.

An Argentinian, Fangio claimed his first Grand Prix title in 1951.

At the time, he was already one of the fastest drivers in the sport.

Behind the wheel of the Mercedes-Benz W 196 R, Fangio proved to be near-unstoppable.

He claimed two consecutive World Drivers’ Champion titles in 1954 and 1955!

turns.raw:
Subaru won the World Rally Championship's Manufacturers' Title three years in a row.

It was from 1995 to 1997, and I still remember the thrill of witnessing that incredible achievement.

Equally exciting was when the company introduced the Impreza WRC in 1997!

The "WRC" in its name stood for "World Rally Car," and it was a new version...

...that allowed a wider range of modifications permitted by Group A regulations.

Previously a 4-door sedan, the Impreza was reborn as a sporty 2-door coupe.

But it wasn't all about style. It performed like a sports car!

In the 1997 season, the Subaru rally team...

...Won eight of 14 races, including the opening rounds in Monte Carlo, Sweden and Kenya.

This incredible performance led to the team taking home its third consecutive WRC title.

The Impreza WRC continued to ev�lve until the year 2000.

It was a car that defined its era and hailed as an important part of WRC history.

turns.zh:
斯巴鲁——世界拉力锦标赛三冠王！

我永远不会忘记1995年到1997年那段激动人心的时光。

同样令我振奋不已的还有1997年翼豹世界拉力赛车的到来！
世界拉力赛车是“世界拉力赛车”的缩写，也是当年引入的新规格……

相比A组规则，世界拉力赛车组可以进行更广泛的改装。
翼豹原本是一款四门轿车，经过回炉重造，成为
一款漂亮的双门车型。

但它不仅长得好看——它真的能跑得很快！
在1997赛季，斯巴鲁拉力车队

在全年的14场比赛中赢得了8场，包括
在蒙特卡洛的开幕战、以及瑞典和肯尼亚站。

惊人的表现也让斯巴鲁连续第三次赢得
世界拉力锦标赛冠军。
翼豹世界拉力赛车持续改装进化，直至2000年。
这款车定义了它所处的时代，至今仍被视为
世界拉力锦标赛历史的重要组成部分。
turns.speaker: Jeremy

Subaru won the World Rally Championship's Manufacturers' Title three years in a row.

It was from 1995 to 1997, and I still remember the thrill of witnessing that incredible achievement.

Equally exciting was when the company introduced the Impreza WRC in 1997!

The "WRC" in its name stood for "World Rally Car," and it was a new version...

...that allowed a wider range of modifications permitted by Group A regulations.

Previously a 4-door sedan, the Impreza was reborn as a sporty 2-door coupe.

But it wasn't all about style. It performed like a sports car!

In the 1997 season, the Subaru rally team...

...Won eight of 14 races, including the opening rounds in Monte Carlo, Sweden and Kenya.

This incredible performance led to the team taking home its third consecutive WRC title.

The Impreza WRC continued to ev�lve until the year 2000.

It was a car that defined its era and hailed as an important part of WRC history.

斯巴鲁——世界拉力锦标赛三冠王！

我永远不会忘记1995年到1997年那段激动人心的时光。

同样令我振奋不已的还有1997年翼豹世界拉力赛车的到来！
世界拉力赛车是“世界拉力赛车”的缩写，也是当年引入的新规格……

相比A组规则，世界拉力赛车组可以进行更广泛的改装。
翼豹原本是一款四门轿车，经过回炉重造，成为
一款漂亮的双门车型。

但它不仅长得好看——它真的能跑得很快！
在1997赛季，斯巴鲁拉力车队

在全年的14场比赛中赢得了8场，包括
在蒙特卡洛的开幕战、以及瑞典和肯尼亚站。

惊人的表现也让斯巴鲁连续第三次赢得
世界拉力锦标赛冠军。
翼豹世界拉力赛车持续改装进化，直至2000年。
这款车定义了它所处的时代，至今仍被视为
世界拉力锦标赛历史的重要组成部分。

turns.raw:
The Peugeot 205 T16 made its WRC debut in Race 5 of the 1984 season, at the Tour de Corse.

Although it managed only a 4th-place finish, it dominated the latter half of the season, winning Rounds 9, 10, and 12.

From the very beginning, the car showed amazing potential!

The secret to the 205 T16’s exceptional speed lies in its innovative engineering.

It was the first Group B rally car to feature all-wheel drive and a mid-mounted engine.

This machine was a true gamechanger!

In the blink of an eye, it took the crown from the Audi Quattro, the reigning front-engine 4x4 champion.

It then went on to claim consecutive WRC titles in 1985 and 1986!

'

turns.zh:
标致205 T16在1984赛季的第5场比赛——
科西嘉岛拉力赛中首次亮相世界拉力锦标赛，
只获得了第4名。

但在赛季的后半段，它主宰了比赛，
赢得了第9、10和12站的冠军。

从亮相的那一年起，这款车一直在飞驰不息！
205 T16的卓越速度的秘密在于其精湛的工程技术。

它也是B组中第一款采用中置引擎和全轮驱动的拉力赛车。

是汽车革命的全方位体现！
它以迅雷不及掩耳之势取代了先前
由奥迪quattro（一款前置四驱赛车）占据的冠军地位……
并在1985年和1986年连续两年赢得
世界拉力锦标赛的总冠军！
turns.speaker: Jeremy

turns.raw:
Can you name for me the world’s highest hill climb, held annually in the state of Colorado?

That’s right! The Pikes Peak International Hill Climb, a race with more than a century of history.

Built to dominate the competition at Pikes Peak was the Suzuki V6 Escudo, a 900kg beast.

It was a machine that required a monster talent to tame.

So, it was fitting that piloting the Escudo was a driver named Nobuhiro "Monster" Tajima.

A veritable dirt veteran, Tajima-san claimed seven straight wins at the All-Japan Dirt Trial Championship.

In 1995, he became the first Japanese driver to win the overall championship at Pikes Peak.

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_RaceEnthusiast_normal_escudo_pikespeak_98_1508304
turns.raw:
Can you name for me the world’s highest hill climb, held annually in the state of Colorado?

That’s right! The Pikes Peak International Hill Climb, a race with more than a century of history.

Built to dominate the competition at Pikes Peak was the Suzuki V6 Escudo, a 900kg beast.

It was a machine that required a monster talent to tame.

So, it was fitting that piloting the Escudo was a driver named Nobuhiro "Monster" Tajima.

A veritable dirt veteran, Tajima-san claimed seven straight wins at the All-Japan Dirt Trial Championship.

In 1995, he became the first Japanese driver to win the overall championship at Pikes Peak.

The Toyota C-HR is a world-famous compact SUV!

It’s perhaps best remembered for its performance at the Nürburgring 24h in 2016.

A car that looks great and is fast to boot— What more could you want?

turns.raw:
This is a fifth-generation Corvette, called the C5 from 2001.

It was a truly unforgettable chapter in the Corvette's legacy.

It was when a C5-based GT racer known as the "C5-R"...

...achieved a stunning overall victory at the 24 Hours of Daytona.

Just a few months later, it secured a class win at Le Mans...

...followed by yet another triumph in 2002.

Beloved by many, the C5-R is still considered among the fastest GT cars in the world!

turns.zh:
这是一辆第五代Corvette——
尽管是一辆2001款的C5。
对于Corvette而言，这是载入史册的年份。

基于C5打造的GT赛车“C5-R”
不仅在戴通纳24小时耐力赛斩获全场总冠军，

数月后更在勒芒赛场摘得本组别桂冠，

并在2002年成功卫冕！
这台深受车迷爱戴的C5-R，至今仍是
全球最快的GT赛车之一。

Why, this is the Group A rally version of the Lancia Delta! A real fan favorite!

Its legend dates back to 1987, the first year in which the WRC title was contested under Group A regulations.

That inaugural season, the Lancia Delta HF won the opening race at Monte Carlo.

And it went on to claim the manufacturers’ and drivers’ titles in a spectacular double victory!

What’s more, it went on winning manufacturers’ titles until 1992—a six-year streak!

That year may have marked the final appearance of a Lancia works team in the WRC.

But it also saw the introduction of the Delta HF Integrale, which dominated the competition in speed and durability.

Starting at Monte Carlo, it won eight races that year and proudly clinched Lancia its sixth consecutive title.

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_RaceEnthusiast_normal_bx_19_trs_87_1508704
turns.raw:
Did you know there was a version of this Citroën BX built for Group B rally homologation?

They called it the BX 4TC.

Up front, a longitudinally mounted turbocharged 2.2-liter inline-4 channeled serious power to all four wheels.

The irony? By the time this beast was finally ready to race...

...Group B was already heading toward extinction.

As a result, it saw action in only a handful of races following its 1986 debut—the final year of Group B competition.

Still, the BX 4TC, with its enlarged fenders and four auxiliary rally lights, projected a commanding presence on the track.

It is truly a sight to behold!

g
turns.en:
Did you know there was a version of this Citroën BX
built for Group B rally homologation?
They called it the BX 4TC.

Up front, a longitudinally mounted turbocharged 2.2-liter inline-4
channeled serious power to all four wheels.
The irony? By the time this beast was
finally ready to race...

...Group B was already heading toward extinction.

As a result, it saw action in only a handful of races following
its 1986 debut—the final year of Group B competition.
Still, the BX 4TC, with its enlarged fenders and four auxiliary
rally lights, projected a commanding presence on the track.
It is truly a sight to behold!
turns.zh:
雪铁龙BX曾经开发过为满足B组别拉力赛规则
而打造的赛事认证车型，这你知道吗？
这台车被命名为'BX 4TC'。

它搭载的2.2升直列四缸涡轮增压引擎纵向安置在车头，
源源不断为四个车轮输送强大的动力。
然而，当这台公路猛兽终于准备好参赛时……

B组别赛事却已走向终点。

所以，在它亮相的1986年，同时也就是B组别最后举办的那一年，
它仅参与了寥寥数场比赛。
尽管如此，这款BX 4TC凭借其加宽的挡泥板
和四盏辅助拉力灯，在赛道上依然威风凛凛。
这台车绝对值得一看！
turns.speaker: Jeremy

turns.raw:
Did you know there was a version of this Citroën BX built for Group B rally homologation?

They called it the BX 4TC.

Up front, a longitudinally mounted turbocharged 2.2-liter inline-4 channeled serious power to all four wheels.

The irony? By the time this beast was finally ready to race...

...Group B was already heading toward extinction.

As a result, it saw action in only a handful of races following its 1986 debut—the final year of Group B competition.

Still, the BX 4TC, with its enlarged fenders and four auxiliary rally lights, projected a commanding presence on the track.

It is truly a sight to behold!

Up front, a longitudinally mounted turbocharged 2.2-liter inline-4

As a result, it saw action in only a handful of races following

turns.zh:
雪铁龙BX曾经开发过为满足B组别拉力赛规则
而打造的赛事认证车型，这你知道吗？
这台车被命名为'BX 4TC'。

它搭载的2.2升直列四缸涡轮增压引擎纵向安置在车头，
源源不断为四个车轮输送强大的动力。
然而，当这台公路猛兽终于准备好参赛时……

B组别赛事却已走向终点。

所以，在它亮相的1986年，同时也就是B组别最后举办的那一年，
它仅参与了寥寥数场比赛。
尽管如此，这款BX 4TC凭借其加宽的挡泥板
和四盏辅助拉力灯，在赛道上依然威风凛凛。
这台车绝对值得一看！

Remember the R34 Skyline GT-R? I was a big fan of that car.

Sadly, it made its exit from the All Japan GT Championship in 2003.

But then, in 2004, it came back…

When Nissan’s in-house works team, Nismo, poured all of its racing know-how into a street-legal GT-R version.

That’s right, I’m talking about the Nismo R34 GT-R Z-tune!

Apparently, development started on this project back in 1999.

In other words, when the R34 Skyline GT-R was at the height of its racing prowess!

To be able to see such a special GT-R up-close like this is really a great honour!

不难猜出，这一项目的开发工作早在1999年就开始了。

能够如此近距离地观赏这样一台特别的GT-R，
真是莫大的荣幸！*

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_RaceEnthusiast_normal_kpgc10_skyline_gtr_70_1508904
turns.raw:
When I hear the name Skyline GT-R, I immediately think of racing champions!

So, it probably goes without saying that I’m also a big fan of the Prince-era Skyline GT, the forefather of the GT-R.

This Nissan Skyline GT-R, affectionately known as the "Hakosuka," carried the torch passed down from the formidable Skyline GT.

It made its debut at the 1969 JAF Grand Prix, held at the legendary Fuji Speedway...

...where it didn’t just win, it made a statement.

From that first race, it racked up 49 consecutive victories through to December 1971!

T
turns.en:
When I hear the name Skyline GT-R, I immediately think of
racing champions!

So, it probably goes without saying that I’m also a big fan
of the Prince-era Skyline GT, the forefather of the GT-R.
This Nissan Skyline GT-R, affectionately known as the "Hakosuka,"
carried the torch passed down from the formidable Skyline GT.

It made its debut at the 1969 JAF Grand Prix,
held at the legendary Fuji Speedway...
...where it didn’t just win,
it made a statement.

From that first race, it racked up 49 consecutive victories
through to December 1971!
turns.zh:
当我听到“Skyline GT-R”这个名字，我条件反射般地
想到了这四个字：赛车冠军！

理所当然，我也是GT-R的前身，Prince时代
的Skyline GT的狂热车迷。
这辆“Nissan Skyline GT-R”，也被称作“Hakosuka”，
继承了所向披靡的Skyline GT的衣钵。

它于1969年在传奇的富士赛道上举办的
JAF大奖赛上首次亮相。
它不只在这条赛道上初战告捷，此后还连战连胜……

最终到1971年12月为止，取得了
举世闻名的49连胜的战绩！
turns.speaker: Jeremy

turns.raw:
When I hear the name Skyline GT-R, I immediately think of racing champions!

So, it probably goes without saying that I’m also a big fan of the Prince-era Skyline GT, the forefather of the GT-R.

This Nissan Skyline GT-R, affectionately known as the "Hakosuka," carried the torch passed down from the formidable Skyline GT.

It made its debut at the 1969 JAF Grand Prix, held at the legendary Fuji Speedway...

...where it didn’t just win, it made a statement.

From that first race, it racked up 49 consecutive victories through to December 1971!

T
turns.en:
When I hear the name Skyline GT-R, I immediately think of
racing champions!

So, it probably goes without saying that I’m also a big fan
of the Prince-era Skyline GT, the forefather of the GT-R.
This Nissan Skyline GT-R, affectionately known as the "Hakosuka,"
carried the torch passed down from the formidable Skyline GT.

It made its debut at the 1969 JAF Grand Prix,
held at the legendary Fuji Speedway...
...where it didn’t just win,
it made a statement.

From that first race, it racked up 49 consecutive victories
through to December 1971!
turns.zh:
当我听到“Skyline GT-R”这个名字，我条件反射般地
想到了这四个字：赛车冠军！

理所当然，我也是GT-R的前身，Prince时代
的Skyline GT的狂热车迷。
这辆“Nissan Skyline GT-R”，也被称作“Hakosuka”，
继承了所向披靡的Skyline GT的衣钵。

它于1969年在传奇的富士赛道上举办的
JAF大奖赛上首次亮相。
它不只在这条赛道上初战告捷，此后还连战连胜……

最终到1971年12月为止，取得了
举世闻名的49连胜的战绩！

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_RaceEnthusiast_normal__2000_gt_67_1509004
turns.raw:
The year 1967 marked a milestone in Japanese motorsports history.

The country hosted its very first 24-hour endurance race at the newly opened Fuji Speedway.

Long-distance endurance races like Le Mans had been a European tradition since the 1920s.

But with their arrival in Japan, a new chapter in motorsport history began.

And the winner of that historic inaugural Fuji 24 Hours?

It was none other than the Toyota works team, racing this 2000GT!

It was driven by the legendary duo of Shihomi Hosoya and co-driver Yoshio Otsubo.

|

turns.zh:
这是于1967年举办的盛会……

日本在新开放的富士赛道上举办了该国
有史以来第一场24小时耐力赛。
该比赛的性质与欧洲自20世纪20年代以来举办的勒芒等
长距离耐力赛相似。

也是此类比赛首次踏上日本的国土，
标志着赛车运动史上的新篇章。
至于这场历史性、开创性的富士24小时耐力赛的冠军……

还用说吗？自然是驾驶着这辆2000GT的Toyota厂队！
驾驶这辆车的车手是传奇的双人组，
细谷四方洋和领航员大坪善男。
turns.speaker: Jeremy

Believe me when I tell you that this N-ONE is a genuine racer!

Just watching them take to the track in their colorful liveries is pure joy!

The year was 2023.

Ferrari claimed its first-ever overall victory at the Nürburgring 24 Hours!

The machine that achieved this remarkable feat was none other than the Ferrari 296 GT3.

It was a historic race, completed in a record 162 laps.

But the 296 GT3 didn’t just secure the overall win.

All three of the team’s entries finished the race, a testament to their outstanding reliability.

In the months that followed, the 296 GT3 continued to dominate, earning victories in endurance races across the globe!

The Mitsubishi FTO is a sports coupe that took the racing world by storm.

It famously competed in the All Japan GT Championship in 1998 and 1999.

Although it retained the front-wheel-drive layout of its road-going sibling...

...it replaced the latter’s naturally-aspirated engine with a turbocharged version of the venerable 4G63 inline-4.

On the track, cars with rear-wheel drive areyin contenders for power and traction.

Although the Mitsubishi FTO never captured a victory in the All Japan GT Championship...

...it did earn a 2nd-place podium finish at the series opener in 1999!

�
turns.en:
The Mitsubishi FTO is a sports coupe that took the racing
world by storm.
It famously competed in the All Japan GT Championship
in 1998 and 1999.

Although it retained the front-wheel-drive layout
of its road-going sibling...

...it replaced the latter’s naturally-aspirated engine with a
turbocharged version of the venerable 4G63 inline-4.
On the track, cars with rear-wheel drive areyin contenders for power and traction.
Although the Mitsubishi FTO never captured a victory
in the All Japan GT Championship...
...it did earn a 2nd-place podium finish at the series opener
in 1999!
turns.zh:
Mitsubishi FTO是一款曾在赛坛掀起波澜的
运动型双门轿跑。
其最广为人知的战绩当属1998至1999年间
征战全日本GT锦标赛的经历。

尽管其公路版姊妹车型的
前轮驱动布局被保留下来……

但原厂自然进气引擎被替换为了
经涡轮增压强化的经典4G63直列四缸引擎。
要知道，在赛场上比拼动力优势的

turns.raw:
In 2022, scarcely a year after its first appearance...

...the ELANTRA N TC rose to the top, claiming the crown at the very pinnacle of global TCR competition.

Even now, it continues to assert its authority as a constant force on the world stage.

And who could overlook its astonishing performance at the Nürburgring 24h in May 2025?

That was the moment the ELANTRA N TC delivered an improbable 1–2 finish in the TCR Class!

Remarkably, it also marked Hyundai’s fifth straight class victory at this legendary endurance race.

turns.zh:
2022年，即此车面世仅一年之后……

ELANTRA N TC就荣获了世界TCR系列赛
最高级别比赛的冠军。
直至今日，此车仍旧在国际舞台上展现着它强大的实力！
谁能忘记它于2025年5月
在纽博格林24小时耐力赛的赛道上驰骋的英姿？

在那场比赛中，ELANTRA N TC
可是包揽了TCR组别的冠亚军，堪称奇迹！
此外，这也是Hyundai在这项传奇赛事中
获得该组别的第五次连胜。\

turns.raw:
Did you know that, along with its increased engine displacement over the previous model...

...the Porsche 911 GT3 R (992) became the first GT3 R to feature a swan-neck rear wing?

For me, its defining accomplishment remains those unforgettable back-to-back victories at the Le Mans 24 Hours.

Both came in the LMGT3 Class, which replaced the LMGTE category in 2024.

In its debut year, it secured a superb class win under conditions that were anything but forgiving.

Then it did it all over again the following year—a truly remarkable achievement, wouldn’t you agree?

取得了这一佳绩。
在首次夺冠那一年，尽量条件艰险，它还是坚韧不拔地
拿下了该组别的辉煌胜利。
然后它就在下一年再次上演了同样的精彩戏码
——真是不容小觑，你说对吧？+

turns.zh:
这辆科迈罗1969 Race-Mod，虽然保留了经典外观，
内里却焕然一新。

可以说，它完美诠释了修复改装车的顶尖水准。
此车的原型车是传奇的科迈罗Z28，
为了征战1960年代风靡一时的泛美房车锦标赛而生。

如今，科迈罗Z28以一款原创定制车的身份荣耀回归，
由《跑车浪漫旅》倾情呈现。
车身姿态经过精心调校，更为低趴，并配备了
专属前保险杠与大量全新空气动力学套件。
车尾则装有一个醒目的大型鸭尾式扰流板，
并采用中置排气布局。
至于它的心脏，则是一台动力磅礴的机械增压V8引擎！

现在，我真想一睹它在赛道上飞驰的风采！
turns.speaker: Jeremy
