turns.raw:
The 1999 Le Mans 24 Hours was one of those races that stays with you.

Factory teams from the world’s biggest automakers arrived with everything to prove, fighting for victory in an all-out war.

When the checkered flag fell, it was BMW’s V12 LMR prototype that stood above them all.

It was BMW’s first overall win at the legendary 24-hour classic.

Now, some 20 years later, BMW has returned to the top category with a machine built for the modern era...

...with this BMW M Hybrid V8!

The car made its presence felt, scoring a 1-2 finish at the 10th round of the 2024 IMSA SportsCar Championship in Indianapolis...

It also took a hypercar class victory in the World Endurance Championship.

There’s no doubt about it: This machine has proven it belongs on the world stage.

W

全球各大顶尖汽车制造商的厂队使出浑身解数，
全力角逐总冠军的殊荣。
而最终登顶的则是宝马的V12 LMR原型车。

时隔二十余年，这一德系劲旅宣布重返顶级组别行列……
携宝马M Hybrid V8强势归来！
这台车在2024年国际汽车运动协会跑车锦标赛第10站
印第安纳波利斯分站中强势包揽冠亚军，

还在世界耐力锦标赛中斩获超级跑车组别冠军。
毫无疑问，这台竞速机器已然在世界舞台证明了自身实力。

The 1999 Le Mans 24 Hours was one of those races
that stays with you.

Factory teams from the world’s biggest automakers arrived with
everything to prove, fighting for victory in an all-out war.
When the checkered flag fell, it was BMW’s V12 LMR prototype
that stood above them all.

It was BMW’s first overall win at the legendary 24-hour classic.

Now, some 20 years later, BMW has returned to the top category
with a machine built for the modern era...
...with this BMW M Hybrid V8!
The car made its presence felt, scoring a 1-2 finish at the 10th
round of the 2024 IMSA SportsCar Championship in Indianapolis...

It also took a hypercar class victory in
the World Endurance Championship.
There’s no doubt about it:
This machine has proven it belongs on the world stage.
turns.zh:
1999年的勒芒24小时耐力赛堪称经典之战。

全球各大顶尖汽车制造商的厂队使出浑身解数，
全力角逐总冠军的殊荣。
而最终登顶的则是宝马的V12 LMR原型车。

这也是宝马首次登顶这一传奇的24小时耐力赛。

时隔二十余年，这一德系劲旅宣布重返顶级组别行列……
携宝马M Hybrid V8强势归来！
这台车在2024年国际汽车运动协会跑车锦标赛第10站
印第安纳波利斯分站中强势包揽冠亚军，

还在世界耐力锦标赛中斩获超级跑车组别冠军。
毫无疑问，这台竞速机器已然在世界舞台证明了自身实力。
turns.speaker: Jeremy

turns.raw:
The Ferrari 499P is the kind of machine built for the history books. Who could forget its stunning run at Le Mans in 2023?

On the grand stage of the race’s historic centenary...

...Ferrari returned to the top flight after a 50-year absence.

Just imagine coming back on a milestone year like that. The pressure must have been enormous!

And yet, in an all-out fight against opponents all chasing the coveted overall championship title...

...it was the No. 51 Ferrari 499P that rose above them all.

The first overall victory for Ferrari in 58 years wasn't just a win, it was one of the great comeback in motorsports history!



turns.zh:
法拉利499P是一台注定载入史册的终极跑车，
它在2023年勒芒比赛上的惊艳表现至今让人难以忘怀。
在这项赛事迎来百年纪念的盛大赛场上，

法拉利暌违五十载后强势回归最高组别赛场。
想想便知——选择在这样一个极具纪念意义的年份复出……
压力绝对超乎寻常。

然而，在各路强敌全力以赴争夺总冠军的激烈鏖战中……
51号法拉利499P成功杀出重围夺得冠军。
这是法拉利时隔58年再度登顶勒芒总冠军。
这场胜利意义非凡，成就了一段王者归来的传奇篇章。
turns.speaker: Jeremy

turns.raw:
Of all the race cars born from the Le Mans Hypercar regulations...

...the Peugeot 9X8 may be the most distinctive of them all.

Its wingless concept made headlines when it made its debut in 2021.

And that bold approach may have helped it briefly take the lead during an especially wet and grueling Le Mans in 2023.

In 2024, the car underwent a major evolution, gaining an all-new rear wing and a more conventional aerodynamic package.

A top-tier contender in the WEC, this is a machine that never fails to make an impression.

turns.zh:
在众多遵循勒芒终极跑车组别规则打造的赛车中……

Peugeot 9X8的设计最为独树一帜。

其“无尾翼”的设计理念在2021年首次亮相时便引发热议……

甚至在2023年雨水肆虐、赛程艰苦的勒芒赛场上，
一度助它领跑全场。
2024年这款赛车迎来重大升级，正式加装全新尾翼。

turns.raw:
The Porsche 963 is a formidable contender in the premier categories of the IMSA and WEC.

It’s had especially strong showings at the IMSA.

Competing in the 2024 IMSA GTP category, the 963 won the first round of the series—the 24 Hours of Daytona.

From there, it racked up further victories at Laguna Seca, Watkins Glen, and Road America...

Before clinching both the Manufacturers' and Drivers' Championship titles.

Meanwhile, in the WEC series, it has established itself as a podium fixture...

Further cementing its status as a modern masterpiece of endurance racing!
turns.en:
The Porsche 963 is a formidable contender in
the premier categories of the IMSA and WEC.

It’s had especially strong showings at the IMSA.
Competing in the 2024 IMSA GTP category, the 963 won
the first round of the series—the 24 Hours of Daytona.

From there, it racked up further victories at Laguna Seca,
Watkins Glen, and Road America...
Before clinching both the Manufacturers' and Drivers'
Championship titles.

Meanwhile, in the WEC series, it has established itself
as a podium fixture...
Further cementing its status as a modern masterpiece
of endurance racing!
turns.zh:
Porsche 963是IMSA与WEC最高组别中的实力劲旅，

在IMSA赛场上的战绩尤其斐然。
征战2024年IMSA GTP赛事期间，
963一举拿下戴通纳24小时耐力赛揭幕战冠军。

随后又接连斩获拉古纳-塞卡赛道、
沃特金斯峡谷国际赛道与美国之路赛道的分站冠军……
最终包揽车厂与车手年度总冠军。

而在WEC赛场上，它也是领奖台的常客……
由此逐步奠定了它在耐力赛中当代经典神车的地位。
turns.speaker: Jeremy

Toyota Prius是日本最著名的混合动力汽车。

而如果我们再把范围缩小到紧凑型汽车的范畴，

turns.raw:
When the Mini was born in 1959, it revolutionized the world of compact front-wheel-drive cars.

Designed by the English engineer Alec Issigonis...

...it sported a uniquely positioned engine and gearbox.

This maximized the space-saving potential of its front-wheel-drive layout.

The result was a small and fast car with a roomy interior.

The Mini's historic front-wheel drive layout is now widely referred to as an "Issigonis" layout.

And why shouldn't it be? It was designed by the brilliant engineer after all.

turns.zh:
当Mini于1959年诞生时，它彻底改变了小型前轮驱动汽车的世界。
此车由英国工程师亚历克·伊斯戈尼斯设计……

它的引擎和变速箱安装的位置非常独特，

最大限度地发挥了前轮驱动布局节省空间的潜力。
因此造就了一辆小而快的汽车，具有宽敞的内部空间。
Mini的历史性前轮驱动布局现在被广泛称为“伊斯戈尼斯”布局。

这并不奇怪。毕竟它就是由这位杰出的工程师设计的！
turns.speaker: Stella

Did you know that the Volkswagen Beetle and the Porsche 911 have some common linkages?

The Beetle was designed by Dr. Ferdinand Porsche, the founder of Porsche Automobiles.

It sports a horizontally-opposed engine at the back of the car that drives the rear wheels...

Yes, precisely! It's a rear-engine, rear-wheel-drive car!

Dr. Porsche carried design elements from the Beetle over to the first Porsche sports car, the Porsche 356...

...and later the Porsche 911.

What started out as a small people's car ended up as a genuine sports car.

While there may be a world of difference between the two...

...the fact that they share a horizontally-opposed engine, RR-layout and the same creator is truly fascinating!

Along with the German Beetle and the British Mini, this Italian FIAT 500…

...is one of the most iconic European small cars in history.

It may be the smallest of its rivals...

...but it can seat four passengers, and its feisty little engine is capable of thrilling speeds.

Its splendid exterior is owing to the handiwork of famed FIAT engineer Dante Giacosa.

He also penned the underlying design.

Giacosa created many great cars for FIAT, and I'm sure you'll come across them in time!



turns.zh:
与德国的Beetle和英国的MINI一样，
这辆意大利的FIAT 500……

是欧洲历史上最具代表性的紧凑型车之一。
和其竞争对手相比，它可能是体型最小的……

但它可以容纳四名乘客，
而且其强劲的小引擎能够达到惊人的速度。
它华丽的外观由著名的FIAT工程师
但特·吉奥科萨亲手打造，

他还包揽了车辆的内饰设计。
吉奥科萨为FIAT创造了许多台伟大的汽车，
你会逐渐发现这些瑰宝的。
turns.speaker: Stella

turns.raw:
The long and storied history of Japanese kei cars has seen many sporty versions of the genre.

And the Honda Beat stood out because it was mid-engine and a convertible!

While the NSX may be Honda’s original mid-engine sports car...

...the Beat boasts the same front/rear weight distribution.

No one ever imagined a kei car with a centrally located engine and an open body...

...that is, until Honda created the Beat!
turns.en:
The long and storied history of Japanese kei cars
has seen many sporty versions of the genre.
And the Honda Beat stood out because
it was mid-engine and a convertible!
While the NSX may be Honda’s original
mid-engine sports car...

...the Beat boasts the same front/rear
weight distribution.
No one ever imagined a kei car with a
centrally located engine and an open body...

...that is, until Honda created the Beat!
turns.zh:
在日式轻型车漫长而丰富的历史上，
出现过许多这种小型跑车。
这款Honda Beat因为采用敞篷设计而显得独树一帜！
Beat采用了与Honda旗下设计出众的中置跑车NSX

近似的配重平衡，
并且在中置布局上安装了一款开放式单体车壳车身……

这也使它成为了世界上第一款采用这种设计的车型！<
turns.speaker: Stella

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarLover_normal_beat_91_1601904
turns.raw:
The long and storied history of Japanese kei cars has seen many sporty versions of the genre.

And the Honda Beat stood out because it was mid-engine and a convertible!

While the NSX may be Honda’s original mid-engine sports car...

...the Beat boasts the same front/rear weight distribution.

No one ever imagined a kei car with a centrally located engine and an open body...

...that is, until Honda created the Beat!
turns.en:

has seen many sporty versions of the genre.
And the Honda Beat stood out because
it was mid-engine and a convertible!

mid-engine sports car...

...the Beat boasts the same front/rear
weight distribution.
No one ever imagined a kei car with a
centrally located engine and an open body...

...that is, until Honda created the Beat!
turns.zh:
在日式轻型车漫长而丰富的历史上，
出现过许多这种小型跑车。
这款Honda Beat因为采用敞篷设计而显得独树一帜！
Beat采用了与Honda旗下设计出众的中置跑车NSX

近似的配重平衡，
并且在中置布局上安装了一款开放式单体车壳车身……

这也使它成为了世界上第一款采用这种设计的车型！<

turns.raw:
When it comes to genuine kei sportscars…

This Suzuki Cappuccino is truly a legend.

It has a front-engine, rear-wheel-drive layout, making it an ‘FR’ car.

Lift up its bonnet and you’ll find that its engine is mounted near the centre of the car.

That alone should convince you that it’s a real sportscar!

Released in 1991, the Cappuccino...

Is often grouped with its competitors, the Mazda AZ-1 and Honda Beat.

Combing their initials, the three may be referred to as the ‘A-B-C’ of kei sportscars.
turns.en:
When it comes to genuine kei sportscars…

This Suzuki Cappuccino is truly a legend.
It has a front-engine, rear-wheel-drive layout,
making it an ‘FR’ car.

Lift up its bonnet and you’ll find that its engine
is mounted near the centre of the car.

That alone should convince you that
it’s a real sportscar!
Released in 1991, the Cappuccino...

Is often grouped with its competitors,
the Mazda AZ-1 and Honda Beat.
Combing their initials, the three may be referred to
as the ‘A-B-C’ of kei sportscars.
turns.zh:
如果要讨论最正宗的轻型跑车……

这款Suzuki Cappuccino就是真正的传奇。
它采用前置引擎、后轮驱动布局，也就是所谓的“前置
后驱”车。

抬起它的引擎盖，你会发现它的引擎位置更贴近车身的
正中。

这就是它作为真正跑车的明证！
这款Cappuccino在1991年上市……

常被拿来和它的竞争者Mazda AZ-1和Honda Beat相提并论。
如果把这三款车的型号名称首字母连在一起，就形成了
轻型跑车的“A-B-C”，代表了最基础的车型。

这个设计的灵感好像是来源于日本的书法！-

turns.raw:
This is an Abarth car—you can tell straightaway from the ‘scorpion’ emblem.

Abarth is one of the most storied brands in motorsport history.

It was established by Carlo Abarth...

Who began his career as a racer and engineer of two- and four-wheel vehicles in the 1920s...

And later had success as a tuner for FIAT.

Today, an Abarth 595 that is based on the old FIAT 500 will fetch a pretty penny!

By the way, about that scorpion emblem...

It comes from the fact that Carlo Abarth was born in November, making him a Scorpio!

P

turns.zh:
从这个“蝎子”的标志你就能一眼看出，这是一辆Abarth的车。
Abarth是汽车历史上最富传奇色彩的品牌之一。

这个品牌由卡洛·阿巴斯创立。

他在上世纪20年代以赛车手和两轮及四轮车辆工程师的
身份开始了自己的职业生涯……
随后，他因为对FIAT车辆的优异调校而闻名于世。

时至今日，一辆基于老款FIAT 500改装的Abarth 595
依然能卖出高价！
哦，顺带一说，它之所以用蝎子作为车标……

是因为卡洛·阿巴斯出生于十一月，所以是天蝎座！~
turns.speaker: Stella

turns.raw:
In Japan, where minivans enjoy tremendous popularity, the Toyota Alphard is the one everyone has their eye on.

One reason for its popularity is its extremely luxurious nature, in equipment and quality.

Ever since the original model was introduced in 2002, the Alphard has remained true to its "luxury minivan" identity.

And the 2015 third-generation model took that premium identity to new heights.

This Executive Lounge was the third-generation Alphard’s top-of-the-line grade.

The oversized second-row seats, unique to this version, were the very definition of comfort!
turns.en:
In Japan, where minivans enjoy tremendous popularity,
the Toyota Alphard is the one everyone has their eye on.
One reason for its popularity is its extremely luxurious nature,
in equipment and quality.
Ever since the original model was introduced in 2002, the Alphard
has remained true to its "luxury minivan" identity.

And the 2015 third-generation model took that
premium identity to new heights.
This Executive Lounge was the third-generation Alphard’s
top-of-the-line grade.

The oversized second-row seats, unique to this version,
were the very definition of comfort!
turns.zh:
在日本，厢式旅行车可是非常热门的车型。
而且更夸张的是，好像每个人都想拥有一辆Toyota Alphard。
这辆车广受欢迎的一个理由
就是借助设计和配置散发出“豪车”的风范。
自从这个型号在2002年推出第一代之后，Alphard
就始终保持着自己“豪华厢式旅行车”的定位……

而2015年的第三代更是抓住了豪华车的精髓。
这辆Executive Lounge版本是第三代Alphard的顶配，

配备有专属的超大尺寸后排座椅，
绝对是无可置疑的舒适性的天花板了！
turns.speaker: Stella

If you’re looking for a stylish hatchback, you can’t go wrong with the MAZDA3.

The MAZDA3 comes in two body types: a 5-door hatchback and a 4-door sedan.

That said, the fact that they have so few shared parts is proof of their purposeful design.

Take the smooth roof line of the hatchback—it’s so beautiful that Mazda went and marketed it as a fastback.

What’s more, this MAZDA3 fastback comes in a "burgundy selection" grade!

From the seats to the interior panels, everything in this package is expressed in a most distinctive shade of red.

MAZDA3提供两种车身版本选择：5门掀背版和4门轿车版。

尽管同属一个车型，但二者之间的通用配件却不多，
这也证明了它们的设计目标性非常明确。
以掀背版本为例，它那流畅的车顶线条非常优雅，而Mazda
也特意将其宣传为“斜背车”。
另外，这款MAZDA3掀背版还供应“勃艮第红”版！

从座椅到内饰板材，一切配置
都采用了最特别的红色调处理。

The Super Formula? Of course I know it. It’s a world famous Japanese formula race series.

The beginning of genuine motorsports in Japan is said to date back to the 1960s.

The first Japanese Grand Prix was held in 1963.

Back then, the track was dominated by modified road cars, or "touring cars" to be precise.

Since then, Japan has also slowly crafted its own formula race scene.

For this to happen, Japanese Grand Prix drivers had to study abroad...

...at famous race schools in England, where they learned the ins and outs of formula racing.

After that, they teamed up with Japanese automotive engineers to develop Japan’s first formula cars.

turns.zh:
超级方程式？我当然知道啦。这是一项
全球知名的日本方程式系列赛。
据说日本真正的赛车运动始于二十世纪六十年代。

第一届日本大奖赛在1963年就举办了。
在当时，统治赛道的多是些经过改装的公路车，
或者更准确说是“房车”。

自那时起，日本就一直在逐步地搭建
属于自己的方程式赛车领域。
为了实现这一目的，日本大奖赛的车手们纷纷走出国门……

在英格兰的著名赛车学校学习，并在那里
了解到了方程式赛车的方方面面。
学成归来后，他们便与日本汽车工程师们合作，
打造出了日本的第一款方程式赛车。

The Super Formula? Of course I know it. It’s a world famous
Japanese formula race series.
The beginning of genuine motorsports in Japan is said
to date back to the 1960s.

The first Japanese Grand Prix was held in 1963.
Back then, the track was dominated by modified road cars,
or "touring cars" to be precise.

Since then, Japan has also slowly crafted its own
formula race scene.
For this to happen, Japanese Grand Prix drivers
had to study abroad...

...at famous race schools in England, where they learned
the ins and outs of formula racing.
After that, they teamed up with Japanese automotive
engineers to develop Japan’s first formula cars.
turns.zh:
超级方程式？我当然知道啦。这是一项
全球知名的日本方程式系列赛。
据说日本真正的赛车运动始于二十世纪六十年代。

第一届日本大奖赛在1963年就举办了。
在当时，统治赛道的多是些经过改装的公路车，
或者更准确说是“房车”。

自那时起，日本就一直在逐步地搭建
属于自己的方程式赛车领域。
为了实现这一目的，日本大奖赛的车手们纷纷走出国门……

在英格兰的著名赛车学校学习，并在那里
了解到了方程式赛车的方方面面。
学成归来后，他们便与日本汽车工程师们合作，
打造出了日本的第一款方程式赛车。
turns.speaker: Stella

turns.raw:
This is a second-generation Subaru Impreza STi.

In Japan, the Impreza STi and the Mitsubishi Lancer Evo were known to have an intense rivalry.

The second-generation STi featured numerous upgrades, none more evident than in this 2004 model.

Notice how the rear wheel arch appears to be slightly widened?

This was done to give the car wide tires and wheels. The suspension and engine were also improved.

This car certainly turned heads after its time trial run at the Nürburgring in Germany.

It was the first Impreza to complete a lap in less than eight minutes!

turns.zh:
这是一台二代Subaru Impreza STi。

在日本，Impreza STi和Mitsubishi Lancer Evo是
一对有名的宿敌。
第二代STi引入了多项升级，在这台2004版的车型上
体现得淋漓尽致。
注意到后轮拱看起来更宽了一些吗？

这是通过加宽轮毂和使用宽胎来实现的，悬挂和引擎
也得到了相应升级。
此车在德国的纽博格林赛道上试测，拿到了令人侧目的结果。

毕竟，这是首台在八分钟内跑完这条赛道的Impreza！

A car with more than 50 years of history and over fifty-million units sold worldwide...

Is there any other car that can make such a claim than the Toyota Corolla?

It’s a brand that has surely made memories for countless of people everywhere.

The GR Corolla is a sports car built by Toyota’s GR division.

What’s more, this model was a special variant penned by Toyota’s master driver Morizo!

To reduce weight, the rear seats of the base 5-seat model were removed.

It also featured a specially-tuned engine and transmission. Without a doubt, this genuine sports car is sure to please.

turns.zh:
超过50年生产历史和全球销量超过五千万辆的记录——

除了丰田卡罗拉，还有哪款车能够
拥有如此辉煌的战绩？
这个品牌无疑给世界各地的无数用户留下了美好的回忆。
这款GR卡罗拉是丰田旗下GR品牌出品
的一款跑车。

更重要的是，这是由丰田的大师级赛车手“Morizo”
亲自设计的特殊版本！
为了减轻重量，这款5座基础车型的后排座椅被全部移除。
此外，它还配备了经过特殊调校的引擎和变速箱。
毫无疑问，这款纯正跑车一定会带来愉悦的驾驶体验。+

亲自设计的特殊版本！
为了减轻重量，这款5座基础车型的后排座椅被全部移除。
此外，它还配备了经过特殊调校的引擎和变速箱。

Did you know that in Europe, they have an annual contest for the world’s most beautiful car?

Well, the Mazda RX-Vision took home the "Most Beautiful Concept Car" award at this contest in 2016.

The event draws crowds of car enthusiasts from all over the world to pick the most beautiful cars of the year.

The RX-Vision was the first car by an Asian manufacturer to win this award.

Penned by Ikuo Maeda, it was a car that left its mark on not only Mazda but Japanese sports-car design in general.

turns.zh:
你知道吗？在欧洲，每年都会举办一场评选
全球最美汽车的比赛。

2016年，Mazda RX-Vision凭借其卓越设计夺得了
“最美概念车”的殊荣。
这项赛事汇聚了来自世界各地的汽车专家，他们负责
从众多参赛车辆中评选出年度最具魅力的汽车。

RX-Vision是赢得该奖项的汽车中，首款由亚洲制造商制造的汽车。
设计师前田育男倾注心血的成果不仅在Mazda的历史上
留下了深刻印记，同时也对日本跑车设计产生了深远影响。

turns.raw:
The Urus was the first SUV designed by Lamborghini.

Of course, Lamborghini is a name normally associated with supercars, like the Countach.

But the first car it built after being founded in 1963...

...was a 2-door grand tourer that offered speed, comfort, and class.

It was called the 350 GT, a large coupe with a V-12 engine mounted up front.

Since the 1970s, Lamborghini has built many elegant GT and 4-door sedan concepts, although they were not for sale.

This means that Lamborghini never forgot about its GT roots! And the Urus was proof of that.
turns.en:
The Urus was the first SUV designed by Lamborghini.
Of course, Lamborghini is a name normally associated
with supercars, like the Countach.

But the first car it built after being founded in 1963...

...was a 2-door grand tourer that offered speed, comfort,
and class.
It was called the 350 GT, a large coupe with a V-12 engine
mounted up front.
Since the 1970s, Lamborghini has built many elegant GT
and 4-door sedan concepts, although they were not for sale.
This means that Lamborghini never forgot about its GT roots!
And the Urus was proof of that.
turns.zh: Urus是Lamborghini设计的第一款SUV。 如今，人们通常会将Lamborghini与各种超级跑车 联系在一起，如Countach…… 不过在1963年创立之初，它打造的第一款车…… 是一款强调速度、舒适性和档次的双门豪华旅行车。 它就是采用前置V12引擎的大型双门跑车——350 GT。 自从1970年代起，Lamborghini曾设计了多款优雅的豪华旅行车 和4门概念轿车，但从未正式发售。 看来Lamborghini从未忘记自己起步于豪华旅行车的根源！ 这款Urus就是确凿的证明！
turns.speaker: Stella

turns.raw:
Do you know the history of AMG?

It started out as a company that built racing engines.

At the helm were two engineers.

They were Hans Werner Aufrecht and Erhard Melcher.

These two worked in the race-engine forge of Daimler-Benz.

When Benz took a hiatus from motorsport...

...Aufrecht and Melcher decided to go into business together.

They founded their engineering company out of Aufrecht’s house in Großaspach, Germany.

Taking the initials of Aufrecht, Melcher, and Großaspach, they christened their company "AMG."

That was in back in 1967!

Do you know the history of AMG?
It started out as a company that built racing engines.

At the helm were two engineers.

They were Hans Werner Aufrecht and Erhard Melcher.

of Daimler-Benz.
When Benz took a hiatus from motorsport...

...Aufrecht and Melcher decided to go into

Taking the initials of Aufrecht, Melcher, and Großaspach,

That was in back in 1967!
turns.zh:
你了解AMG的历史吗？
它起初只是一家专门打造赛车引擎的公司……

由两名工程师汉斯·维尔纳·奥夫莱西特……

和埃尔哈特·梅尔赫执掌。

二人曾经在戴姆勒-奔驰的赛车引擎铸造厂工作。
当奔驰暂时远离赛车运动后……

奥夫莱西特和梅尔赫决定共同创业。

于是他们在奥夫莱西特位于德国格罗萨斯帕赫
的家里创办了他们的工程公司。
他们从奥弗莱希特、梅尔赫和
格罗萨斯帕赫三个名字中

各取一个首字母，为公司起名为“AMG”。

那是在1967年！

turns.raw:
I know this Civic very well!

It's the car known as the "Sports Civic" from the 1990s —the fifth-generation "EG" model to be precise.

The "Sports" moniker alone should tell you that it’s fast, but its engine design and sound are second to none.

You often see these cars tuned in all manner of ways.

What do I like best about tuning a Sports Civic, you ask?

The engine swaps, of course!

For example, a Honda K-engine with a large displacement will give you great sound, speed, and power.

But my favorite would have to be the Type R B-engine.

It might not offer as much power as the K-engine, but its roar is simply unforgettable!

turns.en:
I know this Civic very well!

It's the car known as the "Sports Civic" from the 1990s
—the fifth-generation "EG" model to be precise.
The "Sports" moniker alone should tell you that it’s fast,
but its engine design and sound are second to none.

You often see these cars tuned in all manner of ways.
What do I like best about tuning a Sports Civic, you ask?

The engine swaps, of course!

For example, a Honda K-engine with a large displacement
will give you great sound, speed, and power.
But my favorite would have to be the Type R
B-engine.

It might not offer as much power as the K-engine,
but its roar is simply unforgettable!
turns.zh:
我对这种类型的思域非常熟悉！

准确来说，这是一辆1990年代生产，被称为“运动思域”
的第五代“EG”思域。
从其昵称中的“运动”二字就能看出它的速度有多快，
此外它的引擎设计和声浪也无出其右。

turns.raw:
One of my all-time favorite cars is an 1980s icon— the fourth-generation Civic.

With its powerful engine, this Civic Si was the pride of the hatchback pack.

Civics of this era ranged from smart and chic sedans to uniquely designed 5-door wagons like the Shuttle.

And each was beautiful in its own way!
turns.en:
One of my all-time favorite cars is an 1980s icon—
the fourth-generation Civic.
With its powerful engine, this Civic Si
was the pride of the hatchback pack.
Civics of this era ranged from smart and chic sedans
to uniquely designed 5-door wagons like the Shuttle.
And each was beautiful
in its own way!
turns.zh:
我的毕生挚爱之一诞生于80年代
——那就是第四代Civic。
这台搭载强劲引擎的Civic Si掀背版，堪称
家族的门面担当。
这一时期的Civic车系从优雅时髦的四门轿车，
到造型独特的Shuttle五门瓦罐车，应有尽有。
每款车型都绽放着独特的美！
turns.speaker: Stella

turns.raw:
Peugeot cars are distinguished by their numerical names.

Like the 205 or the 306, they all seem to follow a three-digit pattern.

The history behind this convention actually dates back to 1921 with the 201.

Today, it’s not uncommon to see four-digit names, but did you know that those are reserved for SUVs?

This "2008" is a compact SUV.

As is to be expected of a Peugeot, it's perky and nimble, just as it should be!

9
turns.en:
Peugeot cars are distinguished by their numerical names.

Like the 205 or the 306, they all seem to follow
a three-digit pattern.
The history behind this convention actually dates back
to 1921 with the 201.
Today, it’s not uncommon to see four-digit names,
but did you know that those are reserved for SUVs?

This "2008" is a compact SUV.
As is to be expected of a Peugeot, it's perky and nimble,
just as it should be!
turns.zh:
Peugeot的车可以从它们名字中的数字区分开来。

例如“205”或“306”，似乎所有车名都遵循着三位数命名格式。
这一传统其实可追溯到1929年的“201”！
如今，它旗下以四位数命名的车型并不少见，
但你或许不知道这些是专门留给SUV的。

这台“2008”就是一款紧凑型SUV。
与其它Peugeot车型相似，这台车活力十足，灵活敏捷，
一切都恰到好处！
turns.speaker: Stella

turns.raw:
When I hear the name Citroën, the first thing that comes to mind is this BX.

Who could forget those straight lines, that boxy shape?

Such a unique-looking car could only come from the Italian design house Bertone!

From the Break station wagon to the sports-car version, it was also a car rich in variation.

Launched in 1982, it proved to be a lasting success, staying in production for over a decade.

All told, around 2.3 million units were produced across the entire lineup!

R
turns.en:
When I hear the name Citroën, the first thing that comes
to mind is this BX.
Who could forget those straight lines, that boxy shape?

Such a unique-looking car could only come from the Italian
design house Bertone!
From the Break station wagon to the sports-car version,
it was also a car rich in variation.
Launched in 1982, it proved to be a lasting success,
staying in production for over a decade.
All told, around 2.3 million units were produced
across the entire lineup!
turns.zh:
一听到Citroën，我首先想到的就是这款BX。
有谁会不记得它那笔直的线条和方方正正的造型呢？

而拥有如此独特外观的汽车，毫无疑问只会出自
意大利设计公司Bertone之手！
从Break旅行车到跑车，这款车的衍生车型十分丰富。
1982年问世的BX堪称车坛常青树，生产周期
横跨十余载……
全系产量约达230万台！
turns.speaker: Stella

turns.raw:
Renault boasts a rich and storied legacy that stretches back to the 19th century.

Introduced in 1961, this Renault 4—referred to as “the Quatrelle” by the French—holds a cherished place in that heritage.

After all, it was the first Renault to feature front-wheel drive.

For a company that had built its reputation on front-engine, rear-wheel-drive machines...

...this marked a significant departure with a sizable interior and greater ease of operation.

Thankfully, the Quatrelle was a big success!

This bestseller remained in production for more than 30 years and amassed global sales of more than 8 million units!

turns.zh:
雷诺拥有悠久且丰富的历史，
可以追溯到上上个世纪。

这款于1961年推出的雷诺4，被法国人亲切地称之为
“四翼”，在这段历史中占据着举足轻重的地位。
要知道，它是第一款采用前轮驱动技术的雷诺汽车。

对于雷诺这样一家以
前置发动机、后轮驱动布局车型而闻名的公司而言……
这确实是一个重大转变，但这种变更带来了更大的空间
和更出色的操控性能。
值得庆幸的是，四翼取得了巨大的成功！
作为一款畅销车型，它的生产周期超过了30年，
全球销量突破了800万辆！

turns.raw:
Did you know that the Kangoo was originally designed as a commercial vehicle?

With its generous cargo space, this is a machine that, for many, became a trusted co-worker.

But not all Kangoos were built for hard labor.

Some serve as passenger cars, offering a welcome blend of style and comfort, and they’re every bit as popular.

Renault, after all, has a long tradition of crafting iconic utility vehicles.

Among them was a commercial version of the Renault 4 from the 1960s.

Another was the Express, derived from the second-generation Renault 5.

turns.zh:
你知道吗？Kangoo最初其实是
按商用车来设计的。

凭借宽敞的载物空间，对很多人来说，
它简直堪称得力的工作伙伴！
不过，并非所有Kangoo都是为了干活而生的。

也有一部分乘用车版本具备时尚外观
和舒适性能，人气也非常高。
多年来，Renault推出了不少大名鼎鼎的
“工作用车”车型。

其中就包括1960年代Renault 4的商用版本。
还有一款是Express，它是基于第二代Renault 5打造的！

turns.raw:
The 296 GTB is one of Ferrari’s most iconic GT3 racers.

Its name is derived directly from the numbers associated with its engine.

Specifically, it features a 2.9-liter displacement and 6 cylinders.

Combine the two and you get “296."

I’ve heard that Ferrari used a similar naming convention for several models between 1970 and 1990.

I can’t say exactly how many, but I certainly plan to find out!

G
turns.en:
The 296 GTB is one of Ferrari’s most iconic GT3 racers.
Its name is derived directly from the numbers associated
with its engine.

Specifically, it features a 2.9-liter displacement
and 6 cylinders.

Combine the two and you get “296."
I’ve heard that Ferrari used a similar naming convention
for several models between 1970 and 1990.

I can’t say exactly how many, but I certainly plan to find out!
turns.zh:
296 GTB是Ferrari最具标志性的GT3赛车。
其命名取自引擎的核心参数。

具体而言，该车搭载2.9升排量的6缸引擎。

两者结合便构成了“296”的命名！
我听说，在1970至1990年间，
Ferrari还以类似的方式命名了其他车型。

具体数量我一时说不上来，但我一定会查个明白！
turns.speaker: Stella

turns.raw:
Polestar is an electric vehicle brand from Sweden.

Among its lineup is the hybrid Polestar 5...

...a four-door GT that produces more than 800 horsepower!

You know, Polestar has a bit more history behind it than meets the eye.

It originally served as Volvo’s racing division in the mid-1990s.

The team even collaborated with Volvo to develop several road-going sports cars.

In 2017, Polestar branched out on its own as a high-performance electric vehicle brand.

So now you know a little more about Polestar, a Swedish company with deep racing roots!
turns.en:

In 2017, Polestar branched out on its own as a high-performance

So now you know a little more about Polestar,
a Swedish company with deep racing roots!
turns.zh:
Polestar是源自瑞典的电动汽车品牌。

其产品阵容中包含这款混动版Polestar 5……
这是一款动力超过800匹马力的四门GT车型！
事实上，“Polestar”的品牌底蕴远比表面所见更为深厚。

九十年代中期，它曾担任Volvo的赛车研发部门。

甚至协助Volvo打造了多款公路版运动车型。
2017年，品牌正式独立，转型为高性能电动汽车制造商。
总之，现在你应该对Polestar有点初步概念了——
这是一家植根赛车传统的瑞典企业！?
turns.speaker: Stella

turns.raw:
The Mazda RX-7 is synonymous with rotary-engine sports cars.

This is the 3rd-gen model from 1991, also known as the 'FD.'

It notably bears the name and emblem of Mazda’s former luxury vehicle division, 'ɛ̃fini.'

The FD RX-7 is a light and powerful car.

Pressing down on the accelerator, you immediately feel the limitless motive power of its rotary engine.

And its low, wide stance becomes apparent as soon as you get behind the wheel.

Seen from the outside, it’s a thing of beauty, and a legend in the annals of Mazda history.
turns.en:
The Mazda RX-7 is synonymous with rotary-engine sports cars.
This is the 3rd-gen model from 1991, also known
as the 'FD.'

It notably bears the name and emblem of
Mazda’s former luxury vehicle division, 'ɛ̃fini.'
The FD RX-7 is a light and powerful car.

Pressing down on the accelerator, you immediately
feel the limitless motive power of its rotary engine.
And its low, wide stance becomes apparent as soon
as you get behind the wheel.
Seen from the outside, it’s a thing of beauty,
and a legend in the annals of Mazda history.
turns.zh:
Mazda RX-7是转子引擎跑车的代名词。
眼前这款是1991年推出的第三代车型，代号是“FD”。

其车名与徽标源自Mazda旗下的前豪华车部门——
“ɛ̃fini”，可谓声名显赫。
尽管FD RX-7身轻如燕，动力却相当澎湃。

当你深踩油门，转子引擎那源源不绝的强劲动力
便会瞬间涌现。
而一旦坐进驾驶舱，其低趴、宽体的战斗姿态更是展露无遗。
从旁观赏，它堪称一件工业艺术品，
更是Mazda品牌史上的一段不朽传奇。
turns.speaker: Stella

turns.raw:
With its frog-eyed expression and compact body, this first-generation Twingo is simply adorable!

Unexpectedly spacious inside, its seats can be reclined to a full-flat position.

Say, do you know how it got its funny name?

It’s a play on three dance styles—the twist, swing, and tango.

The Twingo had some limited-edition models created in collaboration with fashion brands.

The 1993 model, this first-generation gem is a rare prize for collectors!
turns.en:

The Twingo had some limited-edition models

The 1993 model, this first-generation gem is a rare prize
for collectors!
turns.zh:
蛙眼大灯和小巧的车身，第一代Twingo就是那么可爱！
它的内部空间出乎意料的宽裕，
座位甚至可以做到完全放平。

对了，你知道这个奇奇怪怪的名字是怎么来的吗？

它其实是三种舞蹈名称的变化组合——Twist（扭扭舞）、
Swing（摇摆舞）与Tango（探戈）。
Twingo还曾与多个时尚品牌联名推出限量特别版。

这款1993年的初代车型，
如今早已成为收藏家们竞相追捧的珍品！
turns.speaker: Stella

turns.raw:
So this is the Yangwang U9, the luxury EV from BYD Auto.

The first supercar from the Chinese maker, it packs an impressive 1,300 BHP as standard.

Would you look at that rear wing? It looks like it came straight off a race car!

With four independent motors powering each wheel, it’s a cornering machine.

And its unique active suspension is absolutely packed with advanced tech.

The supercar of the future, the U9 makes me giddy just talking about it!
turns.en:
So this is the Yangwang U9, the luxury EV from BYD Auto.
The first supercar from the Chinese maker,
it packs an impressive 1,300 BHP as standard.

Would you look at that rear wing? It looks like it came
straight off a race car!
With four independent motors powering each wheel,
it’s a cornering machine.

And its unique active suspension is absolutely packed
with advanced tech.
The supercar of the future, the U9 makes me giddy
just talking about it!
turns.zh:
眼前这台车，就是来自比亚迪的豪华电动汽车
——仰望U9。
作为这家中国车企推出的首款超跑，
它标配高达1300hp的澎湃动力。

瞧瞧那个尾翼，简直就是赛车上原装移植过来的！
四台独立电机各自驱动一个车轮，
赋予了它极为出色的过弯能力。

而那套独特的主动式悬挂系统，
更是塞满了各种前沿技术。
这辆展现未来趋势的超级跑车仰望U9，
光是谈论参数规格，就足以令人心潮澎湃！
turns.speaker: Stella

作为这家中国车企推出的首款超跑，
它标配高达1300hp的澎湃动力。

瞧瞧那个尾翼，简直就是赛车上原装移植过来的！
四台独立电机各自驱动一个车轮，
赋予了它极为出色的过弯能力。

而那套独特的主动式悬挂系统，
更是塞满了各种前沿技术。
这辆展现未来趋势的超级跑车仰望U9，
光是谈论参数规格，就足以令人心潮澎湃！

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf1Kodama_normal_aqua_s_11_1700105
turns.raw:
This is one of Toyota’s best designs in recent years.

It's been over a decade since this car hit the streets.

Yet to see it today, you’d think it were novel.

The low height and its double-bubble roof result in a drag coefficient of 0.28, allowing for a smooth ride.

From the significantly canted windscreen...

...to the drastically sloping rear, this car expresses a bold, clear vision.!
turns.en:
This is one of Toyota’s best designs in recent years.

It's been over a decade since this car
hit the streets.

Yet to see it today, you’d think it were novel.
The low height and its double-bubble roof result in a drag
coefficient of 0.28, allowing for a smooth ride.

From the significantly canted windscreen...

...to the drastically sloping rear, this car expresses
a bold, clear vision.!
turns.zh:
这辆车是Toyota近些年来最好的设计之一。

其实它也已经出现在街头十多年了……

但今天看到它，
还是有种新鲜感。
Toyota通过压低车身高度和采用双气泡型车顶
成功将阻力系数降低至0.28。这样的车开起来肯定很舒服。

无论是明显下探的挡风玻璃……

还是向后延、并在车尾收束下坠的利落侧面轮廓线，
都让人有耳目一新的良好感受。
turns.speaker: Hideo Kodama

turns.raw:
Don’t let this cheerful little package fool you. It showcases a high level of product design.

In fact, it's so good it’s timeless.

No wonder the current Cinquecento borrows from it.

Dante Giacosa, FIAT's legendary engineer...

...rose to prominence in 1955 when he created the 600, Italy’s answer to the post-war compact car.

He then took on the challenge of...

...creating an even better minimally-packaged car. The result was a rear-engine, super-compact Cinquecento.

Thanks to the intentionally flared wheel arches, the car appears to be in constant motion.

The yawning hood lid is also quite appealing, not to mention functional.4
turns.en:
Don’t let this cheerful little package fool you.
It showcases a high level of product design.

In fact, it's so good it’s timeless.

No wonder the current Cinquecento borrows from it.
Dante Giacosa, FIAT's legendary engineer...

...rose to prominence in 1955 when he created the 600,
Italy’s answer to the post-war compact car.

He then took on the challenge of...

...creating an even better minimally-packaged car.
The result was a rear-engine, super-compact Cinquecento.
Thanks to the intentionally flared wheel arches,
the car appears to be in constant motion.
The yawning hood lid is also quite appealing,
not to mention functional.
turns.zh:
千万不要小看这款娇小的车型。它表现出了极高的
产品设计水平，

甚至堪称永恒经典。

难怪最新款的500也借鉴了它的设计。
菲亚特的传奇工程师但特·吉奥科萨……

在1955年设计出了600，为意大利汽车行业拿出了
战后紧凑型汽车的标准答案，也借此声名鹊起。

然后他勇敢地接受了更大的挑战……

开始打造一款更加优秀的低配置车型。
最终他开发出了这辆后置引擎、空间超紧凑的500。
在他的巧手勾勒下，这款车采用了外扩式轮拱，
让它呈现出一种始终处于运动状态下的观感。
它宽大的引擎盖也拥有一种慵懒闲适的吸引力，而性能
自然也不容小觑。
turns.speaker: Hideo Kodama

turns.en:
The pleasure is ours, Kodama-san.
What an honor it is to make your acquaintance!

Kodama-san was the chief designer at Opel.
He worked for more than 40 years in Opel's design department.

He's also a judge at the prestigious and historic
vintage-car event, the Concorso d'Eleganza Villa d'Este.
turns.zh:
应该高兴的是我们，儿玉先生。
认识您真是荣幸！

儿玉先生是Opel的首席设计师。
他在Opel的设计部门工作了超过40年。

他还是权威而且历史悠久的埃斯特别墅古董车展
的评审委员之一。
turns.speaker: Sarah

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf1Kodama_normal__500_f_68_1700205
turns.raw:
Don’t let this cheerful little package fool you. It showcases a high level of product design.

In fact, it's so good it’s timeless.

No wonder the current Cinquecento borrows from it.

Dante Giacosa, FIAT's legendary engineer...

...rose to prominence in 1955 when he created the 600, Italy’s answer to the post-war compact car.

He then took on the challenge of...

...creating an even better minimally-packaged car. The result was a rear-engine, super-compact Cinquecento.

Thanks to the intentionally flared wheel arches, the car appears to be in constant motion.

The yawning hood lid is also quite appealing, not to mention functional.4

Italy’s answer to the post-war compact car.

...creating an even better minimally-packaged car.

turns.zh:
千万不要小看这款娇小的车型。它表现出了极高的
产品设计水平，

甚至堪称永恒经典。

难怪最新款的500也借鉴了它的设计。
菲亚特的传奇工程师但特·吉奥科萨……

在1955年设计出了600，为意大利汽车行业拿出了
战后紧凑型汽车的标准答案，也借此声名鹊起。

然后他勇敢地接受了更大的挑战……

开始打造一款更加优秀的低配置车型。
最终他开发出了这辆后置引擎、空间超紧凑的500。
在他的巧手勾勒下，这款车采用了外扩式轮拱，
让它呈现出一种始终处于运动状态下的观感。
它宽大的引擎盖也拥有一种慵懒闲适的吸引力，而性能
自然也不容小觑。
turns.speaker: Hideo Kodama

turns.raw:
At a time when Giugiaro was designing many production cars, he put his signature styling technique on full display...

...on this Lancia Delta.

It reflects the dignified brand image of Lancia, and gives off a very positive feel.

During the 1970s, Lancia dominated rally races with a car probably everyone is familiar with, the Stratos.

Lancia most likely intended for the Delta to be the spiritual successor of the Stratos.

When comparing it to the rally bred Stratos...

...the Delta improved on the 2-box hatchback-sedan theme.

The fat 16-inch 205 tires and the huge, blistered fenders provided the car with the prowess of a wild animal.

You can see how a tame hatchback can transform into a fierce rally machine.

I do like this kind of design approach as well.�
turns.en:
At a time when Giugiaro was designing many production cars,
he put his signature styling technique on full display...

...on this Lancia Delta.

It reflects the dignified brand image of Lancia,
and gives off a very positive feel.
During the 1970s, Lancia dominated rally races
with a car probably everyone is familiar with, the Stratos.

Lancia most likely intended for the Delta to be
the spiritual successor of the Stratos.

When comparing it to the rally bred Stratos...

...the Delta improved on the 2-box hatchback-sedan theme.
The fat 16-inch 205 tires and the huge, blistered fenders
provided the car with the prowess of a wild animal.

You can see how a tame hatchback can transform
into a fierce rally machine.

I do like this kind of design approach as well.
turns.zh:
有一段时间，乔治亚罗的设计产量大增，推出了多款量产车作品，
但他把自己标志性的造型技术……

……充分展现在这辆蓝旗亚Delta中。

它不仅反映出蓝旗亚高贵庄重的品牌形象，
更给人以积极进取的感觉。
在20世纪70年代，蓝旗亚以一辆被所有人熟知的好车
主宰了拉力赛，那就是Stratos。

蓝旗亚可能原本打算让Delta成为Stratos的精神继承者。

与为拉力赛而生的Stratos不同……

Delta的研发基础车型是一台两厢掀背轿车。
蓝旗亚用16英寸的205宽胎和外扩的特大号挡泥板
赋予了Delta如同野生动物一般无畏的野性。

也让你亲眼目睹一辆温驯的掀背车
是如何被转化为一辆狂暴的拉力赛车的。

顺带一提，我本人非常欣赏这种设计方法。
turns.speaker: Hideo Kodama

turns.raw:
At a time when Giugiaro was designing many production cars, he put his signature styling technique on full display...

...on this Lancia Delta.

It reflects the dignified brand image of Lancia, and gives off a very positive feel.

During the 1970s, Lancia dominated rally races with a car probably everyone is familiar with, the Stratos.

Lancia most likely intended for the Delta to be the spiritual successor of the Stratos.

When comparing it to the rally bred Stratos...

...the Delta improved on the 2-box hatchback-sedan theme.

The fat 16-inch 205 tires and the huge, blistered fenders provided the car with the prowess of a wild animal.

You can see how a tame hatchback can transform into a fierce rally machine.

I do like this kind of design approach as well.�
turns.en:
At a time when Giugiaro was designing many production cars,
he put his signature styling technique on full display...

...on this Lancia Delta.

It reflects the dignified brand image of Lancia,
and gives off a very positive feel.
During the 1970s, Lancia dominated rally races
with a car probably everyone is familiar with, the Stratos.

Lancia most likely intended for the Delta to be
the spiritual successor of the Stratos.

When comparing it to the rally bred Stratos...

...the Delta improved on the 2-box hatchback-sedan theme.
The fat 16-inch 205 tires and the huge, blistered fenders
provided the car with the prowess of a wild animal.

You can see how a tame hatchback can transform
into a fierce rally machine.

I do like this kind of design approach as well.
turns.zh:
有一段时间，乔治亚罗的设计产量大增，推出了多款量产车作品，
但他把自己标志性的造型技术……

……充分展现在这辆蓝旗亚Delta中。

它不仅反映出蓝旗亚高贵庄重的品牌形象，
更给人以积极进取的感觉。
在20世纪70年代，蓝旗亚以一辆被所有人熟知的好车
主宰了拉力赛，那就是Stratos。

蓝旗亚可能原本打算让Delta成为Stratos的精神继承者。

与为拉力赛而生的Stratos不同……

Delta的研发基础车型是一台两厢掀背轿车。
蓝旗亚用16英寸的205宽胎和外扩的特大号挡泥板
赋予了Delta如同野生动物一般无畏的野性。

也让你亲眼目睹一辆温驯的掀背车
是如何被转化为一辆狂暴的拉力赛车的。

顺带一提，我本人非常欣赏这种设计方法。
turns.speaker: Hideo Kodama

turns.en:
The pleasure is ours, Kodama-san.
What an honor it is to make your acquaintance!

Kodama-san was the chief designer at Opel.
He worked for more than 40 years in Opel's design department.

He's also a judge at the prestigious and historic
vintage-car event, the Concorso d'Eleganza Villa d'Este.
turns.zh:
应该高兴的是我们，儿玉先生。
认识您真是荣幸！

儿玉先生是Opel的首席设计师。
他在Opel的设计部门工作了超过40年。

他还是权威而且历史悠久的埃斯特别墅古董车展
的评审委员之一。
turns.speaker: Sarah

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf1Kodama_normal_challenger_rt_70_1700405
turns.raw:
At first glance, it appears to be a normal sedan, but look inside, and you'll realize that this car was created for speed.

This is the category that's referred to as "muscle cars."

This Challenger R/T is like the Barracuda because it's smaller in size.

However, the large front opening and the kicked-up rear quarter...

...are aggressive design cues that match the car's character.

Power is provided by a HEMI engine.

On the hood is a protruding air scoop called the "Shaker."

When it shakes, it declares the enormous power it possesses.

If you include the optional rear spoiler, the Challenger R/T is a muscle car that's sure to catch anyone's eye.A

turns.zh:
如果不仔细看，你会以为它是一辆普通的轿车。
但坐进驾驶舱之后，你就会明白这是一台速度机器。

这个类别的车通常归类为“肌肉车”。

这辆Challenger R/T很像梭鱼，只是尺寸小一号。

不过它那宽大的前脸开口和
拱起的后侧围板……
无不在体现该车极富侵略性的特征。

此车的动力来自一台HEMI引擎。
引擎盖上的进气口又被车迷们戏称为“抖动器”

这个称号来源于它工作时的抖动噪声，
就像在宣告自己的澎湃动力。
如果再装配上车尾扰流板，
Challenger R/T必定会吸引所有人的目光。
turns.speaker: Hideo Kodama

turns.raw:
These days, it's rare to see one person's vision result in a product that reflects his intent to the smallest details.

Setting out to create a fresh car, the genius Gordon Murray came up with the concept.

He then handed the reins to designer Peter Stevens. The result is the F1 you see here.

The concept, which became the base for the F1, was for it to be "a super sports car that could be driven every day."

Some say that the first-generation Honda NSX served as the benchmark.

The center-forward driving position in a three-seat configuration helped to balance the car.

...and also keeping the car's height to a low <1140mm>.

But the design is well-executed, without any strangeness to it at all. I do like it.
turns.en:
These days, it's rare to see one person's vision result in a
product that reflects his intent to the smallest details.

Setting out to create a fresh car, the genius Gordon Murray
came up with the concept.

He then handed the reins to designer Peter Stevens.
The result is the F1 you see here.
The concept, which became the base for the F1, was for it to
be "a super sports car that could be driven every day."

Some say that the first-generation
Honda NSX served as the benchmark.
The center-forward driving position in a three-seat
configuration helped to balance the car.

...and also keeping the car's height to a low 1140mm.
But the design is well-executed,
without any strangeness to it at all. I do like it.
turns.zh:
近几十年来，我们鲜少能看到将设计师的意图
贯彻到每一处细节的作品。

天才设计师戈登·穆雷曾提出过一辆新车的概念构想，

然后将接力棒交到了彼得·史蒂文斯手中。
两人的合作成果就是你眼前的这台F1。
F1的设计初衷，就是创造一辆
“可以日常驾驶的超级跑车”。

还有人说它的设计对标参照物是第一代本田NSX。
这辆车有许多独到之处。例如在三座布局中，
将驾驶员座椅放在前排居中位置，以使重量分配达到最优，

……亦或是将车身高度降到只有1140mm。
迈凯伦在实现设计时做的非常到位，没有一丝不协调感。
我很欣赏这一点。
turns.speaker: Hideo Kodama

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf1Kodama_normal_mclaren_f1_94_1700605
turns.raw:
These days, it's rare to see one person's vision result in a product that reflects his intent to the smallest details.

Setting out to create a fresh car, the genius Gordon Murray came up with the concept.

He then handed the reins to designer Peter Stevens. The result is the F1 you see here.

The concept, which became the base for the F1, was for it to be "a super sports car that could be driven every day."

Some say that the first-generation Honda NSX served as the benchmark.

The center-forward driving position in a three-seat configuration helped to balance the car.

...and also keeping the car's height to a low <1140mm>.

But the design is well-executed, without any strangeness to it at all. I do like it.

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf1Kodama_normal_a6gcs_spyder_54_1700705
turns.raw:
Very Italian in improvisation, I'm quite taken by...

....the high degree of precision displayed here.

One of the things the Maserati brothers, who sold Maserati and started OSCA, left behind was...

...the sohc 6-cylinder engine.

The car that used this engine was their grand prix machine. With that at the foundation, the A6GCS was born.

The car's four driven wheels and various other mechanical parts are covered by a body that seems to be made of soft cloth.

The volume here is minimal.

This body was the work of the famous Modena craftsman Fantuzzi.

You can feel the presence of the design language of the Type 61 Birdcage in this car.

It really excites the soul, this design.�
turns.en:
Very Italian in improvisation,
I'm quite taken by...

....the high degree of precision displayed here.
One of the things the Maserati brothers, who sold Maserati
and started OSCA, left behind was...

...the sohc 6-cylinder engine.

The car that used this engine was their grand prix machine.
With that at the foundation, the A6GCS was born.
The car's four driven wheels and various other mechanical parts
are covered by a body that seems to be made of soft cloth.

The volume here is minimal.

This body was the work of the famous
Modena craftsman Fantuzzi.
You can feel the presence of the design language
of the Type 61 Birdcage in this car.

It really excites the soul, this design.
turns.zh:
这是非常有意大利风格的即兴演绎，
尤其令我着迷的是……

整台车体现出的高精细度。
当玛莎拉蒂兄弟最终离开公司，创建奥斯卡时，

他们为玛莎拉蒂留下了一件宝藏，
就是这台直列六缸单顶置凸轮轴引擎。

使用这台引擎的是他们的一款大奖赛赛车。
在此基础上，他们开发了A6GCS。
宛若薄绸般轻盈的车身用顺滑的曲线
包覆车轮和其他机械部件……

同时也将车身体积控制在了最低限度。

这正是莫德纳的著名车身制造商凡图奇的手笔。
你可以明显看到它的设计语言和Type 61鸟笼一脉相承。

看到这样的设计，让人从内心深处受到震撼！
turns.speaker: Hideo Kodama

尤其令我着迷的是……

整台车体现出的高精细度。
当玛莎拉蒂兄弟最终离开公司，创建奥斯卡时，

他们为玛莎拉蒂留下了一件宝藏，
就是这台直列六缸单顶置凸轮轴引擎。

使用这台引擎的是他们的一款大奖赛赛车。
在此基础上，他们开发了A6GCS。
宛若薄绸般轻盈的车身用顺滑的曲线
包覆车轮和其他机械部件……

同时也将车身体积控制在了最低限度。

这正是莫德纳的著名车身制造商凡图奇的手笔。
你可以明显看到它的设计语言和Type 61鸟笼一脉相承。

看到这样的设计，让人从内心深处受到震撼！
turns.speaker: Hideo Kodama

One of the things the Maserati brothers, who sold Maserati and started OSCA, left behind was...

The car that used this engine was their grand prix machine. With that at the foundation, the A6GCS was born.

The car's four driven wheels and various other mechanical parts are covered by a body that seems to be made of soft cloth.

The volume here is minimal.

This body was the work of the famous Modena craftsman Fantuzzi.

You can feel the presence of the design language of the Type 61 Birdcage in this car.

It really excites the soul, this design.�

turns.raw:
When you mention the 917, I'm reminded by a particular episode. Allow me to talk about something that happened in 1968.

At the Eiffel wind tunnel, which opened in Paris in the 19th century, we were in the midst of a project...

...while in the adjacent room, another car was being tested. That was the 917.

A state-of-the-art advanced racing machine tested at a turn-of-the-century lab! It was amusingly ironic.

The 917 made its debut at the 1969 Geneva Show.

It was the successor to the 908, and instead of an 8-cylinder engine, this monster had an air-cooled flat-12.

Depending on the race, the 917 came in different forms.

On high-speed circuits, it wore a long-tail body,

and on tricky courses like the Targa Florio, it had a short tail.

turns.zh:
提到917，我正好想起了一个故事。
请容我讲讲1968年发生的一件轶事。
当时我们在十九世纪就设立的巴黎埃菲尔风洞实验室里
，我们的新项目正进行到一半……

这时正好有另一辆车在隔壁接受测试，就是这款917。

一辆采用当时最顶尖科技打造
的比赛机器停放在一座修建于前一个世纪的实验室里！

有一种恍若隔世的反差感。
后来，这款917在1969年的日内瓦车展上首次亮相。
虽然这台动力猛兽是908的继任者，但却没有采用水平对置
八缸引擎，而是换上了一台水平对置十二缸风冷引擎。

此外，这台917还可以根据不同类型的赛事调校为不同形式……

例如在高速赛道上采用长车尾，
在塔格·佛罗热耐力赛这样的蜿蜒赛道上则换上短车尾。ne�t id=1700806 type=9

turns.en:
The pleasure is ours, Kodama-san.
What an honor it is to make your acquaintance!

Kodama-san was the chief designer at Opel.
He worked for more than 40 years in Opel's design department.

He's also a judge at the prestigious and historic
vintage-car event, the Concorso d'Eleganza Villa d'Este.
turns.zh:
应该高兴的是我们，儿玉先生。
认识您真是荣幸！

儿玉先生是Opel的首席设计师。
他在Opel的设计部门工作了超过40年。

他还是权威而且历史悠久的埃斯特别墅古董车展
的评审委员之一。
turns.speaker: Sarah

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf1Kodama_normal_mangsta_69_1700905
turns.raw:
What's interesting about this car is that the bodywork was penned by a young Giugiaro, who was then the chief designer at Ghia.

It seems so simple, it looks to drawn by a single brush stroke, thus the shape consists of simple lines and surfaces.

A half century later, the car still looks fresh and alluring.

It shares the same backbone chassis technology as the original Vallelunga, with a Ford V-8 housed within.

Access to the mid-mounted engine comes via a butterfly-type rear hatch.

This detail is also particularly interesting and fun. I like it.n
turns.en:
What's interesting about this car is that the bodywork was penned
by a young Giugiaro, who was then the chief designer at Ghia.

It seems so simple, it looks to drawn by a single brush stroke,
thus the shape consists of simple lines and surfaces.

A half century later,
the car still looks fresh and alluring.
It shares the same backbone chassis technology as
the original Vallelunga, with a Ford V-8 housed within.
Access to the mid-mounted engine comes

This detail is also particularly interesting and fun. I like it.
turns.zh:
这辆车最令人着迷之处全在于它的车身，
这是由Carrozzeria Ghia后来的首席设计师，

当时才初出茅庐的乔盖托·乔治亚罗执笔设计的。

它的外形如此简洁、仿佛是一笔而就，
因此其形状都为简单的线、面所构成。

在半个世纪后的今天，依然有新鲜感和吸引力。
它采用了与其原型Vallelunga相同的脊骨式车架技术，
搭载Ford V8引擎。
掀开鸥翼式的后备箱盖，就可以看到这台中置引擎。

这个细节特别有趣味。我很喜欢。
turns.speaker: Hideo Kodama

Yet it possesses irresistible charm. This is the W194, also known as the 300SL.

It won the Mille Miglia, Grand Prix of Bern, and the Carrera Panamericana in 1952.

This design is the result of avoiding the bottom portion of the structure of the space frame./

它不仅于1952年的意大利一千英里耐力赛、伯尔尼大奖赛和
Carrera泛美公路拉力赛上豪迈地拿下了冠军头衔，

还在勒芒24小时耐力赛中包揽了前二。
此车的上翻式车门被称作“鸥翼”车门，

由此，“鸥翼”也成为了本车的绰号。

其实，如此设计是为了避免车门与空间车架结构的底部发生冲突。

vintage-car event, the Concorso d'Eleganza Villa d'Este.

应该高兴的是我们，儿玉先生。

turns.speaker: Sarah

There seems to be a reason behind every detail of this design, a design with the spirit of rationality.

Yet it possesses irresistible charm. This is the W194, also known as the 300SL.

It won the Mille Miglia, Grand Prix of Bern, and the Carrera Panamericana in 1952.

On top of that, it placed 1-2 at Le Mans.

The doors of this car swing upward in what is known as "gullwing" types.

That term also serves as the nickname for this car.

This design is the result of avoiding the bottom portion of the structure of the space frame./

turns.raw:
Classical yet elegantly refined, this car is truly a stunning work of art.

The body is designed by Carrozzeria Touring...

Which had already experimented with a modern ‘pontoon’ shape and integrated fenders.

What made the 8C2900 different...

Was its classic design, which accentuated its large, sweeping fenders.

Not only did it make a statement among the Alfa Romeos of its day...

It continues to grab the attention of modern Italian car enthusiasts.
turns.en:
Classical yet elegantly refined, this car is truly
a stunning work of art.

The body is designed by Carrozzeria Touring...

Which had already experimented with a modern
‘pontoon’ shape and integrated fenders.
What made the 8C2900 different...

Was its classic design, which accentuated
its large, sweeping fenders.
Not only did it make a statement among
the Alfa Romeos of its day...

It continues to grab the attention of modern
Italian car enthusiasts.
turns.zh:
抛开经典复古的内核不谈，这款车在设计中
将优雅与犀利融为一体，造就了一件毋庸置疑的美妙作品。

Carrozzeria Touring在打造此车身时，
正在实验当时被称作“浮船”的先进设计：

即车身的前后挡泥板连贯为一个整体。
然而，这辆8C 2900还呈现了……

另一种经典设计：上拱的巨大挡泥板。
当然，这一设计元素也被其他Alfa Romeo车型所采用。

毫无疑问这是一辆非常优美的汽车，
甚至比当今的许多Ferrari还要吸睛。
turns.speaker: Hideo Kodama

Which had already experimented with a modern ‘pontoon’ shape and integrated fenders.

What made the 8C2900 different...

Was its classic design, which accentuated its large, sweeping fenders.

Not only did it make a statement among the Alfa Romeos of its day...

It continues to grab the attention of modern Italian car enthusiasts.

抛开经典复古的内核不谈，这款车在设计中

Carrozzeria Touring在打造此车身时，
正在实验当时被称作“浮船”的先进设计：

即车身的前后挡泥板连贯为一个整体。
然而，这辆8C 2900还呈现了……

另一种经典设计：上拱的巨大挡泥板。
当然，这一设计元素也被其他Alfa Romeo车型所采用。

毫无疑问这是一辆非常优美的汽车，
甚至比当今的许多Ferrari还要吸睛。

The pleasure is ours, Kodama-san. What an honor
it is to make your acquaintance!

Kodama-san was the chief designer at Opel. He worked
for more than 40 years in Opel's design department.

He's also a judge at the prestigious and historic
vintage car event, the Concorso d'Eleganza Villa d'Este.
turns.zh:
应该高兴的是我们，儿玉先生。认识您真是荣幸！

儿玉先生是Opel的首席设计师。
他在Opel的设计部门工作了超过40年。

他还是权威而且历史悠久的埃斯特别墅古董车展
的评审委员之一。
turns.speaker: Sarah

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf1Kodama_normal_xnr_ghia_roadster_60_1701305
turns.raw:
Virgil Exner is a designer that I'm quite fond of.

After working with Raymond Loewy, he served as the first design director for Chrysler from 1953 to 1961.

With designs overflowing with personality, he was the leading figure in the golden age of Chrysler design.

From all of those creations, the one that stands out to me is the XNR.

This concept car can be regarded as an answer to sports cars like the Chevrolet Corvette and Ford Thunderbird.

It features a unique asymmetrical design, with an air scoop, interior panel and tailfin serving as accents.

One might call the styling of this car outrageous, but it was very fresh. 

Virgil Exner is a designer that I'm quite fond of.

After working with Raymond Loewy, he served as the first
design director for Chrysler from 1953 to 1961.
With designs overflowing with personality, he was the
leading figure in the golden age of Chrysler design.
From all of those creations, the one that stands out to me
is the XNR.

This concept car can be regarded as an answer to sports cars
like the Chevrolet Corvette and Ford Thunderbird.
It features a unique asymmetrical design, with an air scoop,

One might call the styling of this car outrageous,

turns.zh:
维尔基尔·艾克斯勒是我非常欣赏的设计师。

在与雷蒙德·洛威展开合作后，他在1953到1961年之间
担任Chrysler的首位设计总监。
他的设计洋溢着个人风格，
也是Chrysler设计黄金时代的领导人物。
在他所有的创作中，我觉得最杰出的就是这辆XNR。

这款概念车可以称得上是Chrysler对Chevrolet Corvette和
Ford Thunderbird等跑车的回应。
它采用了独特的非对称设计，并通过进气口、
内衬板和尾翼等元素加以强调。

也许有人会认为这样的风格十分离经叛道，
但确实做到了让所有人耳目一新。*
turns.speaker: Hideo Kodama

turns.en:
The classical proportions and simple shape without needless
frills make this car essentially a sculpture.

Until then, carrozzerie such as Vignale, Ghia
and Zagato produced Ferrari bodies.
In the mid-1950s, the association with Pininfarina deepened,
and their work together increased.

This is a product from that time period.
It's powered by a 4-cylinder engine,
which is mounted well back...

allowing for a long bonnet and the cabin's placement right
in front of the rear wheels.
turns.zh:
经典的比例和简单的形状，无需多余的装饰，
这辆车简直就像是一座雕塑。

在此之前，Ferrari的车身大多交由Vignale、Ghia
和Zagato等车身制造商打造。
从1950年代中期起，Ferrari与Pininfarina深化了合作，
二者联合打造的作品也越来越多。

这辆车就是来自那个时代的产品。
它由一部后置安装的4缸引擎提供动力……

因此可以采用更长的引擎罩，座舱则恰到好处地
位于后轮的前方。

BMW's EV brand began with the "i."

The company offered two products, an urban commuter, the i3, and the super high-performance i8.

Both models utilized different power sources, and each expressed itself with its own form language.

They're quite alluring, no?

Particularly the i3, in addition to the proportions defined by packaging necessities...

The car is eye-catching, even when it's driving around town.

The interior also uses sustainable environmental materials. Everything about the car is thorough.

This kind of approach serves the role of making the user highly conscious of the environment.

That's why this design is so important. A gold star!�
turns.en:
BMW's EV brand began with the "i."

The company offered two products, an urban commuter,
the i3, and the super high-performance i8.
Both models utilized different power sources, and
each expressed itself with its own form language.

They're quite alluring, no?
Particularly the i3, in addition to the proportions
defined by packaging necessities...

The car is eye-catching, even when it's driving
around town.

The interior also uses sustainable environmental materials.
Everything about the car is thorough.
This kind of approach serves the role of making the user
highly conscious of the environment.

That's why this design is so important. A gold star!
turns.zh:
宝马的电动车都以“i”字母起头。

其电动车品牌主打两款产品：作为都市通勤车的i3，
和拥有超强性能的i8。
这两个型号采用了不同的动力源，
而且都以独特的外形设计语言表达出自己的定位。

两辆车是不是都非常诱人？
尤其是这辆i3，在内饰布局和配置上下了不少功夫，
留足了空间……

即便是在城市里驾驶，它也能非常吸睛。

它的内饰采用了可持续环保材料。
此车的一切都透露着缜密、周全。
这样的做法有助于令用户对环保产生深刻的认识。

正因如此，这份独到的设计才显得至关重要。
值得给它颁发一颗金星勋章！
turns.speaker: Hideo Kodama

turns.raw:
BMW's EV brand began with the "i."

The company offered two products, an urban commuter, the i3, and the super high-performance i8.

Both models utilized different power sources, and each expressed itself with its own form language.

They're quite alluring, no?

Particularly the i3, in addition to the proportions defined by packaging necessities...

The car is eye-catching, even when it's driving around town.

The interior also uses sustainable environmental materials. Everything about the car is thorough.

This kind of approach serves the role of making the user highly conscious of the environment.

That's why this design is so important. A gold star!�
turns.en:
BMW's EV brand began with the "i."

The company offered two products, an urban commuter,
the i3, and the super high-performance i8.
Both models utilized different power sources, and
each expressed itself with its own form language.

They're quite alluring, no?
Particularly the i3, in addition to the proportions
defined by packaging necessities...

The car is eye-catching, even when it's driving
around town.

The interior also uses sustainable environmental materials.
Everything about the car is thorough.
This kind of approach serves the role of making the user
highly conscious of the environment.

That's why this design is so important. A gold star!
turns.zh:
宝马的电动车都以“i”字母起头。

其电动车品牌主打两款产品：作为都市通勤车的i3，
和拥有超强性能的i8。
这两个型号采用了不同的动力源，
而且都以独特的外形设计语言表达出自己的定位。

两辆车是不是都非常诱人？
尤其是这辆i3，在内饰布局和配置上下了不少功夫，
留足了空间……

即便是在城市里驾驶，它也能非常吸睛。

它的内饰采用了可持续环保材料。
此车的一切都透露着缜密、周全。
这样的做法有助于令用户对环保产生深刻的认识。

正因如此，这份独到的设计才显得至关重要。
值得给它颁发一颗金星勋章！
turns.speaker: Hideo Kodama

turns.en:
The pleasure is ours, Kodama-san. What an honor
it is to make your acquaintance!

Kodama-san was the chief designer at Opel. He worked
for more than 40 years in Opel's design department.

He's also a judge at the prestigious and historic
vintage car event, the Concorso d'Eleganza Villa d'Este.
turns.zh:
应该高兴的是我们，儿玉先生。认识您真是荣幸！

儿玉先生是Opel的首席设计师。
他在Opel的设计部门工作了超过40年。

他还是权威而且历史悠久的埃斯特别墅古董车展
的评审委员之一。
turns.speaker: Sarah

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf1Kodama_normal_sports_800_65_1701605
turns.raw:
This car has the reputation of having a cute design.

But its creators didn't mean for it to be cute. Rather, they strived to make the design extremely functional.

The end result is effective and quite pleasant.

Based on national automotive standards at the time, Toyota introduced the <800cc> 4-passenger Publica in 1962.

Using that car as a base, the company produced this sporty model called the Toyota Sports 800.

It's also known as the "Yota Hachi."

Despite having a small engine, the car's look suggests it drives in a spritely manner...

...with emphasis placed on aerodynamics and lightness.

Shozo Saito, a designer who worked at Kanto Jidosha, a Toyota subsidiary company...

...played a central role in this design.�
turns.en:
This car has the reputation of having a cute design.

But its creators didn't mean for it to be cute. Rather, they
strived to make the design extremely functional.

The end result is effective and quite pleasant.
Based on national automotive standards at the time, Toyota
introduced the 800cc 4-passenger Publica in 1962.

Using that car as a base, the company produced
this sporty model called the Toyota Sports 800.

It's also known as the "Yota Hachi."
Despite having a small engine, the car's look suggests
it drives in a spritely manner...

...with emphasis placed on aerodynamics and lightness.
Shozo Saito, a designer who worked at Kanto Jidosha,
a Toyota subsidiary company...

...played a central role in this design.
turns.zh:
这辆车因其可爱的设计而举世闻名……

不过这并非设计师的本意，
在设计时，他们致力于最大化突出功能性。
好在结果非常成功、非常令人满意。
基于当时的国家汽车标准，丰田在1962年
推出了排量800cc的4座汽车帕布利卡。

该公司随后又基于该车型推出了
跑车型号丰田Sports 800，

也就是大家口中的“丰田8”。
尽管排量较小，但得益于设计师将外观设计的重点放在了
空气动力学和轻量化，

让人觉得它拥有活力和动感的操控感。
为丰田子公司“关东自动车工业株式会社”工作的设计师佐藤章蔵

在这辆车的设计工作中担任了举足轻重的角色。
turns.speaker: Hideo Kodama

turns.raw:
Thanks to the technical know-how of aerodynamics specialist Malcolm Sayer, this Jaguar D-Type...

...was a dramatic departure for Jaguar in that it embraced a new dynamic form.

From the XK120 to the XK150, Jaguar had pursued a sort of French elegance, but the D-Type was a pure revolution.

With a little more than 70 units built, the D-Type began competing at Le Mans in 1954.

While it came up short in its first year, it won overall victories in 1955 and 1956, a historic feat for Jaguar.

A truly iconic car, its dynamic design would be carried over to the XJ13 and, later, the famous E-Type.~
turns.en:
Thanks to the technical know-how of aerodynamics specialist
Malcolm Sayer, this Jaguar D-Type...

...was a dramatic departure for Jaguar in that it embraced
a new dynamic form.
From the XK120 to the XK150, Jaguar had pursued a sort of
French elegance, but the D-Type was a pure revolution.
With a little more than 70 units built, the D-Type began
competing at Le Mans in 1954.

While it came up short in its first year, it won overall
victories in 1955 and 1956, a historic feat for Jaguar.
A truly iconic car, its dynamic design would be carried over
to the XJ13 and, later, the famous E-Type.~
turns.zh:
得益于空气动力学专家马尔科姆·塞尔所提供的
技术专业知识，这辆Jaguar D-Type……

与过去的Jaguar截然不同，采用了全新的动力学外观。
从XK120到XK150，Jaguar一直追求某种法式的优雅，
而D-Type的推出带来了一场全方位的革新。
在生产了70余辆后，D-Type于1954年开始参加勒芒比赛。

虽然第一年出师不利，但在55年和56年却大获全胜，
在Jaguar的历史上写下了厚重的一笔。
这是一辆真正标志性的赛车，它的动力学设置
后来在XJ13上得到沿用，并被此后著名的E-type所继承。
turns.speaker: Hideo Kodama

turns.raw:
Thanks to the technical know-how of aerodynamics specialist Malcolm Sayer, this Jaguar D-Type...

...was a dramatic departure for Jaguar in that it embraced a new dynamic form.

From the XK120 to the XK150, Jaguar had pursued a sort of French elegance, but the D-Type was a pure revolution.

With a little more than 70 units built, the D-Type began competing at Le Mans in 1954.

While it came up short in its first year, it won overall victories in 1955 and 1956, a historic feat for Jaguar.

A truly iconic car, its dynamic design would be carried over to the XJ13 and, later, the famous E-Type.~

Aspiring to tone down the D-Type racer somewhat, car designer Malcolm Sayer...

Although its engine was from a XK150 of the previous decade, this monocoque racer was thoroughly modern.

It’s truly a thing of beauty!
turns.en:
Aspiring to tone down the D-Type racer somewhat,
car designer Malcolm Sayer...

...gave Jaguar something that was aerodynamic, modern,
and dynamic.

Although its engine was from a XK150 of the previous decade,
this monocoque racer was thoroughly modern.
It’s truly a thing of beauty!
turns.zh:

汽车设计师马尔科姆·塞尔……

和动态感的设计理念。

促成了E-type的诞生。

turns.raw:
Following a trend set by the 4CV, the Renault R8 represented the third generation of the marque’s rear-engine sedans.

Yet the addition of 4-wheel disc brakes made it uniquely modern.

The R8 Gordini is an upgraded version, complete with the magic touch of the great Amédée Gordini.

Affectionately called the "Lunchbox," it has blunt lines and an overall spartan design.

The year 1966 saw the addition of twin headlights.

Dressed in French racing blue, with two white stripes, the Gordini truly has a charm that differentiates it from the pack.
turns.en:
Following a trend set by the 4CV, the Renault R8 represented the
third generation of the marque’s rear-engine sedans.

Yet the addition of 4-wheel disc brakes made it
uniquely modern.
The R8 Gordini is an upgraded version, complete with
the magic touch of the great Amédée Gordini.

Affectionately called the "Lunchbox," it has blunt lines
and an overall spartan design.
The year 1966 saw the addition of twin headlights.

Dressed in French racing blue, with two white stripes,
the Gordini truly has a charm that differentiates it from the pack.
turns.zh:
Renault R8继承4CV的传统，成为该知名品牌的
第三代后置引擎轿车。

四轮碟刹的加入为该系列增添了一抹独特的现代气息。
R8 Gordini是系列中的一款升级版车型，在伟大的设计师
阿梅德·戈迪尼的神奇手笔下，该车的速度进一步提升。

此车因其简洁的线条和整体简约设计
而被亲切地称为“饭盒”。
1966年，该车增加了双前大灯版本。

Gordini车身喷涂法国赛车蓝，配以两条白色条纹，
有一种浑然天成的魅力。
turns.speaker: Hideo Kodama

turns.en:

third generation of the marque’s rear-engine sedans.

uniquely modern.
The R8 Gordini is an upgraded version, complete with
the magic touch of the great Amédée Gordini.

四轮碟刹的加入为该系列增添了一抹独特的现代气息。

turns.raw:
A company that’s known to pivot hard, Suzuki sometimes offers products that really take you by surprise.

The Wagon R was one such example. And so was this Swift Sport.

The four corners of its chunky body are fit with relatively large wheels that speak to its excellent maneuverability.

A small car, it’s equipped with everything it needs and nothing else.

If you were to see it driving down an Italian street, you’d think the car was designed by Italians.
turns.en:
A company that’s known to pivot hard, Suzuki sometimes
offers products that really take you by surprise.

The Wagon R was one such example. And so
 was this Swift Sport.
The four corners of its chunky body are fit with relatively
large wheels that speak to its excellent maneuverability.

A small car, it’s equipped with everything it needs
and nothing else.
If you were to see it driving down an Italian street, you’d
think the car was designed by Italians.
turns.zh:
Suzuki是一家出了名的“推陈出新”的公司，有时会拿出一些
出人意料的产品。

比如Wagon R轻型车，又比如这款Swift Sport。
这款车的外形方正，在四个轮位安装了大一号的轮毂，
体现出它优异的操控性。

这是一辆麻雀虽小，五脏俱全的小型车，
不少一分，也不多一分。
如果在狭窄的意大利街道看到它驶过，你可能
会觉得它和当地的环境浑然一体。
turns.speaker: Hideo Kodama

The Wagon R was one such example. And so was this Swift Sport.

The four corners of its chunky body are fit with relatively large wheels that speak to its excellent maneuverability.

A small car, it’s equipped with everything it needs and nothing else.

If you were to see it driving down an Italian street, you’d think the car was designed by Italians.

turns.zh:
Suzuki是一家出了名的“推陈出新”的公司，有时会拿出一些
出人意料的产品。

比如Wagon R轻型车，又比如这款Swift Sport。
这款车的外形方正，在四个轮位安装了大一号的轮毂，
体现出它优异的操控性。

这是一辆麻雀虽小，五脏俱全的小型车，
不少一分，也不多一分。
如果在狭窄的意大利街道看到它驶过，你可能
会觉得它和当地的环境浑然一体。
turns.speaker: Hideo Kodama

turns.raw:
I never knew that the Abarth 1500 Biposto Bertone was also called the ‘B.A.T. 1’.

But when I consider its round body section and dual front air intakes...

Its many design links to B.A.T. 5, 7 and 9 become clear as day.

The gentle tail fins and thin dorsal fin that runs down the centre of the car are another case in point.

Franco Scaglione, the man who designed this car, joined Bertone as its chief stylist in 1952.

This car was the product of his wonderfully eccentric design mind.

The first B.A.T. (Berlinetta Aerodinamica Tecnica), it has an important place in the history of automotive design.t
turns.en:

The gentle tail fins and thin dorsal fin that runs down

turns.zh:
我之前不知道Abarth 1500 Biposto Bertone
也被称为“B.A.T.1”，

直到看到它圆润的车体和双层前进气口……

它与B.A.T. 5、7和9在设计上的一脉相承
就显露无疑。
柔和的尾翼和纵贯车身的中央长背翼
也体现了这一点。
设计师弗朗哥·斯凯荣内在1952年加入Bertone公司
担任首席设计师。

这款车就是他奇思妙想的产物。
作为第一辆B.A.T.（Berlinetta Aerodinamica Tecnica），
它在汽车设计史上占有相当重要的地位。
turns.speaker: Hideo Kodama

turns.raw:
After Jaguar took a break from racing in 1956, it continued to work on a successor to the D-Type.

This was during the transition from a front-engine layout to a mid-engine one.

While Ford gave us Eric Broadley’s Lola GT, the base model for the GT40...

...and Ferrari gave us the LM...

...Jaguar was committed to building a car with the same design language as the D-Type.

The result? A refined and aerodynamic prototype with a V-12 mounted amidships.

The XJ13.

Designed by the famous Malcolm Sayer...

...the XJ13 never raced, but it surely served as inspiration for the now legendary E-Type.u
turns.en:
After Jaguar took a break from racing in 1956, it continued
to work on a successor to the D-Type.
This was during the transition from a front-engine
layout to a mid-engine one.

While Ford gave us Eric Broadley’s Lola GT,
the base model for the GT40...

...and Ferrari gave us the LM...
...Jaguar was committed to building a car with the same
design language as the D-Type.

The result? A refined and aerodynamic prototype
with a V-12 mounted amidships.
The XJ13.

Designed by the famous Malcolm Sayer...
...the XJ13 never raced, but it surely served as
inspiration for the now legendary E-Type.
turns.zh:
在1956年短暂退出赛车运动后，捷豹继续投入D-Type
后续型号的研发。
这款车诞生于从前置引擎向中置引擎布局过渡的过程中。

在福特推出GT40的基础车型，
即埃里克·布拉德利设计的罗拉 GT……

以及法拉利推出了LM的同时……
捷豹依然致力于沿袭D-Type的设计语言。

其最终成果是一款精致纯粹、拥有优秀
空气动力学性能、采用中置V12引擎的原型车——
XJ13。

XJ13由著名的马尔科姆·塞尔所设计……
尽管从未参加过任何比赛，但它无疑
为E-Type的开发提供了大量的思路。
turns.speaker: Hideo Kodama

turns.raw:
After Jaguar took a break from racing in 1956, it continued to work on a successor to the D-Type.

This was during the transition from a front-engine layout to a mid-engine one.

While Ford gave us Eric Broadley’s Lola GT, the base model for the GT40...

...and Ferrari gave us the LM...

...Jaguar was committed to building a car with the same design language as the D-Type.

The result? A refined and aerodynamic prototype with a V-12 mounted amidships.

The XJ13.

Designed by the famous Malcolm Sayer...

...the XJ13 never raced, but it surely served as inspiration for the now legendary E-Type.u
turns.en:

...and Ferrari gave us the LM...
...Jaguar was committed to building a car with the same

The XJ13.

turns.zh:
在1956年短暂退出赛车运动后，捷豹继续投入D-Type
后续型号的研发。
这款车诞生于从前置引擎向中置引擎布局过渡的过程中。

在福特推出GT40的基础车型，
即埃里克·布拉德利设计的罗拉 GT……

以及法拉利推出了LM的同时……
捷豹依然致力于沿袭D-Type的设计语言。

其最终成果是一款精致纯粹、拥有优秀
空气动力学性能、采用中置V12引擎的原型车——
XJ13。

XJ13由著名的马尔科姆·塞尔所设计……
尽管从未参加过任何比赛，但它无疑
为E-Type的开发提供了大量的思路。
turns.speaker: Hideo Kodama

turns.raw:
The Prius caused a great sensation by being the world’s first mass-produced hybrid car.

But did you know its first-gen design was considered to be somewhat lacking?

The second-generation model featured a one-motion profile from its front to its coda tronca rear...

Which became standard for the Prius line, as you can see in this well-formed third-generation model.
turns.en:
The Prius caused a great sensation by being
the world’s first mass-produced hybrid car.

But did you know its first-gen design was considered
to be somewhat lacking?
The second-generation model featured a one-motion profile
from its front to its coda tronca rear...

Which became standard for the Prius line, as you can see in
this well-formed third-generation model.
turns.zh:
作为全球首款混动汽车，Prius曾引发轰动性的风潮。

不过你知道吗？它的第一代设计被普遍认为有所欠缺，
不够完美。
从第二代车型开始，Prius采用了从车头到
“断尾”（coda tronca）车尾的一体成形轮廓……

这随后就成为了Prius产品系列的标准设计，
你在这款外形美观的第三代车型中也能看到。
turns.speaker: Hideo Kodama

turns.raw:
The Prius caused a great sensation by being the world’s first mass-produced hybrid car.

But did you know its first-gen design was considered to be somewhat lacking?

The second-generation model featured a one-motion profile from its front to its coda tronca rear...

Which became standard for the Prius line, as you can see in this well-formed third-generation model.
turns.en:
The Prius caused a great sensation by being
the world’s first mass-produced hybrid car.

But did you know its first-gen design was considered
to be somewhat lacking?
The second-generation model featured a one-motion profile
from its front to its coda tronca rear...

Which became standard for the Prius line, as you can see in
this well-formed third-generation model.
turns.zh:
作为全球首款混动汽车，Prius曾引发轰动性的风潮。

不过你知道吗？它的第一代设计被普遍认为有所欠缺，
不够完美。
从第二代车型开始，Prius采用了从车头到
“断尾”（coda tronca）车尾的一体成形轮廓……

这随后就成为了Prius产品系列的标准设计，
你在这款外形美观的第三代车型中也能看到。
turns.speaker: Hideo Kodama

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf1Kodama_normal_s_baker_tourer_29_1702505
turns.raw:
This rare S model was built by British coachbuilder Barker, best known for its work with Rolls-Royce cars.

In fact, you’ll notice that its body greatly resembles that of a Rolls-Royce.

Designed by Dr. Ferdinand Porsche during his stint as chief engineer at Daimler-Benz...

...the S-type showed its potential when it won the opening race at the Nürburgring in 1927.

Powered by an inline-6 mounted mid-wheelbase, it is distinguished by its massive hood.

This feature gives the car very sporty proportions.

In addition to a factory body by Mercedes-Benz, the "S" also had bodies by French and Italian coachbuilders.
turns.en:

best known for its work with Rolls-Royce cars.
In fact, you’ll notice that its body greatly resembles
that of a Rolls-Royce.

Designed by Dr. Ferdinand Porsche during his stint as
chief engineer at Daimler-Benz...

...the S-type showed its potential when it won the opening race
at the Nürburgring in 1927.
Powered by an inline-6 mounted mid-wheelbase,
it is distinguished by its massive hood.

This feature gives the car very sporty proportions.
In addition to a factory body by Mercedes-Benz, the "S" also had bodies

turns.zh:
这款极其罕见的S系列是由因为与劳斯莱斯合作而闻名的
英国车身制造厂巴克所打造的。
其实你可以看出，它的车身与劳斯莱斯非常相似。

这辆S型的设计者是当时仍在戴姆勒-奔驰担任
首席工程师的斐迪南·保时捷博士……

并在1927年纽博格林赛道的开幕赛事上获胜，
向世人展现出了巨大的潜力。
它由一部中置直列六缸引擎提供动力，
其巨大的引擎盖尤为吸睛，

也赋予了这辆车极具运动感的比例。
除了由梅赛德斯-奔驰打造的原厂车身外，这辆S型还可以采用
法国和意大利车身制造厂推出的车身。
turns.speaker: Hideo Kodama

turns.raw:
This car was introduced at the 2003 Frankfurt Motor Show. I know because I was there.

Even if somebody were to cover its distinctive shield, I would still know it from its voluminous design.

The round taillights on its short rear overhang are reminiscent of the TZ.

And, well, it simply feels like an Alfa Romeo!

While Alfa Romeo sports models are usually designed by Italian carrozzerie and stylists...

...this 8C was different.

It was penned by Wolfgang Egger’s own design department, Centro Stile Alfa Romeo.'
turns.en:
This car was introduced at the 2003 Frankfurt Motor Show.
I know because I was there.

Even if somebody were to cover its distinctive shield,
I would still know it from its voluminous design.
The round taillights on its short rear overhang
are reminiscent of the TZ.

And, well, it simply feels like an Alfa Romeo!
While Alfa Romeo sports models are usually designed
by Italian carrozzerie and stylists...

...this 8C was different.

It was penned by Wolfgang Egger’s own design department,
Centro Stile Alfa Romeo.'
turns.zh:
这辆车在2003法兰克福车展上首次亮相。
我之所以知道，是因为当时我也在场！

即便把它特点鲜明的盾形车标挡住，我也能
从它宽大的车身设计分辨出来。
其短车尾凸出部分的圆形车尾灯让人回想起了经典车型TZ……

不过说实话……这才是纯正的Alfa Romeo！
Alfa Romeo的跑车车型多由意大利的
车身制造商和外观设计师操刀……

但这辆8C却并非如此。

它是由沃夫冈·埃格尔自己的设计部门——
Centro Stile Alfa Romeo所执笔设计。
turns.speaker: Hideo Kodama

turns.raw:
This car was introduced at the 2003 Frankfurt Motor Show. I know because I was there.

Even if somebody were to cover its distinctive shield, I would still know it from its voluminous design.

The round taillights on its short rear overhang are reminiscent of the TZ.

And, well, it simply feels like an Alfa Romeo!

While Alfa Romeo sports models are usually designed by Italian carrozzerie and stylists...

...this 8C was different.

It was penned by Wolfgang Egger’s own design department, Centro Stile Alfa Romeo.'

turns.zh:
这辆车在2003法兰克福车展上首次亮相。
我之所以知道，是因为当时我也在场！

即便把它特点鲜明的盾形车标挡住，我也能
从它宽大的车身设计分辨出来。
其短车尾凸出部分的圆形车尾灯让人回想起了经典车型TZ……

不过说实话……这才是纯正的Alfa Romeo！
Alfa Romeo的跑车车型多由意大利的
车身制造商和外观设计师操刀……

但这辆8C却并非如此。

它是由沃夫冈·埃格尔自己的设计部门——
Centro Stile Alfa Romeo所执笔设计。
turns.speaker: Hideo Kodama

turns.raw:
The DB3S is a smaller, lighter and more competitive version of the DB3, which lacked a fighting spirit.

Although it retired after 222 laps at Le Mans in 1953...

...it performed well at Silverstone and many other races.

See how the large front fenders stretch from the headlights to the cockpit and on to the voluminous rear?

This is similar to the MGA and AC Ace, as well as the Frazer Nash and Sebring.

That is, it was designed in the classic British style.
turns.en:
The DB3S is a smaller, lighter and more competitive version
of the DB3, which lacked a fighting spirit.
Although it retired after 222 laps at Le Mans in 1953...

...it performed well at Silverstone and many other races.
See how the large front fenders stretch from the headlights
to the cockpit and on to the voluminous rear?

This is similar to the MGA and AC Ace, as well as the
Frazer Nash and Sebring.

That is, it was designed in the classic British style.
turns.zh:
相比于略微欠缺战斗精神的DB3，这辆DB3S可以视作是一个较小较轻、
更偏重竞技的版本。
虽然它在1953年的勒芒只跑了222圈便遗憾退赛……

但在银石和其他赛事上却有上佳的表现。
你看到了吗？它的大号前挡泥板从车头灯一直连接到驾驶舱，
又延伸到宽大的车后部。

这种设计与MGA和AC Ace，以及Frazer Nash
和Sebring非常类似。

换句话说，就是经典的英式车身风格。
turns.speaker: Hideo Kodama

turns.raw:
The DB3S is a smaller, lighter and more competitive version of the DB3, which lacked a fighting spirit.

Although it retired after 222 laps at Le Mans in 1953...

...it performed well at Silverstone and many other races.

See how the large front fenders stretch from the headlights to the cockpit and on to the voluminous rear?

This is similar to the MGA and AC Ace, as well as the Frazer Nash and Sebring.

That is, it was designed in the classic British style.
turns.en:
The DB3S is a smaller, lighter and more competitive version
of the DB3, which lacked a fighting spirit.
Although it retired after 222 laps at Le Mans in 1953...

...it performed well at Silverstone and many other races.
See how the large front fenders stretch from the headlights
to the cockpit and on to the voluminous rear?

This is similar to the MGA and AC Ace, as well as the
Frazer Nash and Sebring.

That is, it was designed in the classic British style.
turns.zh:
相比于略微欠缺战斗精神的DB3，这辆DB3S可以视作是一个较小较轻、
更偏重竞技的版本。
虽然它在1953年的勒芒只跑了222圈便遗憾退赛……

但在银石和其他赛事上却有上佳的表现。
你看到了吗？它的大号前挡泥板从车头灯一直连接到驾驶舱，
又延伸到宽大的车后部。

这种设计与MGA和AC Ace，以及Frazer Nash
和Sebring非常类似。

换句话说，就是经典的英式车身风格。
turns.speaker: Hideo Kodama

turns.zh:

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf1Kodama_normal__911_carrera_rs_96_1702805
turns.raw:
You might say that Porsche is Volkswagen-inspired not only in the architecture of its cars but also their overall design…

Which is said to be owing to the genius of Erwin Komenda, Ferry Porsche’s right-hand engineer.

Yet it was Ferry’s son Butzi who would work this theme into the modern 911.

With headlamps set at the end of its elongated front wings...

A sloping rear, and elliptical side windows...

It is a basic example of the ‘Jaray-style.’Q
turns.en:
You might say that Porsche is Volkswagen-inspired not only
in the architecture of its cars but also their overall design…
Which is said to be owing to the genius of Erwin Komenda,
Ferry Porsche’s right-hand engineer.

Yet it was Ferry’s son Butzi who would work this theme
into the modern 911.
With headlamps set at the end of its elongated front wings...
A sloping rear, and elliptical side windows...

It is a basic example of the ‘Jaray-style.’Q
turns.zh:
很多人认为Porsche不仅在其汽车的架构上
受到Volkswagen的启发，整体设计理念方面也是如此……
并将之归功于艾尔文·柯曼达的天才头脑，
这位工程师同时也是费利·保时捷的得力助手。

但将这一设计理念真正融入到现代911车型中的
其实是费利的儿子（绰号“布奇”）。
在前翼子板顶端设置的头灯……
后溜背的车尾和椭圆形侧窗……

这些都是典型的“贾雷式气动设计”风格的体现。
turns.speaker: Hideo Kodama

which took inspiration from airplanes and airships.<next id=1702809 type=9>

贾雷因其流线型汽车设计而闻名，
而他的设计灵感来源于飞机和飞船。

这位工程师同时也是费利·保时捷的得力助手。

但将这一设计理念真正融入到现代911车型中的
其实是费利的儿子（绰号“布奇”）。
在前翼子板顶端设置的头灯……
后溜背的车尾和椭圆形侧窗……

这些都是典型的“贾雷式气动设计”风格的体现。
turns.speaker: Hideo Kodama
