turns.raw:
When I think of Renault-Alpine race cars, two that come to mind are the rally-bred A110...

...and the long-tailed M Series of Le Mans fame.

The Alpine A220 was built to comply with Group 6 regulations...

...introduced by FIA in 1968.

However, because the car was unable to produce satisfactory results at Le Mans, it was withdrawn from competition.

This model is the rally version, instantly recognizable by its truncated tail.\
turns.en:
When I think of Renault-Alpine race cars, two that come
to mind are the rally-bred A110...

...and the long-tailed M Series
of Le Mans fame.
The Alpine A220 was built to comply
with Group 6 regulations...

...introduced by FIA in 1968.
However, because the car was unable to produce satisfactory
results at Le Mans, it was withdrawn from competition.
This model is the rally version, instantly recognizable by
its truncated tail.\
turns.zh:
说到Renault-Alpine赛车时，我脑海中浮现的两款车
分别是拉力赛出身的A110……

以及剑指勒芒耐力赛的长尾M系列。
Alpine A220是为了符合1968年
FIA引入的Group 6规则

而制造的。
然而，由于未能在勒芒取得令人满意的成绩，
它很快退出了争夺。
我们眼前的这款是拉力赛版本，从它被截短的尾部
就可以看出。
turns.speaker: Hideo Kodama

turns.raw:
The door section without a character line, and the simple side proportions are really classic.

Then there are the covered headlights that came from the DB5 reflecting the fashion at the time.

The tail fin-like design of the rear end is quite American in style...

But then this was an era where Italian design was influenced by American motorcars.

It's this classic feel combined with modern details that give the DB5 its character.

It really is one of the most unique cars from the DB series.

Of course it became famous because of James Bond, but it remains a classic in its own right.�
turns.en:
The door section without a character line, and the
simple side proportions are really classic.
Then there are the covered headlights that came from
the DB5 reflecting the fashion at the time.
The tail fin-like design of the rear end
is quite American in style...

But then this was an era where Italian design was
influenced by American motorcars.
It's this classic feel combined with modern
details that give the DB5 its character.

It really is one of the most unique cars from the
DB series.

Of course it became famous because of James Bond,
but it remains a classic in its own right.
turns.zh:
车门的部分没有特征明显的分界线，简洁的侧面也十分
经典。
从DB5开始引入的包覆式头灯在当时蔚然成风，体现了当
时的潮流。

turns.raw:
This is a great-looking car. It remains one of the more popular models in Gran Turismo.

The R34 Skyline.

It was developed with a clear intent—to create a sports sedan that could serve as the foundation for the GT-R.

In the late 1990s, building a 4-door sedan with limited rear cabin space was far from conventional.

Yet that very approach helped define the R34’s character, and it went on to become one of the most iconic GT-R-based models.

It was fast and strikingly designed.

Even in race-prepared form, it still exudes that unmistakable R34 presence.0

In the late 1990s, building a 4-door sedan with limited rear
cabin space was far from conventional.
Yet that very approach helped define the R34’s character, and it

It was fast and strikingly designed.

turns.zh:
这辆车的外形很不错。
我认为它是Gran Turismo当中比较受欢迎的一款R34 Skyline……

我认为这是一款由开发者创造的、开发意图十分明确的汽车，
目的是制造出一款能作为GT-R基础的运动型轿车。
在20世纪90年代末，
考虑制造一辆后座空间有限的四门轿车显然不是正常的思路。
但最终，R34成为了即使在GT-R历史上也最为耀眼的明星。
这也是它甚至到了现在也备受众人欢迎的原因。

即使变成了如今的赛车模样，
它仍然非常有R34的感觉。

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf2Nakamura_normal_fairlady_z_s_07_1800305
turns.raw:
The main role of the Z33, introduced in 2001, was to resurrect the Z, and serve as a symbol of the revival of Nissan itself.

Therefore, it was a car that had to succeed.

Because the Z has been a defining symbol for Nissan through the years, it naturally embraced the design heritage of the company.

That said, we couldn't give it a retro look.

We needed to retain the essence and spirit of notable Nissans of the past...

...while giving it a thoroughly modern character.

The inspiration for the car's design language was the S30 and the CSP first-generation Silvia.

And, it may be difficult to notice, but there are hints of the SP Fairlady in the body section.

All of this made the Z33 more modern and possess different proportions than the S30...

...but I feel it's still instantly recognizable as a Z from any angle.
turns.en:

turns.zh:
Z33于2001年首次亮相，
它的使命是复活Z系列，并成为日产复兴的象征。

因此，这是一款不许失败的汽车。
作为日产的代表车型，Z33必须体现出公司的设计传统……

但又不能太“复古”。
因此，我们必须保留过去成就的精髓和精神……

再以完善的现代特征进行展现。
它的设计语言可以追溯到S30和第一代Silvia CSP。

而且，容易被人忽略的一个点是
——其车身部分还有些Fairlady SP的影子。
这些设计元素都使得Z33在比例和主题方面较S30更加现代。

但你还是一眼就能看出，这是一辆Z系车。
turns.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

turns.raw:
The main role of the Z33, introduced in 2001, was to resurrect the Z, and serve as a symbol of the revival of Nissan itself.

Therefore, it was a car that had to succeed.

Because the Z has been a defining symbol for Nissan through the years, it naturally embraced the design heritage of the company.

That said, we couldn't give it a retro look.

We needed to retain the essence and spirit of notable Nissans of the past...

...while giving it a thoroughly modern character.

The inspiration for the car's design language was the S30 and the CSP first-generation Silvia.

And, it may be difficult to notice, but there are hints of the SP Fairlady in the body section.

All of this made the Z33 more modern and possess different proportions than the S30...

...but I feel it's still instantly recognizable as a Z from any angle.

turns.zh:
Z33于2001年首次亮相，
它的使命是复活Z系列，并成为日产复兴的象征。

因此，这是一款不许失败的汽车。
作为日产的代表车型，Z33必须体现出公司的设计传统……

但又不能太“复古”。
因此，我们必须保留过去成就的精髓和精神……

再以完善的现代特征进行展现。
它的设计语言可以追溯到S30和第一代Silvia CSP。

而且，容易被人忽略的一个点是
——其车身部分还有些Fairlady SP的影子。
这些设计元素都使得Z33在比例和主题方面较S30更加现代。

但你还是一眼就能看出，这是一辆Z系车。

turns.raw:
In some ways, the Z34 is more classic in overall styling than the Z33.

The wheelbase has been shortened by <100mm>...

...giving it long-nose proportions.

The shape of the roof, and the window graphics with the peak at the very front...

...also adopt the S30's design basic theme.

In contrast, the massive rear fender that squeezes the shape of the body from front to rear...

...aims to ithis car a level of aggressiveness never before seen on a Z.

There were challenges on how to evolve the Z33's styling.

If the Z33 represented a modern and more elegant design theme...

...then the Z34's look is one that's a more authentic of an FR sports car with added aggressiveness.2

than the Z33.
The wheelbase has been shortened by 100mm...

and the window graphics with the peak at the very front...

turns.zh:
从设计上看，Z34比Z33的外观更回归经典。
首先，轴距缩短了100mm……

显得车头相对更长。

其车顶的形状以及最前面的车窗贴花……

则特意延续了S30的设计风格。
相比之下，巨大的后挡泥板让车身的重心从前向后挪……

令它看上去更具有攻击性。
这是之前的Z系列中所罕见的。
当然了，对Z33的外型进行迭代并非易事。

简而言之，如果Z33给人以现代的优雅感……

Z34则更像是一款地道的前置后驱跑车，
而且更具攻击性。
turns.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

turns.raw:
I love this car, and it's easily one of my top three all time.

Based on sketches by Ford designers...

...you get the feeling that its appearance was brought together by British designers...

...who knew how racecars should look and perform.

When compared to the Ferrari 330P4 of the same year...

...the overall shape of the GT40 is emotionally modest, while characterized by a more modern silhouette.

They're both nice, but I think I prefer the GT40.

The face created by the square headlamps and air intakes, which are rare in racecars...

...is aggressive and stylish.

But there's a rather elegant, feminine quality within the car's overall muscular nature...

...expressed by the line that runs from the cabin to the rear end.

Although it hasn't been mentioned much before, but there's a quality not unlike that of the Lamborghini Miura her�.

The Mark II added air intakes, which gave the car even more racecar intensity.

It's this part of the car that I find very alluring.z

我喜欢这辆车。
如果要排名的话，它能轻松跻身我个人喜好排行榜的前三。

此车是由一支来自英国的团队

基于福特设计师的草图打造的……

看得出来，他们对赛车的外观和性能胸有成竹。
与同年的法拉利330 P4相比……

GT40可能欠缺一些激情，但有着更具现代感的轮廓。

turns.en:
A car that expresses this much strength and beauty
in its appearance...

...is quite revolutionary in the history of car design.

It's a design that you simply cannot imitate.

It's a design that goes beyond something that's simply beautiful,
that's what I find most alluring.

It possesses both a futuristic design theme,
a signature element of Gandini's...

...and styling that truly is car-like. The Stratos is a car that
is defined by both.
turns.zh:
你无法想象一辆汽车究竟是如何表现出这种程度的
力量和美感的。

这是革命性的一台车，

是一个无法被模仿的设计，

更是超越了单纯美学的设计。
我认为这就是其魅力所在。

它既拥有甘迪尼标志性的未来主义设计……

又没有忘记其本源。
确切地说，这辆Stratos是一辆跨越两个世界的车。
turns.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

for Carrozzeria Bertone.

turns.zh:
马塞罗·甘迪尼是位来自意大利的传奇设计师，

是Carrozzeria Bertone公司的首席设计师。

Countach和Stratos都是出自这位世界闻名的设计师之手。
turns.speaker: Sarah

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf2Nakamura_normal__stratos_73_1800609
turns.raw:
I'm totally taken with the wraparound cabin and the flawless balance of the low body.

From just its presence, you can almost hear the car's exhaust note, right?

I've seen Gandini's original sketch of the car...

...while the design theme is the same, I was surprised in the difference of the ambience.

In fact, "car design" is something that can't be accomplished by just one person.

The collaboration of engineers, who are themselves craftsmen, and modelers is essential.

In those terms...

...I think it's correct in saying that the Stratos is "Bertone designed."

I would seriously love to add this car to my collection, but it has become too expensive.G
turns.en:
I'm totally taken with the wraparound cabin
and the flawless balance of the low body.

From just its presence,
you can almost hear the car's exhaust note, right?
I've seen Gandini's original sketch of the car...

...while the design theme is the same,
I was surprised in the difference of the ambience.
In fact, "car design" is something that can't
be accomplished by just one person.

The collaboration of engineers, who are themselves
craftsmen, and modelers is essential.

In those terms...

...I think it's correct in saying that
the Stratos is "Bertone designed."
I would seriously love to add this car to my collection,
but it has become too expensive.
turns.zh:
我完全被这辆车的环绕式座舱和其低矮车身的
完美平衡给折服了。

你仔细听，是不是几乎听不到它的排气声？
我看过甘迪尼为这辆车创作的设计草图原稿。

虽然设计主题相同，但传达的情绪感受却明显不同。
事实上，“汽车设计”并不是一个人就能完成的作品。

它需要工程技师和模型师之间的通力合作。

因此……

我觉得更准确的说法应该是——
Stratos由“博通设计打造”。
我是真的很想把这辆车纳入我的收藏，
不过恐怕它现在已经是我负担不起的天价了。<
turns.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

A car that expresses this much strength and beauty
in its appearance...

...is quite revolutionary in the history of car design.

It's a design that you simply cannot imitate.

It's a design that goes beyond something that's simply beautiful,
that's what I find most alluring.

It possesses both a futuristic design theme,
a signature element of Gandini's...

...and styling that truly is car-like. The Stratos is a car that
is defined by both.
turns.zh:
你无法想象一辆汽车究竟是如何表现出这种程度的
力量和美感的。

这是革命性的一台车，

是一个无法被模仿的设计，

更是超越了单纯美学的设计。
我认为这就是其魅力所在。

它既拥有甘迪尼标志性的未来主义设计……

又没有忘记其本源。
确切地说，这辆Stratos是一辆跨越两个世界的车。

This front design was actually...

...a reproduction of the GT-R Proto that we displayed at the 2005 Tokyo Motor Show.

We felt that the graphic theme of the GT-R Proto might be a bit too aggressive for a car making its first ever appearance...

turns.raw:
Look at the tight cabin and the position of the rear engine. It's stunning.

The front fascia is particularly eye-catching.

The ridge that runs down the hood...

...really provides the vehicle with a unique feel.

It's so very French.

But then, it has large fog lamps for rallying...

...and air scoops at the rear have been flawlessly incorporated.

These details that suggest it's a competition vehicle give it its exquisite character.

In terms of design, there are places where the balance is not good, but when seeing the car up close, you don't mind at all.

In fact, it's those things that give this car visual impact.

This type of visual allure, you can't achieve in today's cars.

This car is a true masterpiece, one that I would love to add to my collection.t

turns.zh:
这辆车确实令人叹为观止，请关注紧凑的车厢和
后置引擎的位置。
从正前方看时尤其如此，

因为沿着引擎盖向下延伸的中脊线很有时尚感。

我觉得它非常有“法式风情”。

不过，它同时还配备了用于拉力赛的大雾灯……
以及精心布置的进气口。

这些赛车的美学设计都为它赋予了精致的特征。
从设计角度来看，有些部件似乎不那么平衡，
但凑近看时不仅不会让人这么觉得，

甚至是为这辆车带来了某种视觉冲击感。

它的许多设计在现今的汽车中确实已经不多见了。

这是一项真正的大师之作，我很想把它纳入我的收藏。
turns.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

turns.raw:
This is a masterpiece of Japanese car design.

To be honest, the S30 was developed as a hatchback coupe, rather than a sports car.

There's plenty of cabin space.

Overall headroom is generous for a pure sports car.

Still, it looks very sporty, meaning it is a very special design.

Take the proportion, line, and surface...

...in many ways, the design of this car says "it can only be done this way."

But what is most impressive is...

...is its purity. It exudes a high sense of Japanese beauty.

The look of the nose is modern.

It's a design that's distinctly Japanese, unlike any other car from the U.S. or Europe.

The S30 is unmistakably a design that represents Japan.

From the latter half of the 1960s and on, more than a few amazing sports-car designs were created in Japan.

In that day, there were man� motivated and talented young designers inside Japanese car companies.

They borrowed the best parts of Western design elements, while keeping their own unique character.

I pay respect to the achievements of all of them, especially Yoshihiko Matsuo-san, who recently passed away.�

turns.zh:
这辆车可是日本汽车设计的杰作之一！

严格来讲，S30是作为一款掀背式双门轿跑车开发的，
而不是一款跑车。
如你所见，这辆车的车厢空间很大……

而且与纯粹的跑车相比，头顶空间更富裕。

不过，得益于其卓越的设计，它看起来还是动力十足。
此车的一切——车身比例、线条和外观表面……

无不彰显着“纯正”二字。

但最为出众的……

还是其体现着日式设计美学的优雅和精致。
以其现代化的车头设计为例。

与美式或欧洲的设计都不相同，极具日本车特色。
S30就是一台纯粹的日系车。

从六十年代晚期开始，日本设计出了无数台跑车杰作。

当时的日本汽车公司汇聚了许多位
热忱且有才华的年轻设计�3。
他们从西方设计中汲取精华，
但又保留了自己独特的感受力。

这些设计师都值得我们尊敬。
尤其值得一提的一位，便是最近去世的松尾良彦。
turns.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

如你所见，这辆车的车厢空间很大……

而且与纯粹的跑车相比，头顶空间更富裕。

不过，得益于其卓越的设计，它看起来还是动力十足。
此车的一切——车身比例、线条和外观表面……

无不彰显着“纯正”二字。

但最为出众的……

还是其体现着日式设计美学的优雅和精致。
以其现代化的车头设计为例。

与美式或欧洲的设计都不相同，极具日本车特色。
S30就是一台纯粹的日系车。

从六十年代晚期开始，日本设计出了无数台跑车杰作。

当时的日本汽车公司汇聚了许多位
热忱且有才华的年轻设计�3。
他们从西方设计中汲取精华，
但又保留了自己独特的感受力。

这些设计师都值得我们尊敬。
尤其值得一提的一位，便是最近去世的松尾良彦。
turns.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

turns.raw:
There never was a more stylish and sleek thoroughbred than the 330 P4.

Not before or since.

It may have been built for racing, but it doesn't feel like ‘winning’ was the absolute objective.

You could say that it is the ultimate expression of a style that goes back to the 250 P of the ‘60s.

In terms of design, the fender lines and surfaces are very expressive...

Giving it its Italian flavour.

After the 330 P4, Ferrari racers went a bit dry, prioritising performance and function.

Indeed, this masterpiece comes from an era when race cars were still works of art.
turns.en:
There never was a more stylish and sleek
thoroughbred than the 330 P4.

Not before or since.
It may have been built for racing, but it doesn't feel
like ‘winning’ was the absolute objective.

You could say that it is the ultimate expression of
a style that goes back to the 250 P of the ‘60s.
In terms of design, the fender lines and surfaces
are very expressive...

Giving it its Italian flavour.
After the 330 P4, Ferrari racers went a bit dry,
prioritising performance and function.

Indeed, this masterpiece comes from an era when race cars
were still works of art.
turns.zh:
我的观点是，330 P4是最时尚、最具魅力的纯血赛车，

前无古人，后无来者。
尽管这辆车是严格按照竞赛标准设计的，
但如果你只看外观，赢得比赛似乎并不是它的最高设计准则。

可以说330 P4就是Ferrari在1960年代
中置引擎赛车设计的终极体现。
从设计美学的角度分析，它的侧面线条和轮廓
既流畅，又充满力量感……

……呈现出独有的意大利风貌。
在它之后，就连Ferrari的赛车都开始变得
不那么重视美感，而是将优先级放在性能和功能上。

这款杰作代表了那个赛车也可以很美的时代。
turns.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

turns.raw:
This car really shows off its proportional balance.

Aside from the retrofitted detail parts, I feel that it is an elegant looking car.

Design elements such as the retractable headlamps...

...the area around the rear where the glass hatch blacks out the B-pillar...

...they seem to be a response to cars in the American market at the time.

Looking at it now, it lacks boldness, but it's a look that exudes positive emotions.
turns.en:
This car really shows off its proportional balance.

Aside from the retrofitted detail parts,
I feel that it is an elegant looking car.
Design elements such as the retractable headlamps...

...the area around the rear where the glass hatch blacks out the
B-pillar...

...they seem to be a response to cars in the American market
at the time.
Looking at it now, it lacks boldness,
but it's a look that exudes positive emotions.
turns.zh:
这辆车淋漓尽致地展现了设计师对车身比例均衡的把握。

这辆车的车身细节部件进行了全面的翻新升级，
给人以优雅的印象。
其他的一些设计元素，例如上翻式车头灯……

……玻璃后背和B柱的衔接……

……似乎都是为了响应当时美国市场的需求。
现在看来，这种设计欠缺些魄力，
不过的确传达出积极求变的信息。
turns.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

This car really shows off its proportional balance.

Aside from the retrofitted detail parts, I feel that it is an elegant looking car.

Design elements such as the retractable headlamps...

...the area around the rear where the glass hatch blacks out the B-pillar...

turns.zh:
这辆车淋漓尽致地展现了设计师对车身比例均衡的把握。

这辆车的车身细节部件进行了全面的翻新升级，
给人以优雅的印象。
其他的一些设计元素，例如上翻式车头灯……

……玻璃后背和B柱的衔接……

……似乎都是为了响应当时美国市场的需求。
现在看来，这种设计欠缺些魄力，
不过的确传达出积极求变的信息。
turns.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf2Nakamura_normal_kpgc10_skyline_gtr_70_1801205
turns.raw:
This is the original GT-R, a sports coupe Japan proudly offered to the world in the 1960s.

It has the famous "Surfin' Line" as the disctinct design feature, but the other parts are also well executed.

Despite being passenger car-based, its proportions are rather sporty, and the main design theme is powerful yet simple.

It's an excellent design with a bit of American-car flavor, from the solid door sections to the overall sense of volume.

But it does lack the four round taillights.

When we were designing the R35 GT-R, we were, of course, inspired by the Hakosuka's overall ambience and details.

In truth, a key thing about traditional GT-Rs is that they aren’t fastbacks, but are shaped by the C Pillar.

At first glance, the R35 may look like a fastback...

...but you'll notice that when compared to the KPGC, the window line of the Pillar is set at the same angle.h
turns.en:
This is the original GT-R, a sports coupe
Japan proudly offered to the world in the 1960s.
It has the famous "Surfin' Line" as the disctinct design feature,
but the other parts are also well executed.

Despite being passenger car-based, its proportions are rather
sporty, and the main design theme is powerful yet simple.

It's an excellent design with a bit of American-car flavor, from
the solid door sections to the overall sense of volume.
But it does lack the four round taillights.

When we were designing the R35 GT-R, we were, of course,
inspired by the Hakosuka's overall ambience and details.

In truth, a key thing about traditional GT-Rs is that they
aren’t fastbacks, but are shaped by the C Pillar.
At first glance, the R35 may look like a fastback...

...but you'll notice that when compared to the KPGC,
the window line of the Pillar is set at the same angle.
turns.zh:
这辆初代GT-R是日本在1960年代
呈现给全世界的骄傲——一台双门跑车。
久负盛名的“冲浪线条”是它的专属特色。
当然，其他部位的设计也同样可圈可点。

首先，原车型的定位是轿车，但GT-R将车身比例改得更偏向运动。
其主要的设计主旨就是“简单但性能强大”。

从方正、结实的车门到整车的廓形，
这款杰出的设计里
多少带着一些美国车的影子。
唯一缺少的，是后续车型中加入的四盏标志性圆形车尾灯。

我们在设计R35 GT-R的时候，从Hakosuka的
整体氛围和细节上汲取了不少灵感。

事实上，有个重要设计点值得一提——GT-R并没有采用溜背设计，
溜背的视觉效果来自于直接与下部车身相接的C柱。
粗看之下，R35很像是一台溜背车……

�;�…但与KPGC进行比较之后你就会发现
两者C柱窗户的线条呈现的角度其实是一模一样的。
turns.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

This is the original GT-R, a sports coupe Japan proudly offered to the world in the 1960s.

It has the famous "Surfin' Line" as the disctinct design feature, but the other parts are also well executed.

Despite being passenger car-based, its proportions are rather sporty, and the main design theme is powerful yet simple.

It's an excellent design with a bit of American-car flavor, from the solid door sections to the overall sense of volume.

But it does lack the four round taillights.

When we were designing the R35 GT-R, we were, of course, inspired by the Hakosuka's overall ambience and details.

In truth, a key thing about traditional GT-Rs is that they aren’t fastbacks, but are shaped by the C Pillar.

At first glance, the R35 may look like a fastback...

...but you'll notice that when compared to the KPGC, the window line of the Pillar is set at the same angle.h
turns.en:
This is the original GT-R, a sports coupe
Japan proudly offered to the world in the 1960s.
It has the famous "Surfin' Line" as the disctinct design feature,
but the other parts are also well executed.

Despite being passenger car-based, its proportions are rather
sporty, and the main design theme is powerful yet simple.

It's an excellent design with a bit of American-car flavor, from
the solid door sections to the overall sense of volume.
But it does lack the four round taillights.

When we were designing the R35 GT-R, we were, of course,
inspired by the Hakosuka's overall ambience and details.

In truth, a key thing about traditional GT-Rs is that they
aren’t fastbacks, but are shaped by the C Pillar.
At first glance, the R35 may look like a fastback...

...but you'll notice that when compared to the KPGC,
the window line of the Pillar is set at the same angle.
turns.zh:
这辆初代GT-R是日本在1960年代
呈现给全世界的骄傲——一台双门跑车。
久负盛名的“冲浪线条”是它的专属特色。
当然，其他部位的设计也同样可圈可点。

首先，原车型的定位是轿车，但GT-R将车身比例改得更偏向运动。
其主要的设计主旨就是“简单但性能强大”。

从方正、结实的车门到整车的廓形，
这款杰出的设计里
多少带着一些美国车的影子。
唯一缺少的，是后续车型中加入的四盏标志性圆形车尾灯。

我们在设计R35 GT-R的时候，从Hakosuka的
整体氛围和细节上汲取了不少灵感。

事实上，有个重要设计点值得一提——GT-R并没有采用溜背设计，
溜背的视觉效果来自于直接与下部车身相接的C柱。
粗看之下，R35很像是一台溜背车……

�;�…但与KPGC进行比较之后你就会发现
两者C柱窗户的线条呈现的角度其实是一模一样的。
turns.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

turns.raw:
When Mr. Yamauchi approached me about the Vision Gran Turismo project...

...it was when we were exploring the design strategy of next-gen Infiniti models.

This design came from Infiniti's Beijing studio, which had just been established.

One of our young designers took the initiative and completed this in a short time.

There's some simplicity in the details of the design, but that, in turn, is what makes it so alluring.

For example, where the A-pillar seems to float from the cabin, the resulting form here conveys lots of emotion.

Because its improvisational in nature, it has a strong design feel to it.

Of course, this car was designed strategically employing Infiniti's form language.

Therefore, it effectively links to the production Infiniti cars that came afterwards.t

当山内一典先生找我聊跑车浪漫旅愿景项目时……

……我们正在思考下一代车型应当采用什么样的设计策略。

这款设计来自于刚成立不久的英菲尼迪北京工作室。

团队的一名年轻设计师自告奋勇，
在很短时间内就完成了设计。

它的设计大繁至简，反而为这台车平添了一份魅力。
比如，A柱看上去像是游离在车厢之上，
整车造型更是传递出了强烈的冲动与激情。
因为本质上是即兴创作，所以给人以强烈的设计感，

但它在造型设计语言方面与品牌的血统一脉相承，

更为后续推出的英菲尼迪量产车型留下了许多启发。
turns.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

turns.raw:
The styling of this car is a continuation of the BMW 2002 and represents

the last 3 Series with BMW's traditional design language.

It looks as if the designers employed obvious themes and executed them in an obvious manner, but the car still looks good.

For example, one thing that makes this design effective is...

...the front overhang when viewed from the rear-quarter angle.

It's almost non-existent. You can hardly see it.

Both the engineers and designers understood the importance of proportions.

This design can only happen when planned from the early stages.

It may look simple, but it's not so easily accomplished on a mass-produced vehicle..

turns.raw:
Do you remember the DeltaWing that raced in the 2014 24 Hours of Le Mans?

This car inherits the spirit of that machine.

It was developed with a truly original idea, one that sort of went over the heads of normal folks.

This front-engine/front-drive car gave designer and engineer Ben Bowlby the freedom to realize his vision without compromise.

And it ended up taking this honest shape. I like it.

The proportions are uniqiue and the overall design is well-executed, espeically the rear-quarter.

This wasn't exactly a race version of the GT-R, but after talking things over with Ben...

...he gave it a Vmotion grille and four round taillights, details that gave the DeltaWing some Nissan GT-R flavor.

Unfortunately, the car failed to produce any results at Le Mans, and it was discontinued after a year.�
turns.en:
Do you remember the DeltaWing that raced in the
2014 24 Hours of Le Mans?

This car inherits the spirit of that machine.

It was developed with a truly original idea,
one that sort of went over the heads of normal folks.
This front-engine/front-drive car gave designer and engineer Ben
Bowlby the freedom to realize his vision without compromise.

And it ended up taking this honest shape. I like it.
The proportions are uniqiue and the overall design is well-executed,
espeically the rear-quarter.

This wasn't exactly a race version of the GT-R, but
after talking things over with Ben...

...he gave it a Vmotion grille and four round taillights,
details that gave the DeltaWing some Nissan GT-R flavor.
Unfortunately, the car failed to produce any results at Le Mans,
and it was discontinued after a year.
turns.zh:
你们记得三角翼吗？
参加过2014年勒芒24小时耐力赛的三角翼？

这辆车就是它的精神继承者。

它运用了完全原创的设计思路，
而且可能有些超出普通人的理解范畴。
我的意思是，这是一辆前置前驱车。设计师兼工程师
本·鲍尔比在打造它的过程中获得了充分的自由。

其结果就是这种朴实无华的外形。
我个人觉得很喜欢。
它的比例非常特殊。但效果非常棒，你不觉得呢？
它从侧后方的观赏角度看上去特别震撼。

严格意义上说，它不能算是GT-R的赛车版本，
不过在本和我的通力合作下，

为这款车安装了V动感前格栅，而在其后部，
我们也安装了四盏圆形尾灯。这些细节为它增加了日产GT-R的风味。
遗憾的是，这辆车在勒芒未能有所斩�，在一年后便停产了。

turns.raw:
The Nissan Concept 2020 VGT gave us the great opportunity...

...to freely express the design vision of the Nissan brand.

This styling theme here was created by our London studio in a short time. It's overflowing with energy, don't you think?

This car wasn't particularly based on a specific model, but we gave our young designers complete freedom to shape this car.

And yes, it seems that they all had the future GT-R in mind.

Most anyone can tell that the design was inspired by the GT-R by simply looking at the greenhouse and taillights, right?

The balance of the proportions suggests not a mid-engine car or a long-nose FR machine,

but that of a front mid-engine 4WD car.

While this car is purely a design study...

...the front bumper and details of the rear end are related to that of the 2017 GT-R.�
turns.en:
The Nissan Concept 2020 VGT gave us the great opportunity...

...to freely express the design vision of the Nissan brand.

This styling theme here was created by our London studio
in a short time. It's overflowing with energy, don't you think?

This car wasn't particularly based on a specific model, but we
gave our young designers complete freedom to shape this car.
And yes, it seems that they all had the future GT-R in mind.

Most anyone can tell that the design was inspired by the GT-R
by simply looking at the greenhouse and taillights, right?
The balance of the proportions suggests
not a mid-engine car or a long-nose FR machine,

but that of a front mid-engine 4WD car.
While this car is purely a design study...

...the front bumper and details of the rear end
are related to that of the 2017 GT-R.
turns.zh:
日产Concept 2020 Vision Gran Turismo给了我们一个前所未有的机会……

……让我们可以无拘无束地展现我们对于日产品牌的愿景。

这款车的风格定调是由我们的伦敦工作室在很短的时间内
完成的。你是不是也能感觉到其中充满了流动的能量？

这款车并不是基于某款GT-R车型设计的命题作文，我们
给了年轻设计师们绝对的自由，可以随心所欲地打造这辆车。
而从结果看，他们心中都有各自对于GT-R未来的畅想。

如果单看车身侧面和车尾灯，
很容易就能辨认出其中的GT-R元素，对吧？
还有从车身比例就能看出，它不是什么中置引擎
，也不是长车鼻的前置后驱车，

而是一款前中置引擎四驱车款。
尽管这款车只是一项设计课题……

……但前保险杠^��后部的部分细节
与2017款GT-R有着密切的联系。
turns.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

...the front bumper and details of the rear end are related to that of the 2017 GT-R.�
turns.en:
The Nissan Concept 2020 VGT gave us the great opportunity...

...to freely express the design vision of the Nissan brand.

This styling theme here was created by our London studio
in a short time. It's overflowing with energy, don't you think?

This car wasn't particularly based on a specific model, but we
gave our young designers complete freedom to shape this car.
And yes, it seems that they all had the future GT-R in mind.

Most anyone can tell that the design was inspired by the GT-R
by simply looking at the greenhouse and taillights, right?
The balance of the proportions suggests
not a mid-engine car or a long-nose FR machine,

but that of a front mid-engine 4WD car.
While this car is purely a design study...

...the front bumper and details of the rear end
are related to that of the 2017 GT-R.
turns.zh:
日产Concept 2020 Vision Gran Turismo给了我们一个前所未有的机会……

……让我们可以无拘无束地展现我们对于日产品牌的愿景。

这款车的风格定调是由我们的伦敦工作室在很短的时间内
完成的。你是不是也能感觉到其中充满了流动的能量？

这款车并不是基于某款GT-R车型设计的命题作文，我们
给了年轻设计师们绝对的自由，可以随心所欲地打造这辆车。
而从结果看，他们心中都有各自对于GT-R未来的畅想。

如果单看车身侧面和车尾灯，
很容易就能辨认出其中的GT-R元素，对吧？
还有从车身比例就能看出，它不是什么中置引擎
，也不是长车鼻的前置后驱车，

而是一款前中置引擎四驱车款。
尽管这款车只是一项设计课题……

……但前保险杠^��后部的部分细节
与2017款GT-R有着密切的联系。

At the risk of sounding crass by compliment our own designs...

...I always felt that the GT-R in the Super GT Series was "oh so cool" when watching it in races.

The racecar is modified by NISMO every year...

...and the original image of the GT-R is carefully retained in the grille and the shape of the lights.

When watching a race, it's important to be able to recognize a car when seeing it from a distance.

For that to happen, the front and rear of the base production car must be distinctive.

Also, while race cars may be modified for aerodynamics, GT regulations prohibit changes to the cabin.

In fact, when I was watching a GT race at Suzuka...

...I said to myself, "The racecars painted in their sponsor colors all look the same."　

That's when I decided that the shape of the R35 GT-R's cabin must ab�olutely remain distinctive!n
turns.en:
At the risk of sounding crass by compliment our own designs...

"oh so cool" when watching it in races.

the grille and the shape of the lights.

When watching a race, it's important to be able to
recognize a car when seeing it from a distance.
For that to happen, the front and rear of
the base production car must be distinctive.
Also, while race cars may be modified for aerodynamics,
GT regulations prohibit changes to the cabin.
In fact, when I was watching a GT race at Suzuka...

...I said to myself, "The racecars painted in their
sponsor colors all look the same."　

That's when I decided that the shape of
the R35 GT-R's cabin must ab�olutely remain distinctive!
turns.zh:
虽然这样说感觉像是在自卖自夸……

……不过我坚信当你在Super GT系列赛中
看到这辆GT-R时，你一定会觉得“哇，太酷了”。
每年，我们都会将赛车交由NISMO进行改装……

……而GT-R原本的外观，如格栅和车灯形状等
都精心地保留了下来。

我认为在观看比赛时，能让观众远远地
就把赛车辨认出来很有必要。
要达到这个目标，
基础量产车的前后外观必须要有独到之处。
为了增强空气动力学性能，赛车的车身通常会接受
大量的改装，但GT系列赛又规定

驾驶舱必须与原版量产车保持一致。
我过去在铃鹿赛道观看超跑比赛的时候……

……就觉得“除了赞助商的涂装，这些赛车
看上去都一个样。”

所以，我才会在S��计R35 GT-R的时候赋予驾驶舱独特的风格！
turns.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

turns.raw:
When comparing it to the classic design of its predecessor...

...the 250 GTO adopted a longer nose, lower stance, and a "coda tronca" rear.

Thus, it was designed with aerodynamics strongly in mind.

The front and rear fenders give the car a great sense of energy and vigor.

The view from the rear-quarter angle is just exquisite.

The car's distinguishing features include...

The three air intakes on the hood and air outlets on the fenders.

In staying true to Ferrari’s established design language, while adapting to the rigors of racing...

...the 250 GTO achieved a rare and remarkable equilibrium.

It is precisely this harmony that has made it one of the more popular Ferrari cars ever created.J
turns.en:
When comparing it to the classic design of its predecessor...

...the 250 GTO adopted a longer nose, lower stance,
 and a "coda tronca" rear.
Thus, it was designed with aerodynamics strongly in mind.

The front and rear fenders give the car a great sense
of energy and vigor.

The view from the rear-quarter angle is just exquisite.
The car's distinguishing features include...

The three air intakes on the hood and air outlets
on the fenders.
In staying true to Ferrari’s established design language,
while adapting to the rigors of racing...

...the 250 GTO achieved a rare and remarkable equilibrium.

It is precisely this harmony that has made it one of
the more popular Ferrari cars ever created.
turns.zh:
与之前的经典短轴距车型相比……

250 GTO不仅采用了更长的车鼻，压低了车身高度，还引入了
被称为断尾的后部设计。
在设计时，空气动力学性能也是其重点考量。

宽大的前后挡泥板营造出了
无与伦比的动感氛围。

从侧后方角度看过去，特别华贵高雅。
无论是引擎盖正前方的三个进气口，
还是后保险杠上突出的排气管，

都让人记忆犹新。
可以说，250 GTO的设计既保留了法拉利的底蕴，
又满足了赛车运动的需求……

实现了难能可贵的平衡。

也正是这份平衡感让这款经典法拉利车型充满魅力，
人气爆棚。
turns.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf2Nakamura_normal__250_gto_62_1801909
turns.raw:
When comparing it to the classic design of its predecessor...

...the 250 GTO adopted a longer nose, lower stance, and a "coda tronca" rear.

Thus, it was designed with aerodynamics strongly in mind.

The front and rear fenders give the car a great sense of energy and vigor.

The view from the rear-quarter angle is just exquisite.

The car's distinguishing features include...

The three air intakes on the hood and air outlets on the fenders.

In staying true to Ferrari’s established design language, while adapting to the rigors of racing...

...the 250 GTO achieved a rare and remarkable equilibrium.

It is precisely this harmony that has made it one of the more popular Ferrari cars ever created.J
turns.en:
When comparing it to the classic design of its predecessor...

...the 250 GTO adopted a longer nose, lower stance,
 and a "coda tronca" rear.
Thus, it was designed with aerodynamics strongly in mind.

The front and rear fenders give the car a great sense
of energy and vigor.

The view from the rear-quarter angle is just exquisite.
The car's distinguishing features include...

The three air intakes on the hood and air outlets
on the fenders.
In staying true to Ferrari’s established design language,
while adapting to the rigors of racing...

...the 250 GTO achieved a rare and remarkable equilibrium.

It is precisely this harmony that has made it one of
the more popular Ferrari cars ever created.
turns.zh:
与之前的经典短轴距车型相比……

250 GTO不仅采用了更长的车鼻，压低了车身高度，还引入了
被称为断尾的后部设计。
在设计时，空气动力学性能也是其重点考量。

宽大的前后挡泥板营造出了
无与伦比的动感氛围。

从侧后方角度看过去，特别华贵高雅。
无论是引擎盖正前方的三个进气口，
还是后保险杠上突出的排气管，

都让人记忆犹新。
可以说，250 GTO的设计既保留了法拉利的底蕴，
又满足了赛车运动的需求……

实现了难能可贵的平衡。

也正是这份平衡感让这款经典法拉利车型充满魅力，
人气爆棚。
turns.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

<sseq scmd="GTCafe_Conv_Standard01">This design is by Tom Tjaarda during his Ghia years.<p/>

The Pantera is indeed one of his signature creations, but
I personally feel that for a supercar, it's a bit reserved.<next id=1802106 type=9>
turns.en:
This design is by Tom Tjaarda during his Ghia years.

His specialty is designing elegant lightweight cars.

The Pantera is indeed one of his signature creations, but
I personally feel that for a supercar, it's a bit reserved.
turns.zh:
这辆车的设计是由汤姆·特嘉达在为Ghia工作时完成的。

他的强项就是设计外观优雅的轻量化汽车。

这辆Pantera无疑是他最标志性的作品之一，
不过我个人感觉作为一款超级跑车，它略有些保守了。
turns.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

turns.zh: 你们知道汤姆·特嘉达是谁吗？(
turns.speaker: Sarah

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_Sarah_normal_pantera_71_1802107
turns.raw:
That's right. He's the famous car designer 
known as the father of the Pantera.<p/>
He's noted for working at Italian carrozzerie
Ghia and Pininfarina.<next id=1802109 type=9>g
turns.en:
That's right. He's the famous car designer
known as the father of the Pantera.

Ghia and Pininfarina.
turns.zh:
没错，他是非常著名的汽车设计师，
被誉为“Pantera之父”。

他因为在意大利车身制造商Ghia和Pininfarina的
杰出工作而闻名。$
turns.speaker: Sarah

for this De Tomaso Pantera.<next id=1802109 type=9>

turns.zh:

车身制造商Ghia和Pininfarina工作。

他也因为执笔了这辆De Tomaso Pantera的设计而闻名。_
turns.speaker: Sarah

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf2Nakamura_normal_pantera_71_1802109
turns.raw:
In America, the De Tomaso Pantera is still quite popular.

The Pantera is a model originally developed by Ford, but it strongly possesses Italian supercar qualities.

It was an affordable super car...

So instead of keeping it tucked away for safe keeping, many owners enjoyed tuning their car to their own tastes.u
turns.en:
In America, the De Tomaso Pantera is still quite popular.
The Pantera is a model originally developed by Ford, but
it strongly possesses Italian supercar qualities.

It was an affordable super car...
So instead of keeping it tucked away for safe keeping, many

turns.zh:
De Tomaso Pantera在美国依然非常受欢迎。
Pantera车型最初由Ford开发，却拥有多处
强烈的意大利超级跑车特质。

而且是一辆价格相对较为实惠的超跑……
所以许多车主并没有将他们的爱车束之高阁，
而是按照自己的喜好进行改装。

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf2Nakamura_normal_cobra_coupe_64_1802205
turns.raw:
This car is a masterpiece of American race-car design.

Because of the era, I think its design was undoubtedly influenced by the Ferrari GTO...

But this massive Daytona Coupe possesses an exclusively bold American flair, which I think is fantastic.

From the fully pushed back cabin to the squeezed out rear, the proportions of this car have been taken to the limit.

But that balance is what makes the car so alluring.

I feel this was from using the open-top AC Cobra as a base and getting the most aerodynamic performance possible.

The design sense of Pete Brock, who effectively put this car together, really comes through.�
turns.en:
This car is a masterpiece of
American race-car design.

Because of the era, I think its design was undoubtedly
influenced by the Ferrari GTO...

But this massive Daytona Coupe possesses an exclusively
bold American flair, which I think is fantastic.
From the fully pushed back cabin to the squeezed out rear,
the proportions of this car have been taken to the limit.

But that balance is what makes the car so alluring.
I feel this was from using the open-top AC Cobra as a base
and getting the most aerodynamic performance possible.

The design sense of Pete Brock, who effectively
put this car together, really comes through.
turns.zh:
这辆车是美国赛车设计史上的杰作。

由于所属时代的原因，我认为它的设计毫无疑问
深受Ferrari GTO的影响……

不过这辆体型庞大的Daytona Coupe依然拥有独一无二的
粗犷美国风味，我觉得这一点非常美妙。
从大幅后移的座舱，到高度压缩的翘车尾，
这辆车的比例被推向了极限。

不过，这种奇妙的平衡恰恰是这辆车最迷人的地方。
我认为这是因为它采用了敞篷的AC Cobra作为基础车型，
并尽可能地提升了空气动力学性能。

皮特·布洛克贯彻他的设计理念，成功打造了这款经典车。]
turns.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

turns.en:

turns.zh:
没错。他是一名美国赛车设计师。

在年轻时，他曾在GM工作，并为Chevrolet Corvette
的设计做出了巨大贡献，也展示了自己的才华。

另外他也与卡罗尔·谢尔比联手，打造了这辆Cobra，
为自己赢得了赫赫声名。

This Daytona Cobra is no doubt Pete's signature creation.

It looks like a complicated design...

But the surface areas are clean, making it simpler and more sophisticated than you might think.

That's why the more time passes, the better it looks.
turns.en:
This Daytona Cobra is no doubt Pete's signature creation.

It looks like a complicated design...

But the surface areas are clean, making it simpler and more
sophisticated than you might think.
That's why the more time passes, the better it looks.
turns.zh:
这辆Daytona Cobra毫无疑问是皮特最具代表性的作品。

它的设计看上去有些复杂……

车身表面却异常简洁。要同时保证这样的简约与繁复，
需要花费超乎你想象的设计流程。
正因如此，它的外观才能够随着岁月的推移而常看常新，
令人回味。

turns.raw:
This car is a masterpiece of American race-car design.

Because of the era, I think its design was undoubtedly influenced by the Ferrari GTO...

But this massive Daytona Coupe possesses an exclusively bold American flair, which I think is fantastic.

From the fully pushed back cabin to the squeezed out rear, the proportions of this car have been taken to the limit.

But that balance is what makes the car so alluring.

I feel this was from using the open-top AC Cobra as a base and getting the most aerodynamic performance possible.

The design sense of Pete Brock, who effectively put this car together, really comes through.�
turns.en:
This car is a masterpiece of
American race-car design.

Because of the era, I think its design was undoubtedly
influenced by the Ferrari GTO...

But this massive Daytona Coupe possesses an exclusively
bold American flair, which I think is fantastic.
From the fully pushed back cabin to the squeezed out rear,
the proportions of this car have been taken to the limit.

But that balance is what makes the car so alluring.
I feel this was from using the open-top AC Cobra as a base
and getting the most aerodynamic performance possible.

The design sense of Pete Brock, who effectively
put this car together, really comes through.
turns.zh:
这辆车是美国赛车设计史上的杰作。

由于所属时代的原因，我认为它的设计毫无疑问
深受Ferrari GTO的影响……

不过这辆体型庞大的Daytona Coupe依然拥有独一无二的
粗犷美国风味，我觉得这一点非常美妙。
从大幅后移的座舱，到高度压缩的翘车尾，
这辆车的比例被推向了极限。

不过，这种奇妙的平衡恰恰是这辆车最迷人的地方。
我认为这是因为它采用了敞篷的AC Cobra作为基础车型，
并尽可能地提升了空气动力学性能。

皮特·布洛克贯彻他的设计理念，成功打造了这款经典车。]
turns.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

I might even go so far as to say that its proportions and lines are just about perfect.

Just remember to give it some wide-rim wheels!
turns.en:
No doubt about it, the S30 has a sports car design
that is quintessentially Japanese.

I might even go so far as to say that its proportions and
lines are just about perfect.
The over-fenders and long nose which were added
to the ZG variant...
They actually balance the car quite nicely, giving it
a more ‘aggressive’ charm, so to speak.
Just remember to give it some wide-rim wheels!
turns.zh:
毫无疑问，Nissan S30的跑车设计带有典型的日本风格。

我甚至可以毫不夸张地说，它的比例和线条都堪称完美。
它在ZG车型的基础上增加了宽挡泥板和长车头……
在外形上实现了平衡的观感，更为它赋予了
一种更具“攻击性”的魅力，
同时也没有忘记为它配上一套更宽的车轮！
turns.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

turns.en:
No doubt about it, the S30 has a sports car design
that is quintessentially Japanese.

I might even go so far as to say that its proportions and
lines are just about perfect.
The over-fenders and long nose which were added
to the ZG variant...
They actually balance the car quite nicely, giving it
a more ‘aggressive’ charm, so to speak.
Just remember to give it some wide-rim wheels!
turns.zh:
毫无疑问，Nissan S30的跑车设计带有典型的日本风格。

我甚至可以毫不夸张地说，它的比例和线条都堪称完美。
它在ZG车型的基础上增加了宽挡泥板和长车头……
在外形上实现了平衡的观感，更为它赋予了
一种更具“攻击性”的魅力，
同时也没有忘记为它配上一套更宽的车轮！
turns.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

turns.raw:
In terms of design, the Mark IV was a complete departure from the Ford GTs that came before it.

Its body and side profile alone evidence a prioritization of pure aerodynamic performance.

From this point on, Ford showed its commitment to breaking the GT mold...

...its mission to create completely pure race cars.*
turns.en:
In terms of design, the Mark IV was a complete departure
from the Ford GTs that came before it.
Its body and side profile alone evidence a prioritization
of pure aerodynamic performance.
From this point on, Ford showed its commitment to
breaking the GT mold...

...its mission to create completely pure race cars.*
turns.zh:
在设计上，Mark IV与过去的Ford GT截然不同。
光从车身和侧面剖视图来看，就能充分体现其纯粹为空气动力学性能
而作出的优化。
从此刻开始，Ford展现了突破GT风格桎梏的决心……

目标是创造出完全不同的纯粹赛车。
turns.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

If I’m not mistaken, this car was preceded by the more radical ‘Gallardo’.

And yet the Huracán represented an evolution in Lamborghini’s identity and design language.

Its use of hexagonal forms continues to be seen in today’s Lamborghinis.!
turns.en:
If I’m not mistaken, this car was preceded by
the more radical ‘Gallardo’.
And yet the Huracán represented an evolution
in Lamborghini’s identity and design language.
Its use of hexagonal forms continues to be seen
in today’s Lamborghinis.!
turns.zh:
如果我没记错的话，这辆车的前款应该是
更加激进的“Gallardo”。
然而，Huracán很好地展现了Lamborghini在品牌认同
和设计语言上的革命。
它采用的六角形元素至今可以在现款Lamborghini上看到。
turns.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

If you ask me, this car is less of a design study than it is
a study in aerodynamics.

The roofline runs straight across the body to the rear,
where it abruptly cuts off in a coda tronca.
This tells me that it may have been developed as a prototype
for engineering purposes.
turns.zh:
依我看，这辆车更像是一项“空气动力学研究”
而非“设计研究”。

车顶线条贯穿整车一直延伸到后部，
突然以coda tronca的形式戛然而止。
我有个大胆推测，它可能是以工程研究为目的
而开发的原型车。

turns.en:
That’s right, it refers to a truncated tail, or rear.
What we call a "Kamm Tail" in English.

The Kamm Tail is named after the German aerodynamicist
Wunibald Kamm, who theorized the design in the 1930s.
turns.zh:
没错，它指的是尾部被截短。
在英语中通常被称为“Kamm tail”（断尾）。

这一术语源自于德国空气动力学家温纳尔德·卡姆
（Wunibald Kamm），他在上世纪30年代提出了这种设计理念。

At the time, Mercedes-Benz had just released
the C111, a rotary-engine prototype.

So maybe Mazda was looking for a way to say,
“Hey, rotary engines are our thing!”
As with the Cosmo Sport, this car signalled the direction
that Mazda was to take in its future designs.
turns.zh:
当时，Mercedes-Benz刚刚发布了
一款搭载转子引擎的原型车C111。

turns.en:
It's such an honor to make your acquaintance, Ito-san!

Mr. Ito was a vital part of the design teams at
American car companies, such as GM's Opel and Ford.

He's also known by his English name, "Kuni Ito."

He's quite experienced in the production-design field and served
as a professor at the College for Creative Studies in Detroit.
turns.zh:
伊藤先生，能认识您是我们的荣幸！

伊藤先生曾在多家美国汽车公司的设计团队中
担任要职，包括GM旗下的Opel和Ford。

他还有一个非常著名的英文名字，“Kuni Ito”。

他在汽车制造设计领域拥有非常丰富的经验，
并在底特律的创意设计学院担任教授。
turns.speaker: Sarah

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf3Ito_normal_morris_mini_cooper_s_970_65_1900105
turns.raw:
This is the original Mini. I can't think of any other car design that is so efficient.

It's the ultimate expression of a 4-seat passenger vehicle. It truly has a 'timeless design'.

The original Mini was, for its time, an unusual front-wheel-drive compact.

It was developed for minimal power and maximum interior space.

This packaging was revolutionary for the 20th century.

The car was created in 1955 by the BMC development team, led by Sir Alec Issigonis.

After that, John Cooper tuned the car with twin carburettors and disc brakes.

Thus the Mini Cooper S you see here was born.

It was developed for minimal power and

turns.zh:
这是一辆初代MINI。
我觉得没有比它更高效的汽车设计了。

它就是4座乘用车的终极体现。
这真是一款“不过时的设计”。
这款初代MINI在当时是一辆非常罕见的前驱紧凑型车。

它的开发思路就是追求最小的动力和
最大的可用内部空间。

这样的产品规划在20世纪是非常具有革新性的。
在1955年，由亚历克·伊斯戈尼斯爵士领导的英国汽车集团开发团队
打造了这台MINI。

之后，约翰·库珀对车型进行了调校，
加入了双化油器和碟式制动器……
于是，你眼前的这一辆MINI Cooper S就诞生了。*

turns.raw:
This is the original Mini. I can't think of any other car design that is so efficient.

It's the ultimate expression of a 4-seat passenger vehicle. It truly has a 'timeless design'.

The original Mini was, for its time, an unusual front-wheel-drive compact.

It was developed for minimal power and maximum interior space.

This packaging was revolutionary for the 20th century.

The car was created in 1955 by the BMC development team, led by Sir Alec Issigonis.

After that, John Cooper tuned the car with twin carburettors and disc brakes.

Thus the Mini Cooper S you see here was born.

turns.zh:
这是一辆初代MINI。
我觉得没有比它更高效的汽车设计了。

它就是4座乘用车的终极体现。
这真是一款“不过时的设计”。
这款初代MINI在当时是一辆非常罕见的前驱紧凑型车。

它的开发思路就是追求最小的动力和
最大的可用内部空间。

这样的产品规划在20世纪是非常具有革新性的。
在1955年，由亚历克·伊斯戈尼斯爵士领导的英国汽车集团开发团队
打造了这台MINI。

之后，约翰·库珀对车型进行了调校，
加入了双化油器和碟式制动器……
于是，你眼前的这一辆MINI Cooper S就诞生了。*
turns.speaker: Kunihisa Ito

Mr. Ito was a vital part of the design teams at

turns.en:
It's such an honor to make your acquaintance, Ito-san!

Mr. Ito was a vital part of the design teams at
American car companies, such as GM's Opel and Ford.

He's also known by his English name, "Kuni Ito."

He's quite experienced in the production-design field and served
as a professor at the College for Creative Studies in Detroit.
turns.zh:
伊藤先生，能认识您是我们的荣幸！

伊藤先生曾在多家美国汽车公司的设计团队中
担任要职，包括GM旗下的Opel和Ford。

他还有一个非常著名的英文名字，“Kuni Ito”。

他在汽车制造设计领域拥有非常丰富的经验，
并在底特律的创意设计学院担任教授。
turns.speaker: Sarah

The FD3S Mazda RX-7 was released in 1991. Even now, there are many young fans of this car in the U.S.

It possesses a simple design without any faults.

The styling of this car was born at Mazda's California design studio, led at the time by Tom Matano.

This particular street machine was created by RE Amemiya, which specialises in tuning rotary-powered machines.

Although it's not exactly a 'hashiriya', or ‘street racer,’ it's nevertheless captivating.

It's a car you should drive at least once in Gran Turismo.
turns.en:
The FD3S Mazda RX-7 was released in 1991. Even now,
there are many young fans of this car in the U.S.

It possesses a simple design without any faults.
The styling of this car was born at Mazda's California
design studio, led at the time by Tom Matano.

This particular street machine was created by RE Amemiya,
which specialises in tuning rotary-powered machines.
Although it's not exactly a 'hashiriya', or ‘street racer,’
it's nevertheless captivating.
It's a car you should drive at least once in Gran Turismo.
turns.zh:
这辆FD3S Mazda RX-7虽然推出于1991年，但即便
到了今天，它依然在美国年轻人当中拥有不少粉丝。

它拥有简单而无懈可击的设计。
这辆公路车的外观设计诞生在Mazda的加利福尼亚州
设计工作室，由俣野努主导完成。

眼前的这一台则是由专攻转子引擎调校的公司
RE Amemiya改装后的版本。
尽管严格来讲它并不是一辆“街头赛车”，
但依然非常迷人。
至少，你在《跑车浪漫旅》中应该试驾一下它。$
turns.speaker: Kunihisa Ito

turns.en:
It's such an honor to make your acquaintance, Ito-san!

Mr. Ito was a vital part of the design teams at
American car companies, such as GM's Opel and Ford.

He's also known by his English name, "Kuni Ito."

He's quite experienced in the production-design field and served
as a professor at the College for Creative Studies in Detroit.
turns.zh:
伊藤先生，能认识您是我们的荣幸！

伊藤先生曾在多家美国汽车公司的设计团队中
担任要职，包括GM旗下的Opel和Ford。

他还有一个非常著名的英文名字，“Kuni Ito”。

他在汽车制造设计领域拥有非常丰富的经验，
并在底特律的创意设计学院担任教授。
turns.speaker: Sarah

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf3Ito_normal__787b_91_1900305
turns.raw:
The number of cars participating in the 1991 Le Mans race was only 38, but among those was the new Peugeot 905.

There were also perennial powerhouses like Mercedes-Benz, Jaguar and Porsche sharing that starting grid.

To take them all on, Mazda entered two 787B race cars.

Of those two, the No. 55 car, which started the race in 19th position, gradually worked its way up the running order...

Until it found its way to the front and finished on top! A dramatic first victory for Japanese manufacturers.

To this day, I haven't forgotten the famous green and red livery of that race machine.
turns.en:
The number of cars participating in the 1991 Le Mans race
was only 38, but among those was the new Peugeot 905.

There were also perennial powerhouses like Mercedes-Benz,
Jaguar and Porsche sharing that starting grid.
To take them all on, Mazda entered two 787B race cars.
Of those two, the No. 55 car, which started the race in 19th
position, gradually worked its way up the running order...

Until it found its way to the front and finished on top!
A dramatic first victory for Japanese manufacturers.
To this day, I haven't forgotten the famous green
and red livery of that race machine.<next id=1900306 type=
turns.zh:
在1991年参加勒芒耐力赛的赛车仅有寥寥38辆，
但全新的标致905也在其列。

此外，在发车格上还有各品牌常年出战的高性能赛车，
如梅赛德斯-奔驰、捷豹和保时捷等等。
马自达派出了两辆787B赛车来挑战这些强大的对手。
在这两辆车中，从第19位发车的55号赛车
步步为营，不断提升自己的排位……

……最后终于攀升到领跑位置，并以头名完赛！
这是日本车厂的第一次获胜，过程充满了戏剧性。
时至今日，我依然无法忘怀那部比赛机器
的橙绿色涂装。
turns.speaker: Kunihisa Ito

The prototype and final production model of the original NSX...

Was designed by my friend and former chief designer at Honda, Masato Nakano.

The performance target for the NSX was to surpass the Ferrari 328 and 348...

So you know it had plenty of fighting power.

The GT500 class adopted a stepped-bottom rule in 2007, and that year this car took the title, winning 5 of 9 races.

Because of its incredible speed, you can almost say the series imposed a weight-handicap system.

It's such an honor to make your acquaintance, Ito-san!

Mr. Ito was a vital part of the design teams at
American car companies, such as GM's Opel and Ford.

as a professor at the College for Creative Studies in Detroit.
turns.zh:
伊藤先生，能认识您是我们的荣幸！

伊藤先生曾在多家美国汽车公司的设计团队中
担任要职，包括GM旗下的Opel和Ford。

他还有一个非常著名的英文名字，“Kuni Ito”。

他在汽车制造设计领域拥有非常丰富的经验，
并在底特律的创意设计学院担任教授。

turns.en:
Designed and built by Chrysler's Advanced Design Studios
over the course of 1988 and ’89...

The Viper was dubbed the ‘second-coming’
of the Shelby Cobra.

It was co-production by then-president Bob Lutz
and designer Tom Gale.
Heralding a new era at the New York Auto Show in 2012,
the SRT GTS-R marked the series’ return to racing.
Distinguished by a long nose and short deck body...
Its flat bottom and wing addition promised dramatically
improved aerodynamics.
turns.zh:
这台由Chrysler的高级设计工作室于1988年至1989年

设计和制造的Viper又被称作Shelby Cobra的“再现”。

它是由品牌当时的总裁鲍勃·鲁茨和设计师汤姆·盖尔协手打造。
2012年纽约车展上，Chrysler带着Viper重出江湖，
而SRT GTS-R的命名则代表系列车型回归竞速比赛。
该车具有标志性的长车头和短小平坦的车身……
扁平的底盘和额外的风翼也使得空气动力学效应得到了长足的改进。
turns.speaker: Kunihisa Ito

turns.en:
Designed and built by Chrysler's Advanced Design Studios
over the course of 1988 and ’89...

The Viper was dubbed the ‘second-coming’
of the Shelby Cobra.

It was co-production by then-president Bob Lutz
and designer Tom Gale.
Heralding a new era at the New York Auto Show in 2012,
the SRT GTS-R marked the series’ return to racing.
Distinguished by a long nose and short deck body...
Its flat bottom and wing addition promised dramatically
improved aerodynamics.
turns.zh:
这台由Chrysler的高级设计工作室于1988年至1989年

设计和制造的Viper又被称作Shelby Cobra的“再现”。

它是由品牌当时的总裁鲍勃·鲁茨和设计师汤姆·盖尔协手打造。
2012年纽约车展上，Chrysler带着Viper重出江湖，
而SRT GTS-R的命名则代表系列车型回归竞速比赛。
该车具有标志性的长车头和短小平坦的车身……
扁平的底盘和额外的风翼也使得空气动力学效应得到了长足的改进。
turns.speaker: Kunihisa Ito

The Lexus SC is a grand tourer series.

The second-generation model, the SC430, was a hardtop convertible powered by a mighty V-8 engine.

You see them quite often in the U.S.

The first-generation model was designed at Calty, a Toyota design studio located in California.

powered by a mighty V-8 engine.

studio located in California.

turns.zh:
Lexus SC属于品牌的豪华旅行车系列车型。
其二代车型SC430是由一台强力的V8引擎所驱动的硬顶敞篷车。

在美国，这辆车相对比较常见。
该系列的第一代车型由位于加利福尼亚的
Toyota设计工作室Calty所设计。

然而，这一辆SC430主要是在欧洲的设计工作室中构思完成。
作为日本GT比赛的参赛车辆之一，
其在2008赛季得到了空气动力学升级……

也因此，它在高速赛道上交出了极其出色的答卷。
turns.speaker: Kunihisa Ito

The Jaguar XJR-9 was penned by British racing car designer Tony Southgate.

In 1988, it competed at the World Sports Prototype Championship.

Among its six victories was a legendary show at the 24 Hours of Le Mans...

Which was Jaguar’s first Le Mans victory since 1957!

The Nissan R92CP has an exquisite body design that speaks to its enormous capacity for downforce.

And its blue paint job is dazzling to behold.

Back in 1992, Nissan pitted the R92CP against Toyota’s TS010 in a battle for supremacy.

After winning the opening round at Suzuka, the R92CP went on to win at Fuji and at Sugo...

...contributing to an incredible class victory for Nissan.
turns.en:
The Nissan R92CP has an exquisite body design that speaks
to its enormous capacity for downforce.

And its blue paint job is dazzling to behold.
Back in 1992, Nissan pitted the R92CP against Toyota’s
TS010 in a battle for supremacy.
After winning the opening round at Suzuka, the R92CP
went on to win at Fuji and at Sugo...
...contributing to an incredible class victory for Nissan.
turns.zh:
Nissan R92CP以精致的车身设计彰显其强大的下压力性能。

此外，其炫目的蓝色涂装更是令人眼前一亮。
在1992年，Nissan R92CP与Toyota的TS010展开激烈对决，
争夺行业的巅峰地位。
在铃鹿赛道夺得开幕战胜利后，R92CP继续在富士和
SUGO运动乐园赛道再下两城……
Nissan最终震撼赢得该级别的冠军，此车功不可没。
turns.speaker: Kunihisa Ito

The Nissan R92CP has an exquisite body design that speaks
to its enormous capacity for downforce.

And its blue paint job is dazzling to behold.
Back in 1992, Nissan pitted the R92CP against Toyota’s
TS010 in a battle for supremacy.
After winning the opening round at Suzuka, the R92CP
went on to win at Fuji and at Sugo...
...contributing to an incredible class victory for Nissan.
turns.zh:
Nissan R92CP以精致的车身设计彰显其强大的下压力性能。

此外，其炫目的蓝色涂装更是令人眼前一亮。
在1992年，Nissan R92CP与Toyota的TS010展开激烈对决，
争夺行业的巅峰地位。
在铃鹿赛道夺得开幕战胜利后，R92CP继续在富士和
SUGO运动乐园赛道再下两城……
Nissan最终震撼赢得该级别的冠军，此车功不可没。

The Porsche 919 Hybrid first competed at the WEC in 2014, if I’m not mistaken.

This is the 2016 model. The 2014 car had a white paint job and stylish gray stripes across its body.

Viewed from above, the stripes spelled out the phrase "PORSCHE INTELLIGENT PERFORMANCE."

Among its many design features was its multi-LED headlight system, meant to improve night driving.

To implement it, the front wheel arches were raised, along with the driver’s seat.

The 919’s historic 2016 battle against Toyota’s TS050 was one that will not soon be forgotten at Le Mans.

Indeed, it marked the beginning of the car’s three-year winning streak at the famous racing event.h

turns.zh:
如果我没记错的话，这台保时捷919 Hybrid
在2014年首次参加了世界耐力锦标赛。

这一台是2016款。因为2014年款采用了白色涂装以及
时尚感十足的灰色条纹，交叉纵横于其车身。
从上方看，这些条纹拼出了标语
“保时捷智慧性能”。
在其众多设计特色中，值得一提的是多LED车头灯系统，
该系统旨在提高夜间驾驶的性能。
为了实现这一设计，前轮拱罩被特意提高，
驾驶员座椅也跟着被抬高。
919 Hybrid与丰田的TS050之间激烈的2016年勒芒之战
是一个让人难以忘怀的经典时刻……

实际上，正是在这一战尘埃落定之后，该车
在这一著名赛事上开始了为期三年的连庄。
turns.speaker: Kunihisa Ito

turns.raw:
The TS050 Hybrid is the pride of Japan, and one car that I’d really like to take to the track!

2016 was the year that Toyota introduced the bright white, red, and black colour scheme for its GAZOO Racing cars.

It was also the year that two TS050s faced off against the Porsche 919 at Le Mans.

Tragically, a mere 6 minutes from the finish line, the lead Toyota car suffered engine trouble and lost the race.

However, in 2018, 33 years after its first Le Mans appearance, Toyota took home an incredible overall victory.

It was the first Japanese car to do so since the Mazda 787B’s win in 1991.

这是继1991年Mazda787B赢得比赛后，日本车队首次在勒芒夺冠。

turns.raw:
The TS050 Hybrid is the pride of Japan, and one car that I’d really like to take to the track!

2016 was the year that Toyota introduced the bright white, red, and black colour scheme for its GAZOO Racing cars.

It was also the year that two TS050s faced off against the Porsche 919 at Le Mans.

Tragically, a mere 6 minutes from the finish line, the lead Toyota car suffered engine trouble and lost the race.

However, in 2018, 33 years after its first Le Mans appearance, Toyota took home an incredible overall victory.

It was the first Japanese car to do so since the Mazda 787B’s win in 1991.

2016年，Toyota为旗下所属的GAZOO Racing车队引入了
鲜艳的白色、红色和黑色配色方案。

这一年也是两辆TS050与Porsche 919在勒芒
展开激烈对决的一年。
不幸的是，距离终点仅有6分钟时，领先的Toyota赛车却遭遇
引擎故障，输掉了比赛。
不过，在2018年，在距离首次亮相勒芒已经
过去33年之际，Toyota却取得了令人难以置信的全面胜利。

这是继1991年Mazda787B赢得比赛后，日本车队首次在勒芒夺冠。

turns.raw:
Anyone who has spent time playing Gran Turismo has likely found themselves behind the wheel of this legendary Porsche.

The 956 and its successor, the 962...

...dominated the global motorsport scene for years, racking up numerous victories.

The 962C, in particular, is widely regarded as the most successful sports-racing prototype ever created.

Its striking livery, streamlined bodywork...

...and the vertical fin-supported rear wings are as iconic today as when they first appeared on the track.$
turns.en:
Anyone who has spent time playing Gran Turismo has likely found
themselves behind the wheel of this legendary Porsche.
The 956 and its successor, the 962...
...dominated the global motorsport scene for years,
racking up numerous victories.

The 962C, in particular, is widely regarded as the most
successful sports-racing prototype ever created.
Its striking livery, streamlined bodywork...
...and the vertical fin-supported rear wings are as iconic today
as when they first appeared on the track.$
turns.zh:
任何玩过《跑车浪漫旅》的人想必都曾
至少驾驶过一次这款车型。
Porsche 956及其后继车型962……
在国际赛场上为Porsche赢得了长达数十年的胜利。

事实上，962C被广泛认为是有史以来
“最成功的运动原型赛车”。
它鲜艳的车身涂装，简洁的车身线条……
以及由两侧垂直尾翼支撑的大尺寸后扰流板，即使在
今天仍然充满魅力，一如初上赛道时那样令人印象深刻。
turns.speaker: Kunihisa Ito

The 962C, in particular, is widely regarded as the most successful sports-racing prototype ever created.

Its striking livery, streamlined bodywork...

...and the vertical fin-supported rear wings are as iconic today as when they first appeared on the track.$

Anyone who has spent time playing Gran Turismo has likely found
themselves behind the wheel of this legendary Porsche.
The 956 and its successor, the 962...
...dominated the global motorsport scene for years,
racking up numerous victories.

The 962C, in particular, is widely regarded as the most
successful sports-racing prototype ever created.
Its striking livery, streamlined bodywork...
...and the vertical fin-supported rear wings are as iconic today
as when they first appeared on the track.$
turns.zh:
任何玩过《跑车浪漫旅》的人想必都曾
至少驾驶过一次这款车型。
Porsche 956及其后继车型962……
在国际赛场上为Porsche赢得了长达数十年的胜利。

事实上，962C被广泛认为是有史以来
“最成功的运动原型赛车”。
它鲜艳的车身涂装，简洁的车身线条……
以及由两侧垂直尾翼支撑的大尺寸后扰流板，即使在
今天仍然充满魅力，一如初上赛道时那样令人印象深刻。

一脉相承的设计特征。[

turns.raw:
When the Sauber Mercedes C9 was introduced, it was already somewhat aged...

...having arrived just as Group C regulations ushered in a new era of automotive technology.

It was the era of carbon-fiber monocoque chassis, showcased by TWR-Jaguar machines...

...along with entries from Nissan, Toyota, and Aston Martin.

Meanwhile, the Sauber C9 stuck with an all-aluminum construction.

But that didn’t stop it from dominating Le Mans in 1989 with a stunning 1-2 finish.

How did it achieve such an incredible feat?

The answer lies in the power of Mercedes' advanced computer systems and rock-solid engineering.

It was the kind of victory that only cutting-edge technology could deliver!
turns.en:
When the Sauber Mercedes C9 was introduced, it was already
somewhat aged...

...having arrived just as Group C regulations ushered
in a new era of automotive technology.
It was the era of carbon-fiber monocoque chassis, showcased
by TWR-Jaguar machines...

...along with entries from Nissan, Toyota, and Aston Martin.

Meanwhile, the Sauber C9 stuck with an all-aluminum construction.
But that didn’t stop it from dominating Le Mans in 1989 with a
stunning 1-2 finish.
How did it achieve such an incredible feat?

The answer lies in the power of Mercedes' advanced
computer systems and rock-solid engineering.

It was the kind of victory that only cutting-edge technology
could deliver!
turns.zh:
从1987年首次亮相的那一刻起，索伯梅赛德斯C9
就已经有些过时了。

毕竟，它诞生于C组别规则推出和汽车技术
新时代来临之前的黎明。
这是碳纤维单体壳底盘闪亮登场的年代，以汤姆·沃金肖赛车-捷豹……

日产、丰田和阿斯顿马丁为代表的车型就是例证。

而索伯C9仍然坚持全铝结构。
但这并没有阻止它在1989年的勒芒取得
一二带回的成绩。
它是如何取得这一惊人壮举的呢？

这都要归功于梅赛德斯自己的计算机系统
和可靠的制造工艺！

确实，这是一场只有计算机才能实现的胜利！
turns.speaker: Kunihisa Ito

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf3Ito_normal_sauber_mercedes_c9_89_1901305
turns.raw:
When the Sauber Mercedes C9 was introduced, it was already somewhat aged...

...having arrived just as Group C regulations ushered in a new era of automotive technology.

It was the era of carbon-fiber monocoque chassis, showcased by TWR-Jaguar machines...

...along with entries from Nissan, Toyota, and Aston Martin.

Meanwhile, the Sauber C9 stuck with an all-aluminum construction.

But that didn’t stop it from dominating Le Mans in 1989 with a stunning 1-2 finish.

How did it achieve such an incredible feat?

The answer lies in the power of Mercedes' advanced computer systems and rock-solid engineering.

It was the kind of victory that only cutting-edge technology could deliver!
turns.en:
When the Sauber Mercedes C9 was introduced, it was already
somewhat aged...

...having arrived just as Group C regulations ushered
in a new era of automotive technology.
It was the era of carbon-fiber monocoque chassis, showcased
by TWR-Jaguar machines...

...along with entries from Nissan, Toyota, and Aston Martin.

Meanwhile, the Sauber C9 stuck with an all-aluminum construction.
But that didn’t stop it from dominating Le Mans in 1989 with a
stunning 1-2 finish.
How did it achieve such an incredible feat?

The answer lies in the power of Mercedes' advanced
computer systems and rock-solid engineering.

It was the kind of victory that only cutting-edge technology
could deliver!
turns.zh:
从1987年首次亮相的那一刻起，索伯梅赛德斯C9
就已经有些过时了。

毕竟，它诞生于C组别规则推出和汽车技术
新时代来临之前的黎明。
这是碳纤维单体壳底盘闪亮登场的年代，以汤姆·沃金肖赛车-捷豹……

日产、丰田和阿斯顿马丁为代表的车型就是例证。

而索伯C9仍然坚持全铝结构。
但这并没有阻止它在1989年的勒芒取得
一二带回的成绩。
它是如何取得这一惊人壮举的呢？

这都要归功于梅赛德斯自己的计算机系统
和可靠的制造工艺！

确实，这是一场只有计算机才能实现的胜利！
turns.speaker: Kunihisa Ito

The McLaren P1 is a special edition plug-in hybrid from British automaker McLaren Automotive.

It features a carbon-fiber monocoque with a roof structure called "MonoCage."

It’s the successor to McLaren’s legendary F1.

But the P1 carves out its own identity with a fresh, organic design language.

And, to enhance aerodynamics on the track...

...This GTR features a large front splitter, aggressive side skirts, and an imposing rear wing.Q

turns.zh:
McLaren P1是英国汽车制造商McLaren Automotive推出的
一款特别版插电式混合动力车。
其车身采用了碳纤维单体车壳和
名为“MonoCage”的车顶结构。
尽管设计灵感来源于McLaren的传奇F1赛车……

但P1的设计语言更新颖，更具有活力。
此外，为了提高赛道上的空气动力学性能……

这款GTR配备了大型前分流器、侧裙
以及一个引人注目的尾翼。

The Audi Quattro was a landmark achievement in the history of automotive design.

Introduced in 1981, it revolutionized the world of rally racing.

And, it has remained a benchmark for production-car technology ever since.

Most of its outer panels are crafted from a blend of resin and Kevlar.

But as a purpose-built competition car, it delivered outstanding results.

turns.zh:
Audi Quattro是汽车设计史上的一个里程碑。
它于1981年首次亮相，便彻底改变了拉力赛的世界……

并从此成为赛车技术下放量产车的典范。
其大部分外部面板是由树脂和凯夫拉混合材料制成……

挡风玻璃的角度经过调整，相比原型车
可提供更大的可视范围。
它的挡泥板宽大，轴距短，显得比例很不协调。

然而，作为一款专为比赛设计的汽车，
它以极其出色的成绩做出了回应。
turns.speaker: Kunihisa Ito

turns.raw:
This is such an exciting car!

From an angle, it seems to begin with a tire and end with a tire, and the cabin takes up about half the body.

The height of its shoulder is determined by the suspension, and the rear half of the cabin sits on the driven wheels.

This produces a lot of traction, and that raw power is reflected in the clean lines of the car's sides.

And, it's channeled to propel the long nose forward!

The clean design features classically Japanese inspirations such as flowing rivers and split bamboo.

You could even go far as to say it combines an angelic boldness with a devilish level of detail.

It really is the epitome of "Kodo" design!

Incidentally, the fact that a race version was produced, seemingly out of the blue...

...is probably related to the fact that the design boss in Hiroshima is a race driver himse�f.

I really can't wait to hear that rotary engine roar!C

分的重量正落在驱动轮上，

产生大量的牵引力……这股动力沿着展现车辆亮点的侧

turns.raw:
This is such an exciting car!

From an angle, it seems to begin with a tire and end with a tire, and the cabin takes up about half the body.

The height of its shoulder is determined by the suspension, and the rear half of the cabin sits on the driven wheels.

This produces a lot of traction, and that raw power is reflected in the clean lines of the car's sides.

And, it's channeled to propel the long nose forward!

The clean design features classically Japanese inspirations such as flowing rivers and split bamboo.

You could even go far as to say it combines an angelic boldness with a devilish level of detail.

It really is the epitome of "Kodo" design!

Incidentally, the fact that a race version was produced, seemingly out of the blue...

...is probably related to the fact that the design boss in Hiroshima is a race driver himse�f.

I really can't wait to hear that rotary engine roar!C

turns.raw:
In the 1980s, in the midst of a bubble economy, Japan became the biggest auto producer in the world.

Becoming the leader in the automotive industry requires a lot of thought about what kind of products should be offered.

It was a time of ambition and decision.

There were lots of discussion of what made Japanese automotive design distinctive.

Japanese cars from around this time were embraced by people around the world.

When I first saw the white flowing lines of the Celica, or the A80 Supra, on the cobblestoned streets of Europe,

it was as a mind-blowing experience, reminding me when I first saw giant tail fins of a Chrysler in Azabu in Tokyo.�
turns.en:
In the 1980s, in the midst of a bubble economy, Japan became
the biggest auto producer in the world.

Becoming the leader in the automotive industry requires a lot
of thought about what kind of products should be offered.

It was a time of ambition and decision.
There were lots of discussion of what made
Japanese automotive design distinctive.

Japanese cars from around this time were
embraced by people around the world.
When I first saw the white flowing lines of the Celica, or
the A80 Supra, on the cobblestoned streets of Europe,
it was as a mind-blowing experience, reminding me when I first
saw giant tail fins of a Chrysler in Azabu in Tokyo.
turns.zh:
日本在20世纪80年代经济蓬勃发展时期，曾短暂地为了世
界上最大的汽车生产国。

在汽车行业的领导地位使其自然而然地产生了许多想法，
希望决定汽车发展的方向……

你可以把它视作一种野心或反思。
在那一时期产生了大量的讨论，探讨日本汽车设计独树
一帜的缘由。

撇开理念不谈，这一时期的日本车确实受到了全球车迷
的喜爱。
当我真正遇到白色流线造型的赛利卡，或是在欧洲古城的
鹅卵石街道邂逅A80 Supra时，
那种心灵的震撼和耳目一新的感觉就和我小时候在东京
麻布区看到一辆有巨大尾鳍的克莱斯勒时几乎一模一样。

神乐坂先生是一位杰出的汽车设计师。他出身日本，现
在在意大利任职，

turns.speaker: Sarah

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf4Harada_normal_supra_rz_97_2000205
turns.raw:
In the 1980s, in the midst of a bubble economy, Japan became the biggest auto producer in the world.

Becoming the leader in the automotive industry requires a lot of thought about what kind of products should be offered.

It was a time of ambition and decision.

There were lots of discussion of what made Japanese automotive design distinctive.

Japanese cars from around this time were embraced by people around the world.

When I first saw the white flowing lines of the Celica, or the A80 Supra, on the cobblestoned streets of Europe,

it was as a mind-blowing experience, reminding me when I first saw giant tail fins of a Chrysler in Azabu in Tokyo.�
turns.en:
In the 1980s, in the midst of a bubble economy, Japan became
the biggest auto producer in the world.

Becoming the leader in the automotive industry requires a lot
of thought about what kind of products should be offered.

It was a time of ambition and decision.
There were lots of discussion of what made
Japanese automotive design distinctive.

Japanese cars from around this time were
embraced by people around the world.
When I first saw the white flowing lines of the Celica, or
the A80 Supra, on the cobblestoned streets of Europe,
it was as a mind-blowing experience, reminding me when I first
saw giant tail fins of a Chrysler in Azabu in Tokyo.
turns.zh:
日本在20世纪80年代经济蓬勃发展时期，曾短暂地为了世
界上最大的汽车生产国。

在汽车行业的领导地位使其自然而然地产生了许多想法，
希望决定汽车发展的方向……

你可以把它视作一种野心或反思。
在那一时期产生了大量的讨论，探讨日本汽车设计独树
一帜的缘由。

撇开理念不谈，这一时期的日本车确实受到了全球车迷
的喜爱。
当我真正遇到白色流线造型的赛利卡，或是在欧洲古城的
鹅卵石街道邂逅A80 Supra时，
那种心灵的震撼和耳目一新的感觉就和我小时候在东京
麻布区看到一辆有巨大尾鳍的克莱斯勒时几乎一模一样。
turns.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf4Harada_normal_castrol_toms_supra_97_2000305
turns.raw:
The A80 Supra...

...is a coupe with very traditional sports-car proportions that's kind of rare in Japanese cars.

With a windshield that wraps all around the cabin, it has a proper greenhouse.

And this car takes the classic, beautiful coupe and drops the ride height further and widens the track...

...turning it into a race car that looks like it could really deliver on the track!

The car's shape is simple, so the Castrol livery suits it well.

The lights, which look too close together in the original model, are camouflaged and don't get in the way of the design.

The A80 Supra had lots of tuning parts available for it, so it's no wonder it was so popular with the younger crowd.K

该怎么描述A80 Supra呢……

这是一款采用传统跑车比例的双门跑车，在日本车当中
相当罕见。

环绕式的挡风玻璃仿若一个倒置的温室。
这辆经典、优美的双门跑车进一步降低了离地间隙，加
宽了胎面，

变成了一辆仿佛随时可以一飞冲天的赛车。
简洁的车型与Castrol的涂装相得益彰。

原版车中看起来相距太近的头灯经过涂装的遮掩后也不
那么碍眼了。
再加上80 Supra有很多可供选择的调校件，难怪它在年
轻人中有如此大的魅力了！<next id=2000306 type=

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf4Harada_normal_gr_yaris_rz_hp_20_2000405
turns.raw:
Notice how the tires are positioned far out at the corners, while the cabin tapers gracefully toward the rear.

It’s a winning combination, wouldn’t you agree?

The design conveys a remarkable sense of genuine agility, no matter the vehicle’s height.

It's a type of beauty that is common with cars like the Honda CR-Z.

Front-end designs of recent Toyotas are fairly aggressive looking even unmodified.

In this case, they've taken that and run with it, for the kind of car a real gearhead would appreciate.

The expression of the fascia isn't bad, but it's disappointing that it reminds you of an older Peugeot from afar.

The car is packed with good things so it would be nice if the model sticks and is loved on the streets for a long time.

It makes you want to see a different model like the Renault R5 Turbo where an adult could dress up and drive it in style.

希望普罗大众会喜欢它吧，让它证明自己……

我很高兴能看到一台跟雷诺R5涡轮增压版同类型的其他车型
出现在市场上，成为成熟车手的心头好。

turns.raw:
Historically, many road cars that served as the basis for rally machines have been especially appealing.

Cars like the Mini Cooper S, Audi quattro and Lancia Delta...

...all began as practical, utility-focused family cars.

Yet beneath that everyday form, they carried serious performance potential.

Of course, a true rally car could not be driven on public roads.

From a design standpoint, the challenge was to express that expanded capability within the framework of a road car.

The Evo V introduced larger wheels with pronounced overfenders.

It gave the traditional three-box sedan the stance of a performance machine.

Combined with signature rally elements such as large fog lights and a prominent rear wing...

...it completed the purposeful yet refined design of the second-generation Lancer Evolution.

turns.raw:
The Skyline GT-R is an icon of the Japanese automotive industry.

But there may be no other car in Japan where its history and tradition...

...weighs so heavily on a designer.

In that respect, designing a GT-R today is not so different than designing a Porsche or a Ferrari.

Back when this R33 was built, a normal mid-size sporty sedan was the base.

So there was probably a lot of difficulties in its design.

Based on a three-box shape, the 4-seat production car...

...strictly adhered to its underlying philosophy as a "Wolf in Sheep's Clothing."

Also, because the beginning of the R33 development overlapped with the tail end of the economic bubble in Japan...

...the body of the R33 was large, heavy, and its style was stocky, but it was elegant in overall style.�
turns.en:
The Skyline GT-R is an icon of the
Japanese automotive industry.

But there may be no other car in Japan
where its history and tradition...

...weighs so heavily on a designer.
In that respect, designing a GT-R today is not so different
than designing a Porsche or a Ferrari.

Back when this R33 was built, a normal mid-size sporty sedan
was the base.

So there was probably a lot of difficulties in its design.
Based on a three-box shape, the 4-seat production car...

...strictly adhered to its underlying philosophy
as a "Wolf in Sheep's Clothing."
Also, because the beginning of the R33 development overlapped
with the tail end of the economic bubble in Japan...
...the body of the R33 was large, heavy, and its style
was stocky, but it was elegant in overall style.
turns.zh:
Skyline GT-R品牌是日本汽车工业的一个标志。

但也没有哪辆日本汽车的历史和传统会像这辆车一般……

对设计师产生如此大的压力。
有鉴于此，设计一辆GT-R的压力其实无异于设计一辆
保时捷或法拉利。

这辆R33在设计时以普通的中型运动型轿车为基础……

遇到很多设计上的难题也就无可避免。
在对这台四座三厢量产车进行改造时，

基本的理念是打造出了一匹“披着羊皮的狼”。
而且，由于R33的开发初期正好撞上了日本经济泡沫的
尾声，
因此，R33的车身既大且重，但气度优雅，与当时的时代
背景相吻合。

The Skyline GT-R is an icon of the Japanese automotive industry.

But there may be no other car in Japan where its history and tradition...

...weighs so heavily on a designer.

In that respect, designing a GT-R today is not so different than designing a Porsche or a Ferrari.

Back when this R33 was built, a normal mid-size sporty sedan was the base.

So there was probably a lot of difficulties in its design.

Based on a three-box shape, the 4-seat production car...

...strictly adhered to its underlying philosophy as a "Wolf in Sheep's Clothing."

Also, because the beginning of the R33 development overlapped with the tail end of the economic bubble in Japan...

...the body of the R33 was large, heavy, and its style was stocky, but it was elegant in overall style.�

Japanese automotive industry.

turns.zh:
Skyline GT-R品牌是日本汽车工业的一个标志。

但也没有哪辆日本汽车的历史和传统会像这辆车一般……

对设计师产生如此大的压力。
有鉴于此，设计一辆GT-R的压力其实无异于设计一辆
保时捷或法拉利。

这辆R33在设计时以普通的中型运动型轿车为基础……

遇到很多设计上的难题也就无可避免。
在对这台四座三厢量产车进行改造时，

基本的理念是打造出了一匹“披着羊皮的狼”。
而且，由于R33的开发初期正好撞上了日本经济泡沫的
尾声，
因此，R33的车身既大且重，但气度优雅，与当时的时代
背景相吻合。

turns.raw:
A true sports car of Toyota making a 17-year comeback was this Supra.

In the model changes for the Celica, Toyota never tried to build a design identity for itself.

As if to keep denying its past, the company continued to be the innovator.

And that in itself commands respect, but the Celica is no more.

And the Supra for sure appeared on a blank canvas, without looking to the past, making a dazzling first appearance.

It shares a few components with the BMW Z4, but a different design direction successfully differentiated them.

The only thing that is a little disappointing...

...is that to effectively show the design of its body sides, you want a little more width.

You just can't help your eyes wandering towards the FT-1.W

turns.zh:
这辆Supra是丰田17年后卷土重来的真正跑车杰作。

从赛利卡变到Supra后，丰田并未尝试为它建立一个真正
的设计标识。

他们一直在追逐创新，仿佛是为了不断否定自己的过去。

赛利卡的确值得尊敬，但在Supra身上，你感受不到它的
一丝影子。
Supra无疑是在一块空白的画布上绘制的，在众人眼前
闪亮登场的它与过去的成就毫无牵连。

虽然和宝马Z4共享了相当多的部件，但两者的设计截
然不同，成功地将彼此区分开来。
唯一的小遗憾就是……

如果能加宽车体，就能更好地展示出车身两侧的设计。
我必须承认，它会让你不由自主地联想到那台永远停留
在概念里的丰田FT-1。<next id=2000706 type=9ۜ

A true sports car of Toyota making a 17-year comeback was this Supra.

In the model changes for the Celica, Toyota never tried to build a design identity for itself.

As if to keep denying its past, the company continued to be the innovator.

And that in itself commands respect, but the Celica is no more.

And the Supra for sure appeared on a blank canvas, without looking to the past, making a dazzling first appearance.

It shares a few components with the BMW Z4, but a different design direction successfully differentiated them.

The only thing that is a little disappointing...

...is that to effectively show the design of its body sides, you want a little more width.

You just can't help your eyes wandering towards the FT-1.W

turns.raw:
Look at this MR2, and you're likely to notice its modest, understated design.

In Italy, you'll find fierce beasts like the Urraco, named after a fighting bull, and the Merak.

These are flashy cars that really stand out, but they're not for the faint-hearted.

Let's just say that even when you handle them the right way, they can still bite back.

This MR2 is pretty domesticated in that respect, and does exactly what you tell it to do.

But that doesn't mean it's tame by any means. Put the pedal to the metal and you won't know what hit you!

Still, for a carefree driving experience, you can't go too wrong with this car.

It's one you'll want to make a place for in your heart and in your home.

You can recognize some elements inspired by Ferrari here and there, but all in all, it retains a certain modesty.

Perhaps this reflects Řhe belief of the Japanese designers that they weren't quite ready for the world stage...

...just yet.*

看看这辆MR2，它是如此地谦逊、低调。

在意大利，有着像Urraco这样的猛兽，以公牛的名字命
名，或是同样出名的Merak。

这些姿色出众的好车需要你拥有强大的气场才能驾驭。

这样说吧，就算你知道如何伺候好它们，还是会冷不防
地被它们回咬上一口。
这辆MR2相比之下就服帖多了。你说什么，它就做什么。

当然了，服帖不代表盲从，踩下油门的那一刻，你会瞬
间飞入云端！
拥有如此体贴入微的驾驶体验，怎么的驾驶方法都不会
出错。

这样的它，会让你想将之迎入家中，也迎入你的心里。
你可以在这里或那里瞥见一些与法拉利类似的元素
……但骨子里仍是日本人的谦逊有礼。

也许这反映出了当时的日本设计师的理解，认_��自己的
设计还没有达到世界级的水平

……但是只是暂时没有而已。,
turns.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka

In the transition of automotive design, fenders were originally just mud flaps that attached to the tires.

Just before and after World War II, fenders started to be integrated into the bodies.

And eventually the body sides came to be cut out in the shape of the tires.

In relation to this, the rear fenders of the Viper...

...is structured as a large volume that completely integrates the fender and doors.

And it shows the enormous traction to accommodate the 8.0-liter V-10 engine.

It changed the flow and direction of car design, which was moving towards abstract, multiple surfaces in the 1980s.

The soul of the American car guy is jam packed in these glamorous fenders.

This is how an American Sports car should be!

在汽车设计的漫长历史中，
挡泥板最初只是用于阻挡掀起的泥土的轮胎挡板。

但到了二战前后，设计师开始将挡泥板与车身融为一体。

为此，车身的侧面被切割出了轮胎的形状。
不过拿那种设计对照一下Viper的后挡泥板！

它们变成了车门的一部分，
更加突出了它相当大的体积……

以此展示出8升V10引擎无比强大的牵引力。
这项设计给80年代原本抽象、几何形的车身设计带来了
新的变化。
Viper在这些迷人的巨型挡泥板里灌注了美国汽车人的灵魂，

这才是美国跑车应该有的样子！
turns.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
