Whoa, now this is most impressive!　

The GT1 Turbo specs, brought on by some powerful tuning, has separated this automobile from the base model.

Because of that, the design of the original automobile...

...has been engulfed by the almost violent nature of the added-on parts...

...greatly changing its essence.

The S2000 was originally designed to make the front overhangs appear short...

...but the contrasting proportion of the nose, with its wedged shape design on this car...

...was only possible because of the front mid-engine layout of the S2000.

There's a lot of room for the intervention of design, especially in the details.

And, one can say that its taste comes from a perceived absence of design, making this car a lovable monster.\

这辆车令人非常印象深刻！

在接受了大量强化调校后，这辆GT1 Turbo spec已经变得
与基础车型截然不同。
你可以明显看出，几乎称得上是“暴力”的改装件
彻底颠覆了原车的模样，

可以说已经是台完全不同的车了！
虽说S2000的设计初衷是缩短前悬距……

但Amuse的最终成果却有悖常理地造就了GT1的长车头比例！
不得不说，它在细节和其他设计元素方面都有
长足的改进空间……

但这些“简陋”的呈现反而成了萌点，
使它成为了一头可爱的怪兽。<next id=2001006 type

turns.raw:
Whoa, now this is most impressive!　

The GT1 Turbo specs, brought on by some powerful tuning, has separated this automobile from the base model.

Because of that, the design of the original automobile...

...has been engulfed by the almost violent nature of the added-on parts...

...greatly changing its essence.

The S2000 was originally designed to make the front overhangs appear short...

...but the contrasting proportion of the nose, with its wedged shape design on this car...

...was only possible because of the front mid-engine layout of the S2000.

There's a lot of room for the intervention of design, especially in the details.

And, one can say that its taste comes from a perceived absence of design, making this car a lovable monster.\

彻底颠覆了原车的模样，

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf4Harada_normal__r34_gtr_v2_nur_02_2001105
turns.raw:
This car brings back the spirit of the original Skyline GT-R.

When you compare this car to the R33, the overall design has become compact and solid.

Looking at the abruptly cut-off front end, you get a sense of a modernized version of the C10 "Hakosuka."

The side glass graphics at the C-pillar are also reminiscent of the C10.

You can say that the different front and rear overfenders are take from the Hakosuka, too.

And while the enlarged round taillights are an homage to the C110, dubbed the "Ken-Meri..."

...this car is characterized by an uncommon Japanese design that's simple and powerful.

It's undeniable that the Nissan designers wanted to express the story of the Skyline GT-R through this car.

After all, the growth of a brand stems from love.*

are also reminiscent of the C10.

You can say that the different front and rear overfenders
are take from the Hakosuka, too.
And while the enlarged round taillights are an homage to the
C110, dubbed the "Ken-Meri..."

...this car is characterized by an uncommon Japanese design

It's undeniable that the Nissan designers wanted to express

After all, the growth of a brand stems from love.*
turns.zh:
这辆车再现了原版Skyline GT-R的风采。

与R33相比，它显得紧凑而又结实。
修整过的车头仿佛是C10 “Hakosuka”的
现代版诠释……
C柱处的侧窗玻璃贴花是如此，

甚至连前后不同尺寸的挡泥板也与C10有着深厚的渊源。
那对又大又圆的尾灯
则是对绰号“Ken-Meri”的C110的致敬……

其简约而有力的设计是在日本车中十分罕见的。
毫无疑问，日产的设计师希望通过这款车
展现出Skyline GT-R的背景故事。

我只能说，这绝对是真爱了。@
turns.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf4Harada_normal_zonda_r_09_2001205
turns.raw:
About Pagani's design...

...its approach is quite different from other traditional car makers from Modena.

Ferrari, Lamborghini, Maserati...

...most of their designs are born from historic cars that were on sale in the 1960s and 1970s...

...with body styles that were designed by a carrozzeria in Turin.

When the Zonda was introduced, at the end of the 1990s, the era of designs that shined 30 years before in Turin had concluded...

...thus, Pagani adopted its own unique design language.

It wasn't as if it was leaving all of its rivals in the past at once...

...but it sought to wrap sophisticated mechanisms with an attractive body, without being too flamboyant.

That kind of balance is what defines Pagani, I feel.
turns.en:

...its approach is quite different

...thus, Pagani adopted its own unique design language.
It wasn't as if it was leaving all of its rivals in the
past at once...
...but it sought to wrap sophisticated mechanisms
with an attractive body, without being too flamboyant.

That kind of balance is what defines Pagani, I feel.
turns.zh:
帕加尼的设计方法……

和来自摩德纳的其他传统汽车制造商大相径庭。
以法拉利、兰博基尼、玛莎拉蒂等为例，

他们的大部分设计都来自于在20世纪60年代和70年代
亮相的历史名车……

这些车的车身大多是交给都灵的车身制造商设计的。
当Zonda于20世纪90年代末期发布时，
持续30余年的都灵设计时代已经告一段落……

所以帕加尼首次采用了自己的设计语言。
倒不是说它将过去的对手彻底甩在了身后，
但它确实做出了创新尝试，将复杂的机械构造
装入具有吸引力、同时又不会过于喧宾夺主的车身当中。

这也造就了帕加尼设计特有的平衡感。
turns.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka

持续30余年的都灵设计时代已经告一段落……

所以帕加尼首次采用了自己的设计语言。
倒不是说它将过去的对手彻底甩在了身后，
但它确实做出了创新尝试，将复杂的机械构造
装入具有吸引力、同时又不会过于喧宾夺主的车身当中。

这也造就了帕加尼设计特有的平衡感。

turns.raw:
Oh boy, this is just crazy! That "5" I loved so much, what happened?

Just because it wanted to go fast in rallies, it didn't have to sell its soul to the devil!

It has become <20cm> wider, and if you look at it from the rear, it looks like a laughing Cheshire Cat.

And because the engine is mounted at the rear, it only seats two now.

But wait...

...upon closer examination, aside from the bulging fenders and bumpers, oh my, much of the original 5 is still there, as is.

Aside from the cheeks, the car has a gentle face, which means, it's more Clark Kent than the Hulk.

I mean, what kind of magic is this?

The interior of the Turbo 1 features a super modern Mario Bellini design.

This thing would be stylish, even in Paris!

Oh my! I think I've fallen in love with this crazy 5 Somebody, anybody, gimme some of this magic on my own 5.

turns.zh:
这真是太疯狂了！
他们对我熟悉的那台可爱的小“5”做了什么？

为了让它在拉力赛中有所建树，就非得
把它的灵魂出卖给魔鬼吗？
你看，它的车身整整变宽了20cm。
从背后看过去，就像一只咧嘴笑的柴郡猫。

由于搭载了一台后置引擎，它现在只剩下两个座位了。
等一下……

细看下来，除了隆起的挡泥板和保险杠以外——
哦，原版小“5”的大部分特征基本还是保留了！
不看侧面的话，它的前脸还是和原来一样，
所以还是更像肌肉分明的超人，而不是大块头绿巨人。

他们这是施展了什么样的巫术啊？
Turbo 1的内饰采用了马里奥·贝里尼设计的超现代风格。

就算走上巴黎的T台都不会显得格格不入！
哦，天呐！我想我已经爱上了这辆疯狂的小“5”。
事实上，我愿意接受它的一切！

turns.raw:
This vehicle was created for Vision Gran Turismo by Zagato, an Italian carrozzeria that was founded in 1919.

It's said to be styled after a sketch by Harada, the car's designer, while he studied at ArtCenter College of Design.

Although the three-dimensional composition looks complicated at first glance, each element is a very simple form.

Every module, one after another, intersects to complete the entire design.

Its traditional beauty as an FR sports car...

...exudes the feel from a traditional carrozzeria.

The power bulge on the hood pays homage to the 7.0-liter engine of the Iso Grifo.

And, the taillights were inspired by the Red Torii Gate at Miyajima of Aki in Japan.�
turns.en:
This vehicle was created for Vision Gran Turismo by Zagato,
an Italian carrozzeria that was founded in 1919.

It's said to be styled after a sketch by Harada, the car's
designer, while he studied at ArtCenter College of Design.
Although the three-dimensional composition looks complicated
at first glance, each element is a very simple form.

Every module, one after another, intersects
to complete the entire design.

Its traditional beauty as an FR sports car...

...exudes the feel from a traditional carrozzeria.
The power bulge on the hood
pays homage to the 7.0-liter engine of the Iso Grifo.
And, the taillights were inspired by the Red Torii Gate
at Miyajima of Aki in Japan.
turns.zh:
这台性能怪兽是由1919年成立于意大利的车身制造商扎加托
专为跑车浪漫旅愿景项目量身打造的。

此车的原型来自于公司设计师原田则彦
在艺术中心设计学院时期绘制的一张草图。
尽管它具有令人望而生畏的复杂三维结构，
但其实每个构成元素的形状都很简单。

通过各个简单模块的交错形成完整的车体。

此外，它还体现出了作为一辆前置后驱跑车的传统美感……

充分展现以手工打造闻名的老牌车身制造商的底蕴。
注意引擎盖上的凸起，这是对伊索狮鹫的7L引擎的致敬。
另一方面，尾灯的灵感则来自日本宫岛的红色鸟居。
turns.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka

turns.raw:
This vehicle was created for Vision Gran Turismo by Zagato, an Italian carrozzeria that was founded in 1919.

It's said to be styled after a sketch by Harada, the car's designer, while he studied at ArtCenter College of Design.

Although the three-dimensional composition looks complicated at first glance, each element is a very simple form.

Every module, one after another, intersects to complete the entire design.

Its traditional beauty as an FR sports car...

...exudes the feel from a traditional carrozzeria.

The power bulge on the hood pays homage to the 7.0-liter engine of the Iso Grifo.

And, the taillights were inspired by the Red Torii Gate at Miyajima of Aki in Japan.�

This vehicle was created for Vision Gran Turismo by Zagato,
an Italian carrozzeria that was founded in 1919.

It's said to be styled after a sketch by Harada, the car's
designer, while he studied at ArtCenter College of Design.
Although the three-dimensional composition looks complicated
at first glance, each element is a very simple form.

Every module, one after another, intersects
to complete the entire design.

Its traditional beauty as an FR sports car...

...exudes the feel from a traditional carrozzeria.
The power bulge on the hood
pays homage to the 7.0-liter engine of the Iso Grifo.
And, the taillights were inspired by the Red Torii Gate
at Miyajima of Aki in Japan.
turns.zh:
这台性能怪兽是由1919年成立于意大利的车身制造商扎加托
专为跑车浪漫旅愿景项目量身打造的。

此车的原型来自于公司设计师原田则彦
在艺术中心设计学院时期绘制的一张草图。
尽管它具有令人望而生畏的复杂三维结构，
但其实每个构成元素的形状都很简单。

通过各个简单模块的交错形成完整的车体。

此外，它还体现出了作为一辆前置后驱跑车的传统美感……

充分展现以手工打造闻名的老牌车身制造商的底蕴。
注意引擎盖上的凸起，这是对伊索狮鹫的7L引擎的致敬。
另一方面，尾灯的灵感则来自日本宫岛的红色鸟居。

turns.raw:
One of the roles design plays in industrial products is...

...to instantly convey information and the underlying message in a visual way that may not be noticed at first glance.

It is to project the functional excellence of the product, its philosophy, tradition and the creator's intent, instantly.

It's also supposed to draw the customer in by eliciting a "love at first sight" appeal.

Therefore, the look of products at times tries to appeal to many people at once, making many of them looking similar.

Bluntly put, design is usually dictated by the market.

But in the case of the Radical, this is not the case.

Whether it's a mountain road or the race track, all it needs to do is to go fast.

The headlight, for example, is simply required to shine a light forward.

Although seemingly unapproachable, this car knows its role. It’s a one-of-a-kind sidekick that requires a special love.

These types of cars make life entertaining, don't you think?i

turns.zh:
设计在工业产品制造中扮演的一个重要角色就是……

……要通过视觉手段即时地传递
第一眼可能看不出来的信息和潜台词。

要立刻呈现产品的功能优点、理念、传统和
创造者的想法。

还要通过营造出“一见钟情”的感受
来吸引到消费者。
因此，产品的外观设计有时会试图同时吸引和取悦不同类型的受众，
导致产品外观的趋同性。

说白了，设计大部分时候都受到市场的主导。
不过Radical却是个例外。

不论是山路还是赛道，它唯一的目的就是跑得更快。
比如说它的车头灯就只需要直直地照亮前方。
尽管这台车的声浪不够大、操控性不够友好，
但它很清楚自己的定位。

那就是成为独一无二、让你爱不释手的一_��老朋友。

这类车可以让你的人生充满乐趣，你觉得呢？

turns.raw:
In the 1980s, there was a very unique phenomenon in the history of automotive design. It was a time when the "boxy" style...

...was surely at its peak.

Blister fenders were the result of an attempt to marry round tires to a square body design.

This style is one of the defining symbols of this era.

The polyhedron body of the car here is minimalistic.

But despite its abstract form, its intonation is limited, and the exterior styling exudes extreme passion and excitement.

And because the car is seemingly pressed into an inorganic shape, the end effect is one that's relatively prominent.

turns.zh:
在1980年代，汽车设计的历史上掀起了一股非常独特的浪潮。

“四四方方”的设计理念在当时大行其道。
这部分微微鼓起的挡泥板就是这种思路的产物
——设计师们试图将轮胎的圆形和车身的方形轮廓融合起来。

这样的造型代表了那个年代的显著象征之一。
多边形车身非常抽象、简约。

虽然发出的音浪不大，
但成功通过外立面表达出了强烈的热情和兴奋感。
粗看下，这台车像是一团被捏合而成的无机物，
呈现出相对抢眼的最终效果。~
turns.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf4Harada_normal_datsun_240z_fugu_z_xx_2001905
turns.raw:
I think that the Fugu Z is a very appealing car.

The interior is especially cool because it's so carefully stripped down.

Only the bare minimum parts have been added, which match the car's power output that has nearly doubled.

The original 240Z was straightforward and had beautiful proportions...

...and this car is respectful of that with its minimal customization.

Look at the original fender mirrors, they're in the original Kilimanjaro White color.

It was as if a young person from California came upon a Z that was a bit rough around the edges...

...and polished it with the admiration he had of the car in the past.

And now...

...the raw pureness of the spirit of the 1973 Z shines brightly in the Fugu Z.

Thank you, Sung Kang!c

turns.zh:
我觉得Fugu Z是一辆充满魅力的车。

内饰经过了非常细致的精简，显得尤其炫酷。

这款车只最低限度地安装了必要的改装件，
与之相对的是几乎翻倍的动力输出。
原始车型240Z的设计本身就很简约，
但有着优美的车身比例……

……这台车很好地延续了这一风格，只进行了极少量的改装。
你瞧瞧这原版的挡泥板上装后视镜，
连油漆都是原版的乞力马扎罗白。

就好像是有个加州的年轻人遇上了一辆老爷车Z，
感怀它的破旧不堪……

……就抱着自己对这辆车的情怀对它进行了打磨。
而现在……

……1973 Z那最纯粹、最原始的精神
在Fugu Z的身上得到了灿烂重现。

姜成镐，谢谢你的付出！)

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf4Harada_normal_datsun_240z_fugu_z_xx_2001905
turns.raw:
I think that the Fugu Z is a very appealing car.

The interior is especially cool because it's so carefully stripped down.

Only the bare minimum parts have been added, which match the car's power output that has nearly doubled.

The original 240Z was straightforward and had beautiful proportions...

...and this car is respectful of that with its minimal customization.

Look at the original fender mirrors, they're in the original Kilimanjaro White color.

It was as if a young person from California came upon a Z that was a bit rough around the edges...

...and polished it with the admiration he had of the car in the past.

And now...

...the raw pureness of the spirit of the 1973 Z shines brightly in the Fugu Z.

Thank you, Sung Kang!c

turns.raw:
Now, this is what I call a British sports car!

The hardcore radical quality here is expressed throughout, from the interior to its exterior appearance.

The car's spirit is hardly diplomatic.

It's as if this vehicle is saying, "I have no desire to be a star to the public."

And, at the same time, it exemplifies the pure and naive love that we feel for sports cars.

On the sexy body, which sits extremely low for a front-engine car, there's a cold round detail that totally lacks emotion.

The hood, sculpted and low other than around the engine, and the corresponding trunk lid...

...express a powerful driving force.

In this regard, the styling goes well beyond what many would accept, for love sees no fault.

This design generates indifferent feelings, captivating only those who understand it.

turns.zh:
看啊，这才是我眼中真正的英国跑车！

从内饰到外观，这辆车浑身都散发着不羁和激进。

摒弃圆滑和世故，展现永不妥协的精神。
实际上，它似乎完全无意迎合大众口味。

与此同时，它也向我们表达了对一款纯血、直击本质的
跑车的热爱。
对于一辆前置引擎车来说，它的车身异常低矮流畅，
圆弧的车身细节也显得极度冷漠，不带一丝感情。

引擎盖深深下凹，只有引擎位置高高隆起，
行李箱盖处也采用了同样的设计……
……露出一副动力充盈、跃跃欲试的模样。

其外观设计已经远超大众能够接受的审美范围，
唯有真正的爱好者方能欣赏。
这是一款必然引发争议的设计，只对那些懂它的人
散发无穷魅力。
turns.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka

On the sexy body, which sits extremely low for a front-engine car, there's a cold round detail that totally lacks emotion.

The hood, sculpted and low other than around the engine, and the corresponding trunk lid...

...express a powerful driving force.

In this regard, the styling goes well beyond what many would accept, for love sees no fault.

This design generates indifferent feelings, captivating only those who understand it.

看啊，这才是我眼中真正的英国跑车！

从内饰到外观，这辆车浑身都散发着不羁和激进。

摒弃圆滑和世故，展现永不妥协的精神。
实际上，它似乎完全无意迎合大众口味。

与此同时，它也向我们表达了对一款纯血、直击本质的
跑车的热爱。
对于一辆前置引擎车来说，它的车身异常低矮流畅，
圆弧的车身细节也显得极度冷漠，不带一丝感情。

引擎盖深深下凹，只有引擎位置高高隆起，
行李箱盖处也采用了同样的设计……
……露出一副动力充盈、跃跃欲试的模样。

其外观设计已经远超大众能够接受的审美范围，
唯有真正的爱好者方能欣赏。
这是一款必然引发争议的设计，只对那些懂它的人
散发无穷魅力。

turns.raw:
From its GP machines to the Royales, Bugatti pushed the automobile horizon in many directions in the pre-war era.

Especially in regard to design, Jean Bugatti of the Bugatti family...

Ensured that the company's cars were dynamic in nature and possessed originality that was recognizable at a glance.

However, at the same time, the cars also combined a certain sublimeness and acceptance of classic aesthetics.

Even the Veyron's styling suggested that it was one level apart from its rivals from Modena, Italy.

The traditional wedge-shaped formula was completely discarded...

While the roofline and fenders were presented in natural harmony, flowing down to the rear of the car.

The car's elegant lines are uninterrupted, running smoothly around its body—a joy to trace with your eyes.

The styling expresses a euphoric art nouveau expression� It makes me respect Jean Bugatti all the more.Y

从GP赛车再到皇家，布加迪在二战前
就将汽车的边界向各个方向大幅扩展。

特别是在设计上，布加迪家族的让·布加迪……

负责确保这家公司的所有汽车都拥有动感的本质和
一目了然的原创性。

与此同时，布加迪推出的车也结合了威严感
以及对传统美学的接纳。
这辆布加迪Veryron的风格设计就表现出了它与
来自意大利摩德纳的竞争对手的截然不同。

它彻底地弃用了传统的楔形车身设计……
从车顶到挡泥板的线条自然而和谐，
流泻到车尾。

从一而终的优雅线条沿车身顺滑地向后延伸，
带动你的眼神去追寻，赏心悦目。
这种造型风格表达了一种幸福、陶醉感的新艺术派理念。
也让我对让·布加迪更加肃然起敬。
turns.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka

turns.raw:
This is originally a machine meant for the track, so it's not street legal.

But the design has not been compromised one bit.

It conveys an expression of violent performance combined with the classic beauty that defines Aston Martin.

Having these attributes simultaneously gives this car a Jekyll-and-Hyde design quality.

From a nose that looks like it's about to eat the car ahead to the low skirts and the underside of the rear diffuser...

A strange power resonates from the tissues and internal organs that make up this carbon-fiber machine.

They speak plainly about the origins and intent of this car.

The British-style understatement of the DB series is something that transcends eccentricity.

It is the glorious madness that defines today's Aston Martin.e

turns.zh:
这辆车原本是专为赛道设计的比赛机器，
所以并不能合法在城市道路上行驶。

尽管如此，它的设计并未作出丝毫的妥协。
这辆车结合了暴力的性能和经典的美感，

turns.raw:
The large air intakes placed on the side of the body are reminiscent of elegant French styling of the 1930s.

However, I sense it is slightly mismatched with the wild example of the coda tronca body style.

In the Veyron, the intakes are placed there to improve aerodynamics.

They make the sides look a bit like a French carrosserie or the Delage D6 of Henri Labourdette.

This is a beautiful flamboyant French design, one where the function-defining form to travel at <400km>...

Makes modern-day Bugattis so alluring, don't you think?

It's my fondest hope that they always remain sublime and pure.*
turns.en:
The large air intakes placed on the side of the body are
reminiscent of elegant French styling of the 1930s.
However, I sense it is slightly mismatched with the
wild example of the coda tronca body style.

or the Delage D6 of Henri Labourdette.

This is a beautiful flamboyant French design, one where
the function-defining form to travel at 400km...

Makes modern-day Bugattis so alluring, don't you think?
It's my fondest hope that they always remain
sublime and pure.*
turns.zh:
位于车身两侧的大号进气口令人回忆起1930年代
的那些优雅法国车造型。
不过我总感觉这种风格和“coda tronca”（断尾）
的设计有些不搭。

在Veyron上，在这里设计进气口是为了提升空气动力学性能。
这样的设计让侧面的外观向法式车身靠拢，
又有点类似亨利·拉布戴特的Delage D6。

美观到有些浮夸的法系设计，
外加能够达到400km极速的超跑定位……

让现代版本的Bugatti充满了魅力，对吧？
在此致以我最美好的愿望，希望他们可以
永远保持卓越和纯粹。
turns.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka

The large air intakes placed on the side of the body are reminiscent of elegant French styling of the 1930s.

However, I sense it is slightly mismatched with the wild example of the coda tronca body style.

In the Veyron, the intakes are placed there to improve aerodynamics.

They make the sides look a bit like a French carrosserie or the Delage D6 of Henri Labourdette.

This is a beautiful flamboyant French design, one where the function-defining form to travel at <400km>...

Makes modern-day Bugattis so alluring, don't you think?

It's my fondest hope that they always remain sublime and pure.*

turns.zh:
位于车身两侧的大号进气口令人回忆起1930年代
的那些优雅法国车造型。
不过我总感觉这种风格和“coda tronca”（断尾）
的设计有些不搭。

在Veyron上，在这里设计进气口是为了提升空气动力学性能。
这样的设计让侧面的外观向法式车身靠拢，
又有点类似亨利·拉布戴特的Delage D6。

美观到有些浮夸的法系设计，
外加能够达到400km极速的超跑定位……

让现代版本的Bugatti充满了魅力，对吧？
在此致以我最美好的愿望，希望他们可以
永远保持卓越和纯粹。
turns.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka

turns.raw:
There are a variety of ways to express your passion for cars.

This machine is a 1951 Ford.

Not only has it been lowered, the roof has been left intact, and the body itself has been made thinner.

The engine is from a Lincoln of the same era.

The car creators pulled off in real life what designers today would only attempt on a computer screen.

Cars from this era were simple to tune, having the potential for customization unlike those of today.

Find a basic design that you fancy, and then inject your own sense of beauty and experience into it...

...and you have your own one-of-a-kind masterpiece.

Every detail of this car is a 100-percent reflection of the tastes and experiences of the car owner and creator.

Compare it with today’s exotic cars that await customers in the showrooms, which one do you think stands ou� more?�

turns.zh:
表达对爱车的热情的方式可谓五花八门。

这是一辆1951年的福特。
它的全车车身经过了降低，没有锯掉车顶，
但整车外壳接受了打薄处理。

它的引擎来自于一辆同时期的林肯。

这辆车的创造者赤手空拳就做到了如今的汽车设计师们
只敢借助电脑才能完成的事。
与今天的车不同，来自那个时代的车辆易于调校，
也有很大的改装潜力。

找一辆你中意的基础车型，然后将你的美学与经验
倾注其中……

就能拥有一辆独一无二的杰作。
这辆车上的每个细节都100%体现了它的所有者
与创造者的品味与经验。
与如今静静地在展厅中等待着买家的豪车相比，
你更喜欢哪一辆呢？"

There are a variety of ways to express your passion for cars.

This machine is a 1951 Ford.

Not only has it been lowered, the roof has been left intact, and the body itself has been made thinner.

The engine is from a Lincoln of the same era.

The car creators pulled off in real life what designers today would only attempt on a computer screen.

Cars from this era were simple to tune, having the potential for customization unlike those of today.

Find a basic design that you fancy, and then inject your own sense of beauty and experience into it...

...and you have your own one-of-a-kind masterpiece.

Every detail of this car is a 100-percent reflection of the tastes and experiences of the car owner and creator.

Compare it with today’s exotic cars that await customers in the showrooms, which one do you think stands ou� more?�

turns.zh:
表达对爱车的热情的方式可谓五花八门。

这是一辆1951年的福特。
它的全车车身经过了降低，没有锯掉车顶，
但整车外壳接受了打薄处理。

它的引擎来自于一辆同时期的林肯。

这辆车的创造者赤手空拳就做到了如今的汽车设计师们
只敢借助电脑才能完成的事。
与今天的车不同，来自那个时代的车辆易于调校，
也有很大的改装潜力。

找一辆你中意的基础车型，然后将你的美学与经验
倾注其中……

就能拥有一辆独一无二的杰作。
这辆车上的每个细节都100%体现了它的所有者
与创造者的品味与经验。
与如今静静地在展厅中等待着买家的豪车相比，
你更喜欢哪一辆呢？"
turns.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka

turns.raw:
Today, the WRX STI has grown into a model with its own distinct identity...

...representing Subaru’s engineering capability, technical efficiency and focus on high performance.

But the second-generation WRX STI remained closely tied to the Impreza.

And that connection gave its character a unique appeal.

It effectively reflected the idea of an everyday sedan transformed into a serious performance machine.

With the newer WRX, however, the base model already carried a more aggressive character, making the contrast less pronounced.

If you’re drawn to that sense of transformation—like Peter Parker becoming Spider-Man...

...then this second-generation model, with its clean, understated cabin and simpler window design, may be just right for you.~

turns.zh:
时至今日，WRX STi已经……

拥有了自己独立的品牌价值和存在意义，它代表着
斯巴鲁的技术实力与热情。
有鉴于第二代WRX STi是翼豹的改款版本之一……

使得它的设计完美体现了我们常用来打趣的那句俗语……

“文能出门买菜，武可拉力比赛。”
相比之下，新一代WRX的出厂版本就已经颇具进攻性，
所以新型号上的文武之分就没有那么鲜明了。

因此，如果你想看到的是彼得·帕克
变身成为蜘蛛侠那种迥然相异的反差……
那么内饰朴实简洁，且没有配备三角形后车窗的
第二代WRX将是你的不二选择。
turns.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka

turns.raw:
The Evo’s history is marked by constant improvements and functional expansions.

This MR version was the final model of the third-gen Evo IX, and is said to be one of the best Evos ever.

The third-generation car was based on the Lancer Cedia, which, in turn, was a serious and practical family sedan.

Compared to the second-generation model, it was larger overall. The nose took on a rounded shape, while blister fenders were adopted.

Not quite the battle machine it used to be...

...the large iconic fog lights, reminiscent of rally cars, were done away with.

turns.raw:
If my memory serves me right, I used to be called the Ford Mustang Mach 1.

I’d was dormant for a long time, but when I awoke everything had changed.

I can't sit still. How I wish to burn rubber, driving with all my might!

The power my heart pumps is twice what it used to be.

My tires are larger, and my width, increased.

Now I can hardly recall who I am!

Cherished fragments of my former self remain, in my window shield, headlights, tail, and door.

People say that this is what they love about me.

But I am also a monster, so filled-up with parts that my heart had to be moved back.

The Mach 40... Yes, that is the name of my new self. 
turns.en:
If my memory serves me right, I used to be called
the Ford Mustang Mach 1.

I’d was dormant for a long time, but when I awoke
everything had changed.
I can't sit still. How I wish to burn rubber,
driving with all my might!

The power my heart pumps is twice what it used to be.

My tires are larger, and my width, increased.

Now I can hardly recall who I am!
Cherished fragments of my former self remain, in my window
shield, headlights, tail, and door.

People say that this is what they love about me.

But I am also a monster, so filled-up with parts that
my heart had to be moved back.
The Mach 40... Yes, that is the name of my new self.
turns.zh:
如果我没有记错的话，我曾经被人们称为
“福特Mustang Mach 1”。

我曾在沉寂中度过了很长一段时间，但当我重新苏醒时，
我发现一切都已完全不同。
我不能置身事外。我多么渴望尽情释放自己的力量，
全力行驶，让车轮橡胶冒出阵阵青烟！

我心脏的跳动力量是过去的两倍。

我的轮胎变得更加宽大，我的车身变得更加宽阔。

现在我几乎忘记了自己的本来模样！
代表过去的细微特征只在挡风玻璃、前灯、尾部和车门上得以保留。

人们说这些是他们喜欢我的地方。

但我也变成了一辆动力怪兽，身体里被塞入了各种新的零部件，
以至于我的心脏不得不重新找地方安置。
“Mach 40”……是的，这就是我的新名字。
turns.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka

I can't sit still. How I wish to burn rubber, driving with all my might!

The power my heart pumps is twice what it used to be.

My tires are larger, and my width, increased.

Now I can hardly recall who I am!

Cherished fragments of my former self remain, in my window shield, headlights, tail, and door.

People say that this is what they love about me.

But I am also a monster, so filled-up with parts that my heart had to be moved back.

The Mach 40... Yes, that is the name of my new self. 

turns.raw:
The 997 restores some of what was lost in the transition from the 993 to the 996, while adding some subtle upgrades.

A few of these elements have become something that is unique to Porsche.

A good example of this is where the turn signals are integrated with the bumper's air intake opening.

Such refined details may be small by themselves, however they increase the overall quality and uniformity of the design.
turns.en:

Such refined details may be small by themselves, however they

turns.zh:
997这款车带回了Porsche从993过渡到996时失去的
一些东西，并对细节做了部分改进。

其中的一些升级最终成为了Porsche的标准元素。
这里有一个很好的例子，就是将转向灯与保险杠的进风
口融为一体。

这些改进本身可能很微小，但提高了设计的品质，还有助
于提升车辆的整体性。
turns.speaker: Tom Matano

The 997 restores some of what was lost in the transition from the 993 to the 996, while adding some subtle upgrades.

A few of these elements have become something that is unique to Porsche.

A good example of this is where the turn signals are integrated with the bumper's air intake opening.

Such refined details may be small by themselves, however they increase the overall quality and uniformity of the design.

turns.zh:
997这款车带回了Porsche从993过渡到996时失去的
一些东西，并对细节做了部分改进。

其中的一些升级最终成为了Porsche的标准元素。
这里有一个很好的例子，就是将转向灯与保险杠的进风
口融为一体。

这些改进本身可能很微小，但提高了设计的品质，还有助
于提升车辆的整体性。

Mr. Tsutomu Matano is also famous for having
worked on the Mazda MX-5 Miata Roadster.

He's worked in Europe and America for quite a while now,
and goes by the first name "Tom."
turns.zh:
哇，俣野先生，能见到您实在是我们的荣幸！

俣野努先生因参与设计Mazda MX-5 Miata Roadster
而被人们所熟知。

他在欧洲和美国等地也工作过相当长一段时间，是行业
内众所周知的大师“俣野汤姆”先生。
turns.speaker: Sarah

turns.raw:
You know, from the start, I wanted to give this Roadster a timeless design.

It’s full of that sentiment which compels an owner to wish their car a goodnight.

I've even heard of fans who chose to sleep in it the very first day they had it in their garage.

Truly, it’s the car you’ll name, throw birthday parties for and one day lovingly restore...x
turns.en:
You know, from the start, I wanted to give this Roadster
a timeless design.
It’s full of that sentiment which compels an owner
to wish their car a goodnight.
I've even heard of fans who chose to sleep in it
the very first day they had it in their garage.

Truly, it’s the car you’ll name, throw birthday parties for

turns.zh:
你知道吗，从一开始我就想让这款Roadster成为永不褪
色的设计。
我希望它能完整传递一种情绪，让车主们会在睡前对自
己的爱车道“晚安”……
而且我确实听说过有车迷在买完车的第一天，睡在了车
里。

我希望这是一辆你会特地为它取名、为它庆生的车，并
在某一天将它恢复到最佳状态……
turns.speaker: Tom Matano

turns.raw:
There was this one time I received a wedding invitation from a total stranger living in Texas.

And I thought to myself, 'Maybe its an owner of a Roadster?' So I contacted the Roadster Club of Texas...

And found out that the happy couple had met at the club, and that one had a red car while the other a white one.

Unfortunately I wasn't able to attend the wedding,

But a year later I received word that they had given birth to a baby!

So I painted a miniature model of a Roadster in Pink and sent it to them.

Being able to connect with owners like this is really gratifying for me as a designer.

turns.zh:
有一次，我收到一封喜帖，是住在德克萨斯的陌生人寄
来的。

我心想，“也许这是一位敞篷跑车车主”？然后我联系了
德克萨斯的敞篷跑车俱乐部。

我发现这对夫妇就是通过俱乐部认识的，他们一个人开
红车，一个人开白车
很遗憾我无法抽身参加那场婚礼，

然后过了一年，我又收到了一条消息，他们有了一个宝
宝！

于是我涂了一个粉色的敞篷跑车模型送给他们。
可以像这样和车主们产生交流和联系，令身为设计师的
我感到万分满足。
如果没有开发这台车的同事们投注的热情，也不可能促
成这样的美事。
turns.speaker: Tom Matano

我心想，“也许这是一位敞篷跑车车主”？然后我联系了

红车，一个人开白车
很遗憾我无法抽身参加那场婚礼，

然后过了一年，我又收到了一条消息，他们有了一个宝
宝！

可以像这样和车主们产生交流和联系，令身为设计师的
我感到万分满足。
如果没有开发这台车的同事们投注的热情，也不可能促
成这样的美事。

You know, I used to drive my friend's PGC10 GT-R a lot.

That’s what got me into sports sedans, which I consider to be a "wolf in sheep’s clothing".

Now, this here is the model that set the basic formula for the modern GT-R.

At first glance, it evokes a clear sense of volume.

And by weighing down the rear fender, the designers made the car look like it was in motion even when standing still.

This allowed the GT-R to strike a more aggressive stance than the base GT model.

Also...

...it marked the beginning of the era of sensor-controlled vehicle dynamics and other high-performance technologies.

All of this makes the current GT-R the rightful heir to this R32 GTR.

turns.zh:
我过去常常开我朋友的PGC10 GT-R，所以对它非常熟悉。

运动型轿车给人一种“披着羊皮的狼”的感觉，
这正是这种车型最吸引我的地方。
我现在要介绍的这款车为现代GT-R确立了基本范式。
首先，它表现出一种清晰的体积感。

然后，设计师通过压低后挡板的重心，
让此车有一种蹲伏起跑、跃跃欲试的感觉。
从而赋予了GT-R超越GT的定位。
此外……

从这个型号开始，由传感器来控制车辆动力
和其他高性能附加套件的时代揭开了序幕。

这一切都足以证明这台R32 GT-R正是当代GT-R系列的鼻祖。
turns.speaker: Tom Matano

turns.raw:
I got a call one day from my protégé at Mazda Design asking for my thoughts on the design of the fourth-gen Miata.

I told him that I wrote a scenario for the first three generations at the beginning of the NA project.

I normally look forward 20-25 years ahead from the start of a project.

Therefore, I had no ideas for the fourth-gen car, except the following:

If it was to be mechanically similar, then the design should...

...differ more from the NA to NB, and NB to NC.

If the car was to be mechanically new...

...with an innovative layout or different type of powertrain, then it should be evolutionary.

I never got to see the design of the fourth-gen development at any stage.

When I asked the designers how things were going? Their answer was always...

“Don’t worry, you guided us to do the right thing.”

They actually didn't want to show me the car...

...even on the night before the world premiere event.

Enough was enough, so I made my stand.

I told them that “You know that I can't keep a poker face.”

"Whatever I see or feel shows on my face. I can't help it."

"Can you risk that happening tomorrow?”

They thought about that for a moment, and they came to the correct conclusion.

They finally showed me the car, and do you know what I th�ught?

The fourth-generation car was designed in the right direction, indeed.
turns.en:
I got a call one day from my protégé at Mazda Design asking
for my thoughts on the design of the fourth-gen Miata.
I told him that I wrote a scenario for the first three
generations at the beginning of the NA project.

I normally look forward 20-25 years ahead
from the start of a project.

Therefore, I had no ideas for the fourth-gen car,
except the following:
 If it was to be mechanically similar,
then the design should...

...differ more from the NA to NB, and NB to NC.
If the car was to be mechanically new...

...with an innovative layout or different type of
powertrain, then it should be evolutionary.

 I never got to see the design of the
fourth-gen development at any stage.

When I asked the designers how things were going?
Their answer was always...

“Don’t worry, you guided us
to do the right thing.”
 They actually didn't want to show me the car...

...even on the night before
the world premiere event.

Enough was enough, so I made my stand.

 I told them that
“You know that I can't keep a poker face.”

"Whatever I see or feel shows on my face.
I can't help it."

"Can you risk that happening tomorrow?”

They thought about that for a moment,
and they came to the correct conclusion.

They finally showed me the car, and do you know
what I th�ught?

The fourth-generation car was designed in the right
direction, indeed.
turns.zh:
有一天，我接到来自在马自达设计工作的一位弟子的电话。

他询问我是否为第四代Miata Roadster做过类似的设计规划。
我有个习惯，每当我开启一个项目时，
我都会尝试想象它在之后20年里的演变。

所以我是这样告诉他的。

我说，我在NA项目启动的时候，就已经
为前三代都写好了方案……

但对于第四代而言……

我暂时没有什么具体的想法。
不过我又补充了一句，
如果机械结构上没有太大变化的话，那么设计方面……

相较于从NA到NB以及从NB到NC的演化，
应该体现出更大的变化。

此外……
如果这辆车在机械结构上是全新的，
应用了创新的布局或不同的传动系统……

那么在外观方面也应该体现出充分的演化。

在此之后，我��直没机会参与到第四代Roadster的开发当中。

每当我询问设计师们事情进展如何时，他们都会叫我放心。

“不用担心，”他们总是这样说。

“您给我们指出了一条正确的道路。”
事实上，直到新车全球首发的前一天晚上，
他们都还在想方设法对我保密。

我后来忍不住了。

我对他们说：“我是个藏不住事的人。
万一明天我一不小心当众露�7�失望表情，你们打算怎么办？”

他们这才让我看到了新车，你猜怎么着？

第四代的设计方向走得很踏实。
turns.speaker: Tom Matano

I was involved on the first E30 M3...

...while I was working on the beginning of the E36.

Today, the 3 Series coupe is known as the 4 Series, and the M3 became M4.

I still prefer the old M3 naming, however.

This car here is the most purposefully designed BMW...

...that possesses the true spirit of the M-performance package.

It has the right amount of details like front air intakes that cool the brakes...

...to side air-outlets with the M accent.

It has an extremely athletic look that exemplifies sporty and elegant design.V
turns.en:
I have a soft spot for the M3.

I was involved on the first E30 M3...

...while I was working on the beginning of the E36.
Today, the 3 Series coupe is known as the 4 Series,
and the M3 became M4.

I still prefer the old M3 naming, however.
This car here is the most purposefully designed BMW...

...that possesses the true spirit of the M-performance package.
It has the right amount of details like front air intakes

...to side air-outlets with the M accent.
It has an extremely athletic look

turns.zh:
我对M3情有独钟。

当我们开始开发E36系列的时候……

我还同时承担了E30 M3的开发工作。
现在，3系的双门轿跑车已经被BMW改称为“4系”，
M3也跟着变成了“M4”。

但我仍然喜欢M3。
它是目的性最明确的BMW……

其设计主旨与M性能套件的运动精神完全契合。
细节上的配置也相当到位，例如冷却刹车的前进气口……

以及带有“M”系凌厉风格的侧面进气风道。
仿佛一位穿上设计师品牌运动外套的运动员，
集运动和时尚优雅于一身。
turns.speaker: Tom Matano

他在欧洲和美国等地也工作过相当长一段时间，是行业
内众所周知的大师“俣野汤姆”。

turns.raw:
My buddy had bought one when it came out. I was impressed with how beautiful the engine looked.

It possessed all the right components that make a sports car.

But it was scaled proportionally to match the body size of a kei-car...

...just like the original FIAT 500.

I loved that short stroke 5-speed shifter. It had a tight mechanical feel to it.

However, it became notchy often.

That’s why I wanted the Miata to have a short stroke shifter...

...without the notchiness, of course.g
turns.en:
My buddy had bought one when it came out.
I was impressed with how beautiful the engine looked.

It possessed all the right components that make a sports car.
But it was scaled proportionally to match the
body size of a kei-car...

...just like the original FIAT 500.
I loved that short stroke 5-speed shifter.
It had a tight mechanical feel to it.

However, it became notchy often.
That’s why I wanted the Miata to have a short stroke shifter...

...without the notchiness, of course.
turns.zh:
我正好有位朋友在这部车发售时买过一辆。
我记得当时我就被这台漂亮的引擎给打动了。

它具备一台真正跑车的所有要素，
只是在设计时按照轻型车的尺寸需要被按比例缩小了。

就像原版的FIAT 500一样！
我真的太喜欢它这台短行程的5速手动变速器了。
它可以为你提供扎实、机械的手感……

虽然确实时不时会出一些小毛病。
是它帮助我下定决心为Miata配备了短行程变速箱……

当然，我们的变速箱没有那些小毛病。?
turns.speaker: Tom Matano

But it was scaled proportionally to match the
body size of a kei-car...

...just like the original FIAT 500.
I loved that short stroke 5-speed shifter.
It had a tight mechanical feel to it.

However, it became notchy often.
That’s why I wanted the Miata to have a short stroke shifter...

...without the notchiness, of course.

我正好有位朋友在这部车发售时买过一辆。
我记得当时我就被这台漂亮的引擎给打动了。

它具备一台真正跑车的所有要素，
只是在设计时按照轻型车的尺寸需要被按比例缩小了。

就像原版的FIAT 500一样！
我真的太喜欢它这台短行程的5速手动变速器了。
它可以为你提供扎实、机械的手感……

虽然确实时不时会出一些小毛病。
是它帮助我下定决心为Miata配备了短行程变速箱……

当然，我们的变速箱没有那些小毛病。?

turns.en:
Wow, Mr. Matano, it's truly an honor!

Mr. Tsutomu Matano is known for his work on
the Mazda MX-5 Miata Roadster.

He's worked in Europe and America for quite a while now,
and is widely known as Tom Matano.-
turns.zh:
哇，俣野先生，能见到您实在是我们的荣幸！

俣野努先生因参与设计Mazda MX-5 Miata Roadster
而被人们所熟知。

他在欧洲和美国等地也工作过相当长一段时间，是行业
内众所周知的大师“俣野汤姆”。
turns.speaker: Sarah

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf5Tom_normal_rx8_spirit_r_12_2100705
turns.raw:
I was also involved with the design of the “FD."

I thought that this FR layout sports car at $30K range above the MX-5 would be the last model as the RX-7 as we knew it.

If Mazda were to develop a next-generation RX model...

...I expected that it would have to have a mid-engine layout at a much higher price point.

Then, when the FD replacement project started.

I was torn because we were going to replace the timeless design of the FD...

...with a completely new one.

Luckily, it became 4-seater and a totally different concept.
turns.en:
I was also involved with the design of the “FD."

I thought that this FR layout sports car at $30K range above
the MX-5 would be the last model as the RX-7 as we knew it.
If Mazda were to develop a next-generation
RX model...

...I expected that it would have to have a mid-engine layout
at a much higher price point.
Then, when the FD replacement project started.

 I was torn because we were going to replace the
timeless design of the FD...

...with a completely new one.
Luckily, it became 4-seater and a totally different concept.
turns.zh:
我确实参与了“FD”的一部分工作。

当时，我们都以为它会是我们挚爱的RX-7系车型
的最后一款……
而且，如果要开发下一代的话……

应该会采用中置引擎布局，还要调高售价。
再后来，FD的替换项目启动了。

一开始我有点纠结，因为我们不得不把我心目中
永不过时的设计……

替换成一个全新的设计。
幸好，最终的4座车车型
成功展现出了完全不同的概念。'
turns.speaker: Tom Matano

turns.raw:
This car was introduced as a baby Aston to make it affordable and attract a broader audience.

The design of this car was unmistakably “Aston Martin." In fact, it looked much more trim and agile than other Astons.

In my opinion, I prefer the Vantage V8...

...more than its much heavier and larger siblings.

Later, the company put a V-12 into this tight package.

With that, this Aston made my list of ideal cars.
turns.en:
This car was introduced as a baby Aston to make it affordable
and attract a broader audience.

The design of this car was unmistakably “Aston Martin."
In fact, it looked much more trim and agile than other Astons.
In my opinion, I prefer the Vantage V8...

...more than its much heavier
and larger siblings.

 Later, the company put a V-12 into this tight package.

With that, this Aston made my list of ideal cars.
turns.zh:
为了宣传这款车的亲民价格，吸引更多的受众，
官方给它起了一个绰号，“阿斯顿宝宝”。

它的设计充分地彰显了“Aston Martin”的特色。
与其他车型对比，它看上去更苗条，也更敏捷。
相比于那些体积更大、重量更重的姊妹车型……

……我个人更偏爱这款Vantage V8。

后来，设计师们还将一部V12引擎
塞进了它紧凑的引擎盖下。

有了这项升级，这款Aston Martin也
顺理成章变成了我的理想车型之一。;

This car was introduced as a baby Aston to make it affordable and attract a broader audience.

The design of this car was unmistakably “Aston Martin." In fact, it looked much more trim and agile than other Astons.

In my opinion, I prefer the Vantage V8...

...more than its much heavier and larger siblings.

Later, the company put a V-12 into this tight package.

With that, this Aston made my list of ideal cars.

This car was introduced as a baby Aston to make it affordable
and attract a broader audience.

The design of this car was unmistakably “Aston Martin."
In fact, it looked much more trim and agile than other Astons.
In my opinion, I prefer the Vantage V8...

and larger siblings.

 Later, the company put a V-12 into this tight package.

turns.zh:
为了宣传这款车的亲民价格，吸引更多的受众，
官方给它起了一个绰号，“阿斯顿宝宝”。

它的设计充分地彰显了“Aston Martin”的特色。
与其他车型对比，它看上去更苗条，也更敏捷。
相比于那些体积更大、重量更重的姊妹车型……

……我个人更偏爱这款Vantage V8。

后来，设计师们还将一部V12引擎
塞进了它紧凑的引擎盖下。

有了这项升级，这款Aston Martin也
顺理成章变成了我的理想车型之一。;
turns.speaker: Tom Matano

turns.raw:
This is the seventh-generation Golf GTI.

The first GTI established the high-performance three-box hatchback theme...

That is still very popular around the world.

Since then, the GTI has undergone several evolutions.

While there were a few duds over the years, this GTI was definitely a ‘hit’.

The size of the car has been gradually growing with each evolution.

This seventh-generation model got everything right, from the way it sits to the way it moves.

Not only were these elements balanced, but together they contributed to creating something better.
turns.en:
This is the seventh-generation Golf GTI.

The first GTI established the high-performance
three-box hatchback theme...

That is still very popular around the world.

Since then, the GTI has undergone several evolutions.
While there were a few duds over the years,
this GTI was definitely a ‘hit’.

The size of the car has been gradually
growing with each evolution.

This seventh-generation model got everything right,
from the way it sits to the way it moves.
Not only were these elements balanced, but together
they contributed to creating something better.
turns.zh:
这是一辆七代Golf GTI。

它采用三厢掀背设计，并搭载动力强劲的性能套件。
这也是从初代起就确定的设计思路。

每一代Golf GTI的推出，都会经历一些演化和改变。
多年以来，有些改变成功了，而另一些则不尽如人意。
这一台，是成功的幸运儿之一。

历代的车身尺寸在演化中逐步扩大，

这一代的Golf GTI就做到了将所有的要素搭配地恰到好处。
它们的结合形成了运动的姿态，强大的气势和灵活性，
同时还散发出一种和谐感与力量感。
turns.speaker: Tom Matano

turns.raw:
This is where Jeep culture started.

A purely functional design to meet military needs.

Now, the form-follows-function approach doesn’t always guarantee success.

Only on rare occasions does it work—and in this case the vehicle became an icon.

The engineers who worked on this program...

Must have had a good sense of proportion and high design standards.

They knew precisely where to work their magic.

In some cases, the depth of the flanges helped to strengthen the panels so that thinner pieces could be used.

Truly impressive work!
turns.en:
This is where Jeep culture started.

A purely functional design to meet military needs.

Now, the form-follows-function approach doesn’t
always guarantee success.

Only on rare occasions does it work—and in this case
the vehicle became an icon.
The engineers who worked on this program...

Must have had a good sense of proportion
and high design standards.
They knew precisely where to work their magic.
In some cases, the depth of the flanges helped to strengthen
the panels so that thinner pieces could be used.

Truly impressive work!
turns.zh:
这辆原版车款就是整个Jeep文化的起点。

作为服役车辆，它的设计完全强调功能性。

这种外形为功能服务的设计出发点
显然无法保证美学上的成功。

或者我应该说，成功的几率绝无仅有。
而这样的成功就落在了Jeep身上，缔造出了汽车史上的经典符号。
参与这项开发计划的工程师们……

……很好地掌握了比例的概念，
并且对设计品质有极高的标准。
他们将外观的弧度与半径计算得分毫不差。
例如，他们会通过采用凹陷度更深的轮缘来强化板件的刚度，
以削减板材厚度，达到减重的效果。

光凭这一点，就值得我们向那些早期设计者们脱帽致敬。
turns.speaker: Tom Matano

turns.raw:
Both Ferrari and Pininfarina have a certain philosophy.

And that philosophy is that a Ferrari "must be beautiful and distinctive."

The La Ferrari was introduced as the pinnacle of technology, aerodynamics and styling.

Like its predecessors, it stood as an expression of pure functional beauty.

There are no gimmicky surfaces or details in its design.

It stood apart from the more aggressive-looking supercars of its time.

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf5Tom_normal_gt350_65_2101205
turns.raw:
An iconic creamy white body with the Shelby Blue stripes represented a genuine GT Mustang...

...one that stood out from the super popular base model.

The original Mustang came with great proportions.

Its design was simple and clean.

Due to regulations, no parts were added to the exterior of the Shelby G.T.350.

However, it did come with a lowered suspension, wider tires and the iconic graphics.

If I were to own a Mustang, this would be at the top of my list.
turns.en:
An iconic creamy white body with the Shelby Blue stripes
represented a genuine GT Mustang...

...one that stood out from the super popular base model.
The original Mustang came
with great proportions.

Its design was simple and clean.

Due to regulations, no parts
were added to the exterior of the Shelby G.T.350.
However, it did come with a lowered suspension,
wider tires and the iconic graphics.

 If I were to own a Mustang,
this would be at the top of my list.
turns.zh:
当你看到经典的奶白色车身和Shelby蓝色条纹，
就代表这是一辆血统纯正的GT Mustang……

……当然了，G.T.350肯定要比人气超高的
基础车型更胜一筹。
原款Mustang的车身比例本就十分优秀，

设计方面也以简洁、精炼为主。

受赛事规定限制，这台Shelby G.T.350没有增加任何外部部件，
只是调低了悬挂系统，安装了宽胎
以及加入了标志性的涂装。

要是我想买一台Mustang，那么这款车绝对是我的首选。
turns.speaker: Tom Matano

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf5Tom_normal__300_sel_68_amg_71_2101305
turns.raw:
This 300 SEL may have been big for a sedan, but I consider it a sports sedan all the same.

The best image of this car that I can recall is a head-on shot of it coming out of a corner at speed.

It must have been intimidating for other drivers to see this machine in their rear-view mirrors.

This car is a great example of good visual weight balance.

It also showcases great dynamic weight distribution in full racing trim.q

全套赛车饰条与配件加身后，更显动态十足。:

turns.raw:
There were a few Lamborghini models that succeeded the Countach.

However, none of them defined the Lamborghini style since that car made its debut in 1970.

In my opinion, the Aventador finally achieved it.

Or perhaps it even surpassed it.

It took key design cues of the Countach and added new surface and detail languages.

And it carried the quintessential Lamborghini style into the next generation.
turns.en:
There were a few Lamborghini models that succeeded
the Countach.

However, none of them defined the Lamborghini style
since that car made its debut in 1970.
In my opinion, the Aventador finally achieved it.

Or perhaps it even surpassed it.
It took key design cues of the Countach and added
new surface and detail languages.

And it carried the quintessential Lamborghini style
into the next generation.
turns.zh:
在1970年发布Countach之后，
Lamborghini推出过若干款后续车型。

但没有哪一款能像它那样定义Lamborghini的风格。
在我看来，Aventador终于做到了再造经典，

甚至可以说全面超越了前者。
它继承了Countach的关键设计要素，
并加入了全新的外观和细节设计语言……

将鲜明的Lamborghini风格带入了全新的时代。`
turns.speaker: Tom Matano

Mr. Tsutomu Matano is known for his work on
the Mazda MX-5 Miata Roadster.

He's worked in Europe and America for quite a while now
and is widely known as Tom Matano.!
turns.zh:
哇，俣野努先生，能见到您实在是我们的荣幸！

俣野努先生因参与设计Mazda MX-5 Miata Roadster
而被人们所熟知。

他在欧洲和美国等地也工作过相当长一段时间，
而他的绰号“俣野汤姆”也因此闻名于世。
turns.speaker: Sarah

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf5Tom_normal_aventador_lp_750_4_sv_15_2101405
turns.raw:
There were a few Lamborghini models that succeeded the Countach.

However, none of them defined the Lamborghini style since that car made its debut in 1970.

In my opinion, the Aventador finally achieved it.

Or perhaps it even surpassed it.

It took key design cues of the Countach and added new surface and detail languages.

And it carried the quintessential Lamborghini style into the next generation.
turns.en:
There were a few Lamborghini models that succeeded
the Countach.

However, none of them defined the Lamborghini style
since that car made its debut in 1970.
In my opinion, the Aventador finally achieved it.

Or perhaps it even surpassed it.
It took key design cues of the Countach and added
new surface and detail languages.

And it carried the quintessential Lamborghini style
into the next generation.
turns.zh:
在1970年发布Countach之后，
Lamborghini推出过若干款后续车型。

但没有哪一款能像它那样定义Lamborghini的风格。
在我看来，Aventador终于做到了再造经典，

甚至可以说全面超越了前者。
它继承了Countach的关键设计要素，
并加入了全新的外观和细节设计语言……

将鲜明的Lamborghini风格带入了全新的时代。`
turns.speaker: Tom Matano

I love compact sports models from Germany.

They all have wide tires, twice as wide as Japanese compact cars.

Those wide tires are among the most significant components of this car.

They give the car its personality.

And the resulting wide stance makes the car look stable, as well as possessing performance.

They distinguish the base C coupe from the AMG version for those who have keen eyes.X
turns.en:
I love compact sports models from Germany.
They all have wide tires, twice as wide as
Japanese compact cars.

Those wide tires are among the most significant
components of this car.

They give the car its personality.

And the resulting wide stance makes the car look stable,
as well as possessing performance.
They distinguish the base C coupe from the AMG version
for those who have keen eyes.
turns.zh:
我非常喜爱德国产的紧凑型跑车。
这些车型都采用了宽胎，
其宽度足有日本紧凑型车的两倍。

宽胎正是这辆车最重要的组成部分之一。

赋予了这辆车鲜明的个性。

而这种设计让车身显得又宽又低，看上去非常稳定，
性能也同样卓越。
在懂行的人眼里，这些特点让AMG版本与
基础的C级双门跑车有了明显的区分。
turns.speaker: Tom Matano

This car reminds me of a happy little rabbit in the way it sits slightly inclined towards the front.

It looks more like a fun runabout than a typical commuter econobox.

Unlike retro-modern cars, such as the current Mini and FIAT 500...

...this car is a modern interpretation of the original FIAT 500 with Topolino character.
turns.en:
This car reminds me of a happy little rabbit in the way
it sits slightly inclined towards the front.

It looks more like a fun runabout than a typical
commuter econobox.
Unlike retro-modern cars, such as the current Mini
and FIAT 500...
...this car is a modern interpretation of the original
FIAT 500 with Topolino character.
turns.zh:
这辆车的车头弧度略微下滑，看上去
就像是一只快乐的小兔子。

与其说它是一款典型的经济型通勤车，
不如说更像一辆提供愉悦驾乘体验的轻便汽车。
和其他的复古现代风格汽车，
例如当前版本的MINI和FIAT 500不同……
这辆车就好比是以“米老鼠”角色特点对
初代FIAT 500的现代化演绎。
turns.speaker: Tom Matano

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf5Tom_normal_charger_srt_hellcat_15_2101905
turns.raw:
This is a genuine American muscle car that cuts a distinctive figure on the track.

A mid-size sedan with a super-high horsepower engine...

...it’s more European in its aero parts and suspension than the first-gen model.

This car is a celebration of American "inclusive design."

It offers supercar-level performance at an affordable price.

I once drove a Chrysler 300 SRT at Laguna Seca Raceway.

A dream to drive, its wide torque range allowed me to take the course without frequent gear shifts.
turns.en:
This is a genuine American muscle car that cuts
a distinctive figure on the track.
A mid-size sedan with a super-high horsepower engine...

...it’s more European in its aero parts and suspension
than the first-gen model.
This car is a celebration of American "inclusive design."

It offers supercar-level performance
at an affordable price.
I once drove a Chrysler 300 SRT at Laguna Seca Raceway.

A dream to drive, its wide torque range allowed me to take
the course without frequent gear shifts.
turns.zh:
这辆车是一款真正的美式肌肉车，在赛道上
展现出独特的魅力。
作为一辆中型轿车，它搭载着一颗超高马力的引擎……

在空气动力学和悬挂方面比第一代车型融入了
更多欧洲风格，
从而体现了美国“包容性设计”的理念……

以实惠的价格提供了超级跑车级别的性能体验。
我曾在拉古纳-塞卡赛道上驾驶过一辆Chrysler 300 SRT。

宽广的扭矩范围让我能够在赛道上畅快驾驶而无需频繁换挡。
那种驾驶体验如同梦幻。
turns.speaker: Tom Matano

It offers supercar-level performance
at an affordable price.
I once drove a Chrysler 300 SRT at Laguna Seca Raceway.

A dream to drive, its wide torque range allowed me to take
the course without frequent gear shifts.
turns.zh:
这辆车是一款真正的美式肌肉车，在赛道上
展现出独特的魅力。
作为一辆中型轿车，它搭载着一颗超高马力的引擎……

在空气动力学和悬挂方面比第一代车型融入了
更多欧洲风格，
从而体现了美国“包容性设计”的理念……

以实惠的价格提供了超级跑车级别的性能体验。
我曾在拉古纳-塞卡赛道上驾驶过一辆Chrysler 300 SRT。

宽广的扭矩范围让我能够在赛道上畅快驾驶而无需频繁换挡。
那种驾驶体验如同梦幻。
turns.speaker: Tom Matano

The ‘Baby Lambo’ was added to broaden the market reach
of Lamborghini as a brand.
Unlike their super-car counterparts, the ‘babies’...

and overall efficiency.
The Gallardo is a great example, exhibiting no excess

turns.zh:
“Baby Lambo”系列的推出旨在拓宽Lamborghini品牌
的市场。
与其超级跑车的兄弟相比，这些“小型”车型……

以更锐利的车身线条、更紧凑的车身尺寸
和整体上的高效设计而著称。
Gallardo就是一个很好的例子，从任何角度看都能展现
出简洁而精致的设计，没有任何多余的元素。

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf5Tom_normal_cayman_gt4_clubsport_16_2102205
turns.raw:
The Cayman has gone through a few cycles now.

The mid-engine layout here has made it sleeker in both its roof line and overall proportions.

Indeed, the Cayman has taken on a more serious look with each evolution.

With the GT4 trim, it is no longer positioned beneath the 911.

Holding its own with great presence, tough looks and beefy footwork...

...it has graduated from a casual racer to one that can take on much bigger competition.\
turns.en:
The Cayman has gone through a few cycles now.
The mid-engine layout here has made it sleeker
in both its roof line and overall proportions.
Indeed, the Cayman has taken on a more serious look
with each evolution.

With the GT4 trim, it is no longer positioned beneath
the 911.
Holding its own with great presence, tough looks and
beefy footwork...
...it has graduated from a casual racer to one that can
take on much bigger competition.\
turns.zh:
迄今为止，Cayman已经历了数次更新换代。
中置引擎的布局强化了车顶线条和整体比例的流线感。
事实上，Cayman的每次进化都让其更加凌厉。

升级到GT4版本后，它不再被定位在911之下。
凭借其强大的气场、富有侵略性的外观
和稳健的操控性能……
它已经从一款休闲性能车升级为能够与更高级别对手
竞争的真正赛道利器。
turns.speaker: Tom Matano

The Type R has the perfect balance of cosmetic and mechanical tuning.

Its design is simply iconic.

Equally well-balanced in its proportions, it has a great stance that speaks to its agility on the track.

The car that set the standard for FWD racers, it still looks great.

What’s more, it captured the spirit of JDM tuners better than any other model that came after it.

turns.zh:
Honda Type R在外观设计和机械性能调校方面
达到了完美的平衡。

它的设计堪称经典。
其车身比例同样协调，完美的车身姿态充分
展现了它在赛道上的灵活性。

这款车型为前驱性能车树立了标杆，
时至今日依然魅力不减。
更重要的是，它比后续其他车型都更好地
诠释了日本国内改装车（JDM）文化的精髓。

This is the first Civic that wore the Type “R” designation.

This model started the tradition that continues to this day.

When compared to the latest Type “R” model, it was much purer and simpler.

It shows that times have changed during the past 20 years, like an evolution of a sneaker design.
turns.en:
This is the first Civic that wore the Type “R” designation.

This model started the tradition that continues to this day.
When compared to the latest Type “R” model,
it was much purer and simpler.
It shows that times have changed during the past 20 years,
like an evolution of a sneaker design.
turns.zh:
这是第一款得到“Type R”命名的Civic。

也开启了延续至今的传统。
与最新的Type R车型相比，它更加纯粹和简洁。
它展示了过去20年间的车型变化。就像
运动鞋设计的演变一样。
turns.speaker: Tom Matano

当属来自后段双出排气管的美妙的“声音设计”！

Known as the “Daytona," it is the epitome of the front-engine Prancing Horse GT...

...and probably that of the entire “Gran Turismo” category, as well.

The car was designed by Pininfarina.

It has a very clean and incisive style.

It is based on extreme proportions...

...with a huge sloping hood and a set-back cockpit ending in a compact “Kamm tail."

Some styling elements are particularly iconic, such as the plexiglass headlights.

整个GT类车型的集大成者。

虽然线条比例极端……

turns.raw:
Known as the “Daytona," it is the epitome of the front-engine Prancing Horse GT...

...and probably that of the entire “Gran Turismo” category, as well.

The car was designed by Pininfarina.

It has a very clean and incisive style.

It is based on extreme proportions...

...with a huge sloping hood and a set-back cockpit ending in a compact “Kamm tail."

Some styling elements are particularly iconic, such as the plexiglass headlights.
turns.en:
Known as the “Daytona," it is the epitome of
the front-engine Prancing Horse GT...

...and probably that of the entire
“Gran Turismo” category, as well.
The car was designed by Pininfarina.

It has a very clean and incisive style.

It is based on extreme proportions...

...with a huge sloping hood and a set-back cockpit
ending in a compact “Kamm tail."

Some styling elements are particularly iconic,
such as the plexiglass headlights.
turns.zh:
这款被命名为“Daytona”的跃马是
Ferrari前置引擎车款的集大成者。

不夸张地说，它其实可以算作
整个GT类车型的集大成者。
它的车身由Pininfarina打造，

虽然线条比例极端……

但造型依然干脆、简练。

最吸睛的是它的俯冲式发动机盖，以及通过卡姆式车尾（Kamm tail）
紧凑收束的后置驾驶舱。

就连有机玻璃大灯也采用了流线型的优雅设计。
turns.speaker: Fabio Filippini

abruptly cut off. <p/>
Much like streamline designs, they're known to have
excellent aerodynamics.<p/>

We also refer to it as "Coda Tronca" in Italian.<next id=2200212 type=9>?
turns.en:
Yes! It's a design where the rear of the body appears to
abruptly cut off.

Much like streamline designs, they're known to have
excellent aerodynamics.

Dr. Wunibald Kamm, the person who came up with this, was a
professor at the University of Stuttgart in the 1930s.

Therein lies the reason why this particular design is called
the "Kamm Tail."

We also refer to it as "Coda Tronca" in Italian.?
turns.zh:
没错！采用这种设计的汽车后部就像
被整齐地切掉一块。

卡姆式与流线型车身设计很接近，而且都以
优秀的空气动力学效应闻名。

这一设计是由斯图加特大学的Wunibald Kamm博士
于上世纪30年代提出的，

随即以设计者的名字冠名。

在意大利语中，我们也把它叫作“Coda Tronca”。
turns.speaker: Sarah

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf6Fabio_normal_dino_246gt_69_2200308
turns.raw:
The little berlinetta, known as the Dino 206/246 GT...

...is certainly one of the most beautiful cars ever to grace the light of day!

It is a true masterpiece, derived from the 1965 prototype Dino Berlinetta Speciale.

The lightweight nature and elegant form flawlessly blends with its sportiness.

There is no brutality of expression; instead, it conveyed a sense of purposeful grace.

There is an almost feminine beauty typical of many Pininfarina works.

The sinuosity and purity of shapes, which seem to brush the frame and the wheels...

...starting from the sharp and expressive front to the sleek truncated tail.

Some elements are very iconic, like the side air vents... that will appear on the Ferrari 308...

...and concave rear window that lightens the rear buttresses.

To this day, it remains among the best expressions of timeless beauty and elegance in automotive history.
turns.en:

turns.zh:
这款Dino206/246 GT的Berlinetta小型跑车……

无疑是有史以来最漂亮的汽车之一！

这是一辆真正的杰作，
基于1965年的Dino Berlinetta Speciale打造。
它的轻量化设计以及完美无暇的造型和它的跑车特性
完美地融合在一起。

在整个设计表达中找不出哪怕一丝突兀的线条。

事实上，它唤起了对许多宾尼法利纳作品中
典型柔美线条的回忆。

简洁而顺滑的延续性线条
仿佛抚平了车架和车轮的所有棱角……

从锐利而富有表现力的车头开始，
逐渐过渡到流畅的截断式尾部。
它的一部分元素最终成为了法拉利标志性的设计，
例如后来出现在法拉利308上的侧面进气口……

还有凹陷的后窗，将车尾变得更加轻盈和紧俏。

时至今日，它仍然是汽车历史上对隽永之美
和优雅姿态的最_��诠释之一。
turns.speaker: Fabio Filippini

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf6Fabio_normal_megane_renaultsport_11_2200408
turns.raw:
This is a car I had a hand in styling when I was with Renault Design!

When I designed the Mégane III series with my team...

We decided to make an RS variant right from the start.

The original design was already very compact...

And extreme for a 3-door hatchback, with its sloping rear window and dynamic rear pillar.

Obviously the modified bumpers...

And the large rear central exhaust contribute to making it appear even more aggressive.

But the most successful detail is...

Undoubtedly the F1-inspired suspended wing in the front grille, which integrates the daytime running lights.g
turns.en:
This is a car I had a hand in styling when I was
with Renault Design!

When I designed the Mégane III series with my team...

We decided to make an RS variant right from the start.

The original design was already very compact...

And extreme for a 3-door hatchback, with its sloping rear window
and dynamic rear pillar.
Obviously the modified bumpers...

And the large rear central exhaust contribute to making it
appear even more aggressive.
But the most successful detail is...

Undoubtedly the F1-inspired suspended wing in the front
grille, which integrates the daytime running lights.
turns.zh:
这辆车的造型还是我在Renault Design工作时经手设计的！

当我和我的团队一起设计Mégane III系列时……

从一开始就决定追加设计一个RS版本。

这是一辆紧凑到极致的三门小钢炮，有着大坡度后窗
和动态十足的C柱，
以及显著改造过的后保险杠……

还有汇集到尾部正中的大号排气管，让它更显侵略性。
但最成功的细节……

无疑是前格栅里受F1赛车启发的悬浮翼片，
我们将它直接与日间行车灯整合到了一起。
turns.speaker: Fabio Filippini

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf6Fabio_normal__308_gtb_78_2200508
turns.raw:
The 308 can be considered the progenitor of all modern 8-cylinder Ferraris, and the most popular of them all.

And, perhaps it was also the longest-lasting.

Its production run spanned from 1975 to 1989, including the derivative version, the 328.

Besides its technical aspects, the car's success came from an extremely balanced and pure design.

It's almost timeless.

It serves as a perfect example of Pininfarina’s design philosophy applied to the cars of the Cavallino.

In fact, it takes up some classical themes from the Dino 246, such as the progressive wave on the two-wheel arches...

...and the iconic side air intake, but also the dynamic rear pillars.

And, of course, the truncated tail with four round taillights.

However, all of it was transformed into a very essential and modern shaping for the time.
turns.en:
The 308 can be considered the progenitor of all modern
8-cylinder Ferraris, and the most popular of them all.

And, perhaps it was also the longest-lasting.

 Its production run spanned from 1975 to 1989,
including the derivative version, the 328.

Besides its technical aspects, the car's success came
from an extremely balanced and pure design.

It's almost timeless.

It serves as a perfect example of Pininfarina’s design
philosophy applied to the cars of the Cavallino.
In fact, it takes up some classical themes from the Dino
246, such as the progressive wave on the two-wheel arches...
...and the iconic side air intake,
but also the dynamic rear pillars.

And, of course, the truncated tail with
four round taillights.

However, all of it was transformed into a very essential
and modern shaping for the time.
turns.zh:
308不仅是所有现代8缸法拉利跑车的鼻祖，
而且无疑是所有车款当中最受欢迎的一款。

它可能也是持续量产最久的一款法拉利。

如果将328版本也算进去，
其生产时间足足从1975年延续到1989年。

这都要归功于它纯粹且经得起时代考验的设计。

在评论家口中，它的平衡性同样首屈一指……

还完美诠释了宾尼法利纳的设计理念。
它甚至复兴了Dino 246的经典元素，如外扩的轮拱……
标志性的侧面进气口，动态的C柱……

还包括带有四个圆形尾灯的截断式尾部。

当然，所有这些元素都经过改良，
以适应更加现代化的设计理念。*
turns.speaker: Fabio Filippini

turns.raw:
I remember very well the impact of the Honda NSX at the 1989 Geneva Motor Show.

It was the expression of absolute sportiness combined with Japanese perfection.

In fact, its clean and streamlined style...

...comes from studies previously made with Pininfarina.

These were further developed later by in-house Japanese designers

This design is so pure and balanced that...

...it lasted 15 years without noticeable changes.

While the front and side are slightly reminiscent of the Ferrari style...

...the tail is particularly original and successful.

Of note are its integrated wing and the transversal strip of lights

The "Type R" version boasts intense technical improvement work...

...amd is virtually identical in aesthetics*
turns.en:
I remember very well the impact of the Honda NSX
at the 1989 Geneva Motor Show.

It was the expression of absolute sportiness
combined with Japanese perfection.
In fact, its clean and streamlined style...

...comes from studies previously
made with Pininfarina.

These were further developed later by
in-house Japanese designers

This design is so pure and balanced that...

...it lasted 15 years without noticeable changes.
While the front and
side are slightly reminiscent of the Ferrari style...

...the tail is particularly original and successful.

Of note are its integrated wing and
the transversal strip of lights
The "Type R" version boasts intense technical improvement work...

...amd is virtually identical in aesthetics*
turns.zh:
1989年，本田NSX在日内瓦车展上造成的轰动，
我现在依然记得很清楚。

它是绝对的动感和日本的完美主义的结合。
这种简洁的流线造型……

……其实是本田与宾尼法利纳合作研究的成果。

之后又由日方的内部设计师
进一步完善和发扬光大。

这项成功的设计不仅纯粹，而且平衡……

……以至于沿用了整整15年都未见任何显著改动。
虽然前脸和侧面会让人觉得向法拉利靠拢……

……但其车尾的原创度很高，也相当成功。

一体化的尾翼和横向全尺寸灯带都是可圈可点的创新。
后来的“Type R”版本虽然在技术上做出大幅的改进……

……但在美学方面几乎是全面照搬了原版车。
turns.speaker: Fabio Filippini

turns.zh:
1989年，本田NSX在日内瓦车展上造成的轰动，
我现在依然记得很清楚。

它是绝对的动感和日本的完美主义的结合。
这种简洁的流线造型……

……其实是本田与宾尼法利纳合作研究的成果。

之后又由日方的内部设计师
进一步完善和发扬光大。

这项成功的设计不仅纯粹，而且平衡……

……以至于沿用了整整15年都未见任何显著改动。
虽然前脸和侧面会让人觉得向法拉利靠拢……

……但其车尾的原创度很高，也相当成功。

一体化的尾翼和横向全尺寸灯带都是可圈可点的创新。
后来的“Type R”版本虽然在技术上做出大幅的改进……

……但在美学方面几乎是全面照搬了原版车。

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf6Fabio_normal__458_italia_09_2200808
turns.raw:
The 458 Italia is one of Pininfarina's recent masterpieces for the Cavallino.

It is probably the most beautiful mid-engine Ferrari since the 308...

Inheriting the sportiness, purity and elegance of the 308...

It would influence the design language and proportions of all subsequent models.

Its style is characterized by...

...sinuous yet extremely pure and fluid lines, with no visible air inlets on the sides.

The front is sharp, with the new "scimitar" headlights. The rear can be recognized by single round lights...

...embedded in the bodywork...

...and by the three round central exhausts inspired by the F40.

If perfection in design is achieved when nothing can be removed from a shape without ruining it...

...then the 458 it comes really close.&

turns.zh:
458 Italia是宾尼法利纳最近为跃马品牌设计的杰作之一。

它可能是自308以来外型最优美的中置引擎法拉利……
……同时也继承了308的运动性、纯粹性和优雅……

……并影响到了后续多款车型的设计语言和比例。

其风格特点可以用几点归纳：

极致纯粹、流动的连续车身线条，侧面没有任何明显的进气口。
犀利的前脸采用了新的“弯刀”头灯。显得杀气腾腾。
车尾的辨识度也很高……
……嵌入车身框架的单个圆形后灯……

……以及与F40师出同门的三联中置圆形排气管。
如果完美的设计是增之则长，减之则短……

……那么458已经非常接近于这个境界了。
turns.speaker: Fabio Filippini

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf6Fabio_normal__458_italia_09_2200808
turns.raw:
The 458 Italia is one of Pininfarina's recent masterpieces for the Cavallino.

It is probably the most beautiful mid-engine Ferrari since the 308...

Inheriting the sportiness, purity and elegance of the 308...

It would influence the design language and proportions of all subsequent models.

Its style is characterized by...

...sinuous yet extremely pure and fluid lines, with no visible air inlets on the sides.

The front is sharp, with the new "scimitar" headlights. The rear can be recognized by single round lights...

...embedded in the bodywork...

...and by the three round central exhausts inspired by the F40.

If perfection in design is achieved when nothing can be removed from a shape without ruining it...

...then the 458 it comes really close.&
turns.en:
The 458 Italia is one of Pininfarina's
recent masterpieces for the Cavallino.

It is probably the most beautiful mid-engine
Ferrari since the 308...
Inheriting the sportiness, purity and elegance
of the 308...

It would influence the design language and proportions
of all subsequent models.

Its style is characterized by...

...sinuous yet extremely pure and fluid lines,
with no visible air inlets on the sides.
The front is sharp, with the new "scimitar" headlights.
The rear can be recognized by single round lights...
...embedded in the bodywork...

...and by the three round central exhausts inspired by the F40.
 If perfection in design is achieved when nothing
can be removed from a shape without ruining it...

...then the 458 it comes really close.&
turns.zh:
458 Italia是宾尼法利纳最近为跃马品牌设计的杰作之一。

它可能是自308以来外型最优美的中置引擎法拉利……
……同时也继承了308的运动性、纯粹性和优雅……

……并影响到了后续多款车型的设计语言和比例。

其风格特点可以用几点归纳：

极致纯粹、流动的连续车身线条，侧面没有任何明显的进气口。
犀利的前脸采用了新的“弯刀”头灯。显得杀气腾腾。
车尾的辨识度也很高……
……嵌入车身框架的单个圆形后灯……

……以及与F40师出同门的三联中置圆形排气管。
如果完美的设计是增之则长，减之则短……

……那么458已经非常接近于这个境界了。
turns.speaker: Fabio Filippini

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf6Fabio_normal__250_gt_berlinetta_swb_61_2200908
turns.raw:
The Ferrari 250 GT SWB is the 'Mona Lisa' of sport cars!

It brings sportiness, elegance and power into one perfect shape.

This Pininfarina's design...

Is the final word on a pursuit of volume and proportion that started in 1947 with the Cisitalia 202 Berlinetta.

Compact, dynamic shapes and curved, sinewy surfaces are expressed as utter purity and elegance.

The car fits a low, gritty front, a set-back cabin, generous hips and a compact tail...

All into one concentrated ensemble.

It's not unlike...

A painting by da Vinci or a sculpture by Michelangelo.

That is, it achieves a similarly exceptional level of perfection and timeless beauty.

It is beauty in its purest and most striking essence!
turns.en:
The Ferrari 250 GT SWB is the 'Mona Lisa' of sport cars!

It brings sportiness, elegance and power into one perfect shape.
This Pininfarina's design...

Is the final word on a pursuit of volume and proportion
that started in 1947 with the Cisitalia 202 Berlinetta.

Compact, dynamic shapes and curved, sinewy surfaces
are expressed as utter purity and elegance.
The car fits a low, gritty front, a set-back cabin,
generous hips and a compact tail...

All into one concentrated ensemble.
It's not unlike...

A painting by da Vinci or a sculpture
by Michelangelo.

That is, it achieves a similarly exceptional level
of perfection and timeless beauty.
It is beauty in its purest and most striking essence!
turns.zh:
法拉利250 GT SWB！我愿意将它称为跑车中的“蒙娜丽莎”！

它是运动性、优雅和动力的精髓
在汽车外形上的完美总和。
这个设计方案……

……始于1947年的西斯塔尼亚202双座，
宾尼法利纳将自那以来对体积和比例的探索，都汇萃于此。

紧凑而动感的造型、力量喷涌的曲面……

……带来极致的纯粹和绝对的优雅。
从低矮却坚毅的前脸，到后移的座舱……

从厚实外扩的后轮到收窄的紧凑尾箱……

……同样是那么的纯粹，那么的优雅。
简直能与……

……达芬奇的绘画或米开朗基罗的雕塑相媲美。

它将各种元素浓缩而又均衡地组合在一起，
实现了无可比拟的圆满和永恒之美。

它是美以最纯粹的形式展现……
……是最动人心魄的美之精华！
turns.speaker: Fabio Filippini

turns.raw:
Here, we have the cute Honda Beat...

...a symbol of the Japanese two-seat convertible kei-car category, born in the 1990s.

The car was a result from a historic collaboration between Honda and Pininfarina.

Its clean and simple design perfectly envelops the super compact mid-engine package.

It features side air inlets, but also a "clamshell" front hood and aerodynamically side mirrors.

The perforated steel rims and the motorcycle-like instrument cluster...

...they both contribute to reinforce the basic and sporty spirit of the car.

A special mention goes to the zebra-striped fabric of the seats.

They were a typical 1990s Japanese fashionable trend.n
turns.en:
Here, we have the cute Honda Beat...

...a symbol of the Japanese two-seat
convertible kei-car category, born in the 1990s.

The car was a result from a historic collaboration
between Honda and Pininfarina.
Its clean and simple design perfectly envelops
the super compact mid-engine package.
It features side air inlets, but also a "clamshell" front hood
and aerodynamically side mirrors.
The perforated steel rims and
the motorcycle-like instrument cluster...

...they both contribute to reinforce
the basic and sporty spirit of the car.
A special mention goes to the zebra-striped fabric of the seats.

They were a typical 1990s Japanese fashionable trend.
turns.zh:
看，这就是我们可爱的本田Beat……

……日本双座敞篷轻型车类别诞生于20世纪90年代，
而它就相当于这一类别的象征符号之一。

这台车是本田和宾尼法利纳历史性合作的成果。
它的设计简洁而精巧，将一台超紧凑的中置引擎套件
安装在后轴上。
除了侧面进气口，它还配备了“蚌壳形”的前引擎盖
和集成空气动力学效应的侧后视镜。
孔洞式的钢轮毂和类似摩托车的仪表组……

……无不在强调这辆车走的是朴实、运动的路线。
特别值得一提的是座椅套上的斑马纹路，
这可是走在20世纪90年代日本的时尚潮流前列。
turns.speaker: Fabio Filippini

the basic and sporty spirit of the car.
A special mention goes to the zebra-striped fabric of the seats.

They were a typical 1990s Japanese fashionable trend.
turns.zh:
看，这就是我们可爱的本田Beat……

……日本双座敞篷轻型车类别诞生于20世纪90年代，
而它就相当于这一类别的象征符号之一。

这台车是本田和宾尼法利纳历史性合作的成果。
它的设计简洁而精巧，将一台超紧凑的中置引擎套件
安装在后轴上。
除了侧面进气口，它还配备了“蚌壳形”的前引擎盖
和集成空气动力学效应的侧后视镜。
孔洞式的钢轮毂和类似摩托车的仪表组……

……无不在强调这辆车走的是朴实、运动的路线。
特别值得一提的是座椅套上的斑马纹路，
这可是走在20世纪90年代日本的时尚潮流前列。

turns.raw:
This car represents the baby of the Alfa Romeo range.

Its design recalls the stylistic features of the extreme 8C Competizione.

This includes with his curved sensual surfaces..

....not to mention its drop-shaped headlights and round rear lights.

There are also the “five-circles” theme of the alloy wheels...

These elements are all typical of the Alfa brand.

The cked with an air of condensed energy that seems “ready to explode."

Even the window areas are extremely reduced, and the rear window is very slanted.

And the hatch here is small and, I must say, quite inconvenient.

But you know...

...when it comes to practicality...

Well, let's just say it certainly isn't the main objective of an Alfa Romeo's design.e
turns.en:

....not to mention its drop-shaped headlights and

There are also the “five-circles” theme of the alloy wheels...

These elements are all
typical of the Alfa brand.

The cked with an air of
condensed energy that seems “ready to explode."
Even the window areas are extremely reduced,
and the rear window is very slanted.

turns.zh:
MiTo是阿尔法罗密欧旗下车型中的“大宝贝”。

它的设计特征让人想起剑走偏锋的8C Competizione：
包括那性感的弧度……

……“五环”造型的铝合金轮毂，
更不必提那为人熟知的水滴形头灯和圆形尾灯……

……全都是典型的阿尔法元素。

这辆车看上去仿佛被注入了一股浓缩压实过的能量，
像是“随时会爆炸”一样。
甚至连窗户的面积也遭到极限压缩，后窗陡然倾斜，

继而导致行李箱门开口变小，非常不便。
但是吧……

……每每谈到实用性的时候……

大家都会心领神会地说，
这方面肯定不是阿尔法罗密欧的主要设计目标。
turns.speaker: Fabio Filippini

后者曾主宰了意大利乃至全欧洲的房车锦标赛。
这款“用料节省”的全新限量版Giulia轿车完全把握住了
原车型的精髓和卓越的性能。

在外观设计上，更是以巨大的前格栅、宽挡泥板和一大堆
美观的碳纤维空气动力学组件忠实再现了Sprint的运动感

硕大的20英寸合金轮毂中央还参照真正的赛车
单独增加了中心螺栓。
turns.speaker: Fabio Filippini

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf6Fabio_normal_clio_sport_v6_00_2201308
turns.raw:
Imagine transforming a little French city car into a mid-engine racer!

Ah, but such is the transgressive spirit of the R5 Turbo's direct descendant.

Its sportiness is dynamically expressed through widened flanks and central dual exhausts.

Interestingly, these aggressive elements are balanced with those typical of Renault cars from the '90s.

This is most evident in the way the side edge line "rolls" around the rear wheel...

...and in the use of a geometric design for the front and rear grilles.
turns.en:
Imagine transforming a little French city car
into a mid-engine racer!

Ah, but such is the transgressive spirit of the R5 Turbo's
direct descendant.
Its sportiness is dynamically expressed through
widened flanks and central dual exhausts.

Interestingly, these aggressive elements are balanced
with those typical of Renault cars from the '90s.
This is most evident in the way the side edge line
"rolls" around the rear wheel...
...and in the use of a geometric design
for the front and rear grilles.
turns.zh:
你能想象将一辆小型法式城市用车改造成
一辆中置引擎赛车是什么样子吗？

这辆R5 Turbo的后继车型就承载了这样叛逆不羁的精神。
它的运动形态通过加宽的侧面裙边
和居中的双排气管得到了动态的展现。

有趣的是，这些激进的设计元素却通过90年代经典Renault风格
的中和，取得了完美的平衡。
后轮的“管装”风道线条……
和前后格栅采用的几何分割设计就是最显而易见的证明！
turns.speaker: Fabio Filippini

turns.raw:
Imagine transforming a little French city car into a mid-engine racer!

Ah, but such is the transgressive spirit of the R5 Turbo's direct descendant.

Its sportiness is dynamically expressed through widened flanks and central dual exhausts.

Interestingly, these aggressive elements are balanced with those typical of Renault cars from the '90s.

This is most evident in the way the side edge line "rolls" around the rear wheel...

...and in the use of a geometric design for the front and rear grilles.
turns.en:

into a mid-engine racer!

Ah, but such is the transgressive spirit of the R5 Turbo's
direct descendant.
Its sportiness is dynamically expressed through

Interestingly, these aggressive elements are balanced

This is most evident in the way the side edge line

turns.zh:
你能想象将一辆小型法式城市用车改造成
一辆中置引擎赛车是什么样子吗？

这辆R5 Turbo的后继车型就承载了这样叛逆不羁的精神。

和居中的双排气管得到了动态的展现。

有趣的是，这些激进的设计元素却通过90年代经典Renault风格
的中和，取得了完美的平衡。
后轮的“管装”风道线条……
和前后格栅采用的几何分割设计就是最显而易见的证明！

turns.raw:
The fifth-generation Nissan Silvia was one of my favorite Japanese cars of the early '90s.

A coupe of classic beauty—its lines were remarkably clean and elegant!

It almost looked Italian in design.

That low front, transverse light strip, bright cabin and slender tail...

Everything in this car comes together in a perfect harmony of proportions.m
turns.en:
The fifth-generation Nissan Silvia was one of
my favorite Japanese cars of the early '90s.

A coupe of classic beauty—its lines were
remarkably clean and elegant!

It almost looked Italian in design.
That low front, transverse light strip,
bright cabin and slender tail...
Everything in this car comes together
in a perfect harmony of proportions.
turns.zh:
第五代Nissan Silvia是我最爱的
九十年代初期日式车之一。

这辆呈现出经典美感的双门跑车
拥有令人眼前一亮的简洁优雅线条！

看上去非常像是意大利的设计风格。
低矮的车头、横断式条状车灯、
亮色的驾驶舱和纤细的车尾……
一切都完美地融合在一起，呈现出非常和谐的比例。
turns.speaker: Fabio Filippini

turns.en:
The fifth-generation Nissan Silvia was one of
my favorite Japanese cars of the early '90s.

A coupe of classic beauty—its lines were
remarkably clean and elegant!

It almost looked Italian in design.
That low front, transverse light strip,
bright cabin and slender tail...
Everything in this car comes together
in a perfect harmony of proportions.
turns.zh:
第五代Nissan Silvia是我最爱的
九十年代初期日式车之一。

这辆呈现出经典美感的双门跑车
拥有令人眼前一亮的简洁优雅线条！

看上去非常像是意大利的设计风格。
低矮的车头、横断式条状车灯、
亮色的驾驶舱和纤细的车尾……
一切都完美地融合在一起，呈现出非常和谐的比例。

turns.en:
The fifth-generation Nissan Silvia was one of
my favourite Japanese cars of the early ‘90s.

One thing that has always impressed me about it
is the quality of its shape.
Specifically, the slight 'S' curve in the side profile,
above the wheel of the front fender.

This gives a very delicate and sensitive finish

turns.zh:
第五代Nissan Silvia是我最爱的
九十年代初期日式车之一。

它最让我印象深刻的一点就是外观风格。
具体来说就是它车身侧面轮廓中，前挡泥板轮圈上方
略微呈现出的“S”弧线。

这一细节为车身的立体造型和光线反射添加了
精妙而感性的一笔，起到了画龙点睛的作用。

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf6Fabio_normal__512bb_76_2201608
turns.raw:
For many fans who still adore its essential and compact shape designed by Pininfarina...

...the 512 BB has achieved near-mythical status.

Its design was inspired by...

...the 1968 P6 Berlinetta Speciale prototype.

This is particularly evident in the front and cabin.

Although few people are aware of this...

...you may also notice details derived from the Modulo, the 1970s Ferrari concept car.

The extruding wheel arches are one such detail.

But what everyone certainly remembers about the 512 BB are...

...the large acrylic indicator covers in the front, the louvered hood grille, the small NACA side air vents...

...and the lower bodywork painted matte black.�
turns.en:
For many fans who still adore its essential and compact
shape designed by Pininfarina...

...the 512 BB has achieved near-mythical status.
Its design was inspired by...

...the 1968 P6 Berlinetta Speciale prototype.

This is particularly evident in the front and cabin.

Although few people are aware of this...
...you may also notice details derived from the Modulo,
the 1970s Ferrari concept car.

The extruding wheel arches are one such detail.
But what everyone certainly remembers
about the 512 BB are...

...the large acrylic indicator covers in the front, the louvered
hood grille, the small NACA side air vents...

...and the lower bodywork painted matte black.
turns.zh:
由宾尼法利纳所设计的精简和紧凑的外形
为512 BB赢得了大量的忠实粉丝……

他们也将这款车几乎捧上了神坛。
这辆车的设计灵感来源于……

1968年推出的P6双座特别版原型车。

这一点在其车头和座舱的设计上一览无余。

另外，你还可以从中看到
1970年代推出的法拉利概念赛车摩多罗的部分细节：

例如其向外凸出的车轮拱罩就是其中之一。

不过，发现这些关联的人并不多。
不过，512 BB最让人印象深刻的记忆还是来源于……

车头几何形状的大尺寸亚克力转向灯罩、百叶窗式引擎罩格栅、
小型NACA侧面进气口……

以及哑光黑色的下部车身。
turns.speaker: Fabio Filippini

turns.en:
For many fans who still adore its essential and compact
shape designed by Pininfarina...

...the 512 BB has achieved near-mythical status.
Its design was inspired by...

...the 1968 P6 Berlinetta Speciale prototype.

This is particularly evident in the front and cabin.

Although few people are aware of this...
...you may also notice details derived from the Modulo,
the 1970s Ferrari concept car.

The extruding wheel arches are one such detail.
But what everyone certainly remembers
about the 512 BB are...

...the large acrylic indicator covers in the front, the louvered

...and the lower bodywork painted matte black.
turns.zh:
由宾尼法利纳所设计的精简和紧凑的外形
为512 BB赢得了大量的忠实粉丝……

他们也将这款车几乎捧上了神坛。
这辆车的设计灵感来源于……

1968年推出的P6双座特别版原型车。

这一点在其车头和座舱的设计上一览无余。

另外，你还可以从中看到
1970年代推出的法拉利概念赛车摩多罗的部分细节：

例如其向外凸出的车轮拱罩就是其中之一。

不过，发现这些关联的人并不多。
不过，512 BB最让人印象深刻的记忆还是来源于……

车头几何形状的大尺寸亚克力转向灯罩、百叶窗式引擎罩格栅、
小型NACA侧面进气口……

以及哑光黑色的下部车身。
