I think the little FIAT Abarth 595 Esseesse is the perfect expression of the "Italian spirit."

Particularly the spirit of the 1950 and 1960s, when the zeal and passion of Italian people were expressed without restraint.

The tuned-up version by Carlo Abarth...

...is known for its lowered stance and various mechanical changes.+
turns.en:
I think the little FIAT Abarth 595 Esseesse is the perfect
expression of the "Italian spirit."

Particularly the spirit of the 1950 and 1960s, when the zeal
and passion of Italian people were expressed without restraint.
The tuned-up version by Carlo Abarth...

...is known for its lowered stance
and various mechanical changes.+
turns.zh:
我认为这辆小巧的FIAT Abarth 595 Esseesse
是对“意大利精神”的完美诠释。

特别是在50至60年代，意大利人民即使能力受到客观限制，
热情和激情仍然无比高昂的那股劲儿。
这是由卡洛·阿巴斯改装的版本……

特点是降低了车身的高度，并在机械结构方面进行了调整。
turns.speaker: Fabio Filippini

turns.en:
Of course, he’s the founder of the legendary Italian brand
Abarth, and is famous for his racing and tuning to boot.+
turns.zh:

Abarth的创始人，同时也以高超的赛车技艺和改装技术而闻名。
turns.speaker: Sarah

engineer to boot!<p/>

on FIAT mechanicals.<next id=2201712 type=9>9
turns.en:
Why, he’s the founder of the legendary Italian brand Abarth!

What's more, he was a great racer and an innovative
engineer to boot!

Abarth was founded in 1949, and is well-known for its work
on FIAT mechanicals.
turns.zh:
当然知道了，他可是意大利传奇品牌——Abarth的创始人！

更令人赞叹的是，他也是一位伟大的车手和一位创意无边的
改装工程师！

Abarth创立于1949年，以对FIAT各车型的改装而闻名。
turns.speaker: Sarah

turns.en:
The same goes for the red stripes, scorpio badges, and the
light wheels, transforming it into a race car.

But above all, some details are striking, such as the
rubber locks for the hoods.

The rear-hood was raised to improve cooling,
and "Record Monza" chromed double exhausts were added.
turns.zh:
再加上红色条幅、天蝎徽标和轻量化车轮，
这些改动令其摇身一变，成为了一辆赛车。

那些令人尤为印象深刻的细节也十分吸引眼球，
比如引擎盖上的橡胶锁……

还有为了改善散热而抬高的后引擎盖，以及
“Record Monza”镀铬双排气管。
turns.speaker: Fabio Filippini

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf6Fabio_normal_testarossa_91_2201808
turns.raw:
The Testarossa recalls the exuberance of the 1980s— teen posters and American TV.

In fact, its design was spectacular and ostentatious, totally the opposite of the 512 BB it replaced.

First of all, the Testarossa impressed with its size.

Note the imposing S-shaped volume of its tail and huge, iconic air inlets.

This was copied by tuners and coachbuilders the world over and was reflected in modified, banal city cars.

That’s how innovative it was!

Of particular note was the black grille, which hid the rectangular rear lights...

...that replaced, for the first time, the signature round taillights of previous Ferraris.

Another memorable oddity...

...was the single side-mirror suspended in the middle of the pillar, which was present in the very first versions.
turns.en:
The Testarossa recalls the exuberance of the 1980s—
teen posters and American TV.

In fact, its design was spectacular and ostentatious,
totally the opposite of the 512 BB it replaced.
First of all, the Testarossa impressed with its size.

Note the imposing S-shaped volume of its tail
and huge, iconic air inlets.
This was copied by tuners and coachbuilders the world over
and was reflected in modified, banal city cars.

That’s how innovative it was!
Of particular note was the black grille, which hid
the rectangular rear lights...

...that replaced, for the first time, the signature round
taillights of previous Ferraris.
Another memorable oddity...

...was the single side-mirror suspended in the middle of the
pillar, which was present in the very first versions.
turns.zh:
Testarossa令人回想起80年代的狂热——
就好像当时的青少年海报和美国电视剧的张扬风格。

它的设计与前辈512 BB迥然不同，抢眼而张扬。
首先，Testarossa以其庞大的尺寸给人留下深刻的印象。

其巨大的楔形车尾和侧面巨大的标志性进气口也同样令人瞩目。
这一设计引得世界各地的改装者和车身制造商纷纷效仿
——许多普通的城市车辆都被改装成这个样子，

成为了开创一代潮流的鼻祖！
特别值得一提的是，黑色的进气格栅内其实
隐藏了矩形尾灯……

这是法拉利首次摒弃之前车型经典的圆形尾灯。
另一个令人过目不忘的奇特设计……

是最早期版本中悬挂在A柱中央的单个侧后视镜。

turns.raw:
The Maserati Gran Turismo...

...was a classic interpretation of Italian style and sportiness by Pininfarina.

The long hood, set-back cabin...

...and compact tail were immediately recognizable.

These extremely distinctive proportions were a synthesis of the typical dynamic balance of the GT category.

That said, there were elements that renewed the historic identity of Maserati’s design.

Among them were the three little vents behind the front wheel.
turns.en:
The Maserati Gran Turismo...

...was a classic interpretation of Italian style and sportiness
by Pininfarina.
The long hood, set-back cabin...

...and compact tail were immediately recognizable.
These extremely distinctive proportions were a synthesis
of the typical dynamic balance of the GT category.

That said, there were elements that renewed the
historic identity of Maserati’s design.
Among them were the three little vents behind the front wheel.
turns.zh:
Maserati Gran Turismo……

是Pininfarina对意大利风格和运动性的经典诠释。
修长的引擎盖、后移的车厢……

和紧凑的车尾都是一眼就能认出的特征。
极具辨识度的车身各部位比例是GT系列
典型的动态平衡的综合体现。

尽管如此，车上还添加了一些非常有Maserati风格的元素……
比如前轮后方的三个小小的通风口。
turns.speaker: Fabio Filippini

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf6Fabio_normal_enzo_ferrari_02_2202008
turns.raw:
The Ferrari Enzo, named after Ferrari’s founder, marked a radical stylistic change in Ferrari’s history.

It was certainly one of the most iconic sports cars of the 2000s.

Directly inspired by the aerodynamic shapes of contemporary Formula 1 machines...

...it made a lasting impression with its pointed nose.

Like a jetfighter, driven by functionality and performance, its intersecting blocks created space for its air intakes.

The cabin was also clearly inspired by aeronautical shapes.

At the rear, there appeared, for the first time, dual circular taillights...

...which would later be found on the F430 and other subsequent Ferraris.*
turns.en:
The Ferrari Enzo, named after Ferrari’s founder, marked
a radical stylistic change in Ferrari’s history.

It was certainly one of the most iconic sports cars of the 2000s.
Directly inspired by the aerodynamic shapes
of contemporary Formula 1 machines...

...it made a lasting impression with its pointed nose.
Like a jetfighter, driven by functionality and performance,
its intersecting blocks created space for its air intakes.

The cabin was also clearly inspired by aeronautical shapes.
At the rear, there appeared, for the first time,
dual circular taillights...

...which would later be found on the F430
and other subsequent Ferraris.*
turns.zh:
以法拉利的创始人命名的法拉利Enzo标志着
法拉利史上的一次激进的设计变革。

它无疑是2000年代最具标志性的跑车之一。
此车的设计直接受到了当代F1赛车的
空气动力学造型启发……

以其尖锐的车鼻给人留下了“凶猛”的印象。
它就像一架喷气式战斗机，注重功能和性能，
互相交错的矩形表面为进气口创造了空间。

车厢设计也明显受到航空器的启发。
在车尾，两侧的双圆形尾灯首次亮相……

这种设计后来也出现在F430及其他后续车型上。<next id=2202009 type=9׾
turns.speaker: Fabio Filippini

turns.en:
A legend among supercars of the 1980s,
the Ferrari GTO...

...combined the most advanced performance, technology
and style of its era.
Despite the nominal nod to the iconic 250 GTO from 1962...

...this car actually incorporated the design of the popular 308 GTB,
though slightly stretched to match its longer wheelbase.
Its main character came from the big front-spoiler
and four rectangular daylights...

...as well as the wide fenders covering its big wheels.
The gearbox hanging below the bumper
was framed by four round exhausts.

It was always a wonderful sight to see.

The only details recalling the vintage GTO...

...were the famous three slanted side vents behind the rear wheel,
and the enlarged "duck-tail" spoiler.
turns.zh:
法拉利GTO是80年代超级跑车中的传奇之作……

它集合了当时最先进的性能、技术和当代设计品味。
尽管名字向1962年经典的250 GTO致敬……

但实际上它采用了当时最受欢迎的308 GTB的设计，
不过稍微拉长了车身，以适应更长的轴距。
它的主要特征包括大面积的前导流板和四颗矩形日间行车灯……

以及盖住硕大轮毂的宽大轮拱。
挂在保险杠下方的变速箱被左右四根圆形排气管夹在中间。

每每看到，都让人觉得惊艳。

唯一能让人回想起那款经典GTO的细节……

是后轮后方的三道标志性斜向通风口，和车尾部
超大号的“鸭尾”扰流板。
turns.speaker: Fabio Filippini

turns.raw:
The R.S. 01 was a true mid-engine competition car belonging to the GT category.

Designed for the track, it sat low, wide, and it was functional.

Thanks to its dynamic and muscular form, it was also extremely aggressive.

The huge carbon rear wing always impressed, along with the front spoiler and the rear diffuser.

That said, Renault desired to maintain a "family feeling" in the front and rear...

...so it adopted the style of the lights and grille of the production Mégane.c
turns.en:
The R.S. 01 was a true mid-engine competition car
belonging to the GT category.

Designed for the track, it sat low, wide, and it was functional.

Thanks to its dynamic and muscular form, it was also
extremely aggressive.
The huge carbon rear wing always impressed, along with
the front spoiler and the rear diffuser.

That said, Renault desired to maintain a "family feeling"
in the front and rear...
...so it adopted the style of the lights and grille
of the production Mégane.
turns.zh:
R.S. 01是一款真正的中置引擎赛车，隶属于GT类别。

它专为赛道设计——底盘低、车身宽且功能强大。

充满动感和肌肉感的外形也令它显得攻击性十足。
硕大的碳纤维尾翼给人留下深刻的印象，前扰流器
和后扩散器也同样引人注目。

尽管如此，Renault还是希望在车头和车尾的设计上
保持“家族传承”……
因此借鉴了量产版Mégane的车灯和进气格栅的设计风格。&
turns.speaker: Fabio Filippini

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf6Fabio_normal_f12_berlinetta_12_2202308
turns.raw:
Designed by Pininfarina together with Ferrari Design, the F12 was awarded the Compasso d'Oro 2014.

As you can see, it represents a huge change in design from the previous 599.

Its sculptural forms are extremely compact and "dense."

The front is very aggressive, with the large central grille and two active air intakes for brake cooling...

...while the back is recognized by the "T" theme, visually separating the extractor into two parts.

But the most characteristic elements are the Aero Bridges...

Channelling the air from the hood towards the flanks, improving the overall aerodynamic efficiency.3
turns.en:
Designed by Pininfarina together with Ferrari Design,
the F12 was awarded the Compasso d'Oro 2014.
As you can see, it represents a huge change in
design from the previous 599.

Its sculptural forms are extremely compact and "dense."
The front is very aggressive, with the large central grille
and two active air intakes for brake cooling...
...while the back is recognized by the "T" theme, visually
separating the extractor into two parts.

But the most characteristic elements
are the Aero Bridges...
Channelling the air from the hood towards the flanks,
improving the overall aerodynamic efficiency.
turns.zh:
这辆F12是由宾尼法利纳和法拉利设计合作设计的，
荣获了2014年度的金圆规工业设计奖。
如你所见，相比之前的599，它的设计发生了巨大的变化。

它那雕塑般的形状非常的紧凑和“凝实”。
前脸配备了庞大的中央格栅和两侧冷却刹车用的主动进风口……
攻击性十足，
而后部则能清晰辨认出“T”型元素，在视觉上将排气管
分为左右两组。

但最具特征的元素还是“气动桥”……
它将引擎盖上的空气引导到车身侧面，从而提高了
整体的空气动力学效率。
turns.speaker: Fabio Filippini

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf6Fabio_normal_f430_f1_06_2202408
turns.raw:
The F430 is strongly derived from the 360 Modena, albeit with important technical changes...

Starting with the new V8 engine.

It is also an evolution from a ‘style’ perspective.

While taking the body panels and glass parts from the 360, it has a more aggressive and technical expression.

The large double-oval front air intakes...

Are inspired by the ‘shark nose’ front of the 1961 Ferrari 156 F1.

And the four Enzo-inspired circular tail lights add to its aggressive look.D
turns.en:
The F430 is strongly derived from the 360 Modena,
albeit with important technical changes...
Starting with the new V8 engine.

It is also an evolution from a ‘style’ perspective.

While taking the body panels and glass parts from the 360,
it has a more aggressive and technical expression.
The large double-oval front air intakes...

Are inspired by the ‘shark nose’ front
of the 1961 Ferrari 156 F1.
And the four Enzo-inspired circular tail lights
add to its aggressive look.
turns.zh:
这辆F430在设计上受到了360 Modena的强烈影响，
但也引入了一些重要的技术革新……
首先是一台全新的V8引擎。

从“风格”的角度上来看，你可以将F430视作是一种进化。

虽然采用了与360相同的车身板件和玻璃部件，
却给人以更具进攻性、更有科技感的印象。
它的大型双椭圆形前进气口……

灵感来源于1961年的Ferrari 156 F1上的“鲨鱼鼻”。
四个Enzo风格的环形尾灯则进一步地强化了它的进攻性。+
turns.speaker: Fabio Filippini

turns.en:

the unconventional spirit of the legendary Citroën DS19.

And this DS3 was the first car of the brand.

Aiming instead at a French ‘chic’ imaginary, its shapes

On the whole, I find the extremely compact and energetic

打破常规的精神注入新鲜的血液。

这辆DS3是该品牌的第一款车。
然而，该车与1955年的原版DS在风格和设计上毫无传承。
专注于营造一种法式的“别致”印象，因而选择了稍显复杂，
而且外向的华丽装饰。

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf6Fabio_normal_taycan_turbo_s_20_2202608
turns.raw:
This is the new "electric" expression of Porsche design.

The design of this eco-sustainable evolution adopts the soft and clean language of the Stuttgart house.

The proportions, while similar to those of the Panamera, are more compact and lower to the ground...

...with a typical fast-back tail and a traversing strip of LED rear lights.

However, the front expresses its new identity with the headlights "slashed" directly onto the surface...

...with the four daytime running lights, but also with the aerodynamic outlet behind the front wheel.
turns.en:
This is the new "electric" expression of Porsche design.

The design of this eco-sustainable evolution adopts
the soft and clean language of the Stuttgart house.
The proportions, while similar to those of the Panamera,
are more compact and lower to the ground...
...with a typical fast-back tail and a traversing strip
of LED rear lights.
However, the front expresses its new identity with
the headlights "slashed" directly onto the surface...
...with the four daytime running lights, but also with the
aerodynamic outlet behind the front wheel.
turns.zh:
这款车是对Porsche设计的全新“电气化”表达。

这辆可持续环保升级车型的设计采用
斯图加特品牌那柔和又利落的设计语言。
Taycan的车身比与Panamera类似，
但要比后者更加紧凑、更贴近地面……
还采用了典型的斜背车尾和
由LED灯带构成的横条车尾灯。
不过它的前脸充分体现了全新个性，
两盏大灯和四盏日间行车灯连在一起，直接“下切”向路面……
此外，前轮后方还设计了空气动力学排气口。
turns.speaker: Fabio Filippini

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf6Fabio_normal_taycan_turbo_s_20_2202608
turns.raw:
This is the new "electric" expression of Porsche design.

The design of this eco-sustainable evolution adopts the soft and clean language of the Stuttgart house.

The proportions, while similar to those of the Panamera, are more compact and lower to the ground...

...with a typical fast-back tail and a traversing strip of LED rear lights.

However, the front expresses its new identity with the headlights "slashed" directly onto the surface...

...with the four daytime running lights, but also with the aerodynamic outlet behind the front wheel.
turns.en:
This is the new "electric" expression of Porsche design.

The design of this eco-sustainable evolution adopts
the soft and clean language of the Stuttgart house.
The proportions, while similar to those of the Panamera,
are more compact and lower to the ground...
...with a typical fast-back tail and a traversing strip
of LED rear lights.
However, the front expresses its new identity with
the headlights "slashed" directly onto the surface...
...with the four daytime running lights, but also with the
aerodynamic outlet behind the front wheel.
turns.zh:
这款车是对Porsche设计的全新“电气化”表达。

这辆可持续环保升级车型的设计采用
斯图加特品牌那柔和又利落的设计语言。
Taycan的车身比与Panamera类似，
但要比后者更加紧凑、更贴近地面……
还采用了典型的斜背车尾和
由LED灯带构成的横条车尾灯。
不过它的前脸充分体现了全新个性，
两盏大灯和四盏日间行车灯连在一起，直接“下切”向路面……
此外，前轮后方还设计了空气动力学排气口。
turns.speaker: Fabio Filippini

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf6Fabio_normal_celica_wrc_95_2202708
turns.raw:
The sixth-generation of the Toyota Celica has the most character of all the models in its long lineage.

What we have here is the rally version.

Aesthetically, it’s nearly identical to the production car, apart from the raised rear wing and a few aero features.

An example of modern Japanese "bio-design," it is notably distinguished by its four rounded headlights.

Meanwhile, in other places...

...the Celica draws inspiration from other Toyota sports coupes of its day, such as the Supra and the Soarer.R
turns.en:
The sixth-generation of the Toyota Celica has the most
character of all the models in its long lineage.

What we have here is the rally version.
Aesthetically, it’s nearly identical to the production car,
apart from the raised rear wing and a few aero features.
An example of modern Japanese "bio-design," it is notably
distinguished by its four rounded headlights.
Meanwhile, in other places...

...the Celica draws inspiration from other Toyota sports coupes
of its day, such as the Supra and the Soarer.
turns.zh:
第六代Toyota Celica在其悠久的族系历史上拥有
最独特的个性。

我们眼前的是一辆拉力赛版本车型。
从外观上看，除了抬高的尾翼和安装了几项
空气动力学套件，它和量产版车型几乎别无二致。
这款车是现代日本“仿生设计”的完美示例，
其四盏圆形大灯尤其彰显了这一特色。
与此同时，你可以在多处设计上看到……

Celica从当时的其他Toyota运动型双门跑车，
例如Supra和Soarer身上汲取了不少灵感。
turns.speaker: Fabio Filippini

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf6Fabio_normal_celica_wrc_95_2202708
turns.raw:
The sixth-generation of the Toyota Celica has the most character of all the models in its long lineage.

What we have here is the rally version.

Aesthetically, it’s nearly identical to the production car, apart from the raised rear wing and a few aero features.

An example of modern Japanese "bio-design," it is notably distinguished by its four rounded headlights.

Meanwhile, in other places...

...the Celica draws inspiration from other Toyota sports coupes of its day, such as the Supra and the Soarer.R
turns.en:
The sixth-generation of the Toyota Celica has the most
character of all the models in its long lineage.

What we have here is the rally version.
Aesthetically, it’s nearly identical to the production car,
apart from the raised rear wing and a few aero features.
An example of modern Japanese "bio-design," it is notably
distinguished by its four rounded headlights.
Meanwhile, in other places...

...the Celica draws inspiration from other Toyota sports coupes
of its day, such as the Supra and the Soarer.
turns.zh:
第六代Toyota Celica在其悠久的族系历史上拥有
最独特的个性。

我们眼前的是一辆拉力赛版本车型。
从外观上看，除了抬高的尾翼和安装了几项
空气动力学套件，它和量产版车型几乎别无二致。
这款车是现代日本“仿生设计”的完美示例，
其四盏圆形大灯尤其彰显了这一特色。
与此同时，你可以在多处设计上看到……

Celica从当时的其他Toyota运动型双门跑车，
例如Supra和Soarer身上汲取了不少灵感。
turns.speaker: Fabio Filippini

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf6Fabio_normal_lancer_evo6_tommi_gsr_scp_00_2202808
turns.raw:
The Lancer Evo is one of the most boring Japanese family sedans to have been transformed into a racing beast.

It’s a mild-mannered nobody turned superhero...

The kind typically found in comic books and action flicks.

So what might the ‘super powers’ of this car be from a design perspective?

Why, they are expressed by its sharp spoilers, bumpers and grilles!

All of this brings to mind the imposing image of a samurai’s suit of armour.
turns.en:
The Lancer Evo is one of the most boring Japanese family
sedans to have been transformed into a racing beast.
It’s a mild-mannered nobody turned superhero...

The kind typically found in comic books and action flicks.
So what might the ‘super powers’ of this car be
from a design perspective?
Why, they are expressed by its sharp spoilers, bumpers
and grilles!

All of this brings to mind the imposing image
of a samurai’s suit of armour.
turns.zh:
Lancer Evo是由日本最平淡的轿车产品
族系之一改造而来的比赛野兽。
它就像是漫画或者动作电影中常见的那种……

不显山露水的平凡人变成的超级英雄。
那么从设计角度来说，这款车的“超能力”是什么呢？
还用问吗，它那犀利的扰流板、保险杠和
前格栅就能充分回答这个问题了！

所有这一切都让人不由得联想到日本武士的盔甲。\
turns.speaker: Fabio Filippini

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf6Fabio_normal_v40_t5_rdesign_13_2203008
turns.raw:
The Volvo V40 is a pleasant 5-door hatchback with a sporty demeanor...

...most notably the T5 R-Design version.

Its exterior design conveys an excellent balance of Latin fluidity and Scandinavian rigor.

In fact, it borrows styling cues from the historic Shooting Brake P1800 E...

...a car that possessed an Italian flavor, thanks to the contribution of Sergio Coggiola and Pietro Frua.

What a source of inspiration!

Note the small hollow on the side shoulder and the rounded glass rear window.

These elements recall one of the most iconic cars of the Swedish brand.e
turns.en:
The Volvo V40 is a pleasant 5-door hatchback
with a sporty demeanor...

...most notably the T5 R-Design version.
Its exterior design conveys an excellent balance
of Latin fluidity and Scandinavian rigor.

In fact, it borrows styling cues from
the historic Shooting Brake P1800 E...

...a car that possessed an Italian flavor, thanks to the
contribution of Sergio Coggiola and Pietro Frua.

What a source of inspiration!
Note the small hollow on the side shoulder
and the rounded glass rear window.

These elements recall one of the most iconic cars
of the Swedish brand.
turns.zh:
Volvo V40是一款舒适惬意、带有跑车元素的5门掀背车……

尤其是产品阵容中的T5 R-Design版本。
它的车身外形在拉丁风格的流畅唯美和北欧风格
的严谨坚毅之间取得了傲人的平衡。

它的外形设计借鉴了独具历史意义的Shooting Brake P1800 E……

而科焦拉和弗鲁阿贡献的设计为这款经典车型
赋予了浓厚的意大利风格底蕴。

真是非常了不起的灵感来源。
注意它车身侧面车肩部分的小凹陷和后车窗的
圆弧形玻璃。

这些设计元素带领我们重新领略了这家瑞典品牌
历史上标志性车型的风采。
turns.speaker: Fabio Filippini

turns.raw:
This is the high-performance version of the F430, developed with the help of Michael Schumacher.

Stylistically, it is distinguished by a sharp front, large air intakes, and enhanced brake cooling ducts.

However, the biggest difference is in the rear.

Here we have a large engine grille...

...and a big diffuser framed by a band with two large, round exhausts on either side of the license plate.

To emphasize its sportiness, the side mirrors have been done in carbon fiber...

And a two-tone livery is available as an option.
turns.en:
This is the high-performance version of the F430, developed
with the help of Michael Schumacher.
Stylistically, it is distinguished by a sharp front, large
air intakes, and enhanced brake cooling ducts.
However, the biggest difference is in the rear.

Here we have a large engine grille...

...and a big diffuser framed by a band with two large, round
exhausts on either side of the license plate.
To emphasize its sportiness, the side mirrors have been done
in carbon fiber...
And a two-tone livery is available as an option.
turns.zh:
这是在迈克尔·舒马赫的协助下开发的F430高性能版本。
在外观设计上，它以更锐利的前脸线条、更大的进气口
和优化后的刹车冷却导风口与其他版本区分开来。
然而，最显著的区别在于车尾设计。

这里我们可以看到一个大尺寸的引擎舱散热格栅……

以及一个大型的底部扩散器，由一条装饰带包围，
两个大型圆形排气管则位于车牌的两侧。
为了突出其赛车基因，后视镜采用了碳纤维材质……
此外，还提供了双色条纹涂装作为可选项。
turns.speaker: Fabio Filippini

turns.raw:
Unveiled at the Tokyo Motor Show in 2015...

...the MAZDA RX-VISION immediately thrilled design specialists with the masterful beauty of its sinuous and complex forms.

The "Kodo" design philosophy of applying emotional shapes to evoke fluid and natural movement…

...is perfectly expressed in this spectacular concept car.

Consider its low and wide body, large bonnet, and set-back cockpit.

The side profile is particularly stunning.

This is owing to a controlled use of soft textures and light reflection.

Almost evoking a kind of Japanese lacquer, the flaming red livery...

...helps to amplify the liquid appearance of the RX-VISION’s beautiful sheet metal surfaces.K
turns.en:
Unveiled at the Tokyo Motor Show in 2015...
...the MAZDA RX-VISION immediately thrilled design specialists
with the masterful beauty of its sinuous and complex forms.

The "Kodo" design philosophy of applying emotional shapes
to evoke fluid and natural movement…

...is perfectly expressed in this spectacular concept car.
Consider its low and wide body, large bonnet,
and set-back cockpit.
The side profile is particularly stunning.

This is owing to a controlled use of soft textures
and light reflection.
Almost evoking a kind of Japanese lacquer,
the flaming red livery...

...helps to amplify the liquid appearance of the RX-VISION’s
beautiful sheet metal surfaces.
turns.zh:
2015年东京车展上首次亮相的……
马自达RX-VISION概念赛车，凭借其复杂而流畅的整体
造型美学立即引起了设计专家们的热烈反响。

马自达“魂动”设计理念旨在通过饱含情感的动态造型呈现
流畅自然的动感……

这款令人惊叹的概念赛车完美诠释了该设计哲学。
它拥有低矮而宽阔的车身、
修长的引擎舱盖和靠后的驾驶舱位置。
车身侧面轮廓尤为出众。

这得益于对柔和曲面和光线反射的巧妙运用。
其火焰般的红色车身涂装让人瞬间联想到
日本传统漆器的质感……

进一步强化了RX-VISION车身金属表面的流动美感。
turns.speaker: Fabio Filippini

马自达“魂动”设计理念旨在通过饱含情感的动态造型呈现
流畅自然的动感……

这款令人惊叹的概念赛车完美诠释了该设计哲学。
它拥有低矮而宽阔的车身、
修长的引擎舱盖和靠后的驾驶舱位置。
车身侧面轮廓尤为出众。

这得益于对柔和曲面和光线反射的巧妙运用。
其火焰般的红色车身涂装让人瞬间联想到
日本传统漆器的质感……

进一步强化了RX-VISION车身金属表面的流动美感。
turns.speaker: Fabio Filippini

turns.raw:
The Atenza has a dynamic and elegant design.

It reinterprets the classic sensuality of Italian sportscars from the 1960s...

With a typically Japanese sensitivity to surfaces and details.

A 4-door sedan-coupe layout...

Combined with a style inspired by Mazda Design's 'Kodo' philosophy.

Its soft, fluid shapes and evolving surfaces...

Are enhanced by specially developed metallic colours.

It's not by chance that Mazda cars are often shown in red.

This is done to evoke a sort of fiery temperament defined by emotion and movement.@

柔和的流畅线条与不断演变的表面
被专门开发的金属色车漆进一步增强。
在Mazda的不同广告宣传中，经常以红车示人。>
这并非偶然，红色唤起了某种充满情绪和动感的极致激情意象。

Of all the 911’s countless evolutions, the 964 Turbo S stands out for its exceptionally muscular, pure design.

To bring out its sculptural form...

The entire car is draped in a single hue, from its nose to its 'whale tail' wing.

Its most iconic detail is found in the rear fender air intakes based on those of the Porsche 959!1
turns.en:
Of all the 911’s countless evolutions, the 964 Turbo S
stands out for its exceptionally muscular, pure design.

To bring out its sculptural form...

The entire car is draped in a single hue, from its nose
to its 'whale tail' wing.
And its flared fenders and 18-inch aluminium cup wheels
complete the look.
But if you ask me...

Its most iconic detail is found in the rear fender
air intakes based on those of the Porsche 959!
turns.zh:
在911漫长的进化历程中，964 Turbo S

The Nissan Silvia Spec-R is a small coupe with great proportions.

But it is a great opportunity for you to express your own creativity.

It would make a great custom project car, with large wheels and flaired fenders as a starting point.

Then paint it black, with a splash of color for graphics, or...

...just use your own creative magic!
turns.en:
The Nissan Silvia Spec-R is a small coupe with great proportions.

But it is a great opportunity
for you to express your own creativity.
It would make a great custom project car,
with large wheels and flaired fenders as a starting point.
Then paint it black, with a splash of color for graphics, or... ...just use your own creative magic!
turns.zh:
Nissan Silvia Spec-R是一款车身比例非常好的小型双门跑车，

也是你表达自己的创造力的绝好机会。
它非常适合改装。如果是我的话，会先从大车轮和拓宽
挡泥板入手。
然后把它涂成黑色底色，再添加更多色彩……
不过，可能还是你自己发挥创造力比较好！
turns.speaker: Ed Welburn

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf7Ed_normal_corvette_zr1_90_2300205
turns.raw:
The C4 Corvette is full of innovations, both on its inside and outside.

It’s design is a marked departure from the curvier C3, being more angular and wedge-shaped.

This is evident in the clamshell bonnet and headlamp construction.

In order to tame its powerful four-valve DOHC engine...

The ZR-1 made use of much wider rear tyres and fenders.

The interior was very much inspired by aircraft design.

Some people say that the C4 Corvette lacks the ‘soul’ of a Corvette.

But I happen to like it plenty.
turns.en:
The C4 Corvette is full of innovations,
both on its inside and outside.
It’s design is a marked departure from the curvier C3,
being more angular and wedge-shaped.
This is evident in the clamshell bonnet
and headlamp construction.

In order to tame its powerful four-valve DOHC engine...

turns.zh:
C4 Corvette在内部和外部加入了很多创新点。
它有着楔型的车身，更加有棱有角，与C3 Corvette的
波浪状线条相去甚远。
其掀盖式的引擎盖和头灯的结构就是最好的证明。

ZR-1配备了更宽的后胎和后挡泥板……

以便驯服动力强劲的DOHC 4气门引擎。

其内饰的灵感很大程度来源于飞机。
很多人评论说C4 Corvette缺少了一点Corvette的魂。

但我恰好挺喜欢这款车的。
turns.speaker: Ed Welburn

turns.raw:
The C6 Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 is low and wide, with the stance and physique of a body builder.

To accommodate for wide tyres, it has been given more width than the standard Corvette...

And features more aggressive air vents in its front fender.

Interestingly, the black roof works to emphasise the low-and-wide look of the design.

Also, I really like its round taillights!
turns.en:
The C6 Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 is low and wide,
with the stance and physique of a body builder.

To accommodate for wide tyres, it has been given
more width than the standard Corvette...
And features more aggressive air vents
in its front fender.
Interestingly, the black roof works to emphasise the
low-and-wide look of the design.

Also, I really like its round taillights!
turns.zh:
拥有低矮宽体车身的Chevrolet Corvette C6 ZR1
看上去像一位魁梧的健美运动员。

为了适配更宽的轮胎，它不得不在
标准版Corvette的基础上继续加宽车身……
并在前挡泥板上加入了造型更显凶猛的通风口。
黑色车顶形成了有趣的视觉效果，进一步强调了
低矮和宽阔的外观设计。

另外，我真的很喜欢它的圆形尾灯！
turns.speaker: Ed Welburn

turns.raw:
The C6 Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 is low and wide, with the stance and physique of a body builder.

To accommodate for wide tyres, it has been given more width than the standard Corvette...

And features more aggressive air vents in its front fender.

Interestingly, the black roof works to emphasise the low-and-wide look of the design.

Also, I really like its round taillights!
turns.en:
The C6 Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 is low and wide,
with the stance and physique of a body builder.

To accommodate for wide tyres, it has been given
more width than the standard Corvette...
And features more aggressive air vents
in its front fender.
Interestingly, the black roof works to emphasise the
low-and-wide look of the design.

Also, I really like its round taillights!
turns.zh:
拥有低矮宽体车身的Chevrolet Corvette C6 ZR1
看上去像一位魁梧的健美运动员。

为了适配更宽的轮胎，它不得不在
标准版Corvette的基础上继续加宽车身……
并在前挡泥板上加入了造型更显凶猛的通风口。
黑色车顶形成了有趣的视觉效果，进一步强调了
低矮和宽阔的外观设计。

另外，我真的很喜欢它的圆形尾灯！
turns.speaker: Ed Welburn

turns.raw:
This is my car! Seriously, it’s actually in my garage right now.

The 1969 Camaro is a true classic American muscle car.

The unique grille shape gives the design a wide stance...

... and the character lines on the side of the car gives this Camaro a feeling of speed.

The most dated area of the design are the wheels.

On my '69 Camaro, I ditched the 14-inch Rally wheels and installed 17-inch wheels.

It’s a great car to modify, enhance, and race. Trust me, I know.'
turns.en:

American muscle car.

this Camaro a feeling of speed.

The most dated area of the design are the wheels.

On my '69 Camaro, I ditched the 14-inch Rally wheels

It’s a great car to modify, enhance, and race. Trust me, I know.'
turns.zh:
它就是我的梦中情车！
不开玩笑，我的车库里现在就停着一辆。

这么说吧，1969 Camaro是纯正血统的美式肌肉车。
其独特的进气格栅设计赋予了它宽阔的车身姿态……
艺术化的腰线设计带来了速度感。

如果说它的设计有什么过时的地方，那就是车轮了。

比如我个人就放弃了14英寸的拉力轮毂，
换成了17英寸的。
这是一辆改装潜力巨大，甚至能
提升到赛车水准的好车。

相信我，我知道自己在说什么。
turns.speaker: Ed Welburn

turns.raw:
I’m a big fan of all things Chaparral.

The Chaparral 2J was the most innovative Chaparral.

It's undoubtedly the most radical racecar of the legendary CanAm series.

Its wedge-shaped nose, squared off body and twin fans on the rear...

...instantly made you want to know what mysteries lay below its skin.

Its design looks more like a scientific test bed than an agile racecar.

But the Chaparral 2J could outperform everything.

That's why it was eventually banned from racing because of its incredible technical advantage.

I would have created a body shape which was more in keeping with the front-end design...

...or at least painted the center section white.

turns.zh:
我是Chaparral所有车型的忠实拥簇。

Chaparral 2J是他们最具创新性的一款车型。

毋庸置疑，它是传奇的美加系列当中最激进的一款赛车。
看着它的楔形车头、方正的车身和车位的两部风扇……

让你不由得对它的性能产生好奇。
从设计上看，它更像是一件“实验品”
而不是一台“赛车”，

但Chaparral 2J的确凭实力做到了藐视所有竞争对手。

这就是为什么它最终被禁止参加比赛的原因——
它的技术优势领先到无以复加。
就个人而言，我更倾向于打造
前后端设计更加一致的车身。

至少，我会将车体中段也涂成白色。
turns.speaker: Ed Welburn

turns.raw:
The C7 Corvette was inspired by the rich history of Stingray designs.

That said, it expressed more athleticism in its execution of those designs.

The entire body is like that of a stingray fish, with its undulating surfaces and instantly recognizable slope.

And don't forget that piercing front end.

Its bold hood is shrink-wrapped around a powerful V-8.

Also, its many air intakes and vents manage the flow of air throughout its incredibly sleek design.?
turns.en:
The C7 Corvette was inspired by the rich history
of Stingray designs.

That said, it expressed more athleticism in its execution
of those designs.
The entire body is like that of a stingray fish, with its
undulating surfaces and instantly recognizable slope.

And don't forget that piercing front end.
Its bold hood is shrink-wrapped
around a powerful V-8.
Also, its many air intakes and vents manage the flow of
air throughout its incredibly sleek design.?
turns.zh:
C7 Corvette的设计从Stingray过往车型的丰富历史中
获取了灵感，

并且在运动感方面取得了突破。
整台车的造型好像一条黄貂鱼，
有着棱角分明的前脸设计……

以及起伏的车身表面和令人过目不忘的倾斜线条。
在隆起的引擎盖下包裹着一台强大的V8引擎，
而无处不在的进气口和风道则巧妙地将气流
导向纤细流畅的车身四周。
turns.speaker: Ed Welburn

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf7Ed_normal_corvette_c7_14_2300605
turns.raw:
The C7 Corvette was inspired by the rich history of Stingray designs.

That said, it expressed more athleticism in its execution of those designs.

The entire body is like that of a stingray fish, with its undulating surfaces and instantly recognizable slope.

And don't forget that piercing front end.

Its bold hood is shrink-wrapped around a powerful V-8.

Also, its many air intakes and vents manage the flow of air throughout its incredibly sleek design.?
turns.en:
The C7 Corvette was inspired by the rich history
of Stingray designs.

That said, it expressed more athleticism in its execution
of those designs.
The entire body is like that of a stingray fish, with its
undulating surfaces and instantly recognizable slope.

And don't forget that piercing front end.
Its bold hood is shrink-wrapped
around a powerful V-8.
Also, its many air intakes and vents manage the flow of
air throughout its incredibly sleek design.?
turns.zh:
C7 Corvette的设计从Stingray过往车型的丰富历史中
获取了灵感，

并且在运动感方面取得了突破。
整台车的造型好像一条黄貂鱼，
有着棱角分明的前脸设计……

以及起伏的车身表面和令人过目不忘的倾斜线条。
在隆起的引擎盖下包裹着一台强大的V8引擎，
而无处不在的进气口和风道则巧妙地将气流
导向纤细流畅的车身四周。
turns.speaker: Ed Welburn

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_Sarah_normal_corvette_c7_14_2300606
turns.raw: Thank you for that! It was very interesting indeed!<next id=2300607 type=9>"
turns.en: Thank you for that! It was very interesting indeed!"
turns.zh: 感谢您给我们作了这么精到的讲解！
turns.speaker: Sarah

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf7Ed_normal_chaparral_vision_gt_14_2300705
turns.raw:
Building on Chaparral’s history of innovation, the Chaparral 2X expresses an incredible vision of futurity.

True, it’s a major departure from the Chaparral 2J...

But it’s no less radical in its mission.

With wingsuit technology serving as its inspiration, the Chaparral 2X exhibits unique proportions...

And incorporates moving aerodynamic parts throughout.

All of its design elements work together...

To give it a dynamic look, even when it’s standing still.

The execution of all of the surfaces and the attention to detail are truly stunning.
turns.en:
Building on Chaparral’s history of innovation, the Chaparral
2X expresses an incredible vision of futurity.

True, it’s a major departure from the Chaparral 2J...

But it’s no less radical in its mission.

With wingsuit technology serving as its inspiration,
the Chaparral 2X exhibits unique proportions...

And incorporates moving aerodynamic parts
throughout.
All of its design elements work together...

To give it a dynamic look, even when it’s standing still.

The execution of all of the surfaces and the attention
to detail are truly stunning.
turns.zh:
Chaparral 2X是Chaparral车系创新史的继承者，
造型设计充满未来感。

毋庸置疑，它的造型和Chaparral 2J截然不同……

但追逐极限的使命被延续了下来。

以翼装技术为灵感，Chaparral 2X的车身表现出独特的比例……

并在整个车身融入了可动空气动力学部件。
所有设计元素融合到一起后，赋予了它极富动感的外观。

即便静止不动，依然让人感到冲劲与跃动。

另外，他们对车身表面的处理
和对细节的执着都令人叹服。
turns.speaker: Ed Welburn

concept car.

turns.zh:
C3 Corvette Stingray的设计是对C2 Corvette的一场告别。

它设计之初的目标是要成为可以上路的概念车。

前后挡泥板的形状大胆、狂野，中部线条收紧……

从上翻大灯到时尚有型的侧出排气管……

它从头至脚都非常像一辆“展台车”。

甚至连门把手造型都充满创新！
据说，车身内饰的灵感来自于NASA的火箭与飞船……

不仅如此，有一段时间，所有宇航员的座驾
都是C3 Corvette Stingrays。

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf7Ed_normal_corvette_coupe_63_2300905
turns.raw:
This is the legendary 1963 Corvette Sting Ray ‘Split Window’ coupe.

Regarding its name, the ‘Split Window’...

This comes from the very sleek rod in the rear window.

This rod is not only a distinguishing feature...

It also allows the profile of the car to remain uninterrupted in its flow.

This car is so well-balanced from top to bottom, and from end to end.

I particularly love the fender shape!

Clearly, it was inspired by the Italian streamliners of the 1950s.

When I look at the sleek undulating lines of the 1963 Sting Ray...

It really does remind me of its underwater namesake!
turns.en:
This is the legendary 1963 Corvette Sting Ray
‘Split Window’ coupe.
Regarding its name, the ‘Split Window’...

This comes from the very sleek rod in the rear window.

This rod is not only a distinguishing feature...

It also allows the profile of the car to remain
uninterrupted in its flow.
This car is so well-balanced from top to bottom,
and from end to end.

I particularly love the fender shape!

Clearly, it was inspired by the Italian streamliners
of the 1950s.
When I look at the sleek undulating lines of
the 1963 Sting Ray...

It really does remind me of its underwater
namesake!
turns.zh:
这是传说中的1963款科尔维特Sting Ray
“Split Window”双门跑车。
“Split Window”这个绰号的由来是指它的后车窗被一根立柱一分为二。

这根独树一帜的立柱……

……让车辆的整体轮廓更加连贯和流畅。

我还特别喜爱它的挡泥板的形状，
其灵感应该来源于1950年代意大利汽车的流线型车身。
这辆车从头到尾、从上到下都充满平衡感，

堪称永恒的经典设计。
每次看到那起伏流畅的车身外形……

……我就不由想起那条生活在水底的流线型生物。

没错，那就是这辆车名字的来源，魔鬼鱼。]
turns.speaker: Ed Welburn

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf7Ed_normal_corvette_coupe_63_2300905
turns.raw:
This is the legendary 1963 Corvette Sting Ray ‘Split Window’ coupe.

Regarding its name, the ‘Split Window’...

This comes from the very sleek rod in the rear window.

This rod is not only a distinguishing feature...

It also allows the profile of the car to remain uninterrupted in its flow.

This car is so well-balanced from top to bottom, and from end to end.

I particularly love the fender shape!

Clearly, it was inspired by the Italian streamliners of the 1950s.

When I look at the sleek undulating lines of the 1963 Sting Ray...

It really does remind me of its underwater namesake!
turns.en:
This is the legendary 1963 Corvette Sting Ray
‘Split Window’ coupe.
Regarding its name, the ‘Split Window’...

This comes from the very sleek rod in the rear window.

This rod is not only a distinguishing feature...

It also allows the profile of the car to remain
uninterrupted in its flow.
This car is so well-balanced from top to bottom,
and from end to end.

I particularly love the fender shape!

Clearly, it was inspired by the Italian streamliners
of the 1950s.
When I look at the sleek undulating lines of
the 1963 Sting Ray...

It really does remind me of its underwater
namesake!
turns.zh:
这是传说中的1963款科尔维特Sting Ray
“Split Window”双门跑车。
“Split Window”这个绰号的由来是指它的后车窗被一根立柱一分为二。

这根独树一帜的立柱……

……让车辆的整体轮廓更加连贯和流畅。

我还特别喜爱它的挡泥板的形状，
其灵感应该来源于1950年代意大利汽车的流线型车身。
这辆车从头到尾、从上到下都充满平衡感，

堪称永恒的经典设计。
每次看到那起伏流畅的车身外形……

……我就不由想起那条生活在水底的流线型生物。

没错，那就是这辆车名字的来源，魔鬼鱼。]
turns.speaker: Ed Welburn

turns.raw:
The Toyota 2000GT is a wonderful sports car, and a true modern-day classic.

The proportions are great. I wouldn’t change a thing.

It looks best from a rear three-quarter angle. Seen from that perspective...

The roofline settles far back on the body, making the bonnet look long and sleek.

The ‘60s-era details are creative and add to the charm of the design.8

turns.zh:
这辆Toyota 2000GT是非常优秀的跑车，
也是现代汽车历史中的一款经典杰作。

它的比例十分出色，我甚至找不到任何改进的余地。
我个人最喜欢的欣赏角度是侧后方。
从这个角度看上去……

……车身线条从车顶向尾部缓缓滑落，显得顺滑流畅，
还有它的引擎盖，是那么的修长而利落。

在1960年代，就连细节的设计都创意无穷，
为整体设计增色不少。
turns.speaker: Ed Welburn

Is how it does not rely on gimmicks, but is rather a pure expression of functional beauty.

The surfaces are well-sculpted into tasteful shapes. And the body is muscular, with great proportions.

Though the wheels are the largest of their kind, the car seems to almost hug the ground.

Indeed, the Mercedes A45 AMG has been carefully designed To express a tough and cool attitude.

I want one in my garage!
turns.en:

turns.zh:
这辆Mercedes A45 AMG的设计十分成熟，
性能强悍而且外形帅气。

其车身轮廓充满肌肉感，而且保持了合理的比例。
车身表面经过精心塑形，弧形线条丰富而流畅。
设计师甚至考虑到了轮胎的问题，
最宽尺寸的车胎可以让这辆Mercedes牢牢扒住地面。
这辆车的优势在于不忘初心，
绝无任何花哨的设计，只用实力说话。

这样的车，连我也想买一辆！/
turns.speaker: Ed Welburn

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf7Ed_normal_corvette_racer_concept_59_2301205
turns.raw:
The Corvette Stingray Racer had a big influence on every Corvette that came after it.

It was not designed as a production or concept car, but as a very serious racecar.

Its design was a radical departure from that of previous Corvettes.

Many of its shapes, like those characterized by its beautiful fenders, were inspired by Italian streamliners.

The strong crease that defines the car contributes to its evocation of speed.
turns.en:
The Corvette Stingray Racer had a big influence
on every Corvette that came after it.

It was not designed as a production or concept car,
but as a very serious racecar.

Its design was a radical departure from that of
previous Corvettes.
Many of its shapes, like those characterized by
its beautiful fenders, were inspired by Italian streamliners.
The strong crease that defines the car contributes to
its evocation of speed.
turns.zh:
Corvette Stingray Racer的诞生对后世每一台Corvette
都带来了重大影响。

自设计伊始，它的定位就不是一台量产车或概念车，
而是彻彻底底的赛车。

大刀阔斧的设计改动使其与
之前的Corvette大相径庭。
车身多处的造型设计都明显受到早期意大利流线型车身
的启发，尤其是那堪称精雕细琢的前后挡泥板。
另外，得益于围绕车身一周的“折缝线”设计，
令它多出了几分速度感。
turns.speaker: Ed Welburn

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf7Ed_normal_corvette_racer_concept_59_2301205
turns.raw:
The Corvette Stingray Racer had a big influence on every Corvette that came after it.

It was not designed as a production or concept car, but as a very serious racecar.

Its design was a radical departure from that of previous Corvettes.

Many of its shapes, like those characterized by its beautiful fenders, were inspired by Italian streamliners.

The strong crease that defines the car contributes to its evocation of speed.
turns.en:
The Corvette Stingray Racer had a big influence
on every Corvette that came after it.

It was not designed as a production or concept car,
but as a very serious racecar.

Its design was a radical departure from that of
previous Corvettes.
Many of its shapes, like those characterized by
its beautiful fenders, were inspired by Italian streamliners.
The strong crease that defines the car contributes to
its evocation of speed.
turns.zh:
Corvette Stingray Racer的诞生对后世每一台Corvette
都带来了重大影响。

自设计伊始，它的定位就不是一台量产车或概念车，
而是彻彻底底的赛车。

大刀阔斧的设计改动使其与
之前的Corvette大相径庭。
车身多处的造型设计都明显受到早期意大利流线型车身
的启发，尤其是那堪称精雕细琢的前后挡泥板。
另外，得益于围绕车身一周的“折缝线”设计，
令它多出了几分速度感。
turns.speaker: Ed Welburn

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf7Ed_normal_tesla_model_s_sig_perf_12_2301305
turns.raw:
Tesla Model S Signature Performance has an absolutely wonderful stance.

The wheels are placed well outside of the basic body shape, with generous flairs reaching out to those tires.

The body shape is sleek, slippery, and very cool.

It doesn’t need any tacked-on chrome or aero devices.

I really like the front-end graphics of the Signature Performance model much better than the base Model S.
turns.en:
Tesla Model S Signature Performance has
 an absolutely wonderful stance.

 The wheels are placed well outside of the basic body shape,
with generous flairs reaching out to those tires.
The body shape is sleek, slippery, and very cool.

 It doesn’t need any tacked-on chrome or aero devices.
 I really like the front-end graphics of the Signature Performance
model much better than the base Model S.
turns.zh:
Tesla Model S Signature Performance的外形绝对令人惊艳。

车轮恰到好处地超出车身外廓，
宽大的轮眉向外延展，盖住车轮。
车身线条顺滑流畅，
无需任何附加的铬合金或空气动力学部件，

就已经显得未来感十足，帅气非凡。
我很喜欢Signature Performance的前脸造型，
比基础款Model S的平面耐看多了。
turns.speaker: Ed Welburn

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf7Ed_normal_countach_lp400_74_2301405
turns.raw:
I’ll never forget the first time I saw a Lamborghini Countach on the street.

The LP400 is a very fine car indeed.

It is a modern classic and the very definition of a supercar.

One doesn’t even need to open its scissor doors to feel its striking presence.

It has an extremely wedge-shaped profile with a steep windscreen and high tail.

And the bold crease that runs the length of the car is complimented by well-executed surfaces.
turns.en:
I’ll never forget the first time I saw a Lamborghini
Countach on the street.

The LP400 is a very fine car indeed.

It is a modern classic and the very definition
of a supercar.
One doesn’t even need to open its scissor doors
to feel its striking presence.

It has an extremely wedge-shaped profile
with a steep windscreen and high tail.
And the bold crease that runs the length of the car
is complimented by well-executed surfaces.
turns.zh:
我永远忘不了第一次在街上看到Lamborghini Countach
的情景。

LP400确实是一辆非常出色的车。

它是一款现代经典车，也是超级跑车的绝佳代表。
即使不打开它的剪刀式车门，
也能感受到它令人惊叹的存在感。

它的车身像是一个压到极致的倒梯形，
挡风玻璃斜度很大，尾翼则高高耸起。
一条让人无法忽视的折痕线贯穿整个
侧面车身，夺人眼球。

这条折痕线来自于车身表面的高差——
每个表面都经过精心设计，呈现不同程度的拱起。
turns.speaker: Ed Welburn

turns.raw:
I’ll never forget the first time I saw a Lamborghini Countach on the street.

The LP400 is a very fine car indeed.

It is a modern classic and the very definition of a supercar.

One doesn’t even need to open its scissor doors to feel its striking presence.

It has an extremely wedge-shaped profile with a steep windscreen and high tail.

And the bold crease that runs the length of the car is complimented by well-executed surfaces.
turns.en:
I’ll never forget the first time I saw a Lamborghini
Countach on the street.

The LP400 is a very fine car indeed.

It is a modern classic and the very definition
of a supercar.
One doesn’t even need to open its scissor doors
to feel its striking presence.

It has an extremely wedge-shaped profile
with a steep windscreen and high tail.
And the bold crease that runs the length of the car
is complimented by well-executed surfaces.
turns.zh:
我永远忘不了第一次在街上看到Lamborghini Countach
的情景。

LP400确实是一辆非常出色的车。

它是一款现代经典车，也是超级跑车的绝佳代表。
即使不打开它的剪刀式车门，
也能感受到它令人惊叹的存在感。

它的车身像是一个压到极致的倒梯形，
挡风玻璃斜度很大，尾翼则高高耸起。
一条让人无法忽视的折痕线贯穿整个
侧面车身，夺人眼球。

这条折痕线来自于车身表面的高差——
每个表面都经过精心设计，呈现不同程度的拱起。
turns.speaker: Ed Welburn

The 2016 Camaro was inspired by the original Camaro of the 1960s.

But in a very fresh, contemporary way.

This iteration of the Camaro placed a greater emphasis on its wheels, with a wide stance and muscular fender forms.

Many of its shapes, in particular the hood, front end, and rear were inspired by Corvette design.
turns.en:
The 2016 Camaro was inspired by the original Camaro
of the 1960s.

But in a very fresh, contemporary way.
This iteration of the Camaro placed a greater emphasis on its
wheels, with a wide stance and muscular fender forms.
Many of its shapes, in particular the hood, front end,
and rear were inspired by Corvette design.
turns.zh:
这辆2016款Camaro设计灵感来源于1960年代的初代Camaro……

但进行了大刀阔斧的现代化改动，令人耳目一新。
这个版本的Camaro设计重点强调轮毂和
肌肉感十足的挡泥板，展现类似宽体低趴的形态。
车身部位的许多形状，尤其是引擎盖、车头和车尾，
灵感其实都来源于Corvette。
turns.speaker: Ed Welburn

turns.en:
Everything about The Camaro ZL1 says speed and power.
It’s practically a weapon on wheels.
From its overall stance to its many functional splitters,
wings, and air intakes, this car is track ready!

And the ZL1 Camaro has a wider track
than other Camaros.
Its dark bonnet, grille, headlamps, and full-width splitter
give this car a wide, sinister appearance.
In two-tone colouring, it's all business. Period!
turns.zh:
这辆Camaro ZL1的一切设计目的都是为了速度和力量，
它简直就是一件安上了轮子的武器！
从它的整体姿态到各种功能性的定风翼、尾翼和进气口，
都在告诉你——这辆车完全是为赛道打造的！

这辆Camaro ZL1拥有比其他的Camaro型号更宽的轮距。
涂黑的引擎盖、格栅、车头灯和车身等宽定风翼，
让它显得更狰狞、更具威胁性。
它还通过这种撞色设计表明了态度——不废话，只为胜利！
turns.speaker: Ed Welburn

turns.raw:
The Pontiac GTO was a king among American muscle cars, and the GTO 'The Judge' was the ultimate GTO.

My favourite aspect of the 1969 GTO 'The Judge' was the beautifully sculpted body side and soft fender peaks.

It’s unfortunate that the rear bumper didn’t get the same colour treatment as that of the front bumper.

Other than that, all this car needs are much larger wheels.

They would make the design look more balanced and athletic.\
turns.en:
The Pontiac GTO was a king among American muscle cars,
and the GTO 'The Judge' was the ultimate GTO.
My favourite aspect of the 1969 GTO 'The Judge' was the
beautifully sculpted body side and soft fender peaks.
It’s unfortunate that the rear bumper didn’t get the
same colour treatment as that of the front bumper.

Other than that, all this car needs are much larger wheels.
They would make the design look more balanced
and athletic.\
turns.zh:
Pontiac GTO就是美国肌肉车之王，
而这辆GTO 'The Judge'则是终极的GTO。
我对这辆1969款GTO 'The Judge'最喜爱的一点就是
它那雕塑般硬朗的车身侧线条与柔和的挡泥板上部的交融。
这里有个小小的遗憾，它的后保险杠并没有采用
与前保险杠相同的喷漆颜色。

除此之外，这辆车唯一欠缺之处就是需要更大的轮毂。
大尺寸的轮毂可以让它整体看上去更平衡、更具运动感。
turns.speaker: Ed Welburn

turns.raw:
The C7 ZR1 Corvette is the ultimate expression of a front-engine Corvette's power and bold design.

The ZR1 is sometimes known as ‘The Widebody’.

It’s significantly wider than a standard Corvette Stingray in order to accommodate its massive tyres.

The ZR1 has very significant air intakes and air exits.

These manage the flow of air and feed the many coolers in the nose and tail of the car.

Most people love the rear wing.

But I prefer the smaller rear spoiler that was also available..

这辆C7 ZR1 Corvette是前置引擎Corvette那强大性能

为了容纳那套巨大的轮胎，它比
标准款Corvette Stingray要宽出许多。
ZR1同样还配备了巨大的进气口和出气口……

用于引导气流，为车头和车尾的散热器提供风冷降温。
许多人都很喜欢它的尾翼。

不过我个人更喜欢配备尺寸更小的后扰流板。[
turns.speaker: Ed Welburn

turns.raw:
The Lexus LC500 has absolutely incredible proportions.

With a long, low bonnet, a long wheelbase...

A tight cabin, large wheels placed at the corners...

And an absolutely juicy body shape, which is well-sculpted.

It has very technical headlamps and taillamps, and a fresh interpretation of the Lexus grille.

This design makes it very clear that a highly advanced engine is under the bonnet. I absolutely love this car!
turns.en:
The Lexus LC500 has absolutely incredible proportions.
With a long, low bonnet, a long wheelbase...
A tight cabin, large wheels placed
at the corners...

And an absolutely juicy body shape,
which is well-sculpted.

It has very technical headlamps and taillamps,
and a fresh interpretation of the Lexus grille.
This design makes it very clear that a highly advanced
engine is under the bonnet. I absolutely love this car!
turns.zh:
Lexus LC500的车身比例十分惊人。
它具有修长而低矮的引擎盖，相对较长的轴距
和紧凑的驾驶舱，硕大的车轮更是占据了四角……

外加夺人眼球、线条精雕细刻的抢眼车身造型。

它的大灯和尾灯科技含量很高，前格栅
则是对Lexus经典款式的重新演绎。
整体的造型都在告诉你——我的引擎盖下面安装了一颗
非常先进的引擎。这是我非常非常喜欢的一台车！\
turns.speaker: Ed Welburn

turns.raw:
The Lexus LC500 has absolutely incredible proportions.

With a long, low bonnet, a long wheelbase...

A tight cabin, large wheels placed at the corners...

And an absolutely juicy body shape, which is well-sculpted.

It has very technical headlamps and taillamps, and a fresh interpretation of the Lexus grille.

This design makes it very clear that a highly advanced engine is under the bonnet. I absolutely love this car!
turns.en:
The Lexus LC500 has absolutely incredible proportions.

A tight cabin, large wheels placed
at the corners...

And an absolutely juicy body shape,

外加夺人眼球、线条精雕细刻的抢眼车身造型。

如果这就是Evo的最后一款车型，那么他们无疑是
将最好的留到了最后。
Mitsubishi在2015 Evolution Final Edition的设计中
做到了出色的极致。

他们的设计师创造出了工艺精湛的车身外型，
各个表面、各处线条都做工精细，流畅延伸。
此外，所有空气动力学组件、进气口和出气口
都与该车的总体设计和谐相融，

就连轮胎和轮毂的尺寸也是如此！

turns.en:
The McLaren 650S has classic mid-engine proportions,
executed in a very fresh way.
It has a very bold and distinct face,
as well as a strong rear.

All of the shapes, curves, plan views, and overall profile
work together...
Highlighted by the side scoop and side glass shape.
turns.zh:
McLaren 650S拥有经典的中置引擎比例，
但以一种非常新颖的方式呈现。
它的前脸大胆而独特，车尾设计也风格鲜明。

从车身造型、曲线、表面效果到整体轮廓，无不协调融洽……
侧进气口和侧窗玻璃形状更是将这一特点重点凸显出来。

The Ferrari FXX K gives me the impression of a ‘2-seater Formula 1 Ferrari’.

The overall body shape is aggressive, and every bit of the car is designed for the purpose of speed.

The front wing/splitter, and all of the intakes and air exits are impressive.

I am particularly intrigued by the small shape just forward of the rear wheel which deflects air from the rear tyre.

As you walk around to the rear, it’s all serious business.
turns.en:
The Ferrari FXX K gives me the impression
of a ‘2-seater Formula 1 Ferrari’.
The overall body shape is aggressive, and every bit
of the car is designed for the purpose of speed.
The front wing/splitter, and all of the intakes
and air exits are impressive.
I am particularly intrigued by the small shape just forward
of the rear wheel which deflects air from the rear tyre.

As you walk around to the rear,
it’s all serious business.
turns.zh:
Ferrari FXX K给我一种“次级别F1 Ferrari赛车”的印象。
车身塑造得非常有进攻性，几乎每一个部件
都是为速度而设计的。
从前翼/定风翼，再到所有的进气口及排气口的处理
都令人印象深刻。
特别打动我的是紧靠后轮前方的这个小翼片造型，
它的作用是偏转气流，使其远离后轮。

沿着车身漫步到车后，眼中所及都是匠心独运的设计。\

完全配得上它所获得的一切赞誉。

比如它的引擎盖、挡泥板上缘、下倾的车尾

它最特别的一处设计元素就是它的
鸥翼车门，而且我觉得门关上之后甚至更好看了。

turns.raw:
The GT Concept Car by Citroën has a very intriguing design.

Its centre fuselage disappears behind its very bold fender shapes.

This gives the car a sleek and aggressive look, and helps to manage air flow and cooling in a unique way.

The windscreen and side glass are like slits, giving the GT by Citroën a very private, sinister look.
turns.en:
The GT Concept Car by Citroën has a very intriguing design.

Its centre fuselage disappears behind
its very bold fender shapes.
This gives the car a sleek and aggressive look, and helps
to manage air flow and cooling in a unique way.
The windscreen and side glass are like slits, giving the
GT by Citroën a very private, sinister look.
turns.zh:
这辆GT by Citroën概念车带来了令人惊诧的设计。

它的车身不着痕迹地消失在极度激进的挡泥板之后。
这种特色让这辆车拥有了利落而极富侵略性的外观，
并以独特的方式辅助了气流引导和散热。
挡风玻璃和车窗玻璃就像是在同一块玻璃上开了缝一般，
让这辆GT by Citroën呈现出既注重隐私，又略带邪恶的外观。
turns.speaker: Ed Welburn

Everything about it says 'power', from its bulging shapes to its muscular fenders...

I liken the big-block Chevelle SS to an animal ready to pounce.j
turns.en:
The 1970 Chevrolet Chevelle SS is one of the most masculine
cars of the muscle-car era.
Everything about it says 'power', from its bulging shapes
to its muscular fenders...

To its power-dome, cowl-induction bonnet.
I liken the big-block Chevelle SS
to an animal ready to pounce.
turns.zh:
这辆1970款Chevrolet Chevelle SS是肌肉车黄金时代
最富肌肉感的车型之一。
从它壮硕的车身轮廓到粗犷的挡泥板……

再到向上隆起、采用风帽导气设计的引擎盖，
每个细节无不散发出一种“动力澎湃”的感觉。
我会将这款大排量的Chevelle SS
比作一只蓄势待发的猛兽。
turns.speaker: Ed Welburn

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf8Freeman_normal__911_carrera_rs_92_2400105
turns.raw:
The 964-based RS is one of my favorite models.

Because it retains the original "Ur" 911 shape and air-cooled flat-6!

I'm thrilled it is visually pure and doesn't have any add-ons like a fixed rear wing.

Also, it's Porsche's first Cup Car.

A true successor to the '73 RS and the '74 RS 3.0.

You can immediately tell a 964 RS from a normal 964 by just looking at the stance and the wheels.

The 17-inch wheels on the 964 were made from aluminum.

On the 964 RS, they were visually the same, but were wider and made from lighter magnesium.

Today, they fall into the "unobtanium" category!Z
turns.en:
The 964-based RS is one of my favorite models.

Because it retains the original "Ur" 911 shape
and air-cooled flat-6!
I'm thrilled it is visually pure and doesn't have
any add-ons like a fixed rear wing.

Also, it's Porsche's first Cup Car.

A true successor to the '73 RS and the '74 RS 3.0.
You can immediately tell a 964 RS from a normal 964 by
just looking at the stance and the wheels.

The 17-inch wheels on the 964 were made from aluminum.

On the 964 RS, they were visually the same, but were wider
and made from lighter magnesium.

Today, they fall into the "unobtanium" category!
turns.zh:
这款964 RS版本是我最喜欢的车型之一。

为什么？因为它保留了911原汁原味的“Ur-911”型外形和风
冷水平对置六缸发动机！
它带来的纯粹感令我兴奋不已，比如说，它就没有添加
固定尾翼之类的部件。

而且，它是保时捷的第一辆“奖杯赛车”。

我认为它是73版RS和74版RS 3.0真正的继承者。
只需看一下车辆的姿态和车轮，你就能立即分辨出
964 RS和普通964的差异。

964使用的17寸车轮杯型1是铝制的，

而964 RS虽然使用了同尺寸的车轮，但显得更宽，而
且使用更轻的镁合金材料制造。

镁现在已经被归为“超导矿石”类目，价格不菲！
turns.speaker: Freeman Thomas

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf8Freeman_normal__911_carrera_rs_92_2400107
turns.raw:
It could be ordered in standard colors, along with Rubystone, Signal Green or Maritime Blue.

The sparse interiors came in black as standard.

Then there were the one-piece composite Recaros, with central trimmings in two-tone leathers.

There was the "M001" Carrera Cup Version, the "M002" RS Touring Version, or the "M003" N/GT1 Carrera RS.

This is a must-have for the 911 air-cooled purist!
turns.en:
It could be ordered in standard colors, along with
Rubystone, Signal Green or Maritime Blue.

The sparse interiors came in black as standard.

Then there were the one-piece composite Recaros,
with central trimmings in two-tone leathers.
There was the "M001" Carrera Cup Version, the "M002"
RS Touring Version, or the "M003" N/GT1 Carrera RS.
This is a must-have for the 911 air-cooled purist!
turns.zh:
这辆车的标准车身配色包括了红宝石色，信号绿，海洋
蓝。

内饰倒是标准且朴素的黑色，

外加中间包边的Recaro运动桶椅，可选双色皮革，
还分成了“M001” Carrera Cup版本、“M002” RS Touring版
和“M003” N/GT1 Carrera RS。
对于追求纯粹的风冷引擎911爱好者来说，这是一台必须
拥有的车！
turns.speaker: Freeman Thomas

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf8Freeman_normal__911_carrera_rs_92_2400105
turns.raw:
The 964-based RS is one of my favorite models.

Because it retains the original "Ur" 911 shape and air-cooled flat-6!

I'm thrilled it is visually pure and doesn't have any add-ons like a fixed rear wing.

Also, it's Porsche's first Cup Car.

A true successor to the '73 RS and the '74 RS 3.0.

You can immediately tell a 964 RS from a normal 964 by just looking at the stance and the wheels.

The 17-inch wheels on the 964 were made from aluminum.

On the 964 RS, they were visually the same, but were wider and made from lighter magnesium.

Today, they fall into the "unobtanium" category!Z
turns.en:
The 964-based RS is one of my favorite models.

Because it retains the original "Ur" 911 shape
and air-cooled flat-6!
I'm thrilled it is visually pure and doesn't have
any add-ons like a fixed rear wing.

Also, it's Porsche's first Cup Car.

A true successor to the '73 RS and the '74 RS 3.0.
You can immediately tell a 964 RS from a normal 964 by
just looking at the stance and the wheels.

The 17-inch wheels on the 964 were made from aluminum.

On the 964 RS, they were visually the same, but were wider
and made from lighter magnesium.

Today, they fall into the "unobtanium" category!
turns.zh:
这款964 RS版本是我最喜欢的车型之一。

为什么？因为它保留了911原汁原味的“Ur-911”型外形和风
冷水平对置六缸发动机！
它带来的纯粹感令我兴奋不已，比如说，它就没有添加
固定尾翼之类的部件。

而且，它是保时捷的第一辆“奖杯赛车”。

我认为它是73版RS和74版RS 3.0真正的继承者。
只需看一下车辆的姿态和车轮，你就能立即分辨出
964 RS和普通964的差异。

964使用的17寸车轮杯型1是铝制的，

而964 RS虽然使用了同尺寸的车轮，但显得更宽，而
且使用更轻的镁合金材料制造。

镁现在已经被归为“超导矿石”类目，价格不菲！
turns.speaker: Freeman Thomas

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf8Freeman_normal__911_carrera_rs_92_2400107
turns.raw:
It could be ordered in standard colors, along with Rubystone, Signal Green or Maritime Blue.

The sparse interiors came in black as standard.

Then there were the one-piece composite Recaros, with central trimmings in two-tone leathers.

There was the "M001" Carrera Cup Version, the "M002" RS Touring Version, or the "M003" N/GT1 Carrera RS.

This is a must-have for the 911 air-cooled purist!

turns.zh:
这辆车的标准车身配色包括了红宝石色，信号绿，海洋
蓝。

内饰倒是标准且朴素的黑色，

外加中间包边的Recaro运动桶椅，可选双色皮革，
还分成了“M001” Carrera Cup版本、“M002” RS Touring版
和“M003” N/GT1 Carrera RS。
对于追求纯粹的风冷引擎911爱好者来说，这是一台必须
拥有的车！

turns.raw:
There are some subtle visual differences between this car and the R8 LMS: it's cleaner, with fewer graphics.

The aggressive look of the red tail lights and flat red bumper lines remain very much in place.

It's still a classically German look, in other words!

The front is also more visually striking, and the spoiler is now at a reverse angle.

Some have also noted that the red winglets look a little bit like whiskers.

This is an evolved version of the R8 LMS, hence the 'Evo' name. It's certainly had a visual overhaul!

Truth be told, it's getting closer and close to being my perfect car!]

turns.zh:
与之前2015年的R8勒芒系列赛相比，这款R8只有一些外观
上细微差别。它的车身比较干净，没有那么多繁琐的图形，
但红色的尾灯和横向的红色保险杠线条让它保留了应有
的侵略性。

换句话说，这就是经典的日耳曼风格！
它的正面也变得更引人瞩目。还有扰流板被设置成了反角。
有人还开玩笑说，红色的侧翼就像两撇胡须一样。

名称中包含的“进化”一词代表它是R8勒芒系列赛的进
化版，整体视觉效果发生了天翻地覆的变化。

说句真心话，它离我心目中的完美汽车越来越近了！
turns.speaker: Freeman Thomas

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf8Freeman_normal_tt_coupe_32_03_2400305
turns.raw:
The design of the original Audi TT Coupe is very close to my heart.

My intent was to be "absolute" and "pure" in a holistic concept.

My inspirations for the TT concepts were...

...Erwin Komenda's 356 Speedster and 550 LeMans Coupe...

...along with Ecola Spada's Giulietta SZ "round tail" Coupe.

The short round front and rear overhangs arch up geometrically...

...into the belt-line with the fender arches repeating the motion.

The upper spear-line served to shave the surface and light reflection...

...and connect the headlamp/taillamp graphics.

This creates an energy that also communicates "quattro" by visually connecting the wheels!

The low, round "chopped" roof sits on top of the lower fuselage as a separate visual element similar to the 550 LeMans Coupe.

The interior designed in collaboration with Romulus Rost is just as absolute and pure!

I still can't believe Audi produced the TT!^

turns.zh:
我对初代奥迪TT轿跑的设计
仍记忆犹新！

我当时的整体设计理念是
“绝对”和“纯粹”。
TT的灵感来自于

艾尔文·柯曼达的356 Speedster和550勒芒轿跑，

以及艾可拉·斯帕达的
吉里耶塔 SZ “圆尾”轿跑。短小的圆拱形车头和车尾
，其形状一直延续至车腰，连挡泥板也沿用这一几何形状。
车体上部的线条起到了
削修表面、避免反光、

连接头灯/尾灯形状的作用。

这种将前后轮连接起来的视觉效果，
还传达出了“四驱”的能量！
低矮的圆拱形车顶直接坐落在下车身上，
创造出了一个独立的，类似550勒芒轿跑的视觉元素。
与罗穆卢斯·罗斯特合作设计的内饰
也同�绝对和纯粹！
我仍然不敢相信奥迪真的把TT生产了出来！~
turns.speaker: Freeman Thomas

turns.raw:
The original 2001 996-based GT3 is one of the best-kept Porsche secrets!

Both technically and mechanically, it is the most raw of all the GT3s!

It featured a naturally aspirated GT1/Mezger flat-6 in a reinforced chassis geared towards motorsports.

The success of the GT3 was unexpected, with demand exceeding the limited production run!

It is pure magic!;
turns.en:
The original 2001 996-based GT3 is one of
the best-kept Porsche secrets!

Both technically and mechanically, it is the most raw
of all the GT3s!
It featured a naturally aspirated GT1/Mezger flat-6 in a
reinforced chassis geared towards motorsports.

The success of the GT3 was unexpected, with demand
exceeding the limited production run!

It is pure magic!;
turns.zh:
2001款996 GT3是Porsche最大的秘密武器之一！

无论是技术方面，还是机械方面，
这款车型的凶悍程度都冠绝Porsche所推出的所有GT3！
它搭载了来自GT1/Mezger的自然进气水平对置六缸引擎
以及赛车级的强化悬挂。

GT3的成功来得如此突然，订单纷至沓来，
远超原有的限量发售数！

这辆车简直像有魔力一般！
turns.speaker: Freeman Thomas

turns.raw: Have you ever heard of Porsche's Mezger engine？<yesno msgid=2400407 msgtype=9 nmsgid=2400408 nmsgtype=9>
turns.en: Have you ever heard of Porsche's Mezger engine？
turns.zh: 您听说过Porsche的Mezger引擎吗？
turns.speaker: Sarah

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_Sarah_normal__911_gt3_01_2400407
turns.raw:
<sseq scmd="GTCafe_Conv_CarDetail_Rear">That's correct! It's an engine created by Porsche's
legendary engineer Hans Mezger!<p/>
He's responsible for the 911's traditional air-cooled
engines, as well as race engines for F1 and Le Mans.<p/>
Although 911 engines became water-cooled starting with
the 996...<p/>
...the engines for the GT2, GT3 and Turbo
were still rooted in designs by Mezger.<next id=2400409 type=9>
turns.en:
That's correct! It's an engine created by Porsche's
legendary engineer Hans Mezger!

He's responsible for the 911's traditional air-cooled
engines, as well as race engines for F1 and Le Mans.

Although 911 engines became water-cooled starting with
the 996...

...the engines for the GT2, GT3 and Turbo
were still rooted in designs by Mezger.
turns.zh:
没错！这款引擎由Porsche的传奇工程师汉斯·梅茨格打造！

他负责设计了911的风冷引擎，以及
F1和勒芒赛事用的赛车引擎。

尽管自996之后，911的引擎都换成了水冷……

但梅茨格的设计理念依然根植于GT2，GT3以及911 Turbo之中。
turns.speaker: Sarah

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_Sarah_normal__911_gt3_01_2400408

<sseq scmd="GTCafe_WalkSide">Serious enthusiasts went with the optional form-fitting race
seats and factory-installed roll-cage.<p/>
The immense success of the GT3 caught even Porsche
by surprise.<p/>
In fact, customer demand far exceeded the original
production run.<next id=2400410 type=9>h
turns.en:
Serious enthusiasts went with the optional form-fitting race
seats and factory-installed roll-cage.

The immense success of the GT3 caught even Porsche
by surprise.

In fact, customer demand far exceeded the original
production run.
turns.zh:
骨灰级的专业车迷们甚至会为这台车选配
量身定制的赛车座椅和原厂防滚架。

GT3的巨大成功甚至让Porsche都感到惊讶。

事实上，客户的需求远远超出了最初计划的生产量。
turns.speaker: Freeman Thomas

legendary engineer Hans Mezger!

were still rooted in designs by Mezger.

F1和勒芒赛事用的赛车引擎。

尽管自996之后，911的引擎都换成了水冷……

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf8Freeman_normal_mono_16_2400505
turns.raw:
The BAC Mono is one gorgeous piece of engineering.

It's a great example of exceptional industrial design.

Every detail is beautifully executed with functional forms and fresh graphics.

Its inspiration comes from single-seat formula cars.

It's a serious road and track machine that is designed to extract the maximum out of the driver and car.

The serious aerodynamics are played out visually.

Take a look at the fuselage.

It tapers to the rear with the large side intakes and routes the air through and over the back spoiler/wing.

I also love how the engineering is approached.

It comes equipped with push-rod front suspension shocks, and the rear suspension arms on full display.

This car is indeed an impressive example of how form can follow function.

It is truly a highly technical, clever design language that is beautifully done!y

turns.zh:
BAC Mono是一辆工程学的奇迹、

一件出类拔萃的工业设计样本……

它的设计灵感来自于单座方程式赛车。
每一处细节都精雕细琢……
采用功能至上的部件和极致简洁的贴花，

这是一辆货真价实的公路和赛道机器，
所有设计只为让驾驶者和车辆都发挥出全部潜力。
严谨的空气动力学设计毫不掩饰地呈现在眼前。

以车身为例，

车身两侧从前向后逐渐收窄，露出硕大的侧进气口，
以便引导气流从车后部的上方通过。

它在工程上的处理方式也是我很欣赏的。

它配备了推杆式前悬挂减震……

而后悬挂臂则直接裸露在外。
turns.speaker: Freeman Thomas

turns.raw:
It's hard to believe the car is nearly two decades old!

Stylistically, the Carrera GT was ahead of its time.

It became the future DNA for Porsche...

...especially for the Boxster and Cayman, and I would say, influenced the 918.

It has a lot of innovative details, such as the double hump mesh rear screen...

...with the stylized aero roll bars hovering above.

I also love the rear diffuser with the integrated exhausts.

Also inspiring was the interior with the center console bridge.

If I were to make one criticism...

...then it would have be the visually long bodyside.

The front fender outlet and rear fender inlet...

...connected by the horizontal lines accentuate this.

The clever details continue with the center-lock wheels.

...and the aero supported mirrors.

I would sa� the styling of the Carrera GT is truly timeless...

...and a masterpiece of modern Porsche design!L

turns.zh:
Carrera GT是永不过时的艺术品。

我认为它是保时捷现代设计中的杰作！

你甚至很难想象这辆车已经问世这么多个年头了！
从造型上，Carrera GT完全领先了它的时代……

它的设计元素影响到了后续几乎所有保时捷车型……

比如Boxster和Cayman，甚至还包括918。
它蕴含了大量的创新细节……

比如双峰式的后置透明引擎罩，
以及悬在引擎上、造型独具的空力防倾杆。

集成在保险杠上的排气管
和后扩散器也是我喜欢的设计。

同样令人耳目一新的还有内饰的中控台。
不过呢，如果要我提意见的话……

我觉得长度有些太长了。

尤其是侧面的水平线条，显得拖沓……

因为它把前挡泥板的出风口
和后挡泥板进风口连起来了……
保时捷在这台车上还加入了很多巧思……

例如中央锁止轮毂和空气动力学后视镜等等。
turns.speaker: Freeman Thomas

 I would sa� the styling of the Carrera GT
is truly timeless...

...and a masterpiece of modern Porsche design!
turns.zh:
Carrera GT是永不过时的艺术品。

我认为它是保时捷现代设计中的杰作！

你甚至很难想象这辆车已经问世这么多个年头了！
从造型上，Carrera GT完全领先了它的时代……

它的设计元素影响到了后续几乎所有保时捷车型……

比如Boxster和Cayman，甚至还包括918。
它蕴含了大量的创新细节……

比如双峰式的后置透明引擎罩，
以及悬在引擎上、造型独具的空力防倾杆。

集成在保险杠上的排气管
和后扩散器也是我喜欢的设计。

同样令人耳目一新的还有内饰的中控台。
不过呢，如果要我提意见的话……

我觉得长度有些太长了。

尤其是侧面的水平线条，显得拖沓……

因为它把前挡泥板的出风口
和后挡泥板进风口连起来了……
保时捷在这台车上还加入了很多巧思……

例如中央锁止轮毂和空气动力学后视镜等等。

真的，它对前继车型的各方面优化都完成得相当漂亮。

在汽车设计中，表达个性从来都不是一件容易的事。

但这辆车绝对是一个正面例子！
睁着一双“圆眼睛”的前脸看着就很是友好。

就算在一个停车场里停满相同颜色的这台车，
你依然会感觉它们每一台都有自己的个性！
不同的颜色为FIAT 500注入了个性与情绪。

考虑到它的经典复古造型，
复古怀旧的涂装更相得益彰。
turns.speaker: Freeman Thomas

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf8Freeman_normal_ford_gt_06_2400807
turns.raw:
It is really a clever design in that it is larger than the original but scaled up perfectly!

If you put an original next to it, you won't believe the difference in size.

The original car was really quite small.

The shut-lines play a key part and play an important role in modernizing the GT40.

The larger size allows larger and taller people to fit comfortably and allows them get in and out easily.

This is truly an iconic "daily driver" super car with Ford reliability and parts access.

The styling inside and out has proven to be timeless. A true collector's car for the serious enthusiast.

turns.zh:
他们采取了非常巧妙的设计手法：
扩大车身尺寸，然后完美复刻原车比例！

将两辆车停在一起时，你甚至很难发现它们的差别。

而实际上，GT40要小上一号。
在打造现代版GT40时，
精准化镶板的工艺发挥了重要的作用。

“大号”的新Ford GT为身材更高大的驾驶者带来了便利。
这是一款真正能满足日常驾驶的经典超级跑车，
并拥有Ford的可靠品质和零部件供应支持。

无论是内饰还是外观，
这辆车的设计都经受得起时间的考验。

这是一辆真正的车迷会选择收藏的好车。<next id=2400808 type=9׾

turns.raw:
The 2005 MINI Cooper S is still stylistically and proportionately the best one！

I loved these when they came out, and I still love them!

Minimal overhangs and simple bodysides. Low beltline and great all-round visibility.

All the horizontal lines were drawn in parallel to each other.

This is when it seemed the MINI designers had a bigger voice with great vision!

They looked amazing in a variety of colors, liveries with optional roof colors and graphics.

The interior continued the theme with the big round central screen.

The MINI screamed fun!

turns.zh:
从风格和比例上比较，2005 MINI Cooper S都应当是
MINI产品线中的佼佼者！

这款车刚刚投产时我就爱上了它。
直到今天。我觉得它依然魅力不减！
你可以重点关注极限的短前悬、简约的廓形，以及
低腰线和全方位的视野，

还有车身的每一根水平线条都保持平行。

全都来自那个MINI的设计师们还抱有远见的时代！
无论搭配什么样的涂装、车顶颜色或是贴花，
它都能让你惊艳不已。

另外我还要夸一句圆形的中控屏幕。

没错，MINI就是这样，从里到外都充满乐趣！
turns.speaker: Freeman Thomas

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf8Freeman_normal_mini_cooper_s_06_2400905
turns.raw:
The 2005 MINI Cooper S is still stylistically and proportionately the best one！

I loved these when they came out, and I still love them!

Minimal overhangs and simple bodysides. Low beltline and great all-round visibility.

All the horizontal lines were drawn in parallel to each other.

This is when it seemed the MINI designers had a bigger voice with great vision!

They looked amazing in a variety of colors, liveries with optional roof colors and graphics.

The interior continued the theme with the big round central screen.

The MINI screamed fun!
turns.en:

proportionately the best one！

I loved these when they came out, and I still love them!
Minimal overhangs and simple bodysides.

 All the horizontal lines were drawn in parallel
to each other.

had a bigger voice with great vision!
They looked amazing in a variety of colors,
liveries with optional roof colors and graphics.

The interior continued the theme with the

turns.zh:
从风格和比例上比较，2005 MINI Cooper S都应当是
MINI产品线中的佼佼者！

这款车刚刚投产时我就爱上了它。
直到今天。我觉得它依然魅力不减！
你可以重点关注极限的短前悬、简约的廓形，以及
低腰线和全方位的视野，

还有车身的每一根水平线条都保持平行。

全都来自那个MINI的设计师们还抱有远见的时代！
无论搭配什么样的涂装、车顶颜色或是贴花，
它都能让你惊艳不已。

另外我还要夸一句圆形的中控屏幕。

没错，MINI就是这样，从里到外都充满乐趣！
turns.speaker: Freeman Thomas

turns.raw:
This is the car that made Henrik Fisker famous! It’s truly a modern 507!

There's a lot I like about it.

First, I like how it pushes BMW's emotional envelope.

It almost has a handmade look...

It reflects a more human approach to design.

It’s really quite wonderful!

It’s a more emotional, artistic approach that embraces imperfections as character!

And, if anything, the Z8 is full of character.P
turns.en:
This is the car that made Henrik Fisker famous!
It’s truly a modern 507!
There's a lot I like about it.

First, I like how it pushes BMW's emotional envelope.

It almost has a handmade look...

It reflects a more human approach to design.

It’s really quite wonderful!
It’s a more emotional, artistic approach that
embraces imperfections as character!
And, if anything, the Z8 is full of character.
turns.zh:
这辆车让亨里克·菲斯克声名鹊起！
你可以说，它就是现代版的507了！
我喜欢它的地方有很多。

首先，我喜欢它把宝马感性的一面发挥到了极致。

它的外观给人一种手工打造的质感……

反映出一种更有人情味的设计方法。

它有着极强的表现力！
这是一种更感性、更艺术的设计方法，
接纳不完美，并把它转化为车的个性！
倒不如说，这台Z8全身上下都散发着强烈的个性！
turns.speaker: Freeman Thomas

It has a solid overall design and possesses plenty of Ford’s unique DNA.

The wide stance and large tires result in great handling character and tremendous height.

Its capable 4WD system allows it to excel on rough off-road terrain.

This first-generation Raptor had a V-8 that matched its aggressive character.=

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf8Freeman_normal__911_carrera_rs_cs_95_2401205
turns.raw:
Unlike the 993 Carrera RS, the 993 RS Clubsport was built with racing as its sole purpose.

It featured a distinctive rear wing with integrated air inlets.

The downforce generated at the rear was balanced by an extended front spoiler.

The wheels were a three-piece design, with staggered offsets front and rear.

A single glance at the exterior details made it clear this was the work of Style Porsche...

...the in-house design studio at Porsche Weissach.

Inside, the cabin was defined by a spartan layout and a reinforced roll cage.

Like other 911-based race cars of its era, the Clubsport channeled its forebears.

I almost feel for the owner attempting to persuade the authorities to license it for road use!

A formidable challenge, though not an impossible one![
turns.en:
Unlike the 993 Carrera RS, the 993 RS Clubsport
was built with racing as its sole purpose.

It featured a distinctive rear wing with integrated air inlets.
The downforce generated at the rear was balanced
by an extended front spoiler.
The wheels were a three-piece design,
with staggered offsets front and rear.

A single glance at the exterior details made it clear
this was the work of Style Porsche...

...the in-house design studio at Porsche Weissach.
Inside, the cabin was defined by a spartan layout
and a reinforced roll cage.

Like other 911-based race cars of its era,
the Clubsport channeled its forebears.

I almost feel for the owner attempting to persuade
the authorities to license it for road use!
A formidable challenge, though not an impossible one![
turns.zh:
基于993打造的RS Clubsport版本
是比993 Carrera RS更加纯粹的赛道机器。
尾翼产生的巨大下压力需要通过狭长的前端扰流板来平衡。
轮毂采用3片式锻造设计，而且前后采用不同的偏距值。

从外观细节中不难看出，它的设计来自品牌自有的

保时捷-魏斯萨赫设计工作室——“保时捷设计”。
内饰采用赛车专用的朴素黑色，并安装了全面焊接加固的防滚架。

在这一代基于保时捷911打造的赛车上，
你仍然可以看到一些原版911的元素。

我可以想象，某些有追求的车主可能会尝试
为这辆车注册登记，获得上路许可……

……想必这位车主需要和车管部门费好大一番口舌了。
不过我“听说”还真的有人成功了！
turns.speaker: Freeman Thomas

with staggered offsets front and rear.

A single glance at the exterior details made it clear
this was the work of Style Porsche...

...the in-house design studio at Porsche Weissach.
Inside, the cabin was defined by a spartan layout
and a reinforced roll cage.

Like other 911-based race cars of its era,
the Clubsport channeled its forebears.

I almost feel for the owner attempting to persuade
the authorities to license it for road use!
A formidable challenge, though not an impossible one![
turns.zh:
基于993打造的RS Clubsport版本
是比993 Carrera RS更加纯粹的赛道机器。
尾翼产生的巨大下压力需要通过狭长的前端扰流板来平衡。
轮毂采用3片式锻造设计，而且前后采用不同的偏距值。

从外观细节中不难看出，它的设计来自品牌自有的

保时捷-魏斯萨赫设计工作室——“保时捷设计”。
内饰采用赛车专用的朴素黑色，并安装了全面焊接加固的防滚架。

在这一代基于保时捷911打造的赛车上，
你仍然可以看到一些原版911的元素。

我可以想象，某些有追求的车主可能会尝试
为这辆车注册登记，获得上路许可……

……想必这位车主需要和车管部门费好大一番口舌了。
不过我“听说”还真的有人成功了！
turns.speaker: Freeman Thomas

turns.speaker: Sarah

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf8Freeman_normal_tt_cup_16_2401305
turns.raw:
The 2016 TT Cup is exciting in that it's an extremely well-proportioned racecar...

...when compared to the production-based street version.

I like the fender forms that hint at the original TT, but these are bolder and wider.

The graphics are pure Audi Sport with the red, gray and silver.

I also like the black wheels brought out to the maximum track width.

It gives the car an amazing stance that's more absolute!
turns.en:
The 2016 TT Cup is exciting in that it's
an extremely well-proportioned racecar...

...when compared to the production-based street version.

I like the fender forms that hint at the original TT,
but these are bolder and wider.
The graphics are pure Audi Sport
with the red, gray and silver.

I also like the black wheels brought out
to the maximum track width.
It gives the car an amazing stance that's more absolute!
turns.zh:
2016 TT Cup是一辆让人心生悸动的赛车，
因为和量产的街车版本相比……

……它更加的“匀称”。

我喜欢这辆车的挡泥板设计，
有点原版TT的味道，不过做得更大也更宽。
红灰银涂装是Audi Sport的官方风格。

漆黑的轮毂我也觉得不错，
而且他们将轮距加宽到了极致，
让整车造型看上去更加坚定和动态。
这台车的设计语言非常大胆，也非常引人注目！
turns.speaker: Freeman Thomas

It is truly a whimsical and fun design! It says, "Don't take things so seriously!"

Look at the front with its friendly round headlamps and a smiling grille!

The Daihatsu Copen makes me smile!

 It is truly a whimsical and fun design!
It says, "Don't take things so seriously!"
 Look at the front with its friendly round
headlamps and a smiling grille!
 The taillights repeat the expression with its round eyes.
And, proportionally, it has a nice stance.
This design here visually puts the wheels on the ends,
making it a look like its ready to pounce!
turns.zh:
每当我看到Daihatsu Copen，都会忍不住笑！

这确实算是一个异想天开的有趣设计！
它仿佛在说：“看我萌你一脸！”
前脸这里，是对你开心眨眼的圆形大灯和嘴角上翘的进气格栅！
尾灯也是两颗萌萌的圆眼睛。
它的车身比例相当不错，所以静态效果很出彩。
设计师特意把前后轮距拉远，
让它看起来像是要“猛兽”扑食一般！

Here we go! The Daihatsu Copen makes me smile!

It is truly a whimsical and fun design! It says, "Don't take things so seriously!"

Look at the front with its friendly round headlamps and a smiling grille!

The taillights repeat the expression with its round eyes. And, proportionally, it has a nice stance.

This design here visually puts the wheels on the ends, making it a look like its ready to pounce!
turns.en:
Here we go!
The Daihatsu Copen makes me smile!

 It is truly a whimsical and fun design!
It says, "Don't take things so seriously!"
 Look at the front with its friendly round
headlamps and a smiling grille!
 The taillights repeat the expression with its round eyes.
And, proportionally, it has a nice stance.
This design here visually puts the wheels on the ends,
making it a look like its ready to pounce!
turns.zh:
每当我看到Daihatsu Copen，都会忍不住笑！

这确实算是一个异想天开的有趣设计！
它仿佛在说：“看我萌你一脸！”
前脸这里，是对你开心眨眼的圆形大灯和嘴角上翘的进气格栅！
尾灯也是两颗萌萌的圆眼睛。
它的车身比例相当不错，所以静态效果很出彩。
设计师特意把前后轮距拉远，
让它看起来像是要“猛兽”扑食一般！
turns.speaker: Freeman Thomas

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf8Freeman_normal__918_spyder_13_2401505
turns.raw:
The 918 was designed as the flagship...

...to showcase Porsche's latest styling DNA and advanced technology for the future.

The styling forecasted Porsche's next generation of vehicles.

The dual rear exhausts exiting through...

...the rear upper cooling grille

looks like a jet pack...

...and is really exciting!

You can also see the production version of the four element LED headlights and the rear taillamp LED frame.

Along with the form vocabulary, you can also see these elements showing up into the next generation of Porsches

Another favorite area of mine was...

...the interior design with the high bridge center console.

This was first seen in the 2003 Carrera GT but newly imagined.

The design language and style has worn well over the years.

A bit restrained to the eyes compared to other competitors.

But still well received and a popular edition to a super car collection!
turns.en:

You can also see the production version of

Along with the form vocabulary, you can also see

Another favorite area of mine was...

...the interior design with the high bridge center console.

This was first seen in the 2003 Carrera GT but newly imagined.
The design language and style
has worn well over the years.

A bit restrained to the eyes
compared to other competitors.

But still well received and
a popular edition to a super car collection!
turns.zh:
918是作为保时捷的旗舰型号来设计的……

是为了充分展现
这家公司最新的设计基因和未来将采用的先进科技。

其设计风格预示了保时捷之后几代车型的设计路线。
穿过车尾上部冷却格栅的……

两根排气管，

整体看起来就像背着一个喷气背包……

令人感觉很酷！
此车还采用了量产版的四点式LED大灯和LED框架式尾灯。
这些元素和形状设计语汇，都在下一代保时捷车型中得到了沿袭。
918还有一点是我非常钟爱的……

就是内饰设计中如引桥般高高矗立的中控台。

这项设计早在2003年的Carrera GT上就出现过，
但这次经过了重新构思。
这些设计语言和风格随着时间的打磨已经变得圆熟，p�
尽管和竞品相比可能显得有一些平静内敛。

但爱好者们对918的接受度从未减少分毫。它永远是
所有超级跑车收藏者心目中的人气之选。.
turns.speaker: Freeman Thomas

两根排气管，

尽管和竞品相比可能显得有一些平静内敛。

但爱好者们对918的接受度从未减少分毫。它永远是
所有超级跑车收藏者心目中的人气之选。.
