turns.raw:
The 918 was designed as the flagship...

...to showcase Porsche's latest styling DNA and advanced technology for the future.

The styling forecasted Porsche's next generation of vehicles.

The dual rear exhausts exiting through...

...the rear upper cooling grille

looks like a jet pack...

...and is really exciting!

You can also see the production version of the four element LED headlights and the rear taillamp LED frame.

Along with the form vocabulary, you can also see these elements showing up into the next generation of Porsches

Another favorite area of mine was...

...the interior design with the high bridge center console.

This was first seen in the 2003 Carrera GT but newly imagined.

The design language and style has worn well over the years.

A bit restrained to the eyes compared to other competitors.

But still well received and a popular edition to a super car collection!

Freeman used to be the design director at Ford.

He's also known for his work at Porsche and Audi,
and he's famous as the designer of the first-generation Audi TT.
turns.zh:
谢谢您，弗里曼，我们很荣幸能见到您！

弗里曼曾经担任过Ford的设计总监。

他在Porsche和Audi时期的设计也有口皆碑。
而且，他还是第一代Audi TT的设计师。-
turns.speaker: Sarah

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf8Freeman_normal_ford_roadster_1932_xx_2401605
turns.raw:
The '32 is the quintessential hot rod!

It was nicknamed "Deuce" because of the 2 in "32."

It was visually simple but complex in its execution.

Look closely and you'll not find a flat line anywhere!

It possesses a powerfully aggressive package,

that's all about proportion, balance, stance and form.

The shape tapers in every view.

The stance is set up with just the right amount of rake.

The back tires taller than the fronts.

The '32 also signals the beginning of the iconic Ford V-8!

In a '32 Hot Rod, the motor becomes an emotional part of the whole.]
turns.en:
The '32 is the quintessential hot rod!

It was nicknamed "Deuce" because of the 2 in "32."

It was visually simple but complex in its execution.
Look closely and
you'll not find a flat line anywhere!

It possesses a powerfully aggressive package,

that's all about proportion,
balance, stance and form.
The shape tapers in every view.
 The stance is set up
 with just the right amount of rake.

The back tires taller than the fronts.
The '32 also signals the beginning of
the iconic Ford V-8!

In a '32 Hot Rod, the motor becomes
an emotional part of the whole.]
turns.zh:
这款'32可以被视作是改装车中的标杆！

玩家们还将“32”中的“2”变成了这辆车的昵称：“二点”。

看似平平无奇的外观下，其实内有乾坤。
仔细观察后，你会发现整个车身上找不到一条平直的线条！

它的整体设计充满了力量和冲劲……

这也是车身比例、平衡、姿态和整体轮廓巧妙结合的成果。
让它在各个角度都显得凌厉利落……
前倾角的角度设置得恰到好处，

后轮比前轮高一些，就形成了现在这攻击型的姿态。
此外，这辆'32还标志着福特首次引入其招牌V8引擎！

对于'32 而言，
这台引擎是其浑然天成的整体中的神来之笔。
turns.speaker: Freeman Thomas

turns.raw:
The Type 930 911 Turbo was Porsche's first true super car.

It appealed to a new kind of Porsche customer.

Indeed, the "Turbo" added another element.

Somewhere inside those Superman fender flares and that big rear wing was...

...the humbleness of Clark Kent.

It was a success story from the time it made its debut at the 1973 Frankfurt Motor Show.

The 911 truly presented the 1970s for Porsche.

But did you know it was scheduled to be replaced?

That was before the Type 930 911 Turbo breathed new life into the model.

Of course, we know this now in hindsight.

The original 930 had a long and strong production run from 1975 to 1989...

...with an update to the new 964/965 platform in 1990.

Also of note was the "Turbo" script that became iconic unto itself.

In fact, this script is still being used by�Porsche today on all subsequent Turbos.�

turns.zh:
这辆Type 930 911 Turbo是保时捷第一款
真正意义上的超级跑车！

它还吸引来一批性格张扬的保时捷新车迷。

毫无疑问，这台“Turbo”树立起了一代传奇的形象！
这辆谦逊、简约的911就好比汽车领域的“克拉克·肯特”——

它的挡泥板和巨大的尾翼闪耀着如同超人般充满力量感的光泽。
自从在1973法兰克福车展上惊艳亮相的那一刻起，
这款车就迎来了巨大成功。

911成为了保时捷在70年代最闪耀的代言人。

不过你知道吗？如果不是Type 930 911 Turbo又为911系列
注入了全新的生命力。

这个系列原本将迎来被替换的命运。

当然，我们现在这么说也是事后诸葛亮罢了。
初代930在1975年到1989年之间持续生产了
很长的时间，产量也很庞大……

然后�3在1990年升级到了964/965平台。
另外值得一提的是，“Turbo”名称本身也成为了一代传奇。

事实上，保时捷直到今天还在沿用，
并推出了许多款后续的“Turbo”车型！
turns.speaker: Freeman Thomas

turns.raw:
With more mid-engine cars from Ford and Ferrari winning in LM-GTE, WEC and American IMSA events...

...Porsche needed to do something.

Styled by Gran Larson in 2017...

...this mid-engine 911 RSR was a bold move.

Back in 1996, Porsche tried something similar, getting Tony Hatter to design...

...a mid-engine 911 GT1 based on the 933.

The 2017 RSR silhouette hides...

...its mid-engine architecture, making it look like a rear-engine 991.

That said, it is wider and more aggressive.

As the saying goes in the automobile industry...

..."Win on Sunday, sell on Monday!"
turns.en:
With more mid-engine cars from Ford and Ferrari winning
in LM-GTE, WEC and American IMSA events...

...Porsche needed to do something.
Styled by Gran Larson in 2017...

...this mid-engine 911 RSR was a bold move.

Back in 1996, Porsche tried something similar,
getting Tony Hatter to design...

...a mid-engine 911 GT1 based on the 933.
The 2017 RSR silhouette hides...

...its mid-engine architecture, making it look
like a rear-engine 991.

That said, it is wider and more aggressive.
As the saying goes in the automobile industry...

..."Win on Sunday, sell on Monday!"
turns.zh:
当越来越多的中置引擎福特和法拉利赛车在勒芒房车耐力赛、
世界耐力锦标赛和美国国际赛车运动协会等赛事中取得成功……

保时捷也必须要设法迎头赶上！
这辆中置引擎的911 RSR由格兰·拉尔森在2017设计……

算是保时捷相当激进的一步！

早在1996年，保时捷就已经进行过类似的尝试，
让托尼·哈特尔设计出……

一款基于933的中置引擎911 GT1。
这辆2017 RSR的外形轮廓巧妙掩饰了……

它的中置引擎架构，让它看上去像一辆引擎后置的991。

尽管如此，它的车身相对更宽，整体外形也更具侵略性！
就像是汽车行业内一句俗话说的那样……

“周日一胜，周一大卖！”
turns.speaker: Freeman Thomas

With more mid-engine cars from Ford and Ferrari winning in LM-GTE, WEC and American IMSA events...

...Porsche needed to do something.

Styled by Gran Larson in 2017...

...this mid-engine 911 RSR was a bold move.

Back in 1996, Porsche tried something similar, getting Tony Hatter to design...

...a mid-engine 911 GT1 based on the 933.

The 2017 RSR silhouette hides...

...its mid-engine architecture, making it look like a rear-engine 991.

That said, it is wider and more aggressive.

As the saying goes in the automobile industry...

..."Win on Sunday, sell on Monday!"

当越来越多的中置引擎福特和法拉利赛车在勒芒房车耐力赛、
世界耐力锦标赛和美国国际赛车运动协会等赛事中取得成功……

保时捷也必须要设法迎头赶上！
这辆中置引擎的911 RSR由格兰·拉尔森在2017设计……

算是保时捷相当激进的一步！

早在1996年，保时捷就已经进行过类似的尝试，
让托尼·哈特尔设计出……

一款基于933的中置引擎911 GT1。
这辆2017 RSR的外形轮廓巧妙掩饰了……

它的中置引擎架构，让它看上去像一辆引擎后置的991。

尽管如此，它的车身相对更宽，整体外形也更具侵略性！
就像是汽车行业内一句俗话说的那样……

“周日一胜，周一大卖！”
turns.speaker: Freeman Thomas

turns.raw:
The ’55 Porsche Spyder Type 550/1500RS is the icon of all Porsche Spyders.

It was a minimalist car stripped of all but what is needed.

Its organic, functional form was designed by Erwin Komenda.

He was the body designer for all the Auto-Union "Rennwagens," as well as the VW Beetle and Porsche 356.

He really was the chief architect of the early Porsche and VW design DNA.

Stylistically, the Spyder Type 550 is similar to a 365 Speedster.

That said, it is much more capable, with its mid-engine chassis and aluminum body.

The rag-top roof actually serves no real purpose, except to meet the letter of the rule book.

It’s as if Porsche was saying to the regulators, "Look, it has a roof!"

In addition to a diminutive body and short wheelbase...

...it has an extremely low cowl/beltline with just an aero screen.

Incidentally, the Porsche Spyder Type 550 was given the nickname "Giant Killer."

This is because, in the right hands, it was capable of beating much more powerful and faster machines.

Indeed, it was a popular car for sportsmen or works drivers looking to win a class victory or compete in a road rally.�

这辆1955年出品的保时捷敞篷type 550/1500RS是
所有保时捷敞篷车型中最具标志性的一款！

这辆车采用极简设计，剥离了一切非必需的元素！

它那浑然天成、功能实用的外形是由
艾尔文·柯曼达设计……

这名车身设计师也是汽车联盟所有“赛车”车型
以及大众甲壳虫和保时捷356的创造者。

可以说，他就是早期保时捷和大众设计DNA
的主要构建者！
从外观上看，敞篷type 550和365 Speedster非常相似。

不过前者采用了中置引擎布局和铝制车身，性能也更出色。
它的帆布车顶其实并不具备实际功能，
只是为了符合规则的要求而已！

就好像保时捷在对规则监管方说：“你们看，我有车顶哦！”
除了截短的车身和短轴距之外……

它还拥有极低的风罩�u腰线，
并且只采用了埃尔罗斯林风挡。
保时捷敞篷type 550获得“巨人杀手”的昵称
则是个意外之喜！

这是因为在技术高超的车手驾驭下，它可以击败
性能更强、速度更快的车型！
毋庸置疑，这是一辆人气极高的赛车，可以帮助竞技车手或
厂队车手赢得赛事胜利或加入公路拉力竞赛的争夺。
turns.speaker: Freeman Thomas

turns.raw:
The ’55 Porsche Spyder Type 550/1500RS is the icon of all Porsche Spyders.

It was a minimalist car stripped of all but what is needed.

Its organic, functional form was designed by Erwin Komenda.

He was the body designer for all the Auto-Union "Rennwagens," as well as the VW Beetle and Porsche 356.

He really was the chief architect of the early Porsche and VW design DNA.

Stylistically, the Spyder Type 550 is similar to a 365 Speedster.

That said, it is much more capable, with its mid-engine chassis and aluminum body.

The rag-top roof actually serves no real purpose, except to meet the letter of the rule book.

It’s as if Porsche was saying to the regulators, "Look, it has a roof!"

In addition to a diminutive body and short wheelbase...

...it has an extremely low cowl/beltline with just an aero screen.

Incidentally, the Porsche Spyder Type 550 was given the nickname "Giant Killer."

This is because, in the right hands, it was capable of beating much more powerful and faster machines.

Indeed, it was a popular car for sportsmen or works drivers looking to win a class victory or compete in a road rally.�

这辆1955年出品的保时捷敞篷type 550/1500RS是
所有保时捷敞篷车型中最具标志性的一款！

这辆车采用极简设计，剥离了一切非必需的元素！

它那浑然天成、功能实用的外形是由
艾尔文·柯曼达设计……

这名车身设计师也是汽车联盟所有“赛车”车型
以及大众甲壳虫和保时捷356的创造者。

可以说，他就是早期保时捷和大众设计DNA
的主要构建者！
从外观上看，敞篷type 550和365 Speedster非常相似。

不过前者采用了中置引擎布局和铝制车身，性能也更出色。
它的帆布车顶其实并不具备实际功能，
只是为了符合规则的要求而已！

就好像保时捷在对规则监管方说：“你们看，我有车顶哦！”
除了截短的车身和短轴距之外……

它还拥有极低的风罩�u腰线，
并且只采用了埃尔罗斯林风挡。
保时捷敞篷type 550获得“巨人杀手”的昵称
则是个意外之喜！

这是因为在技术高超的车手驾驭下，它可以击败
性能更强、速度更快的车型！
毋庸置疑，这是一辆人气极高的赛车，可以帮助竞技车手或
厂队车手赢得赛事胜利或加入公路拉力竞赛的争夺。
turns.speaker: Freeman Thomas

turns.raw:
The 356 A/1500 GS GT Carrera Speedster takes the most spartan model in the Porsche lineup...

...and pushes it into the level of "unobtanium."

The Speedster shape and form are an extension of the other 356A models, but more extreme.

With its low wrap-around windshield, tall shoulder...

...and longer rear deck...

...the Speedster has attitude.

Both James Dean and Steve McQueen had Speedsters.

Unique to the Carrera GT are the deletion of the side spears and sill deco.

The bumpers do away with the bumper horns and the deco is replaced with aluminum trim.

You can also see the front leather tie-down straps and GT roll bar.

The GT eventually received aluminum opening panels.

And even the normal-looking wheels are specially constructed of steel and aluminum.

As with all Por�ches, you really need to take a close look at each model to know all the variations.S

turns.zh:
356 A/1500 GS GT Carrera Speedster是基于保时捷产品线中
最简约的车型开发的……

又将其推向了“无法企及”的境界！
Speedster的外形沿袭了其他356A车型的设计，
但更加的极致……

低矮的环绕式挡风玻璃、高耸的轮眉……

还有更长的后部，
无不彰显其自成一派的风范！

詹姆斯·迪恩和史蒂夫·麦奎因都曾
将Speedster作为他们的座驾。
这个Carrera GT版本的独特之处在于
取消了侧面装饰条和侧裙装饰。
前保险杠取消了撞角，用铝制饰条取代了装饰件。

你还可以看到前盖的皮革固定带和后座的GT防护杆。
GT车型最终采用了铝制板材……

甚至看起来平平无奇的轮圈也是
钢铝混合材质的特殊结构。
保]��捷的车总是需要你仔细观察才能分辨出它与
普通“推杆”车型的各种差异！这一台也不例外。
turns.speaker: Freeman Thomas

turns.raw:
The 1956 GS Carrera Coupe was the most powerful and most luxurious Porsche available in its day.

This year marked the first time we saw the improved "A" model.

It was visually similar to the "pre-A," except it had the 15-inch wheels...

...with larger rear-wheel openings and non-rolled rocker sills.

The GS had the same sill and bumper trim as the lower line models, but there really wasn't a visual difference...

...except for the fact that the rear sat a bit lower due to the heavier 4-cam Carrera engine.

The interior was the same as well, except there were two push-pull switches above the instrumentation.

This was to control the dual coils specific to the Carrera engine.

When you opened up the rear lid, you saw the real difference between the A and pre-A.

The 4-cam Carrera engine was an artistic masterpiece! The fan shroud and assembly were gorgeous too!=

turns.zh:
‘56 ‘GS’ Carrera Coupe是保时捷史上最强劲、最豪华的一款。

名称中的56代表经过大刀阔斧改进的365A新款
问世的首个年份。
在外观上，它与之前的“pre-A”车型非常相似，
唯一不同之处在于采用了新款15英寸车轮……

后轮轮拱更大，侧裙没有滚边。
由于GS车型与低端车型都采用同款侧裙和保险杠装饰，
所所以外观上并无差异……

只是因为搭载了更重的四凸轮轴“Carrera”引擎，
车尾被压得更低。

内饰也几乎一模一样，只在
仪表板上方多了两个推拉按钮，

那是用来控制“Carrera”引擎独有的两个点火线圈的。
只有当你打开后引擎盖时，才能发现真正的差别所在！

你会发现，四凸轮轴“Carrera”引擎简直是一件美妙的艺术品！
连风扇罩和总成��打造得异常精美！
turns.speaker: Freeman Thomas

The GS had the same sill and bumper trim as the lower
line models, but there really wasn't a visual difference...

...except for the fact that the rear sat a bit lower due to
the heavier 4-cam Carrera engine.

The interior was the same as well, except there were two
push-pull switches above the instrumentation.

This was to control the dual coils specific
to the Carrera engine.
When you opened up the rear lid, you saw the real difference between the A and pre-A.

The 4-cam Carrera engine was an artistic masterpiece!
The fan shroud and assembly were gorgeous too!=
turns.zh:
‘56 ‘GS’ Carrera Coupe是保时捷史上最强劲、最豪华的一款。

名称中的56代表经过大刀阔斧改进的365A新款
问世的首个年份。
在外观上，它与之前的“pre-A”车型非常相似，
唯一不同之处在于采用了新款15英寸车轮……

后轮轮拱更大，侧裙没有滚边。
由于GS车型与低端车型都采用同款侧裙和保险杠装饰，
所所以外观上并无差异……

只是因为搭载了更重的四凸轮轴“Carrera”引擎，
车尾被压得更低。

内饰也几乎一模一样，只在
仪表板上方多了两个推拉按钮，

那是用来控制“Carrera”引擎独有的两个点火线圈的。
只有当你打开后引擎盖时，才能发现真正的差别所在！

你会发现，四凸轮轴“Carrera”引擎简直是一件美妙的艺术品！
连风扇罩和总成��打造得异常精美！
turns.speaker: Freeman Thomas

The 2011 Audi R18 TDI LMP1 marked a return to a fixed-roof coupe body again for the first time since the 1999 R8C.

This, to me, was when design, engineering, and motorsports came to the perfect intersection for Audi.

Seeing these "Star Wars" coupes in the rain at night, with wipers and headlights, running at high speed...

Man, that was exciting to watch!

I see them as advanced concepts for the road that I can relate to.

They were truly a tour de force of technology!

对我来说，这款车是Audi的设计、工程学技术
和赛车运动知识的完美结合！
在漆黑雨夜中，看到这些“星球大战”风格的跑车
顶着独特的雨刷和大灯高速奔驰的身影……

令我激动万分！
我认为这台车体现出了先进的道路交通工具理念，
引发了我的共鸣。

这样的车才是站在技术巅峰的作品！
turns.speaker: Freeman Thomas

turns.raw:
The goal of J Mays and his team...

...was to make this car more of a European sports car while not losing its American pony-car heritage.

It was truly a tough undertaking!

The resulting car is the quintessential Mustang...

...which looked like it went to finishing school in Europe.

The new side DLO with rear quarter window was initially controversial...

...because the previous Mustangs had a B-pillar separating a scoop, window, or a clean panel.

The new DLO made the Mustang visually more sophisticated and provided better visibility.

The front-end looked aggressive, with its thin, angled eyes and aggressive grille!

The rear-end took the three-bar iconic taillights to a new level.

It had a sequential blinker inspired by the '67/'68 Shelby.

And, did it ever look �ean, especially with optional big wheels spaced-out to the edges!x

and aggressive grille!
The rear-end took the three-bar iconic taillights

And, did it ever look �ean, especially with optional big
wheels spaced-out to the edges!
turns.zh:
梅斯及其团队的目标……

是使这款车更贴近一辆欧洲跑车，同时不失
其美式小马车的传统。

这确实是一个艰巨的任务！
他们最终的成果是一款典型的Mustang……

但跑去欧洲的商场采购装扮了一番。
新的后侧窗设计起初引发了不少争议……

前款Mustang的B柱非常宽厚，在后侧只隔出了一个进气口、
以及一扇小窗，或者叫它一块平整的玻璃更合适。

相比之下，新侧窗使这款Mustang在视觉上更加精致，
并提供了更好的侧后方视野。
前脸部分的设计更为激进
——细长而倾斜的大灯和狰狞的进气口极具攻击性！
经典的三道杠式尾灯设计被提升到了一个新的高度……
并采用了受到'67/'68 Shel�y启发的顺序闪灯效果。

在选配了几乎占满全部轮拱的大尺寸轮圈之后，
整车的姿态近乎完美，更显卓尔不凡！
turns.speaker: Freeman Thomas

turns.raw:
The Genesis Coupé was a true sports car with RWD and a <343ps> 3.8-liter V-6.

The exterior styling was inspired by its RWD proportions.

This resulted in a long dash-to-front axle, a long hood with a short front-overhang...

...and a cabin set rearward.

The styling lines and graphics were unique, inspired by an East Asian ink-wash painting process.

This process started with abstract black ink-brush strokes to find the right facial and styling expressions.

The idea of the artistic process was to create a unique character and interest.

In a way, this was an extension of the classical theme of sketching...

...with the added bonus of allowing the brush strokes to create unexpected graphics.
turns.en:
The Genesis Coupé was a true sports car with RWD
and a 343ps 3.8-liter V-6.
The exterior styling was inspired by its RWD proportions.

This resulted in a long dash-to-front axle, a long hood with
a short front-overhang...

...and a cabin set rearward.
The styling lines and graphics were unique, inspired
by an East Asian ink-wash painting process.
This process started with abstract black ink-brush strokes
to find the right facial and styling expressions.

The idea of the artistic process was to create a unique
character and interest.
In a way, this was an extension of the classical theme
of sketching...

...with the added bonus of allowing the brush strokes
to create unexpected graphics.
turns.zh:
捷尼赛思Coupe是一款真正的后驱跑车，搭载一台
输出343ps的3.8升V6引擎。
外观设计为了着重凸显后驱车的比例，

带来长轴距的前舱（从仪表盘到车头）、修长的引擎盖
和较短的前悬挂……

以及向后移置的车厢。
其造型的线条和样式均十分独特，是从东亚水墨画的
绘制过程中汲取了灵感。
在水墨绘画中，往往会用毛笔以抽象的墨色笔触
勾勒出准确的面部和造型表达。

其内核是追求独特的个性和审美趣味。
在某种程度上，它是素描这一经典画技的延伸……

并加入了以毛笔笔触带来的、意想不到的视觉效果。
turns.speaker: Freeman Thomas

This resulted in a long dash-to-front axle, a long hood with
a short front-overhang...

...and a cabin set rearward.
The styling lines and graphics were unique, inspired
by an East Asian ink-wash painting process.
This process started with abstract black ink-brush strokes
to find the right facial and styling expressions.

The idea of the artistic process was to create a unique
character and interest.

of sketching...

...with the added bonus of allowing the brush strokes

turns.zh:

输出343ps的3.8升V6引擎。

和较短的前悬挂……

以及向后移置的车厢。

绘制过程中汲取了灵感。
在水墨绘画中，往往会用毛笔以抽象的墨色笔触
勾勒出准确的面部和造型表达。

在某种程度上，它是素描这一经典画技的延伸……

并加入了以毛笔笔触带来的、意想不到的视觉效果。

这款“23”窗的Sambabus拥有可完全打开的
后拉式布制天窗……

以及从前一直环绕延伸到后方边角的大量侧窗，
顶上还有“全景式”的一圈边窗。
而丰富的车漆色系也为它的视觉魅力增色不少！
turns.speaker: Freeman Thomas

turns.raw:
The lovable Bug continues with the 1966 VW 1200 Beetle.

This version has enlarged front and rear windows.

The first-generation Pretzel's split rear window changed in 1953 to a larger oval rear window.

In 1958, the rear window changed again and became even larger.

With this model...

...the demand for better visibility, lighting, power, and safety caused the three-arch silhouette to evolve again.

But the original character and charm remained.

The last production air-cooled Beetle came in 2003.

Just think, 21,529,464 units built since 1945! That’s quite a run, and it’s still popular!<
turns.en:
The lovable Bug continues with the 1966 VW 1200 Beetle.

This version has enlarged front and rear windows.
The first-generation Pretzel's split rear window
changed in 1953 to a larger oval rear window.

In 1958, the rear window changed again
and became even larger.
With this model...

...the demand for better visibility, lighting, power, and
safety caused the three-arch silhouette to evolve again.
But the original character and charm remained.

The last production air-cooled Beetle came in 2003.
Just think, 21,529,464 units built since 1945! That’s quite
a run, and it’s still popular!<
turns.zh:
1966大众1200甲壳虫延续了甲壳虫的可爱风格！

这个车型加大了前后车窗。
第一代“椒盐卷饼”的分块式后窗于1953款更换为了

turns.raw:
Inspired by the Komenda Porsche 550 Le Mans Coupé...

...the RUF CTR3’s styling has lasted well, and is still being requested by customers.

This was RUF’s first foray into building a car with its own all-carbon-fiber body design.

It utilized a race-engineered all-aluminum mid-engine subframe with pushrod suspension.

The front underbody is a highly modified Porsche lightweight steel/aluminum structure.

It was engineered to meet RUF’s performance standards.

The super low cabin allows for an extremely low front, while the rear spoiler generates speed control and downforce.

Elsewhere, the six rear vents provide a clue to the <700ps> twin-turbo Mezger-based flat-6 underneath.
turns.en:
Inspired by the Komenda Porsche 550 Le Mans Coupé...

...the RUF CTR3’s styling has lasted well, and is still being
requested by customers.

This was RUF’s first foray into building a car with its
own all-carbon-fiber body design.

It utilized a race-engineered all-aluminum mid-engine
subframe with pushrod suspension.
The front underbody is a highly modified Porsche
lightweight steel/aluminum structure.

It was engineered to meet RUF’s performance standards.
The super low cabin allows for an extremely low front, while
the rear spoiler generates speed control and downforce.
Elsewhere, the six rear vents provide a clue to the 700ps
twin-turbo Mezger-based flat-6 underneath.
turns.zh:
这辆如虎CTR3的灵感来源于
柯曼达保时捷550勒芒轿跑……

它的外观设计历久弥新，至今依然能够打动消费者。

这是如虎首次使用他们自己的全碳纤维
车身设计打造一辆车……

并采用了针对比赛开发的全铝合金后中置引擎
副车框和推杆式悬挂系统。
其车头的底部结构是一套经过高度改装的保时捷
轻量化钢铝制结构……

并为了满足如虎的性能需求而经过重新加工。
其超低设置的驾驶舱也使车头高度降至极低，
同时由后扰流板提供高速下的操控性和下压力。
此外，其车身后部的六个排气管也让人得以一瞥它那基于梅茨格打造的
700ps双涡轮增压水平对置六缸引擎的恐怖动力。
turns.speaker: Freeman Thomas

The front underbody is a highly modified Porsche lightweight steel/aluminum structure.

It was engineered to meet RUF’s performance standards.

The super low cabin allows for an extremely low front, while the rear spoiler generates speed control and downforce.

Elsewhere, the six rear vents provide a clue to the <700ps> twin-turbo Mezger-based flat-6 underneath.

车身设计打造一辆车……

副车框和推杆式悬挂系统。
其车头的底部结构是一套经过高度改装的保时捷
轻量化钢铝制结构……

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf8Freeman_normal__917_ll_14_2402805
turns.raw:
This is the car every car designer dreams of doing! It’s gorgeous!

Its influence is, of course, the 917!

The cabin is low and sleek, with extreme cab-forward architecture, like that of the original 917.

The windshield shape is like a visor wrapping around the sides...

...while the front has a bit of 918 DNA.

A slightly restrained low, narrow mouth...

...and four headlamps seem to forecast the new Porsche headlight DNA of the 919, raced at Le Mans.

The wheels are similar to the 918.

The rear spoiler is interesting, as it connects the fender forms and has the taillamp integrated flush below.

The paint scheme is inspired by the Le-Mans-winning "Porsche-Salzburg" 917K...

...run by the Porsche-Piech family team in Austria.�
turns.en:

The paint scheme is inspired by the Le-Mans-winning
"Porsche-Salzburg" 917K...

...run by the Porsche-Piech family team in Austria.
turns.zh:
这是一款所有汽车设计师都梦寐以求想要打造的车型！
它简直太漂亮了！

这也是理所当然的，毕竟参照的基础车型可是917！
和原版917一样，它的驾驶舱高度较低，呈流线型设计，
并采用了驾驶舱极度前置的结构。
挡风玻璃的形状更像是一副包裹住侧面的面罩……

前脸略微透露出918的血统。
其略显克制且低窄的进气口……

和四盏大灯则预言了随后在勒芒参赛的919
所引领的保时捷大灯设计理念。
它的轮毂与918类似。

其后扰流板与挡泥板直接相连，从而将尾灯顺畅地
整合在下方，显得趣味十足。

它的涂装方案灵感来源于由奥地利的保时捷·皮耶希家族
车队经营，并在勒芒取得胜利的……

“保时捷·萨尔茨堡�&917K。
turns.speaker: Freeman Thomas

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf8Freeman_normal_lancer_evo8_mr_gsr_04_2403005
turns.raw:
The long-named Evo VIII MR GSR is a really special machine. A true sports sedan with rallying pedigree.

The Evo's styling is sober and restrained, but set off by its large functional rear wing.

The sober theme is continued on the inside.

The main difference is a thick steering wheel and high-bolstered Recaro seats.

Did you know that the name "Recaro" is short for "Reutter Carosserie?"

This is where Porsche handmade many of its car bodies in the 1960s.

The body manufacturing division was sold to Porsche and "Reutter" went off to make seats under Recaro!

A small bit of trivia!!.
turns.en:
The long-named Evo VIII MR GSR is a really special machine.
A true sports sedan with rallying pedigree.
The Evo's styling is sober and restrained, but set off
by its large functional rear wing.

The sober theme is continued on the inside.
The main difference is a thick steering wheel
and high-bolstered Recaro seats.

Did you know that the name "Recaro" is short for
"Reutter Carosserie?"
This is where Porsche handmade many of its car bodies
in the 1960s.

The body manufacturing division was sold to Porsche
and "Reutter" went off to make seats under Recaro!
A small bit of trivia!!.
turns.zh:
拥有长串名字的翼豪陆神VIII MR GSR车型是一款非常特别
的座驾。它是一辆具有拉力赛血统的运动型轿车。
翼豪陆神的外观设计简洁而内敛，但实用的大型尾翼
为其增添了亮点。

这种简洁风格在内饰中得以延续。
主要的区别在于厚实的方向盘和
高包裹性的Recaro赛车座椅。

你知道吗？“Recaro”这个名字其实是
“Reutter Carosserie”的缩写。
在20世纪60年代，保时捷的许多车身就是
在这里手工打造的。

后来，车身制造部门被出售给了保时捷，
而“瑞特”则以“Recaro”的名义专门生产座椅！
这是个有趣的小知识！
turns.speaker: Freeman Thomas

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf8Freeman_normal_lancer_evo8_mr_gsr_04_2403005
turns.raw:
The long-named Evo VIII MR GSR is a really special machine. A true sports sedan with rallying pedigree.

The Evo's styling is sober and restrained, but set off by its large functional rear wing.

The sober theme is continued on the inside.

The main difference is a thick steering wheel and high-bolstered Recaro seats.

Did you know that the name "Recaro" is short for "Reutter Carosserie?"

This is where Porsche handmade many of its car bodies in the 1960s.

The body manufacturing division was sold to Porsche and "Reutter" went off to make seats under Recaro!

A small bit of trivia!!.

A true sports sedan with rallying pedigree.
The Evo's styling is sober and restrained, but set off
by its large functional rear wing.

The sober theme is continued on the inside.
The main difference is a thick steering wheel
and high-bolstered Recaro seats.

Did you know that the name "Recaro" is short for
"Reutter Carosserie?"
This is where Porsche handmade many of its car bodies
in the 1960s.

The body manufacturing division was sold to Porsche
and "Reutter" went off to make seats under Recaro!
A small bit of trivia!!.
turns.zh:
拥有长串名字的翼豪陆神VIII MR GSR车型是一款非常特别
的座驾。它是一辆具有拉力赛血统的运动型轿车。
翼豪陆神的外观设计简洁而内敛，但实用的大型尾翼
为其增添了亮点。

这种简洁风格在内饰中得以延续。
主要的区别在于厚实的方向盘和
高包裹性的Recaro赛车座椅。

你知道吗？“Recaro”这个名字其实是
“Reutter Carosserie”的缩写。
在20世纪60年代，保时捷的许多车身就是
在这里手工打造的。

后来，车身制造部门被出售给了保时捷，
而“瑞特”则以“Recaro”的名义专门生产座椅！
这是个有趣的小知识！
turns.speaker: Freeman Thomas

turns.raw:
The 2015 RUF RGT 4.2 is based on the Porsche 991, with bespoke modifications to RUF specs.

Most noteworthy is the naturally-aspirated flat-6, punched out to 4.2 litres...

And 525hp.

Visually, it is recognizable by its aluminium wheels and wide wheel arches.

This gives it a great stance and a menacing look!

The rear ‘ducktail’ is of RUF’s own design…

And first appeared on the Rt 35 at the 2012 Geneva Motor Show.
turns.en:
The 2015 RUF RGT 4.2 is based on the Porsche 991,
with bespoke modifications to RUF specs.
Most noteworthy is the naturally-aspirated flat-6,
punched out to 4.2 litres...

And 525hp.
Visually, it is recognizable by its aluminium wheels
and wide wheel arches.
This gives it a great stance and a menacing look!
The rear ‘ducktail’ is of RUF’s own design…

And first appeared on the Rt 35 at the 2012 Geneva
Motor Show.
turns.zh:
2015款RUF RGT 4.2是基于原版Porsche 991，
按照RUF规格进行定制改装的车型。
最引人注目的是其自然吸气水平对置六缸引擎，
排量增大到4.2升……

输出功率高达525马力。
在外观上，它以铝合金轮毂和加宽的轮拱为醒目特征。
这造就了车身出色的姿态和极具威慑力的外观！
后部的“鸭尾”扰流板是RUF自主设计的……

它首次亮相于2012年日内瓦车展上展出的Rt 35车型。
turns.speaker: Freeman Thomas

turns.raw:
Well it seems like you really enjoy collecting cars?

I tend to collect things I love myself, so I know exactly how you feel.

I'm the Artistic Director of Dior Men's collections.

And, I'm always thinking about new, novel things.

Recently, I came up with an idea about a new collaboration.

The initial thought came from advertisements involving cars and Dior from the 1960s to the 1980s.

At the time, Dior had a line of perfume that sponsored races like the Dakar Rally and the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

And I thought to myself, what if we could combine the elegant essence of Dior with a legendary sports car?

I was sure it would result in a phenomenal sports car that would surprise everyone!

And, I had a particular car in mind that would be perfect for this collaboration.

It was the iconic De Tomaso Mangusta from the 1960s.

The De Tomaso Mangusta was designed by Giugia�o during his years at Carrozzeria Ghia.

He's a genius who entered the world of car design at 17 years of age, before becoming the chief developer at Ghia at just 27.

I've heard that Giugiaro's father was an artist.

So, I guess the styling ability of Giugiaro also comes from the artist's lineage in him.

Now, I realized that there's a similarity between the timeless, classic atmosphere of the Mangusta and the tone of Dior.

Therefore, I selected a slightly conservative, cream color for the Mangusta, accented with a modest but chic stripe...

...with the “Dior” lettering on the side.

The car number 47 was derived from the year of the first Dior collection, in 1947...

...and all these ideas came to life in the project with Gran Turismo, resulting in this very special car.

There's also a some special magic to this Mangusta as well.

I designed a sp2cial racing outfit for the driver of this car.

The suit is yellow, a very iconic color for sports cars. It stands out, but it's not too flamboyant.

The logo representing Dior uses the classic "CD Diamond" taken from the same era as the car, from the 1960s and 1970s.

The shoes are from our well known "Diorizon" series.

But the upper side is changed and newly redesigned for driving.

It would make me very happy if this becomes one of the surprises in yo6r collection!

turns.zh:
嗯，看来你们很喜欢收藏汽车？

我也会收藏一些自己喜欢的东西，
所以很能明白你们的感受。

我现在担任迪奥男装系列的艺术总监，

所以我一直在思考新鲜、新奇的事物。
最近，我突然想到了关于一个新合作项目的好点子。

最初的灵感是来源于迪奥在上世纪六十到八十年代间的
汽车合作广告。

当时，迪奥有条香水产品线为达喀尔拉力赛
和勒芒24小时拉力赛等比赛提供了赞助。

于是我就在心里盘算，如果把迪奥的优雅神韵
和一辆传奇跑车相结合会是怎么样的结果？

一定可以打造出一辆划时代的跑车，让所有人惊叹！

我脑海中就浮现出一辆非常适合这个合作项目的汽车。
二十世纪六十年代的标志性名车“德托马索Mangusta”。

德托马索Mangusta Ghia工作时
设计的。

他是一个天才，17岁就进入了汽车设计的世界，
仅27岁就成为了吉亚的首席开发工程师。

我听说乔治亚罗的父亲是一位画家。

所以我猜乔治亚罗的造型设计能力
也来自于他血液中流淌的艺术家基因。
我发觉Mangusta那永恒的、经典的气质
与迪奥的格调之间存在着相似之处。

因此我为它选择了一个稍有�+保守的奶油色车身，
搭配低调而又别致的暗金条纹，
然后把“迪奥”字样放在车身的侧面。
车头的数字“47”来自于迪奥品牌首秀的年份，1947年。
我的这些理念在与跑车浪漫旅合作的项目中
成为了现实，造就了这辆非常独特的汽车。

伴随这辆Mangusta而来的还有另一个特别的魔法。

我为它的驾驶者也设���了一套特别的赛车装备。

赛车服是黄色的，对于赛车而言是一个经典的颜色。
足够鲜明，但又不过分张扬。
作为代表迪奥的标志，我们选用了经典的“CD菱形纹样”，
与这辆赛车来自同一个年代——上世纪六十和七十年代。

赛车靴来自于我们知名的“Diorizon”系列，

但在踝部以上做了调整，针对车手的需求重新进行了设计。

如果这辆车能��成为你那些令人惊艳的藏品之一，
我也会感到非常满足！
turns.speaker: Kim Jones

turns.raw:
Well it seems like you really enjoy collecting cars?

I tend to collect things I love myself, so I know exactly how you feel.

I'm the Artistic Director of Dior Men's collections.

And, I'm always thinking about new, novel things.

Recently, I came up with an idea about a new collaboration.

The initial thought came from advertisements involving cars and Dior from the 1960s to the 1980s.

At the time, Dior had a line of perfume that sponsored races like the Dakar Rally and the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

And I thought to myself, what if we could combine the elegant essence of Dior with a legendary sports car?

I was sure it would result in a phenomenal sports car that would surprise everyone!

And, I had a particular car in mind that would be perfect for this collaboration.

It was the iconic De Tomaso Mangusta from the 1960s.

The De Tomaso Mangusta was designed by Giugia�o during his years at Carrozzeria Ghia.

He's a genius who entered the world of car design at 17 years of age, before becoming the chief developer at Ghia at just 27.

I've heard that Giugiaro's father was an artist.

So, I guess the styling ability of Giugiaro also comes from the artist's lineage in him.

Now, I realized that there's a similarity between the timeless, classic atmosphere of the Mangusta and the tone of Dior.

Therefore, I selected a slightly conservative, cream color for the Mangusta, accented with a modest but chic stripe...

...with the “Dior” lettering on the side.

The car number 47 was derived from the year of the first Dior collection, in 1947...

...and all these ideas came to life in the project with Gran Turismo, resulting in this very special car.

There's also a some special magic to this Mangusta as well.

I designed a sp2cial racing outfit for the driver of this car.

The suit is yellow, a very iconic color for sports cars. It stands out, but it's not too flamboyant.

The logo representing Dior uses the classic "CD Diamond" taken from the same era as the car, from the 1960s and 1970s.

The shoes are from our well known "Diorizon" series.

But the upper side is changed and newly redesigned for driving.

It would make me very happy if this becomes one of the surprises in yo6r collection!

turns.zh:
嗯，看来你们很喜欢收藏汽车？

我也会收藏一些自己喜欢的东西，
所以很能明白你们的感受。

我现在担任迪奥男装系列的艺术总监，

所以我一直在思考新鲜、新奇的事物。
最近，我突然想到了关于一个新合作项目的好点子。

最初的灵感是来源于迪奥在上世纪六十到八十年代间的
汽车合作广告。

当时，迪奥有条香水产品线为达喀尔拉力赛
和勒芒24小时拉力赛等比赛提供了赞助。

于是我就在心里盘算，如果把迪奥的优雅神韵
和一辆传奇跑车相结合会是怎么样的结果？

一定可以打造出一辆划时代的跑车，让所有人惊叹！

我脑海中就浮现出一辆非常适合这个合作项目的汽车。
二十世纪六十年代的标志性名车“德托马索Mangusta”。

德托马索Mangusta Ghia工作时
设计的。

他是一个天才，17岁就进入了汽车设计的世界，
仅27岁就成为了吉亚的首席开发工程师。

我听说乔治亚罗的父亲是一位画家。

所以我猜乔治亚罗的造型设计能力
也来自于他血液中流淌的艺术家基因。
我发觉Mangusta那永恒的、经典的气质
与迪奥的格调之间存在着相似之处。

因此我为它选择了一个稍有�+保守的奶油色车身，
搭配低调而又别致的暗金条纹，
然后把“迪奥”字样放在车身的侧面。
车头的数字“47”来自于迪奥品牌首秀的年份，1947年。
我的这些理念在与跑车浪漫旅合作的项目中
成为了现实，造就了这辆非常独特的汽车。

伴随这辆Mangusta而来的还有另一个特别的魔法。

我为它的驾驶者也设���了一套特别的赛车装备。

赛车服是黄色的，对于赛车而言是一个经典的颜色。
足够鲜明，但又不过分张扬。
作为代表迪奥的标志，我们选用了经典的“CD菱形纹样”，
与这辆赛车来自同一个年代——上世纪六十和七十年代。

赛车靴来自于我们知名的“Diorizon”系列，

但在踝部以上做了调整，针对车手的需求重新进行了设计。

如果这辆车能��成为你那些令人惊艳的藏品之一，
我也会感到非常满足！

turns.raw:
In many respects this ND Roadster is a product that I put alot of effort into.

The car I started competing in races with when I was into motorsports as a student, was the NB Roadster.

Later I would buy an NR-A version of the ND Roadster and compete in one-make races,

but what I focused on most as the designer of the ND roadster, was how it looks on the move.

It had to look good racing on a track, and in order to create the base structure that would achieves this,

I kept imagining its form exiting a corner with the load on its rear tires,while working on its design.

Today I'm competing in Japan’s Super Endurance series as both the team manager and driver of MAZDA SPIRIT RACING.

I actually race in a Roadster with this very livery, and we're lucky to have many other roadsters participating in this class.

Whether it be real or virtual, I hope we can all enjoy racing on the track, as challengers with the same goals!

And I hope you'll keep up with the latest activities of MAZDA SPIRIT RACING, too.

turns.zh:
我曾经为设计这辆ND Roadster
付出了极大的精力和时间。
我从学生时代起就是狂热的赛车迷，
还驾驶着NB Roadster参加过正式比赛。

再后来，我买过一辆NR-A版本的ND Roadster
去参加马自达举办的单一车种比赛。
在设计这款ND Roadster时，我最重视的一点
就是它在运动中所表现出来的模样。

也就是说，要让它在赛道上显得特别炫酷。
为了实现这个目的……
我在设计它的外观时，始终在脑海中想象
一辆重心后置的赛车出弯的模样。
目前我正在以马自达SPIRIT RACING车手以及车队经理
的身份参加日本的超级耐久系列赛。

我驾驶的其实是一辆采用同样涂装的敞篷跑车，
能与这么多同组别的其他敞篷跑车汽车竞技真是太幸运了。
不论赛道是真实还是虚拟的，
我希望大家都可以作为志同道合的挑战者，共同享受比赛的乐趣！
我也希望你可以多多关注马自达SPIRIT RACING的最新动态。

turns.raw:
The RX-VISION is a car in which I placed my car designer life on the line.

I worked on it from the standpoint of really making the dream sports car I have in my mind.

And one of the most important things for a sports car is its fundamental structure.

Historic cars that are still popular and beautiful to look at today all have exceptionally great proportions.

So the first thing we worked on for the RX-VISION was also the structure.

A textbook FR (Front Engine Rear Drive) with a long nose, and the ability to place proper load on the rear wheels.

In the final stages, we extended the front nose about 150mm from the structure we had originally designed,

the part from the front doors up to the front wheel center.

In the very end we made it a slightly unbalanced proportion...

But at that moment we got a lot of traction on the rear wheels, I thought "This will work!"

That slight unbalance is the hook. It's the secret to making someone go "Hmm".

The other secret is the reflection of light.

If you look at the RX-VISION as you circle it, I think you'll notice that the light's reflection moves around like a creature.

Cars are like family or friends to those who are into them.

And it's a very rare industrial product that runs around on its own.

That makes cars have the same type of existence as animals running around in the wild, or an athlete running on a field.

And when you think of it that way, I also want cars to be something that looks beautiful and truly alive in nature.

And for that you need a "sense of life."

So when thinking about what is the sense of life, that will put cars at one with nature,

we tried to express life in the car with the light's reflections 6nd their beauty on the car's body.

And those are the type of shapes that are instilled in the RX-VISION.

说到RX-VISION，那可是我赌上专业设计师的身份，
倾注全部心血的作品。

我想通过它，把我脑海中理想跑车的样子变成现实。
设计跑车，最关键的就是定好基本结构。

你看那些经典车型，哪个不是比例优美？

所以我设计RX-VISION时，第一步就是确定它的结构。
我先是采用了教科书般经典的前置引擎后轮驱动
设计——就是那种前脸很长，重心偏后的布局。

然后，在定稿前的最后一刻，我又把前鼻加长了150mm。

具体来说，就是加在了从前门到前轮中心那一段。
这么一改，车身比例看起来有点不太协调……但是这样
做能让后轮抓地力更强。

只要绕着车子转一圈，你就会觉得它像个有生命的东西。
对于车迷来说，汽车就跟家人朋友一样亲密。

动员。

美，还要让它“活”起来。

在思考怎么才能让它看起来更自然时……

我开始实验光线在车身上的反射效果。

就这样，RX-VISION活灵活现地呈现在了大家面前！

turns.raw:
The RX-VISION is a car in which I placed my car designer life on the line.

I worked on it from the standpoint of really making the dream sports car I have in my mind.

And one of the most important things for a sports car is its fundamental structure.

Historic cars that are still popular and beautiful to look at today all have exceptionally great proportions.

So the first thing we worked on for the RX-VISION was also the structure.

A textbook FR (Front Engine Rear Drive) with a long nose, and the ability to place proper load on the rear wheels.

In the final stages, we extended the front nose about 150mm from the structure we had originally designed,

the part from the front doors up to the front wheel center.

In the very end we made it a slightly unbalanced proportion...

But at that moment we got a lot of traction on the rear wheels, I thought "This will work!"

That slight unbalance is the hook. It's the secret to making someone go "Hmm".

The other secret is the reflection of light.

If you look at the RX-VISION as you circle it, I think you'll notice that the light's reflection moves around like a creature.

Cars are like family or friends to those who are into them.

And it's a very rare industrial product that runs around on its own.

That makes cars have the same type of existence as animals running around in the wild, or an athlete running on a field.

And when you think of it that way, I also want cars to be something that looks beautiful and truly alive in nature.

And for that you need a "sense of life."

So when thinking about what is the sense of life, that will put cars at one with nature,

we tried to express life in the car with the light's reflections 6nd their beauty on the car's body.

And those are the type of shapes that are instilled in the RX-VISION.

It's nice to meet you too!

Maeda-san is the brilliant car designer who penned
this RX-VISION GT3 for Mazda!

What’s more, he famously heads up all of the company’s
design projects.

The father of Mazda's 'Kodo Design' philosophy, he is one of

turns.zh:
我也很高兴认识您！

前田先生可是一位了不起的汽车设计师，就是他
为Mazda操刀设计了这款RX-VISION GT3！

不仅如此，他还是Mazda所有设计项目的总设计师，
在业界享有盛名。

前田先生还是Mazda“魂动设计”理念的缔造者，可以说是
日本最有名的汽车设计师之一。
turns.speaker: Sarah

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf9Maeda_normal_rx_vision_gt3_concept_20_2600305
turns.raw:
When producing the RX-VISION, I had a long running desire to make the RX-VISION a GT3 car and compete in the Le Mans.

I'm a car designer, but I have a soft spot for motorsports.

The first movie that I spent my own allowance on to go see in a theater, during elementary school, was about the 24 hours of Le Mans.

I still remember being really excited to see the fantastic battles between cars like the Porsche 917 and Ferrari 512S.

It made me want to race at the Le Mans in the future, and it also was what got me to strive for a job involving cars.

Mazda won the Le Mans,

and that event naturally connected to that scene of the Le Mans that I dreamed of as a child.

But I want to have everyone take interest in todays motorsports scene, not just events of the past like the 787B.

I strongly hope to add a new page to Mazda's motorsports.

In that �espect the GT3 version of the RX-VISION was a car that I really wanted to make happen,

and I was able to do that first in Gran Turismo virtually.

This is something I created with the strong conviction, "that this will be a real car in the future."

And I personally want to drive the Sarthe circuit in this car.

turns.zh:
不瞒你说，当RX-VISION还只是张图纸的时候，我就已经
在盘算着有朝一日要让它征战勒芒了。
要知道，我不光是个汽车设计师，还是个赛车迷呢。

还记得我人生第一次自掏腰包买电影票，看的就是讲
勒芒24小时耐力赛的片子。

那会儿看到保时捷917和法拉利512S在赛道上激烈
厮杀，那个兴奋劲儿，到现在我都忘不了。

就是那时候，我萌生了自己也要去勒芒的念头，也是从
那时起，我下定决心要投身汽车行业。
1991年马自达在勒芒的那次胜利……

毫无疑问又一次点燃了我年轻时的梦想。
不过，我觉得我们不能老是躺在787B的功劳簿上。

是时候该为马自达的赛车史开启一页新的篇章。

这就是为什么我铆足了劲要打造RX-VISION的GT3版本……
虽然现在这辆车只在《跑车浪漫旅》（在此感谢游戏）里
作为一辆虚拟车首次亮相。

但我坚信，总有一天，我会亲自驾驶着它……在那条

传说中的萨森赛道上驰骋！
turns.speaker: Ikuo Maeda

turns.raw:
It's so nice to meet you!<p/>
As a car designer for Mazda, Mr. Maeda worked on many road 
cars including the RX-8 and Demio, and many concept cars.<p/>
He's famous for leading and managing all 
the car designs produced in Mazda!<p/>
He's also the father of Mazda's "Kodo Design" philosophy,

turns.en:
It's so nice to meet you!

As a car designer for Mazda, Mr. Maeda worked on many road
cars including the RX-8 and Demio, and many concept cars.

He's famous for leading and managing all
the car designs produced in Mazda!

He's also the father of Mazda's "Kodo Design" philosophy,
and is one of the leading car designers of Japan.
turns.zh:
我也很高兴认识您！

作为Mazda的汽车设计师，前田先生设计过许多公路车型，
包括RX-8和Demio，当然还有许多概念车。

不仅如此，他还是Mazda所有设计项目的总设计师，
在业界享有盛名。

前田先生还是Mazda“魂动设计”理念的缔造者，可以说是
日本最有名的汽车设计师之一。^
turns.speaker: Sarah

turns.label: Buddy_GTCafe_CarDesignerProf9Maeda_normal_mazda3_gt4m_xx_2600405
turns.raw:
In the Japanese Super Endurance Series, I myself race in the MAZDA3 race car.

Lots of effort went into the MAZDA3 as a production model of course, but it was also drawn with the racing scene in mind.

In this racing modified version as well, I tried to maintain the original shape of the MAZDA3 as much as possible.

The modification including the livery is something that doesn't disrupt the beauty and silhouette of the car.

Another point of focus was how good it looks when running.

Like how the rear tread sticks out like a proper Super Endurance race car.

When you're overtaken by this car, I think you'll really notice how good it looks from the back...

...so on the track, I'd appreciate if you would let me pass!y

turns.zh:
我跟你讲，我在日本超级耐力系列赛中可是真开过这辆
马自达3赛车哦！

马自达3本身是款普通的量产车型，不过我们设计的时候
就已经考虑到了它未来可能会上赛道。
所以在打造赛车版本的时候，我们尽量保留了原版的帅
气造型。

不光是车身轮廓线条，连车身涂装我们都精心设计，
就是想让它保持原车的美感。
当然啦，我们也得让它在赛道上看起来够劲儿。

怎么做到的？我们给它装上了更宽的后轮轴，也是超级
耐力赛车的标配。

效果太棒了，尤其是超车的时候，那叫一个帅气！
所以呢，要是哪天你在赛道上碰到我，可得乖乖让道。
然后你就知道它的超车有多帅气了！
turns.speaker: Ikuo Maeda

turns.zh:
我也很高兴认识您！

前田先生可是一位了不起的汽车设计师，就是他
为Mazda操刀设计了这款MAZDA3！

不仅如此，他还是Mazda所有设计项目的总设计师，

前田先生还是Mazda“魂动设计”理念的缔造者，可以说是

turns.raw:
I think the MAZDA3 is one of the top 5 cars in my career as a car designer.

The design of the MAZDA3 also trails back to the RX-VISION.

In the RX-VISION, I created a form that expresses a sense of life in the beauty of its reflections.

And the design of the MAZDA3 is an achievement of that form created in the RX-VISION, in the C segment.

It's one of my personal favorites, and I think its a car that will mark its name in history.
turns.en:
I think the MAZDA3 is one of the top 5 cars
in my career as a car designer.

The design of the MAZDA3 also trails back to the RX-VISION.
In the RX-VISION, I created a form that expresses
a sense of life in the beauty of its reflections.
And the design of the MAZDA3 is an achievement of that form
created in the RX-VISION, in the C segment.
It's one of my personal favorites, and I think its a car
that will mark its name in history.
turns.zh:
MAZDA3可以说是我的职业生涯中最有代表性的五款车之一。

它的设计其实和RX-VISION挺有渊源的。
我在设计RX-VISION的时候，创造了一种通过漂亮的光
影折射效果让车身“活”过来的造型。
而MAZDA3呢，就是把这种设计应用到了C级车上。
我个人很喜欢MAZDA3。我敢打包票，这款车绝对会成为
汽车设计史上的一个亮点！
turns.speaker: Ikuo Maeda

I think the MAZDA3 is one of the top 5 cars in my career as a car designer.

The design of the MAZDA3 also trails back to the RX-VISION.

In the RX-VISION, I created a form that expresses a sense of life in the beauty of its reflections.

a sense of life in the beauty of its reflections.

created in the RX-VISION, in the C segment.
It's one of my personal favorites, and I think its a car
that will mark its name in history.
turns.zh:
MAZDA3可以说是我的职业生涯中最有代表性的五款车之一。

它的设计其实和RX-VISION挺有渊源的。
我在设计RX-VISION的时候，创造了一种通过漂亮的光
影折射效果让车身“活”过来的造型。
而MAZDA3呢，就是把这种设计应用到了C级车上。
我个人很喜欢MAZDA3。我敢打包票，这款车绝对会成为
汽车设计史上的一个亮点！

turns.raw:
In a way this Atenza is my debut work. There were a lot of obstacles, and it brings back a lot of memories.

I was appointed the general manager of the design division in 2009, to be the leader of Mazda design,

but I was told about my new position just 2 weeks before, so I became general manager without any time to be ready.

And the first production car that I worked on, was this Atenza.

Givender major role and responsibility, this was a state of emergency for me,

but it was just as much a chance as it was a crisis.

It was a time in which the design theme for the next generation of Mazda's were being considered from almost scratch,

and I thought to make design the major pillar of Mazda from here and now.

And actually, the development of this car had already progressed quite a bit under the previous design manager already,

but after th�nking that we need to create the philosophy of Mazda for the next age, and make design itself one of the pillars,

I made the decision to completely change the design that was already in motion.

To do this it was necessary to redesign things that normally should not be touched in terms of the development schedules.

As a result, the final design schedule for the production car was delayed about 10 months...

And I was really scolded badly by the managing d�rector of development at the time. A LOT.

At the time I was working on the "SHINARI" concept car that would be the vision model for the next era,

and I translated the design theme of SHINARI to the production car because it was a car made alongside the SHINARI.

It's a car that I personally care for a lot, I was even still driving it until very recently.

Its been over 10 years now, but I think its a design that doesn't feel old.

The more you work onwstandard cars, the more you understand the power of design.

And saloons are difficult to design, because they are the base for all cars.

I think timeless cars of an orthodox category is where the ability of designers are truly tested.

turns.zh:
阿特兹可以说是我的设计生涯的开端，说起来，这个项
目真是苦乐自知，回忆满满啊。
2009年，我突然被任命为马自达设计部门的部长。

事情非常突然，我只有两周时间来适应这个新职位。

我接手后参与的第一款量产车就是阿特兹。
说实话，那会儿真是责任重大，差点儿没把我压垮。
不过，我硬是把这个危机扭转成了成功的机遇。

当时，马自达正在为下一代车型寻找新的设计主题。

我的想法是把“设计哲学”作为马自达未来发展的支柱。
老实说，前任部长在阿特兹上已经下了不少功夫。

但为了实现我的新一代设计理念……

我决定把这个已经在顺畅推进的项目推倒重来。

也就是说，一些通常在生产后期不会再改动的部分，我
们也^��重新设计。
结果就是这款量产车设计进度整整推迟了10个月左右。

这下可把上司们气得不轻——他们当时大发雷霆。

与此同时，我还在筹备一款叫“靱”的概念赛车，它将成为
马自达下一代的前瞻性参考车型。

有意思的是，因为“靱”和阿特兹的开发是同期进行，
它们俩最后用上了同一个设计主题。
说真的，阿特兹U��我来说意义非凡。事实上，直到前不
久我还在开这车呢。

虽然这款车已经面世十多年了，但它的设计仍然经得住
时间的考验。

你知道吗？你在标准车型上花的功夫越多，就越能体会
到设计的魔力。

尤其是轿车，看起来再普通不过，设计起来反而最难。

所以，要评估一位设计师的水平，关键在于他能否为正
统车型设计出经久不衰的作品。
turns.speaker: Ikuo Maeda

阿特兹可以说是我的设计生涯的开端，说起来，这个项
目真是苦乐自知，回忆满满啊。
2009年，我突然被任命为马自达设计部门的部长。

事情非常突然，我只有两周时间来适应这个新职位。

我接手后参与的第一款量产车就是阿特兹。
说实话，那会儿真是责任重大，差点儿没把我压垮。
不过，我硬是把这个危机扭转成了成功的机遇。

当时，马自达正在为下一代车型寻找新的设计主题。

我的想法是把“设计哲学”作为马自达未来发展的支柱。
老实说，前任部长在阿特兹上已经下了不少功夫。

但为了实现我的新一代设计理念……

我决定把这个已经在顺畅推进的项目推倒重来。

也就是说，一些通常在生产后期不会再改动的部分，我
们也^��重新设计。
结果就是这款量产车设计进度整整推迟了10个月左右。

这下可把上司们气得不轻——他们当时大发雷霆。

与此同时，我还在筹备一款叫“靱”的概念赛车，它将成为
马自达下一代的前瞻性参考车型。

有意思的是，因为“靱”和阿特兹的开发是同期进行，
它们俩最后用上了同一个设计主题。
说真的，阿特兹U��我来说意义非凡。事实上，直到前不
久我还在开这车呢。

虽然这款车已经面世十多年了，但它的设计仍然经得住
时间的考验。

你知道吗？你在标准车型上花的功夫越多，就越能体会
到设计的魔力。

尤其是轿车，看起来再普通不过，设计起来反而最难。

所以，要评估一位设计师的水平，关键在于他能否为正
统车型设计出经久不衰的作品。

turns.raw:
In a way this Atenza is my debut work. There were a lot of obstacles, and it brings back a lot of memories.

I was appointed the general manager of the design division in 2009, to be the leader of Mazda design,

but I was told about my new position just 2 weeks before, so I became general manager without any time to be ready.

And the first production car that I worked on, was this Atenza.

Givender major role and responsibility, this was a state of emergency for me,

but it was just as much a chance as it was a crisis.

It was a time in which the design theme for the next generation of Mazda's were being considered from almost scratch,

and I thought to make design the major pillar of Mazda from here and now.

And actually, the development of this car had already progressed quite a bit under the previous design manager already,

but after th�nking that we need to create the philosophy of Mazda for the next age, and make design itself one of the pillars,

I made the decision to completely change the design that was already in motion.

To do this it was necessary to redesign things that normally should not be touched in terms of the development schedules.

As a result, the final design schedule for the production car was delayed about 10 months...

And I was really scolded badly by the managing d�rector of development at the time. A LOT.

At the time I was working on the "SHINARI" concept car that would be the vision model for the next era,

and I translated the design theme of SHINARI to the production car because it was a car made alongside the SHINARI.

It's a car that I personally care for a lot, I was even still driving it until very recently.

Its been over 10 years now, but I think its a design that doesn't feel old.

The more you work onwstandard cars, the more you understand the power of design.

And saloons are difficult to design, because they are the base for all cars.

I think timeless cars of an orthodox category is where the ability of designers are truly tested.

"if Mazda was to compete in the top category of the Le Mans, what would be a great design."

The LM55 name stands for "Car Number 55 of Le Mans," and is taken from the legendary racing car of Mazda.

I remember that we did a full aerodynamic simulation, and really went through a thorough development process for this car.

We had engineers knowledgeable about racing cars also become involved in the development.

There is a full scale model as well, and its on display in the Mazda Museum.

And actually, my name is on the car as the driver.

It is from the wish that if this car appears, and it runs on the Le Mans, that I want to be the driver.

The Le Mans hyper car class regulations allow a fair amount of design freedom...

and if we make a car like this and compete, that would be a huge opport�nity!

turns.raw:
In my mid 20's I was assigned to a position in the US, and the FD was a car from that time.

It was when Matano-san was in the US studio, and the clay model for this car was being made in the design studio.

It isn't a car that I worked on myself, but I remember thinking that the shape of this car is really great.

The greatness of this car is in the relationship between the tires and the body.

The body is thin vertically, and the tires have a sense of presence, and it is a honed 3 dimensional shape with no excess anywhere.

That's why this car still doesn't look old. Its beautiful.

The original idea came from a designer named Wu-Huang Chin.

He draws surfaces like this just with a marker. He's a design genius who is really good at drawing.

I think you could say that the FD and NA Roadster of this era are at the pinnacle of the Mazda design in Mazda history.

Their ability to work 3 dimensional shapes at the time was truly world class

and this is a product from the time when the foundations of Mazda design was formed.�
turns.en:
In my mid 20's I was assigned to a position in the US,
and the FD was a car from that time.

It was when Matano-san was in the US studio, and the clay model
for this car was being made in the design studio.

It isn't a car that I worked on myself, but I remember
thinking that the shape of this car is really great.
The greatness of this car is in the relationship
between the tires and the body.

The body is thin vertically, and the tires have a sense of presence,
and it is a honed 3 dimensional shape with no excess anywhere.

That's why this car still doesn't look old.
Its beautiful.
The original idea came from a designer named Wu-Huang Chin.

He draws surfaces like this just with a marker. He's
a design genius who is really good at drawing.
I think you could say that the FD and NA Roadster of this era
are at the pinnacle of the Mazda design in Mazda history.

Their ability to work 3 dimensional shapes at the time
was truly world class

and this is a product from the time when the foundations of
Mazda design was formed.
turns.zh:
说起这款FD，那可得追溯到我20多岁的时候了，那会儿
我还在美国工作呢。

那时俣野努先生也在美国工作室任职，这辆车的黏土模
型就是在那儿做的。

虽然不是我个人参与设计的，但我记得当时就觉得这辆
车的造型很独到。
这车最棒的地方就是轮胎和车身的比例关系。

车身压低变薄，让轮胎显得特别醒目，整体看上去给人
一种精雕细琢的感觉，一点儿多余的东西都没有。

正是这种设计，让它成为了经典。美，真的太美了。
这车最初的创意图来自一位叫秦无荒的设计师。

这位老兄可是个设计天才，画功了得。你敢信吗？
他就用一支马克笔就把这车给设计出来了。
要我说，这个年代的FD和NA Roadster绝对是马自达
历史上最杰出的两个设�。

当时马自达处理三维形状的能力确实是世界一流的。

正好也赶上了马自达的设计理念刚开始成型的时候。
turns.speaker: Ikuo Maeda

This is a car for which I was the Chief designer. I also owned this RX-8 for quite a while.

Actually my children were born in the year that the RX-8 was announced.

They were twin boys, but in our house it was already decided from the very beginning that our family car would be an RX-8.

The RX-8 was perfect for raising twins.

One reason is that the RX-8 is a 4 door, but you can't open the rear doors without opening the front doors.

So even when they were at a rambunctious age, I could drive without worrying about them accidentally opening the doors

To make a silhouette that looks like a sports car with 4 doors and with proper space for 4 people,

is actually very difficult.

There's not many cars in the world that have accomplished this.

It would be great to design something again with this package and engine one day.

There was a Mazda Fan Festa event the other day, at a circuit in Okayama.

There were a lot of RX-8 owners there. I really appreciate the fact that they are taking great care of these cars even today.U

turns.zh:

我自己也有一辆RX-8，开了相当长一段时间。
实际上，我家的双胞胎恰好就出生在RX-8发布的那一年。

我生的是一对男孩，但在他们出生之前，我就打定主意
要把RX-8作为家里的家用车。

RX-8简直就是为带双胞胎量身定做的。
虽然它是一辆四门车的，但有个特别之处：前门得先打
开，后门才能开。

这可就省心了，我再也不用担心那两个调皮蛋在我开车
时不小心把门拉开了。
说实话，要设计一辆既有跑车范儿，还能舒舒服服坐四
个人的四门车……

不是件容易事。

能做到这一点的车真不多。

有朝一日要是我能再设计一款这种配置和引擎的车型
就好了。
前几天，我�'�冈山参加了个马自达车迷聚会……

我看到好多人都是开着RX-8来的。这么多年过去了，这
款车还是很有人气，真令人开心。

要把RX-8作为家里的家用车。

虽然它是一辆四门车的，但有个特别之处：前门得先打
开，后门才能开。

这可就省心了，我再也不用担心那两个调皮蛋在我开车
时不小心把门拉开了。
说实话，要设计一辆既有跑车范儿，还能舒舒服服坐四
个人的四门车……

不是件容易事。

能做到这一点的车真不多。

有朝一日要是我能再设计一款这种配置和引擎的车型
就好了。
前几天，我�'�冈山参加了个马自达车迷聚会……

我看到好多人都是开着RX-8来的。这么多年过去了，这
款车还是很有人气，真令人开心。

It's so nice to meet you!<p/>
As a car designer for Mazda, Mr. Maeda worked on many road 
cars including the RX-8 and Demio, and many concept cars.<p/>

turns.en:
It's so nice to meet you!

As a car designer for Mazda, Mr. Maeda worked on many road
cars including the RX-8 and Demio, and many concept cars.

He's famous for leading and managing all
the car designs produced in Mazda!

He's also the father of Mazda's "Kodo Design" philosophy,
and is one of the leading car designers of Japan.
turns.zh:
我也很高兴认识您！

前田先生以汽车设计师的身份设计过许多公路车型，
包括RX-8和Demio，当然还有许多概念车。

不仅如此，他还是Mazda所有设计项目的总设计师，
在业界享有盛名。

前田先生还是Mazda“魂动设计”理念的缔造者，可以说是
日本最有名的汽车设计师之一。
turns.speaker: Sarah

turns.raw:
This is a car for which I was the Chief designer. I also owned this RX-8 for quite a while.

Actually my children were born in the year that the RX-8 was announced.

They were twin boys, but in our house it was already decided from the very beginning that our family car would be an RX-8.

The RX-8 was perfect for raising twins.

One reason is that the RX-8 is a 4 door, but you can't open the rear doors without opening the front doors.

So even when they were at a rambunctious age, I could drive without worrying about them accidentally opening the doors

To make a silhouette that looks like a sports car with 4 doors and with proper space for 4 people,

is actually very difficult.

There's not many cars in the world that have accomplished this.

It would be great to design something again with this package and engine one day.

There was a Mazda Fan Festa event the other day, at a circuit in Okayama.

There were a lot of RX-8 owners there. I really appreciate the fact that they are taking great care of these cars even today.U

So I was the Chief Designer for the Demio before this model, and have a lot of memories about the car.

This model was not designed as a single car but as a series.

The three models, the Atenza, Axela, and the Demio were designed simultaneously.

And actually I love small cars like the Demio.

I especially love Italian compact cars like the Autobianchi and the Alfa Romeo Alfasud,

and I personally owned an old British Mini in the past.

So when I first found out that I would be designing the Demio I was really happy about it!P

设计了一整个系列。

ATENZA、AXELA和DEMIO这三款车，我们是同期设计，
同时进行，一气呵成！
说实话，我其实特别喜欢DEMIO这种小巧玲珑的车。

尤其是意大利的那些紧凑小车，比如Autobianchi和
Alfa Romeo Alfasud。

我还真有过一辆老款的英国Mini呢。
所以你能想象到，当我听说要我来设计DEMIO的时候，
我有多高兴！

turns.raw:
The Mark II, Chaser and Cresta were known as the three brothers of Toyota’s luxury-sedan lineup.

This sixth-generation Chaser earned particular fame through its success in Japanese touring-car racing...

...most notably during the 1998 Japanese Touring Car Championship.

By then, Honda and Nissan had withdrawn their factory teams from the once fiercely contested series.

Although the 1998 season largely became an all-Toyota affair...

Masanori Sekiya drove the ESSO TOM’S Chaser to six victories in 11 races.

And he claimed the drivers’ championship.

The JTCC came to an end following the 1998 season.

That made the Chaser’s championship victory a fitting conclusion to an important era.

K

turns.zh:
“Mark II”、“Chaser”和“Cresta”是丰田旗下
豪华轿车产品阵容的三兄弟。

这款第6代Chaser因其在日本房车赛中的傲人成绩而独负盛名……
特别是它在1998年日本房车锦标赛中的惊艳表现。

此前的一年，对手本田和日产
同时率旗下厂队退出了这一传奇赛事。

虽然这使得1998年赛季几乎变成了丰田的单一车种系列赛……
但关谷正德驾驶ESSO TOM'S Chaser发挥出色，
赢得了11场比赛中的6场……

并拿下了冠军。
全日本房车锦标赛组别的比赛正是在那个1998年赛季宣告终止。

因此，第6代Chaser获得的历史性胜利就更显得弥足珍贵。
turns.speaker: Jeremy

turns.raw:
The Toyota Mark II is widely regarded as one of Japan’s most iconic luxury sedans.

Produced from 1968 to 2004, it enjoyed a remarkable 36-year run spanning nine generations.

The original 1968 model was known as the Corona Mark II.

The name suggested a larger, more luxurious version of Toyota’s popular Corona sedan.

When the fifth-generation model arrived in 1984, the Corona name was dropped in favor of Toyota Mark II.

This particular car is an eighth-generation Mark II.

More specifically, it is the highly sought-after Tourer V.

Under the hood is Toyota’s legendary turbocharged 1JZ-GTE inline-6.

What sets the Tourer V apart is it combines the refinement of a luxury sedan with high performance.

turns.zh:
丰田Mark II作为日本最经典的豪华轿车之一，可谓久负盛名。

从1968年到2004年，这款车的生产持续了足足36年，
期间一共迭代了九代。
1968年生产的初版车型
被命名为“Corona Mark II”。

“Mark II”代表它是丰田的
日常代步轿车车型Corona的豪华版。

在该系列于1984年发布第5代车型时，
其名称不再包含“Corona”标识，而是直接命名为“丰田Mark II”。
这里的这台是第8代的Mark II。

也就是车迷圈子中炙手可热、一车难求的Tourer V。
它所搭载的，正是丰田大名鼎鼎的
1JZ-GTE直列6缸涡轮增压引擎。

这款车的独特之处，便是将精致的豪华车设计
与生猛的动力进行了无缝的融合。

The granddaddy of lightweight sports cars, the Seven is a legend among legends.

Its story began in 1957, when the car was introduced by British automaker Lotus.

Lotus ended production in 1972, but the story did not end there.

Caterham acquired the rights the following year and continues to build the Seven today.

This Superlight R500 combines a highly tuned engine wwith a featherweight <500kg> body.

Its acceleration feels almost instantaneous, demanding complete concentration from the driver.

The engine delivers a hard-edged note that seems to resonate through the entire car.

For anyone seeking the pure thrill of the racetrack, few cars can match the Superlight R500.

The granddaddy of lightweight sports cars,
the Seven is a legend among legends.
Its story began in 1957, when the car was
introduced by British automaker Lotus.

Lotus ended production in 1972, but the story did not end there.
Caterham acquired the rights the following year and
continues to build the Seven today.
This Superlight R500 combines a highly tuned engine
wwith a featherweight 500kg body.

Its acceleration feels almost instantaneous, demanding
complete concentration from the driver.

The engine delivers a hard-edged note that seems
to resonate through the entire car.
For anyone seeking the pure thrill of the racetrack,
few cars can match the Superlight R500.
turns.zh:
“Seven”作为所有轻量级跑车的鼻祖，
堪称传奇中的传奇。
这一系列的根源最早可以追溯到1957年，
由英国汽车制造商莲花打造。

虽然莲花在1972年停产了“Seven”系列车型……
但凯特汉姆在次年就接过了生产权，并一直生产到现在。
这辆Superlight R500在轻如羽毛的500kg车身中，

搭载了一台精心调校的强大引擎。

其油门几乎是瞬时响应，因此驾驶时可千万别分神。

它那高昂的引擎轰鸣声，能让你从头到脚都感到震颤。
毫无疑问，对于追求赛道刺激感的车迷来说，
这款车就是他们的终极目标。

这款车就是他们的终极目标。
turns.speaker: Chris

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
This is an icon of British sports cars in the 1960s.

It was an evolution model where they took the highly
regarded DB4 and raised its performance.
And Touring was the Carrozzeria who did the body for this car.
detailRows.zh:
这是二十世纪六十年代标志性的英国跑车。

在备受推崇的DB4跑车基础上强化了性能。
这辆车的车身是由Carrozzeria Touring公司打造的。

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
The tuned inline-6 was much more powerful
than its rivals in its day.

And the car was quite simply sensual to drive.
This is the quintessential icon of Aston Martin, and of course,
the price is going nowhere but up!>
detailRows.zh:
经过调校后的直列6缸发动机比当时的所有对手都要更强。

这辆车开起来也很爽。
这辆车是Aston Martin的典型代表作，当然价格也是一
路水涨船高！

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
The C4 Corvette ZR-1 is a famously speedy Corvette.

It set seven international and world records in the 1990s.

In fact, its speed record went unmatched for more than
two decades.
The V-8 engine developed in conjunction with Lotus
was truly impressive and high powered...

...producing over 100ps more than the standard model.

All in all, it's a car that's even more valuable than
its price would suggest.
detailRows.zh:
这辆C4 Corvette ZR-1快如闪电的名气谁人不知，谁人不晓。

它在二十世纪九十年代总计创下了7项世界纪录。

事实上，这个无人能及的速度纪录保持了超过20年。
这款车上装载了与Lotus公司一同研制的V8发动机动力强
劲、令人惊艳，

比标准版的动力提高了不止100ps。

我要说的是，它的售价远远不能代表其真正的价值。

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
The first-generation Viper was initially offered as
an open-top model.

That was the RT/10.

This GTS was introduced later as the coupe version.
The coupe’s structure improved rigidity,
which in turn enhanced handling.
Lamborghini was also involved in the development
of the V10 engine.
Viewed in that context, it was a remarkably cost-effective
performance car.
detailRows.zh:
上市的第一代Viper首先推出的是敞篷车。

型号是“RT/10”吧。

这个GTS版本是改良后的双座跑车版本。
车身更加坚固，操纵感也更强。
Lamborghini也参与了它的V10发动机的研发。
如果从这个角度去想，这可是一辆性价比非常高的车。

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
Now this is a true icon—it can truly be said to
have changed the history of the racing car.

In addition to its really familiar styling, it's got a top
that can be folded down easily and a snug cockpit.
What's more, at the time of release, it was very
reasonably priced.
The market for convertible lightweight sports cars— those
ones that make you feel at one with your vehicle—

Well, it was virtually at the point of extinction.

This was the saviour which revived an entire genre of cars.
detailRows.zh:
这辆车是一面真正的旗帜，你甚至可以说它改变了赛车
的历史。

还是那家喻户晓的造型，加上方便折叠的顶篷和舒适无
比的座舱，
还有在发售之初非常实惠的价格。
能让你感到人车融为一体、操控自如的敞篷轻量级跑车
的市场

在当时已几近消亡。

这款车可以说是以一己之力挽救了所有同类车型的救星。

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
This car is based on the RX-VISION that was introduced at the
2015 Tokyo Motor Show.

It's powered by a 4-rotor engine, and you can immediately tell
from its shape that it's a front-engine/rear-wheel-drive car.

This was the future vision of the rotary sports car.

And now, this RX-VISION was made into a race car.
The engine is a naturally-aspirated 4-rotor
rotary called the SKYACTIV-R.

The weight of the car is 1250kg, and it
produces 570ps.
It truly feels like the return of the legendary 787B
as a front-engine/rear-wheel-drive model!$
detailRows.zh:
这辆车是基于2015年在东京车展上推出的一款名为
“RX-VISION”的汽车。

它由一部四转子引擎提供动力，而且你可以从车的外形
上看出来，这是一款前置引擎后轮驱动的汽车。

在当时，这是对转子发动机跑车的未来展望。

而如今，这款RX-VISION终于被改成了一辆赛车。
引擎是被命名为SKYACTIV-R的四转子自然进气引擎。

整车重量为1250kg，引擎功率为570ps。
看到它，就让人觉得传奇的787B跑车以前置引擎、后轮
驱动的形式王者归来了！

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
With the arrival of the Evo V generation, the Lancer Evo
series' turning performance improved dramatically.
The body was made wider to accommodate the increased
tread width.
The tyres have 17 inch rims and Brembo
brake calipers come fitted as standard.
All in all, it's one of the greatest cars
to drive in the world.
detailRows.zh:
Lancer Evo系列是从Evo V这一代开始大幅改善它的转弯
性能的。
车身变得更宽，以便扩大胎距，
而且换上了17英寸轮毂，全系标配了Brembo刹车卡钳。
我概括一下，它是全世界开起来最棒的车之一。-

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
'The Romance of Minus 21 Seconds'.
That was the advertising slogan for the R33 Skyline GT-R.
In a time trial on the Nürburgring Nordschleife...

It shaved a full 21 seconds off the lap time of its
predecessor, the R32 GT-R.
It was a slogan that reflected all the effort that
had gone into the development of the R33 GT-R.
I think stories like that really add to this car's value.
detailRows.zh:
缩短了21秒的浪漫”。
这是R33 Skyline GT-R广告口号。
在纽博格林北侧赛道的一次计时赛中，

R33 Skyline GT-R将前辈车型R32 GT-R的单圈成绩消掉了
整整21秒。
这条口号也反映出了Nissan为研发R33 GT-R所做的所有
投入。
我认为正是这样的故事让R33 GT-R这款车更有价值。

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
This is a truly historic car, and an extremely valuable one.
Érik Comas became Driver Champion behind the wheel of
a GT-R at the 1999 All Japan GT Championships.
In fact, the Pennzoil car finished in the points
in every race that season...

...and claimed four podium finishes out of seven races that year.

It was also the last GT-R powered by the RB26DETT engine
to claim the title in the GT Championships.
detailRows.zh:
这可是一台历史悠久的车了……而且极其珍贵。
埃里克·科马斯就是坐在这辆GT-R赛车里夺得1999年
全日本GT锦标赛车手总冠军的。
这辆Pennzoil赛车在那个赛季的每站比赛中都获得了积分，

并在当年的7场比赛中4次登上领奖台。

这也是最后一辆搭载RB26DETT引擎获得该项赛事冠军的GT-R。

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
With a body as compact as the S13 two generations before it,
This car has a design that combines superb styling
with impeccable balance.
And being turbocharged, it produces a respectable 250ps.

It actually competed in Japan's GT Championships too.
It's also a great base car for drifting customisations,
meaning you get a lot of fun for your dollar.
detailRows.zh:
随着Silvia重新回归两代之前，S13时期的紧凑车身设计，
整体造型变得集造型优美和完美匀称于一身。
涡轮增压则使这款车能够输出令人惊叹的250ps。

这辆车不仅作为赛车参加了全日本房车锦标赛，
同时也是漂移改装车的绝佳基础车型。可以这么说，
你付出的每一分价格都能带来无上的乐趣。

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
This is a definitive Porsche—a sportscar that makes
absolutely no compromises.
After 2008, the 997 GT3 produced double the downforce
it previously did.
In addition, the engine and brakes were made
even more powerful.
Not only that, but it utilises an engine crankcase that
has been honed for racing since the air cooled days.
No question about it, this one's a real gem.
detailRows.zh:
这是一辆不折不扣，毫不妥协、绝对纯粹的Porsche跑车。
2008年之后的997 GT3的下压力提高了一倍，
引擎功率和刹车也更加强大。
不仅如此，它所使用的发动机曲轴箱是从风冷技术时代
就不断积累研发的赛车用版本。
毫无疑问，这既是一颗璀璨的宝石。

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
The only notable difference with the standard 964 Carrera
is the 40mm lower ride height.

You may not notice that because it's very discreet.
At a glance you would think it was a standard 964.
But that's another element that woos the fans
of the 964 911 Carrera RS.
It's extremely pure to say the least. There are no comfort
items here at all.
As a result, it's 120kg lighter, and its handling
is razor sharp.
I'm certain it will continue to rise in value over time.
It's definitely one of the best of the best.?
detailRows.zh:
这款车与标准的964 Carrera唯一明显的视觉差异是
离地间隙又降低了40mm。

如果没注意到这个差异，
你可能会错以为这是台标准版本的964。
但是，令964型911 Carrera RS的铁粉们
疯狂的要点在于
它的极致简化配置，完全摒弃了
装饰件和舒适性功能。
其结果便是高达120kg的减重，以及如同手术刀般
犀利的操控。
这款车的价值无疑会持续攀高，
因为它绝对是一辆好车中的好车。

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
It's fast, affordable, and manageable in size...

Truly this is one of the great commercial sportscars.
The 2nd generation MR2 that debuted in 1989 was
continually improved over the years.
This represents its pinnacle, with its power
ramped up to an impressive 245ps.

In spite of this, its handling remains remarkably
straightforward.

Truly this is a car where the price tag
doesn't reflect its true value.
detailRows.zh:
价格在可承受的范围之内，尺寸可控且速度很快，

它确确实实是最好的量产跑车之一。
第二代MR2于1989年首次亮相，之后多年来一直在不断
改进。
这一台是系列的巅峰之作，功率提高到了令人心驰神往
的245ps，

操控方面也是相当直截了当。

就这辆车而言，其价值远大于售价，太划算了。

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
The most appealing aspect of the AE86 is the experience it
offered to spirited-driving enthusiasts.

It was a rear-wheel-drive coupe that offered excellent control
and a highly engaging drive.
In the well-known Japanese comic series “Initial D,”
the sister model, the Trueno, took center stage.

However, many enthusiasts favored the Levin.

One reason was weight.
The Levin, with its fixed headlights, was approximately
5kg lighter than the Trueno.

In a car this light, an extra 5kg over the front axle could make
a noticeable difference in handling.
detailRows.zh:
AE86最吸引人的要素朴实无华，就在于它的驾驶感。

这是一款操纵感极强的后驱双门轿车，给驾驶者带来非
常多的乐趣。
著名的日本漫画《头文字D》就将Levin的姐妹车Trueno
作为了主角车。

但在现实里，大部分人会更青睐Levin。

原因在于车重的差异。
配有固定头灯的Levin要比Trueno轻5kg。

在这么轻的车头上多出的5kg，会带来天差地别的影响。

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
This is the 1997 winner of the All Japan GT Championships.
It's a truly valuable race car indeed.

It's also famed for being the first car to take the title from the
Nissan teams, which were dominating the GT Championships.
The Tom's Supra first appeared in 1994, which means
it took four years for them to reach this point.
With a glorious race history and historical value,
this is a treasure for sure.
detailRows.zh:
这款赛车是1997年全日本房车锦标赛的冠军车，是一辆
真正有价值的赛车。

它也是第一辆从一直统治该项锦标赛的
日产手中夺走冠军头衔的赛车。
这款TOM's Supra于1994年亮相，花费了整整四年时间
才取得了如此殊荣。
兼具辉煌的赛史和极高的历史价值，这辆车必定是一笔
珍贵财富。

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
The GR Yaris was developed by Toyota as a rare
example of a fully in-house sports car.

It featured a carbon-fiber roof and a highly rigid body
structure designed specifically for this model.
Its engine and all-wheel-drive system were also purpose-built.

The car was engineered from the ground up to compete in
the World Rally Championship (WRC).
It delivered an exceptionally engaging driving experience, with
performance that rivaled far more expensive cars.

It stands as a model likely to leave a lasting mark
in automotive history.
detailRows.zh:
经过了很长一段时间的沉寂后，GR Yaris是Toyota 100%
自主研发的第一辆新跑车。

碳纤维车顶和坚固的车身都是专门为这款车设计的，
引擎和四驱系统也是如此。

这辆从头打造的赛车就是冲着世界拉力锦标赛去的。
驾驶它的感觉非常美妙，不是吗？我认为在比它贵上一
倍的车也不一定具备如此高的性能水准。

我相信这是一款会在车史上留下印记的车型。

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
This car is the same. It has a powerful engine and is
extremely lightweight. It's also quick and agile.

It can go toe-to-toe with sports cars with twice
the price tag.
It's a true heir to the Abarth tradition.
detailRows.zh:
这款车轻盈而敏捷，引擎动力充沛，

甚至能够和价格是自己两倍的跑车比拼速度。
它是Abarth传统的真正继承者。

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
This rare beauty is an icon of Italian car manufacturing.
The FIAT 500 made its debut in 1957.

It is considered one of legendary FIAT car designer
Dante Giacosa's most enduring masterpieces.

Giacosa contributed to the fabulous engineering legacy
of FIAT for many, many years.
At under 3m in length, it's compact in nature, but can snugly
fit four people thanks to a space-saving rear-engine.
It is celebrated to this day for its undeniable charm.
You can see where the modern FIAT 500
got its good looks from!
detailRows.zh:
这款稀世珍品诠释了意大利汽车制造业的外在之美。
FIAT 500于1957年问世。

被认为是极富传奇色彩的FIAT汽车设计大师但特·吉奥科萨的
代表作之一，这款车型久盛不衰，是永恒的经典。

吉奥科萨为FIAT设计多年，留下许多非凡的作品。
这款车总长不到3m，是紧凑型汽车，但由于
配置了省空间的后置引擎，因此可以容纳4人。
这款车的魅力毋庸置疑，因而久负盛名……
我们一眼就能看出具备现代感的
FIAT 500外观有多吸睛！

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
The Volkswagen Type 1 is one little car that made
a big splash in automotive history.
Designed as a functional civilian car by none other than
Ferdinand Porsche…

...its distinctive rounded shape resulted in the nickname,
"Beetle."
Its production run spanned more than 60 years, producing
21,529,464 units from the 1940s to the early 2000s.

Thus, the Type 1 is considered one of the most historically
significant cars ever.
detailRows.zh:
这是一款在汽车史上掀起巨大波澜的小型车。这款车正是由费迪南德·保时捷所设计的
实用型民用车……

由于其独特的造型，获得了“甲壳虫”的昵称。
Type 1是久盛不衰的经典车型，
在汽车产业热销超过60年……

从20世纪40年代到21世纪初，
总共卖出了21,529,464辆……

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
This is a first-generation Honda Civic Type R.
What's really special about this car is its specially-tuned
1.6L naturally-aspirated straight-four engine.
Just wait till you hear its thrilling roar and exhaust note—
you'll think you're driving a genuine racing car!

The effect is really amazing, especially when you go
from the 6000rpm to over 8000rpm.
Since it was based on a front-wheel drive car, the Type R
was originally marketed at an affordable price.

But nowadays its value has been reassessed
owing to its exceptional performance.
detailRows.zh:
这是第一代Honda Civic Type R。
这款车的独到之处在于配备专门调校过的
1.6L自然吸气直列四缸引擎。
当你听到这辆车亢奋的引擎声和排气声时，你会以为
自己在开一辆真正的赛车！

具备惊人的性能，特别是从6000rpm
加速到8000rpm以上时，效果更为震撼。
Type R是前轮驱动的车款，因此起初的定价相当实惠。

但如今，由于其优异的性能，所以已经重新定价了。

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
Simply put, the Honda Integra Type R is one of the meanest
compact cars in the world. It is a true race car for the road.
At its release, this first-gen Integra Type R came with a
price tag that was affordable to young enthusiasts.

It served as a tool for young drivers to hone their
skills as only a Type R could.
The Integra Type R's naturally-aspirated engine was a pumped-up
version used in the base model...

...producing 20ps more output.
The car also featured a strengthened chassis and boasted
more than 40kg in weight reduction.
It serves as a true showcase of 1990s Japanese automotive
engineering.
detailRows.zh: 不用多说，本田Type R提供了迅疾而流畅的驾驶体验。 完全是款名副其实的公路赛车。 第一代形格Type R发售时，由于其定价对于年轻车主来说 并非不可接受…… 因此吸引许多人将其作为入门车型， 用来体验驾驶Type R的乐趣。 其自然吸气引擎比起基础车型 更加强劲有力。 因此在功率上提升了20ps。 形格Type R还采用了强化底盘，并减轻了40kg以上的整体车重上。 这款车是上世纪90年代日本汽车制造业中当之无愧的代表杰作。

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
Without a doubt, the Mini is one of the world's
most popular compact cars.
It was introduced in Britain in 1959.

Its outward appearance was left largely unchanged
over the course of its 40-year production history.
In 2001, it was reborn in the form of the next-generation Mini
we see here.

Although double the size of its classic predecessor,
its handling and styling were pure Mini.
Although the original Mini was British, these modern iterations
were actually developed by BMW.

The German manufacturer did a commendable job
maintaining the spirit of the original car.
detailRows.zh:
Mini毋庸置疑是全世界最畅销的车型之一。
1959年在英国问世……

经过长达40年的生产历史，
外观大体未变。
直到2001年才推出新一代Mini，
也就是我们目前见到的这一款。

尽管尺寸上比历史悠久的前代车型大了两倍，
其操控性和风格仍维持地道的Mini水准。
Mini本是英国车，但其新一代车型出自BMW之手。

制造商的变动，在其响应迅速的转向及
卓越的刚性上得到淋漓尽致的体现。

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
When it comes to speedy little road rockets,
the first thing that comes to mind is this Mini.
Although the original Mini was built as a compact car for the
masses, it possessed a high level of performance.

The first to notice the Mini’s potential was the car
constructor Cooper, of Formula 1 fame.
That was the company that created this sporty Mini Cooper S.

The car shined in in races and rallies of the day,
leaving behind a lasting legacy.
This model, with an improved engine displacement of 970cc,
is especially prized within the series.
detailRows.zh:
说到小而快的车型，首先想到的就是这款Mini。
尽管最初的英国Mini可能是定位于紧凑型民用车，
但其性能仍然不可小觑。

首先注意到Mini潜力的是天才汽车工程师Cooper，
对，就是以F1闻名的传奇人物。
他的团队是这款运动型Mini Cooper S的
幕后推手。

这款车在竞赛和拉力赛中取得的光辉战绩，
成就了一代传奇。
这款车型引擎排量提升高达970cc，
是该系列中弥足珍惜的一款。

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
Combining a light, compact body with a responsive
rear-wheel drive chassis...
And a peppy 1.8L straight-four engine—this S13 Silvia
is one well-balanced FR sports car.
Not only does it strike an elegant pose when parked, but it
looks great tearing around a corner, too!
Nowadays, these cars are really something special.
In fact, the S13's best qualities are priceless!
detailRows.zh:
这轻巧紧凑的车身与响应迅速的后轮驱动底盘相结合……
加上强劲的1.8升直列四缸引擎，这台S13 Silvia
简直是面面俱到的前置后驱跑车。
不仅停放时姿态优雅，转弯时同样美得让人窒息。
现如今，这款车确实非同寻常。
老实说，S13本身就是无价之宝！

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
While the standard 208 GTi was undeniably small
and light, it did offer loads of fun to the driver.
This Peugeot Sport-engineered version takes the driving
experience to a whole other level.
Its exquisite chassis is stable and responsive.

On even extremely twisty mountain roads,
the car was an absolute pleasure to drive.
In fact, its amazing chassis is reason enough to add this car
in your collection.
detailRows.zh:
虽然标准规格的208 GTi无疑是一款小而轻巧的车型，
驾驶起来却趣味无穷……
这款Peugeot Sport精心设计的款式，更将驾驶体验
带到了一个全新的高度。
精细的底盘设置给人以无与伦比的稳重感……

即便是行驶在最蜿蜒的山间道路上，
都能让人尽享驾驶妙趣。
老实说，仅凭其优秀的底盘，
就值得你去收藏这辆车了。

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
The Ford Mustang has been celebrated as a legendary American
sports car ever since it hit the market in 1964.
One look at this exceptional seventh-generation model
just might entice you to shout "Mustangs rule!"
Incorporating the essence of its predecessors...

...it boasts a proud lineage without relying too heavily
on retro design cues.
The star of the show is undoubtedly the
the V-8 engine found in this GT.

For a car with so much power, it came with an
astonishingly reasonable price tag.
detailRows.zh:
自1964年上市以来，Ford Mustang一直被誉为是
美国跑车的一代传奇。
只要你看到这款卓尔不群的第七代车型，
你一定会欢呼“Mustang！”
凝聚了之前历代车型中的精髓……

从骨子里就流淌着厚重的历史底蕴，
不需要刻意攀附浮夸的复古风。
毋庸置疑，这款GT车继续搭载最优良的
V8引擎。

对于一款充满肌肉感的跑车而言，
其价格确实相当公道。

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
The sixth-generation Camaros were well-built machines,
especially this SS-grade make.
It is equipped with the same 6.2L LT1 engine that was first
introduced in the Corvette.
The handling is nothing short of exceptional, and should
make winding roads a truly thrilling experience.

Honestly, for all it offers, it's really quite reasonably
priced.
detailRows.zh:
第六代Camaros工艺精湛，
特别是这款具备SS等级的制作。
这款车搭载了6.2L LT1引擎，
这款引擎曾首次亮相于Corvette车型上。
其操控性堪称卓越，在蜿蜒起伏之间，
驾驶体验更加刺激。

坦白说，这款车提供的这一切，
确实对得起这个价。

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
Are you familiar with the term "muscle car?"

They were large American machines from the 1960s known for
their large displacement and enormous power.
The first-generation Camaro Z28 was one of the more notable
models from that era.

Its V-8 engine was developed especially for the Trans Am racing
series, meaning it was highly potent.
Instead having tons of torque like other large-displacement
eengines, it offered plenty of top-end power.

With awesome straight-line speed, the race version of the
Z28 took home several victories in Trans-Am races.
Known as the last of the Z28s, this 1969 model has been
coveted for generations.
detailRows.zh:
你熟悉“肌肉车”吗？

这类车以其大排量和强劲动力而闻名，
是60年代美国跑车文化的典型特征。
第一代Camaro Z28就是在该文化浪潮中诞生的传奇车型之一……

但其专为Trans Am系列赛研发的
V8引擎，也同样令人惊叹。
不像大部分的大排量引擎那样强调扭矩，
而是主打高转速。

不但能在日常行驶中派上用场，还是让Camaro Z28
在Trans Am竞赛获胜的幕后功臣。
这款1969年车型是Z28最后的改款，
其每代车款都令人着迷不已。

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
This sixth-generation ZL1 may be the most valuable Camaro
of all time.
Taking its engine from the Corvette Z06, the ZL1 is capable of
an output of over 650ps.
What’s more, this '1LE Package' has been outfitted
for track performance needs.

Incredibly, it completed a lap of the Nürburgring
Nordschleife in 7:16:04!

That's a super-car-level time, mind you!
And yet it's about 1/3 the price of your average super car,
meaning it offers more bang for your buck!
detailRows.zh:
这款第六代ZL1可能有史以来最有价值的Camaro车型了。
ZL1搭载的引擎来自Corvette Z06，能产生超过650ps的功率。
配备了专为赛道性能需求打造的
“1LE套件”。

令人难以置信的是，它以7:16:04的成绩跑完了
纽博格林北侧单圈赛道！

要知道，这可是超跑级别的成绩！
然而，其价格仅是寻常超跑的1/3，
绝对带给你极高的性价比！

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
There's nothing like an M car from BMW. The first-generation M3
is mostly associated with racing.

The final model was this "Sport Evolution," which was quite
popular.
It is distinguished by its upgraded 2.5-liter engine
and rear spoilers.
At first glance, the mods may seem slight, but
those in the know will tell you otherwise.
