Oh yeah, these cars were impressive indeed.
Not too many of the original M3s were produced, so you can
expect their prices will increase with time.
detailRows.zh:
哦，一辆BMW M系列的车……
第一代M3最适合拿来竞赛了。

这款“Sport Evolution”是最终型号，备受欢迎。
这款车的特点是升级过的2.5L引擎以及尾部扰流板。
乍一看，好像只是些细微改动，但实则不然。

呵呵！实际上这车型深藏不露……
这款车的产量不多，所以价格
只会不断往上涨。

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
Of all the Nissan Skyline GT-Rs, this R32 stands out
as truly special.
From the late 1960s to the early 1970s, the Skyline seemed
unstoppable on the Japanese race circuit.

However, Nissan halted production of the Skyline GT-R
in response to the 1973 oil crisis.
In 1989, the GT-R name was revived with this
R32 Skyline GT-R.
Nissan poured all of its technical know-how into
its development.
The hard work paid off, as the R32 dominated the competition
from the get-go, winning the hearts of motorsport fans.

I can only imagine that its value will continue to increase
over time.
detailRows.zh:
在日产Skyline GT-R系列车型中，这款R32
脱颖而出，成为一代变革之作！
从20世纪60年代末到70年代初，Skyline在日本赛道上
大杀四方，几乎势不可挡。

然而，为应对1973年的石油危机，日产中断了
该车型的生产。
1989年，GT-R这个代号因这款R32 Skyline GT-R车型
而再次响亮于赛场之上。

日产在研发这款车型时倾注了其
所有的技术积累。
辛勤努力最终有了回报，R32一出现就称霸了
整个赛场，赢得了众多赛车铁杆粉的青睐。

我推测，随着时间的累积
这款车将持续升值。

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
The Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution is an iconic turbocharged
4-wheel-drive Japanese sports car.
It's affectionately known as the "Evo."

The early Evos have won the hearts of countless fans thanks to
their stellar performance at world rally championships.
Although Mitsubishi has not competed in a
world rally competition since 2005...

...the Evo's popularity only continues to grow.
Historically speaking, this Evo X "Final Edition" was
the last production car to be produced of the series.

It featured a tuned-up engine capable of outputting
an astounding 313ps.

You can bet that its value on the international market
will only continue to appreciate with time.
detailRows.zh:
三菱蓝瑟翼豪陆神是标志性的日本
四轮驱动涡轮增压跑车。
车迷都称这辆车为“翼豪陆神”……

由于这一系列车型在世界拉力赛中表现出众，
赢得了无数粉丝的喜爱。
虽然自2005年以来，三菱和翼豪陆神
一直没有参加世界拉力赛……

但这款翼豪陆神的热度却不减反增。
回顾其发展史，翼豪陆神X的“终极版”车型是这系列的
最后一款量产车型。

这个版本的车型搭载更强大的引擎，
输出功率高达令人震惊的313ps。

可以保证，这款车型将来
在国际市场上的价值只会越来越高。

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
This E92 M3 is the fourth instalment in the BMW
M3 series that began with the E30.
Its pride is in its engine...

As it is the only generation of M3 to haul a howling V8.
At the time of its development, BMW was powering its other
cars with V10 engines built for F1 racing...

But the sense of speed and torque achieved by
this high-precision V8 are not to be sniffed at.
What’s more, you'll be surprised at how light it is
compared to its straight-six predecessor.

Indeed, this incredible car is worth having for
its engine alone!
detailRows.zh:
这款E92 M3是BMW M3车系
继E30后的第四款车。
这款车最引以为傲的是其引擎……

是M3系列中唯一搭载高亢V8引擎的一代车型。
在研发这款车型时，BMW仍采用V10引擎
打造其他F1比赛的车型……

但是，这台高精度V8引擎所实现的速度和扭矩
不容小觑。
更令人惊讶的是，相比于其前代搭载的直列六缸引擎，
这具引擎是如此轻巧。

确实，单纯就冲那引擎，
这款突破想象的车型就值得拥有！

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
If you're seeking thrills that only a German GT car
can offer, then the BMW M3 is for you!
This E46 M3 came powered by a mighty S54B inline-6.

This engine delivered high revs and a power output that was
simply out of this world.

It is without a doubt an icon among icons.
The E46 also exhibited the exceptional FR handling that drivers
have come to expect in BMW cars.

Indeed, more and more people will be singing its praises
in the years to come, you'll see.
detailRows.zh:
如果你追求只有跑车引擎才能提供的刺激感，
那么选BMW M3系列肯定没错！
这款E46 M3搭载S54B直列六缸引擎……

产生的极高转速和强大的动力输出，简直让你感觉飞出天际。

这款车毫无疑问是经典中的经典。
E46也展现出了BMW跑车向来优异的
前置后驱操控性能。

可以肯定的是，
会有越来越多的人迷上这款车。

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
The Alfa Romeo 4C is a car with plenty of charm.
First and foremost, it's impressively light,
weighing a mere 895kg!

This is rather astounding when one considers the design
trends of the 2010s.
Its innovative carbon-fiber body really
paid off in this respect.
Although powered by a small turbocharged 1.8-liter engine, the
car's lightweight nature made it accelerate like a super car.
Moreover, its mid-engine sports car proportions
made it a sight to behold.

It even pays homage to Alfa Romeo's historic
Tipo 33 Stradale.
detailRows.zh:
4C这款车极具魅力……
首先，它轻巧之极，整车仅重895kg
，令人印象深刻！

考虑到2010年那时的设计趋势，
这是相当让人惊愕的。
创新的碳纤维车身，
对轻量化有极大帮助。
虽然只搭载了1.8L涡轮引擎，但轻盈的车身
让这辆车能飙出超跑的速度。
此外，中置引擎的跑车设计
确实令人耳目一新。

这样的设计，是在向Alfa Romeo史上具有
非凡意义的Tipo 33 Stradale致敬。

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
This car is one of the most legendary creations
in Alfa Romeo's storied history.
Alfa Romeo was once a purveyor of the world's foremost
race cars and premium GT vehicles.

What we have here is a modern rendition of the cars
from that period.
From its name to its styling, it conjures up memories
of the company as it was in the 1930s and 1940s.
Although it employs an FR drive system, the transmission
has been mounted at the rear.

The transaxle assembly was meant to improve
weight distribution.
While the name and legacy are enough to give you chills,
wait until you get behind the wheel and drive it!
detailRows.zh:
这款车是Alfa Romeo史上最富传奇色彩的作品之一。
Alfa Romeo曾专注于制造赛车和高级GT车型。

这款车则是用现代手法
来演绎那段时期的代表之作。
这款车从称谓到款式，无一不唤起人们对
Alfa Romemo在20世纪30和40年代的记忆。
虽然采用前置后驱系统，
不过变速器却置于后方……

采用跨轴布局，目的是改善重量分布。
不仅在称谓和外观上令人振奋，
这款车的驾驭感受也非常梦幻！

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
Now, this is a true icon! A modern take
on the Ford GT40 of Le Mans fame.

It was built to commemorate Ford's 100th anniversary.
In terms of design, it conjured up memories of the beautiful
race cars that played a big role at Le Mans in the 1960s.
Under the sheet metal, however, it was completely revamped,
with an innovative aluminum space frame.
Also, in a brilliant move, it combined a supercharged
mid-mounted V8 engine...

...with a 6-speed manual gearbox.
Honestly, I can't imagine the value of this beauty
ever going down.
detailRows.zh:
现在这款车可以说是真的经典！
因勒芒耐力赛而闻名的现代版Ford GT40……

为庆祝Ford成立100周年而制造。
从设计上来看，令人回忆起那些在20世纪60年代
大放异彩的赛车。
至于内装，则完全改头换面，
采用全新研发的铝制空间车架。
这款车另一项高明的设计是搭载
中置V8机械增压引擎……

并配备六速手动变速箱。
坦白说，我觉得这款尤物的价值
不可能下降。

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
Ford's F-Series is the most popular line of pickup trucks
in North America.

And the Raptor is by far the highest performance model
of the bunch.
One design objective was to optimize it for off-road racing,
therefore, the truck possesses sports-car-like handling.
The Raptor boasts a wide body, reinforced suspension and a
6.2-liter V-8 capable of producing more than 400ps.
Put this beast in its element, and it'll shatter your notion
of how fast a truck can go.
detailRows.zh:
Ford的“F系列”车型是北美最流行的皮卡。

Raptor是该系列中迄今性能最强大的一款车型。
它的设计理念之一便是强化在越野赛中的性能表现，
这使得它与其他贴地的跑车截然不同。
Raptor不仅有宽车体、强化的悬挂系统，
还有一台能输出400ps以上的6.2升V8引擎。
只要将这头野兽的本领发挥出来，
您对于卡车能跑多快的认识一定会被击碎。

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
Here we have a seventh-generation Corvette,
or "C7" for short.
If I'm not mistaken, the C7 made its debut in 2013,
at the North American International Auto Show.

And seeing as how the original Corvette was born in 1953…
...the timing of its release lined up nicely with the Corvette's
60th anniversary.
Even in its basic package, the C7 boasted a powerful
race car engine.

You won't find any European sports car that delivers
so much "bang" for the buck.
If you ask me, I'd say it's a real deal for a sports car!
detailRows.zh:
这是一台第七代Corvette——
简称“C7”。
如果我没记错的话，C7的首次露面是在2013年的底特律车展上。

1953年是初代Corvette诞生的年份……
这辆车亮相的日子正好是那款车的60周年纪念日。
C7连基本版都搭载了一台强劲的赛车引擎。

用同样的价钱，你绝对找不到能出这么大力的欧洲产跑车。
要我说，对于一款跑车而言，这辆车绝对物超所值！

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
This car taught the world the true meaning of "Turbo".
Even today it is often referred to as simply "Turbo."
Porsche poured all of its the engineering expertise into the
turbocharger that powered this Type 930 911.

Compared to the 1978 model, the flat-6 engine had more
displacement, at 3.3 liters, and an output of 300ps.
Because the 911 is a rear-engine car, more load is placed on
the rear tires, giving it superior traction.

Add to this a turbocharger, and you've got a machine that
can really get up and go!
This 930 holds its own among Porsche's many masterpieces
and belongs in every enthusiast's collection.
detailRows.zh:
这辆车让世界领教到了“涡轮”的真正含义。
即使在今天，这辆车也会经常被提起。
Porsche汇集了他们所有的涡轮设计经验，
然后将其倾注到了这台930型911的涡轮上。

相比79年版，这款车的排气量提升到了3.3升，动力也增加至了300ps。
由于911是一辆后置引擎的跑车，其后轮承受的重量更多，
产生的抓地力也更大。

在这些基础上，涡轮增压器更是大幅增加了这辆车的进气量！
这辆930在Porsche众多杰作中占有一席之地，非常有收藏价值。

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
Now, there's a beauty! This isn’t just any Supra, you know.

It's known as a "homologation model," meaning
it was developed primarily as a race car.
Toyota's reason for creating it was to win the Group A
title in the Japanese Touring Car Championship.

To ensure it was battle-ready, the engineers performed
various mechanical upgrades.
These included a turbine and intercooler, as well as parts for naturally-aspirated and turbocharged engines.
As a result, the Turbo A produced 30ps more
than the base model.
With production capped at 500 units, this homologation model
sold out in the blink of an eye.

Aside from the wheel color and bumper shape, it doesn’t
look too different from its forebear.

However, those in the know will instantly
recognize its worth.
detailRows.zh:
天啊！这可不是一辆普通的Supra……

这是一辆为竞赛而生的“赛事认证”型。
丰田当时想用这辆车夺得日本房车锦标赛的A组别桂冠。

为了准备这项赛事，这辆车得到了多处机械升级。
这些升级包括一台涡轮机和中冷器，以及
自然吸气和涡轮增压发动机的部件。
这些升级使这辆车的马力比基础车型提高了30ps。
由于生产上限是500辆，“赛事认证”型转眼间就卖光了。

除了轮毂颜色和保险杠形状之外，
它的外形与基本型完全一样。

然而，有眼光的人
肯定一眼就能看出它的价值！

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
The 300 SL, which was introduced in the 1950s, is considered
a masterpiece of Mercedes-Benz engineering to this day.

This SLS AMG brings that legendary vehicle to
the 21st century.
And, it revives the most iconic feature of the 300 SL, which
are those gullwing doors!
Under the sheet metal, the chassis is all modern, highlighted
by a highly-rigid and lightweight aluminum space frame.

Under the hood is a naturally-aspirated V-8 that
produces 571ps.
It possesses an FR layout, complete with a transaxle,
meaning that the gearbox is located at the rear.
This allows for an ideal front/rear weight distribution that
makes this car extremely balanced through corners.

As the successor to the 300 SL, one can only imagine that
its value will continue to rise.
detailRows.zh:
300 SL在上世纪五十年代亮相时
被认为是梅赛德斯-奔驰的工程杰作。

这辆SLS AMG将那辆口碑载道的传奇带回到了21世纪。
它甚至让300 SL最具标志性特色——鸥翼门复活了！
这辆车的底盘采用了现代的设计，
由高硬度和轻质的铝制空间框架构成。

它搭载了一台发动机自然吸气V8发动机，
能够输出571ps的强大动力。
尽管这辆车采用了前置后驱布局，但其变速箱
位于后部；这意味着它有跨轴传动。
这种设计让理想的重量分布成为了可能，
从而改善了这辆车在直线和弯道上性能！

作为300 SL的后继者，这辆车的价值
肯定会水涨船高吧。

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
The Nissan Skyline GT-R is the quintessential
Japanese sports car.

Among its many iterations, this R34
is particularly popular.
Not only does it sport the famed RB26DETT engine,
but it was also the final version of the model.
This limited-edition final production model...

...called the V-Spec II Nür features an extremely
balanced engine.
It remains one of the crown jewel of all Skyline GT-Rs.
detailRows.zh:
Nissan Skyline GT-R是日本跑车的代表作。

在这个车系众多的车型中，R34型尤其受欢迎。
这辆车不仅搭载了一台备受赞誉的RB26DETT引擎，
它还是这款车的终极形态……
一辆限量版最终生产型……

这辆V·Spec II Nür不仅引擎更加平衡……
它更是被视作Skyline GT-R皇冠上的明珠。

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
The Jaguar XJ220 is celebrated the world over as one of
the most unique super cars of the 1990s.
It began as a pet project for several Jaguar engineers
and designers...

...who, together, worked off the clock.
It is for this reason that the team that made the XJ220
came to be known as "The Saturday Club."

You might say that this car represented the free expression
of lofty ideals held by Jaguar employees.
Once the prototype was unveiled, it attracted attention everywhere,
leading to official development and production.
Combining the beauty of Jaguar’s legendary 1960s race cars...

...with the performance of its 1990s race machines...
...built by the experts at England’s most storied luxury car builder,
the XJ220 was a car like no other.
detailRows.zh:
捷豹XJ220被全世界车迷誉为
二十世纪九十年代最独具魅力的超级跑车。
这款车最初只是几名捷豹工程师和设计师的私人项目……

在工作之余进行研发。
正因如此，打造XJ220的团队也后人被称为“星期六俱乐部”。

可以说，这辆车充分地代表了捷豹员工
对于自己理念的自由表达。
这台原型车甫一亮相，便立刻在全世界范围内造成了轰动，
也让公司下定决心，开启正式研发并投产。
这台车结合了品牌六十年代传奇赛车的优雅造型……

以及九十年代赛车的超强性能……
还有英格兰那历史悠久的豪华车制造专业知识，
可以称得上是绝无仅有的珍宝。

detailRows.sourceName: Alfa Romeo Giulia Sprint GT Veloce '67
detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
The Giulia Sprint is one of the most popular cars that
Alfa Romeo ever produced.
Because the Sprint also came as a 4-door sedan,
this car was also called the Giulia coupe.

It became a world-famous sports car, penned by genius car designer
Giorgetto Giugiaro.
Alfa Romeo had its start building super-fast race cars
to compete in grand prix races.

So, they’ve long had the technical know-how
to build high-performance engines.
This Giulia Sprint may be small, but it’s powered
by a mighty inline-4 engine with a DOHC head.

Combined with a rear-wheel-drive layout, it’s an absolute
thrill to ride.
And, it served as the base for a super-lightweight
GTA model, too.
detailRows.zh:
朱丽叶竞速是阿尔法罗密欧旗下的最受欢迎的汽车之一。
由于竞速所属的车系下还有一台四门轿车，所以
它也被称为“朱丽叶轿跑”。

这是一辆世界闻名的跑车，由天才汽车设计师
乔盖托·乔治亚罗操刀设计。
阿尔法罗密欧从创立之初就致力于制造用于参加
大奖赛的高速赛车。

因此长期积累了制造高性能引擎所需的技术知识。
这辆朱丽叶竞速虽然个头不大，但它由一台强大的
直列四缸双凸轮轴引擎驱动。

加上后轮驱动的加持，绝对能够带来刺激的驾驶体验。
而且这辆车也是超轻量级GTA车型的开发基础车型之一。

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
From the moment of its birth, this Aston Martin Valkyrie
was already the stuff of legend.

It is the child of a British sports car brand with over
a century of history and Red Bull Racing.
The aerodynamic elements were penned by one of the greatest
designers in F1 history—Adrian Newey.
But wait till you hear about its 6.5L naturally-aspirated
V12 engine...

Which is capable of outputting 1000ps at 10500rpm!
It’s an otherworldly engine deserving of an F1 machine.
And yet, believe it or not, this car is street-legal!

It is the greatest sports car currently conceivable by
an F1 partnership made in heaven.]
detailRows.zh:
打从降生的那一刻起，这台阿斯顿马丁Valkyrie已经具备了
成为传奇的素质。

它是英国百年老牌跑车制造商和红牛车队携手合作的产物。
它的空气动力学元素由F1历史上最伟大的设计师之一
——阿德里安·纽维操刀设计。
但是别以为这就完了，听听它那6.5升自然进气V12引擎的轰鸣……

它能在10500rpm下产生高达1000ps的动力！
你可以说这是一台跨界引擎，就算安装在F1赛车上也毫不逊色。
而且，信不信由你，这车居然还能合法上路！

它是目前与F1专业知识结合得最完美、最棒的跑车。

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
Ah, 1953—an unforgettable year! That was the year that gave
us the "C1," or first-gen Chevrolet Corvette.

And so began the age of mass-production sports cars
in the United States of America.
While sports cars were already stateside, they were mostly
European—and if not, they were rare and costly.

In other words, a truly "American" sports car had yet to be born.
Then General Motors released the Chevrolet Corvette.

From 1953 on, this roofless 2-seater pretty much underwent
yearly upgrades, each time promising more and more power.
This C1 Corvette is from 1958, and is well-known
for its major design overhaul.

Two headlights became four, and the hood was given
a number of fake louvres.

By the time 1960 rolled around, GM was selling many C1s,
a sign of its enduring popularity.
To this day, the Corvette remains�synonymous with
American sports car culture...

...making it one of the most important sports cars
in automotive history.
detailRows.zh:
啊，1953——令人难忘的一年！
在这一年，“C1”，也就是第一代的雪佛兰科尔维特诞生了。

这也标志着美国量产跑车时代的开端。
虽然当时跑车在美国已不少见，但这些跑车大多数来自欧洲。
而非欧洲跑车车型就更加凤毛麟角，而且价格高昂了。

换句话说，真正“美国”产的跑车还没有诞生。
就在此时，通用汽车发布了雪佛兰科尔维特。

从1953年开始，这辆无顶双座跑车几乎每年都要进行更新，
而且每次的动力都变得愈发强大。
这辆C1科尔维特来自1958年，因其设计上的重大更改而闻名。

两枚大灯增加到四枚，引擎盖上增加了几处伪百叶格栅。

到了1960年，通用汽车的C1产量仍然可观，可见该车型
经久不衰的人气。
直至今日，科尔维特仍然是美国跑车文化的代名词……

这令它成为了汽车历史上最重要的跑车之一。

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
This here is the 7th generation
of the Civic Type R.

I hear it set a fabulous time at the notoriously tough
Nürburgring track in Germany.
Speaking of Honda sports cars and the Nürburgring...

...the first-generation NSX was test-driven there
during its development.
Rumor has it, after its first test run, the test driver
came back with a curious complaint.

Apparently, the car had not performed very well
"in the air."

Now, the Nürburgring is known for its elevation changes
and many "jumps."

Still, when the Honda engineers heard the news,
they were shocked.
Honda later built its own test track based on
the Nürburgring in Hokkaido, Japan.

The track is known as Takasu Proving Ground.
This new Type R was developed at the Takasu Proving Ground and the Suzuka Circuit.
detailRows.zh:
这是第七代思域Type R。

我听说它在德国以挑战难度最高而著称的纽博格林赛道上
创下了惊人的圈速记录。
说到本田的跑车和纽博格林赛道……

第一代NSX在研发期间就选择了在那里试驾。
传闻称，在首次试跑之后，试驾员给出了
一个“奇特”的负面评价，

说这辆车在“空中”的表现不佳。

这并不让人意外，因为纽博格林赛道以其起伏的路面
和许多“飞越”而闻名。

然而，当本田的工程师们听到这个消息时，还是感到十分震惊。
之后，本田在日本北海道建造了一条以纽博格林赛道为原型
的测试赛道，

该赛道被命名为“鹰栖试车场”。
这款新的Type R就是通过在鹰栖试车场和铃鹿赛道
不断测试而开发的。

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
This here’s a legend of American stock car racing.
In stock car racing, production-model cars are raced
pretty much as-is.

The Superbird’s large rear wing and long front nose
were essential tools...

...for winning NASCAR races, the top tier of stock
car racing in the United States.

Basically, they were special racing parts
for a production car.
In its effort to meet NASCAR homologation,
the Superbird was sold for but one year...

...and few were ever produced.

Afterwards, stock car races began to feature more
and more pure race cars.
Indeed, this car is from an age when street cars
and race cars greatly resembled each other.*
detailRows.zh:
这一辆是美国改装赛车比赛中的传奇。
在改装赛车比赛中，量产型的车辆通常是以原始的出厂配置的状态直接参与竞速。

这辆Superbird的大号后翼和长车鼻都是竞速利器……

能够帮助它赢得美国的顶级改装赛车赛事——纳斯卡赛车。

事实上，这些车身部件都是专门服务于量产型车辆的特殊竞速部件。
为了满足纳斯卡赛车的赛事资格认证条件，
Superbird仅对外销售一年……

总产量也不多。

在那之后，改装赛车比赛开始涌入越来越多种类的赛车。
的确，这款车来自于那个公路车和赛车
相似度极高的时代。

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
Yes, I can recall when this Volvo V40 debuted like it was yesterday.
It was in 2012, if I’m not mistaken.
It was a 5-door compact hatchback that exemplified
the company's dedication to practicality and safety.

What’s more, it had beautiful coupe-like styling.
I’ll have you know, this styling borrowed many design cues
from the great Volvos of the 1960s.

We're talking P1800 and 1800ES, for instance.
detailRows.zh:
没错，我还依稀记得这辆Volvo V40首发时的情景。
如果我没记错的话，那是在2012年。
这是一款5门紧凑型掀背车，从头到尾贯彻了Volvo
那久经考验的实用性哲学。

此外，它还采用了雅致的双门轿跑外形风格。
我必须要告诉你，这种设计风格从来自1960年代的
伟大Volvo车型身上吸取了不少的灵感。

例如P1800和1800ES之类的经典Volvo车型！

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
The Unimog—a versatile, multi-purpose truck with a storied legacy
has been a legend among enthusiasts for decades.
Its remarkable history traces all the way back to 1945.

It was originally designed as an agricultural workhorse.

And, it first entered production in 1948.
The 411 you see here belongs to the second-generation
series from 1956.

In addition to boasting a more powerful engine than the 401, it
was equipped with a wide array of specialized attachments.
It was the most well-rounded of the early Unimogs. Its endearing
design has captured the hearts of countless tractor enthusiasts.
detailRows.zh:
作为多功能卡车界的“活化石”，Unimog
数十年来一直是车迷心中的机械传奇。
事实上，它的传奇历史甚至可以追溯到1945年！

最初被设计为农用机械的它……

于1948年正式量产。
眼前这台411属于1956年诞生的第二代车型。

相较401型，不仅引擎功率大幅提升，更配有
整套专业级拓展套件。
作为早期Unimog家族最全能的成员，其独特设计
征服了无数拖拉机爱好者。

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
Nismo is the name of Nissan’s in-house works team.

They are famous for building production cars packed
with racing know-how.
In 2004, to mark its 20th anniversary, Nismo introduced
this R34 GT-R Z-tune.

Of all the Nismo products, this one takes the crown.
At the time of its release, the R34 Skyline GT-R was
already retired.

This meant that the Z-tune had to be based on used cars.
Naturally, only those deemed excellent by Nismo were used.

The engines and bodies were disassembled and reengineered
with racing technology.
Today, R34 GT-Rs are celebrated as prized collector’s cars
across the globe.

But none more than the legendary Z-tune!
detailRows.zh:
Nismo是Nissan自家厂队的名称，

以打造出结合诸多赛车技术的量产车而闻名。
2004年，为纪念成立20周年，Nismo推出了
这款R34 GT-R Z-tune。

在所有Nismo作品中，这款车堪称巅峰之作。
在它发布之时，R34 Skyline GT-R已经停产退役……

这意味着Z-tune必须以旧款车型为基础来进行打造。
自然，只有那些被Nismo评定为极品的车辆才会被选用。

引擎和车身随后被拆解，并运用赛车技术
进行重新改造。
如今，R34 GT-R被全世界奉为收藏珍品。

而其中最珍贵的莫过于Z-tune！]

detailRows.sourceName: DELTA HF Integrale WRC Group A (1992)
detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
Lancia of Italy had long been a dominant force
in the World Rally Championship.

This Group A rally version of the Delta stands
as a testament to Lancia’s many triumphs.
From 1987 to 1992, the marque secured six
consecutive manufacturers’ championships.

It was a legendary achievement—one that remains unmatched
in the history of the world’s premier rally series.
This Group A Delta rally car stands as an undeniable testament
to Lancia’s dominance in the sport.
Even the production car version, built for Group B
homologation...

...is the envy of car collectors everywhere!~
detailRows.zh:
意大利的Lancia在很长一段时间里都是
世界拉力锦标赛统治级的存在。

这款Delta Group A拉力赛版本正是其荣耀传承中的闪耀瑰宝。
从1987年到1992年，Lancia豪取六连车厂冠军头衔……

这项传奇成就在世界顶级拉力赛事中至今无人能复刻。
这台Delta Group A拉力赛车无疑是Lancia成功的见证。
即便只是作为为了满足Gr.B组别认证而打造的
量产版车型……

也令全球汽车藏家艳羡不已！

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
Renault is famous for its minivans, especially the Espace.
This Avantime may resemble a minivan, but it
was really intended to be a two-door coupe.
A truly unique car, if I may say so.

It was designed by none other than Patrick le Quément,
chief designer at Renault from the 1980s to the 2000s.
Released in 2001, it had a remarkably brief production run
of two short years.

A shame, really, as it’s a car overflowing with character,
inside and out. Indeed, I feel there’s nothing quite like it.
No wonder it continues to attract fans all over the world.
It’s another shining achievement in Renault’s long history.
detailRows.zh:
雷诺以其打造的多功能乘用车而闻名，特别是Espace。
虽然这款Avantime看起来像多功能乘用车，但实际上
它是按照双门轿跑车的标准打造的。
实话实说，这确实是一款独一无二的车。

它的设计师正是帕特里克·勒·奎芒，
他在1980年代至2000年代期间担任雷诺的首席设计师。
该车于2001年发布，生产周期却异常短暂，
仅仅持续了两年时间。

这实在令人惋惜，因为这是一款由内到外都充满个性
的汽车。说真的，我觉得再也找不到如此特立独行的车型了。
难怪它至今仍吸引着世界各地的车迷。
这又是雷诺悠久历史中的一项辉煌成就。

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
This is the successor to the legendary original Skyline GT-R,
or "Hakosuka," as it was affectionately known in Japan.

This car earned its nickname from an ad campaign featuring a
charming young couple known as “Ken” and “Mary.”

Among Skyline fans, it has forever been remembered by that name
—the “Kenmeri GT-R.”
The Hakosuka rose to prominence in Japanese touring car racing,
earning a fearsome reputation for being unstoppable.

Naturally, the Kenmeri was expected to carry the torch passed
down by its proud predecessor. But fate had other plans.

The 1970s ushered in a new era of strict emissions regulations,
cutting short the Kenmeri’s racing legacy before it began.
Because of these regulations, building cars with high-performance
engines like the GT-R became impossible.
And so, just four months after the Kenmeri went on sale,�
production ended, leaving behind only 197 units ever built.

Although it never had a chance to compete in any races...
...its tragic fate and small production run have made
it—in the eyes of enthusiasts—a legend all its own.,
detailRows.zh:
此车是传奇初代天际线GT-R的继承者，
后者在日本被亲切地称为“箱型”……

而本车的昵称则源自一则流行广告，在广告中出现了
一对名为“肯”与“玛丽”的可爱年轻情侣。

因此，在天际线车迷圈中，如今人们都称这款车为
“肯·玛丽GT-R”。
前辈“箱型”在日本房车赛事中声名鹊起，
赢得了不可战胜的美誉。

按理说，“肯·玛丽”本应延续其前辈铸就的辉煌……

然而时运不济，1970年代恰逢严格的排放法规
开始实施的时代。
这些法规导致GT-R这类搭载高性能引擎的车型
无法继续生产。
因此，“肯·玛丽”在上市仅四个月后便宣告停产，
最终产量定格在197台。

虽然它从未有机会踏上赛场……
但悲情的命运与稀有的产量，反而成就了
其独特的传奇地位。

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
The Toyota Land Cruiser is the vehicle that effectively wrote
the first chapter of Japanese off-road history.

Released in 1960, the “40” marked the third-generation model.

In Japan, fans affectionately call it the “Yonmaru,” a nickname
drawn from the Japanese pronunciation of its model number.
A commercial vehicle built to haul goods in agriculture and
farming, it also served first-responders in times of emergency.

Above all else, it was created with one purpose in mind—
to be a true “working vehicle."
From its ladder-frame chassis to its suspension, every component
was engineered with durability in mind.

Well-built and dependable, it embodied all the qualities
that made the Land Cruiser a legend.

With an impressive production run that has lasted 24 years...
...this best-selling SUV has made the Land Cruiser a household name
all over the world.
detailRows.zh:
丰田Land Cruiser是真正开创
日本越野历史的车型。

这款1960年发布的“40系”是第三代车型。

它被日本车迷亲切地称为“四丸”，
这个昵称源自其车型编号的日语发音。
作为旨在运输农业物资和进行紧急救援的商用车辆……

它的首要且最重要的设计目的是成为一款“工具车”。
从梯形车架底盘到悬挂系统，
每个部件都可谓为经久耐用而打造。

制造精良且可靠耐用，它完美体现了
Land Cruiser的所有优秀特质。

凭借长达24年的辉煌生产周期……
这款畅销车型让Land Cruiser之名
享誉全球，家喻户晓。

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
The Espace F1 was unveiled in 1994
at the Paris Motor Show.

More than 30 years have passed since then,
yet it remains as astonishing as ever.
Based on the wildly popular family car,
the Renault Espace...

...the Espace F1 was powered by a Renault V-10 engine from the
1992 Formula 1 champion machine, the Williams FW14B.

It was transplanted amidships in true race-car fashion.
At the time, Renault and Williams were the dominant duo
in Formula 1 racing.

But no one expected them to install an F1 engine in a
minivan! It was, indeed, a fantastical concept.
Although it never reached production, it remains a brilliant star
in Renault’s history.
detailRows.zh:
Espace F1于1994年在巴黎国际车展首次亮相。

三十余年后的今天，这款车型依然令人叹为观止。
基于风靡全球的家用车型Renault Espace打造……

Espace F1搭载的Renault V10引擎
源自1992年F1冠军赛车，Williams车队的FW14B……

并依照赛车规格采用中置布局。
当时Renault和Williams堪称
一级方程式赛场的黄金组合。

但谁也未曾料想，他们竟会将F1引擎
植入一台家用MPV！这无疑是天马行空的创举。
虽未量产上市，此车始终是Renault品牌史上
璀璨夺目的传奇之作。@

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
Since its debut in 1980, this first-gen Fiat Panda went on to
become a best-seller with a 20-year-plus production run.

The basic car par excellence, it remains beloved by drivers
all over the world.
The original Panda is perhaps the car most associated
with the world-class car designer Giorgetto Giugiaro.

Fiat entrusted him with designing the next generation
of the compact car.
The objective was a car combining intuitive handling
with cost-effective production.
Drawing on his deep knowledge of automotive design, Giugiaro
came up with solutions to all sorts of problems...

...such as the economical use of flat glass
for all of the car's window surfaces.
Indeed, this masterpiece is simply brimming with hallmarks
of his inimitable genius!
detailRows.zh:
自1980年问世以来，这款初代菲亚特Panda
以长达二十余年的生产周期成为常青车型。

作为极致简约却性能卓著的经典代表，
至今仍深受全球车迷喜爱。
初代Panda可谓是与世界级设计大师
乔盖托·乔治亚罗最具渊源的车型。

菲亚特将这款紧凑车型的换代设计全权委托于他。
设计计划书要求打造兼具直观操控体验
与亲民制造成本的车型。
凭借深厚的汽车设计造诣，
乔治亚罗采用创新方案解决了诸多难题……

诸如全车玻璃表面均采用成本更有优势的平板玻璃。
毫无疑问，这件杰作处处闪耀着
大师独一无二的设计智慧！

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
Three days after its introduction at the 2019 Paris Motor Show...

...this car competed in the eighth round of the
Nürburgring Endurance Series.
It qualified 2nd and finished 5th overall in the race—
an impressive result right out of the box.
As it had not yet been commercially released,
it entered the SPX class for test cars.
The R8 LMS Evo demonstrated its potential from
the very beginning.

It went on to compete successfully in GT racing series
around the world.'
detailRows.zh:
在2019年巴黎车展上公布后仅3天，这辆车就出现在
纽博格林耐力系列赛的第8轮比赛中！
它在排位赛中获得总成绩第二名，在决赛中获得总成绩
第五名。作为初出茅庐的新车，这个成绩还不错吧？
因为这款车还没正式上市销售，所以它作为测试车参加
SPX级的比赛。
总而言之，R8 LMS Evo从一开始就完全展示了它的肌肉。

之后也继续在世界各地的超级跑车比赛中再创佳绩。

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
Have you ever heard of the German ADAC GT Masters?

It's a race where each car has a pair of drivers,
one amateur and one pro.
For the 2016 ADAC Masters, Chevrolet entered a
Corvette C7 FIA-GT3.
The following year, they claimed both driver and
team championships.

This is a car that an amateur can handle, but which can
also withstand any punishment a pro can throw at it.

Yep, in terms of performance, this Corvette C7 Gr.3
machine is quite something.
detailRows.zh:
你听说过德国ADAC GT大师赛？

这是一场需要两位车手：一位新人车手、一位资深车手
交替参赛的比赛。
在2016年的ADAC大师赛中，Chevrolet派出了Corvette C7 FIA-GT3。
在之后一年，他们同时拿下了车手和车队总冠军。

这台车不仅操控平易近人，适合新手，又能经受住专业
选手的“折磨”。

可以肯定，Corvette C7 Gr.3在性能方面很有一套。

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
Lamborghini actually never really got into motorsports
as a manufacturer over the yearsBut when it developed an FIA-GT3 car based on the
Huracán in 2015...
...the company finally sent a works machine into the circuit! It made its debut at the 2015 Blancpain Endurance Series.
And it totally left the other cars in the dust,
finishing winning by a margin of 30 seconds.The car was actually disqualified at one point
because of a rule violation in the team's refueling equipment.
But the team appealed and won,
and so did the GT3's in its debut race.
detailRows.zh:
你知道么？Lamborghini作为一家制造商，其实很多年
都没有真正参加过赛车运动了。
但他们积极做出了改变，在2015年基于Huracán打造了
这款FIA-GT3，

终于把它们的车送上了赛道！
它在2015年的宝珀耐力系列赛上首次亮相，

就让它的对手们完全望尘莫及，以比第二名快了30秒的
成绩夺得了冠军。
实际上，他们在比赛中一度被取消了资格，因为赛会判
定他们的加油设备出现了违规。

但是他们的上诉成功了，最终在首秀中就赢得了冠军。

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
You know, the R33 GT-R always reminds me of Le Mans in 1995.
At the time, regulations prevented cars from entering if
a four-door version existed in the lineup.

So, Nissan developed a special 2-door “NISMO GT-R LM."

It was registered in the U.K. to meet homologation requirements.
And Nissan succeeded in entering the car at Le Mans.

It showed just how determined team manager, Kozo Watanabe was...

...to see the GT-R compete in the race.
detailRows.zh:
说起R33 GT-R，总是让我想起
1995年的勒芒24小时耐力赛。
因为当时的勒芒规则明确规定：
若某车系拥有四门版本，则其赛车不得参赛。

为此，Nissan特别打造了一辆双门版的Nissan NISMO GT-R LM，

在英国注册并通过了赛事认证，
这才成功将这辆车送上了勒芒的起跑线。

由此可见，这辆GT-R的研发主管渡边衡三

让其参加勒芒24小时耐力赛的意愿是何等强烈！

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
Ah, Car No. 1, this one brings back memories.

It’s the Pennzoil NISMO GT-R that competed
in the 1999 All Japan GT Championship.
Érik Comas drove the No. 23 Pennzoil GT-R to victory...

...earning the No. 1 designation for the following season.
Oh, and here’s a bit of trivia,
if you’re interested.

Many Nissan GT race cars carry the number 23, right?

That number comes from the Japanese pronunciation of 2-3 (ni-san).
It’s a long-standing tradition for Nissan race cars to wear
this number, seen well before 1999.
detailRows.zh:
哎，这不是冠军车吗？我知道这辆车！

这是参加过1999年全日本GT锦标赛的Pennzoil Nismo GT-R！
驾驶23号Pennzoil的埃里克·科马斯拿到了最后比赛的胜利，

艰辛地为这辆车守住了宝贵的冠军。
对了，关于这辆车还有一件轶闻，
有兴趣听听吗？

有很多Nissan的超级跑车都是23号对不对？
但第一辆使用23作为号码的……
没错，就是1998年的这辆Pennzoil！

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
Ah, so this is the GR Supra that entered the Nürburgring
24 Hour race just a month after it went on sale...

Did you know the driver for the first stint of the final was none
other than Toyota President, Akio 'Morizo' Toyoda?

Basically, the man who brought the GR Supra to life!
The car was basically the retail model, with the bare
minimum safety equipment needed to race.
Still, it managed to claim 41st place overall,
and was third in its class.
It totally showed how good a performer
the GR Supra really is.+
detailRows.zh:
所以这就是刚刚上市一个月就去参加了纽博格林24小时耐力赛
的GR Supra……

你知道在决赛中驾驶第一赛段的车手不是别人，
正是Toyota的总裁丰田章男吗？

事实上，就是他让这辆GR Supra复活的！
这辆参赛的Supra基本上就是一台零售车型，
只配备了比赛所需的最低限度安全设备，
但它还是获得了第41名的总成绩，并在同级车中排名第3。
这样的成绩完全显示出了GR Supra的卓越性能。

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
Japan's GT Championship in the late 1990s was a three-way battle
between the Nissan Skyline, Honda NSX and the Toyota Supra.
The battles amongst Japan's three major car manufacturers
was one for the ages!

By the final round, which was run in the pouring rain,
all three teams were still in contention for the title.
Even after the checkered flag was waved, it wasn't
certain who had won the series.
That's because two teams were tied for the top spot, and
their 2nd-place finishes were also even.

This meant the tiebreaker came down to the number of 3rd-place
finishes they had recorded over the season...
In the end, the Tom's Supra Number 36 came out
on top in the historic 1997 season.
detailRows.zh:
二十世纪九十年代末，日本房车锦标赛呈现的是三足鼎立
的态势：日产天际线、本田NSX和丰田Supra。
这辆Tom's Supra在1997年夺冠的那一役，
堪称一场真正的悬念大戏！

战至大雨滂沱的最后一轮比赛中，
竟仍有4支车队保有夺冠可能！
甚至在方格旗落下之后，冠军归属仍然扑朔迷离。
因为有两支车队积分持平、并列第一，就连他们在赛季中获得亚军
的次数也完全相同。

最后为了决定胜负，竟要追溯这两支车队
在整个赛季中获得季军的次数！
而这辆36号Tom's Supra正是从那场扣人心弦的
1997年冠军决战中脱颖而出的最终王者！

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
The Yaris WRC is a car that totally dominated
the World Rally Championships.

It claimed the Manufacturers' title in 2018...

and in 2019 it took the Drivers' title as well,
with a record six wins.

Sure enough, the GR Yaris was developed specifically
with the goal of total domination of the WRC in mind.
Initially, a competition car was developed for the WRC,
with a commercial car planned for homologation.
In any case, for a real motorsports fan, there aren't
many cars on the road that are quite this exciting!
detailRows.zh:
Yaris WRC是一款彻底统治了世界拉力锦标赛的赛车。

它在2018年获得了制造商冠军，

在2019年则取得创纪录的6场胜利，摘下车手冠军的桂冠。

我们可以确定的是，这辆GR Yaris是专为统治世界拉力
锦标赛而研发的！
他们先是制造了一台能在锦标赛上夺冠的比赛机器，
然后再规划量产车型，接受赛事认证。
不管怎么说，对于一个真正的赛车迷来说，这是少数几
辆能令人兴奋到不能自己的公路车！

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
The fifth-generation Skyline GT-R went by the codename R34.
The man responsible for its development was
Kozo Watanabe.

A graduate of Tokyo University, Watanabe earned
a degree in automotive engineering.
The R34 was his follow-up to the R33.
A longtime admirer of race car development...

Watanabe wanted to go to Britain to develop Formula 1 cars.

But fate ialised and he began working for Nissan,
which was then racing the R380 and the R381.
When Watanabe was tasked with developing the R33
Skyline GT-R...

...he swore he'd build a car that would exceed the speed
of the R32.

It turned out, he kept his word. On a test run, the R33
set a lap time of 7:59 at the Nürburgring!
This time was 21 seconds faster than the fastest lap
set by the R32.

The R33 then led to the R34, śhich carried on the
spirit of its predecessor.
detailRows.zh: 这辆R34是第五代的Skyline GT-R。 这辆车的设计者是渡边衡三。 他毕业于东大汽车工程系。 R34是R33的后继车型。 渡边早对赛车开发早就心痒不已…… 他本想前往英国去设计F1赛车。 由于这个目标未能实现，他进入了 当时正在使用R380和R381竞赛的日产工作。 当渡边接到了设计Skyline GT-R R33的任务时…… 他曾发誓要造一辆比R32更快的车。 您猜怎么着？在试跑时，R33在纽博格林赛道上 跑出了7:59的单圈时间！ 比R32的记录快了21秒。 当然了，它的后继者R34身上也继承了这种精神。

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
The Pikes Peak Hill Climb is a race held in
Colorado, USA.

It is a race in which drivers compete for the fastest time
up a long and treacherous mountain road.
The course measures 20km, climbing 1440m to the finish
at 4302m—higher than Mount Fuji in Japan!
This Audi S1 shattered records with its victory at
the storied event.
Based on a WRC machine, it featured large wings at the
front and rear, ensuring maximum downforce.
But who was the driver behind the wheel on that winding
“Race to the Clouds?"

Why, it was none other than WRC champion
Walter Röhrl!
detailRows.zh:
派克峰爬坡赛是在美国科罗拉多州举办的比赛。

这是一场车手们需要在漫长而险峻的山路上
达成最快时间记录的赛事。
这条赛道长达20km，海拔始于1440m，终于4302m——比日本的富士山还要高！
这辆奥迪S1以破纪录的成绩在这场著名赛事中获得了胜利。
基于一辆世界拉力锦标赛赛车，这辆车前后
都配备了巨大的定风翼，以获得最大的下压力。
那么驾驶这辆车，沿着蜿蜒的山路，
勇敢地“冲上云霄”的人是谁呢？

这个人正是世界拉力锦标赛的冠军沃尔特·罗尔！

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
Audi made its Le Mans debut in 1999.
Up to 2016, it competed in the LMP1 class,
where it performed exceedingly well.

In fact, it had podium finishes for eighteen
consecutive years!
But in its final race, Audi's R18 was stuck in 4th place
for most of the race.
People feared that Audi would finish out of the top three,
breaking its long streak of podium finishes

But with ten minutes to go, the race leader, Toyota,
experienced a mechanical problem.
This allowed the R18 to move into 3rd place and establish
its record of 18 consecutive podium finishes!

Ultimately, the streak came to an end when Audi announced
its withdrawal from Le Mans the following year.
detailRows.zh:
Audi在1999年首次亮相勒芒。
一直到2016年，Audi在LMP1级别的比赛中表现得非常出色。

事实上，Audi已经连续18年登上领奖台了！
但就在去年，R18在比赛终段时仍然是第四名。
大家都觉得Audi今年登台无望了。

然而，距离比赛结束还有10分钟时，领头的丰田出现了机械故障！
这让R18挤进了第三位，站上了领奖台，
并达成了连续18年登上领奖台的记录。

最终，由于Audi宣布从那年的勒芒赛事中退出，
他们的连胜纪录也就此终结。

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
“Rotary engines are notorious for their poor fuel economy,
making them ill-suited for endurance races.”

At least, this is what people in the racing world had believed.

But the engineers at Mazda took a different view.
So, they got together and created the R26B engine,
which emphasized horsepower over torque.

This decision effectively made it a durable
and fuel-efficient engine.
The 4-rotor engine found a home in the now-legendary 787B.

It was the first Japanese car to claim the overall title
at Le Mans in 1991.
Jonny Herbert, the driver who drove
the final three stints...

...was so dehydrated after the race that he was unable
to make the podium.
As for the engine, when Mazda's engineers took it apart, they
apparently saw that it could have gone another 500 km!
detailRows.zh:
转子引擎的油耗高得吓人，所以不适合耐力赛。”

赛车界曾是这样看待转子引擎的。

但是马自达的工程师们却不这么认为！
他们努力的结晶便是将重点放在马力上，
而不是扭矩上的R26B引擎。

这项明智的决定使这台引擎不仅可靠，而且省油。
这台传奇的发动机就装在了这台787B上。

于1991年，它成为了第一台在勒芒夺冠的日本车。
不幸的是，约翰尼·赫伯特在开完最后三段后……

由于严重脱水，无法站上领奖台。
赛后，当马自达的工程师将引擎拆开时，
他们发现这台引擎还能再跑500km！

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
Porsche has contributed greatly to motorsport over the
years, as a manufacturer and seller to privateers.
Even in the world's fastest racing category, which is
the sports prototype class...

It entered races as a factory team while also
selling its race cars to privateers.
Indeed, Porsche's widespread support of race
culture is an integral part of its legacy.

This is evidenced by the history of the 956 and 962,
two Group C models from the early 1980s.
Although the 962’s factory team withdrew from competition
in 1988...

...the cars continued racing for private teams.
It's said that Porsche manufactured 150 examples
of the 956 and 962 for competition.*
detailRows.zh:
多年来，Porsche作为制造商和私人销售商，
对汽车运动做出了巨大贡献。
即使在参与世界上最快的赛事，运动原型赛事的同时……

他们在把赛车卖给私人的同时，还在运营着一支工厂队伍。
事实上，保时捷对赛车文化的广泛支持已经成了其遗产的一部。

这一点可以从956和962这两款
80年代初的C组别车型的历史中看出来。
虽然962的工厂队伍在1988年退出了竞技舞台……

私人车队却仍然在使用那些车竞赛。
据说，在Porsche的赛车生涯期间，
他们一共生产了150辆956和962。

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
This second-generation NSX-GT race car appeared in 2014.

Does that sound odd to you?
It should, because the second-generation NSX production
car was released two years later in 2016.
There's simple explanation to this.

The race NSX wasn't based on the production NSX, but on
the NSX Concept...
...which was unveiled ahead of the production version
in 2014.

However, it was this concept car that took
the GT name.
In mid-2016, the second-generation NSX production car
was officially released.

Because of this, the competition car was also called
the NSX-GT.
This car came in 3rd place in Round Five of the
Super GT in Japan.
detailRows.zh:
这台第二代NSX-GT于2014年首次亮相。

听起来不觉得有些奇怪吗？
毕竟，它的基本车型，第二代NSX，在2016年才开始销售。
实际上，这辆车既是NSX，也不是NSX。

这是因为，它的原型车是一辆叫做NSX Concept的车……
那辆车是在本田于2014年，在其生产型出现前公布的。

然而，继承GT名号的依然是一辆赛车！
2016年中，第二代NSX正式发布。

因此，这款赛车也被称为NSX-GT。
作为概念时代的最后一款特规车型，
这款车在日本Super GT第五轮比赛中获得了第三名。

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
This Lexus RC F competes in Japan's top racing category,
Super GT.
It made it debut in...2014, I think.

This one is the 2016 spec. I have fond memories of seeing
it in action!
It lost the first four races to the Nissan GT-R, but then
made a stunning comeback after changing the engine!
By the end of the season, it had managed to claw its way up
to fifth place in the rankings.
As it happens, that season's championship was won by another
RC F, number 39!
detailRows.zh:
这辆Lexus RC F参加了日本的顶级赛事Super GT。
这款车应该是在……2014年首次亮相的。

这辆车是2016年的型号。它在赛场上驰骋的样子仍能令我心潮澎湃！
这辆车在前四场比赛中输给了Nissan GT-R，
但在更换引擎之后，它上演了一场惊人的反击战！
在赛季结束时，它已经成功地爬到了第五的位置。
碰巧的是，该赛季的冠军是由另一辆车号为39的RC F赢得的！

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
When it comes to R35 GT-R race cars, the Nissan MOTUL
AUTECH GT-R is perhaps the best of them all!
It won two consecutive Super GT championships in the GT500
class, starting in 2014.
It also began the 2016 season in unbelievable
form.

It took the first two races, at Okayama and the
Fuji International Speedway, respectively.

These victories made it the odds-on favorite to win ithird series champion in a row.
The car was atop the rankings going into the final race...

However, because of the ballast it was required to carry,
it could only manage a 7th-place finish in the race.
This meant that it ended the season in
3rd place for the series.

The MOTUL Autech team did give it all it had,
but just came up a little short.
The drivers were Tsugio Matsuda and Ronnie �uintarelli.

They showed amazing speed all season long, and today,
they're still at it and still winning races!
detailRows.zh:
说起R35 GT-R赛车的话，
日产MOTUL AUTECH GT-R绝对是其中的王者。
从2014年开始，这辆车已经在GT500级别的
Super GT锦标赛中连续获胜了两次。
它在2016赛季中的开局也是势不可挡……

在冈山的第一场和富士赛道的第二场中接连获胜！

在当时看来，这辆车拿下第三个锦标赛冠军已经是板上钉钉的事了。
在赛事进行到最后一场时，它在排名中依然名列前茅……

但是沉重的压舱物使它在这场比赛中惜败，只获得了第七名。
这意味着，这辆车在这个季度中仅以第三名完赛。

他们没能上演帽子戏法，真是太可惜了！
不过，松田次生和罗尼·昆塔雷利的老司机团队无疑是非常快的！

他们俩现在�8�已步入四十，但却依然没有一丝慢下来的迹象！ ,

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
I don't care what anyone else says, I think this is the
world's most beautiful race car!
I just can't get enough of that bodywork, especially the
wheelhouses and fenders.

It's not just a nice looking car, though.
It won the 24 Hours of Daytona on its first try in 1967.

In fact, the 330 P4 occupied
all the podium positions.
Seeing three 330 P4s cross the finish line together...
well, that was enough to bring a tear to my eye.
The 330 P4 won the 1000 Kilometers
of Monza that same year as well!

Formula 1 drivers Lorenzo Bandini and Mike Parkes
piloted the Ferrari in that race.
The car was then entered in the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

But defending champion Ford still proved dominant,
and the 330 P4 came in 2nd place.
The Ford GT40 that won at Le Mans �hat year is also
a beautiful car.

But for me, nothing comes close to the 330 P4.
Viva Ferrari!*
detailRows.zh:
我不管其他人怎么看，反正我就觉得
这辆车就是世界上最好看的赛车！
这些曲线我不管看多少遍都看不腻。
瞧瞧这轮拱罩和挡泥板！

而且这辆车不仅是好看！
它在1967年亮相时就赢得了戴通纳24小时耐力赛！

实际上，为了展现硬实力，这款车直接霸占了整座领奖台！
想象一下三辆330 P4一同跨过终点线的景象……
简直要让我感动到哭了！
就在同一年，330 P4还赢得了蒙扎1000km的冠军！

一级方程式车手洛伦佐·班迪尼和迈克·帕克斯
都曾代表法拉利参赛。
330 P4还参加过勒芒耐力赛……

但是福特的数量优势实在太大，所以330 P4只得了第二名。
那辆在勒芒夺冠的福特GT40�$是一辆优美的车子……

但对我而言，330 P4才是我心中永远的神。
法拉利万岁！

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
This is the road version of the Mark I that raced at Le Mans
in 1966.

The Ford GT40 Mk I was introduced in 1964.

It was developed specifically to beat Ferrari at Le Mans,
where the Italian company had dominated.
Three Mk Is participated in the 1964 Le Mans race, but they all
retired without making it to the finish line.

In 1965, Ford put Carroll Shelby in charge of everything
from development to strategy, with the same result...
Then, Shelby completely overhauled the chassis and engine,
creating the Mk II in 1966.

Eight Mk IIs and five Mk Is waged war at Le Mans
that year.
It was an overwhelming show of strength in numbers!

This determination brought home the Le Mans title for Ford,
finally putting an end to Ferrari's run.
detailRows.zh:
这辆车是参加了1966年勒芒耐力赛的Mark 1的公路版。

福特GT40 Mark 1公布于1964年。

这辆车是专门为了超越当时称霸勒芒的法拉利而开发的。
1964年，有三辆Mark 1参加了勒芒耐力赛，但全部中途退赛了。

1965年，福特任命卡罗尔·谢尔比负责从开发到战略的一切工作，
但比赛结果还是一样……
1966年，对底盘和发动机进行了完全改造的Mark II开发完成。

一共八辆Mark II和五辆Mark I参加了当年的勒芒耐力赛。
那可是压倒性的数量优势！

因此，福特也毫无意外地在那年首次夺得了勒芒耐力赛冠军宝座！

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
The 1988 24 Hours of Le Mans was one for the history books.

Jaguar fans from the UK were showed up in force, with Union Jack
flags waving all around the track.

It was a sight I'll never forget.
This is the car that brought Jaguar the victory that day.
It finally got the better of the Porsches that had
dominated Le Mans for so long.

It certainly put a smile on the legions of British fans.
But they first had to endure a stressful race.
It wasn't until the end that Jaguar was able to put away
the Porsche that was applying pressure all race.

Just thinking of it now sends a chill down my spine.
detailRows.zh:
1988年的勒芒24小时耐力赛相当不平凡。

那年，大批来自英国的Jaguar车迷涌入赛场，
赛道上的米字旗四处可见。

我永远也忘不了那番景象！
而那天为Jaguar赢得胜利的，正是这辆车……
他们在那天终于打败了称霸勒芒已久的Porsche。

这也让英国车迷充满了自豪和喜悦。
萨森赛车场那时热闹非凡！
那场比赛非常激烈，获胜的Jaguar到最后
都一直面临着身后Porsche的压力！

光是想想那场景就让我背脊发凉！

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
The Stratos, designed by Marcello Gandini...

...was created to accomplish just one goal.
And what was that, you ask? To win rally races.

Legend has it that the car was a handful to drive
owing to its short wheelbase.
In fact, only a handful of drivers could ever really
master it.
One of them was the legendary rally driver
Sandro Munari.

He controlled the Stratos like it was a part of his body.
His view on the matter was:

"If you find driving this car difficult, then your skills
just aren't good enough."
detailRows.zh:
Stratos的设计者是马塞罗·甘迪尼……

他设计这辆车的目的只有一个。
那个目的是？在拉力赛中获胜。

传说这辆车非常难驾驭……
实际上，真正驾驭了这辆车的人也就那么几名车手。
传奇拉力车手桑德罗·穆纳利便是这些车手之一。

对他来说，操纵Stratos就像是操纵玩具车那样易如反掌！
他对此的看法是：

“如果您觉得这车难开，那只能说明你还欠火候！”i

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
This is a McLaren F1 that has seen some track action.
Many consider this car to be the perfect sport car.
This race spec version first made an appearance in 1994.

And in 1995, it made its Le Mans debut,
going on to grab the overall title!
Incidentally, the victorious McLaren F1 GTR was once driven
by former Formula 1 driver JJ Lehto...

...and Japanese driver Masanori Sekiya.
It was the first time that a Japanese driver had won at
Le Mans.

He was also the fastest driver on the team, even when rain
fell during the night at the Circuit de la Sarthe.
detailRows.zh:
一辆久经战阵的McLaren F1！这可能是
有史以来最接近“完美”的车子了……
这辆车的赛车版本在1994年首次出现……

并于1995年首次在勒芒参赛，然后赢得了比赛！
顺便一说，那辆获胜的McLaren F1 GTR是由前F1车手JJ尼赫托和……

日本车手关谷正德驾驶的。
那是日本车手首次在勒芒夺冠！

而且，在那个萨森赛车场的雨夜里，他是车队里最快的车手！

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
This is a race car version of Mercedes-Benz's luxury sedan,
the 300 SEL.

The 300 SEL caught the eye of Mercedes-Benz tuner, AMG...
Who tweaked it to racing spec by increasing the engine
displacement to 6.8L.
It made its race debut in July 1971...

...in a European Touring Car Championship race at Spa-
Francorchamps in Belgium.
It won its class there, and finished in a very impressive
2nd place overall.

Pretty amazing for a large, 4-door sedan!
This result put AMG on the map, and gave it worldwide
prominence.
AMG would go on to play a key role in Mercedes-Benz's
race teams at the DTM and elsewhere.
detailRows.zh:
这是梅赛德斯-奔驰的豪华轿车300 SEL的赛车版本。

梅赛德斯-奔驰的改装商AMG慧眼发掘了300 SEL。
AMG将其调整为赛车规格，引擎排量增加到了6.8升。
它于1971年7月首次在比赛中亮相……

在比利时斯帕弗朗科尔尚赛道举行的欧洲房车锦标赛中，
它不仅赢得了本级别的比赛，并获得了总成绩第二名，
令人印象深刻。

对于一辆大型四门轿车来说，这是很了不起的成就。
这一成就也使AMG声名鹊起，并在全世界范围内为人所知。
在那之后，他们在梅赛德斯-奔驰旗下的各支赛车队伍中、
在包括德国房车大师赛的各项赛事中发挥了关键作用。

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
Renault is a company that loves to compete.

It has been involved in many forms of motorsport,
including Formula 1.
It was also formidable in the rallying world, alongside
cars such as the Gordini and the Alpine from the 70s.

The 1980s, though, the company was all about this R5 Turbo.
One of its early drivers, Jean Ragnotti, mentioned that the
car suffered from terrible handling.
He also confessed that misjudgments on narrow roads would
always cause the rear of the car to hit objects.

This is because the rear of the R5 Turbo was wider than the
front.
It's amusing to hear seasoned pros complain about aspects
of a car they don't like.
detailRows.zh:
Renault是一家热爱竞技的公司。

他们会参与各项赛车运动，F1自然也在其列。
他们的拉力赛血统包括Gordini，以及1970年代的Alpine。

而到了20世纪80年代，主角就成了R5 Turbo。
作为早期驾驶者之一的让·拉格诺蒂提到过，车辆原本的
操控性非常糟糕。
他还坦言，在狭窄的道路上，车尾常常会因为车手的错
误判断而导致碰撞。

这是因为R5 Turbo的车尾比车头宽。
听到经验丰富的专业人员也会遇到这类问题，真是很有
意思！

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
I was pretty surprised when I heard about the car Nissan
were entering into Le Mans in 2015!

This GT-R LM NISMO.
The designer, Ben Bowlby, opted for an FF layout, and worked
hard on the aerodynamics.
Unfortunately, however, these innovations didn't pay off.

In qualifying, the car was 20 seconds slower than its
fastest rival.
Worse still, in the race itself, two of three cars had to
retire, so only one was able to reach the finish line.

However, even this finisher didn't complete enough laps,
and was officially judged not to have finished!
detailRows.zh:
听说Nissan要在2015年参加勒芒比赛时，我非常惊讶！

在这辆GT-R LM NISMO上，
设计师本·鲍尔比选择了前置前驱布局，并在空气动力学
方面下了很大功夫。
不幸的是，这些创新并没有得到回报。

在排位赛中，该车比第一名慢了足有20秒。
雪上加霜的是，参加正赛的三辆车中有两辆不得不退赛，
这意味着只有一辆车最终到达了终点。

而且，就连这位通过终点线的车手也因为没有完成足够
的圈数而被判定为未完成比赛！

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
What happened in June 1972 was pretty unusual by anyone's
standards.

It was the second race of the popular Fuji Grand Champion
Series, which took place on the Fuji International Speedway.
And, despite being up against Gr.6 and Gr.7 race cars...

...a lower-level machine based on a production model managed
to emerge victorious!
The car was a Fairlady 240ZG, and its driver
was Japan's Haruhito Yanagida.
The race took place in heavy rain, and the 240ZG performed
exceptionally against its higher-ranked rivals.

And yes indeed, it beat all of the other entries.
The event became known in Japan as the "Z in the Rain" race, and
remains one of the most legendary moments in motorsports.
detailRows.zh:
在任何人看来，1972年6月发生的事情都是非比寻常的
奇迹。

当时，人气十足的富士大冠军赛的第二场比赛正在富士
高速赛道上如火如荼地举行。
面对组别6和组别7类别的对手……

一辆基于零售车型改装的低级别汽车却杀出重围、斩获
了胜利！
这辆车是一辆Fairlady 240ZG，车手是日本的柳田春人。
在大雨滂沱的赛场上，240ZG在与高等级对手的较量中
表现得异常出色……

最终以第一名的成绩冲过终点线！
这场比赛在日本被称为“雨中的Z”，是赛车运动中最具
传奇色彩的时刻之一。

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
The Tour de Corse?

Well, it's a famous rally event that takes place on the
French island of Corsica.
The 1964 Tour de Corse was a particular classic.

Only eight cars out of 79 managed to complete the race!
What's more, Renault's R8 Gordini claimed first, third,
fourth and fifth place!

It was quite the remarkable achievement.
Gordini was an engine manufacturer, originally, established
by the Italian driver and engineer Amedeo Gordini.

The R8 Gordini came about through a collaboration with
Renault.
detailRows.zh:
科西嘉岛拉力赛？

嗯，这是一项著名的拉力赛事，在法国的科西嘉岛上
举行。
1964年的科西嘉岛拉力赛特别经典。

79辆参赛汽车中只有8辆成功完成了比赛！
而Renault的R8 Gordini就囊括了第一、第三、第四和第五名！

这是相当了不起的成就。
Gordini是一家引擎制造商，由意大利车手和工程师阿
梅戴·戈蒂尼一手创办。

R8 Gordini就是其与Renault合作的产物。;

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
Are you familiar with the WRC?

It stands for "World Rally Championship," and features rally
races that take place on a variety of road surfaces.

It was formed in 1973 when rally championships held in
various countries were unified.
The new international race series was christened the
World Rally Championship, and the rest is history.

This is the Alpine A110, the winner of the very first
WRC series.
Its compact body came with an 1800cc engine mounted
at the rear, ensuring excellent traction.

The A110 won the first race of the 1973 season, held in
Monte Carlo.

In fact, Alpine A110s took all three podium places,
defeating entries form Porsche and Lancia.
The car now occupies a page in the history books as the car
that won the first WRC race and series.]
detailRows.zh:
你对世界拉力锦标赛熟悉吗？

在公共道路上举行拉力
赛是其独有的特色。

它设立于1973年，将在不同国家举行的拉力锦标赛整合
到了一起。
这就是世界拉力锦标赛的开端，并延续至今。

这一辆阿尔派A110正是第一届世界拉力锦标赛的冠军。
它的车身紧凑，后置发动机确保
后轮产生足够的牵引力。

它在蒙特卡洛赢下了1973年赛季的第一场比赛。

事实上，阿尔派A110一路上击败了保时捷和蓝旗亚，
包揽了领奖台！
A110就此踏上了赢得世界拉力锦标赛首季比赛的道路，并通过比
赛造成巨大的轰动效应！

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
For drift fans, this car is instantly recognizeable as Dai's car.

Daijiro Yoshihara is a Japanese race driver who
specializes in drifting.
He was the series champion of the 2011 Formula DRIFT
Championship Series.
For the 2018 season, his car was this one,
based on the Subaru BRZ.
It packed a turbocharged 7.8-liter V-8 under the hood.

The engine produced a massive 1000ps of power!
Unfortunately, it didn't carry him to the
championship that year.

Still, the BRZ was impressive nontheless.
detailRows.zh:
提到这辆车，人们就会联想起吉原大！

吉原大二郎是一位日本赛车手，专业从事漂移运动。
他是2011年漂移方程式锦标赛系列赛的冠军。
后来，他驾驶一辆基于Subaru BRZ的赛车继
续参加了2018年的系列赛。
在车辆的引擎盖下安装的是一台7.8L V8涡轮增压引擎。

能够产生1000ps的巨大动力！
虽然这台引擎并不足以让他赢得冠军，

但是，BRZ+V8仍然是一个令人振奋不已的组合！

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
The development of the Toyota 86 started at the Nürburgring
in 2011.
The first time the development drivers encountered the 86,
it was nothing special.

As such, one of them noted that 'we realised we had to
rebuild the car from scratch'.
The retail and race spec versions of the 86 were both
developed at the same time...

And the racing car was entered into races such as the
Nürburgring 24 Hours.
The experiences from those races were used to improve the
retail car—and that's the 86 you see before you.

In fact, the developers ended up referring to this one as
the 'ultimate 86'!
detailRows.zh:
Toyota86的开发始于2011年的纽博格林赛道。
开发测试车手与86的第一次邂逅，并没有擦出火花。

其中一位车手指出，“我们意识到我们必须从头开始重新
打造这辆车”。
86的零售和比赛规格版本的开发是同期进行的……

赛车版被用于参加纽博格林24小时耐力赛等比赛。
通过比赛积累的经验又被用来改进零售版——也就是你
面前的这台86。

事实上，开发人员最终将这款车称为“终极86”！

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
Toyota has been entering hybrid racing cars into Le Mans
since 2012...

...with its first victory coming in 2018.
While its cars displayed impressive performance year after year,
they couldn't quite translate those speeds into victories.
There were some close calls, though. In 2016, one of its cars stopped
at the front of the pack, with just one lap to go!

The victorious Porsche team couldn't believe its luck.
In any case, this just made Toyota’s 2018 victory sweeter.
I remember it clearly—I was so happy!

What's more, Toyota would go on to win five in a row,
its most recent win being in 2022!
detailRows.zh:
自2012年以来，丰田一直致力于将混合动力赛车投入
到勒芒的比赛当中……

他们的首个胜利直到2018年才姗姗来迟。
在此之前，这些赛车每每都展现出令人惊叹的速度，
但却始终无法将这种速度转化为胜利。
不过，期间也有过几次胜利触手可及的时刻——2016年，
领跑车阵的丰田却在离终点只剩下一圈时抛锚了！

就连捡漏的保时捷车队都不敢相信自己的好运气。
不过，这些挫败只是让2018年的胜利变得更加甘美。
我清楚记得当时的感受——我当时高兴坏了！

更激动人心的是，丰田在之后的五年里连战连捷，
其中也包括2022年新鲜出炉的一胜！

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
Here's a legendary car from the early days of Japanese
motorsports.

I've heard all about how it used to race around the newly
built Suzuka Circuit.
If you were to ask me which race by this car nicknamed
"Yota-Hachi" was the finest...

...I would have to say that it was the one at Funabashi
Circuit in July 1965.

The event was the All-Japan Club Championship, and the
driver was Tojiro Ukiya.
Ukiya broke his fender in a collision early in the race,
dropping him to 16th place.

After that incident, however, he staged a stunning comeback,
moving up through the field to win the race!
There was something almost divine about the performance he
displayed that day.
detailRows.zh:
这是一辆来自日本赛车运动早期的传奇汽车。

我听说过它是如何在新建成的铃鹿赛道上飞驰的！
如果你要问我“丰田八”有史以来最精彩的比赛是哪一场……

那一定是1965年7月在船桥赛道举行的那场比赛。

这是全日本俱乐部锦标赛的一站，车手是浮谷东次郎。
在比赛前期的一次碰撞中，浮谷撞坏了他的挡泥板。车
辆修复后，他的位置跌到了第16位。

然而，在那之后他上演了一场惊人的反击战，在一路高
歌猛进，最终取得了第一名的好成绩
他在那天表现出的速度简直如有神助！

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
This is no ordinary pickup truck. It's a super truck,
capable of dominating on dirt tracks and oval circuits.
Any mention of a Tundra makes me think of the Baja 1000
desert race.

It's an all-night race that takes place on a 1,600 km
course in the Mexican desert.
It's a challenging race, with more than half the cars entered
never seeing the finish line.

Toyota took on the Baja with this Tundra tuned by TRD,
and the truck won in its class.
And, did you known that the Tundra TRD also
raced on oval race tracks?

In 2019, it entered a survival event in Daytona, winning a
race in which only nine out of 32 cars finished.
detailRows.zh:
这不是一辆普通的皮卡车。这是一辆真正的超级卡车，
在泥地赛道和椭圆赛道上都占据着统治性的地位！
一提到坦途，我就会想到巴哈1000沙漠越野赛。

这场在墨西哥沙漠举办，赛程长达1600km的比赛
全部在夜晚举行。
这是一项艰苦卓绝的赛事，每次都有半数以上的参赛车
辆会因为各种原因退赛。

Toyota公司带着这辆由丰田赛车开发中心改装过的坦途参加了比赛，
并在本级别中揽获冠军。
此外，你知道坦途丰田赛车开发中心也曾在椭圆赛道上比试过吗？

2019年，它参加了在戴通纳举行的生存赛，在一场32辆
汽车中只有9辆完赛的比赛中取得最终的胜利。

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
Do you know when Aston Martin started participating in
international races?

It was way back in the 1920s!

They also competed at Le Mans until the 1950s, but the marque
then took a long break from motorsports after that.
In fact, they were absent from the racing scene for 30 years,
until it returned in 2005.

It was a triumphant return as well, with Aston Martin
claiming victory at Sebring.
The winning car that day was a DBR9 GT1. Beautiful, isn't it?
It would prove to be the start of a nice run for
the DBR9.

In 2007, it was the first Aston Martin to finish in the top five
at Le Mans in 48 years. It also won the GT1 class.
Six Aston Martins entered Le Mans that year.

All six cars finished the race, showing that they had
reliability as well as speed.
It was defini�ely good to have Aston Martin's cars back in
racing and to see them perform so well!

At the 2008 Le Mans race, a DBR9 was entered wearing
the legendary Gulf Oil livery.

It beat the Chevrolet Corvette to claim the GT1 class
for the second straight year.
detailRows.zh:
你知道阿斯顿马丁是从什么时候开始参加国际比赛的吗？

那要追溯到20世纪20年代！

而在勒芒，他们的比赛历史一直持续到了20世纪50年代。
在那之后，他们做出了长期诀别赛车运动的决定。
当他们在2005年重返赛车运动时，已经是阔别赛场的
30年后了。

阿斯顿马丁在他们回归的第一场比赛中就在赛百灵赛
道获得了胜利，为这次回归奏响了凯旋之歌！
当天获胜的赛车是一辆DBR9 GT1。它很美吧？
这场比赛是DBR9写下壮丽篇章的开端。

2007年，它成为48年来第一辆在勒芒比赛中跻身前五的
阿斯顿马丁！它还赢得了GT1级别的冠军。
那年共有六辆阿斯顿马丁参加了勒芒比赛。

所有车辆都完成了比赛，为其可靠性和�;�度做出证明。
也因此，阿斯顿马丁迅速找回他们对赛车的热情就不奇怪了！

在2008年的勒芒比赛中，一辆DBR9以传奇的海湾石油
涂装参赛。

它击败了强劲对手雪佛兰科尔维特，连续第二年赢得
了GT1级别的冠军！

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
Among Alfa Romeo’s more recent contributions to motorsports
was this car, which turned many heads in its day.
The street-legal 155 was styled by the Italian design house
I.DE.A Institute in 1992.

And a year later, in 1993, the race-ready 155 2.5 V6 TI
was born.

The improvements made to the car
were nothing short of amazing.
Consider this: The car took 12 wins in the DTM series.

This was an incredible feat indeed.
Behind its wheel were former F1 drivers Nicola Larini
and Alessandro Nannini.

In the series, Larini took 10 checkered flags,
while Nannini claimed two.
Nannini was involved in a terrible helicopter accident in
1990, where his arm was severed and needed to be reattached.

To facilitate his return to racing, the 155
was specially modified.

And, he was still able to win two races!

It really said something about the skill and
competitiveness of a former F1 driver.
detailRows.zh:
在阿尔法罗密欧近来对赛车运动的贡献中，
这辆车无疑让所有人眼前一亮。
1992年，意大利设计事务所I.DE.A Institute
设计了街道版155跑车。

一年后，即1993年，比赛规格的155 2.5 V6 TI
诞生了。

基于街道版的改装将车型打磨得至臻完美！
事实上，这款赛车总计获得了12场德国房车大师赛冠军，

真是了不起的成就！
实现这一壮举的功勋车手是前F1车手尼古拉·拉里尼和
亚历山德罗·纳尼尼。

尼古拉取得了10场胜利，而亚历山德罗则贡献了另两个
冠军领奖台。
在1990年，亚历山德罗不幸遭遇一场可怕的直升机事故，
他的手臂被切断，不得不重新接上。

为了方便他重返赛场，155赛车专门为其进行了特殊改装。

由此看�，1993年的那两场胜利确实意义非凡！

不仅证明了155的强大，更展现了这位前F1车手的傲人实力。

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
Trust me, you’re not likely to forget a car like this.

This is the Chaparral 2J, which was built for
the 1970 Can-Am Series.
What makes it original is found at the rear of the car.

There, you'll find two fans powered by a 274cc engine.

These fans suck the car to the ground
to generate downforce.

They expel the air between the underbody and the road,
creating a suction effect.

For this reason, the 2J is sometimes referred to as
the "fan car.".
Thanks to this ingenious piece of engineering, the car can
take corners at speeds that defy all logic.

The Chaparral 2J set incredible lap times
in all four of the races it entered.

In fact, it even took pole position.
Its Achilles Heel was reliability.

But before it could run a full race, the FIA
changed the rules on aerodynamics...

...deeming the fan system illegal.
One can only imagine what this car could have achieved,
had it been given time to develop.
detailRows.zh:
这是一台让人过目难忘的车！

这辆Chaparral 2J是专为1970年加拿大-美国挑战杯系列赛制造的。
在它的身后，你会发现……

两台通过274cc单缸发动机驱动的风扇。

这些风扇将空气从车身下方排出，以产生下压力……

这使它看起来好像直接吸在地面上一样。

也因此，它常被人称为“风扇车”。
它甚至能够以违反物理常识的高速过弯……

在它参加的所有四场比赛中，
Chaparral 2J都创下了令人难以置信的单圈记录！

确切地说，它包揽了所有四场比赛的杆位。
当然了，它的稳定性另当别论……

在创下纪录后，它未能获准参加后续的比赛。
因为国际汽联针对性地更改了关于空气动力学的规则……

直接将“风扇车”排除在比赛之外。
这样的遗憾也引来了人们的不断遐想。
如果在当时有机会继续改进这辆车，它可以取得什么样的成就！`

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
This is the Jaguar D-Type from 1954. It was introduced as
the evolutionary successor to the C-Type.

Like its predecessor, it was specifically built
to win at Le Mans.
Although it set a top speed record at the 1954 race,
it was forced to retire.

But in 1955, after being involved in a horrendous accident,
it took the overall win with Mike Hawthorn behind the wheel.
The car won again in 1956 and 1957, giving Jaguar an
incredible three wins in a row.

By the way, did you know that hydrodynamic principles
were applied to the D-Type’s curved body?
At the time, it signaled the start of adopting advanced
aerodynamic principles to increase performance.
detailRows.zh:
这是1954年出厂的捷豹D-Type。
作为C-Type的继任者，它得到了全面进化。

与它的前辈一样，D-Type是专门为在勒芒比赛中获胜而制造的。
尽管它在1954年的比赛中创造了速度纪录，但没能完成比
赛就退赛了。
在1955年，迈克·霍索恩驾驶D-Type在躲过一次可怕的碰撞事
故后，取得了最终胜利。

在56年和57年，D-Type连番卫冕，实现了惊人的勒芒三连冠。

值得一提的是，你知道D-Type的弧线车身设计考虑了流体力
学原理吗？
在当时，这标志着对抗空气阻力的军备竞赛正式开始！

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en: Want to know why Porsche is so popular among gearheads? One reason is that the company makes its cars available to the masses. This is true not only of their production cars, but also their top prototypes. Take the once-retired 908 and 917 models, for example. Porsche later sold them to private teams. And when these teams took to the track with these cars... ...Porsche offered them the same level of support of its own factory teams. After all, when a Porsche wins, whether for the factory or a private team… ...it’s still a win for Porsche. Beginning with John Wyer Automotive... ...the Porsche 917 was raced by several Austrian and American teams. And who can forget 917K’s appearance in the 1971 film "Le Mans," starring the legendary Steve McQueen!
detailRows.zh:
为什么车迷们都这么喜欢保时捷？

其中一个原因是，保时捷没有敝帚自珍，将赛车都留为己用。
这不仅仅指的是量产赛车，也包括他们的顶级原型车。

以退役的908和917赛车为例，
保时捷后来把它们出售给了私人车队。

而当买家将这些车重新带入比赛时……

保时捷为他们提供了与原厂车队同等的技术支持。

毕竟，当一辆退役的保时捷在私人车队中再次获胜时……

这仍然是属于保时捷的胜利，不是吗？
从约翰·怀尔汽车公司开始……

有多支奥地利和美国车队曾驾驶保时捷917参赛。
在1971年上映的电影《勒芒》中见识过史蒂夫·麦奎因的
精彩表现后，还有谁能忘记917K的风采呢？

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
Porsche is a mainstay of the WEC, which is short for the
World Endurance Championship.

Currently, Porsche's entry in this series is the 911 RSR.

The car competes in both the LMP1 and LM-GTE classes.
As you can imagine, the 911 is a force to be reckoned with
because of its speed and reliability.

While contesting for overall victories in the LMP1 class,
it also looked to grab the top spot in the GT class.
This particular 911 RSR competed in the WEC and IMSA
in 2017.

It received a bit of backlash from Porsche
enthusiasts, however.

That’s because its engine is mounted amidships,
and not at the rear.
Therefore, many hardcore enthusiasts cried foul,
saying that it wasn't a real 911.

Still, the new engine location did improve
the car’s stability at high speed.

And the resulting change in weight distribution is said to
have dramatically reduced tire friction.
Seen in this light, the alterations make sense.
Porsche is there to win, after all.]
detailRows.zh:
一贯以来，保时捷都是世界耐力锦标赛，即“世界耐力锦标赛”的冠军有
力争夺者之一。

其发布的911 RSR同时参加了

勒芒原型车1级和LM-GTE两个级别的比赛。
如您预想得到的，作为保时捷毋庸置疑的旗舰，

911在追求勒芒原型车1级级别的全面胜利的同时，也向GT级别的头名
发起了挑战。
这辆911 RSR在2017年参加了世界耐力锦标赛和国际汽车运动协会的一系列比赛，

但也受到了保时捷车迷群体的一些质疑。

这是因为它的引擎被安装在车体中部，而不是后部。
很多硬核车迷们会说，“真正的”911必须是后置引擎。

但不得不说，中置布局确实改善了赛车的高速稳定性……

而且，据说这样的重量分配调整极大地减少了轮胎摩损。
从这个角度来看，这些改变是可以理解的。毕竟，
保时捷就是为了赢得比赛而生的。

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
The V12 Vantage GT3 made its first appearance
in 2012, at the British GT Championships.
Now, how do you think it performed
on its home turf?

Well, over 67 races, across seven seasons,
it had a podium finish nearly every time!
And what’s more, in over 30% of its races,
it came in first place!

Needless to say, it will be remembered as a legendary
production racing car in the annals of GT3 history.
Indeed, up until 2019, when it passed the baton
to its V8-mounted successor...

This incredible car enjoyed a long career at the forefront
of GT racing.
detailRows.zh:
V12 Vantage GT3在2012年的
英国GT锦标赛上初露峥嵘。
你来猜猜它的主场表现如何？

在七个赛季的67场比赛中，它几乎每次都能登上领奖台。
更夸张的是，它在超过三成的比赛中
站上了最高领奖台！

毋庸置疑，这是一台
值得被铭记在GT3历史中的传奇赛车。
事实上，直到2019年，它才把接力棒
传给它的V8车型继任者……

这辆了不起的赛车将其漫长的职业生涯都献给了GT赛事
的最前线。

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
This Audi R8-based GT3 was unveiled at the
Geneva Motor Show in March 2015.

If you consider yourself an Audi fan, you should know
about this car's illustrious history.
Only two months after it was introduced, the R8 LMS competed
at the Nürburgring 24-hour race.
This was its first competition, and as you
probably guessed by now, it won the race.

It wasn't easy though because the BMW Z4 charged hard
from the start.
However, after 24 hours of racing, the R8 LMS won by the
amazingly slim margin of 40 seconds!

It just goes to show that races are not just won by pure
speed, but also by reliability.
detailRows.zh: 这台基于R8打造的GT3赛车在2015年3月的 日内瓦车展上首次亮相。 说实话，还有谁没听说过它的辉煌事迹吗？ 在亮相后仅两个月，它就参加了纽博格林24小时耐力赛。 我提醒一句，这可是它的第一场比赛！它的首秀就直奔 冠军而去！ 不用猜，奥迪R8 LMS最终成功地取得了令人印象深刻的首 场胜利…… 而第二名的BMW Z4落后它足足40秒之多！ 这样的胜利简直令人瞠目结舌！ 这也证明了一点——想要赢下比赛不仅仅要依靠性能， 也要靠稳定性和可靠性。

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
When designing a race car, the natural impulse
is to build something small and light.

But this M6 GT3 breaks the mold, with a total length that is
5cm longer than that of the production model.
The wheelbase has also been extended.

Many wondered if the extra length of the car would
diminish its handling ability.

That concern was wiped clean when racers first
drove the car.

They praised it for its precise balance and
smooth turning feel.
And their findings were soon backed up by results.

The M6 GT3 drove to a magnificent win on
the narrow Macao GP circuit in 2018.
At the wheel then was Japanese touring-car
ace Seiji Ara.

It was a truly incredible race to behold.*
detailRows.zh:
说到赛车设计，人们很自然地会想到小而轻的竞速机器。

但是这辆M6 GT3却反其道而行之——
它的车身长度比量产车型还要长出5cm！
它的轴距嘛，当然也很长！

这样的设计让人不由地担心起它的过弯能力来。

然而，开过它的车手却不是这么说的……

他们对车辆的精确操控和平顺过弯能力赞不绝口。
你还是不相信？

那我告诉你一个事实，日本房车赛传奇车手荒圣治驾驶着它
于2018年在狭窄的澳门大奖赛赛道上
取得了一场辉煌的胜利……

这是一场令人难以置信的比赛，精彩程度令人叹为观止！

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
One thing that racing enthusiasts love about BMW...
Is their long-standing commitment to developing
customer racing cars like this one here.

When a new production car is released, a race-ready
model can be expected to follow soon after.
This Z4 GT3 made its biggest impression...

At endurance races like the Nürburgring 24 Hours...

Where it was driven by BMW works drivers
Bruno Spengler and Timo Glock.
Part of what makes BMW so cool is that they can be
assertive without coming off as conceited.

They exude that sort of confidence that just lets
the facts speak for themselves.
detailRows.zh:
赛车迷对BMW最津津乐道的就是……
他们长期以来致力于开发客制赛车，就比如我们眼前的
这台。

每当BMW有新款量产车发布时，你可以期待赛事规格的
车型很快会接踵而至。
这辆Z4 GT3在纽博格林24小时耐力赛等多项耐力赛事中……

给人留下了深刻的印象……

在纽博格林，BMW派出的是冠军车手布鲁诺·斯宾格勒和
蒂姆·格洛克。
在比赛方面，BMW从来只用事实说话，

那自然流露的自信而不自负的气质显得尤为卓尔不群。

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
Wow, Ferrari builds really amazing race cars.
In fact, the company even has its own one-make series
called the "Ferrari Challenge."

It’s an upscale event that brings together gentlemen
drivers from all over the world.
But don’t get me wrong, these are genuine race machines.

A sibling of the 458 GT3 called the Ferrari 458 GTC
has competed in the GTE class at the WEC...

...and claimed an incredible victory in the GTE-Pro class
at the Le Mans 24 Hours in 2012.
An FIA-GT3-compliant model of the 458 GT3
even competed in the Blancpain GT Series.
detailRows.zh:
我跟你说，Ferrari造的赛车都很厉害。
他们甚至还有自家的单一车种系列赛，
名叫“Ferrari挑战赛”。

这项奢华的赛事吸引到了全世界的绅士车手齐聚一堂。
不过千万不要误会了，他们在比赛中驾驶的全都是纯正
赛车。

这辆Ferrari 458 GTC是458 GT3的姐妹车型，
曾经参加过世界耐力锦标赛GTE组别的赛事……

还在2012年的勒芒24小时耐力赛的
GTE-Pro组别中拿下了异常精彩的一胜。
另外还有一款符合FIA-GT3规格的458 GT3车型
甚至参加了Blancpain GT系列赛。<

detailRows.sourceName: Ford GT LM Race Car Spec II
detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
Beginning in 1966, the first-generation Ford GT
claimed four consecutive wins at Le Mans.
Thirty-six years later, in 2005, a reproduction model
was released to celebrate Ford’s centennial.

About 1,500 units of this reproduction model
were sold as road cars.
But what if this car were to race at Le Mans today?
Developed for Gran Turismo, this Ford GT LM Race Car
Spec II tries to answer that question.

Just wait until you see its speed on the straights!?
detailRows.zh:
从1966年开始，第一代Ford GT在勒芒连续拿下了四冠。
在36年后的2005年，为了纪念公司的一百周年，
Ford又推出了一款复刻车。

这台复刻车款是一台公路车，总共生产了约1500辆。
如果让这款车去参加当今的勒芒比赛，会有什么样的亮
眼表现呢？
为了回答这个问题，专为跑车浪漫旅开发的
Ford GT LM Race Car Spec II应运而生。

你就等着见识一下它在直道上的速度吧！

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
At the 1966 Le Mans, the first-generation Ford GT
beat its archnemesis, Ferrari.

This victory made the Ford GT the first American car to win
the 24-hour race.
Fast-forward 50 years to 2016.

The Ford GT returned to beat Ferrari
once again at Le Mans.
It was an amazing feat 50 years in the making.
It’s what makes racing so much fun!
Indeed, the long history of motorsports is filled
with such iconic battles.
detailRows.zh:
在1966年的勒芒，第一代Ford GT击败了它的宿敌Ferrari……

成为了第一辆赢得这项24小时耐力赛的美国车。
我们将时针快拨50年，来到2016年……

Ford GT又回到了勒芒的赛场上，再次将Ferrari斩落马下！
这是一场跨越半个世纪的伟大胜利！也再次展现了赛车
运动的精彩与乐趣！
在赛车运动漫长的历史中，永远不缺乏这样的经典之战。,

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
A Gran Turismo Championship icon
and the ultimate race car....
...inaugural series champion Igor Fraga and
2019 champion, Mikail Hizal...

...raced this machine at the 2018 GTC finals in Monaco
to a near dead heat.
I’ll never forget the electrifying energy in the venue
when the winner was announced!
The responsiveness of its 3.0-liter NA engine is incredible...

...and its exhaust note is like music!

Because of its sharp handling, it requires
comprehensive driving skill to master.
But if you can tame this beast, you’re well on
your way to becoming Gran Turismo royalty!
detailRows.zh:
它是GT锦标赛的传奇，也是终极的赛车。
首届锦标赛冠军伊戈尔·弗拉加和2019年度冠军
米迦勒·希扎尔……

驾驶着这款比赛机器在摩纳哥举行的2018年总决赛中杀得
难解难分。
我永远不会忘记最后宣布冠军那一刻赛场里迸发的热烈
气氛！
3升自然进气引擎的响应速度十分傲人……

它的排气声响听起来也极其美妙！

灵敏的操控意味着你需要拥有全面的驾驶技术才能够驾
驭它。
如果你能够驯服这头猛兽，相信你的跑车浪漫旅比赛传奇之路
会一路畅通！

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
Did you know that there is a full-scale paper model
of this EPSON NSX?

It's true. EPSON commissioned Japanese paper artist
Hitoshi Shinozaki to build one.
It’s entirely made of cardboard, including
the tires and all of the other intricate parts.

It looks like the real thing, as if it could
drive off at a moment’s notice.

But I digress.
The real NSX competed under EPSON colors
in Japanese GT races from 2004 to 2009.

At the time, the All Japan Grand Touring Championship
was evolving into the Super GT Series.
The EPSON NSX competed in the latter half of the 2008
season, where it came in 2nd place in Round 8 race.
detailRows.zh:
你知道吗？这款ESPON NSX居然还有一套全尺寸的纸模呢。

这是真的，是Epson委托日本纸模艺术家筱崎仁帮他们打造的。
这个纸模全部由硬纸板做成，甚至连轮胎和其他的圆形
部件也不例外。

这个纸模看上去足以以假乱真，就好像可以随时上路一般！

……咳咳，不好意思跑题了。
Epson涂装的NSX真车参加了2004年到2009年期间的
全日本GT赛事。

当时正是全日本GT锦标赛向国际Super GT系列赛转型的阶段。
这款EPSON NSX参加的是2008年系列赛的后半段赛程，并在第8
轮中跑出了第二名的好成绩。

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
What, you don’t think that I know this car?
It’s the SLS AMG GT3!

The first customer race car in Mercedes-Benz’s
long and storied history.
It was produced in an era when Mercedes race cars were out
of reach for most privateers.

But the SLS AMG GT3 changed all that.
And its speed and reliability made it a formidable
weapon for privateers the world over.

The SLS AMG GT 3 has really competed in
many, many GT races over the years.
detailRows.zh:
什么？你以为我不认识这辆车？
开什么玩笑，这可是SLS AMG GT3啊！

这是Mercedes-Benz那漫长而传奇的历史当中的首款客制赛车！
在那之前，大部分的私人车队都没机会入手
这样一辆Mercedes赛车。

不过，SLS AMG GT3的出现改变了历史。
凭借可靠且强劲的速度，它成为了全球各地私人车手手
中最强力的武器。

这款SLS AMG GT 3参加过的GT比赛数不胜数！

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
It all goes back some 90 years,
to the Eifel race of 1934.

Back then, the all-white Mercedes F1 was deemed
1kg too heavy for competition.

To reduce its weight, a mechanic scraped off the car's
paint, exposing its aluminum body.
It was this silver-colored car
that ended up winning the race.

This car was dubbed the "Silver Arrow," instantly becoming
a symbol for racing excellence.
Since then, silver has been Germany’s national
racing color.

Of course, sponsorship liveries are much
more common today.

And race cars painted in their national colors
are very much a thing of the past.
But if you’re interested in racing history, you should
look into the national race colors of other countries.
detailRows.zh:
这个故事要说回到90多年前，那是1934年的埃菲尔比赛……

当时的那辆全白色梅赛德斯F1赛车因为超重1kg，无法参加比赛。

为了减重，一名机械师直接刮掉了喷漆，露出了铝制的
赛车车身。
最终，这辆原色梅赛德斯赛车还赢下了比赛！

于是赛车运动历史上最传奇的名称之一“银箭”便诞生了！
自那之后，银色就成为了德国的赛车运动主色调！

当然，今天的赛车运动中赞助商涂装已经非常普及。

采用国家官方配色的赛车已经成为了历史。
不过，如果你对F1的历史感兴趣，
不妨多了解一下其他国家的官方配色！

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
This Audi takes me back to the 2011 Le Mans 24-hour race.

Incredibly, it crossed the finish line and won
the competition...

A nail-biting 13.845 seconds before
the second-place Peugeot.

Rarely has Le Mans had such a close race!
Although Audi bested Peugeot in terms of speed,
the same couldn't be said about fuel efficiency.

Peugeot tried to use this to their advantage
by taking as few pitstops as possible.

So while Audi was making excellent time,
it couldn’t quite shake Peugeot.
But in the end, Audi’s speed won out, eking out
a victory against its competitor.
detailRows.zh:
看着这辆Audi，我仿佛回到了2011年的勒芒24小时耐力赛。

它以非同凡俗的姿态越过终点线并赢得了冠军……

只领先了第二名的Peugeot13.845秒，令人捏了一把汗。

在勒芒，很少能见到这样针尖对麦芒的比赛！
虽然Audi在速度上胜过了Peugeot一筹，但是在
燃油效率方面就一言难尽了。

Peugeot充分利用这一优势，尽量减少了进站加油的次数。

所以，单圈时间极其优秀的Audi始终没能将Peugeot甩开。
但最终，还是Audi的速度胜出，惊险击败了对手。

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
Toyota introduced this Lexus SC430 as the successor to...

The 80 Supra for the Super GT racing series.
The 2008 series in which it debuted was a heated contest
right down to the last race!

But when the Petronas Tom’s car crossed the finish line
and took the team title...

It established itself as a champion car
for the history books.
By the way, did you know that the base SC430
wwas a vario-roof convertible?

To get it battle-ready, Toyota built a reinforced roof
that combined a roll cage and carbon panels...

and fit it over the original.
In other words, the SC430 GT500 is in fact
built upon a coupe body!
detailRows.zh:
这辆雷克萨斯SC430是丰田为……

参加Super GT赛事的80 Supra推出的继任者。
在这辆车出道的2008年，系列赛的每一场厮杀都十分激烈，
悬念一直留到了决赛！

最终，这辆Petronas Tom’s赛车越过终点线，
为车队夺得了冠军……

自己也作为冠军之车被载入了史册。
顺带一提，你知道SC430的基础车其实是一辆折叠硬顶敞篷车吗？

为了让它能够参赛，丰田专为它打造了以防滚车架
和碳纤维面板制造的强化车顶……

安在原先的车辆上。
换句话说，这辆SC430 GT500其实是基于双门轿跑的车身而打造的！

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
This Peugeot 908 HDi FAP really shot past the competition
at the 2010 Le Mans 24 Hours!

After taking down reigning champ Audi
at the 2009 race...
Peugeot approached the 2010 race eager for another win,
and set to improving their 908.

And of the four 908s that competed, all four placed
in the top qualifying positions!

What’s more, the fourth-place Peugeot beat
the fifth-place Audi by over two seconds.
But you know, it’s no easy feat to win a 24-hour
endurance race.

All of the Peugeot’s 908s experienced trouble on the track,
and were forced to retire.
Which goes to show that endurance races are really not
just about speed but also the strength to carry on.'
detailRows.zh:
在2010年度的勒芒24小时耐力赛上，
标致908 HDi FAP宛如一支离弦之箭，速度快到惊人！

在2009年的勒芒比赛中击败卫冕冠军奥迪后……
标致继续精益求精，改良他们的908。
他们已经迫不及待地想要在2010年的赛场再度蝉联冠军。

后来，参赛的四辆908直接包揽了排位赛的前四！

而且就连第四名的标致都领先第五名的奥迪整整两秒以上。
然而，要赢得24小时耐力赛并不是那么轻而易举的事。

事与愿违，标致的所有参赛车都在赛道上
遭遇了困难，最终被迫退赛。
这也表明了一点——在耐力赛中，重要的不仅仅是速度，
坚持到底的耐久力也非常重要。

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
The AMG GT3 is renowned for its reliable strength
at FIA GT3 races around the world.

It is doubtless the star player among GT3 machines.
In 2016, when the second-generation AMG GT3 was
handed over to private teams...

It showed off its strength and speed, dominating the top
positions at the 24 Hours Nürburgring in its debut year.
Also, while road-going AMG GTs
were powered by a 4L twin-turbo V8...

This was not always the case with
their racing counterparts.

For the SLS AMG GT3 was the first to be equipped
with a race-tested 6.3L naturally-aspirated model.
detailRows.zh:
AMG GT3以其在世界各地的国际汽联GT3比赛中表现出的
可靠性而在业界闻名。

在GT3组别的参赛车辆当中，它无疑是一位明星选手。
2016年，是第二代AMG GT3交付给私人车队使用的第一年……

在出道当年，它就表现出无与伦比的实力和速度，
成为纽博格林24小时耐力赛的顶流。
AMG GT的公路版本通常配备4升的双涡轮V8引擎……

但该引擎并未被应用到赛车版本上。

SLS AMG GT3是首款配备了一台经过比赛考验的
6.3升自然吸气引擎的车型。

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
In touring car races and rallies...

Renault has long been represented by the compact R5
and its successor, the Clio.

Ah, the WRC Gr.B R5 Turbo and the F2-class Clio Williams!
Those were some great cars!
But what about the somewhat larger Mégane?
Well...

They certainly pulled out all the stops for
this Mégane Trophy!
Despite the outward resemblance to its road-going
variant...

It is in fact a one-make racer, powered by
a midship 3.8L V6 courtesy of Nissan!
It was originally built to compete in the popular Renault
Sport Series, which takes place in Europe.
detailRows.zh:
在房车赛和拉力赛方面……

一直以来代表Renault出战的都是紧凑型的R5及其继任者Clio。

像是WRC Gr.B R5 Turbo和F2级别的Clio Williams！
都是数一数二的好车！
再往上一个级别，就轮到Mégane了？

好吧……Renault为了推动自家举办的Mégane杯，
确实是使出了浑身解数！
虽然外表与其公路版本极其相似……

但实际上这是一辆单一车种专用赛车，
搭载与Nissan联合开发的中置3.8升V6引擎！
另外，这台车原本打算参加的是在欧洲举办的高人气比赛
——Renaul Sport系列赛。

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
Carroll Shelby made it his life’s mission to trounce
Ferrari at the Le Mans 24 Hours.

The first attempt he made was, of course,
in the famed Shelby Cobra.
However, as the open-bodied Cobra was lacking in terms
of high-speed aerodynamics...

Shelby turned to designer Pete Brock
for a body overhaul.

In return, Brock handed him back
the Shelby Cobra Daytona Coupe.
However, by then, Shelby had given his attention to
the development of the Ford GT40.

So this Cobra Daytona Coupe really only raced
for a fleeting two years...

In 1964 and ’65.
Only a few Shelby Cobras were ever produced--I'm
jealous of anyone who gets their hands on one!]
detailRows.zh:
卡罗尔·谢尔比毕生的宿愿
就是在勒芒24小时耐力赛中完胜法拉利。

他的第一次尝试当然就是这辆声名斐然的Shelby Cobra。
显然，Cobra的敞篷车身缺乏高速时所需的空气动力学性能……

于是，谢尔比向设计师皮特·布洛克求助，
对车身进行了大幅修改。

布洛克交付给他的便是这台Shelby Cobra Daytona Coupe了。
只不过，此时谢尔比的注意力已经转向了福特GT40的开发。

因此这辆Cobra Daytona Coupe的赛车经历
只有短短的两年……

即1964和65年。
Shelby Cobra的制造数量极为有限——
真是嫉妒那些能搞到一辆的幸运儿！'

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
This SF19 was built for Japan’s top formula racing series,
the Super Formula Championship.

The Super Formula is the preeminent formula racing event
in all of Asia…

And is considered the quickest motorsport after F1.
In Super Formula races, drivers tend to show their skill
through overtaking manoeuvres.

By the way, are you familiar with overtaking systems?

It is a system that allows a driver momentarily increases
the flow of fuel to the engine for increased speed!

It requires plenty of control and the utmost technique!
This Honda-powered SF19 conjures up memories
of Alex Palou’s record victory.

Palou later went on to compete in the IndyCar series,
a formula racing series held in the USA.
detailRows.zh:
这辆SF19是为日本顶尖的方程式系列赛
——超级方程式锦标赛而开发的。

放眼整个亚洲，超级方程式都是最卓越的方程式比赛……

也被视为是仅次于F1的最快汽车赛事。
在超级方程式比赛中，车手们倾向于
通过超车来展现个人技巧。

顺带问一句，你对超级方程式的超车系统有了解吗？

它可以通过短暂提高注入引擎的燃料量，以提升车速！

同时也需要车手大量的操控和纯熟的技巧才能驾驭！
这辆本田出品的SF19见证了亚历克斯·帕卢
创下纪录的胜利。

在那之后，帕卢又转战印地系列赛，
那是在美国举办的另一项方程式赛车系列赛。

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
Well, if it isn’t an SF19, built for Japan’s top formula
race series, the Super Formula Championship.

Pop quiz! Do you know who supplies the SF19's
engines?

The answer is: Toyota and Honda.
This machine here is powered by a Toyota engine, and it was
raced by Kazuki Nakajima and Kamui Kobayashi.

That’s right, two racers that Toyota trained
for the F1 Grand Prix!
Although it produces about half the power of an F1 car,
it’s small, light, and possesses great aerodynamics.

Thanks to their F1 experience, the drivers were able
to push the car to its limits.
Nick Cassidy was the series champion when this machine
made its debut in 2019.
detailRows.zh:
哎呀，这不是SF19，专门为日本顶尖的方程式系列赛，
超级方程式锦标赛而打造的赛车吗！

突击小测验！你知道为SF19提供引擎的是哪个厂家吗？

答案就是……丰田和本田！
这一台车里用的是丰田的引擎，
而驾驶它参加比赛的分别是中岛一贵和小林可梦伟。

没错，这两位可都是丰田旗下参加过F1大奖赛的车手！
虽然SF19的动力只有F1赛车的一半，但它也更小巧而轻量，
并且空气动力学性能相当不赖。

得益于两位车手的F1经验，能将此车的潜能发挥到极限。
在SF19亮相的2019年，尼克·卡西迪赢得了当年的系列赛冠军。

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
A second-generation Swift Sport!

Thanks to its high base specs, this car can compete
without much modification.
