In fact, it was even entered as a junior rally car
at the World Rally Championship!

Having taken the title twice, Suzuki has proved...

The great potential of this machine.
Manufacturing credit goes to Monster Sport, a Japanese
company headed by Nobuhiro Tajima.

Speaking of Tajima-san...

His impressive career includes six consecutive wins
at the Pikes Peak International Hillclimb.
Monster Sport has also built legendary hill climbers
based on the Suzuki Cultus and Escudo.
detailRows.zh:
这是第二代的Swift Sport啊！

因为基础规格够高，所以无需过多改装，
就能直接参加比赛。
事实上，它甚至作为青年拉力赛赛车参加了
世界拉力锦标赛！

Suzuki用两个冠军头衔证明了……

这辆车的巨大潜能。
这辆车的制造者是Monster Sport，一家田嶋伸博创办的日本公司。

说起田嶋先生……

他拥有傲人的职业生涯战绩，曾在派克峰国际爬坡赛中获得六连胜。
在他的带领下，Monster Sport也基于Suzuki Cultus和Escudo
生产传奇的山地爬坡赛车。

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
The GR Supra Racing Concept was revealed at the
Geneva Motor Show in March 2018.
When I saw it, I immediately thought to myself,
"The Supra is back at the track!"
Truly, Toyota is an incredible company!

Prior to the GR Supra’s release in 2019...

They had developed models built to LMGTE and
FIA GT-4 specifications.
Its debut race on Japanese soil was the first round
of the 2020 Super GT, at Fuji Speedway.

And of the six Supras that apparently competed,
five swept the top finishing positions!
detailRows.zh:
GR Supra Racing Concept是于2018年3月在日内瓦车展上亮相的。
当我看到它的时候，
我就在心里对自己说，“Supra又回来比赛了！”
Toyota真的是一家让人惊艳的公司！

在2019年，GR Supra还没推出之前……
他们就开发过LMGTE和FIA GT-4级别规格的Supra。
此车在日本本土的出道首战是在富士赛车场
举行的2020 Super GT第一轮。

六辆参赛的Supra中，就有五辆车包揽了完赛前五名的名次！

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
This is the car that kick-started Honda’s near 60 years
of Formula 1 Grand Prix history.

After a rough start in 1964, Honda was back in 1965,
with this RA272.

It took the checkered flag at the Mexican Grand Prix
in the final round of the season.
That year happened to be the last one in which F1 machines
were powered by 1.5-liter naturally-aspirated engines.

And let me tell you, the engine that powered this RA272
was something special!
It was a V-12 with 1495cc of displacement and capable of
a whopping 230 horsepower!

Surprisingly, the displacement per cylinder was a mere
125cc, something that reflected Honda's motorcycle engines.

What’s more, weighing in at 215kg, this super compact
engine was mounted horizontally amidships!

Have you ever heard of such a thing being done
on a Formula 1 car?
But if you give it some thou�ht, you’ll see that
it actually made a lot of sense.

By mounting an engine on its side, you can shorten
the wheelbase and put less stress on the gearbox.

Compact and easy to handle, Honda’s early attempt
at an F1 machine was an amazing display of engineering.
The track on which the Mexico Grand Prix takes place
is 2300m above sea level.

The low air pressure typically gives engines some
trouble generating power.

In designing the RA272’s powerplant, former aircraft engineer
and Honda’s F1 team leader Yoshio Nakamura...

...made sure it would function at high altitudes,
giving the RA272 an edge over its rivals.
The driver of the winning car was Richie Ginther,
one of the most skilled drivers of his day.

All these ingredients came together in Honda’s first F1 win.
And with that, a glorious history was in the making!
detailRows.zh:
这款车是本田近60年的F1大奖赛历史的先行者。

在经历了1964年的艰难起步之后，本田在1965年
携这款RA272卷土重来……

它在本赛季的最后一站，即墨西哥大奖赛上取得了冠军。
1965年也是赛会允许F1赛车使用
1.5升自然吸气引擎的最后一个赛季。

事实上，为这台RA272提供动力的引擎有点本事！
这台排量为1495cc的V12引擎能够产生惊人的230马力！

更令人惊讶的是，单个汽缸的排量仅有125cc，
让人不禁联想到本田摩托车引擎的传承。

除此之外，这台超级紧凑的引擎重量仅为215kg，
而且横向安置在车体的中部！

你可曾听说过这样的事情发生在一台F1赛车上？
但是细细思量，你就会发现这样的设计实际上颇为合理。

通过将引擎横向放置T��可以缩短轴距，
减轻变速箱所承受的压力。

本田的初次试水获得了立竿见影的成效，
他们的F1赛车因尺寸紧凑而易于操控。
由于墨西哥大奖赛所处的赛道高于海平面，2300m

低气压通常会给引擎的动力输出带来一些影响。

在设计RA272的引擎时，前飞机工程师
兼本田的F1车队负责人中村良夫……

就确保了它能在高海拔地区正常运转，
使RA272在竞�9对手前抢占了先机。
而坐在获胜赛车中的车手里奇·金瑟尔，
也是一位真正专业的赛车大师！

所有的致胜因素在本田的第一个F1冠军头衔中
汇集到了一起。就这样，一段光辉的历史诞生了！

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
In 1983, after a 15-year break, Honda returned to Formula 1 racing.

For the next 10 years, until it retired again in 1992,
it dominated the competition like no other.

In 1984, a year after its comeback, a Honda-Williams machine
claimed a victory at the American Grand Prix.

The driver of that car was none other than Keke Rosberg,
winner of the 1982 F1 Drivers’ Championship.

Man, did he look super cool when it came time for him
to ascend the podium.
In any event, the successor of Honda-Williams’ impressive machine
was this McLaren MP4/4.

McLaren began powering its machines with Honda engines
in 1988.

And with drivers Ayrton Senna and Alain Prost, it claimed
the championship that year.
The man responsible for designing the MP4/4 was genius
race-car designer Gordon Murray.

In addition to having a low center of gravity, the McLaren
MP4/4 was equipped with Honda's 1.5-li�er RA168E engine.

This turbocharged engine normally produced at 685 horsepower,
but it could be boosted to a maximum 1500 horsepower!

Apparently, the car had trouble with fuel economy,
but Honda’s brilliant engineers found a way to deal with that.

Indeed, they managed to produce the best F1 engine
of the day.
McLaren’s F1 results for the 1988 season were nothing short
of astounding.

To start, they won 15 of 16 races that year!

They al�o claimed 15 pole positions, ten 1-2 finishes,
and ten fastest laps.

And with 199 Constructors’ points, they finished
139 points ahead of the second-place team.

When it came to Drivers’ points, Prost had 87 and Senna
had 90, handing him his first Drivers’ title.
This historic win for Senna took place at the Suzuka Circuit
in the Japanese Grand Prix.

It was such a glorious win Soichiro Honda supposedly
said, “If only every day could be this greatv”3
detailRows.zh:
1983年，阔别赛场15年之后，本田回到了F1的赛场。

在接下来的十年里，本田彻底主宰了赛道，
直到1992年再次退出。

1984年，在本田归来一年后，本田-威廉姆斯车队的赛车
在美国大奖赛上取得了胜利。

夺冠车手正是1982年F1世界锦标赛总冠军得主——科克·罗斯伯格。

天啊，那位老兄登上领奖台的样子酷得不行。
紧随其后，延续本田-威廉姆斯优雅胜利
的是这辆迈凯伦MP4/4。

迈凯伦在1988年开始选用本田引擎作为他们赛车
的动力单元……

并与两位车手埃尔顿·塞纳和阿兰·普罗斯特一起，
一鼓作气夺得了制造商冠军。
负责设计这台MP4/4的人是F1天才工程师戈登·穆雷。

除了低重心设计外，迈凯伦MP4/4
还搭载了1.5升本田RA168E引擎。

这台涡轮增压引擎的标准功率就]��685马力，
但还可以通过增压提升到最大1500马力！

显然，这辆车的油耗会是个难题——
但本田出色的工程师们迎难而上，成功克服了这项艰巨的任务。

事实上，他们制造出了当时最出色的F1引擎。
迈凯伦在1988年赛季取得的成绩惊天动地。

这么说吧，他们赢下了那年16场比赛中的15场！

他们还拿下了15个杆位，在10场比赛中完成一二带回，�
以及创造了十次最快圈速。

最终，他们获得了199分的制造商积分，
足足领先第二名139分！

在车手积分方面，普罗斯特拿下87分，而塞纳拿下90分，
获得了他的第一个世界冠军。
塞纳的这次历史性胜利就发生在日本大奖赛的铃鹿赛道上。

这场胜利是如此的辉煌，以至于我仿佛还能听到
本田宗一郎说：“如果每天都能如此精彩就好了！”P

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en: Ah, the 1973 Porsche 911 Carrera RS... What a legend! What a treasure! This precious gem was designed to compete in touring car races. Touring car races are specifically for modified production cars. The extent to which a car can be modified is heavily restricted by FIA guidelines. But transforming high-performance road cars into pure race cars... ...is serious business for many automakers, and it has led to the some really special machines. These cars are known as homologation models, which means they meet FIA requirements for competition. When the FIA revised its world championship regulations in 1973... ...Porsche was approved to compete in Group 4 (Gr.4) of the Grand Touring competition. The 911 Carrera RS was the homologation model designed to conquer this Gr.4 class. The road-going car was made lighter and more powerful than the standard 911... ...and served as the base for the competition-tuned 911 Carrera RSR! When the 911 Carrera RSR made its debut in March 1973 at the 12 Hours of Sebring in Florida... ...it turned heads with a dazzling 1-2 finish! After that, it continued to perform well at the world championship series! It even came out on top against more powerful rivals at major races like the Daytona 24 Hours and Targa Florio. That season was simply mag�ificent, as it scored a well-deserved world championship title!
detailRows.zh:
啊，1973款保时捷911 Carrera RS……
好一个传奇！好一颗瑰宝！

这款保时捷的掌上明珠是专为参加房车赛而设计的，
后者是专为公路车改装赛车设立的比赛。

尽管其改装程度受到了国际汽联准则的严格限制……

但打造一台可以轻易改装为符合
赛事规格赛车的高性能公路车……

依然有许多汽车制造商将其视为工作的重点。
也因此，许多出类拔萃的高性能车应运而生。

这类汽车被称为“赛事认证车型”，
代表它们符合国际汽联的比赛规格要求。
当国际汽联在1973年修订其世界锦标赛规则时……

保时捷被批准参加房车赛组别4（Gr.4）级别的比赛。

这台911 Carrera RS正是为征服组别4级别赛事而设计的赛事认证车型。
这款改装后的公路跑车比标准版911更轻、动力也更强劲��
并成为了竞赛规格的911 Carrera RSR的原型！

911 Carrera RSR于1973年3月在佛罗里达州的
赛百灵12小时耐力赛上首次亮相……

就以包揽前两名的惊人战绩让所有人眼前一亮！

此后，它继续在世界锦标赛的各项系列赛中发挥出色！
它甚至在戴通纳24小时耐力赛和塔格·佛罗热等重大比赛中
力压性能更强大的对手并脱颖而出。<p/�
对于保时捷来说，这是一个辉煌的赛季，
也是属于当之无愧的世界冠军的胜利！

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
The Honda S series will always be remembered for the bold
way it tore up the race track!

It was Honda’s first mass-produced car and a true racer
that was active before its official release.
In 1963, a year before its debut, it took part in
a famous European rally called the Marathon de la Route.

A year later, the Honda S600 pulled off a
stunning GT1-class victory at the Japanese Grand Prix.
In the same year, it also competed in world endurance races,
such as the Nürburgring 500 km, where it won best-in-class.

Around this time, Honda was also performing well in Formula 1 and
had established itself as a major player in motorsports.
The year 1966 saw this S800, powered by a 791cc-engine.

This car became the vanguard of Japanese racing
well into the 1970s.

At the time, Honda had plans to establish a motorsports
support department for S seri�s competition racers.

This initiative would later result in the creation of the
Racing Service Center (RSC).

Today, RSC is known as Honda Racing Corporation (HRC), a
division of Honda overseeing motorsports activities.
Indeed, the S series is an indispensable part of Honda
and Japan’s racing history!
detailRows.zh:
本田S系列将永远被人们铭记，因为它曾经以不羁
的风格征服了赛道！

它是本田的第一辆量产车，也是一款真正的
赛道机器，在其正式发售之前就活跃在赛场上。
1963年，在其正式发布的前一年，它就参加了
鼎鼎大名的欧洲拉力赛——84小时马拉松汽车耐力赛。

一年之后的1964年，在首次亮相后，本田S600
又在日本大奖赛的GT1级别中取得了惊人的胜利。
同年，它还参加了世界耐力赛，
在纽博格林500km赛事上战胜了同级别最强大的对手！

在本田S系列大放异彩期间，本田在F1锦标赛中也屡有出色表现，
从而在赛车运动领域确立了自己的重要地位。
1966年，这款由791cc引擎驱动的S800发布。

并且一直到1970年代都处于日本赛车的先锋地位。

当时�7本田就计划为参加S系列比赛的赛车手们
建立一个赛车运动支持部门。

这一提案在后来推动了赛车服务中心的创建……
也就是今天的本田赛车公司——专门统管其赛车活动的部门。
可以这么说，S系列是本田和日本赛车历史中
不可缺少的一部分！

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
This is the Audi RS5 Turbo DTM, the legendary double-title
winner of the 2019 Deutsche Tourenwagen Masters (DTM)!
First held in 1984, the DTM is a race series
predominantly featuring German automakers.

While DTM regulations have varied from time to time,
the 1990s were known for race cars with crazy top speeds.

Heavily modified cars and the latest technology made the series
“the fastest touring car race in the world.”
In 2019, Class 1 regulations were introduced, which were
near-identical to those of Japan’s Super GT GT500 class.

This Audi RS5 Turbo DTM was one machine built to
meet the new Class 1 regulations.

The plan at the time was to unify the DTM and Super GT
technical regulations...

...and in 2019, joint-series races between the two organizations were actually held!
Afterwards, the DTM switched to a GT3-formula, bringing
an en� to a truly unified series with Super GT.
In any event, this Class-1 Audi RS5 Turbo DTM from 2019,
which competed in those joint-series races...

...is, without a doubt, one of the most notable cars
in DTM’s history.
detailRows.zh:
这是一辆传奇般的奥迪RS5 Turbo DTM，2019年
德国房车大师赛的双料冠军！
德国房车大师赛首办于1984年，主要由德国汽车制造商参赛。

尽管德国房车大师赛的规则在其漫长的历史上经历了无数次变更，但到了
九十年代，这项赛事主要以其疯狂的高速获得世人关注。

高度改装的汽车配合顶尖科技，使这项赛事
成为了“全世界最快的房车赛”。
在2019年，这项赛事引入了“组别1”规格，
与日本Super GT的GT500组别规格相仿。

这辆奥迪RS5 Turbo DTM就是专门为
符合“组别1”组别所打造的比赛机器。

当时的目标就是统一德国房车大师赛和Super GT的技术规格……

而且在2019年，这两项赛事甚至真的举办了联合赛事！
在那之后，德国房车大师赛转变为GT3形式，放弃了
与Super GT合并的计划。
尽管如此，这辆在举办联合赛事的2019年推出的
组别1奥迪RS5 Turbo DTM……

毫无疑问是德国房车大师赛历史上最重要的冠军车之一。

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
The Porsche Carrera GTS is hailed as one of the most
beautiful cars of the 1960s.

It is also known as the Porsche 904.
A mass-produced sports car, its design and mid-engine chassis
were clearly built to win races.
As soon as it rolled off the production line in 1964, it set
out to dominate in every race it entered.

Its performance at the famous Targa Florio in Italy
is well known.
The Targa Florio was a road endurance race in Sicily
consisting of a 72km track that was lapped ten times.

Competing in the Targa Florio’s GT2 class in April 1964,
the Carrera GTS...

...bested its rivals Ferrari, Alfa Romeo and Ford, claiming
an impressive overall victory.

The drivers who piloted the Carrera GTS were Antonio Pucci
from Italy, and Colin Davis from England.
In the same year, the Carrera GTS also won class victories�
at Sebring and Le Mans.

A year later, in 1965, it won again at the
Targa Florio and elsewhere.*
detailRows.zh:
保时捷Carrera GTS被誉为二十世纪六十年代
最美的汽车之一。

它还有另一个名字——保时捷904。
作为一款量产跑车，它的设计和中置引擎底盘
很明显是为了赢得比赛而设计的。
当这款车在1964年开下生产线后，它立刻
就向全世界证明了自己的实力。

这辆车在意大利的塔格·佛罗热大赛上的杰出表现举世闻名。
塔格·佛罗热大赛是一项在意大利西西里举行的公路耐力赛，
需要跑完十圈共计72公里。

这辆Carrera GTS于1964年4月参加了
塔格·佛罗热大赛的GT2组别……

击败了法拉利、阿尔法罗密欧和福特等对手，光荣地赢得了总冠军！

完成这一伟大成就的车手是来自意大利的安东尼奥·普基
和来自英格兰的科林·戴维斯。
在�+�一年，Carrera GTS还赢得了赛百灵12小时耐力赛
和勒芒24小时耐力赛的冠军。

一年之后的1965年，它又气势汹汹地杀回塔格·佛罗热大赛
和多项其他比赛，并再度夺魁！_

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
The Porsche 959 is perhaps best remembered for its
performance at the Paris-Dakar Rallies of the 1980s.
The Paris-Dakar Rally...

...was a race that stretched for more than 10,000km,
from Paris, France, to Dakar, Senegal.

A course spanning vast deserts and mountainous terrain,
it was considered the toughest rally in the world.
Porsche’s first success at the event was in 1984,
a year before the 959’s official debut.

Driver René Metge pulled off a marvelous overall victory
in a 911 fitted with a developmental 4WD system.
A year later, in 1985, Porsche entered the race with a 959, which
combined 4WD and a twin-turbo engine.

However, it wasn’t until ’86 that the 959 had an overall
victory at the rally, once again thanks to René Metge!
detailRows.zh:
保时捷959最值得铭记的大概就是它在二十世纪八十年代的
巴黎-达喀尔拉力赛上的杰出表现。
巴黎-达喀尔拉力赛……

是一项从法国巴黎前往塞内加尔的达喀尔，
行程超过10000公里的拉力远征。

其赛道横跨广阔的沙漠和山脉地形，
被誉为世界上最艰苦的拉力赛。
保时捷在这项赛事中拿到的首冠是在1984年，
959正式亮相的前一年……

当时雷内·梅杰驾驶着一辆安装有实验性四驱系统的911，
英勇地夺下了总冠军。
一年之后的1985年，保时捷终于派出了959参赛，
同样采用四轮驱动系统和双涡轮增压引擎的搭配。

不过959要等到1986年才拿到了总冠军，
而这一次夺魁的车手还是雷内·梅杰！

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
This is the SF23, a car developed for the Super Formula series,
Japan's top-level formula race competition.
All teams participating in Super Formula must use
a race car with the same chassis.

Teams are also restricted to a turbocharged 2.0-liter 4-cylinder engine
built by either Toyota or Honda.

That effectively makes Super Formula
a one-make race series.
In such a contest, victory is largely decided by a combination
of individual skill and team strategy.

This is one of the major draws of Japanese
Super Formula races.
Super Formula machines are distinguished by their
aerodynamic design...

...which is meant to limit air resistance at the rear
and sides of the body.

Because these machines are so similar in capability,
the race becomes a test of a driver’s skill.
The SF23 pushes this concept to new heights,�
promising more dramatic wheel-to-wheel action!
detailRows.zh:
这辆SF23是专为日本的顶级方程式系列赛事
——超级方程式所打造的赛车。
所有参与超级方程式的车队都必须
使用同一款底盘开发的赛车。

并且，所有车队也只允许采用由丰田或本田所开发的
两款规格一致的2升4缸涡轮增压引擎之一。

因此超级方程式本质上也是一项单一车种方程式赛事。
在这样的比赛中，胜利在很大程度上是由
车手个人和车队策略所共同决定的。

这也是日本超级方程式系列赛的主要魅力之一。
超级方程式赛车拥有非常独特的空气动力学设计……

致力于尽量降低车身两侧和后部的空气阻力。

由于赛车的性能旗鼓相当，因此这项赛事
也成为了车手操控技术的比拼。
到了今年，这款SF23又将这一理^��拔高到了全新高度，
保证可以为车迷们带来更激动人心的白刃战场面！"

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
Ever since it was introduced, the Mercedes AMG GT3
has been hailed as one of the fastest and fiercest GT3 race cars.
The original AMG GT3 made its debut in 2016.

At its first Nürburgring 24 Hours race, it did the
unthinkable, achieving an amazing 1-2-3 finish!
This machine is the updated AMG GT3,
which was introduced in 2019.

It featured aerodynamic improvements that generated
greater downforce than before.

Also, an all-new braking system placed less stress
on the tires.
While these performance upgrades resulted in
faster lap times...

...a more durable engine gave the AMG GT3 increased reliability.
And, a vastly improved parts management system...
...as well as several other tweaks made setting up and servicing the car easier for race mechanics.
detailRows.zh:
自初代型号发布以来，梅赛德斯AMG GT3一直被誉为
最强最速GT3赛车。
初代AMG GT3在2016年首次登上赛车舞台。

在参加的第一场纽博格林24小时耐力赛里，
它令人震惊地包揽了前三名，创下了永垂史册的壮举！
我们面前的这款赛车是升级后的AMG GT3，
于2019年首次亮相。

经过全面强化的空气动力性能
确保可以提供超强的下压力！

而全新的刹车技术则有效降低了轮胎磨损的压力。
除了这些性能升级带来的更出色的单圈时间外……

这辆AMG GT3还配备了更耐用的引擎、
一套大幅升级的零部件管理系统……
以及多项精细调整，从而帮助车队在赛道上更加风驰电掣。

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
The R32 Skyline GT-R is popular the world over, but this NISMO
version is really something else.
NISMO, or "Nissan Motorsport International," is the company's
motorsports division.

It was established in 1984.

Back then, Japan was totally into international touring car races
starring the Super Silhouette and other Nissan greats.
Actually, ever since the 1960s, Nissan’s works team has won
many of Japan’s top grand prix races.

This wealth of experience is what made NISMO possible.
And, with all the work that NISMO put into this GT-R,
you know it was destined to be a legend!
detailRows.zh:
R32 Skyline GT-R在全世界都非常有人气，但这台NISMO
却有其独特之处。
NISMO即“Nissan国际赛车”的简写，负责管理Nissan的赛车部门。

它成立于1984年。

当时，以“超级剪影”和其他Nissan大赛为代表的
国际房车赛令整个日本都为之痴狂。
事实上，自1960年代以来，Nissan官方车队就登顶了
许多场日本顶级的大奖赛。

这些在比赛中积累的宝贵经验成为了NISMO设计的基石。
只要了解NISMO在这台GT-R中倾注的努力，你就知道
它是一台不折不扣的传奇！

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
Most every rally-racing enthusiast knows about the "Evo."
The Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution is really that historic.
This is the Evo III, the third-generation model.
It's a car with a storied history.
It helped Mitsubishi ace driver Tommi Mäkinen win
his first WRC drivers title in 1996.

Mäkinen then went on to win four consecutive
drivers titles piloting different iterations of the "Evo."

He was truly a legendary rally driver.
And, the car that put him on his path to history was a rally
car based on this Mitsubishi Lancer Evo III.@
detailRows.zh:
每一个拉力赛的车迷都对“Evo”了如指掌！
Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution就是有这么出名。
这台是Evo III，第三代车型，有着一段传奇的历史……
当Mitsubishi的王牌车手，托米·马基宁在96 WRC上
赢得首个车手冠军时，驾驶的便是这辆车。

此后，马基宁驾驶着不同迭代版本的“Evo”
拿下了车手冠军四连胜！

他是拉力赛史上的传奇车手！
而助他走上荣耀之路的正是基于这台
Mitsubishi Lancer Evo III开发的拉力赛车。

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
The Maserati MC20 is a mid-engine sports car from 2020.
The letters in its name stand for "Maserati" and "Corse,"
meaning "race," along with its introduction year.

You can think of it as a successor to the MC12, that legend
built to compete at the 2004 FIA GT Championship.
Since its founding in the early-20th century, Maserati has
been known for its race cars.

From F1 machines like the 250F to sports cars like the
A6GCS, there is no limits to the company's achievements.
Now, while Maserati hasn’t been racing much
these days...

...this MC20-based machine marked its glorious return
to the track!
detailRows.zh:
Maserati MC20是一台2020年的中置跑车。
它的名字将“Maserati”和意为“竞速”的“Corse”
与发布年份相结合。

此前，Maserati曾为2004 FIA GT锦标赛打造了传奇车型MC12，
此车可以视作其继任者。
自从二十世纪早期成立以来，Maserati一直以赛车享誉世界。

从250F这样的F1赛车到A6GCS这样的跑车，
可以说是取得了数不胜数的成就。
近年来，虽然Maserati较少涉足赛车竞速领域……

但这台基于MC20开发的赛车无疑标志着它荣归赛场！

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
Why, this is the Garage RCR Civic, the winner of the Gran
Turismo Award at SEMA 2017!
Garage RCR refers to a body shop in Phoenix, Arizona,
and the Civic, which this car is based om, is the 1992 EG.

The custom parts are genuine JDM!
From its widebody kit to its hood, a wealth of
Japanese tuning parts have been expertly used.
Built to excel at time attacks, its chassis, engine and
transmission were tuned to perfection.

You’ll be blown away by its 5-speed sequential gearbox
and 400ps of turbocharged power.
I hear that Phil Robles, the owner of this car...

...built it piece-by-piece with his son Jesse.
detailRows.zh:
哇，这就是那台Garage RCR思域，
2017年美国汽车用品改装车展览会跑车浪漫旅大奖的得主！
“Garage RCR”指的是亚利桑那州凤凰城的一家车身工厂，
“思域”则是指这辆改装车的原型车'92 EG思域。

它所有的定制部件都是纯正的JDM（为日本国内市场生产）！
从宽体套件到前引擎盖，都是从品类丰富的日本改装件中
专业甄选出来的。
为了在计时赛中获得出色的成绩，它的底盘、引擎
及变速箱都经过了精心调校。

五速序列变速箱和高达400马力的涡轮增压引擎
绝对震撼。
据说这辆车是由它的主人飞利浦·罗伯斯与
他的儿子杰西一起……

逐个零件亲手组装起来的！

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
Who didn’t pay attention to the FIA GT Championship
when it launched in the mid-1990s?

Especially with all those incredibly cool Group GT1 machines!
This Mercedes-Benz CLK-LM from 1998 is a legend
of that GT1 category.

It was the successor to the CLK-GTR, which was built
in only 128 days...

...to compete in the 1997 championship.
Despite its short production time, the CLK-GTR really
tore up the track!
At the championship in 1997, it won six of 11 races, earning it
the coveted series title.
Appearing in the middle of the 1998 series was the CLK-GTR’s
evolution model—the CLK-LM.

With these two cars, Mercedes-Benz went on to win every race
of the GT Championship that year!
detailRows.zh:
在上世纪90年代中期，国际汽联GT锦标赛的诞生引起了
无数人的关注。

特别是那些令人叹为观止的GT1级赛车，
让人简直挪不开眼！
1998年推出的这辆梅赛德斯-奔驰CLK-LM就
堪称GT1级赛车中的传奇。

CLK-LM是CLK-GTR的继任者。1997年，为了赶上当年的锦标赛……

梅赛德斯在短短的128天内就造出了CLK-GTR。
尽尽管时间紧迫，CLK-GTR在赛道上的表现却令人刮目相看！
在1997年的锦标赛中，它在11场比赛中6次告捷，
成功夺得人们梦寐以求的系列赛冠军。
而在1998年的系列赛中，CLK-GTR的演化版本
——CLK-LM也随之亮相。

凭借这两款赛车，梅赛德斯-奔驰在当年的GT锦标赛中一路称霸，
豪夺每一场比赛的胜利！

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
Do you remember when the Toyota GT-One competed
at Le Mans in 1998 and 1999?

Well, I remember those spectacular races like it was yesterday!
And while Toyota may not have taken the overall victory
it was hoping for...

...it was doubtless the team that everybody expected to see
on the podium in 1999.

That year, Toyota entered three GT-Ones at Le Mans,
and they thoroughly impressed during qualifying!

Two of its cars took the 1st and 2nd positions, while the 3rd
started in P8.

The performance of the cars were simply awesome.

However, at the start of the race, the top two GT-Ones had
to retire—a reminder that anything can happen on the track.
This left Toyota with only the No. 3 car...

...driven by Toshio Suzuki, Ukyo Katayama,
and Keiichi Tsuchiya.
Having lost its top two cars, Toyota bet the farm
on this last hope of winning.

Initially racing on the defensive, Car No. 3
quickly changed its tactics, going on the offensive.

Picking up its pace, it miraculously set a course record
in the final part of the race.

Before long, it climbed to 2nd place, with the race-leader, BMW,
in its crosshairs.
But then—it burst a rear tire while traveling
at more than 300 km/h!

An attempt was made to continue, but an emergency pitstop
dashed Toyota’s dream of an overall victory.

After � tire change, Car No. 3 raced to a 2nd-place
finish that had all the world holding its breath.
This is why the GT-One has a special place in my heart,
even if Toyota has now become a Le Mans champion.
detailRows.zh:
你还记得丰田GT-1在1998年和1999年
参加勒芒24小时耐力赛时的飒爽身姿吗？

嗯，那几场精彩的比赛让我记忆犹新！
尽管丰田没能获得期待中的总冠军……

但毫无疑问，每个人都相信这支车队
是99年的夺冠热门。

在那一年，丰田将三辆GT-1赛车带到了勒芒，
并以风驰电掣的速度一路碾压排位赛阶段！

三辆车中的两辆分别夺得了第一和第二名，
而第三辆车排在第8名。

每辆车跑出的时间都不容轻视。

然而决赛甫一开始，两辆领先的GT-1赛车就被迫退赛，
也证明了赛道上一切意外皆可能发生。
于是丰田车队只剩下了一辆赛车……

由片山右京、铃木利男和土屋圭市驾驶的3号GT-1。
在损失了两辆前排赛车之后，丰田将赌注全部下
在了这台唯��的希望上。

3号赛车最初采取了守势，但很快便转守为攻……

并且不断加速，在比赛最后阶段奇迹般地
创下了赛道纪录。

很快它就攀升到了第二名，并将目标锁定在了
领先的宝马赛车上……
但接下来发生的事情让所有人惊掉了下巴
——在超过<300 km/h>的时速下，它的一个后轮发生了爆胎！

他们选择顽强坚持，但被迫紧急进站也剥夺了
他�赢得总冠军的梦想！

在更换轮胎后，3号赛车奋力追赶，让全世界
都屏住了呼吸，最终仍旧以第二名完赛。
这就是为什么即便现在丰田已经成为了勒芒冠军，
GT-1依然在我心中占据了非常特殊的地位。

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
The NSX is a Japanese GT racer! This was proved at the 2000
All Japan Grand Touring Championship (JGTC).

The NSX made its first appearance in the JGTC’s GT500 class
during the 1996 season.
Despite putting up a good fight...

It was unable to beat such powerful opponents as the Nissan
Skyline GT-R and Toyota Supra.

However, come 2000, the NSX took a great evolutionary
leap forward.
In this year, a team of five NSXs won four of seven races...
With Ryo Michigami, in the No.16 Castrol MUGEN NSX,
winning the driver’s title.
This was the first time an NSX won in JGTC history.
detailRows.zh:
这辆NSX是参加全日本GT锦标赛的赛车啊！它的实力已经在2000年
全日本GT锦标赛中得到了充分证明。

NSX在1996赛季全日本GT锦标赛的GT500组别中首次亮相。
尽管拼尽全力……

仍然无法撼动如日产Skyline GT-R和丰田Supra
这样的强大对手。

不过当时间来到2000年，NSX得到了飞跃般的进化。
在这个赛季，总共五辆NSX组成的参赛阵容拿下了
七场比赛中的四场胜利……
而驾驶16号嘉实多无限NSX赛车的道上龙
更是赢下了车手冠军头衔。
这也是NSX在全日本GT锦标赛的历史上首次夺魁。

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
This is one of my favourite Skylines—the R31, and a Group A
homologation GTS-R no less!

Who could forget its performance at the Japanese Touring Car
Championship, Japan’s top touring car event of the 1980s?
It's no doubt best known for its performance
in the 1989 JTC series.
It was this year that saw three Skyline GTS-Rs competing...

of which Masahiro Hasemi and Anders Olofsson’s
No. 50 car won three of six races!

What a way to win the series title!
And the way it stood up to those mighty European cars—
how cool is that!
detailRows.zh: 这是我最爱的一辆Skyline——R31，而且这辆GTS-R 还获得了A组别认证！ 它在1980年代日本顶级房车赛事——日本房车锦标赛上 的优异表现实在让人过目难忘！ 它最亮眼的一次表现无疑是在1989年日本房车锦标赛系列赛上。 就在这一年，三辆Skyline GTS-R在比赛中同台竞技…… 其中长谷见昌弘和安德斯·奥洛夫松驾驶的50号赛车 赢下了六场比赛中的半数！ 这是多么震撼人心的夺冠过程啊！ 更不必说它勇敢挑战那些强大欧洲赛车的英姿—— 真是太酷了！

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
More than anything, I associate the Volvo 240 series
with racing.
The 2-door sedan turbo model made a big splash at European
and German touring car championships.

So much so that its hallmark boxy shape earned it
the nickname ‘the Flying Brick.’
Racing performance aside, this Estate model
is a legend among legends.

Between 1974 and 1993, the Volvo 240 series sold
some 2.7 million units...

Of which, 950,000 were the Estate model. Now, more than
thirty years after its retirement...
It remains the classic estate car that people
all over the world still love to this day!
detailRows.zh:
在我心目中，Volvo 240系列都堪称非常优秀的赛车。
其中的2门轿车涡轮增压版本曾在欧洲和德国的房车
赛事中引起了巨大轰动。

由于影响力巨大，乃至于其方块状外形
为它赢得了“飞砖”的昵称。
除了比赛表现之外，这款Estate车型在市场上也堪称
传奇中的传奇。

在1974到1993之间，Volvo 240系列总共售出了
大约270万台……

其中95万台都是Estate型号。即便在停产超过三十年的
现在……
它依然是全世界车迷所深爱的一款经典旅行车！

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
The W 196 R was an F1 powerhouse that took the international
racing scene by storm!
It made its debut in 1954, during the French Grand Prix,
or Race 4 of the World Championship of Drivers.
It was piloted by none other than Juan Manuel Fangio,
who had raced for Maserati up to Race 3…

...before he decided to join the newly arrived Mercedes-Benz
works team.
An Argentinian, Fangio claimed his first Grand Prix
title in 1951.

At the time, he was already one of the fastest drivers
in the sport.
Behind the wheel of the Mercedes-Benz W 196 R, Fangio proved
to be near-unstoppable.
He claimed two consecutive World Drivers’ Champion titles
in 1954 and 1955!
detailRows.zh:
W 196 R是一辆席卷了国际赛车界的F1赛车！
它于1954年在法国大奖赛，也就是世界赛车锦标赛的
第4站中首次亮相。
驾驶它的是胡安·曼努埃尔·方吉奥，他在第3场比赛为止
还在为玛莎拉蒂车队效力……

随后决定加入新成立的梅赛德斯-奔驰车队。
方吉奥是阿根廷人，他在1951年赢得了自己的
第一个大奖赛冠军。

在当时，他已经是这项运动中最快的车手之一。
在梅赛德斯-奔驰W 196 R的加持下，
方吉奥几乎无人能挡……
在1954年和1955年连续赢得两届世界车手冠军！]

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
Subaru won the World Rally Championship's Manufacturers' Title
three years in a row.

It was from 1995 to 1997, and I still remember the thrill
of witnessing that incredible achievement.

Equally exciting was when the company introduced the Impreza WRC
in 1997!
The "WRC" in its name stood for "World Rally Car,"
and it was a new version...

...that allowed a wider range of modifications
permitted by Group A regulations.
Previously a 4-door sedan, the Impreza
was reborn as a sporty 2-door coupe.

But it wasn't all about style. It performed like a sports car!
In the 1997 season, the Subaru rally team...

...Won eight of 14 races, including the opening rounds
in Monte Carlo, Sweden and Kenya.

This incredible performance led to the team taking home
its third consecutive WRC title.
The Impreza WRC continued to ev�lve
until the year 2000.
It was a car that defined its era and hailed as an
important part of WRC history.
detailRows.zh:
斯巴鲁——世界拉力锦标赛三冠王！

我永远不会忘记1995年到1997年那段激动人心的时光。

同样令我振奋不已的还有1997年翼豹世界拉力赛车的到来！
世界拉力赛车是“世界拉力赛车”的缩写，也是当年引入的新规格……

相比A组规则，世界拉力赛车组可以进行更广泛的改装。
翼豹原本是一款四门轿车，经过回炉重造，成为
一款漂亮的双门车型。

但它不仅长得好看——它真的能跑得很快！
在1997赛季，斯巴鲁拉力车队

在全年的14场比赛中赢得了8场，包括
在蒙特卡洛的开幕战、以及瑞典和肯尼亚站。

惊人的表现也让斯巴鲁连续第三次赢得
世界拉力锦标赛冠军。
翼豹世界拉力赛车持续改装进化，直至2000年。
这款车定义了它所处的时代，至今仍被视为
世界拉力锦标赛历史的重要组成部分。

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
The Peugeot 205 T16 made its WRC debut in Race 5 of the 1984
season, at the Tour de Corse.
Although it managed only a 4th-place finish, it dominated the
latter half of the season, winning Rounds 9, 10, and 12.

From the very beginning, the car showed amazing potential!
The secret to the 205 T16’s exceptional speed lies
in its innovative engineering.

It was the first Group B rally car to feature all-wheel drive
and a mid-mounted engine.

This machine was a true gamechanger!
In the blink of an eye, it took the crown from the Audi Quattro,
the reigning front-engine 4x4 champion.
It then went on to claim consecutive WRC titles
in 1985 and 1986!'
detailRows.zh:
标致205 T16在1984赛季的第5场比赛——
科西嘉岛拉力赛中首次亮相世界拉力锦标赛，
只获得了第4名。

但在赛季的后半段，它主宰了比赛，
赢得了第9、10和12站的冠军。

从亮相的那一年起，这款车一直在飞驰不息！
205 T16的卓越速度的秘密在于其精湛的工程技术。

它也是B组中第一款采用中置引擎和全轮驱动的拉力赛车。

是汽车革命的全方位体现！
它以迅雷不及掩耳之势取代了先前
由奥迪quattro（一款前置四驱赛车）占据的冠军地位……
并在1985年和1986年连续两年赢得
世界拉力锦标赛的总冠军！

detailRows.sourceName: V6 Escudo Pikes Peak Special spec.98
detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
Can you name for me the world’s highest hill climb,
held annually in the state of Colorado?

That’s right! The Pikes Peak International Hill Climb,
a race with more than a century of history.
Built to dominate the competition at Pikes Peak was
the Suzuki V6 Escudo, a 900kg beast.

It was a machine that required a monster talent to tame.
So, it was fitting that piloting the Escudo was a driver named
Nobuhiro "Monster" Tajima.
A veritable dirt veteran, Tajima-san claimed seven
straight wins at the All-Japan Dirt Trial Championship.

In 1995, he became the first Japanese driver to win
the overall championship at Pikes Peak.<
detailRows.zh:
你知道在美国科罗拉多州每年举办的
世界海拔最高的登山赛吗？

正是拥有百年历史的派克峰国际爬坡赛！
Suzuki V6 Escudo这台仅有900公斤重的机械猛兽，
正是为赢得派克峰爬坡赛而生。

想要驯服这头狂暴怪兽，就需要一名怪兽级车手……
他便是有着“怪兽Tajima”名号的田岛伸博。
这位砂石路面的绝对统治者，曾七度蝉联
全日本砂道锦标赛冠军。

1995年，他更是成为首位在派克峰赛事中
斩获全场总冠军的日本车手。

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
The Toyota C-HR is a world-famous compact SUV!
It’s perhaps best remembered for its performance
at the Nürburgring 24h in 2016.

I mean, who ever expected to see a C-HR variant
from TOYOTA GAZOO Racing tearing up the Ring?

Needless to say, it had a beautiful run
at the world’s toughest 24-hour race.
A car that looks great and is fast to boot—
What more could you want?
detailRows.zh:
关于Toyota C-HR这台全球知名的紧凑型SUV，
最令人难忘的印象莫过于其在2016年
纽博格林24小时耐力赛上的表现。

说真的，谁能想到Toyota GAZOO车队打造的C-HR赛车
竟在纽博格林赛道上大放异彩呢？

更别说在世界上最严苛的24小时耐力赛中留下惊艳轨迹。
一台既有型格又具速度的车——你还能奢求什么呢？

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
This is a fifth-generation Corvette, called the C5
from 2001.
It was a truly unforgettable chapter in the Corvette's legacy.

It was when a C5-based GT racer known as the "C5-R"...
...achieved a stunning overall victory at the 24 Hours
of Daytona.

Just a few months later, it secured a class
win at Le Mans...

...followed by yet another triumph in 2002.
Beloved by many, the C5-R is still considered
among the fastest GT cars in the world!
detailRows.zh:
这是一辆第五代Corvette——
尽管是一辆2001款的C5。
对于Corvette而言，这是载入史册的年份。

基于C5打造的GT赛车“C5-R”
不仅在戴通纳24小时耐力赛斩获全场总冠军，

数月后更在勒芒赛场摘得本组别桂冠，

并在2002年成功卫冕！
这台深受车迷爱戴的C5-R，至今仍是
全球最快的GT赛车之一。

detailRows.sourceName: DELTA HF Integrale WRC Group A (1992)
detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
Why, this is the Group A rally version of the Lancia Delta!
A real fan favorite!
Its legend dates back to 1987, the first year in which
the WRC title was contested under Group A regulations.
That inaugural season, the Lancia Delta HF won the opening
race at Monte Carlo.

And it went on to claim the manufacturers’ and drivers’ titles
in a spectacular double victory!

What’s more, it went on winning manufacturers’ titles until
1992—a six-year streak!
That year may have marked the final appearance of a Lancia works
team in the WRC.
But it also saw the introduction of the Delta HF Integrale,
which dominated the competition in speed and durability.
Starting at Monte Carlo, it won eight races that year
and proudly clinched Lancia its sixth consecutive title.
detailRows.zh:
哇，这可是蓝旗亚Delta的A组别拉力赛版本！
车迷们的心头好！
这台车的传奇始于1987年，世界拉力锦标赛在那年
首次设立A组别。
首个赛季，蓝旗亚Delta HF便在蒙特卡洛揭幕战
旗开得胜……

并一路狂飙，达成斩获车厂和车手
双料冠军的壮举！

不仅如此，它更将车厂冠军头衔一直保持到了1992年
——成就六连冠伟业！
1992年是蓝旗亚车厂车队最后一次亮相
世界拉力锦标赛……
但同年问世的Delta HF Integrale依然在速度
和力量上力压群雄。.
从蒙特卡洛开始，它在那年赢得了八场比赛，
更荣耀地为蓝旗亚捧起六连冠奖杯。

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
Did you know there was a version of this Citroën BX
built for Group B rally homologation?
They called it the BX 4TC.

Up front, a longitudinally mounted turbocharged 2.2-liter inline-4
channeled serious power to all four wheels.
The irony? By the time this beast was
finally ready to race...

...Group B was already heading toward extinction.

As a result, it saw action in only a handful of races following
its 1986 debut—the final year of Group B competition.
Still, the BX 4TC, with its enlarged fenders and four auxiliary
rally lights, projected a commanding presence on the track.
It is truly a sight to behold!
detailRows.zh:
雪铁龙BX曾经开发过为满足B组别拉力赛规则
而打造的赛事认证车型，这你知道吗？
这台车被命名为'BX 4TC'。

它搭载的2.2升直列四缸涡轮增压引擎纵向安置在车头，
源源不断为四个车轮输送强大的动力。
然而，当这台公路猛兽终于准备好参赛时……

B组别赛事却已走向终点。

所以，在它亮相的1986年，同时也就是B组别最后举办的那一年，
它仅参与了寥寥数场比赛。
尽管如此，这款BX 4TC凭借其加宽的挡泥板
和四盏辅助拉力灯，在赛道上依然威风凛凛。
这台车绝对值得一看！

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
Remember the R34 Skyline GT-R? I was a big fan
of that car.

Sadly, it made its exit from the All Japan GT Championship in 2003.
But then, in 2004, it came back…

When Nissan’s in-house works team, Nismo, poured all
of its racing know-how into a street-legal GT-R version.
That’s right, I’m talking about the Nismo R34 GT-R Z-tune!
Apparently, development started on this project
back in 1999.

In other words, when the R34 Skyline GT-R was at the height
of its racing prowess!
To be able to see such a special GT-R up-close like this
is really a great honour!
detailRows.zh:
还记得R34天际线GT-R吗？我是它的忠实粉丝。

遗憾的是，这台车在2003年退出了全日本GT锦标赛的舞台。
不过在随后的2004年，

日产自家厂队NISMO倾注其所有赛车技术打造出了
一款可以合法上路的GT-R，让它便重回大众视野……
没错，我说的就是NISMO R34 GT-R Z-tune！
不难猜出，这一项目的开发工作早在1999年就开始了。

换句话说，开发在R34天际线GT-R还在
实力巅峰的时候就开始了！
能够如此近距离地观赏这样一台特别的GT-R，
真是莫大的荣幸！*

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
When I hear the name Skyline GT-R, I immediately think of
racing champions!

So, it probably goes without saying that I’m also a big fan
of the Prince-era Skyline GT, the forefather of the GT-R.
This Nissan Skyline GT-R, affectionately known as the "Hakosuka,"
carried the torch passed down from the formidable Skyline GT.

It made its debut at the 1969 JAF Grand Prix,
held at the legendary Fuji Speedway...
...where it didn’t just win,
it made a statement.

From that first race, it racked up 49 consecutive victories
through to December 1971!
detailRows.zh:
当我听到“Skyline GT-R”这个名字，我条件反射般地
想到了这四个字：赛车冠军！

理所当然，我也是GT-R的前身，Prince时代
的Skyline GT的狂热车迷。
这辆“Nissan Skyline GT-R”，也被称作“Hakosuka”，
继承了所向披靡的Skyline GT的衣钵。

它于1969年在传奇的富士赛道上举办的
JAF大奖赛上首次亮相。
它不只在这条赛道上初战告捷，此后还连战连胜……

最终到1971年12月为止，取得了
举世闻名的49连胜的战绩！

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
The year 1967 marked a milestone in Japanese motorsports history.

The country hosted its very first 24-hour endurance race
at the newly opened Fuji Speedway.
Long-distance endurance races like Le Mans had been
a European tradition since the 1920s.

But with their arrival in Japan, a new chapter
in motorsport history began.
And the winner of that historic inaugural
Fuji 24 Hours?

It was none other than the Toyota works team,
racing this 2000GT!
It was driven by the legendary duo of Shihomi Hosoya
and co-driver Yoshio Otsubo.|
detailRows.zh:
这是于1967年举办的盛会……

日本在新开放的富士赛道上举办了该国
有史以来第一场24小时耐力赛。
该比赛的性质与欧洲自20世纪20年代以来举办的勒芒等
长距离耐力赛相似。

也是此类比赛首次踏上日本的国土，
标志着赛车运动史上的新篇章。
至于这场历史性、开创性的富士24小时耐力赛的冠军……

还用说吗？自然是驾驶着这辆2000GT的Toyota厂队！
驾驶这辆车的车手是传奇的双人组，
细谷四方洋和领航员大坪善男。

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
Believe me when I tell you that this N-ONE
is a genuine racer!
It has participated in one-make series across Japan.

Honda launched these events in 2014.

That means the N-ONE boasts over a decade of
racing heritage.
Cars competing in these no-holds-barred races had to be outfitted
with roll cages and a host of specialized racing components.
Just watching them take to the track in their colorful
liveries is pure joy!
detailRows.zh:
相信我，这辆N-ONE是天生的极品赛车！
这款车曾经征战日本各地的单一车种比赛。

Honda从2014年开始举办这些赛事，这就意味着……

N-ONE参与赛车运动的历史已有十年之久！
参加此类无护栏赛事的赛车必须配备
防滚架和其他指定赛车配件。
光是看着这些身披五颜六色涂装的赛车进入赛场
就足够让人心潮澎湃！

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
On the centennial running of the 24 Hours of Le Mans in 2023...

...a mid-engine race car claimed a brilliant victory
in the GT AM class...

...an achievement that forever redefined the legacy of
America’s sports car, the Chevrolet Corvette.

Its name—the C8—marked it as the eighth generation of
the storied Corvette.
It was also the first production model to break from tradition,
abandoning the front-engine/rear-wheel-drive layout...

...in favor of a mid-engine design transforming the
character of the car.
It proved to be a wise move, as the mid-engine Corvette has since
become a formidable presence in GT racing worldwide.
detailRows.zh:
在2023年勒芒24小时耐力赛百年庆典之际……

这款中置引擎赛车在GT AM组别
取得了辉煌胜利……

极大地改变了“美国跑车”——Chevrolet Corvette的
历史进程。

“C8”彰显了它作为这款标志性车型
第八代产品的身份。
这是首款摒弃传统前置引擎后轮驱动
布局的量产Corvette……

它转而将引擎置于车身中部！
这一明智之举显然取得了成功，因为中置引擎的Corvette
自此成为众多GT赛事中不可小觑的力量。

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
The year was 2023.

Ferrari claimed its first-ever overall victory at the
Nürburgring 24 Hours!
The machine that achieved this remarkable feat was none other
than the Ferrari 296 GT3.
It was a historic race, completed in a record 162 laps.

But the 296 GT3 didn’t just secure the overall win.

All three of the team’s entries finished the race,
a testament to their outstanding reliability.
In the months that followed, the 296 GT3 continued to dominate,
earning victories in endurance races across the globe!
detailRows.zh:
时间来到2023年……

Ferrari在纽博格林24小时耐力赛斩获首个全场冠军！
缔造这一历史性突破的正是Ferrari 296 GT3。
这场载入史册的比赛以162圈创纪录完成。

但296 GT3的成就远不止于此。

三台参赛赛车全部顺利完赛，充分证明了其优异的可靠性。
此后，296 GT3更在全球耐力赛场上连战连捷！

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
The Mitsubishi FTO is a sports coupe that took the racing
world by storm.
It famously competed in the All Japan GT Championship
in 1998 and 1999.

Although it retained the front-wheel-drive layout
of its road-going sibling...

...it replaced the latter’s naturally-aspirated engine with a
turbocharged version of the venerable 4G63 inline-4.
On the track, cars with rear-wheel drive areyin contenders for power and traction.
Although the Mitsubishi FTO never captured a victory
in the All Japan GT Championship...
...it did earn a 2nd-place podium finish at the series opener
in 1999!
detailRows.zh:
Mitsubishi FTO是一款曾在赛坛掀起波澜的
运动型双门轿跑。
其最广为人知的战绩当属1998至1999年间
征战全日本GT锦标赛的经历。

尽管其公路版姊妹车型的
前轮驱动布局被保留下来……

但原厂自然进气引擎被替换为了
经涡轮增压强化的经典4G63直列四缸引擎。
要知道，在赛场上比拼动力优势的
往往是那些后轮驱动车型。
虽然此车型未能在全日本GT锦标赛摘得桂冠……
但在1999赛季揭幕战中还是成功斩获了亚军佳绩！

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
In 2022, scarcely a year after its first appearance...

...the ELANTRA N TC rose to the top, claiming the crown
at the very pinnacle of global TCR competition.
Even now, it continues to assert its authority as
a constant force on the world stage.
And who could overlook its astonishing performance
at the Nürburgring 24h in May 2025?

That was the moment the ELANTRA N TC delivered an improbable
1–2 finish in the TCR Class!
Remarkably, it also marked Hyundai’s fifth straight class victory
at this legendary endurance race.
detailRows.zh:
2022年，即此车面世仅一年之后……

ELANTRA N TC就荣获了世界TCR系列赛
最高级别比赛的冠军。
直至今日，此车仍旧在国际舞台上展现着它强大的实力！
谁能忘记它于2025年5月
在纽博格林24小时耐力赛的赛道上驰骋的英姿？

在那场比赛中，ELANTRA N TC
可是包揽了TCR组别的冠亚军，堪称奇迹！
此外，这也是Hyundai在这项传奇赛事中
获得该组别的第五次连胜。\

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
Did you know that, along with its increased engine
displacement over the previous model...

...the Porsche 911 GT3 R (992) became the first
GT3 R to feature a swan-neck rear wing?
For me, its defining accomplishment remains those unforgettable
back-to-back victories at the Le Mans 24 Hours.

Both came in the LMGT3 Class, which replaced
the LMGTE category in 2024.
In its debut year, it secured a superb class win under
conditions that were anything but forgiving.
Then it did it all over again the following year—a truly
remarkable achievement, wouldn’t you agree?
detailRows.zh:
你知道吗？Porsche 911 GT3 R (992)不仅
排量比其前任大……

也是第一款采用天鹅颈式尾翼的GT3 R？
就我个人而言，它最令人难忘的成就，
是在勒芒24小时耐力赛中实现了两夺冠。

它在LMGT3组别（2024年取代LMGTE组别）中
取得了这一佳绩。
在首次夺冠那一年，尽量条件艰险，它还是坚韧不拔地
拿下了该组别的辉煌胜利。
然后它就在下一年再次上演了同样的精彩戏码
——真是不容小觑，你说对吧？+

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
This Camaro 1969 Race-Mod is classic on the outside
and modern within.

In other words, it perfectly embodies the spirit of every
great restomod.
It’s based on the legendary Camaro Z28, which was built
to compete in the popular Trans-Am Series of the 1960s.

Now the Camaro Z28 returns as an original custom car,
courtesy of Gran Turismo.
Built to sit lower on the ground, this car is equipped
with a special bumper and a host of new aero parts.
Meanwhile, the back features a large ducktail spoiler
and centre exit exhaust.
As for its engine, it runs on a mighty supercharged V8!

Now�I want to see it in action!*
detailRows.zh:
这辆科迈罗1969 Race-Mod，虽然保留了经典外观，
内里却焕然一新。

可以说，它完美诠释了修复改装车的顶尖水准。
此车的原型车是传奇的科迈罗Z28，
为了征战1960年代风靡一时的泛美房车锦标赛而生。

如今，科迈罗Z28以一款原创定制车的身份荣耀回归，
由《跑车浪漫旅》倾情呈现。
车身姿态经过精心调校，更为低趴，并配备了
专属前保险杠与大量全新空气动力学套件。
车尾则装有一个醒目的大型鸭尾式扰流板，
并采用中置排气布局。
至于它的心脏，则是一台动力磅礴的机械增压V8引擎！

现在，我真想一睹它在赛道上飞驰的风采！

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
The 1999 Le Mans 24 Hours was one of those races
that stays with you.

Factory teams from the world’s biggest automakers arrived with
everything to prove, fighting for victory in an all-out war.
When the checkered flag fell, it was BMW’s V12 LMR prototype
that stood above them all.

It was BMW’s first overall win at the legendary 24-hour classic.

Now, some 20 years later, BMW has returned to the top category
with a machine built for the modern era...
...with this BMW M Hybrid V8!
The car made its presence felt, scoring a 1-2 finish at the 10th
round of the 2024 IMSA SportsCar Championship in Indianapolis...

It also took a hypercar class victory in
the World Endurance Championship.
There’s no doubt about it:
This machine has proven it belongs on the world stage.
detailRows.zh:
1999年的勒芒24小时耐力赛堪称经典之战。

全球各大顶尖汽车制造商的厂队使出浑身解数，
全力角逐总冠军的殊荣。
而最终登顶的则是宝马的V12 LMR原型车。

这也是宝马首次登顶这一传奇的24小时耐力赛。

时隔二十余年，这一德系劲旅宣布重返顶级组别行列……
携宝马M Hybrid V8强势归来！
这台车在2024年国际汽车运动协会跑车锦标赛第10站
印第安纳波利斯分站中强势包揽冠亚军，

还在世界耐力锦标赛中斩获超级跑车组别冠军。
毫无疑问，这台竞速机器已然在世界舞台证明了自身实力。

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
The Ferrari 499P is the kind of machine built for the history books.
Who could forget its stunning run at Le Mans in 2023?
On the grand stage of the race’s historic centenary...

...Ferrari returned to the top flight after a 50-year absence.
Just imagine coming back on a milestone year like that.
The pressure must have been enormous!

And yet, in an all-out fight against opponents all chasing
the coveted overall championship title...
...it was the No. 51 Ferrari 499P that rose above them all.
The first overall victory for Ferrari in 58 years wasn't just a win,
it was one of the great comeback in motorsports history!
detailRows.zh:
法拉利499P是一台注定载入史册的终极跑车，
它在2023年勒芒比赛上的惊艳表现至今让人难以忘怀。
在这项赛事迎来百年纪念的盛大赛场上，

法拉利暌违五十载后强势回归最高组别赛场。
想想便知——选择在这样一个极具纪念意义的年份复出……
压力绝对超乎寻常。

然而，在各路强敌全力以赴争夺总冠军的激烈鏖战中……
51号法拉利499P成功杀出重围夺得冠军。
这是法拉利时隔58年再度登顶勒芒总冠军。
这场胜利意义非凡，成就了一段王者归来的传奇篇章。

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
Of all the race cars born from the Le Mans Hypercar regulations...

...the Peugeot 9X8 may be the most
distinctive of them all.

Its wingless concept made headlines
when it made its debut in 2021.

And that bold approach may have helped it briefly take the lead
during an especially wet and grueling Le Mans in 2023.
In 2024, the car underwent a major evolution, gaining an all-new
rear wing and a more conventional aerodynamic package.
A top-tier contender in the WEC, this is a machine
that never fails to make an impression.
detailRows.zh:
在众多遵循勒芒终极跑车组别规则打造的赛车中……

Peugeot 9X8的设计最为独树一帜。

其“无尾翼”的设计理念在2021年首次亮相时便引发热议……

甚至在2023年雨水肆虐、赛程艰苦的勒芒赛场上，
一度助它领跑全场。
2024年这款赛车迎来重大升级，正式加装全新尾翼。
作为WEC赛场上的顶尖强者，这台车总能惊艳全场。

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
The Porsche 963 is a formidable contender in
the premier categories of the IMSA and WEC.

It’s had especially strong showings at the IMSA.
Competing in the 2024 IMSA GTP category, the 963 won
the first round of the series—the 24 Hours of Daytona.

From there, it racked up further victories at Laguna Seca,
Watkins Glen, and Road America...
Before clinching both the Manufacturers' and Drivers'
Championship titles.

Meanwhile, in the WEC series, it has established itself
as a podium fixture...
Further cementing its status as a modern masterpiece
of endurance racing!
detailRows.zh:
Porsche 963是IMSA与WEC最高组别中的实力劲旅，

在IMSA赛场上的战绩尤其斐然。
征战2024年IMSA GTP赛事期间，
963一举拿下戴通纳24小时耐力赛揭幕战冠军。

随后又接连斩获拉古纳-塞卡赛道、
沃特金斯峡谷国际赛道与美国之路赛道的分站冠军……
最终包揽车厂与车手年度总冠军。

而在WEC赛场上，它也是领奖台的常客……
由此逐步奠定了它在耐力赛中当代经典神车的地位。

detailRows.speaker: Stella
detailRows.en:
A Viper is a type of poisonous snake right?
It’s kind of fitting for the car's image.
Though I kinda think the face of the car
looks kinda cute in a way.
Wow, but when you sit in the driver's seat its hard to tell
where the front end of the car is...

But I guess that's because the engine is huge!
detailRows.zh:
知道吗，Viper这个词其实是一种毒蛇的名字？用来
形容这款车倒是很贴切。
尽管我觉得这款车的前脸看上去还挺可爱的。
可是当你坐进驾驶室里的时候绝对会大吃一惊，因为你
很难看到这辆车的车头究竟在哪里……

我猜这是因为它的引擎实在太大了！

detailRows.speaker: Stella
detailRows.en:
This is a famous car—I know this one!

I always think it’s so cute when I see one.
And I love how it looks when the headlights pop open!
There are lots of Mazda Roadster fans all around the world, right?
That’s another great thing about this car.-
detailRows.zh:
这是一款很有名的汽车，我认识的！
我一直觉得这辆车非常的可爱
……而且我还喜欢它的大灯翻起来的样子！
Mazda Roadster在全世界有很多粉丝对不对？
这是这款车另一个很酷的地方。

detailRows.speaker: Stella
detailRows.en:
This car looks so beautiful no matter which angle
you look at it from.

I see, so it’s a special concept car of Mazda.

I mean, you can tell right away it’s a sportscar,
but its so elegant and attractive.
But the engine sound is a big surprise!

I didn't know engines could sound so crisp and clear!
detailRows.zh:
无论从哪个角度看，这辆车都是那么的漂亮迷人。

我知道了！所以这是一辆Mazda的特别概念赛车！

我是说，你一眼就能看出这是一辆跑车，但它的外形是那么优雅，
那么让人目眩神迷。
可是发动机的声音真的是让人大吃一惊！

我从来不知道发动机也可以发出如此清脆的声音！

detailRows.speaker: Stella
detailRows.en:
This car...it's named after a mounted knight with a lance.

And this is the fifth-generation version?
I can tell by its appearance that
it's not slow or modest.
It gained fame in the World Rally Championship
and enjoyed popularity across the globe? Impressive!
This is a really nice car, I hope you take good care of it!
detailRows.zh:
所以说这款车是以一位手持长枪的骑士命名的……

而且这是第五代车款了？
一看外表就知道，它肯定不是一辆慢吞吞的老爷车。
哇哦，所以它在世界拉力锦标赛上一举成名，接着在
全世界都很受欢迎。
这真是一辆好车呀。希望你能好好照顾它哦。

detailRows.speaker: Stella
detailRows.en:
You know when you look at this car from an angle
it looks like an Italian car, it's so beautiful.
Huh, what's with this gauge that’s mounted in
this weird position?

Ohh, so they've already got a place for the boost gauge
for the turbo.

With the boost gauge in your face like that
It probably makes you wanna drive faster!
detailRows.zh:
你从某个角度看这辆车的时候，它就像一台意大利车那
样美丽。
嗯？安装在这个奇怪位置的仪表是怎么回事？

哦哦，所以他们为涡轮增压表特意找了一个位置。

像这样把仪表装在你面前，大概会让你想要开得更快吧！

detailRows.speaker: Stella
detailRows.en:
A GT3 is basically like a race car, right?

Or at least just as fast? That's what I heard.
It looks like any other Porsche at first glance, but people
who know can tell the difference, right?
It’s not flashy, but it drives like a true race car.

That’s seriously cool.
detailRows.zh:
GT3其实是一辆赛车，是不是？还是说和赛车一样快？
我好像听说过它的。
在我看来这就像别的Porsche一样……
懂车的人才能分辨出来，是不是？
没有那么拉风，但开起来像真的赛车一样，非常酷！

detailRows.speaker: Stella
detailRows.en:
Even I know this one—the Porsche 911 is famous.
I thought this would be a really expensive model.

But this RS doesn’t have much in the way of equipment.

I don’t even see a door handle.

Oh, you pull this red strap?
So it’s all to make the car lighter?

That’s pretty wild. They really went that far
to save weight.
detailRows.zh:
就连我都知道这款车，Porsche 911太有名了。
我还以为这款车会非常非常贵，可是……这款RS上面
缺了好多的设备呀。

我甚至连门把手都没见着。
哦，你要拉这根红绳……所以这都是为了让车更轻？
这也太疯狂了，他们居然会为了减重做这么极端的事。?

detailRows.sourceName: Impreza Coupe WRX Type R STi Version VI '99
detailRows.speaker: Stella
detailRows.en:
The Subaru Impreza?
It was really famous in motorsports too right? And so this is the final version of the special models?'The most refined and rare…'
You really like this car huh.
detailRows.zh:
Subaru Impreza在赛车圈里相当有名对不对？而且这台是这款特殊车型的最终版？“最精致且最罕见的……”
那你真的很喜欢这辆车哈。

detailRows.speaker: Stella
detailRows.en:
I've seen this car in the movie 'The Fast and the Furious'!
It's the Toyota Supra right?The 'Supra' letters look like it was written
with a Japanese brush.

I am right? I thought so!
So they really wrote it like in Japanese calligraphy.
detailRows.zh:
我在《速度与激情》里见过这款车！
这是Toyota Supra，对不对？字母Supra就像是用日本的毛笔写的。

我说对了？我就说嘛。他们写的真的是日本书法。

detailRows.speaker: Stella
detailRows.en:
It looks like a really compact supercar.
It's smooth and looks really cool.
So the engine is in the back? It’s a two seater
and pretty tight inside.

Wow but its got a pretty decent sized boot,
not bad!
detailRows.zh:
这款车一眼看上去就是辆紧凑版超跑。
流线型的车身非常的酷。
所以发动机放在后面？这是部两座车，里面很紧凑。

哇喔，但是后备箱还是挺大的，不错！

detailRows.speaker: Stella
detailRows.en:
It's not big, but you just can ignore it.
Ah, I see. This GR Yaris was made for motorsports.

I guess it does look like a sports car,
and it's no slouch out on the track.

It's nice that it's also good for everyday use—I mean,
you can even sit in the back!
detailRows.zh:
这辆车虽然小巧玲珑，但实力却不可小觑。
噢，原来是这样。这辆GR Yaris是专为赛车运动而生的。

它看上去确实就是一辆跑车，在赛道上表现得也不弱。

而且日常使用也非常好开，我说真的，后排也能坐人！

detailRows.speaker: Stella
detailRows.en:
I thought this was a FIAT 500 at first,
but this car's called an Abarth?

It's still just as cute,
and the engine sounds amazing!
The Scorpion emblem adds a touch of class as well.

It traces back to the company's founder who was born
under the Scorpio zodiac sign. That's really cool!
detailRows.zh:
所以我一开始还以为这就是辆FIAT 500，可它的名字叫Abarth？

我觉得这辆车也挺可爱的，
不过引擎的声音太了不得了！蝎子车标也很有品味，好经典。

所以说，用这个标志是因为创始人是天蝎座的啊！
这真的是太酷了。

detailRows.speaker: Stella
detailRows.en:
The Toyota Prius is arguably the most popular Japanese
hybrid car.

And when it comes to subcompacts, the most popular
could well be the Toyota Aqua.
Outside of Japan, the Aqua is marketed as the "Prius C."

But perhaps I'm getting ahead of myself.
Are you familiar with the term "hybrid car?"
detailRows.zh:
Toyota Prius是日本最著名的混合动力汽车。

而如果我们再把范围缩小到紧凑型汽车的范畴，
那最著名的要属Toyota Aqua了。
在日本以外，Aqua被称为“Prius C”。

但是等等——也许我忽略了一点。
你熟悉“混合动力汽车”这个概念吗？

detailRows.speaker: Stella
detailRows.en:
Oh great! It's a car that runs on two power sources—
a fuel-burning engine and an electric motor.

Electric motors are great for accelerating, and allow
for tight control.
By balancing engine and motor power, hybrid cars offer
a very efficient driving experience.
detailRows.zh:
太棒了！这是一种靠两种动力源运行的汽车——
燃烧燃料的引擎和电机。

电机的加速能力很强，并且可以实现精确控制。
通过平衡引擎和电机输出的动力，混合动力汽车可以
提供非常高效的驾驶体验。

detailRows.speaker: Stella
detailRows.en:
Well, it's a car that runs on two power sources—
a fuel-burning engine and an electric motor.

Electric motors are great for accelerating, and allow
for tight control.
By balancing engine and motor power, hybrid cars offer
a very efficient driving experience.
detailRows.zh:
好吧，它是一种靠两种动力源运行的汽车——
燃烧燃料的引擎和电机。

电机的加速能力很强，并且可以实现精确控制。
通过平衡引擎和电机输出的动力，混合动力汽车可以
提供非常高效的驾驶体验。

detailRows.speaker: Stella
detailRows.en:
The Honda Fit is one of Japan's most popular compact cars.
By the time this third-generation model made its debut in 2013,
2,000,000 units had been sold in Japan alone!

It is a perennial bestseller.
From this model on, the Fit Hybrid began featuring
a more powerful engine.
Which reminds me, have you heard of the Civic?
It's another Honda compact car.
Like the Fit, the Civic is a front-wheel-drive
compact.

And it drives just like a sports car!
detailRows.zh:
Honda Fit是日本最著名的紧凑型汽车之一。
到2013年第三代车型首次亮相时，仅在日本就
卖出了200万台！

它是一款常青畅销的车型！
从这个车型开始，Fit Hybrid开始配备更强大的引擎。
这让我想起了另一台车——你知道 “Civic”吗？
也是Honda的紧凑型车。
与Fit一样，老款Civic是一款前轮驱动的紧凑型车......

但它开起来就像一辆跑车！\

detailRows.speaker: Stella
detailRows.en:
This Demio is Mazda’s entry in the compact
car marketplace.

It was sold outside of Japan as the "Mazda2"
and it proved to be a big hit.
So the car was reintroduced to the Japanese market in 2019
with that very name.

Mazda is famous for its beautiful rear-wheel sports cars...

...and its legendary race cars that have won titles
the world over.
I'm sure that you'll run into one eventually!
detailRows.zh:
这款Demio是Mazda对紧凑型汽车市场的贡献。

实际上它在日本以外被称为“Mazda2”......
以至于它在2019年重新进入日本市场时，也叫回了这个名字！

Mazda旗下的名车既有优雅的后轮驱动跑车......

也有在全世界范围包揽冠军头衔的传奇赛车。
我相信你以后会遇到一辆这样的车！

detailRows.speaker: Stella
detailRows.en:
When the Mini was born in 1959, it revolutionized the world
of compact front-wheel-drive cars.
Designed by the English engineer Alec Issigonis...

...it sported a uniquely positioned engine and gearbox.

This maximized the space-saving potential of its
front-wheel-drive layout.
The result was a small and fast car with a roomy interior.
The Mini's historic front-wheel drive layout is now
widely referred to as an "Issigonis" layout.

And why shouldn't it be? It was designed by the
brilliant engineer after all.
detailRows.zh:
当Mini于1959年诞生时，它彻底改变了小型前轮驱动汽车的世界。
此车由英国工程师亚历克·伊斯戈尼斯设计……

它的引擎和变速箱安装的位置非常独特，

最大限度地发挥了前轮驱动布局节省空间的潜力。
因此造就了一辆小而快的汽车，具有宽敞的内部空间。
Mini的历史性前轮驱动布局现在被广泛称为“伊斯戈尼斯”布局。

这并不奇怪。毕竟它就是由这位杰出的工程师设计的！

detailRows.speaker: Stella
detailRows.en:
Did you know that the Volkswagen Beetle and the Porsche 911
have some common linkages?

The Beetle was designed by Dr. Ferdinand Porsche,
the founder of Porsche Automobiles.
It sports a horizontally-opposed engine at the back of the
car that drives the rear wheels...

Yes, precisely! It's a rear-engine, rear-wheel-drive car!
Dr. Porsche carried design elements from the Beetle over to
the first Porsche sports car, the Porsche 356...

...and later the Porsche 911.
What started out as a small people's car
ended up as a genuine sports car.

While there may be a world of difference
between the two...

...the fact that they share a horizontally-opposed engine,
RR-layout and the same creator is truly fascinating!
detailRows.zh:
你知道大众甲壳虫和保时捷911之间有一些
共同的联系吗？

甲壳虫是由费迪南德·保时捷博士设计的，他同时也是
保时捷汽车的创始人。
甲壳虫的车身后部配置了一台水平对置引擎，用于驱动后轮……

这使它成为了名副其实的后置引擎、后轮驱动车型！
保时捷博士后来将甲壳虫的设计元素应用到了第一辆保时捷跑车，
保时捷356……

以及后来的保时捷911上。
可以这么说，最初的小型民用汽车设计最终却变成了真正的跑车。

虽然现在两者之间可能有天壤之别……

但它们都采用水平对置引擎、后置后驱布局，并且
发明者都是同一个人的事实确实耐人寻味！

detailRows.speaker: Stella
detailRows.en:
Along with the German Beetle and the British Mini,
this Italian FIAT 500…

...is one of the most iconic European small cars in history.
It may be the smallest of its rivals...

...but it can seat four passengers, and its feisty little engine
is capable of thrilling speeds.
Its splendid exterior is owing to the handiwork of famed
FIAT engineer Dante Giacosa.

He also penned the underlying design.
Giacosa created many great cars for FIAT, and I'm sure
you'll come across them in time!
detailRows.zh:
与德国的Beetle和英国的MINI一样，
这辆意大利的FIAT 500……

是欧洲历史上最具代表性的紧凑型车之一。
和其竞争对手相比，它可能是体型最小的……

但它可以容纳四名乘客，
而且其强劲的小引擎能够达到惊人的速度。
它华丽的外观由著名的FIAT工程师
但特·吉奥科萨亲手打造，

他还包揽了车辆的内饰设计。
吉奥科萨为FIAT创造了许多台伟大的汽车，
你会逐渐发现这些瑰宝的。

detailRows.speaker: Stella
detailRows.en:
The long and storied history of Japanese kei cars
has seen many sporty versions of the genre.
And the Honda Beat stood out because
it was mid-engine and a convertible!
While the NSX may be Honda’s original
mid-engine sports car...

...the Beat boasts the same front/rear
weight distribution.
No one ever imagined a kei car with a
centrally located engine and an open body...

...that is, until Honda created the Beat!
detailRows.zh:
在日式轻型车漫长而丰富的历史上，
出现过许多这种小型跑车。
这款Honda Beat因为采用敞篷设计而显得独树一帜！
Beat采用了与Honda旗下设计出众的中置跑车NSX

近似的配重平衡，
并且在中置布局上安装了一款开放式单体车壳车身……

这也使它成为了世界上第一款采用这种设计的车型！<

detailRows.speaker: Stella
detailRows.en:
When it comes to genuine kei sportscars…

This Suzuki Cappuccino is truly a legend.
It has a front-engine, rear-wheel-drive layout,
making it an ‘FR’ car.

Lift up its bonnet and you’ll find that its engine
is mounted near the centre of the car.

That alone should convince you that
it’s a real sportscar!
Released in 1991, the Cappuccino...

Is often grouped with its competitors,
the Mazda AZ-1 and Honda Beat.
Combing their initials, the three may be referred to
as the ‘A-B-C’ of kei sportscars.
detailRows.zh:
如果要讨论最正宗的轻型跑车……

这款Suzuki Cappuccino就是真正的传奇。
它采用前置引擎、后轮驱动布局，也就是所谓的“前置
后驱”车。

抬起它的引擎盖，你会发现它的引擎位置更贴近车身的
正中。

这就是它作为真正跑车的明证！
这款Cappuccino在1991年上市……

常被拿来和它的竞争者Mazda AZ-1和Honda Beat相提并论。
如果把这三款车的型号名称首字母连在一起，就形成了
轻型跑车的“A-B-C”，代表了最基础的车型。

detailRows.speaker: Stella
detailRows.en:
Oh, I’ve seen this car before in a "Fast & Furious" film.
It’s the Toyota Supra.
As the ancestor of the GR Supra, it has a special
place in Toyota’s sports-car history.
And there’s something really neat about
its emblem, too.

It was actually inspired by the art of
Japanese calligraphy.|
detailRows.zh:
啊，我以前见过这款车，是在《速度与激情》电影里。
这是一辆Toyota Supra啊。
它是GR Supra的始祖，在Toyota的跑车历史上
拥有非常特殊的地位。
而且它的车标设计也非常简洁。

这个设计的灵感好像是来源于日本的书法！-

detailRows.speaker: Stella
detailRows.en:
This is an Abarth car—you can tell straightaway
from the ‘scorpion’ emblem.
Abarth is one of the most storied brands
in motorsport history.

It was established by Carlo Abarth...

Who began his career as a racer and engineer of
two- and four-wheel vehicles in the 1920s...
And later had success as a tuner for FIAT.

Today, an Abarth 595 that is based on the old FIAT 500
will fetch a pretty penny!
By the way, about that scorpion emblem...

It comes from the fact that Carlo Abarth was born
in November, making him a Scorpio!
detailRows.zh:
从这个“蝎子”的标志你就能一眼看出，这是一辆Abarth的车。
Abarth是汽车历史上最富传奇色彩的品牌之一。

这个品牌由卡洛·阿巴斯创立。

他在上世纪20年代以赛车手和两轮及四轮车辆工程师的
身份开始了自己的职业生涯……
随后，他因为对FIAT车辆的优异调校而闻名于世。

时至今日，一辆基于老款FIAT 500改装的Abarth 595
依然能卖出高价！
哦，顺带一说，它之所以用蝎子作为车标……

是因为卡洛·阿巴斯出生于十一月，所以是天蝎座！~

detailRows.speaker: Stella
detailRows.en:
In Japan, where minivans enjoy tremendous popularity,
the Toyota Alphard is the one everyone has their eye on.
One reason for its popularity is its extremely luxurious nature,
in equipment and quality.
Ever since the original model was introduced in 2002, the Alphard
has remained true to its "luxury minivan" identity.

And the 2015 third-generation model took that
premium identity to new heights.
This Executive Lounge was the third-generation Alphard’s
top-of-the-line grade.

The oversized second-row seats, unique to this version,
were the very definition of comfort!
detailRows.zh:
在日本，厢式旅行车可是非常热门的车型。
而且更夸张的是，好像每个人都想拥有一辆Toyota Alphard。
这辆车广受欢迎的一个理由
就是借助设计和配置散发出“豪车”的风范。
自从这个型号在2002年推出第一代之后，Alphard
就始终保持着自己“豪华厢式旅行车”的定位……

而2015年的第三代更是抓住了豪华车的精髓。
这辆Executive Lounge版本是第三代Alphard的顶配，

配备有专属的超大尺寸后排座椅，
绝对是无可置疑的舒适性的天花板了！

detailRows.speaker: Stella
detailRows.en:
If you’re looking for a stylish hatchback, you can’t
go wrong with the MAZDA3.
The MAZDA3 comes in two body types: a 5-door hatchback
and a 4-door sedan.

That said, the fact that they have so few shared parts
is proof of their purposeful design.
Take the smooth roof line of the hatchback—it’s so beautiful
that Mazda went and marketed it as a fastback.
What’s more, this MAZDA3 fastback comes in a
"burgundy selection" grade!

From the seats to the interior panels, everything in this
package is expressed in a most distinctive shade of red.
detailRows.zh:
如果你想要找一辆外观时尚的掀背车，选MAZDA3准没错！
MAZDA3提供两种车身版本选择：5门掀背版和4门轿车版。

尽管同属一个车型，但二者之间的通用配件却不多，
这也证明了它们的设计目标性非常明确。
以掀背版本为例，它那流畅的车顶线条非常优雅，而Mazda
也特意将其宣传为“斜背车”。
另外，这款MAZDA3掀背版还供应“勃艮第红”版！

从座椅到内饰板材，一切配置
都采用了最特别的红色调处理。

detailRows.speaker: Stella
detailRows.en:
The Super Formula? Of course I know it. It’s a world famous
Japanese formula race series.
The beginning of genuine motorsports in Japan is said
to date back to the 1960s.

The first Japanese Grand Prix was held in 1963.
Back then, the track was dominated by modified road cars,
or "touring cars" to be precise.

Since then, Japan has also slowly crafted its own
formula race scene.
For this to happen, Japanese Grand Prix drivers
had to study abroad...

...at famous race schools in England, where they learned
the ins and outs of formula racing.
After that, they teamed up with Japanese automotive
engineers to develop Japan’s first formula cars.
detailRows.zh:
超级方程式？我当然知道啦。这是一项
全球知名的日本方程式系列赛。
据说日本真正的赛车运动始于二十世纪六十年代。

第一届日本大奖赛在1963年就举办了。
在当时，统治赛道的多是些经过改装的公路车，
或者更准确说是“房车”。

自那时起，日本就一直在逐步地搭建
属于自己的方程式赛车领域。
为了实现这一目的，日本大奖赛的车手们纷纷走出国门……

在英格兰的著名赛车学校学习，并在那里
了解到了方程式赛车的方方面面。
学成归来后，他们便与日本汽车工程师们合作，
打造出了日本的第一款方程式赛车。

detailRows.speaker: Stella
detailRows.en:
This is a second-generation Subaru Impreza STi.

In Japan, the Impreza STi and the Mitsubishi Lancer Evo
were known to have an intense rivalry.
The second-generation STi featured numerous upgrades, none more
evident than in this 2004 model.
Notice how the rear wheel arch appears to be slightly
widened?

This was done to give the car wide tires and wheels.
The suspension and engine were also improved.
This car certainly turned heads after its time trial run
at the Nürburgring in Germany.

It was the first Impreza to complete a lap
in less than eight minutes!
detailRows.zh:
这是一台二代Subaru Impreza STi。

在日本，Impreza STi和Mitsubishi Lancer Evo是
一对有名的宿敌。
第二代STi引入了多项升级，在这台2004版的车型上
体现得淋漓尽致。
注意到后轮拱看起来更宽了一些吗？

这是通过加宽轮毂和使用宽胎来实现的，悬挂和引擎
也得到了相应升级。
此车在德国的纽博格林赛道上试测，拿到了令人侧目的结果。

毕竟，这是首台在八分钟内跑完这条赛道的Impreza！

detailRows.speaker: Stella
detailRows.en:
A car with more than 50 years of history and over fifty-million
units sold worldwide...

Is there any other car that can make such a claim
than the Toyota Corolla?
It’s a brand that has surely made memories
for countless of people everywhere.
The GR Corolla is a sports car built by Toyota’s
GR division.

What’s more, this model was a special variant penned by
Toyota’s master driver Morizo!
To reduce weight, the rear seats of the base 5-seat model
were removed.
It also featured a specially-tuned engine and transmission.
Without a doubt, this genuine sports car is sure to please.
detailRows.zh:
超过50年生产历史和全球销量超过五千万辆的记录——

除了丰田卡罗拉，还有哪款车能够
拥有如此辉煌的战绩？
这个品牌无疑给世界各地的无数用户留下了美好的回忆。
这款GR卡罗拉是丰田旗下GR品牌出品
的一款跑车。

更重要的是，这是由丰田的大师级赛车手“Morizo”
亲自设计的特殊版本！
为了减轻重量，这款5座基础车型的后排座椅被全部移除。
此外，它还配备了经过特殊调校的引擎和变速箱。
毫无疑问，这款纯正跑车一定会带来愉悦的驾驶体验。+

detailRows.speaker: Stella
detailRows.en:
Did you know that in Europe, they have an annual contest
for the world’s most beautiful car?

Well, the Mazda RX-Vision took home the "Most Beautiful
Concept Car" award at this contest in 2016.
The event draws crowds of car enthusiasts from all over
the world to pick the most beautiful cars of the year.

The RX-Vision was the first car by an Asian manufacturer
to win this award.
Penned by Ikuo Maeda, it was a car that left its mark on not
only Mazda but Japanese sports-car design in general.
detailRows.zh:
你知道吗？在欧洲，每年都会举办一场评选
全球最美汽车的比赛。

2016年，Mazda RX-Vision凭借其卓越设计夺得了
“最美概念车”的殊荣。
这项赛事汇聚了来自世界各地的汽车专家，他们负责
从众多参赛车辆中评选出年度最具魅力的汽车。

RX-Vision是赢得该奖项的汽车中，首款由亚洲制造商制造的汽车。
设计师前田育男倾注心血的成果不仅在Mazda的历史上
留下了深刻印记，同时也对日本跑车设计产生了深远影响。

detailRows.speaker: Stella
detailRows.en:
The Urus was the first SUV designed by Lamborghini.
Of course, Lamborghini is a name normally associated
with supercars, like the Countach.

But the first car it built after being founded in 1963...

...was a 2-door grand tourer that offered speed, comfort,
and class.
It was called the 350 GT, a large coupe with a V-12 engine
mounted up front.
Since the 1970s, Lamborghini has built many elegant GT
and 4-door sedan concepts, although they were not for sale.
This means that Lamborghini never forgot about its GT roots!
And the Urus was proof of that.
detailRows.zh: Urus是Lamborghini设计的第一款SUV。 如今，人们通常会将Lamborghini与各种超级跑车 联系在一起，如Countach…… 不过在1963年创立之初，它打造的第一款车…… 是一款强调速度、舒适性和档次的双门豪华旅行车。 它就是采用前置V12引擎的大型双门跑车——350 GT。 自从1970年代起，Lamborghini曾设计了多款优雅的豪华旅行车 和4门概念轿车，但从未正式发售。 看来Lamborghini从未忘记自己起步于豪华旅行车的根源！ 这款Urus就是确凿的证明！

detailRows.speaker: Stella
detailRows.en:
This is the second-generation Audi R8.
You can tell straight away because...
...the "side-blades" on the body are split into two
and the graphics are slightly more compact.
Then there’s the engine. This model only came with a V-10,
the most powerful being the "V10 plus."

Given how slick the car looks, you’d be surprised to know
how much oomph it has!
detailRows.zh:
相信你第一眼就认出来了，这是一辆第二代Audi R8。
其车身上的“侧刃”分成了两片，整体图形
也变得更加紧凑。
另外还要提到全系列搭配的V10引擎，绝对不容小觑，
其中性能最强大的型号就是这台“V10 plus”。

这款车的外形非常利落，也会让你不禁想象
它的动力有多么生猛！

detailRows.speaker: Stella
detailRows.en:
Do you know the history of AMG?
It started out as a company that built racing engines.

At the helm were two engineers.

They were Hans Werner Aufrecht and Erhard Melcher.

These two worked in the race-engine forge
of Daimler-Benz.
When Benz took a hiatus from motorsport...

...Aufrecht and Melcher decided to go into
business together.

They founded their engineering company out of
Aufrecht’s house in Großaspach, Germany.
Taking the initials of Aufrecht, Melcher, and Großaspach,
they christened their company "AMG."

That was in back in 1967!
detailRows.zh:
你了解AMG的历史吗？
它起初只是一家专门打造赛车引擎的公司……

由两名工程师汉斯·维尔纳·奥夫莱西特……

和埃尔哈特·梅尔赫执掌。

二人曾经在戴姆勒-奔驰的赛车引擎铸造厂工作。
当奔驰暂时远离赛车运动后……

奥夫莱西特和梅尔赫决定共同创业。

于是他们在奥夫莱西特位于德国格罗萨斯帕赫
的家里创办了他们的工程公司。
他们从奥弗莱希特、梅尔赫和
格罗萨斯帕赫三个名字中

各取一个首字母，为公司起名为“AMG”。

那是在1967年！

detailRows.speaker: Stella
detailRows.en:
I know this Civic very well!

It's the car known as the "Sports Civic" from the 1990s
—the fifth-generation "EG" model to be precise.
The "Sports" moniker alone should tell you that it’s fast,
but its engine design and sound are second to none.

You often see these cars tuned in all manner of ways.
What do I like best about tuning a Sports Civic, you ask?

The engine swaps, of course!

For example, a Honda K-engine with a large displacement
will give you great sound, speed, and power.
But my favorite would have to be the Type R
B-engine.

It might not offer as much power as the K-engine,
but its roar is simply unforgettable!
detailRows.zh:
我对这种类型的思域非常熟悉！

准确来说，这是一辆1990年代生产，被称为“运动思域”
的第五代“EG”思域。
从其昵称中的“运动”二字就能看出它的速度有多快，
此外它的引擎设计和声浪也无出其右。

你经常会看到这款车被调校成各种不同的形态。
你知道关于运动思域的调校，我最爱哪一方面吗？

当然是更换改装引擎啦！

比如说，大排量的本田K-引擎可以给你澎湃的声浪、
风驰电掣的速度和充沛的动力。
不过我的最爱还是Type R B-引擎。

虽然动力不如K-引擎，但它的咆哮声绝对令人
终生难忘！

detailRows.speaker: Stella
detailRows.en:
One of my all-time favorite cars is an 1980s icon—
the fourth-generation Civic.
With its powerful engine, this Civic Si
was the pride of the hatchback pack.
Civics of this era ranged from smart and chic sedans
to uniquely designed 5-door wagons like the Shuttle.
And each was beautiful
in its own way!
detailRows.zh:
我的毕生挚爱之一诞生于80年代
——那就是第四代Civic。
这台搭载强劲引擎的Civic Si掀背版，堪称
家族的门面担当。
这一时期的Civic车系从优雅时髦的四门轿车，
到造型独特的Shuttle五门瓦罐车，应有尽有。
每款车型都绽放着独特的美！

detailRows.speaker: Stella
detailRows.en:
The Peugeot 205 is fondly remembered as a
best-selling compact car.
A perennial favorite, it enjoyed a 15-year production run
from 1983 to 1998...

...selling more than five million units, becoming the most
successful model in Peugeot’s history.
This GTI hot hatch is powered by a spirited engine and
delivers an exhilarating driving experience.
It shares its lineage with the iconic Turbo 16—a legendary
Group B rally homologation special.{
detailRows.zh:
Peugeot 205作为一款畅销紧凑型车而被人们铭记。
从1983投产到1998年的15年间，这款车持续常青，

全球销量更是突破500万台，创下Peugeot的销售记录。
这台GTI小钢炮不仅动力澎湃，
更拥有行云流水般的操控体验。
它与为B组拉力赛而生的传奇认证车型Turbo 16
更是同宗同源。

detailRows.speaker: Stella
detailRows.en:
Peugeot cars are distinguished by their numerical names.

Like the 205 or the 306, they all seem to follow
a three-digit pattern.
The history behind this convention actually dates back
to 1921 with the 201.
Today, it’s not uncommon to see four-digit names,
but did you know that those are reserved for SUVs?

This "2008" is a compact SUV.
As is to be expected of a Peugeot, it's perky and nimble,
just as it should be!
detailRows.zh:
Peugeot的车可以从它们名字中的数字区分开来。

例如“205”或“306”，似乎所有车名都遵循着三位数命名格式。
这一传统其实可追溯到1929年的“201”！
如今，它旗下以四位数命名的车型并不少见，
但你或许不知道这些是专门留给SUV的。

这台“2008”就是一款紧凑型SUV。
与其它Peugeot车型相似，这台车活力十足，灵活敏捷，
一切都恰到好处！

detailRows.speaker: Stella
detailRows.en:
When I hear the name Citroën, the first thing that comes
to mind is this BX.
Who could forget those straight lines, that boxy shape?

Such a unique-looking car could only come from the Italian
design house Bertone!
From the Break station wagon to the sports-car version,
it was also a car rich in variation.
Launched in 1982, it proved to be a lasting success,
staying in production for over a decade.
All told, around 2.3 million units were produced
across the entire lineup!
detailRows.zh:
一听到Citroën，我首先想到的就是这款BX。
有谁会不记得它那笔直的线条和方方正正的造型呢？

而拥有如此独特外观的汽车，毫无疑问只会出自
意大利设计公司Bertone之手！
从Break旅行车到跑车，这款车的衍生车型十分丰富。
1982年问世的BX堪称车坛常青树，生产周期
横跨十余载……
全系产量约达230万台！

detailRows.speaker: Stella
detailRows.en:
Renault boasts a rich and storied legacy that
stretches back to the 19th century.

Introduced in 1961, this Renault 4—referred to as “the Quatrelle”
by the French—holds a cherished place in that heritage.
After all, it was the first Renault to
feature front-wheel drive.

For a company that had built its reputation on
front-engine, rear-wheel-drive machines...
...this marked a significant departure with a sizable interior
and greater ease of operation.
Thankfully, the Quatrelle was a big success!
This bestseller remained in production for more than 30 years
and amassed global sales of more than 8 million units!
detailRows.zh:
雷诺拥有悠久且丰富的历史，
可以追溯到上上个世纪。

这款于1961年推出的雷诺4，被法国人亲切地称之为
“四翼”，在这段历史中占据着举足轻重的地位。
要知道，它是第一款采用前轮驱动技术的雷诺汽车。

对于雷诺这样一家以
前置发动机、后轮驱动布局车型而闻名的公司而言……
这确实是一个重大转变，但这种变更带来了更大的空间
和更出色的操控性能。
值得庆幸的是，四翼取得了巨大的成功！
作为一款畅销车型，它的生产周期超过了30年，
全球销量突破了800万辆！

detailRows.speaker: Stella
detailRows.en:
Did you know that the Kangoo was originally designed
as a commercial vehicle?

With its generous cargo space, this is a machine that, for many,
became a trusted co-worker.
But not all Kangoos were built for hard labor.

Some serve as passenger cars, offering a welcome blend of style
and comfort, and they’re every bit as popular.
Renault, after all, has a long tradition of crafting
iconic utility vehicles.

Among them was a commercial version of the Renault 4
from the 1960s.
Another was the Express, derived from
the second-generation Renault 5.
detailRows.zh:
你知道吗？Kangoo最初其实是
按商用车来设计的。

凭借宽敞的载物空间，对很多人来说，
它简直堪称得力的工作伙伴！
不过，并非所有Kangoo都是为了干活而生的。

也有一部分乘用车版本具备时尚外观
和舒适性能，人气也非常高。
多年来，Renault推出了不少大名鼎鼎的
“工作用车”车型。

其中就包括1960年代Renault 4的商用版本。
还有一款是Express，它是基于第二代Renault 5打造的！

detailRows.speaker: Stella
detailRows.en:
This may look like an ordinary R34 GT-R, but I can
recognize its true identity at a glance.
This is the BNR34 N1 base, built by the legendary
Japanese tuning house, Mine’s!
Mine’s is one of the oldest and most respected tuners
of the Skyline GT-R lineage.

Its creations embody the perfect balance of power, handling,
and speed, whether on the street or the circuit!

This is a machine every collector dreams of owning.
Among Mine’s many GT-R masterpieces, the BNR34 N1
base stands out as truly exceptional!
detailRows.zh:
这看似是一台普通的R34 GT-R，
但我当即就辨认出了它的不凡来历。
它竟然是著名日本改装厂Mine’s出品的
BNR34 GT-R N1 base！
Mine’s是历史最悠久、最受推崇的
Skyline GT-R改装厂商之一。

无论是街道驰骋还是赛道竞速，
他们的作品都展现出极致的动力、操控与速度！

这无疑是每位收藏家心驰神往的梦想座驾。
而在Mine’s众多GT-R改装杰作中，
BNR34 GT-R N1 base堪称真正的非凡之作！

detailRows.speaker: Stella
detailRows.en:
The 296 GTB is one of Ferrari’s most iconic GT3 racers.
Its name is derived directly from the numbers associated
with its engine.

Specifically, it features a 2.9-liter displacement
and 6 cylinders.

Combine the two and you get “296."
I’ve heard that Ferrari used a similar naming convention
for several models between 1970 and 1990.

I can’t say exactly how many, but I certainly plan to find out!
detailRows.zh:
296 GTB是Ferrari最具标志性的GT3赛车。
其命名取自引擎的核心参数。

具体而言，该车搭载2.9升排量的6缸引擎。

两者结合便构成了“296”的命名！
我听说，在1970至1990年间，
Ferrari还以类似的方式命名了其他车型。

具体数量我一时说不上来，但我一定会查个明白！

detailRows.speaker: Stella
detailRows.en:
Polestar is an electric vehicle brand from Sweden.

Among its lineup is the hybrid Polestar 5...
...a four-door GT that produces more than 800 horsepower!
You know, Polestar has a bit more history behind it
than meets the eye.

It originally served as Volvo’s racing division in the mid-1990s.

The team even collaborated with Volvo to develop several
road-going sports cars.
In 2017, Polestar branched out on its own as a high-performance
electric vehicle brand.
So now you know a little more about Polestar,
a Swedish company with deep racing roots!
detailRows.zh:
Polestar是源自瑞典的电动汽车品牌。

其产品阵容中包含这款混动版Polestar 5……
这是一款动力超过800匹马力的四门GT车型！
事实上，“Polestar”的品牌底蕴远比表面所见更为深厚。

九十年代中期，它曾担任Volvo的赛车研发部门。

甚至协助Volvo打造了多款公路版运动车型。
2017年，品牌正式独立，转型为高性能电动汽车制造商。
总之，现在你应该对Polestar有点初步概念了——
这是一家植根赛车传统的瑞典企业！?

detailRows.speaker: Stella
detailRows.en:
The Mazda RX-7 is synonymous with rotary-engine sports cars.
This is the 3rd-gen model from 1991, also known
as the 'FD.'

It notably bears the name and emblem of
Mazda’s former luxury vehicle division, 'ɛ̃fini.'
The FD RX-7 is a light and powerful car.

Pressing down on the accelerator, you immediately
feel the limitless motive power of its rotary engine.
And its low, wide stance becomes apparent as soon
as you get behind the wheel.
Seen from the outside, it’s a thing of beauty,
and a legend in the annals of Mazda history.
detailRows.zh:
Mazda RX-7是转子引擎跑车的代名词。
眼前这款是1991年推出的第三代车型，代号是“FD”。

其车名与徽标源自Mazda旗下的前豪华车部门——
“ɛ̃fini”，可谓声名显赫。
尽管FD RX-7身轻如燕，动力却相当澎湃。

当你深踩油门，转子引擎那源源不绝的强劲动力
便会瞬间涌现。
而一旦坐进驾驶舱，其低趴、宽体的战斗姿态更是展露无遗。
从旁观赏，它堪称一件工业艺术品，
更是Mazda品牌史上的一段不朽传奇。

detailRows.speaker: Stella
detailRows.en:
Ah yes, the second-generation Renault Captur.
The C-shaped motif in the front and rear lights...

...is a signature element of Renault design.
Not only does this car looks sharp, it drives with confidence.
It’s easy to see why it became a bestselling compact SUV...

...across the European market.
The original Captur outsold its compact SUV rivals in European
markets year after year.
And this second-generation model, introduced in 2019,
proved just as popular.
detailRows.zh:
没错，这正是第二代Renault Captur。
其前后灯组采用的C形设计元素……

乃是Renault品牌的标志性语言。
它不仅颜值出众，驾控感受同样可圈可点。

无怪乎它能成为欧洲市场最畅销的紧凑型跨界SUV。
初代Captur的年销量便已傲视同级，
而这台于2019年推出的第二代车型，
其热度更是丝毫未减！

detailRows.speaker: Stella
detailRows.en:
With its frog-eyed expression and compact body,
this first-generation Twingo is simply adorable!
Unexpectedly spacious inside, its seats can be reclined
to a full-flat position.

Say, do you know how it got its funny name?

It’s a play on three dance styles—the twist, swing,
and tango.
The Twingo had some limited-edition models
created in collaboration with fashion brands.

The 1993 model, this first-generation gem is a rare prize
for collectors!
detailRows.zh:
蛙眼大灯和小巧的车身，第一代Twingo就是那么可爱！
它的内部空间出乎意料的宽裕，
座位甚至可以做到完全放平。

对了，你知道这个奇奇怪怪的名字是怎么来的吗？

它其实是三种舞蹈名称的变化组合——Twist（扭扭舞）、
Swing（摇摆舞）与Tango（探戈）。
Twingo还曾与多个时尚品牌联名推出限量特别版。

这款1993年的初代车型，
如今早已成为收藏家们竞相追捧的珍品！

detailRows.speaker: Stella
detailRows.en:
So this is the Yangwang U9, the luxury EV from BYD Auto.
The first supercar from the Chinese maker,
it packs an impressive 1,300 BHP as standard.

Would you look at that rear wing? It looks like it came
straight off a race car!
With four independent motors powering each wheel,
it’s a cornering machine.

And its unique active suspension is absolutely packed
with advanced tech.
The supercar of the future, the U9 makes me giddy
just talking about it!
detailRows.zh:
眼前这台车，就是来自比亚迪的豪华电动汽车
——仰望U9。
作为这家中国车企推出的首款超跑，
它标配高达1300hp的澎湃动力。

瞧瞧那个尾翼，简直就是赛车上原装移植过来的！
四台独立电机各自驱动一个车轮，
赋予了它极为出色的过弯能力。

而那套独特的主动式悬挂系统，
更是塞满了各种前沿技术。
这辆展现未来趋势的超级跑车仰望U9，
光是谈论参数规格，就足以令人心潮澎湃！

detailRows.speaker: Hideo Kodama
detailRows.en:
This is one of Toyota’s best designs in recent years.

It's been over a decade since this car
hit the streets.

Yet to see it today, you’d think it were novel.
The low height and its double-bubble roof result in a drag
coefficient of 0.28, allowing for a smooth ride.

From the significantly canted windscreen...

...to the drastically sloping rear, this car expresses
a bold, clear vision.!
detailRows.zh:
这辆车是Toyota近些年来最好的设计之一。

其实它也已经出现在街头十多年了……

但今天看到它，
还是有种新鲜感。
Toyota通过压低车身高度和采用双气泡型车顶
成功将阻力系数降低至0.28。这样的车开起来肯定很舒服。

无论是明显下探的挡风玻璃……

还是向后延、并在车尾收束下坠的利落侧面轮廓线，
都让人有耳目一新的良好感受。

detailRows.speaker: Hideo Kodama
detailRows.en:
Don’t let this cheerful little package fool you.
It showcases a high level of product design.

In fact, it's so good it’s timeless.

No wonder the current Cinquecento borrows from it.
Dante Giacosa, FIAT's legendary engineer...

...rose to prominence in 1955 when he created the 600,
Italy’s answer to the post-war compact car.

He then took on the challenge of...

...creating an even better minimally-packaged car.
The result was a rear-engine, super-compact Cinquecento.
Thanks to the intentionally flared wheel arches,
the car appears to be in constant motion.
The yawning hood lid is also quite appealing,
not to mention functional.
detailRows.zh:
千万不要小看这款娇小的车型。它表现出了极高的
产品设计水平，

甚至堪称永恒经典。

难怪最新款的500也借鉴了它的设计。
菲亚特的传奇工程师但特·吉奥科萨……

在1955年设计出了600，为意大利汽车行业拿出了
战后紧凑型汽车的标准答案，也借此声名鹊起。

然后他勇敢地接受了更大的挑战……

开始打造一款更加优秀的低配置车型。
最终他开发出了这辆后置引擎、空间超紧凑的500。
在他的巧手勾勒下，这款车采用了外扩式轮拱，
让它呈现出一种始终处于运动状态下的观感。
它宽大的引擎盖也拥有一种慵懒闲适的吸引力，而性能
自然也不容小觑。

detailRows.speaker: Hideo Kodama
detailRows.en:
At a time when Giugiaro was designing many production cars,
he put his signature styling technique on full display...

...on this Lancia Delta.

It reflects the dignified brand image of Lancia,
and gives off a very positive feel.
During the 1970s, Lancia dominated rally races
with a car probably everyone is familiar with, the Stratos.

Lancia most likely intended for the Delta to be
the spiritual successor of the Stratos.

When comparing it to the rally bred Stratos...

...the Delta improved on the 2-box hatchback-sedan theme.
The fat 16-inch 205 tires and the huge, blistered fenders
provided the car with the prowess of a wild animal.

You can see how a tame hatchback can transform
into a fierce rally machine.

I do like this kind of design approach as well.
detailRows.zh:
有一段时间，乔治亚罗的设计产量大增，推出了多款量产车作品，
但他把自己标志性的造型技术……

……充分展现在这辆蓝旗亚Delta中。

它不仅反映出蓝旗亚高贵庄重的品牌形象，
更给人以积极进取的感觉。
在20世纪70年代，蓝旗亚以一辆被所有人熟知的好车
主宰了拉力赛，那就是Stratos。

蓝旗亚可能原本打算让Delta成为Stratos的精神继承者。

与为拉力赛而生的Stratos不同……

Delta的研发基础车型是一台两厢掀背轿车。
蓝旗亚用16英寸的205宽胎和外扩的特大号挡泥板
赋予了Delta如同野生动物一般无畏的野性。

也让你亲眼目睹一辆温驯的掀背车
是如何被转化为一辆狂暴的拉力赛车的。

顺带一提，我本人非常欣赏这种设计方法。

detailRows.speaker: Hideo Kodama
detailRows.en:
At first glance, it appears to be a normal sedan, but look
inside, and you'll realize that this car was created for speed.

This is the category that's referred to as "muscle cars."

This Challenger R/T is like the Barracuda
because it's smaller in size.

However, the large front opening
and the kicked-up rear quarter...
...are aggressive design cues that match the car's character.

Power is provided by a HEMI engine.
On the hood is a protruding air scoop
called the "Shaker."

When it shakes, it declares the enormous power it possesses.
If you include the optional rear spoiler, the Challenger R/T
is a muscle car that's sure to catch anyone's eye.
detailRows.zh:
如果不仔细看，你会以为它是一辆普通的轿车。
但坐进驾驶舱之后，你就会明白这是一台速度机器。

这个类别的车通常归类为“肌肉车”。

这辆Challenger R/T很像梭鱼，只是尺寸小一号。

不过它那宽大的前脸开口和
拱起的后侧围板……
无不在体现该车极富侵略性的特征。

此车的动力来自一台HEMI引擎。
引擎盖上的进气口又被车迷们戏称为“抖动器”

这个称号来源于它工作时的抖动噪声，
就像在宣告自己的澎湃动力。
如果再装配上车尾扰流板，
Challenger R/T必定会吸引所有人的目光。

detailRows.speaker: Hideo Kodama
detailRows.en:
The Miura is quite controversial among us designers.

The debate surrounding this car is about the
identity of its true designer.

Some say that the Miura was the creation of
Bertone's Giorgetto Guigiaro...

...while others contend it was his successor,
Marcello Gandini's work.
The overall look of the car is quite advanced for its time,
comparable to that of the Ford GT40, in fact.
