However, what sticks out to me is the detail
of the headlights that stare upward.

This detail can be found on another one of
Guigiaro's products, the FIAT 850 Spider.

Does this make the Miura's true designer, Guigiaro?
I think so.
Regardless, we should all be happy that...

...the first-ever mid-engine Lamborghini
was a car that looked this amazing.
detailRows.zh:
Miura在我们这些设计师当中是个颇具争议的话题。

不过，大家的争论焦点是它的真正设计者究竟是谁。

有的人说是博通的乔盖托·乔治亚罗……

……而另一些人则认为它是博通的后辈马塞罗·甘迪尼的作品。
这辆车的整体外观在当时相当超前，
甚至可以与福特GT40的横空出世相提并论。
然而，最令我印象深刻的是那副朝上的头灯。

在乔治亚罗的另一款作品菲亚特850敞篷上，
也能找到类似的细节。

这是否说明Miura的真正设计师是乔治亚罗？我是这么认为的。
无论如何……

……有史以来的第一辆中置引擎兰博基尼的外观是如此超凡脱俗，
总算没有令人失望。

detailRows.speaker: Hideo Kodama
detailRows.en:
These days, it's rare to see one person's vision result in a
product that reflects his intent to the smallest details.

Setting out to create a fresh car, the genius Gordon Murray
came up with the concept.

He then handed the reins to designer Peter Stevens.
The result is the F1 you see here.
The concept, which became the base for the F1, was for it to
be "a super sports car that could be driven every day."

Some say that the first-generation
Honda NSX served as the benchmark.
The center-forward driving position in a three-seat
configuration helped to balance the car.

...and also keeping the car's height to a low 1140mm.
But the design is well-executed,
without any strangeness to it at all. I do like it.
detailRows.zh:
近几十年来，我们鲜少能看到将设计师的意图
贯彻到每一处细节的作品。

天才设计师戈登·穆雷曾提出过一辆新车的概念构想，

然后将接力棒交到了彼得·史蒂文斯手中。
两人的合作成果就是你眼前的这台F1。
F1的设计初衷，就是创造一辆
“可以日常驾驶的超级跑车”。

还有人说它的设计对标参照物是第一代本田NSX。
这辆车有许多独到之处。例如在三座布局中，
将驾驶员座椅放在前排居中位置，以使重量分配达到最优，

……亦或是将车身高度降到只有1140mm。
迈凯伦在实现设计时做的非常到位，没有一丝不协调感。
我很欣赏这一点。

detailRows.speaker: Hideo Kodama
detailRows.en:
Very Italian in improvisation,
I'm quite taken by...

....the high degree of precision displayed here.
One of the things the Maserati brothers, who sold Maserati
and started OSCA, left behind was...

...the sohc 6-cylinder engine.

The car that used this engine was their grand prix machine.
With that at the foundation, the A6GCS was born.
The car's four driven wheels and various other mechanical parts
are covered by a body that seems to be made of soft cloth.

The volume here is minimal.

This body was the work of the famous
Modena craftsman Fantuzzi.
You can feel the presence of the design language
of the Type 61 Birdcage in this car.

It really excites the soul, this design.
detailRows.zh:
这是非常有意大利风格的即兴演绎，
尤其令我着迷的是……

整台车体现出的高精细度。
当玛莎拉蒂兄弟最终离开公司，创建奥斯卡时，

他们为玛莎拉蒂留下了一件宝藏，
就是这台直列六缸单顶置凸轮轴引擎。

使用这台引擎的是他们的一款大奖赛赛车。
在此基础上，他们开发了A6GCS。
宛若薄绸般轻盈的车身用顺滑的曲线
包覆车轮和其他机械部件……

同时也将车身体积控制在了最低限度。

这正是莫德纳的著名车身制造商凡图奇的手笔。
你可以明显看到它的设计语言和Type 61鸟笼一脉相承。

看到这样的设计，让人从内心深处受到震撼！

detailRows.speaker: Hideo Kodama
detailRows.en:
When you mention the 917, I'm reminded by a particular episode.
Allow me to talk about something that happened in 1968.
At the Eiffel wind tunnel, which opened in Paris in the
19th century, we were in the midst of a project...

...while in the adjacent room,
another car was being tested. That was the 917.

A state-of-the-art advanced racing machine tested at a
turn-of-the-century lab! It was amusingly ironic.
The 917 made its debut at the 1969 Geneva Show.
It was the successor to the 908, and instead of an 8-cylinder
engine, this monster had an air-cooled flat-12.

Depending on the race, the 917 came in different forms.

On high-speed circuits, it wore a long-tail body,

and on tricky courses like the Targa Florio, it had a short tail.
detailRows.zh:
提到917，我正好想起了一个故事。
请容我讲讲1968年发生的一件轶事。
当时我们在十九世纪就设立的巴黎埃菲尔风洞实验室里
，我们的新项目正进行到一半……

这时正好有另一辆车在隔壁接受测试，就是这款917。

一辆采用当时最顶尖科技打造
的比赛机器停放在一座修建于前一个世纪的实验室里！

有一种恍若隔世的反差感。
后来，这款917在1969年的日内瓦车展上首次亮相。
虽然这台动力猛兽是908的继任者，但却没有采用水平对置
八缸引擎，而是换上了一台水平对置十二缸风冷引擎。

此外，这台917还可以根据不同类型的赛事调校为不同形式……

例如在高速赛道上采用长车尾，
在塔格·佛罗热耐力赛这样的蜿蜒赛道上则换上短车尾。ne�t id=1700806 type=9

detailRows.speaker: Hideo Kodama
detailRows.en:
What's interesting about this car is that the bodywork was penned
by a young Giugiaro, who was then the chief designer at Ghia.

It seems so simple, it looks to drawn by a single brush stroke,
thus the shape consists of simple lines and surfaces.

A half century later,
the car still looks fresh and alluring.
It shares the same backbone chassis technology as
the original Vallelunga, with a Ford V-8 housed within.
Access to the mid-mounted engine comes
via a butterfly-type rear hatch.

This detail is also particularly interesting and fun. I like it.
detailRows.zh:
这辆车最令人着迷之处全在于它的车身，
这是由Carrozzeria Ghia后来的首席设计师，

当时才初出茅庐的乔盖托·乔治亚罗执笔设计的。

它的外形如此简洁、仿佛是一笔而就，
因此其形状都为简单的线、面所构成。

在半个世纪后的今天，依然有新鲜感和吸引力。
它采用了与其原型Vallelunga相同的脊骨式车架技术，
搭载Ford V8引擎。
掀开鸥翼式的后备箱盖，就可以看到这台中置引擎。

这个细节特别有趣味。我很喜欢。

detailRows.speaker: Hideo Kodama
detailRows.en:
And the high-performance version of that Golf I is the GTI.

Considered wide at the time, its 175/70R13 tires were covered
 by a special black plastic lip.
Red molding inside the front grille, the GTI had subtle hints
identifying its true nature...

...which made it all the more stylish.
When it comes to hot hatches,
this is a car that I still would like to own.
detailRows.zh:
而Golf I的高性能版本就是这款GTI，

Golf I GTi采用的175/70 R13轮胎在当时被视作宽胎。
设计师特意在轮胎上方增加了一道别致的黑色塑料轮眉，
配合环绕前格栅一周的红色条纹设计，
隐约透露着GTI的本质……

令其更显风采卓然。
在高性能掀背车中，
这是我一直想要收藏的一辆车。>

detailRows.speaker: Hideo Kodama
detailRows.en:
There seems to be a reason behind every detail of this design,
a design with the spirit of rationality.

Yet it possesses irresistible charm.
This is the W194, also known as the 300SL.
It won the Mille Miglia, Grand Prix of Bern,
and the Carrera Panamericana in 1952.

On top of that, it placed 1-2 at Le Mans.
The doors of this car swing upward in
what is known as "gullwing" types.

That term also serves as the nickname for this car.

This design is the result of avoiding the bottom portion
 of the structure of the space frame./
detailRows.zh:
这款车的每一处设计细节似乎皆有所本，既具有理性精神，
又有令人无法抵挡的魅力。

它就是W194，也被称为300SL。
它不仅于1952年的意大利一千英里耐力赛、伯尔尼大奖赛和
Carrera泛美公路拉力赛上豪迈地拿下了冠军头衔，

还在勒芒24小时耐力赛中包揽了前二。
此车的上翻式车门被称作“鸥翼”车门，

由此，“鸥翼”也成为了本车的绰号。

其实，如此设计是为了避免车门与空间车架结构的底部发生冲突。

detailRows.speaker: Hideo Kodama
detailRows.en:
Classical yet elegantly refined, this car is truly
a stunning work of art.

The body is designed by Carrozzeria Touring...

Which had already experimented with a modern
‘pontoon’ shape and integrated fenders.
What made the 8C2900 different...

Was its classic design, which accentuated
its large, sweeping fenders.
Not only did it make a statement among
the Alfa Romeos of its day...

It continues to grab the attention of modern
Italian car enthusiasts.
detailRows.zh:
抛开经典复古的内核不谈，这款车在设计中
将优雅与犀利融为一体，造就了一件毋庸置疑的美妙作品。

Carrozzeria Touring在打造此车身时，
正在实验当时被称作“浮船”的先进设计：

即车身的前后挡泥板连贯为一个整体。
然而，这辆8C 2900还呈现了……

另一种经典设计：上拱的巨大挡泥板。
当然，这一设计元素也被其他Alfa Romeo车型所采用。

毫无疑问这是一辆非常优美的汽车，
甚至比当今的许多Ferrari还要吸睛。

detailRows.speaker: Hideo Kodama
detailRows.en:
Virgil Exner is a designer that I'm quite fond of.

After working with Raymond Loewy, he served as the first
design director for Chrysler from 1953 to 1961.
With designs overflowing with personality, he was the
leading figure in the golden age of Chrysler design.
From all of those creations, the one that stands out to me
is the XNR.

This concept car can be regarded as an answer to sports cars
like the Chevrolet Corvette and Ford Thunderbird.
It features a unique asymmetrical design, with an air scoop,
interior panel and tailfin serving as accents.

One might call the styling of this car outrageous,
but it was very fresh.
detailRows.zh:
维尔基尔·艾克斯勒是我非常欣赏的设计师。

在与雷蒙德·洛威展开合作后，他在1953到1961年之间
担任Chrysler的首位设计总监。
他的设计洋溢着个人风格，
也是Chrysler设计黄金时代的领导人物。
在他所有的创作中，我觉得最杰出的就是这辆XNR。

这款概念车可以称得上是Chrysler对Chevrolet Corvette和
Ford Thunderbird等跑车的回应。
它采用了独特的非对称设计，并通过进气口、
内衬板和尾翼等元素加以强调。

也许有人会认为这样的风格十分离经叛道，
但确实做到了让所有人耳目一新。*

detailRows.speaker: Hideo Kodama
detailRows.en:
The classical proportions and simple shape without needless
frills make this car essentially a sculpture.

Until then, carrozzerie such as Vignale, Ghia
and Zagato produced Ferrari bodies.
In the mid-1950s, the association with Pininfarina deepened,
and their work together increased.

This is a product from that time period.
It's powered by a 4-cylinder engine,
which is mounted well back...

allowing for a long bonnet and the cabin's placement right
in front of the rear wheels.
detailRows.zh:
经典的比例和简单的形状，无需多余的装饰，
这辆车简直就像是一座雕塑。

在此之前，Ferrari的车身大多交由Vignale、Ghia
和Zagato等车身制造商打造。
从1950年代中期起，Ferrari与Pininfarina深化了合作，
二者联合打造的作品也越来越多。

这辆车就是来自那个时代的产品。
它由一部后置安装的4缸引擎提供动力……

因此可以采用更长的引擎罩，座舱则恰到好处地
位于后轮的前方。

detailRows.speaker: Hideo Kodama
detailRows.en:
BMW's EV brand began with the "i."

The company offered two products, an urban commuter,
the i3, and the super high-performance i8.
Both models utilized different power sources, and
each expressed itself with its own form language.

They're quite alluring, no?
Particularly the i3, in addition to the proportions
defined by packaging necessities...

The car is eye-catching, even when it's driving
around town.

The interior also uses sustainable environmental materials.
Everything about the car is thorough.
This kind of approach serves the role of making the user
highly conscious of the environment.

That's why this design is so important. A gold star!
detailRows.zh:
宝马的电动车都以“i”字母起头。

其电动车品牌主打两款产品：作为都市通勤车的i3，
和拥有超强性能的i8。
这两个型号采用了不同的动力源，
而且都以独特的外形设计语言表达出自己的定位。

两辆车是不是都非常诱人？
尤其是这辆i3，在内饰布局和配置上下了不少功夫，
留足了空间……

即便是在城市里驾驶，它也能非常吸睛。

它的内饰采用了可持续环保材料。
此车的一切都透露着缜密、周全。
这样的做法有助于令用户对环保产生深刻的认识。

正因如此，这份独到的设计才显得至关重要。
值得给它颁发一颗金星勋章！

detailRows.speaker: Hideo Kodama
detailRows.en:
This car has the reputation of having a cute design.

But its creators didn't mean for it to be cute. Rather, they
strived to make the design extremely functional.

The end result is effective and quite pleasant.
Based on national automotive standards at the time, Toyota
introduced the 800cc 4-passenger Publica in 1962.

Using that car as a base, the company produced
this sporty model called the Toyota Sports 800.

It's also known as the "Yota Hachi."
Despite having a small engine, the car's look suggests
it drives in a spritely manner...

...with emphasis placed on aerodynamics and lightness.
Shozo Saito, a designer who worked at Kanto Jidosha,
a Toyota subsidiary company...

...played a central role in this design.
detailRows.zh:
这辆车因其可爱的设计而举世闻名……

不过这并非设计师的本意，
在设计时，他们致力于最大化突出功能性。
好在结果非常成功、非常令人满意。
基于当时的国家汽车标准，丰田在1962年
推出了排量800cc的4座汽车帕布利卡。

该公司随后又基于该车型推出了
跑车型号丰田Sports 800，

也就是大家口中的“丰田8”。
尽管排量较小，但得益于设计师将外观设计的重点放在了
空气动力学和轻量化，

让人觉得它拥有活力和动感的操控感。
为丰田子公司“关东自动车工业株式会社”工作的设计师佐藤章蔵

在这辆车的设计工作中担任了举足轻重的角色。

detailRows.speaker: Hideo Kodama
detailRows.en:
In the Japanese automobile world, performing a model change
without dramatically altering the car's design is rare.

But it is carried out quite well here.
The way the windscreen blends into the side glass
gives the impression of a full-face helmet.

This car possesses the same basic design theme
as its predecessor.
What has noticeably changed is...

A more powerful looking one-frame front end
and air intakes on either side.
However, these aren't exaggerated changes,
just effective.
detailRows.zh:
在日本汽车界，在车辆改款时不对原设计进行大幅更新
是非常少见的情况。

不过这款新车的整体感觉非常不错。
它的挡风玻璃与侧面车窗融为一体，
给人一种全罩式头盔的感觉。

新车采用了与前代车型相同的基础设计主题。
最明显的改变在于……

更凸显力量感的单条前格栅
以及车头两侧的进气口。
这些改动不追求夸张的造型变化，只追求效率。.

detailRows.speaker: Hideo Kodama
detailRows.en:
Thanks to the technical know-how of aerodynamics specialist
Malcolm Sayer, this Jaguar D-Type...

...was a dramatic departure for Jaguar in that it embraced
a new dynamic form.
From the XK120 to the XK150, Jaguar had pursued a sort of
French elegance, but the D-Type was a pure revolution.
With a little more than 70 units built, the D-Type began
competing at Le Mans in 1954.

While it came up short in its first year, it won overall
victories in 1955 and 1956, a historic feat for Jaguar.
A truly iconic car, its dynamic design would be carried over
to the XJ13 and, later, the famous E-Type.~
detailRows.zh:
得益于空气动力学专家马尔科姆·塞尔所提供的
技术专业知识，这辆Jaguar D-Type……

与过去的Jaguar截然不同，采用了全新的动力学外观。
从XK120到XK150，Jaguar一直追求某种法式的优雅，
而D-Type的推出带来了一场全方位的革新。
在生产了70余辆后，D-Type于1954年开始参加勒芒比赛。

虽然第一年出师不利，但在55年和56年却大获全胜，
在Jaguar的历史上写下了厚重的一笔。
这是一辆真正标志性的赛车，它的动力学设置
后来在XJ13上得到沿用，并被此后著名的E-type所继承。

detailRows.speaker: Hideo Kodama
detailRows.en:
Aspiring to tone down the D-Type racer somewhat,
car designer Malcolm Sayer...

...gave Jaguar something that was aerodynamic, modern,
and dynamic.

That was this E-Type.
Although its engine was from a XK150 of the previous decade,
this monocoque racer was thoroughly modern.
It’s truly a thing of beauty!
detailRows.zh:
为了推出一辆能与D-Type赛车争辉的新赛车，
汽车设计师马尔科姆·塞尔……

为Jaguar带来了极其富有空气动力学、现代感
和动态感的设计理念。

促成了E-type的诞生。
虽然搭载了一台十多年前的XK150的引擎，这台单体车壳赛车
仍然是一台彻头彻尾的现代赛车。
它真是一件无与伦比美丽的造物！`

detailRows.speaker: Hideo Kodama
detailRows.en:
Following a trend set by the 4CV, the Renault R8 represented the
third generation of the marque’s rear-engine sedans.

Yet the addition of 4-wheel disc brakes made it
uniquely modern.
The R8 Gordini is an upgraded version, complete with
the magic touch of the great Amédée Gordini.

Affectionately called the "Lunchbox," it has blunt lines
and an overall spartan design.
The year 1966 saw the addition of twin headlights.

Dressed in French racing blue, with two white stripes,
the Gordini truly has a charm that differentiates it from the pack.
detailRows.zh:
Renault R8继承4CV的传统，成为该知名品牌的
第三代后置引擎轿车。

四轮碟刹的加入为该系列增添了一抹独特的现代气息。
R8 Gordini是系列中的一款升级版车型，在伟大的设计师
阿梅德·戈迪尼的神奇手笔下，该车的速度进一步提升。

此车因其简洁的线条和整体简约设计
而被亲切地称为“饭盒”。
1966年，该车增加了双前大灯版本。

Gordini车身喷涂法国赛车蓝，配以两条白色条纹，
有一种浑然天成的魅力。

detailRows.speaker: Hideo Kodama
detailRows.en:
A company that’s known to pivot hard, Suzuki sometimes
offers products that really take you by surprise.

The Wagon R was one such example. And so
 was this Swift Sport.
The four corners of its chunky body are fit with relatively
large wheels that speak to its excellent maneuverability.

A small car, it’s equipped with everything it needs
and nothing else.
If you were to see it driving down an Italian street, you’d
think the car was designed by Italians.
detailRows.zh:
Suzuki是一家出了名的“推陈出新”的公司，有时会拿出一些
出人意料的产品。

比如Wagon R轻型车，又比如这款Swift Sport。
这款车的外形方正，在四个轮位安装了大一号的轮毂，
体现出它优异的操控性。

这是一辆麻雀虽小，五脏俱全的小型车，
不少一分，也不多一分。
如果在狭窄的意大利街道看到它驶过，你可能
会觉得它和当地的环境浑然一体。

detailRows.speaker: Hideo Kodama
detailRows.en:
I never knew that the Abarth 1500 Biposto Bertone was also
called the ‘B.A.T. 1’.

But when I consider its round body section
and dual front air intakes...

Its many design links to B.A.T. 5, 7 and 9 become
clear as day.
The gentle tail fins and thin dorsal fin that runs down
the centre of the car are another case in point.
Franco Scaglione, the man who designed this car,
joined Bertone as its chief stylist in 1952.

This car was the product of his wonderfully eccentric
design mind.
The first B.A.T. (Berlinetta Aerodinamica Tecnica), it has
an important place in the history of automotive design.
detailRows.zh:
我之前不知道Abarth 1500 Biposto Bertone
也被称为“B.A.T.1”，

直到看到它圆润的车体和双层前进气口……

它与B.A.T. 5、7和9在设计上的一脉相承
就显露无疑。
柔和的尾翼和纵贯车身的中央长背翼
也体现了这一点。
设计师弗朗哥·斯凯荣内在1952年加入Bertone公司
担任首席设计师。

这款车就是他奇思妙想的产物。
作为第一辆B.A.T.（Berlinetta Aerodinamica Tecnica），
它在汽车设计史上占有相当重要的地位。

detailRows.speaker: Hideo Kodama
detailRows.en:
After Jaguar took a break from racing in 1956, it continued
to work on a successor to the D-Type.
This was during the transition from a front-engine
layout to a mid-engine one.

While Ford gave us Eric Broadley’s Lola GT,
the base model for the GT40...

...and Ferrari gave us the LM...
...Jaguar was committed to building a car with the same
design language as the D-Type.

The result? A refined and aerodynamic prototype
with a V-12 mounted amidships.
The XJ13.

Designed by the famous Malcolm Sayer...
...the XJ13 never raced, but it surely served as
inspiration for the now legendary E-Type.
detailRows.zh:
在1956年短暂退出赛车运动后，捷豹继续投入D-Type
后续型号的研发。
这款车诞生于从前置引擎向中置引擎布局过渡的过程中。

在福特推出GT40的基础车型，
即埃里克·布拉德利设计的罗拉 GT……

以及法拉利推出了LM的同时……
捷豹依然致力于沿袭D-Type的设计语言。

其最终成果是一款精致纯粹、拥有优秀
空气动力学性能、采用中置V12引擎的原型车——
XJ13。

XJ13由著名的马尔科姆·塞尔所设计……
尽管从未参加过任何比赛，但它无疑
为E-Type的开发提供了大量的思路。

detailRows.speaker: Hideo Kodama
detailRows.en:
The Prius caused a great sensation by being
the world’s first mass-produced hybrid car.

But did you know its first-gen design was considered
to be somewhat lacking?
The second-generation model featured a one-motion profile
from its front to its coda tronca rear...

Which became standard for the Prius line, as you can see in
this well-formed third-generation model.
detailRows.zh:
作为全球首款混动汽车，Prius曾引发轰动性的风潮。

不过你知道吗？它的第一代设计被普遍认为有所欠缺，
不够完美。
从第二代车型开始，Prius采用了从车头到
“断尾”（coda tronca）车尾的一体成形轮廓……

这随后就成为了Prius产品系列的标准设计，
你在这款外形美观的第三代车型中也能看到。

detailRows.speaker: Hideo Kodama
detailRows.en:
This rare S model was built by British coachbuilder Barker,
best known for its work with Rolls-Royce cars.
In fact, you’ll notice that its body greatly resembles
that of a Rolls-Royce.

Designed by Dr. Ferdinand Porsche during his stint as
chief engineer at Daimler-Benz...

...the S-type showed its potential when it won the opening race
at the Nürburgring in 1927.
Powered by an inline-6 mounted mid-wheelbase,
it is distinguished by its massive hood.

This feature gives the car very sporty proportions.
In addition to a factory body by Mercedes-Benz, the "S" also had bodies
by French and Italian coachbuilders.
detailRows.zh:
这款极其罕见的S系列是由因为与劳斯莱斯合作而闻名的
英国车身制造厂巴克所打造的。
其实你可以看出，它的车身与劳斯莱斯非常相似。

这辆S型的设计者是当时仍在戴姆勒-奔驰担任
首席工程师的斐迪南·保时捷博士……

并在1927年纽博格林赛道的开幕赛事上获胜，
向世人展现出了巨大的潜力。
它由一部中置直列六缸引擎提供动力，
其巨大的引擎盖尤为吸睛，

也赋予了这辆车极具运动感的比例。
除了由梅赛德斯-奔驰打造的原厂车身外，这辆S型还可以采用
法国和意大利车身制造厂推出的车身。

detailRows.speaker: Hideo Kodama
detailRows.en:
This car was introduced at the 2003 Frankfurt Motor Show.
I know because I was there.

Even if somebody were to cover its distinctive shield,
I would still know it from its voluminous design.
The round taillights on its short rear overhang
are reminiscent of the TZ.

And, well, it simply feels like an Alfa Romeo!
While Alfa Romeo sports models are usually designed
by Italian carrozzerie and stylists...

...this 8C was different.

It was penned by Wolfgang Egger’s own design department,
Centro Stile Alfa Romeo.'
detailRows.zh:
这辆车在2003法兰克福车展上首次亮相。
我之所以知道，是因为当时我也在场！

即便把它特点鲜明的盾形车标挡住，我也能
从它宽大的车身设计分辨出来。
其短车尾凸出部分的圆形车尾灯让人回想起了经典车型TZ……

不过说实话……这才是纯正的Alfa Romeo！
Alfa Romeo的跑车车型多由意大利的
车身制造商和外观设计师操刀……

但这辆8C却并非如此。

它是由沃夫冈·埃格尔自己的设计部门——
Centro Stile Alfa Romeo所执笔设计。

detailRows.speaker: Hideo Kodama
detailRows.en:
The DB3S is a smaller, lighter and more competitive version
of the DB3, which lacked a fighting spirit.
Although it retired after 222 laps at Le Mans in 1953...

...it performed well at Silverstone and many other races.
See how the large front fenders stretch from the headlights
to the cockpit and on to the voluminous rear?

This is similar to the MGA and AC Ace, as well as the
Frazer Nash and Sebring.

That is, it was designed in the classic British style.
detailRows.zh:
相比于略微欠缺战斗精神的DB3，这辆DB3S可以视作是一个较小较轻、
更偏重竞技的版本。
虽然它在1953年的勒芒只跑了222圈便遗憾退赛……

但在银石和其他赛事上却有上佳的表现。
你看到了吗？它的大号前挡泥板从车头灯一直连接到驾驶舱，
又延伸到宽大的车后部。

这种设计与MGA和AC Ace，以及Frazer Nash
和Sebring非常类似。

换句话说，就是经典的英式车身风格。

detailRows.speaker: Hideo Kodama
detailRows.en:
You might say that Porsche is Volkswagen-inspired not only
in the architecture of its cars but also their overall design…
Which is said to be owing to the genius of Erwin Komenda,
Ferry Porsche’s right-hand engineer.

Yet it was Ferry’s son Butzi who would work this theme
into the modern 911.
With headlamps set at the end of its elongated front wings...
A sloping rear, and elliptical side windows...

It is a basic example of the ‘Jaray-style.’Q
detailRows.zh:
很多人认为Porsche不仅在其汽车的架构上
受到Volkswagen的启发，整体设计理念方面也是如此……
并将之归功于艾尔文·柯曼达的天才头脑，
这位工程师同时也是费利·保时捷的得力助手。

但将这一设计理念真正融入到现代911车型中的
其实是费利的儿子（绰号“布奇”）。
在前翼子板顶端设置的头灯……
后溜背的车尾和椭圆形侧窗……

这些都是典型的“贾雷式气动设计”风格的体现。

detailRows.speaker: Hideo Kodama
detailRows.en:
When I think of Renault-Alpine race cars, two that come
to mind are the rally-bred A110...

...and the long-tailed M Series
of Le Mans fame.
The Alpine A220 was built to comply
with Group 6 regulations...

...introduced by FIA in 1968.
However, because the car was unable to produce satisfactory
results at Le Mans, it was withdrawn from competition.
This model is the rally version, instantly recognizable by
its truncated tail.\
detailRows.zh:
说到Renault-Alpine赛车时，我脑海中浮现的两款车
分别是拉力赛出身的A110……

以及剑指勒芒耐力赛的长尾M系列。
Alpine A220是为了符合1968年
FIA引入的Group 6规则

而制造的。
然而，由于未能在勒芒取得令人满意的成绩，
它很快退出了争夺。
我们眼前的这款是拉力赛版本，从它被截短的尾部
就可以看出。

detailRows.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
detailRows.en:
The door section without a character line, and the
simple side proportions are really classic.
Then there are the covered headlights that came from
the DB5 reflecting the fashion at the time.
The tail fin-like design of the rear end
is quite American in style...

But then this was an era where Italian design was
influenced by American motorcars.
It's this classic feel combined with modern
details that give the DB5 its character.

It really is one of the most unique cars from the
DB series.

Of course it became famous because of James Bond,
but it remains a classic in its own right.
detailRows.zh:
车门的部分没有特征明显的分界线，简洁的侧面也十分
经典。
从DB5开始引入的包覆式头灯在当时蔚然成风，体现了当
时的潮流。
尾部的立鳍设计很有美式腔调……

那个时代的意大利也正受到美国车型设计的影响。
经典氛围和现代化细节造就了DB5的个性。

它是DB系列中最为独特的一款车，

虽说成为“邦德”车令它名声大噪，但它本身也不失为一
款经典车型。

detailRows.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
detailRows.en:
This is a great-looking car. It remains one of the
more popular models in Gran Turismo.

The R34 Skyline.

It was developed with a clear intent—to create a sports
sedan that could serve as the foundation for the GT-R.
In the late 1990s, building a 4-door sedan with limited rear
cabin space was far from conventional.
Yet that very approach helped define the R34’s character, and it
went on to become one of the most iconic GT-R-based models.
It was fast and strikingly designed.

Even in race-prepared form, it still exudes that unmistakable
R34 presence.
detailRows.zh:
这辆车的外形很不错。
我认为它是Gran Turismo当中比较受欢迎的一款R34 Skyline……

我认为这是一款由开发者创造的、开发意图十分明确的汽车，
目的是制造出一款能作为GT-R基础的运动型轿车。
在20世纪90年代末，
考虑制造一辆后座空间有限的四门轿车显然不是正常的思路。
但最终，R34成为了即使在GT-R历史上也最为耀眼的明星。
这也是它甚至到了现在也备受众人欢迎的原因。

即使变成了如今的赛车模样，
它仍然非常有R34的感觉。

detailRows.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
detailRows.en:
The main role of the Z33, introduced in 2001, was to resurrect
the Z, and serve as a symbol of the revival of Nissan itself.

Therefore, it was a car that had to succeed.
Because the Z has been a defining symbol for Nissan through the
years, it naturally embraced the design heritage of the company.

That said, we couldn't give it a retro look.
We needed to retain the essence and spirit
of notable Nissans of the past...

...while giving it a thoroughly modern character.
The inspiration for the car's design language was
the S30 and the CSP first-generation Silvia.

And, it may be difficult to notice, but there are hints
of the SP Fairlady in the body section.
All of this made the Z33 more modern
and possess different proportions than the S30...

...but I feel it's still instantly
recognizable as a Z from any angle.<next�id=1800306 type=9ԙ
detailRows.zh:
Z33于2001年首次亮相，
它的使命是复活Z系列，并成为日产复兴的象征。

因此，这是一款不许失败的汽车。
作为日产的代表车型，Z33必须体现出公司的设计传统……

但又不能太“复古”。
因此，我们必须保留过去成就的精髓和精神……

再以完善的现代特征进行展现。
它的设计语言可以追溯到S30和第一代Silvia CSP。

而且，容易被人忽略的一个点是
——其车身部分还有些Fairlady SP的影子。
这些设计元素都使得Z33在比例和主题方面较S30更加现代。

但你还是一眼就能看出，这是一辆Z系车。

detailRows.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
detailRows.en:
In some ways, the Z34 is more classic in overall styling
than the Z33.
The wheelbase has been shortened by 100mm...

...giving it long-nose proportions.

The shape of the roof,
and the window graphics with the peak at the very front...

...also adopt the S30's design basic theme.
In contrast, the massive rear fender that squeezes the shape
of the body from front to rear...

...aims to ithis car a level of aggressiveness never
before seen on a Z.
There were challenges on how to evolve the Z33's styling.

If the Z33 represented a modern and more
elegant design theme...

...then the Z34's look is one that's a more authentic of an
FR sports car with added aggressiveness.
detailRows.zh:
从设计上看，Z34比Z33的外观更回归经典。
首先，轴距缩短了100mm……

显得车头相对更长。

其车顶的形状以及最前面的车窗贴花……

则特意延续了S30的设计风格。
相比之下，巨大的后挡泥板让车身的重心从前向后挪……

令它看上去更具有攻击性。
这是之前的Z系列中所罕见的。
当然了，对Z33的外型进行迭代并非易事。

简而言之，如果Z33给人以现代的优雅感……

Z34则更像是一款地道的前置后驱跑车，
而且更具攻击性。

detailRows.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
detailRows.en:
I love this car, and it's easily one of my top three all time.

Based on sketches by Ford designers...

...you get the feeling that its appearance was brought together
by British designers...

...who knew how racecars should look and perform.
When compared to the Ferrari 330P4 of the same year...

...the overall shape of the GT40 is emotionally modest,
while characterized by a more modern silhouette.

They're both nice, but I think I prefer the GT40.
The face created by the square headlamps and air intakes,
which are rare in racecars...

...is aggressive and stylish.
But there's a rather elegant, feminine quality within the car's
overall muscular nature...

...expressed by the line that runs from the cabin to
the rear end.

Although it hasn't been mentioned much before, but there's
a quality not unlike that of the Lamborghini Miura her�.
The Mark II added air intakes, which gave the car
even more racecar intensity.

It's this part of the car that I find very alluring.
detailRows.zh:
我喜欢这辆车。
如果要排名的话，它能轻松跻身我个人喜好排行榜的前三。

此车是由一支来自英国的团队

基于福特设计师的草图打造的……

看得出来，他们对赛车的外观和性能胸有成竹。
与同年的法拉利330 P4相比……

GT40可能欠缺一些激情，但有着更具现代感的轮廓。

当然了，这两部车都很棒，只是我个人更偏爱GT40。
请注意方形大灯和进气口所构成的前脸，
这在赛车上是很少见的。

我会觉得它既有侵略性，又有时尚感。
尽管总体上“孔武有力”，但还是可以让人感受到
一丝优雅气质，

主要体现在从车厢延伸到尾部的线条中。

虽然之前很少被提及，但其实
兰博基尼Miura与此车师出同门。
在Mark II版�'�中增加的多个进气口使它看起来更有张力。

事实上，我觉得最有魅力的就是这部分。

detailRows.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
detailRows.en:
I'm totally taken with the wraparound cabin
and the flawless balance of the low body.

From just its presence,
you can almost hear the car's exhaust note, right?
I've seen Gandini's original sketch of the car...

...while the design theme is the same,
I was surprised in the difference of the ambience.
In fact, "car design" is something that can't
be accomplished by just one person.

The collaboration of engineers, who are themselves
craftsmen, and modelers is essential.

In those terms...

...I think it's correct in saying that
the Stratos is "Bertone designed."
I would seriously love to add this car to my collection,
but it has become too expensive.
detailRows.zh:
我完全被这辆车的环绕式座舱和其低矮车身的
完美平衡给折服了。

你仔细听，是不是几乎听不到它的排气声？
我看过甘迪尼为这辆车创作的设计草图原稿。

虽然设计主题相同，但传达的情绪感受却明显不同。
事实上，“汽车设计”并不是一个人就能完成的作品。

它需要工程技师和模型师之间的通力合作。

因此……

我觉得更准确的说法应该是——
Stratos由“博通设计打造”。
我是真的很想把这辆车纳入我的收藏，
不过恐怕它现在已经是我负担不起的天价了。<

detailRows.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
detailRows.en:
Ah, this is the 2017 model, after the second minor change.
This front design was actually...

...a reproduction of the GT-R Proto that we displayed
at the 2005 Tokyo Motor Show.

We felt that the graphic theme of the GT-R Proto might be a bit
too aggressive for a car making its first ever appearance...

This design was born from us saying, "Let's try one
more time to express the design in a different way."
The 2017 car has a very complete look to it, and
I do like it myself.

Also, regarding the interior,
it has a modern design with depth and good textures.
detailRows.zh:
哦，这是2017年的车型，经历了第二次“小”改款。
前部车身的设计其实取自……

我们在2005年东京车展上展出的GT-R Proto概念车。

当时，我们觉得作为一款首次亮相的车型，
设计有些过于激进……

于是搁置了这个设计方案，等待时机成熟。
正如你现在所看到的，时机到了。
2017年车型的外观设计完成度很高，我自己也很满意。

我也非常喜欢现代感十足的新内饰，
我们对材质的应用很到位。

detailRows.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
detailRows.en:
Look at the tight cabin and the position of the rear engine.
It's stunning.
The front fascia is particularly eye-catching.

The ridge that runs down the hood...

...really provides the vehicle with a unique feel.

It's so very French.

But then, it has large fog lamps for rallying...
...and air scoops at the rear have been flawlessly incorporated.

These details that suggest it's a competition vehicle
give it its exquisite character.
In terms of design, there are places where the balance is not
good, but when seeing the car up close, you don't mind at all.

In fact, it's those things that give this car visual impact.

This type of visual allure,
you can't achieve in today's cars.

This car is a true masterpiece, one that I would love to
add to my collection.
detailRows.zh:
这辆车确实令人叹为观止，请关注紧凑的车厢和
后置引擎的位置。
从正前方看时尤其如此，

因为沿着引擎盖向下延伸的中脊线很有时尚感。

我觉得它非常有“法式风情”。

不过，它同时还配备了用于拉力赛的大雾灯……
以及精心布置的进气口。

这些赛车的美学设计都为它赋予了精致的特征。
从设计角度来看，有些部件似乎不那么平衡，
但凑近看时不仅不会让人这么觉得，

甚至是为这辆车带来了某种视觉冲击感。

它的许多设计在现今的汽车中确实已经不多见了。

这是一项真正的大师之作，我很想把它纳入我的收藏。

detailRows.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
detailRows.en:
This is a masterpiece of Japanese car design.

To be honest, the S30 was developed as a hatchback coupe,
rather than a sports car.
There's plenty of cabin space.

Overall headroom is generous for a pure sports car.

Still, it looks very sporty,
meaning it is a very special design.
Take the proportion, line, and surface...

...in many ways, the design of this car says
"it can only be done this way."

But what is most impressive is...

...is its purity.
It exudes a high sense of Japanese beauty.
The look of the nose is modern.

It's a design that's distinctly Japanese,
unlike any other car from the U.S. or Europe.
The S30 is unmistakably a design that represents Japan.

From the latter half of the 1960s and on,
more than a few amazing sports-car designs were created in Japan.

In that day, there were man� motivated
and talented young designers inside Japanese car companies.
They borrowed the best parts of Western design elements,
while keeping their own unique character.

I pay respect to the achievements of all of them, especially
Yoshihiko Matsuo-san, who recently passed away.
detailRows.zh:
这辆车可是日本汽车设计的杰作之一！

严格来讲，S30是作为一款掀背式双门轿跑车开发的，
而不是一款跑车。
如你所见，这辆车的车厢空间很大……

而且与纯粹的跑车相比，头顶空间更富裕。

不过，得益于其卓越的设计，它看起来还是动力十足。
此车的一切——车身比例、线条和外观表面……

无不彰显着“纯正”二字。

但最为出众的……

还是其体现着日式设计美学的优雅和精致。
以其现代化的车头设计为例。

与美式或欧洲的设计都不相同，极具日本车特色。
S30就是一台纯粹的日系车。

从六十年代晚期开始，日本设计出了无数台跑车杰作。

当时的日本汽车公司汇聚了许多位
热忱且有才华的年轻设计�3。
他们从西方设计中汲取精华，
但又保留了自己独特的感受力。

这些设计师都值得我们尊敬。
尤其值得一提的一位，便是最近去世的松尾良彦。

detailRows.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
detailRows.en:
There never was a more stylish and sleek
thoroughbred than the 330 P4.

Not before or since.
It may have been built for racing, but it doesn't feel
like ‘winning’ was the absolute objective.

You could say that it is the ultimate expression of
a style that goes back to the 250 P of the ‘60s.
In terms of design, the fender lines and surfaces
are very expressive...

Giving it its Italian flavour.
After the 330 P4, Ferrari racers went a bit dry,
prioritising performance and function.

Indeed, this masterpiece comes from an era when race cars
were still works of art.
detailRows.zh:
我的观点是，330 P4是最时尚、最具魅力的纯血赛车，

前无古人，后无来者。
尽管这辆车是严格按照竞赛标准设计的，
但如果你只看外观，赢得比赛似乎并不是它的最高设计准则。

可以说330 P4就是Ferrari在1960年代
中置引擎赛车设计的终极体现。
从设计美学的角度分析，它的侧面线条和轮廓
既流畅，又充满力量感……

……呈现出独有的意大利风貌。
在它之后，就连Ferrari的赛车都开始变得
不那么重视美感，而是将优先级放在性能和功能上。

这款杰作代表了那个赛车也可以很美的时代。

detailRows.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
detailRows.en:
This car really shows off its proportional balance.

Aside from the retrofitted detail parts,
I feel that it is an elegant looking car.
Design elements such as the retractable headlamps...

...the area around the rear where the glass hatch blacks out the
B-pillar...

...they seem to be a response to cars in the American market
at the time.
Looking at it now, it lacks boldness,
but it's a look that exudes positive emotions.
detailRows.zh:
这辆车淋漓尽致地展现了设计师对车身比例均衡的把握。

这辆车的车身细节部件进行了全面的翻新升级，
给人以优雅的印象。
其他的一些设计元素，例如上翻式车头灯……

……玻璃后背和B柱的衔接……

……似乎都是为了响应当时美国市场的需求。
现在看来，这种设计欠缺些魄力，
不过的确传达出积极求变的信息。

detailRows.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
detailRows.en:
This is the original GT-R, a sports coupe
Japan proudly offered to the world in the 1960s.
It has the famous "Surfin' Line" as the disctinct design feature,
but the other parts are also well executed.

Despite being passenger car-based, its proportions are rather
sporty, and the main design theme is powerful yet simple.

It's an excellent design with a bit of American-car flavor, from
the solid door sections to the overall sense of volume.
But it does lack the four round taillights.

When we were designing the R35 GT-R, we were, of course,
inspired by the Hakosuka's overall ambience and details.

In truth, a key thing about traditional GT-Rs is that they
aren’t fastbacks, but are shaped by the C Pillar.
At first glance, the R35 may look like a fastback...

...but you'll notice that when compared to the KPGC,
the window line of the Pillar is set at the same angle.
detailRows.zh:
这辆初代GT-R是日本在1960年代
呈现给全世界的骄傲——一台双门跑车。
久负盛名的“冲浪线条”是它的专属特色。
当然，其他部位的设计也同样可圈可点。

首先，原车型的定位是轿车，但GT-R将车身比例改得更偏向运动。
其主要的设计主旨就是“简单但性能强大”。

从方正、结实的车门到整车的廓形，
这款杰出的设计里
多少带着一些美国车的影子。
唯一缺少的，是后续车型中加入的四盏标志性圆形车尾灯。

我们在设计R35 GT-R的时候，从Hakosuka的
整体氛围和细节上汲取了不少灵感。

事实上，有个重要设计点值得一提——GT-R并没有采用溜背设计，
溜背的视觉效果来自于直接与下部车身相接的C柱。
粗看之下，R35很像是一台溜背车……

�;�…但与KPGC进行比较之后你就会发现
两者C柱窗户的线条呈现的角度其实是一模一样的。

detailRows.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
detailRows.en:
When Mr. Yamauchi approached me about
the Vision Gran Turismo project...

...it was when we were exploring the design strategy
of next-gen Infiniti models.

This design came from Infiniti's Beijing studio,
which had just been established.

One of our young designers took the initiative
and completed this in a short time.

There's some simplicity in the details of the design,
but that, in turn, is what makes it so alluring.
For example, where the A-pillar seems to float from the cabin,
the resulting form here conveys lots of emotion.
Because its improvisational in nature,
it has a strong design feel to it.

Of course, this car was designed strategically
employing Infiniti's form language.

Therefore, it effectively links to
the production Infiniti cars that came afterwards.
detailRows.zh:
当山内一典先生找我聊跑车浪漫旅愿景项目时……

……我们正在思考下一代车型应当采用什么样的设计策略。

这款设计来自于刚成立不久的英菲尼迪北京工作室。

团队的一名年轻设计师自告奋勇，
在很短时间内就完成了设计。

它的设计大繁至简，反而为这台车平添了一份魅力。
比如，A柱看上去像是游离在车厢之上，
整车造型更是传递出了强烈的冲动与激情。
因为本质上是即兴创作，所以给人以强烈的设计感，

但它在造型设计语言方面与品牌的血统一脉相承，

更为后续推出的英菲尼迪量产车型留下了许多启发。

detailRows.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
detailRows.en:
The styling of this car is a continuation
of the BMW 2002 and represents

the last 3 Series with BMW's traditional design language.

It looks as if the designers employed obvious themes and
executed them in an obvious manner, but the car still looks good.
For example, one thing that makes this design effective is...

...the front overhang when viewed from the rear-quarter angle.

It's almost non-existent.
You can hardly see it.

Both the engineers and designers understood
the importance of proportions.

This design can only happen when planned from the early stages.

It may look simple, but it's not so easily accomplished
on a mass-produced vehicle..
detailRows.zh:
这款车延续了2002款的风格，
在BMW的传统设计语言下竭力展现最新一代3系的风貌。

我感觉，设计师们最初就定下了张扬肆意的调子，
在呈现时更是不遗余力，最终的效果也非常出彩。
比如说，它有个非常精妙的设计……

……如果你从斜后方角度观察车头前悬部分，

你会发现几乎看不到，
仿佛它不存在一样。

这代表BMW的工程师和设计师们对车身比例研究得很透彻。

要实现这一点，必须在开发前期就将之纳入规划。

这是一件知易行难的事，在打造一款量产车时，
能实现这样的成果确实难能可贵。.

detailRows.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
detailRows.en:
Do you remember the DeltaWing that raced in the
2014 24 Hours of Le Mans?

This car inherits the spirit of that machine.

It was developed with a truly original idea,
one that sort of went over the heads of normal folks.
This front-engine/front-drive car gave designer and engineer Ben
Bowlby the freedom to realize his vision without compromise.

And it ended up taking this honest shape. I like it.
The proportions are uniqiue and the overall design is well-executed,
espeically the rear-quarter.

This wasn't exactly a race version of the GT-R, but
after talking things over with Ben...

...he gave it a Vmotion grille and four round taillights,
details that gave the DeltaWing some Nissan GT-R flavor.
Unfortunately, the car failed to produce any results at Le Mans,
and it was discontinued after a year.
detailRows.zh:
你们记得三角翼吗？
参加过2014年勒芒24小时耐力赛的三角翼？

这辆车就是它的精神继承者。

它运用了完全原创的设计思路，
而且可能有些超出普通人的理解范畴。
我的意思是，这是一辆前置前驱车。设计师兼工程师
本·鲍尔比在打造它的过程中获得了充分的自由。

其结果就是这种朴实无华的外形。
我个人觉得很喜欢。
它的比例非常特殊。但效果非常棒，你不觉得呢？
它从侧后方的观赏角度看上去特别震撼。

严格意义上说，它不能算是GT-R的赛车版本，
不过在本和我的通力合作下，

为这款车安装了V动感前格栅，而在其后部，
我们也安装了四盏圆形尾灯。这些细节为它增加了日产GT-R的风味。
遗憾的是，这辆车在勒芒未能有所斩�，在一年后便停产了。

detailRows.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
detailRows.en:
The Nissan Concept 2020 VGT gave us the great opportunity...

...to freely express the design vision of the Nissan brand.

This styling theme here was created by our London studio
in a short time. It's overflowing with energy, don't you think?

This car wasn't particularly based on a specific model, but we
gave our young designers complete freedom to shape this car.
And yes, it seems that they all had the future GT-R in mind.

Most anyone can tell that the design was inspired by the GT-R
by simply looking at the greenhouse and taillights, right?
The balance of the proportions suggests
not a mid-engine car or a long-nose FR machine,

but that of a front mid-engine 4WD car.
While this car is purely a design study...

...the front bumper and details of the rear end
are related to that of the 2017 GT-R.
detailRows.zh:
日产Concept 2020 Vision Gran Turismo给了我们一个前所未有的机会……

……让我们可以无拘无束地展现我们对于日产品牌的愿景。

这款车的风格定调是由我们的伦敦工作室在很短的时间内
完成的。你是不是也能感觉到其中充满了流动的能量？

这款车并不是基于某款GT-R车型设计的命题作文，我们
给了年轻设计师们绝对的自由，可以随心所欲地打造这辆车。
而从结果看，他们心中都有各自对于GT-R未来的畅想。

如果单看车身侧面和车尾灯，
很容易就能辨认出其中的GT-R元素，对吧？
还有从车身比例就能看出，它不是什么中置引擎
，也不是长车鼻的前置后驱车，

而是一款前中置引擎四驱车款。
尽管这款车只是一项设计课题……

……但前保险杠^��后部的部分细节
与2017款GT-R有着密切的联系。

detailRows.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
detailRows.en:
At the risk of sounding crass by compliment our own designs...

...I always felt that the GT-R in the Super GT Series was
"oh so cool" when watching it in races.
The racecar is modified by NISMO every year...

...and the original image of the GT-R is carefully retained in
the grille and the shape of the lights.

When watching a race, it's important to be able to
recognize a car when seeing it from a distance.
For that to happen, the front and rear of
the base production car must be distinctive.
Also, while race cars may be modified for aerodynamics,
GT regulations prohibit changes to the cabin.
In fact, when I was watching a GT race at Suzuka...

...I said to myself, "The racecars painted in their
sponsor colors all look the same."　

That's when I decided that the shape of
the R35 GT-R's cabin must ab�olutely remain distinctive!
detailRows.zh:
虽然这样说感觉像是在自卖自夸……

……不过我坚信当你在Super GT系列赛中
看到这辆GT-R时，你一定会觉得“哇，太酷了”。
每年，我们都会将赛车交由NISMO进行改装……

……而GT-R原本的外观，如格栅和车灯形状等
都精心地保留了下来。

我认为在观看比赛时，能让观众远远地
就把赛车辨认出来很有必要。
要达到这个目标，
基础量产车的前后外观必须要有独到之处。
为了增强空气动力学性能，赛车的车身通常会接受
大量的改装，但GT系列赛又规定

驾驶舱必须与原版量产车保持一致。
我过去在铃鹿赛道观看超跑比赛的时候……

……就觉得“除了赞助商的涂装，这些赛车
看上去都一个样。”

所以，我才会在S��计R35 GT-R的时候赋予驾驶舱独特的风格！

detailRows.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
detailRows.en:
For a car that came two generations
after the S30, this one has rediscovered its "Z-ness."

Three-dimensional undulations of the body are restrained,

and the design theme is simple yet bold.
The flush surface of the side glass and body around
the door section was an American design trend at the time.

You coud say that the Z32
is more of a coupe in design than a sport car,
The super wide-and-low body proportion
makes the overall look amazingly sporty.
If you look at the design flow it does deviate
from the "Z story",

but the level of refinement of its design
is truly outstanding.

That's why the car is still so popular.

And here's an interesting fact:
The area around the opening line of the rear hatch,
 was carried over to the Z33.
detailRows.zh:
自S30推出又过了两代之后，
这款新车终于重新找回了“Z”系列的特色。

车身的起伏曲线十分克制，

用于展现简洁而又大胆的设计主旨。
侧面车窗底部与车门周围的车身齐平于同一平面……

体现了当时美国汽车设计领域的主流趋势。
与其说Z32是跑车，它更像是一台双门轿跑……
但那宽体低趴的姿态像是匍匐在地，
使整体外观充满了动感。

如果从设计流线上看，确实有些偏离Z系列的传统要素，

但其设计的精致程度无疑令人赞许。

这也解释了它为何至今仍然受到车迷们的追捧。
另外，后备箱盖开合线附近区域的设计在
后续车型Z33中也得到了沿用。

detailRows.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
detailRows.en:
When comparing it to the classic design of its predecessor...

...the 250 GTO adopted a longer nose, lower stance,
 and a "coda tronca" rear.
Thus, it was designed with aerodynamics strongly in mind.

The front and rear fenders give the car a great sense
of energy and vigor.

The view from the rear-quarter angle is just exquisite.
The car's distinguishing features include...

The three air intakes on the hood and air outlets
on the fenders.
In staying true to Ferrari’s established design language,
while adapting to the rigors of racing...

...the 250 GTO achieved a rare and remarkable equilibrium.

It is precisely this harmony that has made it one of
the more popular Ferrari cars ever created.
detailRows.zh:
与之前的经典短轴距车型相比……

250 GTO不仅采用了更长的车鼻，压低了车身高度，还引入了
被称为断尾的后部设计。
在设计时，空气动力学性能也是其重点考量。

宽大的前后挡泥板营造出了
无与伦比的动感氛围。

从侧后方角度看过去，特别华贵高雅。
无论是引擎盖正前方的三个进气口，
还是后保险杠上突出的排气管，

都让人记忆犹新。
可以说，250 GTO的设计既保留了法拉利的底蕴，
又满足了赛车运动的需求……

实现了难能可贵的平衡。

也正是这份平衡感让这款经典法拉利车型充满魅力，
人气爆棚。

detailRows.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
detailRows.en:
This is a design that tried to break away from
the previous design language of BMW.

The shapes created by my former classmate
Chris Bangle when he was at BMW...

Were interesting and exciting in the eyes of a designer.
This M3 also began moving away from the authentic
proportions of an FR vehicle.
However, the surface treatment is fresh and interesting.
Even seeing it now, it's not bad at all.
This is one of the cars that represented
the change in flow of BMW design.
detailRows.zh:
这辆车的设计在尝试摆脱BMW之前的设计语言，带来革新。

它是由我从前的同学
克里斯·班格尔在BMW工作时所设计的……

在设计师眼中，这些设计元素非常有趣，非常激动人心。
此外，这辆M3开始从车身配比上与传统前置后驱车分道扬镳。
其车身外观的处理也非常新颖有趣。
即便从现在的眼光来看也丝毫不过时。
可以说，这是一台反映了BMW设计思路演变的车。\

detailRows.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
detailRows.en:
In America, the De Tomaso Pantera is still quite popular.
The Pantera is a model originally developed by Ford, but
it strongly possesses Italian supercar qualities.

It was an affordable super car...
So instead of keeping it tucked away for safe keeping, many
owners enjoyed tuning their car to their own tastes.
detailRows.zh:
De Tomaso Pantera在美国依然非常受欢迎。
Pantera车型最初由Ford开发，却拥有多处
强烈的意大利超级跑车特质。

而且是一辆价格相对较为实惠的超跑……
所以许多车主并没有将他们的爱车束之高阁，
而是按照自己的喜好进行改装。

detailRows.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
detailRows.en:
This car is a masterpiece of
American race-car design.

Because of the era, I think its design was undoubtedly
influenced by the Ferrari GTO...

But this massive Daytona Coupe possesses an exclusively
bold American flair, which I think is fantastic.
From the fully pushed back cabin to the squeezed out rear,
the proportions of this car have been taken to the limit.

But that balance is what makes the car so alluring.
I feel this was from using the open-top AC Cobra as a base
and getting the most aerodynamic performance possible.

The design sense of Pete Brock, who effectively
put this car together, really comes through.
detailRows.zh:
这辆车是美国赛车设计史上的杰作。

由于所属时代的原因，我认为它的设计毫无疑问
深受Ferrari GTO的影响……

不过这辆体型庞大的Daytona Coupe依然拥有独一无二的
粗犷美国风味，我觉得这一点非常美妙。
从大幅后移的座舱，到高度压缩的翘车尾，
这辆车的比例被推向了极限。

不过，这种奇妙的平衡恰恰是这辆车最迷人的地方。
我认为这是因为它采用了敞篷的AC Cobra作为基础车型，
并尽可能地提升了空气动力学性能。

皮特·布洛克贯彻他的设计理念，成功打造了这款经典车。]

detailRows.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
detailRows.en:
This Daytona Cobra is no doubt Pete's signature creation.

It looks like a complicated design...

But the surface areas are clean, making it simpler and more
sophisticated than you might think.
That's why the more time passes, the better it looks.
detailRows.zh:
这辆Daytona Cobra毫无疑问是皮特最具代表性的作品。

它的设计看上去有些复杂……

车身表面却异常简洁。要同时保证这样的简约与繁复，
需要花费超乎你想象的设计流程。
正因如此，它的外观才能够随着岁月的推移而常看常新，
令人回味。

detailRows.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
detailRows.en:
No doubt about it, the S30 has a sports car design
that is quintessentially Japanese.

I might even go so far as to say that its proportions and
lines are just about perfect.
The over-fenders and long nose which were added
to the ZG variant...
They actually balance the car quite nicely, giving it
a more ‘aggressive’ charm, so to speak.
Just remember to give it some wide-rim wheels!
detailRows.zh:
毫无疑问，Nissan S30的跑车设计带有典型的日本风格。

我甚至可以毫不夸张地说，它的比例和线条都堪称完美。
它在ZG车型的基础上增加了宽挡泥板和长车头……
在外形上实现了平衡的观感，更为它赋予了
一种更具“攻击性”的魅力，
同时也没有忘记为它配上一套更宽的车轮！

detailRows.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
detailRows.en:
In terms of design, the Mark IV was a complete departure
from the Ford GTs that came before it.
Its body and side profile alone evidence a prioritization
of pure aerodynamic performance.
From this point on, Ford showed its commitment to
breaking the GT mold...

...its mission to create completely pure race cars.*
detailRows.zh:
在设计上，Mark IV与过去的Ford GT截然不同。
光从车身和侧面剖视图来看，就能充分体现其纯粹为空气动力学性能
而作出的优化。
从此刻开始，Ford展现了突破GT风格桎梏的决心……

目标是创造出完全不同的纯粹赛车。

detailRows.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
detailRows.en:
If I’m not mistaken, this car was preceded by
the more radical ‘Gallardo’.
And yet the Huracán represented an evolution
in Lamborghini’s identity and design language.
Its use of hexagonal forms continues to be seen
in today’s Lamborghinis.!
detailRows.zh:
如果我没记错的话，这辆车的前款应该是
更加激进的“Gallardo”。
然而，Huracán很好地展现了Lamborghini在品牌认同
和设计语言上的革命。
它采用的六角形元素至今可以在现款Lamborghini上看到。

detailRows.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
detailRows.en:
This 400R is the complete car, not the GT-R that was based
on the R33.
It’s a car for connoisseurs.

With new bumpers, air outlets,
and overfenders...
...it’s practically a different car, and yet it’s
incredibly sleek all the same.
detailRows.zh:
这辆400R是一辆“完全体”的车，而不仅仅是脱胎于R33的GT-R。
这是一辆为鉴赏家们设计的车。

它采用了新的保险杠、出气口和轮眉……
实际上可以算成一辆完全不同的车了。
尽管如此，它的外观依然是那么的流畅和优美。

detailRows.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
detailRows.en:
If you ask me, this car is less of a design study than it is
a study in aerodynamics.

The roofline runs straight across the body to the rear,
where it abruptly cuts off in a coda tronca.
This tells me that it may have been developed as a prototype
for engineering purposes.
detailRows.zh:
依我看，这辆车更像是一项“空气动力学研究”
而非“设计研究”。

车顶线条贯穿整车一直延伸到后部，
突然以coda tronca的形式戛然而止。
我有个大胆推测，它可能是以工程研究为目的
而开发的原型车。

detailRows.speaker: Sarah
detailRows.en:
That’s right, it refers to a truncated tail, or rear.
What we call a "Kamm Tail" in English.

The Kamm Tail is named after the German aerodynamicist
Wunibald Kamm, who theorized the design in the 1930s.
detailRows.zh:
没错，它指的是尾部被截短。
在英语中通常被称为“Kamm tail”（断尾）。

这一术语源自于德国空气动力学家温纳尔德·卡姆
（Wunibald Kamm），他在上世纪30年代提出了这种设计理念。

detailRows.speaker: Sarah
detailRows.en:
Oh, it refers to a truncated tail, or rear.
What we call a "Kamm Tail" in English.

The Kamm Tail is named after the German aerodynamicist
Wunibald Kamm, who theorized the design in the 1930s.
detailRows.zh:
哦，那我解释下，它指的是尾部被截短。
在英语中通常被称为“Kamm tail”（断尾）。

这一术语源自于德国空气动力学家温纳尔德·卡姆
（Wunibald Kamm），他在上世纪30年代提出了这种设计理念。>

detailRows.speaker: Kunihisa Ito
detailRows.en:
This is the original Mini. I can't think of any
other car design that is so efficient.

It's the ultimate expression of a 4-seat passenger vehicle.
It truly has a 'timeless design'.
The original Mini was, for its time, an unusual
front-wheel-drive compact.

It was developed for minimal power and
maximum interior space.

This packaging was revolutionary for the 20th century.
The car was created in 1955 by the BMC development
team, led by Sir Alec Issigonis.

After that, John Cooper tuned the car with
twin carburettors and disc brakes.
Thus the Mini Cooper S you see here was born.<next id=1900106 type=9׾
detailRows.zh:
这是一辆初代MINI。
我觉得没有比它更高效的汽车设计了。

它就是4座乘用车的终极体现。
这真是一款“不过时的设计”。
这款初代MINI在当时是一辆非常罕见的前驱紧凑型车。

它的开发思路就是追求最小的动力和
最大的可用内部空间。

这样的产品规划在20世纪是非常具有革新性的。
在1955年，由亚历克·伊斯戈尼斯爵士领导的英国汽车集团开发团队
打造了这台MINI。

之后，约翰·库珀对车型进行了调校，
加入了双化油器和碟式制动器……
于是，你眼前的这一辆MINI Cooper S就诞生了。*

detailRows.speaker: Kunihisa Ito
detailRows.en:
The FD3S Mazda RX-7 was released in 1991. Even now,
there are many young fans of this car in the U.S.

It possesses a simple design without any faults.
The styling of this car was born at Mazda's California
design studio, led at the time by Tom Matano.

This particular street machine was created by RE Amemiya,
which specialises in tuning rotary-powered machines.
Although it's not exactly a 'hashiriya', or ‘street racer,’
it's nevertheless captivating.
It's a car you should drive at least once in Gran Turismo.
detailRows.zh:
这辆FD3S Mazda RX-7虽然推出于1991年，但即便
到了今天，它依然在美国年轻人当中拥有不少粉丝。

它拥有简单而无懈可击的设计。
这辆公路车的外观设计诞生在Mazda的加利福尼亚州
设计工作室，由俣野努主导完成。

眼前的这一台则是由专攻转子引擎调校的公司
RE Amemiya改装后的版本。
尽管严格来讲它并不是一辆“街头赛车”，
但依然非常迷人。
至少，你在《跑车浪漫旅》中应该试驾一下它。$

detailRows.speaker: Kunihisa Ito
detailRows.en:
The number of cars participating in the 1991 Le Mans race
was only 38, but among those was the new Peugeot 905.

There were also perennial powerhouses like Mercedes-Benz,
Jaguar and Porsche sharing that starting grid.
To take them all on, Mazda entered two 787B race cars.
Of those two, the No. 55 car, which started the race in 19th
position, gradually worked its way up the running order...

Until it found its way to the front and finished on top!
A dramatic first victory for Japanese manufacturers.
To this day, I haven't forgotten the famous green
and red livery of that race machine.<next id=1900306 type=
detailRows.zh:
在1991年参加勒芒耐力赛的赛车仅有寥寥38辆，
但全新的标致905也在其列。

此外，在发车格上还有各品牌常年出战的高性能赛车，
如梅赛德斯-奔驰、捷豹和保时捷等等。
马自达派出了两辆787B赛车来挑战这些强大的对手。
在这两辆车中，从第19位发车的55号赛车
步步为营，不断提升自己的排位……

……最后终于攀升到领跑位置，并以头名完赛！
这是日本车厂的第一次获胜，过程充满了戏剧性。
时至今日，我依然无法忘怀那部比赛机器
的橙绿色涂装。

detailRows.speaker: Kunihisa Ito
detailRows.en:
The prototype and final production model
of the original NSX...

Was designed by my friend and former chief
designer at Honda, Masato Nakano.
The performance target for the NSX was
to surpass the Ferrari 328 and 348...

So you know it had plenty of fighting power.
The GT500 class adopted a stepped-bottom rule in 2007, and
that year this car took the title, winning 5 of 9 races.

Because of its incredible speed, you can almost say
the series imposed a weight-handicap system.
The following year, in 2008, the NSX's highlight was a 2nd-
place finish in the 8th race of the season at Autopolis.
detailRows.zh:
这辆初代NSX的原型和最终量产型……

……都由我的朋友、前本田首席设计师中野正人所设计的。
NSX的性能目标是要超越法拉利328和348，

所以可想而知，它的战斗力极其惊人。
GT500组别的赛事在2007年采用了阶梯式淘汰规则，

在这一年里，这辆NSX不仅赢得了冠军，还拿下了
九场比赛中的五场胜利。

因为它所向无敌的速度，甚至会让人们怀疑这项系列赛
是不是采用了一套非常不利于大重量赛车的制度。
在接下来的2008年，NSX最亮眼的表现则出现在
奥托波里斯赛道，它在赛季的第八场比赛中以第二名完赛。

detailRows.speaker: Kunihisa Ito
detailRows.en:
Designed and built by Chrysler's Advanced Design Studios
over the course of 1988 and ’89...

The Viper was dubbed the ‘second-coming’
of the Shelby Cobra.

It was co-production by then-president Bob Lutz
and designer Tom Gale.
Heralding a new era at the New York Auto Show in 2012,
the SRT GTS-R marked the series’ return to racing.
Distinguished by a long nose and short deck body...
Its flat bottom and wing addition promised dramatically
improved aerodynamics.
detailRows.zh:
这台由Chrysler的高级设计工作室于1988年至1989年

设计和制造的Viper又被称作Shelby Cobra的“再现”。

它是由品牌当时的总裁鲍勃·鲁茨和设计师汤姆·盖尔协手打造。
2012年纽约车展上，Chrysler带着Viper重出江湖，
而SRT GTS-R的命名则代表系列车型回归竞速比赛。
该车具有标志性的长车头和短小平坦的车身……
扁平的底盘和额外的风翼也使得空气动力学效应得到了长足的改进。

detailRows.speaker: Kunihisa Ito
detailRows.en:
The Lexus SC is a grand tourer series.
The second-generation model, the SC430, was a hardtop convertible
powered by a mighty V-8 engine.

You see them quite often in the U.S.
The first-generation model was designed at Calty, a Toyota design
studio located in California.

However, this SC430 was mainly conceived
at design studios in Europe.
A competitor at Japanese GT races, it received aerodynamic
upgrades for the 2008 season...

...during which it tore up the high-speed tracks.
detailRows.zh:
Lexus SC属于品牌的豪华旅行车系列车型。
其二代车型SC430是由一台强力的V8引擎所驱动的硬顶敞篷车。

在美国，这辆车相对比较常见。
该系列的第一代车型由位于加利福尼亚的
Toyota设计工作室Calty所设计。

然而，这一辆SC430主要是在欧洲的设计工作室中构思完成。
作为日本GT比赛的参赛车辆之一，
其在2008赛季得到了空气动力学升级……

也因此，它在高速赛道上交出了极其出色的答卷。

detailRows.speaker: Kunihisa Ito
detailRows.en:
The Jaguar XJR-9 was penned by British racing car
designer Tony Southgate.
In 1988, it competed at the World Sports Prototype
Championship.
Among its six victories was a legendary show at the 24 Hours
of Le Mans...

Which was Jaguar’s first Le Mans victory since 1957!
The XJR-9 also won the Teams Championship...

And driver Martin Brundle won the Drivers title.
No doubt, the XJR-9’s purple paint job is now known
to one and all!
detailRows.zh:
Jaguar XJR-9是由英国赛车设计师托尼·索斯盖特
所执笔设计的。
1988年，这款车参加了世界原型跑车锦标赛。
它一共取得过六项冠军，其中最传奇的表演
在勒芒24小时耐力赛上上演。

那也是自1957年后Jaguar首次在勒芒夺魁！
XJR-9赢得了车队冠军……

而车手马丁·布伦德尔赢得了车手冠军。
毫无疑问，这款XJR-9紫的涂装现如今已经举世皆知。'

detailRows.speaker: Kunihisa Ito
detailRows.en:
The Nissan R92CP has an exquisite body design that speaks
to its enormous capacity for downforce.

And its blue paint job is dazzling to behold.
Back in 1992, Nissan pitted the R92CP against Toyota’s
TS010 in a battle for supremacy.
After winning the opening round at Suzuka, the R92CP
went on to win at Fuji and at Sugo...
...contributing to an incredible class victory for Nissan.
detailRows.zh:
Nissan R92CP以精致的车身设计彰显其强大的下压力性能。

此外，其炫目的蓝色涂装更是令人眼前一亮。
在1992年，Nissan R92CP与Toyota的TS010展开激烈对决，
争夺行业的巅峰地位。
在铃鹿赛道夺得开幕战胜利后，R92CP继续在富士和
SUGO运动乐园赛道再下两城……
Nissan最终震撼赢得该级别的冠军，此车功不可没。

detailRows.speaker: Kunihisa Ito
detailRows.en:
The Porsche 919 Hybrid first competed at the WEC in 2014,
if I’m not mistaken.

This is the 2016 model. The 2014 car had a white
paint job and stylish gray stripes across its body.
Viewed from above, the stripes spelled out the phrase
"PORSCHE INTELLIGENT PERFORMANCE."
Among its many design features was its multi-LED headlight
system, meant to improve night driving.
To implement it, the front wheel arches were
raised, along with the driver’s seat.
The 919’s historic 2016 battle against Toyota’s TS050 was one
that will not soon be forgotten at Le Mans.

Indeed, it marked the beginning of the car’s three-year
winning streak at the famous racing event.
detailRows.zh:
如果我没记错的话，这台保时捷919 Hybrid
在2014年首次参加了世界耐力锦标赛。

这一台是2016款。因为2014年款采用了白色涂装以及
时尚感十足的灰色条纹，交叉纵横于其车身。
从上方看，这些条纹拼出了标语
“保时捷智慧性能”。
在其众多设计特色中，值得一提的是多LED车头灯系统，
该系统旨在提高夜间驾驶的性能。
为了实现这一设计，前轮拱罩被特意提高，
驾驶员座椅也跟着被抬高。
919 Hybrid与丰田的TS050之间激烈的2016年勒芒之战
是一个让人难以忘怀的经典时刻……

实际上，正是在这一战尘埃落定之后，该车
在这一著名赛事上开始了为期三年的连庄。

detailRows.speaker: Kunihisa Ito
detailRows.en:
The TS050 Hybrid is the pride of Japan, and one car that
I’d really like to take to the track!
2016 was the year that Toyota introduced the bright white,
red, and black colour scheme for its GAZOO Racing cars.

It was also the year that two TS050s faced off against
the Porsche 919 at Le Mans.
Tragically, a mere 6 minutes from the finish line, the lead
Toyota car suffered engine trouble and lost the race.
However, in 2018, 33 years after its first Le Mans appearance,
Toyota took home an incredible overall victory.

It was the first Japanese car to do so since the Mazda
787B’s win in 1991.<next id=1901006 type
detailRows.zh:
TS050 Hybrid是日本的骄傲，同时也是我
非常渴望在赛道上驾驶的一款车！
2016年，Toyota为旗下所属的GAZOO Racing车队引入了
鲜艳的白色、红色和黑色配色方案。

这一年也是两辆TS050与Porsche 919在勒芒
展开激烈对决的一年。
不幸的是，距离终点仅有6分钟时，领先的Toyota赛车却遭遇
引擎故障，输掉了比赛。
不过，在2018年，在距离首次亮相勒芒已经
过去33年之际，Toyota却取得了令人难以置信的全面胜利。

这是继1991年Mazda787B赢得比赛后，日本车队首次在勒芒夺冠。

detailRows.speaker: Kunihisa Ito
detailRows.en:
Anyone who has spent time playing Gran Turismo has likely found
themselves behind the wheel of this legendary Porsche.
The 956 and its successor, the 962...
...dominated the global motorsport scene for years,
racking up numerous victories.

The 962C, in particular, is widely regarded as the most
successful sports-racing prototype ever created.
Its striking livery, streamlined bodywork...
...and the vertical fin-supported rear wings are as iconic today
as when they first appeared on the track.$
detailRows.zh:
任何玩过《跑车浪漫旅》的人想必都曾
至少驾驶过一次这款车型。
Porsche 956及其后继车型962……
在国际赛场上为Porsche赢得了长达数十年的胜利。

事实上，962C被广泛认为是有史以来
“最成功的运动原型赛车”。
它鲜艳的车身涂装，简洁的车身线条……
以及由两侧垂直尾翼支撑的大尺寸后扰流板，即使在
今天仍然充满魅力，一如初上赛道时那样令人印象深刻。

detailRows.speaker: Kunihisa Ito
detailRows.en:
To qualify the CLK-GTR, the predecessor of this CLK-LM,
for racing...

Mercedes-Benz was required to build 25 road-going cars for a few
lucky multi-millionaires.
Like its predecessor, the CLK-LM evolution had leather
upholstery and an air-conditioning system.
The dashboard, grille, headlights, and taillights
are similarly pleasing.
At the same time, it clearly maintains the design integrity
of its mass-produced CLK brethren.
detailRows.zh:
为了使Mercedes-Benz CLK-GTR，这款CLK-LM的
前代车型获得参赛资格……

Mercedes-Benz不得不生产了25辆公路车，
出售给少数几位幸运的超级富豪。
因此，和前代车型一样，这款称作CLK-LM的改款车型
也配备了真皮内饰和空调系统。
其仪表盘、前格栅、前大灯和尾灯的设计同样精致。
与此同时，它也明显保留了与其量产CLK系列车型
一脉相承的设计特征。[

detailRows.speaker: Kunihisa Ito
detailRows.en:
When the Sauber Mercedes C9 was introduced, it was already
somewhat aged...

...having arrived just as Group C regulations ushered
in a new era of automotive technology.
It was the era of carbon-fiber monocoque chassis, showcased
by TWR-Jaguar machines...

...along with entries from Nissan, Toyota, and Aston Martin.

Meanwhile, the Sauber C9 stuck with an all-aluminum construction.
But that didn’t stop it from dominating Le Mans in 1989 with a
stunning 1-2 finish.
How did it achieve such an incredible feat?

The answer lies in the power of Mercedes' advanced
computer systems and rock-solid engineering.

It was the kind of victory that only cutting-edge technology
could deliver!
detailRows.zh:
从1987年首次亮相的那一刻起，索伯梅赛德斯C9
就已经有些过时了。

毕竟，它诞生于C组别规则推出和汽车技术
新时代来临之前的黎明。
这是碳纤维单体壳底盘闪亮登场的年代，以汤姆·沃金肖赛车-捷豹……

日产、丰田和阿斯顿马丁为代表的车型就是例证。

而索伯C9仍然坚持全铝结构。
但这并没有阻止它在1989年的勒芒取得
一二带回的成绩。
它是如何取得这一惊人壮举的呢？

这都要归功于梅赛德斯自己的计算机系统
和可靠的制造工艺！

确实，这是一场只有计算机才能实现的胜利！

detailRows.speaker: Kunihisa Ito
detailRows.en:
The McLaren P1 is a special edition plug-in hybrid
from British automaker McLaren Automotive.
It features a carbon-fiber monocoque with a roof
structure called "MonoCage."
It’s the successor to McLaren’s legendary F1.

But the P1 carves out its own identity with a fresh,
organic design language.
And, to enhance aerodynamics
on the track...

...This GTR features a large front splitter, aggressive
side skirts, and an imposing rear wing.
detailRows.zh:
McLaren P1是英国汽车制造商McLaren Automotive推出的
一款特别版插电式混合动力车。
其车身采用了碳纤维单体车壳和
名为“MonoCage”的车顶结构。
尽管设计灵感来源于McLaren的传奇F1赛车……

但P1的设计语言更新颖，更具有活力。
此外，为了提高赛道上的空气动力学性能……

这款GTR配备了大型前分流器、侧裙
以及一个引人注目的尾翼。

detailRows.speaker: Kunihisa Ito
detailRows.en:
The Audi Quattro was a landmark achievement
in the history of automotive design.
Introduced in 1981, it revolutionized the world
of rally racing.

And, it has remained a benchmark for production-car
technology ever since.
Most of its outer panels are crafted from a blend of
resin and Kevlar.

And its steeply raked windshield provides better visibility
than many of its peers.
With wide fenders, a short wheelbase, and somewhat awkward
proportions, it may not have been the prettiest machine.

But as a purpose-built competition car,
it delivered outstanding results.
detailRows.zh:
Audi Quattro是汽车设计史上的一个里程碑。
它于1981年首次亮相，便彻底改变了拉力赛的世界……

并从此成为赛车技术下放量产车的典范。
其大部分外部面板是由树脂和凯夫拉混合材料制成……

挡风玻璃的角度经过调整，相比原型车
可提供更大的可视范围。
它的挡泥板宽大，轴距短，显得比例很不协调。

然而，作为一款专为比赛设计的汽车，
它以极其出色的成绩做出了回应。

detailRows.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
detailRows.en:
This is such an exciting car!

From an angle, it seems to begin with a tire and end with a
tire, and the cabin takes up about half the body.
The height of its shoulder is determined by the suspension,
and the rear half of the cabin sits on the driven wheels.

This produces a lot of traction, and that raw power is
reflected in the clean lines of the car's sides.
And, it's channeled to propel the long nose forward!

The clean design features classically Japanese inspirations
such as flowing rivers and split bamboo.
You could even go far as to say it combines an angelic boldness
with a devilish level of detail.

It really is the epitome of "Kodo" design!

Incidentally, the fact that a race version was produced,
seemingly out of the blue...

...is probably related to the fact that the design boss
in Hiroshima is a race driver himse�f.

I really can't wait to hear that rotary engine roar!
detailRows.zh:
这是一辆让人热血沸腾的车！

当你从某个特定角度看它的时候，它的线条以一颗轮胎
为始，以另一颗轮胎为终。它的座舱占据了大约车身的1/2。
车辆肩线的高度完全由悬挂的行程决定……座舱后半部
分的重量正落在驱动轮上，

产生大量的牵引力……这股动力沿着展现车辆亮点的侧
面弧线流动……
带着庞大的推力径直冲向长长的车头！

它有破竹的清澈，更有清溪的纯净，简洁的设计带有经
典的日本风韵。
仿佛结合了天使的大胆以及魔鬼的邪恶细节。

“魂动”设计的巅峰，就在此刻，此处！

像这样横空出世般的赛车版本……

可能与广岛工厂的设计总监本身就是一名赛车手有关。

噢，我已经迫不及待想听听它的转子引�(�轰鸣的声音了！

detailRows.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
detailRows.en:
In the 1980s, in the midst of a bubble economy, Japan became
the biggest auto producer in the world.

Becoming the leader in the automotive industry requires a lot
of thought about what kind of products should be offered.

It was a time of ambition and decision.
There were lots of discussion of what made
Japanese automotive design distinctive.

Japanese cars from around this time were
embraced by people around the world.
When I first saw the white flowing lines of the Celica, or
the A80 Supra, on the cobblestoned streets of Europe,
it was as a mind-blowing experience, reminding me when I first
saw giant tail fins of a Chrysler in Azabu in Tokyo.
detailRows.zh:
日本在20世纪80年代经济蓬勃发展时期，曾短暂地为了世
界上最大的汽车生产国。

在汽车行业的领导地位使其自然而然地产生了许多想法，
希望决定汽车发展的方向……

你可以把它视作一种野心或反思。
在那一时期产生了大量的讨论，探讨日本汽车设计独树
一帜的缘由。

撇开理念不谈，这一时期的日本车确实受到了全球车迷
的喜爱。
当我真正遇到白色流线造型的赛利卡，或是在欧洲古城的
鹅卵石街道邂逅A80 Supra时，
那种心灵的震撼和耳目一新的感觉就和我小时候在东京
麻布区看到一辆有巨大尾鳍的克莱斯勒时几乎一模一样。

detailRows.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
detailRows.en:
The A80 Supra...

...is a coupe with very traditional sports-car proportions
that's kind of rare in Japanese cars.

With a windshield that wraps all around the cabin,
it has a proper greenhouse.
And this car takes the classic, beautiful coupe and drops the
ride height further and widens the track...

...turning it into a race car that looks like it could really
deliver on the track!
The car's shape is simple, so the Castrol livery suits it well.

The lights, which look too close together in the original model,
are camouflaged and don't get in the way of the design.
The A80 Supra had lots of tuning parts available for it, so
it's no wonder it was so popular with the younger crowd.
detailRows.zh:
该怎么描述A80 Supra呢……

这是一款采用传统跑车比例的双门跑车，在日本车当中
相当罕见。

环绕式的挡风玻璃仿若一个倒置的温室。
这辆经典、优美的双门跑车进一步降低了离地间隙，加
宽了胎面，

变成了一辆仿佛随时可以一飞冲天的赛车。
简洁的车型与Castrol的涂装相得益彰。

原版车中看起来相距太近的头灯经过涂装的遮掩后也不
那么碍眼了。
再加上80 Supra有很多可供选择的调校件，难怪它在年
轻人中有如此大的魅力了！<next id=2000306 type=

detailRows.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
detailRows.en:
Notice how the tires are positioned far out at the corners,
while the cabin tapers gracefully toward the rear.

It’s a winning combination, wouldn’t you agree?

The design conveys a remarkable sense of genuine agility,
no matter the vehicle’s height.

It's a type of beauty that is common with cars like
the Honda CR-Z.
Front-end designs of recent Toyotas are fairly aggressive
looking even unmodified.

In this case, they've taken that and run with it, for the
kind of car a real gearhead would appreciate.

The expression of the fascia isn't bad, but it's disappointing
that it reminds you of an older Peugeot from afar.
The car is packed with good things so it would be nice if the
model sticks and is loved on the streets for a long time.

It makes you want to see a different model like the Renault R5
Turbo where an adult could dress up and drive it in style.<next id=2000406 type=9ԙ
detailRows.zh:
你看，轮胎被远远地放在四角，座舱自然向后收窄，

这就叫强强联合，你说对不对？

即便车身高度很高，依然给人以灵活的感觉。

这种美感在诸如本田CR-Z等车型中相当常见。
最近几年的丰田在车身前部设计方面相当具有侵略性。

在这一台上也是如此，而且绝对能让真正的爱车人
满心欢喜。

前饰板的设计不算太坏，但还是有点令人失望。
从远处看，它会让你想起标致的老爷车。
丰田在这款车里塞进了很多不错的特性，
希望普罗大众会喜欢它吧，让它证明自己……

我很高兴能看到一台跟雷诺R5涡轮增压版同类型的其他车型
出现在市场上，成为成熟车手的心头好。

detailRows.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
detailRows.en:
Historically, many road cars that served as the basis
for rally machines have been especially appealing.

Cars like the Mini Cooper S, Audi quattro
and Lancia Delta...

...all began as practical, utility-focused family cars.

Yet beneath that everyday form, they carried
serious performance potential.
Of course, a true rally car could not be driven on public roads.

From a design standpoint, the challenge was to express that
expanded capability within the framework of a road car.
The Evo V introduced larger wheels with pronounced overfenders.

It gave the traditional three-box sedan
the stance of a performance machine.
Combined with signature rally elements such as large
fog lights and a prominent rear wing...

...it completed the purposeful yet refined design of the
second-generation Lancer Evolution.
detailRows.zh:
从历史上看，许多被用作拉力赛车改装原型的公路车都
非常有吸引力。

我指的是像迷你Cooper S、奥迪quattro和
蓝旗亚Delta这样的车……

这些都是以家庭用车为目的，讲究实用性的车型。

它们就仿佛是栖息在城市中的动物。
当然了，真正的拉力赛车都是禁止在街道上驾驶的。

因此在设计方面，重点在于如何在公路车的框架内表达扩展的远景。
Evo V采用了人们期待已久的大车轮，
为了搭配车轮，挡泥板的尺寸也相应拓展，

这台三厢轿车的底盘也由此换成了赛车底盘。
拉力赛车标志性的巨大雾灯和尾翼自然更不用提。

你可以认为，它就代表了第二代Lancer Evo的完整形态。

detailRows.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
detailRows.en:
The Skyline GT-R is an icon of the
Japanese automotive industry.

But there may be no other car in Japan
where its history and tradition...

...weighs so heavily on a designer.
In that respect, designing a GT-R today is not so different
than designing a Porsche or a Ferrari.

Back when this R33 was built, a normal mid-size sporty sedan
was the base.

So there was probably a lot of difficulties in its design.
Based on a three-box shape, the 4-seat production car...

...strictly adhered to its underlying philosophy
as a "Wolf in Sheep's Clothing."
Also, because the beginning of the R33 development overlapped
with the tail end of the economic bubble in Japan...
...the body of the R33 was large, heavy, and its style
was stocky, but it was elegant in overall style.
detailRows.zh:
Skyline GT-R品牌是日本汽车工业的一个标志。

但也没有哪辆日本汽车的历史和传统会像这辆车一般……

对设计师产生如此大的压力。
有鉴于此，设计一辆GT-R的压力其实无异于设计一辆
保时捷或法拉利。

这辆R33在设计时以普通的中型运动型轿车为基础……

遇到很多设计上的难题也就无可避免。
在对这台四座三厢量产车进行改造时，

基本的理念是打造出了一匹“披着羊皮的狼”。
而且，由于R33的开发初期正好撞上了日本经济泡沫的
尾声，
因此，R33的车身既大且重，但气度优雅，与当时的时代
背景相吻合。

detailRows.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
detailRows.en:
A true sports car of Toyota making a 17-year comeback
was this Supra.

In the model changes for the Celica, Toyota never tried
to build a design identity for itself.

As if to keep denying its past, the company
continued to be the innovator.

And that in itself commands respect,
but the Celica is no more.
And the Supra for sure appeared on a blank canvas, without
looking to the past, making a dazzling first appearance.

It shares a few components with the BMW Z4, but a different
design direction successfully differentiated them.
The only thing that is a little disappointing...

...is that to effectively show the design of its body sides,
you want a little more width.
You just can't help your eyes wandering towards the FT-1.
detailRows.zh:
这辆Supra是丰田17年后卷土重来的真正跑车杰作。

从赛利卡变到Supra后，丰田并未尝试为它建立一个真正
的设计标识。

他们一直在追逐创新，仿佛是为了不断否定自己的过去。

赛利卡的确值得尊敬，但在Supra身上，你感受不到它的
一丝影子。
Supra无疑是在一块空白的画布上绘制的，在众人眼前
闪亮登场的它与过去的成就毫无牵连。

虽然和宝马Z4共享了相当多的部件，但两者的设计截
然不同，成功地将彼此区分开来。
唯一的小遗憾就是……

如果能加宽车体，就能更好地展示出车身两侧的设计。
我必须承认，它会让你不由自主地联想到那台永远停留
在概念里的丰田FT-1。<next id=2000706 type=9ۜ

detailRows.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
detailRows.en:
Look at this MR2, and you're likely to notice its modest, understated design.

In Italy, you'll find fierce beasts like the Urraco,
named after a fighting bull, and the Merak.

These are flashy cars that really stand out, but they're
not for the faint-hearted.

Let's just say that even when you handle them the
right way, they can still bite back.
This MR2 is pretty domesticated in that respect,
and does exactly what you tell it to do.

But that doesn't mean it's tame by any means. Put the pedal
to the metal and you won't know what hit you!
Still, for a carefree driving experience,
you can't go too wrong with this car.

It's one you'll want to make a place for
in your heart and in your home.
You can recognize some elements inspired by Ferrari here
and there, but all in all, it retains a certain modesty.

Perhaps this reflects Řhe belief of the Japanese designers
that they weren't quite ready for the world stage...

...just yet.*
detailRows.zh:
看看这辆MR2，它是如此地谦逊、低调。

在意大利，有着像Urraco这样的猛兽，以公牛的名字命
名，或是同样出名的Merak。

这些姿色出众的好车需要你拥有强大的气场才能驾驭。

这样说吧，就算你知道如何伺候好它们，还是会冷不防
地被它们回咬上一口。
这辆MR2相比之下就服帖多了。你说什么，它就做什么。

当然了，服帖不代表盲从，踩下油门的那一刻，你会瞬
间飞入云端！
拥有如此体贴入微的驾驶体验，怎么的驾驶方法都不会
出错。

这样的它，会让你想将之迎入家中，也迎入你的心里。
你可以在这里或那里瞥见一些与法拉利类似的元素
……但骨子里仍是日本人的谦逊有礼。

也许这反映出了当时的日本设计师的理解，认_��自己的
设计还没有达到世界级的水平

……但是只是暂时没有而已。,

detailRows.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
detailRows.en:
In the transition of automotive design, fenders were originally
just mud flaps that attached to the tires.

Just before and after World War II, fenders started to be
integrated into the bodies.

And eventually the body sides came to be
cut out in the shape of the tires.
In relation to this, the rear fenders of the Viper...

...is structured as a large volume that completely
integrates the fender and doors.

And it shows the enormous traction to accommodate
the 8.0-liter V-10 engine.
It changed the flow and direction of car design, which was
moving towards abstract, multiple surfaces in the 1980s.
The soul of the American car guy is jam packed in these
glamorous fenders.

This is how an American Sports car should be!
detailRows.zh:
在汽车设计的漫长历史中，
挡泥板最初只是用于阻挡掀起的泥土的轮胎挡板。

但到了二战前后，设计师开始将挡泥板与车身融为一体。

为此，车身的侧面被切割出了轮胎的形状。
不过拿那种设计对照一下Viper的后挡泥板！

它们变成了车门的一部分，
更加突出了它相当大的体积……

以此展示出8升V10引擎无比强大的牵引力。
这项设计给80年代原本抽象、几何形的车身设计带来了
新的变化。
Viper在这些迷人的巨型挡泥板里灌注了美国汽车人的灵魂，

这才是美国跑车应该有的样子！

detailRows.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
detailRows.en:
Whoa, now this is most impressive!　

The GT1 Turbo specs, brought on by some powerful tuning,
has separated this automobile from the base model.
Because of that, the design of the original automobile...

...has been engulfed by the almost violent nature of the
added-on parts...

...greatly changing its essence.
The S2000 was originally designed to make the front
overhangs appear short...

...but the contrasting proportion of the nose,
with its wedged shape design on this car...

...was only possible because of the front mid-engine layout
of the S2000.
There's a lot of room for the intervention of design,
especially in the details.

And, one can say that its taste comes from a perceived
absence of design, making this car a lovable monster.\
detailRows.zh:
这辆车令人非常印象深刻！

在接受了大量强化调校后，这辆GT1 Turbo spec已经变得
与基础车型截然不同。
你可以明显看出，几乎称得上是“暴力”的改装件
彻底颠覆了原车的模样，

可以说已经是台完全不同的车了！
虽说S2000的设计初衷是缩短前悬距……

但Amuse的最终成果却有悖常理地造就了GT1的长车头比例！
不得不说，它在细节和其他设计元素方面都有
长足的改进空间……

但这些“简陋”的呈现反而成了萌点，
使它成为了一头可爱的怪兽。<next id=2001006 type

detailRows.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
detailRows.en:
This car brings back the spirit of the original Skyline GT-R.

When you compare this car to the R33, the overall design has
become compact and solid.
Looking at the abruptly cut-off front end, you get a sense of
a modernized version of the C10 "Hakosuka."
The side glass graphics at the C-pillar
are also reminiscent of the C10.

You can say that the different front and rear overfenders
are take from the Hakosuka, too.
And while the enlarged round taillights are an homage to the
C110, dubbed the "Ken-Meri..."

...this car is characterized by an uncommon Japanese design
that's simple and powerful.
It's undeniable that the Nissan designers wanted to express
the story of the Skyline GT-R through this car.

After all, the growth of a brand stems from love.*
detailRows.zh:
这辆车再现了原版Skyline GT-R的风采。

与R33相比，它显得紧凑而又结实。
修整过的车头仿佛是C10 “Hakosuka”的
现代版诠释……
C柱处的侧窗玻璃贴花是如此，

甚至连前后不同尺寸的挡泥板也与C10有着深厚的渊源。
那对又大又圆的尾灯
则是对绰号“Ken-Meri”的C110的致敬……

其简约而有力的设计是在日本车中十分罕见的。
毫无疑问，日产的设计师希望通过这款车
展现出Skyline GT-R的背景故事。

我只能说，这绝对是真爱了。@

detailRows.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
detailRows.en:
About Pagani's design...

...its approach is quite different
from other traditional car makers from Modena.
Ferrari, Lamborghini, Maserati...

...most of their designs are born from
historic cars that were on sale in the 1960s and 1970s...

...with body styles that were designed by a carrozzeria in Turin.
When the Zonda was introduced, at the end of the 1990s, the era
of designs that shined 30 years before in Turin had concluded...

...thus, Pagani adopted its own unique design language.
It wasn't as if it was leaving all of its rivals in the
past at once...
...but it sought to wrap sophisticated mechanisms
with an attractive body, without being too flamboyant.

That kind of balance is what defines Pagani, I feel.
detailRows.zh:
帕加尼的设计方法……

和来自摩德纳的其他传统汽车制造商大相径庭。
以法拉利、兰博基尼、玛莎拉蒂等为例，

他们的大部分设计都来自于在20世纪60年代和70年代
亮相的历史名车……

这些车的车身大多是交给都灵的车身制造商设计的。
当Zonda于20世纪90年代末期发布时，
持续30余年的都灵设计时代已经告一段落……

所以帕加尼首次采用了自己的设计语言。
倒不是说它将过去的对手彻底甩在了身后，
但它确实做出了创新尝试，将复杂的机械构造
装入具有吸引力、同时又不会过于喧宾夺主的车身当中。

这也造就了帕加尼设计特有的平衡感。

detailRows.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
detailRows.en:
Oh boy, this is just crazy!
That "5" I loved so much, what happened?

Just because it wanted to go fast in rallies,
it didn't have to sell its soul to the devil!
It has become 20cm wider, and if you look at it from the
rear, it looks like a laughing Cheshire Cat.

And because the engine is mounted at the rear,
it only seats two now.
But wait...

...upon closer examination, aside from the bulging fenders and
bumpers, oh my, much of the original 5 is still there, as is.
Aside from the cheeks, the car has a gentle face,
which means, it's more Clark Kent than the Hulk.

I mean, what kind of magic is this?
The interior of the Turbo 1
features a super modern Mario Bellini design.

This thing would be stylish, even in Paris!
Oh my! I think I've fallen in love with this crazy 5
Somebody, anybody, gimme some of this magic on my own 5.
detailRows.zh:
这真是太疯狂了！
他们对我熟悉的那台可爱的小“5”做了什么？

为了让它在拉力赛中有所建树，就非得
把它的灵魂出卖给魔鬼吗？
你看，它的车身整整变宽了20cm。
从背后看过去，就像一只咧嘴笑的柴郡猫。

由于搭载了一台后置引擎，它现在只剩下两个座位了。
等一下……

细看下来，除了隆起的挡泥板和保险杠以外——
哦，原版小“5”的大部分特征基本还是保留了！
不看侧面的话，它的前脸还是和原来一样，
所以还是更像肌肉分明的超人，而不是大块头绿巨人。

他们这是施展了什么样的巫术啊？
Turbo 1的内饰采用了马里奥·贝里尼设计的超现代风格。

就算走上巴黎的T台都不会显得格格不入！
哦，天呐！我想我已经爱上了这辆疯狂的小“5”。
事实上，我愿意接受它的一切！

detailRows.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
detailRows.en:
Usually, when using the elements of
an existing car to create a variant...

...you usually hit it with a completely design to differentiate
it from the original, so they don't occupy the same market.

This is done to avoid cannibalism.
That's why, from the designer's point of view, although in
theory it may be possible, you dare not just carry over a design.

It's like you're not doing your job.
But considering the playful spirit and freedom of will of
car guys, this act can't be ignored.

Nope. These days, just about anything goes!
In North America, when the merging of auto makers and their
brands happened early on, this sort of thing was very common.
Things like customization and the diversification
and maturity of the autotmotive culture...

...it all comes down to the passion of the customers.
detailRows.zh:
通常情况下，在设计一款当前车款的衍生车型时……

你会想应用一些新的设计，使其与基础车型作出区分。

换句话说，你会希望避免与原车型发生直接竞争。
所以对于设计师而言，借鉴设计元素通常是业界大忌，

会让人觉得设计师根本没有尽职尽责地去设计。
但是对于追求玩趣、想象力丰富的怪咖设计师来说，
这种手法却是不可或缺的。

事实上，现在的汽车设计已经是百无禁忌！
在北美，随着汽车厂商及其品牌的并购，
这种做法已经变得司空见惯。
这种风潮代表了定制和汽车文化的多样性和成熟化……

它是以消费者的热情为第一驱动力的。

detailRows.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
detailRows.en:
This vehicle was created for Vision Gran Turismo by Zagato,
an Italian carrozzeria that was founded in 1919.

It's said to be styled after a sketch by Harada, the car's
designer, while he studied at ArtCenter College of Design.
Although the three-dimensional composition looks complicated
at first glance, each element is a very simple form.

Every module, one after another, intersects
to complete the entire design.

Its traditional beauty as an FR sports car...

...exudes the feel from a traditional carrozzeria.
The power bulge on the hood
pays homage to the 7.0-liter engine of the Iso Grifo.
And, the taillights were inspired by the Red Torii Gate
at Miyajima of Aki in Japan.
detailRows.zh:
这台性能怪兽是由1919年成立于意大利的车身制造商扎加托
专为跑车浪漫旅愿景项目量身打造的。

此车的原型来自于公司设计师原田则彦
在艺术中心设计学院时期绘制的一张草图。
尽管它具有令人望而生畏的复杂三维结构，
但其实每个构成元素的形状都很简单。

通过各个简单模块的交错形成完整的车体。

此外，它还体现出了作为一辆前置后驱跑车的传统美感……

充分展现以手工打造闻名的老牌车身制造商的底蕴。
注意引擎盖上的凸起，这是对伊索狮鹫的7L引擎的致敬。
另一方面，尾灯的灵感则来自日本宫岛的红色鸟居。

detailRows.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
detailRows.en:
One of the roles design plays in industrial products is...

...to instantly convey information and the underlying message
in a visual way that may not be noticed at first glance.

It is to project the functional excellence of the product, its
philosophy, tradition and the creator's intent, instantly.

It's also supposed to draw the customer in
by eliciting a "love at first sight" appeal.
Therefore, the look of products at times tries to appeal to
many people at once, making many of them looking similar.

Bluntly put, design is usually dictated by the market.
But in the case of the Radical, this is not the case.

Whether it's a mountain road or the race track,
all it needs to do is to go fast.
The headlight, for example, is simply required
to shine a light forward.
Although seemingly unapproachable, this car knows its role.
It’s a one-of-a-kind sidekick that requires a special love.

These types of cars make life entertaining, don't you think?
detailRows.zh:
设计在工业产品制造中扮演的一个重要角色就是……

……要通过视觉手段即时地传递
第一眼可能看不出来的信息和潜台词。

要立刻呈现产品的功能优点、理念、传统和
创造者的想法。

还要通过营造出“一见钟情”的感受
来吸引到消费者。
因此，产品的外观设计有时会试图同时吸引和取悦不同类型的受众，
导致产品外观的趋同性。

说白了，设计大部分时候都受到市场的主导。
不过Radical却是个例外。

不论是山路还是赛道，它唯一的目的就是跑得更快。
比如说它的车头灯就只需要直直地照亮前方。
尽管这台车的声浪不够大、操控性不够友好，
但它很清楚自己的定位。

那就是成为独一无二、让你爱不释手的一_��老朋友。

这类车可以让你的人生充满乐趣，你觉得呢？

detailRows.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
detailRows.en:
In the 1980s, there was a very unique phenomenon in the history
of automotive design. It was a time when the "boxy" style...

...was surely at its peak.
Blister fenders were the result of an attempt to marry
round tires to a square body design.

This style is one of the defining symbols of this era.
The polyhedron body of the car here is minimalistic.

But despite its abstract form, its intonation is limited,
and the exterior styling exudes extreme passion and excitement.
And because the car is seemingly pressed into an inorganic shape,
the end effect is one that's relatively prominent.<next id=2001706 type
detailRows.zh:
在1980年代，汽车设计的历史上掀起了一股非常独特的浪潮。

“四四方方”的设计理念在当时大行其道。
这部分微微鼓起的挡泥板就是这种思路的产物
——设计师们试图将轮胎的圆形和车身的方形轮廓融合起来。

这样的造型代表了那个年代的显著象征之一。
多边形车身非常抽象、简约。

虽然发出的音浪不大，
但成功通过外立面表达出了强烈的热情和兴奋感。
粗看下，这台车像是一团被捏合而成的无机物，
呈现出相对抢眼的最终效果。~

detailRows.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
detailRows.en:
The Mini, Beetle and Cinquecento of today...

Are more than just products of their manufacturers.
They have become unique brands unto themselves.
Well, the Ford GT that appeared in 2005 is
a sports car example of this phenomenon.

Nine years later, a slew of hypercars
would appear, stirring fierce rivalry.

This 2017 Ford GT returned to its origins while,
at the same time, adopting innovation.
Viewed from a low angle, it bears traces of
the 1960s car that raced at Le Mans.
And from a higher angle, one can clearly make out
its innovative three-dimensional design.
detailRows.zh:
极具标志性特色的Mini、Beetle和Cinquecento……

……不仅只是一款产品……

……更成为了各自品牌独一无二的名片。
这款2005年亮相的Ford GT
则是Ford的超跑“门面”。

但在那之后的九年间，随着大量超级跑车相继问世，
市场竞争日趋激烈。

这款2017 Ford GT采用了传承经典的设计理念，
同时引入了多项革新。
俯下身来观察，你会发现它甚至保留了
1960年代勒芒赛车时的部分特征。
而通过俯瞰视角，则可以清晰地见证革新性的3D建模设计车壳。<

detailRows.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
detailRows.en:
I think that the Fugu Z is a very appealing car.

The interior is especially cool because it's so carefully
stripped down.

Only the bare minimum parts have been added,
which match the car's power output that has nearly doubled.
The original 240Z was straightforward and had
beautiful proportions...

...and this car is respectful of that with its
minimal customization.
Look at the original fender mirrors, they're in the
original Kilimanjaro White color.

It was as if a young person from California came upon
a Z that was a bit rough around the edges...

...and polished it with the admiration he had of the car
in the past.
And now...

...the raw pureness of the spirit of the
1973 Z shines brightly in the Fugu Z.

Thank you, Sung Kang!
detailRows.zh:
我觉得Fugu Z是一辆充满魅力的车。

内饰经过了非常细致的精简，显得尤其炫酷。

这款车只最低限度地安装了必要的改装件，
与之相对的是几乎翻倍的动力输出。
原始车型240Z的设计本身就很简约，
但有着优美的车身比例……

……这台车很好地延续了这一风格，只进行了极少量的改装。
你瞧瞧这原版的挡泥板上装后视镜，
连油漆都是原版的乞力马扎罗白。

就好像是有个加州的年轻人遇上了一辆老爷车Z，
感怀它的破旧不堪……

……就抱着自己对这辆车的情怀对它进行了打磨。
而现在……

……1973 Z那最纯粹、最原始的精神
在Fugu Z的身上得到了灿烂重现。

姜成镐，谢谢你的付出！)

detailRows.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
detailRows.en:
Now, this is what I call a British sports car!

The hardcore radical quality here is expressed throughout,
from the interior to its exterior appearance.

The car's spirit is hardly diplomatic.
It's as if this vehicle is saying,
