"I have no desire to be a star to the public."

And, at the same time, it exemplifies the pure and naive love
that we feel for sports cars.
On the sexy body, which sits extremely low for a front-engine
car, there's a cold round detail that totally lacks emotion.

The hood, sculpted and low other than around the engine,
and the corresponding trunk lid...
...express a powerful driving force.

In this regard, the styling goes well beyond what
many would accept, for love sees no fault.
This design generates indifferent feelings,
captivating only those who understand it.
detailRows.zh:
看啊，这才是我眼中真正的英国跑车！

从内饰到外观，这辆车浑身都散发着不羁和激进。

摒弃圆滑和世故，展现永不妥协的精神。
实际上，它似乎完全无意迎合大众口味。

与此同时，它也向我们表达了对一款纯血、直击本质的
跑车的热爱。
对于一辆前置引擎车来说，它的车身异常低矮流畅，
圆弧的车身细节也显得极度冷漠，不带一丝感情。

引擎盖深深下凹，只有引擎位置高高隆起，
行李箱盖处也采用了同样的设计……
……露出一副动力充盈、跃跃欲试的模样。

其外观设计已经远超大众能够接受的审美范围，
唯有真正的爱好者方能欣赏。
这是一款必然引发争议的设计，只对那些懂它的人
散发无穷魅力。

detailRows.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
detailRows.en:
The soul of a creator reaches out to unknown horizons.

At the point of arrival, new footprints
erase what was there before.

This creative passion will forever be engraved into
people's hearts and never disappear.
These extraordinary creators...their visions have
profoundly shaped the automotive world.

They grab hold of the distant future and pull it in.

They fly in the skies where technology and design are free,
then safely land where their completed car becomes legend.
And the creator becomes a hero.

The designer of the 1955 DS was the Italian,
 Flaminio Bertoni.
Unfortunately, his existence became
widely known only after his passing.]
detailRows.zh:
这是创作者的灵魂在向着未知的边界进行探索。

在抵达之时，新的足迹便抹去了原先的痕迹。

然而，这份创作的激情将永远铭刻在人们心中，
永远不会消失。
这些非凡的创作者，他们的愿景深刻地塑造了汽车世界。

他们抓住遥远的未来，将其带到人们的眼前。

他们自由飞翔在技术和设计的天空中，随着他们安全落下，
因之而生的汽车便成为了传奇。
而创作者则成为了英雄。

1955 DS的设计师是一位意大利人，弗拉米尼奥·贝托尼。
令人扼腕的是，他的声名在故去之后才广泛地为人所知。

detailRows.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
detailRows.en:
From its GP machines to the Royales, Bugatti pushed the
automobile horizon in many directions in the pre-war era.

Especially in regard to design, Jean Bugatti
of the Bugatti family...

Ensured that the company's cars were dynamic in nature and
possessed originality that was recognizable at a glance.

However, at the same time, the cars also combined a certain
sublimeness and acceptance of classic aesthetics.
Even the Veyron's styling suggested that it was one
level apart from its rivals from Modena, Italy.

The traditional wedge-shaped formula was
completely discarded...
While the roofline and fenders were presented in natural
harmony, flowing down to the rear of the car.

The car's elegant lines are uninterrupted, running smoothly
around its body—a joy to trace with your eyes.
The styling expresses a euphoric art nouveau expression�
It makes me respect Jean Bugatti all the more.
detailRows.zh:
从GP赛车再到皇家，布加迪在二战前
就将汽车的边界向各个方向大幅扩展。

特别是在设计上，布加迪家族的让·布加迪……

负责确保这家公司的所有汽车都拥有动感的本质和
一目了然的原创性。

与此同时，布加迪推出的车也结合了威严感
以及对传统美学的接纳。
这辆布加迪Veryron的风格设计就表现出了它与
来自意大利摩德纳的竞争对手的截然不同。

它彻底地弃用了传统的楔形车身设计……
从车顶到挡泥板的线条自然而和谐，
流泻到车尾。

从一而终的优雅线条沿车身顺滑地向后延伸，
带动你的眼神去追寻，赏心悦目。
这种造型风格表达了一种幸福、陶醉感的新艺术派理念。
也让我对让·布加迪更加肃然起敬。

detailRows.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
detailRows.en:
This is originally a machine meant for the track,
so it's not street legal.

But the design has not been compromised one bit.
It conveys an expression of violent performance combined
with the classic beauty that defines Aston Martin.

Having these attributes simultaneously gives
this car a Jekyll-and-Hyde design quality.
From a nose that looks like it's about to eat the car ahead
to the low skirts and the underside of the rear diffuser...
A strange power resonates from the tissues and internal
organs that make up this carbon-fiber machine.

They speak plainly about the origins and intent
of this car.
The British-style understatement of the DB series is
something that transcends eccentricity.

It is the glorious madness that defines today's
Aston Martin.
detailRows.zh:
这辆车原本是专为赛道设计的比赛机器，
所以并不能合法在城市道路上行驶。

尽管如此，它的设计并未作出丝毫的妥协。
这辆车结合了暴力的性能和经典的美感，
也是阿斯顿马丁赖以成名的品牌特点。

两者的结合让这辆车呈现出
如同化身博士般的古怪质感。
从它那看上去就像是要把前车吞掉的车头
到两侧的侧裙，再到夸张的后扩散器……
组成这辆碳纤维怪兽的“肌肉组织”和“内部器官”
迸发出一股奇异的能量，

也开门见山地阐述了这辆车的血统和其设计意图。
DB系列那英式的低调和不动声色已经无法用另类形容。

也正是这种孤芳自赏的疯狂个性，
让今日的阿斯顿马丁依然能够屹立在汽车之林。

detailRows.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
detailRows.en:
The large air intakes placed on the side of the body are
reminiscent of elegant French styling of the 1930s.
However, I sense it is slightly mismatched with the
wild example of the coda tronca body style.

In the Veyron, the intakes are placed there
to improve aerodynamics.
They make the sides look a bit like a French carrosserie
or the Delage D6 of Henri Labourdette.

This is a beautiful flamboyant French design, one where
the function-defining form to travel at 400km...

Makes modern-day Bugattis so alluring, don't you think?
It's my fondest hope that they always remain
sublime and pure.*
detailRows.zh:
位于车身两侧的大号进气口令人回忆起1930年代
的那些优雅法国车造型。
不过我总感觉这种风格和“coda tronca”（断尾）
的设计有些不搭。

在Veyron上，在这里设计进气口是为了提升空气动力学性能。
这样的设计让侧面的外观向法式车身靠拢，
又有点类似亨利·拉布戴特的Delage D6。

美观到有些浮夸的法系设计，
外加能够达到400km极速的超跑定位……

让现代版本的Bugatti充满了魅力，对吧？
在此致以我最美好的愿望，希望他们可以
永远保持卓越和纯粹。

detailRows.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
detailRows.en:
There are a variety of ways to express your passion for cars.

This machine is a 1951 Ford.
Not only has it been lowered, the roof has been left intact,
and the body itself has been made thinner.

The engine is from a Lincoln of the same era.

The car creators pulled off in real life what designers
today would only attempt on a computer screen.
Cars from this era were simple to tune, having the potential
for customization unlike those of today.

Find a basic design that you fancy, and then inject your
own sense of beauty and experience into it...

...and you have your own one-of-a-kind masterpiece.
Every detail of this car is a 100-percent reflection of the
tastes and experiences of the car owner and creator.
Compare it with today’s exotic cars that await customers in the
showrooms, which one do you think stands ou� more?
detailRows.zh:
表达对爱车的热情的方式可谓五花八门。

这是一辆1951年的福特。
它的全车车身经过了降低，没有锯掉车顶，
但整车外壳接受了打薄处理。

它的引擎来自于一辆同时期的林肯。

这辆车的创造者赤手空拳就做到了如今的汽车设计师们
只敢借助电脑才能完成的事。
与今天的车不同，来自那个时代的车辆易于调校，
也有很大的改装潜力。

找一辆你中意的基础车型，然后将你的美学与经验
倾注其中……

就能拥有一辆独一无二的杰作。
这辆车上的每个细节都100%体现了它的所有者
与创造者的品味与经验。
与如今静静地在展厅中等待着买家的豪车相比，
你更喜欢哪一辆呢？"

detailRows.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
detailRows.en:
Today, the WRX STI has grown into a model
with its own distinct identity...

...representing Subaru’s engineering capability, technical
efficiency and focus on high performance.
But the second-generation WRX STI remained closely
tied to the Impreza.

And that connection gave its character a unique appeal.

It effectively reflected the idea of an everyday sedan
transformed into a serious performance machine.
With the newer WRX, however, the base model already carried a more
aggressive character, making the contrast less pronounced.

If you’re drawn to that sense of transformation—like
Peter Parker becoming Spider-Man...
...then this second-generation model, with its clean, understated
cabin and simpler window design, may be just right for you.~
detailRows.zh:
时至今日，WRX STi已经……

拥有了自己独立的品牌价值和存在意义，它代表着
斯巴鲁的技术实力与热情。
有鉴于第二代WRX STi是翼豹的改款版本之一……

使得它的设计完美体现了我们常用来打趣的那句俗语……

“文能出门买菜，武可拉力比赛。”
相比之下，新一代WRX的出厂版本就已经颇具进攻性，
所以新型号上的文武之分就没有那么鲜明了。

因此，如果你想看到的是彼得·帕克
变身成为蜘蛛侠那种迥然相异的反差……
那么内饰朴实简洁，且没有配备三角形后车窗的
第二代WRX将是你的不二选择。

detailRows.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
detailRows.en:
The Evo’s history is marked by constant improvements
and functional expansions.

This MR version was the final model of the third-gen Evo IX,
and is said to be one of the best Evos ever.The third-generation car was based on the Lancer Cedia,
which, in turn, was a serious and practical family sedan.
Compared to the second-generation model, it was larger overall.
The nose took on a rounded shape, while blister fenders were adopted.

Not quite the battle machine it used to be...

...the large iconic fog lights, reminiscent of rally cars,
were done away with.

It was a sign that the Evo was expanding its sphere of competition
to include endurance races and the like.
At the same time, the car's upscale nature grew.

Multi-purpose cars like the Evo tend to adapt
to their surroundings.

In this sense, they evolve like living things.

And that is just one of the many reasons that
fans continue to love the Evo.
detailRows.zh:
在翼豪陆神的发展史上，充斥着持续不断的改进和功能拓展。

这款MR版本是第三代翼豪陆神IX的终极车型，
也被公认为最卓越的翼豪陆神之一。
第三代翼豪陆神的开发基于蓝瑟西迪亚，
一款普通而实用的家庭轿车。
相较于第二代，它的车身整体更大，车头被重新设计得
更加圆润，同时加入了引人注目的凸起轮拱。

它不再保持曾经的战斗机器风格……

标志性的硕大雾灯，以及那些让人联想到
拉力赛车的元素，也不复存在……

这暗示着翼豪陆神正在将其竞争领域从耐力赛扩大到
更多不同领域。
与此同时，车辆的高端进阶属性也更为凸显。

像翼豪陆神这样的多功能车型往往能够灵活
适应不同的环境。

从这个意义上说，它们就像�生物一样在不断演变进化。

这正是车迷们一直对翼豪陆神怀有深厚感情的众多原因之一。

detailRows.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
detailRows.en:
If my memory serves me right, I used to be called
the Ford Mustang Mach 1.

I’d was dormant for a long time, but when I awoke
everything had changed.
I can't sit still. How I wish to burn rubber,
driving with all my might!

The power my heart pumps is twice what it used to be.

My tires are larger, and my width, increased.

Now I can hardly recall who I am!
Cherished fragments of my former self remain, in my window
shield, headlights, tail, and door.

People say that this is what they love about me.

But I am also a monster, so filled-up with parts that
my heart had to be moved back.
The Mach 40... Yes, that is the name of my new self.
detailRows.zh:
如果我没有记错的话，我曾经被人们称为
“福特Mustang Mach 1”。

我曾在沉寂中度过了很长一段时间，但当我重新苏醒时，
我发现一切都已完全不同。
我不能置身事外。我多么渴望尽情释放自己的力量，
全力行驶，让车轮橡胶冒出阵阵青烟！

我心脏的跳动力量是过去的两倍。

我的轮胎变得更加宽大，我的车身变得更加宽阔。

现在我几乎忘记了自己的本来模样！
代表过去的细微特征只在挡风玻璃、前灯、尾部和车门上得以保留。

人们说这些是他们喜欢我的地方。

但我也变成了一辆动力怪兽，身体里被塞入了各种新的零部件，
以至于我的心脏不得不重新找地方安置。
“Mach 40”……是的，这就是我的新名字。

detailRows.speaker: Tom Matano
detailRows.en:
The 997 restores some of what was lost in the transition from
the 993 to the 996, while adding some subtle upgrades.

A few of these elements have become something that is
unique to Porsche.
A good example of this is where the turn signals are integrated
with the bumper's air intake opening.

Such refined details may be small by themselves, however they
increase the overall quality and uniformity of the design.
detailRows.zh:
997这款车带回了Porsche从993过渡到996时失去的
一些东西，并对细节做了部分改进。

其中的一些升级最终成为了Porsche的标准元素。
这里有一个很好的例子，就是将转向灯与保险杠的进风
口融为一体。

这些改进本身可能很微小，但提高了设计的品质，还有助
于提升车辆的整体性。

detailRows.speaker: Tom Matano
detailRows.en:
You know, from the start, I wanted to give this Roadster
a timeless design.
It’s full of that sentiment which compels an owner
to wish their car a goodnight.
I've even heard of fans who chose to sleep in it
the very first day they had it in their garage.

Truly, it’s the car you’ll name, throw birthday parties for
and one day lovingly restore...
detailRows.zh:
你知道吗，从一开始我就想让这款Roadster成为永不褪
色的设计。
我希望它能完整传递一种情绪，让车主们会在睡前对自
己的爱车道“晚安”……
而且我确实听说过有车迷在买完车的第一天，睡在了车
里。

我希望这是一辆你会特地为它取名、为它庆生的车，并
在某一天将它恢复到最佳状态……

detailRows.speaker: Tom Matano
detailRows.en:
There was this one time I received a wedding invitation
from a total stranger living in Texas.

And I thought to myself, 'Maybe its an owner of a Roadster?'
So I contacted the Roadster Club of Texas...

And found out that the happy couple had met at the club,
and that one had a red car while the other a white one.
Unfortunately I wasn't able to attend the wedding,

But a year later I received word that they had given birth
to a baby!

So I painted a miniature model of a Roadster in Pink
and sent it to them.
Being able to connect with owners like this
is really gratifying for me as a designer.
It's the resut it wouldn’t be possible witho share the passion
of everybody who wo��ed on t�e �a��քext id=2100208 type=9>R
detailRows.zh:
有一次，我收到一封喜帖，是住在德克萨斯的陌生人寄
来的。

我心想，“也许这是一位敞篷跑车车主”？然后我联系了
德克萨斯的敞篷跑车俱乐部。

我发现这对夫妇就是通过俱乐部认识的，他们一个人开
红车，一个人开白车
很遗憾我无法抽身参加那场婚礼，

然后过了一年，我又收到了一条消息，他们有了一个宝
宝！

于是我涂了一个粉色的敞篷跑车模型送给他们。
可以像这样和车主们产生交流和联系，令身为设计师的
我感到万分满足。
如果没有开发这台车的同事们投注的热情，也不可能促
成这样的美事。

detailRows.speaker: Tom Matano
detailRows.en:
You know, I used to drive my friend's
PGC10 GT-R a lot.

That’s what got me into sports sedans, which I consider to be
a "wolf in sheep’s clothing".
Now, this here is the model that set the basic formula
for the modern GT-R.
At first glance, it evokes a clear sense of volume.

And by weighing down the rear fender, the designers
made the car look like it was in motion even when standing still.
This allowed the GT-R to strike a more aggressive stance
than the base GT model.
Also...

...it marked the beginning of the era of sensor-controlled
vehicle dynamics and other high-performance technologies.

All of this makes the current GT-R the rightful heir
to this R32 GTR.
detailRows.zh:
我过去常常开我朋友的PGC10 GT-R，所以对它非常熟悉。

运动型轿车给人一种“披着羊皮的狼”的感觉，
这正是这种车型最吸引我的地方。
我现在要介绍的这款车为现代GT-R确立了基本范式。
首先，它表现出一种清晰的体积感。

然后，设计师通过压低后挡板的重心，
让此车有一种蹲伏起跑、跃跃欲试的感觉。
从而赋予了GT-R超越GT的定位。
此外……

从这个型号开始，由传感器来控制车辆动力
和其他高性能附加套件的时代揭开了序幕。

这一切都足以证明这台R32 GT-R正是当代GT-R系列的鼻祖。

detailRows.speaker: Tom Matano
detailRows.en:
I got a call one day from my protégé at Mazda Design asking
for my thoughts on the design of the fourth-gen Miata.
I told him that I wrote a scenario for the first three
generations at the beginning of the NA project.

I normally look forward 20-25 years ahead
from the start of a project.

Therefore, I had no ideas for the fourth-gen car,
except the following:
 If it was to be mechanically similar,
then the design should...

...differ more from the NA to NB, and NB to NC.
If the car was to be mechanically new...

...with an innovative layout or different type of
powertrain, then it should be evolutionary.

 I never got to see the design of the
fourth-gen development at any stage.

When I asked the designers how things were going?
Their answer was always...

“Don’t worry, you guided us
to do the right thing.”
 They actually didn't want to show me the car...

...even on the night before
the world premiere event.

Enough was enough, so I made my stand.

 I told them that
“You know that I can't keep a poker face.”

"Whatever I see or feel shows on my face.
I can't help it."

"Can you risk that happening tomorrow?”

They thought about that for a moment,
and they came to the correct conclusion.

They finally showed me the car, and do you know
what I th�ught?

The fourth-generation car was designed in the right
direction, indeed.
detailRows.zh:
有一天，我接到来自在马自达设计工作的一位弟子的电话。

他询问我是否为第四代Miata Roadster做过类似的设计规划。
我有个习惯，每当我开启一个项目时，
我都会尝试想象它在之后20年里的演变。

所以我是这样告诉他的。

我说，我在NA项目启动的时候，就已经
为前三代都写好了方案……

但对于第四代而言……

我暂时没有什么具体的想法。
不过我又补充了一句，
如果机械结构上没有太大变化的话，那么设计方面……

相较于从NA到NB以及从NB到NC的演化，
应该体现出更大的变化。

此外……
如果这辆车在机械结构上是全新的，
应用了创新的布局或不同的传动系统……

那么在外观方面也应该体现出充分的演化。

在此之后，我��直没机会参与到第四代Roadster的开发当中。

每当我询问设计师们事情进展如何时，他们都会叫我放心。

“不用担心，”他们总是这样说。

“您给我们指出了一条正确的道路。”
事实上，直到新车全球首发的前一天晚上，
他们都还在想方设法对我保密。

我后来忍不住了。

我对他们说：“我是个藏不住事的人。
万一明天我一不小心当众露�7�失望表情，你们打算怎么办？”

他们这才让我看到了新车，你猜怎么着？

第四代的设计方向走得很踏实。

detailRows.speaker: Tom Matano
detailRows.en:
I have a soft spot for the M3.

I was involved on the first E30 M3...

...while I was working on the beginning of the E36.
Today, the 3 Series coupe is known as the 4 Series,
and the M3 became M4.

I still prefer the old M3 naming, however.
This car here is the most purposefully designed BMW...

...that possesses the true spirit of the M-performance package.
It has the right amount of details like front air intakes
that cool the brakes...

...to side air-outlets with the M accent.
It has an extremely athletic look
that exemplifies sporty and elegant design.
detailRows.zh:
我对M3情有独钟。

当我们开始开发E36系列的时候……

我还同时承担了E30 M3的开发工作。
现在，3系的双门轿跑车已经被BMW改称为“4系”，
M3也跟着变成了“M4”。

但我仍然喜欢M3。
它是目的性最明确的BMW……

其设计主旨与M性能套件的运动精神完全契合。
细节上的配置也相当到位，例如冷却刹车的前进气口……

以及带有“M”系凌厉风格的侧面进气风道。
仿佛一位穿上设计师品牌运动外套的运动员，
集运动和时尚优雅于一身。

detailRows.speaker: Tom Matano
detailRows.en:
My buddy had bought one when it came out.
I was impressed with how beautiful the engine looked.

It possessed all the right components that make a sports car.
But it was scaled proportionally to match the
body size of a kei-car...

...just like the original FIAT 500.
I loved that short stroke 5-speed shifter.
It had a tight mechanical feel to it.

However, it became notchy often.
That’s why I wanted the Miata to have a short stroke shifter...

...without the notchiness, of course.
detailRows.zh:
我正好有位朋友在这部车发售时买过一辆。
我记得当时我就被这台漂亮的引擎给打动了。

它具备一台真正跑车的所有要素，
只是在设计时按照轻型车的尺寸需要被按比例缩小了。

就像原版的FIAT 500一样！
我真的太喜欢它这台短行程的5速手动变速器了。
它可以为你提供扎实、机械的手感……

虽然确实时不时会出一些小毛病。
是它帮助我下定决心为Miata配备了短行程变速箱……

当然，我们的变速箱没有那些小毛病。?

detailRows.speaker: Tom Matano
detailRows.en:
I was also involved with the design of the “FD."

I thought that this FR layout sports car at $30K range above
the MX-5 would be the last model as the RX-7 as we knew it.
If Mazda were to develop a next-generation
RX model...

...I expected that it would have to have a mid-engine layout
at a much higher price point.
Then, when the FD replacement project started.

 I was torn because we were going to replace the
timeless design of the FD...

...with a completely new one.
Luckily, it became 4-seater and a totally different concept.
detailRows.zh:
我确实参与了“FD”的一部分工作。

当时，我们都以为它会是我们挚爱的RX-7系车型
的最后一款……
而且，如果要开发下一代的话……

应该会采用中置引擎布局，还要调高售价。
再后来，FD的替换项目启动了。

一开始我有点纠结，因为我们不得不把我心目中
永不过时的设计……

替换成一个全新的设计。
幸好，最终的4座车车型
成功展现出了完全不同的概念。'

detailRows.speaker: Tom Matano
detailRows.en:
This car was introduced as a baby Aston to make it affordable
and attract a broader audience.

The design of this car was unmistakably “Aston Martin."
In fact, it looked much more trim and agile than other Astons.
In my opinion, I prefer the Vantage V8...

...more than its much heavier
and larger siblings.

 Later, the company put a V-12 into this tight package.

With that, this Aston made my list of ideal cars.
detailRows.zh:
为了宣传这款车的亲民价格，吸引更多的受众，
官方给它起了一个绰号，“阿斯顿宝宝”。

它的设计充分地彰显了“Aston Martin”的特色。
与其他车型对比，它看上去更苗条，也更敏捷。
相比于那些体积更大、重量更重的姊妹车型……

……我个人更偏爱这款Vantage V8。

后来，设计师们还将一部V12引擎
塞进了它紧凑的引擎盖下。

有了这项升级，这款Aston Martin也
顺理成章变成了我的理想车型之一。;

detailRows.speaker: Tom Matano
detailRows.en:
This is the seventh-generation Golf GTI.

The first GTI established the high-performance
three-box hatchback theme...

That is still very popular around the world.

Since then, the GTI has undergone several evolutions.
While there were a few duds over the years,
this GTI was definitely a ‘hit’.

The size of the car has been gradually
growing with each evolution.

This seventh-generation model got everything right,
from the way it sits to the way it moves.
Not only were these elements balanced, but together
they contributed to creating something better.
detailRows.zh:
这是一辆七代Golf GTI。

它采用三厢掀背设计，并搭载动力强劲的性能套件。
这也是从初代起就确定的设计思路。

每一代Golf GTI的推出，都会经历一些演化和改变。
多年以来，有些改变成功了，而另一些则不尽如人意。
这一台，是成功的幸运儿之一。

历代的车身尺寸在演化中逐步扩大，

这一代的Golf GTI就做到了将所有的要素搭配地恰到好处。
它们的结合形成了运动的姿态，强大的气势和灵活性，
同时还散发出一种和谐感与力量感。

detailRows.speaker: Tom Matano
detailRows.en:
This is where Jeep culture started.

A purely functional design to meet military needs.

Now, the form-follows-function approach doesn’t
always guarantee success.

Only on rare occasions does it work—and in this case
the vehicle became an icon.
The engineers who worked on this program...

Must have had a good sense of proportion
and high design standards.
They knew precisely where to work their magic.
In some cases, the depth of the flanges helped to strengthen
the panels so that thinner pieces could be used.

Truly impressive work!
detailRows.zh:
这辆原版车款就是整个Jeep文化的起点。

作为服役车辆，它的设计完全强调功能性。

这种外形为功能服务的设计出发点
显然无法保证美学上的成功。

或者我应该说，成功的几率绝无仅有。
而这样的成功就落在了Jeep身上，缔造出了汽车史上的经典符号。
参与这项开发计划的工程师们……

……很好地掌握了比例的概念，
并且对设计品质有极高的标准。
他们将外观的弧度与半径计算得分毫不差。
例如，他们会通过采用凹陷度更深的轮缘来强化板件的刚度，
以削减板材厚度，达到减重的效果。

光凭这一点，就值得我们向那些早期设计者们脱帽致敬。

detailRows.speaker: Tom Matano
detailRows.en:
Both Ferrari and Pininfarina have a certain philosophy.

And that philosophy is that a Ferrari "must
be beautiful and distinctive."
The La Ferrari was introduced as the pinnacle of
technology, aerodynamics and styling.

Like its predecessors, it stood as an expression of
pure functional beauty.
There are no gimmicky surfaces or details in its design.
It stood apart from the more aggressive-looking supercars of its time.
detailRows.zh:
Ferrari和Pininfarina都秉承了同一设计理念：

每一辆Ferrari都必须“美观而独特”。
这台LaFerrari就代表了技术、空气动力学和美学风格上的极致。

和其前辈们一样，它同样遵循“性能高于造型”的设计思路，
摒弃一切花哨的装饰曲面或细节，
在众多外观更加“唬人”的超级跑车中显得鹤立鸡群。

detailRows.speaker: Tom Matano
detailRows.en:
An iconic creamy white body with the Shelby Blue stripes
represented a genuine GT Mustang...

...one that stood out from the super popular base model.
The original Mustang came
with great proportions.

Its design was simple and clean.

Due to regulations, no parts
were added to the exterior of the Shelby G.T.350.
However, it did come with a lowered suspension,
wider tires and the iconic graphics.

 If I were to own a Mustang,
this would be at the top of my list.
detailRows.zh:
当你看到经典的奶白色车身和Shelby蓝色条纹，
就代表这是一辆血统纯正的GT Mustang……

……当然了，G.T.350肯定要比人气超高的
基础车型更胜一筹。
原款Mustang的车身比例本就十分优秀，

设计方面也以简洁、精炼为主。

受赛事规定限制，这台Shelby G.T.350没有增加任何外部部件，
只是调低了悬挂系统，安装了宽胎
以及加入了标志性的涂装。

要是我想买一台Mustang，那么这款车绝对是我的首选。

detailRows.speaker: Tom Matano
detailRows.en:
This 300 SEL may have been big for a sedan, but
I consider it a sports sedan all the same.
The best image of this car that I can recall is a head-on
shot of it coming out of a corner at speed.

It must have been intimidating for other drivers
to see this machine in their rear-view mirrors.
This car is a great example of good visual weight balance.

It also showcases great dynamic weight distribution
in full racing trim.
detailRows.zh:
作为一辆轿车，这辆300 SEL也许有点尺寸过大，
不过我依然认为它是一辆很棒的运动型轿车。
我印象中这辆车最美的姿态就是
站在正前方看着它以高速驶出弯道。

其他车手从后视镜里看着这辆猛兽步步逼近时
心里一定非常紧张。
它拥有恰到好处的车身比例。

全套赛车饰条与配件加身后，更显动态十足。:

detailRows.speaker: Tom Matano
detailRows.en:
There were a few Lamborghini models that succeeded
the Countach.

However, none of them defined the Lamborghini style
since that car made its debut in 1970.
In my opinion, the Aventador finally achieved it.

Or perhaps it even surpassed it.
It took key design cues of the Countach and added
new surface and detail languages.

And it carried the quintessential Lamborghini style
into the next generation.
detailRows.zh:
在1970年发布Countach之后，
Lamborghini推出过若干款后续车型。

但没有哪一款能像它那样定义Lamborghini的风格。
在我看来，Aventador终于做到了再造经典，

甚至可以说全面超越了前者。
它继承了Countach的关键设计要素，
并加入了全新的外观和细节设计语言……

将鲜明的Lamborghini风格带入了全新的时代。`

detailRows.speaker: Tom Matano
detailRows.en:
I love compact sports models from Germany.
They all have wide tires, twice as wide as
Japanese compact cars.

Those wide tires are among the most significant
components of this car.

They give the car its personality.

And the resulting wide stance makes the car look stable,
as well as possessing performance.
They distinguish the base C coupe from the AMG version
for those who have keen eyes.
detailRows.zh:
我非常喜爱德国产的紧凑型跑车。
这些车型都采用了宽胎，
其宽度足有日本紧凑型车的两倍。

宽胎正是这辆车最重要的组成部分之一。

赋予了这辆车鲜明的个性。

而这种设计让车身显得又宽又低，看上去非常稳定，
性能也同样卓越。
在懂行的人眼里，这些特点让AMG版本与
基础的C级双门跑车有了明显的区分。

detailRows.speaker: Tom Matano
detailRows.en:
What a cute little car. It looks like a miniature
supercar.
There are no gimmicky surfaces or details.

It makes me want to get in and attack a twisty road.
detailRows.zh:
真是一辆可爱的小车啊。它看上去就像是一辆微缩版超跑。
没有任何花哨的表面或细节。

它只会让我想要钻进车里，
在崎岖的道路上风驰电掣。

detailRows.speaker: Tom Matano
detailRows.en:
This car reminds me of a happy little rabbit in the way
it sits slightly inclined towards the front.

It looks more like a fun runabout than a typical
commuter econobox.
Unlike retro-modern cars, such as the current Mini
and FIAT 500...
...this car is a modern interpretation of the original
FIAT 500 with Topolino character.
detailRows.zh:
这辆车的车头弧度略微下滑，看上去
就像是一只快乐的小兔子。

与其说它是一款典型的经济型通勤车，
不如说更像一辆提供愉悦驾乘体验的轻便汽车。
和其他的复古现代风格汽车，
例如当前版本的MINI和FIAT 500不同……
这辆车就好比是以“米老鼠”角色特点对
初代FIAT 500的现代化演绎。

detailRows.speaker: Tom Matano
detailRows.en:
The base V12 Vantage S was a more potent version
of the elegant V8 Vantage...
With a V12 engine and pronounced athleticism.

While this GT3 version may have swapped out elegance
for a full-blown 'performance' look...
It maintains those unmistakable Aston Martin proportions.
detailRows.zh:
这款车型的基础版本就是一台V12 Vantage S，
相当于V8 Vantage的动力强化版……
搭载了V12引擎，和更为显著的运动特征。

而到了GT3版本，则基本舍弃了优雅，
取而代之的是全方位的“高性能”外观……
但仍保留了Aston Martin独特的车身比例。

detailRows.speaker: Tom Matano
detailRows.en:
This is a genuine American muscle car that cuts
a distinctive figure on the track.
A mid-size sedan with a super-high horsepower engine...

...it’s more European in its aero parts and suspension
than the first-gen model.
This car is a celebration of American "inclusive design."

It offers supercar-level performance
at an affordable price.
I once drove a Chrysler 300 SRT at Laguna Seca Raceway.

A dream to drive, its wide torque range allowed me to take
the course without frequent gear shifts.
detailRows.zh:
这辆车是一款真正的美式肌肉车，在赛道上
展现出独特的魅力。
作为一辆中型轿车，它搭载着一颗超高马力的引擎……

在空气动力学和悬挂方面比第一代车型融入了
更多欧洲风格，
从而体现了美国“包容性设计”的理念……

以实惠的价格提供了超级跑车级别的性能体验。
我曾在拉古纳-塞卡赛道上驾驶过一辆Chrysler 300 SRT。

宽广的扭矩范围让我能够在赛道上畅快驾驶而无需频繁换挡。
那种驾驶体验如同梦幻。

detailRows.speaker: Tom Matano
detailRows.en:
This was a very unique car in the sense that Toyota’s
designers had to create an original design style for it.

It feels expertly sculpted.
In order to fit a 6-cylinder engine, the Supra’s nose
had to be extended, both physically and visually.
As a result, it looks like a powerful grand tourer.
detailRows.zh:
这是一款非常独特的车型，Toyota的设计师们
注入了完全原创的设计风格。

它的车身给人以精雕细琢的感觉。
为了塞入一台6缸引擎，这辆Supra的车头不得不
横向加宽，也呈现出更豪迈的视觉风格。
最终的造型也更接近一辆性能强大的豪华旅行车。

detailRows.speaker: Tom Matano
detailRows.en:
The ‘Baby Lambo’ was added to broaden the market reach
of Lamborghini as a brand.
Unlike their super-car counterparts, the ‘babies’...

Are known for their sharper surfaces, tighter dimensions,
and overall efficiency.
The Gallardo is a great example, exhibiting no excess
from any angle.
detailRows.zh:
“Baby Lambo”系列的推出旨在拓宽Lamborghini品牌
的市场。
与其超级跑车的兄弟相比，这些“小型”车型……

以更锐利的车身线条、更紧凑的车身尺寸
和整体上的高效设计而著称。
Gallardo就是一个很好的例子，从任何角度看都能展现
出简洁而精致的设计，没有任何多余的元素。

detailRows.speaker: Tom Matano
detailRows.en:
The Cayman has gone through a few cycles now.
The mid-engine layout here has made it sleeker
in both its roof line and overall proportions.
Indeed, the Cayman has taken on a more serious look
with each evolution.

With the GT4 trim, it is no longer positioned beneath
the 911.
Holding its own with great presence, tough looks and
beefy footwork...
...it has graduated from a casual racer to one that can
take on much bigger competition.\
detailRows.zh:
迄今为止，Cayman已经历了数次更新换代。
中置引擎的布局强化了车顶线条和整体比例的流线感。
事实上，Cayman的每次进化都让其更加凌厉。

升级到GT4版本后，它不再被定位在911之下。
凭借其强大的气场、富有侵略性的外观
和稳健的操控性能……
它已经从一款休闲性能车升级为能够与更高级别对手
竞争的真正赛道利器。

detailRows.speaker: Tom Matano
detailRows.en:
The Type R has the perfect balance of cosmetic and
mechanical tuning.

Its design is simply iconic.
Equally well-balanced in its proportions, it has a great
stance that speaks to its agility on the track.

The car that set the standard for FWD racers,
it still looks great.
What’s more, it captured the spirit of JDM tuners better
than any other model that came after it.<next id=2102306 type
detailRows.zh:
Honda Type R在外观设计和机械性能调校方面
达到了完美的平衡。

它的设计堪称经典。
其车身比例同样协调，完美的车身姿态充分
展现了它在赛道上的灵活性。

这款车型为前驱性能车树立了标杆，
时至今日依然魅力不减。
更重要的是，它比后续其他车型都更好地
诠释了日本国内改装车（JDM）文化的精髓。

detailRows.speaker: Tom Matano
detailRows.en:
This is the first Civic that wore the Type “R” designation.

This model started the tradition that continues to this day.
When compared to the latest Type “R” model,
it was much purer and simpler.
It shows that times have changed during the past 20 years,
like an evolution of a sneaker design.
detailRows.zh:
这是第一款得到“Type R”命名的Civic。

也开启了延续至今的传统。
与最新的Type R车型相比，它更加纯粹和简洁。
它展示了过去20年间的车型变化。就像
运动鞋设计的演变一样。

detailRows.speaker: Fabio Filippini
detailRows.en:
The design is modified with larger grilles and sporty bumpers,
side skirts and 17-inch alloy wheels.
It also reflects the original vintage livery with red stripes and
other colored elements like the mirrors and brake calipers.
And the two large, enameled badges on the front and rear
show the original colors of the famous Scorpio logo.
But the most exciting thing...

...is the fantastic “sound design” coming from the
rear dual exhausts!
detailRows.zh:
在升级方面，Abarth 500的设计采用了更大的格栅、运动型保
险杠、侧裙和17英寸铝合金轮毂。
而且还引入了象征原版复古涂装的红色条纹以及应用于
后视镜和刹车卡钳的其他色彩元素。
车前和车后两个精美无比的大型珐琅徽章展示了品牌原
版配色的著名天蝎座标志。
但最激动人心的……

当属来自后段双出排气管的美妙的“声音设计”！

detailRows.speaker: Sarah
detailRows.en:
Yes! It's a design where the rear of the body appears to
abruptly cut off.

Much like streamline designs, they're known to have
excellent aerodynamics.

Dr. Wunibald Kamm, the person who came up with this, was a
professor at the University of Stuttgart in the 1930s.

Therein lies the reason why this particular design is called
the "Kamm Tail."

We also refer to it as "Coda Tronca" in Italian.?
detailRows.zh:
没错！采用这种设计的汽车后部就像
被整齐地切掉一块。

卡姆式与流线型车身设计很接近，而且都以
优秀的空气动力学效应闻名。

这一设计是由斯图加特大学的Wunibald Kamm博士
于上世纪30年代提出的，

随即以设计者的名字冠名。

在意大利语中，我们也把它叫作“Coda Tronca”。

于上世纪30年代提出的，

随即以设计者的名字冠名。

在意大利语中，我们也把它叫作“Coda Tronca”。|

detailRows.speaker: Fabio Filippini
detailRows.en:
The plexiglass headlights on the early models and...

...design elements such as the orange indicator lights that
extend on the side...

...are defining symbols of this car.
Also, the grooves that flow in a straight line on the side
of the car are...

...implemented on most Ferraris that followed this car.

The star-shaped 5-spoke aluminum wheels are also important
symbols of Ferrari's design.
Yes, yes. This wheel originated from a sports prototype car
from the 1960s...

...and was first used on the Daytona.
detailRows.zh:
早期车型上的有机玻璃大灯和……

侧面的橙色指示灯
之类的设计元素……

都是这款车的主要特征之一。
此外，请注意那些直线形的凹槽……

在此之后被应用到了大多数Ferrari上。

星形的五辐铝制车轮也是Ferrari设计的重要标志。
事实上，这种轮毂样式源于20世纪60年代设计……

并在戴通纳比赛中投入使用的一台原型跑车。

detailRows.speaker: Fabio Filippini
detailRows.en:
This is a car I had a hand in styling when I was
with Renault Design!

When I designed the Mégane III series with my team...

We decided to make an RS variant right from the start.

The original design was already very compact...

And extreme for a 3-door hatchback, with its sloping rear window
and dynamic rear pillar.
Obviously the modified bumpers...

And the large rear central exhaust contribute to making it
appear even more aggressive.
But the most successful detail is...

Undoubtedly the F1-inspired suspended wing in the front
grille, which integrates the daytime running lights.
detailRows.zh:
这辆车的造型还是我在Renault Design工作时经手设计的！

当我和我的团队一起设计Mégane III系列时……

从一开始就决定追加设计一个RS版本。

这是一辆紧凑到极致的三门小钢炮，有着大坡度后窗
和动态十足的C柱，
以及显著改造过的后保险杠……

还有汇集到尾部正中的大号排气管，让它更显侵略性。
但最成功的细节……

无疑是前格栅里受F1赛车启发的悬浮翼片，
我们将它直接与日间行车灯整合到了一起。

detailRows.speaker: Fabio Filippini
detailRows.en:
The 308 can be considered the progenitor of all modern
8-cylinder Ferraris, and the most popular of them all.

And, perhaps it was also the longest-lasting.

 Its production run spanned from 1975 to 1989,
including the derivative version, the 328.

Besides its technical aspects, the car's success came
from an extremely balanced and pure design.

It's almost timeless.

It serves as a perfect example of Pininfarina’s design
philosophy applied to the cars of the Cavallino.
In fact, it takes up some classical themes from the Dino
246, such as the progressive wave on the two-wheel arches...
...and the iconic side air intake,
but also the dynamic rear pillars.

And, of course, the truncated tail with
four round taillights.

However, all of it was transformed into a very essential
and modern shaping for the time.
detailRows.zh:
308不仅是所有现代8缸法拉利跑车的鼻祖，
而且无疑是所有车款当中最受欢迎的一款。

它可能也是持续量产最久的一款法拉利。

如果将328版本也算进去，
其生产时间足足从1975年延续到1989年。

这都要归功于它纯粹且经得起时代考验的设计。

在评论家口中，它的平衡性同样首屈一指……

还完美诠释了宾尼法利纳的设计理念。
它甚至复兴了Dino 246的经典元素，如外扩的轮拱……
标志性的侧面进气口，动态的C柱……

还包括带有四个圆形尾灯的截断式尾部。

当然，所有这些元素都经过改良，
以适应更加现代化的设计理念。*

detailRows.speaker: Fabio Filippini
detailRows.en:
If there is a car that perfectly
represents Ferrari’s spirit...

...it is the F40.

The progenitor of all Hypercars,
an absolute myth for enthusiasts.
It follows typical Pininfarina design continuity.

It incorporates the cabin volume of the usual 308
with a body inspired by competition.
Low, profiled, with retractable headlights...

... and indicators that sit behind
smoked Plexiglas.
With the two NACAs
on the hood...

...as well as the four lateral "gills" in GTO-style
behind the rear wheel...

..it integrates many functional air intakes.

Other characterstic elements are...

...the horizontal black groove...

...as well as the three round central exhausts and...
...the huge rear wing with the initials F40
in bas-relief on the right side.
detailRows.zh:
如果说有哪辆车能完美代表法拉利的精神……

……那么非F40莫属。

它是所有终极跑车的始祖，是车迷心目中的绝对神话。
它在设计方面延续了宾尼法利纳的经典风格，

并继承了普通版本308的驾驶舱，
但车身造型设计明显是为竞速而生的：
无论是低矮的轮廓，翻转式大灯……

……及雾面有机玻璃后的转向指示灯；
还是引擎盖上的两个NACA进气口……

……或是后轮之后的四道GTO风格竖向“鳃”状风口……

……功能性进气口的数量多得让人瞠目结舌。

当然，它的个性还不止于此：

……纯黑色水平蜂窝格栅、
三联装的中置圆形排气管以及……
……大到夸张的尾翼。
在尾翼的右侧面还有一个大大的“F40”]��雕标志。

detailRows.speaker: Fabio Filippini
detailRows.en:
I remember very well the impact of the Honda NSX
at the 1989 Geneva Motor Show.

It was the expression of absolute sportiness
combined with Japanese perfection.
In fact, its clean and streamlined style...

...comes from studies previously
made with Pininfarina.

These were further developed later by
in-house Japanese designers

This design is so pure and balanced that...

...it lasted 15 years without noticeable changes.
While the front and
side are slightly reminiscent of the Ferrari style...

...the tail is particularly original and successful.

Of note are its integrated wing and
the transversal strip of lights
The "Type R" version boasts intense technical improvement work...

...amd is virtually identical in aesthetics*
detailRows.zh:
1989年，本田NSX在日内瓦车展上造成的轰动，
我现在依然记得很清楚。

它是绝对的动感和日本的完美主义的结合。
这种简洁的流线造型……

……其实是本田与宾尼法利纳合作研究的成果。

之后又由日方的内部设计师
进一步完善和发扬光大。

这项成功的设计不仅纯粹，而且平衡……

……以至于沿用了整整15年都未见任何显著改动。
虽然前脸和侧面会让人觉得向法拉利靠拢……

……但其车尾的原创度很高，也相当成功。

一体化的尾翼和横向全尺寸灯带都是可圈可点的创新。
后来的“Type R”版本虽然在技术上做出大幅的改进……

……但在美学方面几乎是全面照搬了原版车。

detailRows.speaker: Fabio Filippini
detailRows.en:
The 458 Italia is one of Pininfarina's
recent masterpieces for the Cavallino.

It is probably the most beautiful mid-engine
Ferrari since the 308...
Inheriting the sportiness, purity and elegance
of the 308...

It would influence the design language and proportions
of all subsequent models.

Its style is characterized by...

...sinuous yet extremely pure and fluid lines,
with no visible air inlets on the sides.
The front is sharp, with the new "scimitar" headlights.
The rear can be recognized by single round lights...
...embedded in the bodywork...

...and by the three round central exhausts inspired by the F40.
 If perfection in design is achieved when nothing
can be removed from a shape without ruining it...

...then the 458 it comes really close.&
detailRows.zh:
458 Italia是宾尼法利纳最近为跃马品牌设计的杰作之一。

它可能是自308以来外型最优美的中置引擎法拉利……
……同时也继承了308的运动性、纯粹性和优雅……

……并影响到了后续多款车型的设计语言和比例。

其风格特点可以用几点归纳：

极致纯粹、流动的连续车身线条，侧面没有任何明显的进气口。
犀利的前脸采用了新的“弯刀”头灯。显得杀气腾腾。
车尾的辨识度也很高……
……嵌入车身框架的单个圆形后灯……

……以及与F40师出同门的三联中置圆形排气管。
如果完美的设计是增之则长，减之则短……

……那么458已经非常接近于这个境界了。

detailRows.speaker: Fabio Filippini
detailRows.en:
The Ferrari 250 GT SWB is the 'Mona Lisa' of sport cars!

It brings sportiness, elegance and power into one perfect shape.
This Pininfarina's design...

Is the final word on a pursuit of volume and proportion
that started in 1947 with the Cisitalia 202 Berlinetta.

Compact, dynamic shapes and curved, sinewy surfaces
are expressed as utter purity and elegance.
The car fits a low, gritty front, a set-back cabin,
generous hips and a compact tail...

All into one concentrated ensemble.
It's not unlike...

A painting by da Vinci or a sculpture
by Michelangelo.

That is, it achieves a similarly exceptional level
of perfection and timeless beauty.
It is beauty in its purest and most striking essence!
detailRows.zh:
法拉利250 GT SWB！我愿意将它称为跑车中的“蒙娜丽莎”！

它是运动性、优雅和动力的精髓
在汽车外形上的完美总和。
这个设计方案……

……始于1947年的西斯塔尼亚202双座，
宾尼法利纳将自那以来对体积和比例的探索，都汇萃于此。

紧凑而动感的造型、力量喷涌的曲面……

……带来极致的纯粹和绝对的优雅。
从低矮却坚毅的前脸，到后移的座舱……

从厚实外扩的后轮到收窄的紧凑尾箱……

……同样是那么的纯粹，那么的优雅。
简直能与……

……达芬奇的绘画或米开朗基罗的雕塑相媲美。

它将各种元素浓缩而又均衡地组合在一起，
实现了无可比拟的圆满和永恒之美。

它是美以最纯粹的形式展现……
……是最动人心魄的美之精华！

detailRows.speaker: Fabio Filippini
detailRows.en:
Here, we have the cute Honda Beat...

...a symbol of the Japanese two-seat
convertible kei-car category, born in the 1990s.

The car was a result from a historic collaboration
between Honda and Pininfarina.
Its clean and simple design perfectly envelops
the super compact mid-engine package.
It features side air inlets, but also a "clamshell" front hood
and aerodynamically side mirrors.
The perforated steel rims and
the motorcycle-like instrument cluster...

...they both contribute to reinforce
the basic and sporty spirit of the car.
A special mention goes to the zebra-striped fabric of the seats.

They were a typical 1990s Japanese fashionable trend.
detailRows.zh:
看，这就是我们可爱的本田Beat……

……日本双座敞篷轻型车类别诞生于20世纪90年代，
而它就相当于这一类别的象征符号之一。

这台车是本田和宾尼法利纳历史性合作的成果。
它的设计简洁而精巧，将一台超紧凑的中置引擎套件
安装在后轴上。
除了侧面进气口，它还配备了“蚌壳形”的前引擎盖
和集成空气动力学效应的侧后视镜。
孔洞式的钢轮毂和类似摩托车的仪表组……

……无不在强调这辆车走的是朴实、运动的路线。
特别值得一提的是座椅套上的斑马纹路，
这可是走在20世纪90年代日本的时尚潮流前列。

detailRows.speaker: Fabio Filippini
detailRows.en:
This car represents the baby of
the Alfa Romeo range.

Its design recalls the stylistic features of
the extreme 8C Competizione.
This includes with his curved sensual surfaces..

....not to mention its drop-shaped headlights and
round rear lights.
There are also the “five-circles” theme of the alloy wheels...

These elements are all
typical of the Alfa brand.

The cked with an air of
condensed energy that seems “ready to explode."
Even the window areas are extremely reduced,
and the rear window is very slanted.

And the hatch here is small and, I must say,
quite inconvenient.
But you know...

...when it comes to practicality...

Well, let's just say it certainly isn't
the main objective of an Alfa Romeo's design.
detailRows.zh:
MiTo是阿尔法罗密欧旗下车型中的“大宝贝”。

它的设计特征让人想起剑走偏锋的8C Competizione：
包括那性感的弧度……

……“五环”造型的铝合金轮毂，
更不必提那为人熟知的水滴形头灯和圆形尾灯……

……全都是典型的阿尔法元素。

这辆车看上去仿佛被注入了一股浓缩压实过的能量，
像是“随时会爆炸”一样。
甚至连窗户的面积也遭到极限压缩，后窗陡然倾斜，

继而导致行李箱门开口变小，非常不便。
但是吧……

……每每谈到实用性的时候……

大家都会心领神会地说，
这方面肯定不是阿尔法罗密欧的主要设计目标。

detailRows.speaker: Fabio Filippini
detailRows.en:
GTA is an acronym for "Gran Turismo Alleggerita," the legendary
race version of the 1965 Alfa Romeo Giulia Sprint.

It dominated the Touring Car championships
in Italy and Europe.
This limited, "mean" version of the new Giulia sedan fully
captures its original spirit and exuberant performance.

The design also shows its sportiness with a big front grille,
wide fenders and carbon-fiber aerodynamic elements.
Even the Alfa shield is made of carbon-fiber!
And the huge 20-inch alloy wheels have a single central nut,
like on real race cars.
detailRows.zh:
GTA是“Gran Turismo Alleggerita”的缩写，
它是传奇的1965 Alfa Romeo Giulia Sprint的公路赛车版本。

后者曾主宰了意大利乃至全欧洲的房车锦标赛。
这款“用料节省”的全新限量版Giulia轿车完全把握住了
原车型的精髓和卓越的性能。

在外观设计上，更是以巨大的前格栅、宽挡泥板和一大堆
美观的碳纤维空气动力学组件忠实再现了Sprint的运动感
——甚至连Alfa车标的盾徽也是由碳纤维制成的！
硕大的20英寸合金轮毂中央还参照真正的赛车
单独增加了中心螺栓。

detailRows.speaker: Fabio Filippini
detailRows.en:
Imagine transforming a little French city car
into a mid-engine racer!

Ah, but such is the transgressive spirit of the R5 Turbo's
direct descendant.
Its sportiness is dynamically expressed through
widened flanks and central dual exhausts.

Interestingly, these aggressive elements are balanced
with those typical of Renault cars from the '90s.
This is most evident in the way the side edge line
"rolls" around the rear wheel...
...and in the use of a geometric design
for the front and rear grilles.
detailRows.zh:
你能想象将一辆小型法式城市用车改造成
一辆中置引擎赛车是什么样子吗？

这辆R5 Turbo的后继车型就承载了这样叛逆不羁的精神。
它的运动形态通过加宽的侧面裙边
和居中的双排气管得到了动态的展现。

有趣的是，这些激进的设计元素却通过90年代经典Renault风格
的中和，取得了完美的平衡。
后轮的“管装”风道线条……
和前后格栅采用的几何分割设计就是最显而易见的证明！

detailRows.speaker: Fabio Filippini
detailRows.en:
The fifth-generation Nissan Silvia was one of
my favorite Japanese cars of the early '90s.

A coupe of classic beauty—its lines were
remarkably clean and elegant!

It almost looked Italian in design.
That low front, transverse light strip,
bright cabin and slender tail...
Everything in this car comes together
in a perfect harmony of proportions.
detailRows.zh:
第五代Nissan Silvia是我最爱的
九十年代初期日式车之一。

这辆呈现出经典美感的双门跑车
拥有令人眼前一亮的简洁优雅线条！

看上去非常像是意大利的设计风格。
低矮的车头、横断式条状车灯、
亮色的驾驶舱和纤细的车尾……
一切都完美地融合在一起，呈现出非常和谐的比例。

detailRows.speaker: Fabio Filippini
detailRows.en:
The fifth-generation Nissan Silvia was one of
my favourite Japanese cars of the early ‘90s.

One thing that has always impressed me about it
is the quality of its shape.
Specifically, the slight 'S' curve in the side profile,
above the wheel of the front fender.

This gives a very delicate and sensitive finish
to the surface modelling and reflections.
detailRows.zh:
第五代Nissan Silvia是我最爱的
九十年代初期日式车之一。

它最让我印象深刻的一点就是外观风格。
具体来说就是它车身侧面轮廓中，前挡泥板轮圈上方
略微呈现出的“S”弧线。

这一细节为车身的立体造型和光线反射添加了
精妙而感性的一笔，起到了画龙点睛的作用。

detailRows.speaker: Fabio Filippini
detailRows.en:
For many fans who still adore its essential and compact
shape designed by Pininfarina...

...the 512 BB has achieved near-mythical status.
Its design was inspired by...

...the 1968 P6 Berlinetta Speciale prototype.

This is particularly evident in the front and cabin.

Although few people are aware of this...
...you may also notice details derived from the Modulo,
the 1970s Ferrari concept car.

The extruding wheel arches are one such detail.
But what everyone certainly remembers
about the 512 BB are...

...the large acrylic indicator covers in the front, the louvered
hood grille, the small NACA side air vents...

...and the lower bodywork painted matte black.
detailRows.zh:
由宾尼法利纳所设计的精简和紧凑的外形
为512 BB赢得了大量的忠实粉丝……

他们也将这款车几乎捧上了神坛。
这辆车的设计灵感来源于……

1968年推出的P6双座特别版原型车。

这一点在其车头和座舱的设计上一览无余。

另外，你还可以从中看到
1970年代推出的法拉利概念赛车摩多罗的部分细节：

例如其向外凸出的车轮拱罩就是其中之一。

不过，发现这些关联的人并不多。
不过，512 BB最让人印象深刻的记忆还是来源于……

车头几何形状的大尺寸亚克力转向灯罩、百叶窗式引擎罩格栅、
小型NACA侧面进气口……

以及哑光黑色的下部车身。

detailRows.speaker: Fabio Filippini
detailRows.en:
I think the little FIAT Abarth 595 Esseesse is the perfect
expression of the "Italian spirit."

Particularly the spirit of the 1950 and 1960s, when the zeal
and passion of Italian people were expressed without restraint.
The tuned-up version by Carlo Abarth...

...is known for its lowered stance
and various mechanical changes.+
detailRows.zh:
我认为这辆小巧的FIAT Abarth 595 Esseesse
是对“意大利精神”的完美诠释。

特别是在50至60年代，意大利人民即使能力受到客观限制，
热情和激情仍然无比高昂的那股劲儿。
这是由卡洛·阿巴斯改装的版本……

特点是降低了车身的高度，并在机械结构方面进行了调整。

detailRows.speaker: Fabio Filippini
detailRows.en:
The same goes for the red stripes, scorpio badges, and the
light wheels, transforming it into a race car.

But above all, some details are striking, such as the
rubber locks for the hoods.

The rear-hood was raised to improve cooling,
and "Record Monza" chromed double exhausts were added.
detailRows.zh:
再加上红色条幅、天蝎徽标和轻量化车轮，
这些改动令其摇身一变，成为了一辆赛车。

那些令人尤为印象深刻的细节也十分吸引眼球，
比如引擎盖上的橡胶锁……

还有为了改善散热而抬高的后引擎盖，以及
“Record Monza”镀铬双排气管。

detailRows.speaker: Fabio Filippini
detailRows.en:
The Testarossa recalls the exuberance of the 1980s—
teen posters and American TV.

In fact, its design was spectacular and ostentatious,
totally the opposite of the 512 BB it replaced.
First of all, the Testarossa impressed with its size.

Note the imposing S-shaped volume of its tail
and huge, iconic air inlets.
This was copied by tuners and coachbuilders the world over
and was reflected in modified, banal city cars.

That’s how innovative it was!
Of particular note was the black grille, which hid
the rectangular rear lights...

...that replaced, for the first time, the signature round
taillights of previous Ferraris.
Another memorable oddity...

...was the single side-mirror suspended in the middle of the
pillar, which was present in the very first versions.
detailRows.zh:
Testarossa令人回想起80年代的狂热——
就好像当时的青少年海报和美国电视剧的张扬风格。

它的设计与前辈512 BB迥然不同，抢眼而张扬。
首先，Testarossa以其庞大的尺寸给人留下深刻的印象。

其巨大的楔形车尾和侧面巨大的标志性进气口也同样令人瞩目。
这一设计引得世界各地的改装者和车身制造商纷纷效仿
——许多普通的城市车辆都被改装成这个样子，

成为了开创一代潮流的鼻祖！
特别值得一提的是，黑色的进气格栅内其实
隐藏了矩形尾灯……

这是法拉利首次摒弃之前车型经典的圆形尾灯。
另一个令人过目不忘的奇特设计……

是最早期版本中悬挂在A柱中央的单个侧后视镜。

detailRows.speaker: Fabio Filippini
detailRows.en:
The Maserati Gran Turismo...

...was a classic interpretation of Italian style and sportiness
by Pininfarina.
The long hood, set-back cabin...

...and compact tail were immediately recognizable.
These extremely distinctive proportions were a synthesis
of the typical dynamic balance of the GT category.

That said, there were elements that renewed the
historic identity of Maserati’s design.
Among them were the three little vents behind the front wheel.
detailRows.zh:
Maserati Gran Turismo……

是Pininfarina对意大利风格和运动性的经典诠释。
修长的引擎盖、后移的车厢……

和紧凑的车尾都是一眼就能认出的特征。
极具辨识度的车身各部位比例是GT系列
典型的动态平衡的综合体现。

尽管如此，车上还添加了一些非常有Maserati风格的元素……
比如前轮后方的三个小小的通风口。

detailRows.speaker: Fabio Filippini
detailRows.en:
The Ferrari Enzo, named after Ferrari’s founder, marked
a radical stylistic change in Ferrari’s history.

It was certainly one of the most iconic sports cars of the 2000s.
Directly inspired by the aerodynamic shapes
of contemporary Formula 1 machines...

...it made a lasting impression with its pointed nose.
Like a jetfighter, driven by functionality and performance,
its intersecting blocks created space for its air intakes.

The cabin was also clearly inspired by aeronautical shapes.
At the rear, there appeared, for the first time,
dual circular taillights...

...which would later be found on the F430
and other subsequent Ferraris.*
detailRows.zh:
以法拉利的创始人命名的法拉利Enzo标志着
法拉利史上的一次激进的设计变革。

它无疑是2000年代最具标志性的跑车之一。
此车的设计直接受到了当代F1赛车的
空气动力学造型启发……

以其尖锐的车鼻给人留下了“凶猛”的印象。
它就像一架喷气式战斗机，注重功能和性能，
互相交错的矩形表面为进气口创造了空间。

车厢设计也明显受到航空器的启发。
在车尾，两侧的双圆形尾灯首次亮相……

这种设计后来也出现在F430及其他后续车型上。<next id=2202009 type=9׾

detailRows.speaker: Fabio Filippini
detailRows.en:
A legend among supercars of the 1980s,
the Ferrari GTO...

...combined the most advanced performance, technology
and style of its era.
Despite the nominal nod to the iconic 250 GTO from 1962...

...this car actually incorporated the design of the popular 308 GTB,
though slightly stretched to match its longer wheelbase.
Its main character came from the big front-spoiler
and four rectangular daylights...

...as well as the wide fenders covering its big wheels.
The gearbox hanging below the bumper
was framed by four round exhausts.

It was always a wonderful sight to see.

The only details recalling the vintage GTO...

...were the famous three slanted side vents behind the rear wheel,
and the enlarged "duck-tail" spoiler.
detailRows.zh:
法拉利GTO是80年代超级跑车中的传奇之作……

它集合了当时最先进的性能、技术和当代设计品味。
尽管名字向1962年经典的250 GTO致敬……

但实际上它采用了当时最受欢迎的308 GTB的设计，
不过稍微拉长了车身，以适应更长的轴距。
它的主要特征包括大面积的前导流板和四颗矩形日间行车灯……

以及盖住硕大轮毂的宽大轮拱。
挂在保险杠下方的变速箱被左右四根圆形排气管夹在中间。

每每看到，都让人觉得惊艳。

唯一能让人回想起那款经典GTO的细节……

是后轮后方的三道标志性斜向通风口，和车尾部
超大号的“鸭尾”扰流板。

detailRows.speaker: Fabio Filippini
detailRows.en:
The R.S. 01 was a true mid-engine competition car
belonging to the GT category.

Designed for the track, it sat low, wide, and it was functional.

Thanks to its dynamic and muscular form, it was also
extremely aggressive.
The huge carbon rear wing always impressed, along with
the front spoiler and the rear diffuser.

That said, Renault desired to maintain a "family feeling"
in the front and rear...
...so it adopted the style of the lights and grille
of the production Mégane.
detailRows.zh:
R.S. 01是一款真正的中置引擎赛车，隶属于GT类别。

它专为赛道设计——底盘低、车身宽且功能强大。

充满动感和肌肉感的外形也令它显得攻击性十足。
硕大的碳纤维尾翼给人留下深刻的印象，前扰流器
和后扩散器也同样引人注目。

尽管如此，Renault还是希望在车头和车尾的设计上
保持“家族传承”……
因此借鉴了量产版Mégane的车灯和进气格栅的设计风格。&

detailRows.speaker: Fabio Filippini
detailRows.en:
Designed by Pininfarina together with Ferrari Design,
the F12 was awarded the Compasso d'Oro 2014.
As you can see, it represents a huge change in
design from the previous 599.

Its sculptural forms are extremely compact and "dense."
The front is very aggressive, with the large central grille
and two active air intakes for brake cooling...
...while the back is recognized by the "T" theme, visually
separating the extractor into two parts.

But the most characteristic elements
are the Aero Bridges...
Channelling the air from the hood towards the flanks,
improving the overall aerodynamic efficiency.
detailRows.zh:
这辆F12是由宾尼法利纳和法拉利设计合作设计的，
荣获了2014年度的金圆规工业设计奖。
如你所见，相比之前的599，它的设计发生了巨大的变化。

它那雕塑般的形状非常的紧凑和“凝实”。
前脸配备了庞大的中央格栅和两侧冷却刹车用的主动进风口……
攻击性十足，
而后部则能清晰辨认出“T”型元素，在视觉上将排气管
分为左右两组。

但最具特征的元素还是“气动桥”……
它将引擎盖上的空气引导到车身侧面，从而提高了
整体的空气动力学效率。

detailRows.speaker: Fabio Filippini
detailRows.en:
The F430 is strongly derived from the 360 Modena,
albeit with important technical changes...
Starting with the new V8 engine.

It is also an evolution from a ‘style’ perspective.

While taking the body panels and glass parts from the 360,
it has a more aggressive and technical expression.
The large double-oval front air intakes...

Are inspired by the ‘shark nose’ front
of the 1961 Ferrari 156 F1.
And the four Enzo-inspired circular tail lights
add to its aggressive look.
detailRows.zh:
这辆F430在设计上受到了360 Modena的强烈影响，
但也引入了一些重要的技术革新……
首先是一台全新的V8引擎。

从“风格”的角度上来看，你可以将F430视作是一种进化。

虽然采用了与360相同的车身板件和玻璃部件，
却给人以更具进攻性、更有科技感的印象。
它的大型双椭圆形前进气口……

灵感来源于1961年的Ferrari 156 F1上的“鲨鱼鼻”。
四个Enzo风格的环形尾灯则进一步地强化了它的进攻性。+

detailRows.speaker: Fabio Filippini
detailRows.en:
The ‘DS’ brand was created by the PSA Group to renew
the unconventional spirit of the legendary Citroën DS19.

And this DS3 was the first car of the brand.
However, there is no similarity or stylistic reference
to the original DS from 1955.
Aiming instead at a French ‘chic’ imaginary, its shapes
are a little complex, with showy decorations.

On the whole, I find the extremely compact and energetic
proportions to be very pleasant.
And the ‘shark fin’ of the central pillar, represents,
I think, its most characteristic design element.
detailRows.zh:
“DS”是由PSA集团创建的新品牌，旨在为传奇的Citroën DS19
打破常规的精神注入新鲜的血液。

这辆DS3是该品牌的第一款车。
然而，该车与1955年的原版DS在风格和设计上毫无传承。
专注于营造一种法式的“别致”印象，因而选择了稍显复杂，
而且外向的华丽装饰。

整体上，我觉得它的车身比例给人以一种
非常紧凑而活力动感的印象，看起来赏心悦目。
我个人认为中柱处的“鲨鱼鳍”是此车最具特色的设计元素。

detailRows.speaker: Fabio Filippini
detailRows.en:
This is the new "electric" expression of Porsche design.

The design of this eco-sustainable evolution adopts
the soft and clean language of the Stuttgart house.
The proportions, while similar to those of the Panamera,
are more compact and lower to the ground...
...with a typical fast-back tail and a traversing strip
of LED rear lights.
However, the front expresses its new identity with
the headlights "slashed" directly onto the surface...
...with the four daytime running lights, but also with the
aerodynamic outlet behind the front wheel.
detailRows.zh:
这款车是对Porsche设计的全新“电气化”表达。

这辆可持续环保升级车型的设计采用
斯图加特品牌那柔和又利落的设计语言。
Taycan的车身比与Panamera类似，
但要比后者更加紧凑、更贴近地面……
还采用了典型的斜背车尾和
由LED灯带构成的横条车尾灯。
不过它的前脸充分体现了全新个性，
两盏大灯和四盏日间行车灯连在一起，直接“下切”向路面……
此外，前轮后方还设计了空气动力学排气口。

detailRows.speaker: Fabio Filippini
detailRows.en:
The sixth-generation of the Toyota Celica has the most
character of all the models in its long lineage.

What we have here is the rally version.
Aesthetically, it’s nearly identical to the production car,
apart from the raised rear wing and a few aero features.
An example of modern Japanese "bio-design," it is notably
distinguished by its four rounded headlights.
Meanwhile, in other places...

...the Celica draws inspiration from other Toyota sports coupes
of its day, such as the Supra and the Soarer.
detailRows.zh:
第六代Toyota Celica在其悠久的族系历史上拥有
最独特的个性。

我们眼前的是一辆拉力赛版本车型。
从外观上看，除了抬高的尾翼和安装了几项
空气动力学套件，它和量产版车型几乎别无二致。
这款车是现代日本“仿生设计”的完美示例，
其四盏圆形大灯尤其彰显了这一特色。
与此同时，你可以在多处设计上看到……

Celica从当时的其他Toyota运动型双门跑车，
例如Supra和Soarer身上汲取了不少灵感。

detailRows.sourceName: Lancer Evolution VI GSR T.M. EDITION Special Color Package '00
detailRows.speaker: Fabio Filippini
detailRows.en:
The Lancer Evo is one of the most boring Japanese family
sedans to have been transformed into a racing beast.
It’s a mild-mannered nobody turned superhero...

The kind typically found in comic books and action flicks.
So what might the ‘super powers’ of this car be
from a design perspective?
Why, they are expressed by its sharp spoilers, bumpers
and grilles!

All of this brings to mind the imposing image
of a samurai’s suit of armour.
detailRows.zh:
Lancer Evo是由日本最平淡的轿车产品
族系之一改造而来的比赛野兽。
它就像是漫画或者动作电影中常见的那种……

不显山露水的平凡人变成的超级英雄。
那么从设计角度来说，这款车的“超能力”是什么呢？
还用问吗，它那犀利的扰流板、保险杠和
前格栅就能充分回答这个问题了！

所有这一切都让人不由得联想到日本武士的盔甲。\

detailRows.speaker: Fabio Filippini
detailRows.en:
The Renault Clio RS is an icon of Europe’s
"Supermini" segment.

The Williams version of the original series is remembered
with particular fondness.
Like its forebears, this RS version of the fourth-series model
combined extreme sportiness with quiet urbanity.

In terms of design, this car has sportiness in its DNA.
Its muscular shapes, aggressive front, and the concealed
rear-door handles in its C-pillars...
...give one the impression of a two-door coupe.

Thanks to this, the sportier bumpers, aero details, and low
stance with 18-inch wheels and red calipers...
...are sufficient to visually transform it into a little
racing "weapon."A
detailRows.zh:
雷诺Clio RS是欧洲“超迷你”类型
中的标志性车型。

第1代中的Williams版本尤其受到
广大车迷们的喜爱和铭记。
和前代车型一样，这款第4代的RS版本也完美综合了
极致的运动性能和安静的都市驾乘体验。

从设计上讲，这款车的确具备运动的基因。
它采用了充满肌肉感的外形、极富侵略性的前脸，
并将后门的把手隐藏在C柱之中……
给人以双门跑车的观感。

基于这种设计，再加上运动感十足的保险杠、空气动力学细节
以及应用了18寸轮毂和红色卡钳的超低姿态车身……
足以在视觉上将它充分改造成一款赛道小钢炮！

detailRows.speaker: Fabio Filippini
detailRows.en:
The Volvo V40 is a pleasant 5-door hatchback
with a sporty demeanor...

...most notably the T5 R-Design version.
Its exterior design conveys an excellent balance
of Latin fluidity and Scandinavian rigor.

In fact, it borrows styling cues from
the historic Shooting Brake P1800 E...

...a car that possessed an Italian flavor, thanks to the
contribution of Sergio Coggiola and Pietro Frua.

What a source of inspiration!
Note the small hollow on the side shoulder
and the rounded glass rear window.

These elements recall one of the most iconic cars
of the Swedish brand.
detailRows.zh:
Volvo V40是一款舒适惬意、带有跑车元素的5门掀背车……

尤其是产品阵容中的T5 R-Design版本。
它的车身外形在拉丁风格的流畅唯美和北欧风格
的严谨坚毅之间取得了傲人的平衡。

它的外形设计借鉴了独具历史意义的Shooting Brake P1800 E……

而科焦拉和弗鲁阿贡献的设计为这款经典车型
赋予了浓厚的意大利风格底蕴。

真是非常了不起的灵感来源。
注意它车身侧面车肩部分的小凹陷和后车窗的
圆弧形玻璃。

这些设计元素带领我们重新领略了这家瑞典品牌
历史上标志性车型的风采。

detailRows.speaker: Fabio Filippini
detailRows.en:
This is the high-performance version of the F430, developed
with the help of Michael Schumacher.
Stylistically, it is distinguished by a sharp front, large
air intakes, and enhanced brake cooling ducts.
However, the biggest difference is in the rear.

Here we have a large engine grille...

...and a big diffuser framed by a band with two large, round
exhausts on either side of the license plate.
To emphasize its sportiness, the side mirrors have been done
in carbon fiber...
And a two-tone livery is available as an option.
detailRows.zh:
这是在迈克尔·舒马赫的协助下开发的F430高性能版本。
在外观设计上，它以更锐利的前脸线条、更大的进气口
和优化后的刹车冷却导风口与其他版本区分开来。
然而，最显著的区别在于车尾设计。

这里我们可以看到一个大尺寸的引擎舱散热格栅……

以及一个大型的底部扩散器，由一条装饰带包围，
两个大型圆形排气管则位于车牌的两侧。
为了突出其赛车基因，后视镜采用了碳纤维材质……
此外，还提供了双色条纹涂装作为可选项。

detailRows.speaker: Fabio Filippini
detailRows.en:
Unveiled at the Tokyo Motor Show in 2015...
...the MAZDA RX-VISION immediately thrilled design specialists
with the masterful beauty of its sinuous and complex forms.

The "Kodo" design philosophy of applying emotional shapes
to evoke fluid and natural movement…

...is perfectly expressed in this spectacular concept car.
Consider its low and wide body, large bonnet,
and set-back cockpit.
The side profile is particularly stunning.

This is owing to a controlled use of soft textures
and light reflection.
Almost evoking a kind of Japanese lacquer,
the flaming red livery...

...helps to amplify the liquid appearance of the RX-VISION’s
beautiful sheet metal surfaces.
detailRows.zh:
2015年东京车展上首次亮相的……
马自达RX-VISION概念赛车，凭借其复杂而流畅的整体
造型美学立即引起了设计专家们的热烈反响。

马自达“魂动”设计理念旨在通过饱含情感的动态造型呈现
流畅自然的动感……

这款令人惊叹的概念赛车完美诠释了该设计哲学。
它拥有低矮而宽阔的车身、
修长的引擎舱盖和靠后的驾驶舱位置。
车身侧面轮廓尤为出众。

这得益于对柔和曲面和光线反射的巧妙运用。
其火焰般的红色车身涂装让人瞬间联想到
日本传统漆器的质感……

进一步强化了RX-VISION车身金属表面的流动美感。

detailRows.speaker: Fabio Filippini
detailRows.en:
The Atenza has a dynamic and elegant design.
It reinterprets the classic sensuality of Italian sportscars
from the 1960s...
With a typically Japanese sensitivity to surfaces
and details.
A 4-door sedan-coupe layout...

Combined with a style inspired by Mazda Design's
'Kodo' philosophy.

Its soft, fluid shapes and evolving surfaces...

Are enhanced by specially developed metallic colours.
It's not by chance that Mazda cars are often
shown in red.
This is done to evoke a sort of fiery temperament
defined by emotion and movement.@
detailRows.zh:
Atenza兼具动感和优雅的设计。
它重新诠释了20世纪60年代意大利跑车的经典性感……
又同时具备日本车典型的对于表面和细节的敏感。
这款车采用四门轿跑车的布局，

并融入了Mazda设计部提出的“魂动”设计理念。

柔和的流畅线条与不断演变的表面
被专门开发的金属色车漆进一步增强。
在Mazda的不同广告宣传中，经常以红车示人。>
这并非偶然，红色唤起了某种充满情绪和动感的极致激情意象。

detailRows.speaker: Fabio Filippini
detailRows.en:
Of all the 911’s countless evolutions, the 964 Turbo S
stands out for its exceptionally muscular, pure design.

To bring out its sculptural form...

The entire car is draped in a single hue, from its nose
to its 'whale tail' wing.
And its flared fenders and 18-inch aluminium cup wheels
complete the look.
But if you ask me...

Its most iconic detail is found in the rear fender
air intakes based on those of the Porsche 959!
detailRows.zh:
在911漫长的进化历程中，964 Turbo S
以其极具力量感的纯粹设计独树一帜。

为了彰显此车雕塑般的形体美……

全车从车头到标志性的“鲸鱼尾”尾翼，
都采用了始终如一的配色。
宽体翼子板和18英寸的铝制赛车轮毂，
更是将这份视觉张力推向了极致。
如果你要问我哪处细节最有代表性……

还得是后翼子板上的进气口，
这正是传承自Porsche 959的独特设计！

detailRows.speaker: Ed Welburn
detailRows.en:
The Nissan Silvia Spec-R is a small coupe with great proportions.

But it is a great opportunity
for you to express your own creativity.
It would make a great custom project car,
with large wheels and flaired fenders as a starting point.
Then paint it black, with a splash of color for graphics, or... ...just use your own creative magic!
detailRows.zh:
Nissan Silvia Spec-R是一款车身比例非常好的小型双门跑车，

也是你表达自己的创造力的绝好机会。
它非常适合改装。如果是我的话，会先从大车轮和拓宽
挡泥板入手。
然后把它涂成黑色底色，再添加更多色彩……
不过，可能还是你自己发挥创造力比较好！

detailRows.speaker: Ed Welburn
detailRows.en:
The C4 Corvette is full of innovations,
both on its inside and outside.
It’s design is a marked departure from the curvier C3,
being more angular and wedge-shaped.
This is evident in the clamshell bonnet
and headlamp construction.

In order to tame its powerful four-valve DOHC engine...

The ZR-1 made use of much wider rear tyres and fenders.

The interior was very much inspired by aircraft design.
Some people say that the C4 Corvette lacks
the ‘soul’ of a Corvette.

But I happen to like it plenty.
detailRows.zh:
C4 Corvette在内部和外部加入了很多创新点。
它有着楔型的车身，更加有棱有角，与C3 Corvette的
波浪状线条相去甚远。
其掀盖式的引擎盖和头灯的结构就是最好的证明。

ZR-1配备了更宽的后胎和后挡泥板……

以便驯服动力强劲的DOHC 4气门引擎。

其内饰的灵感很大程度来源于飞机。
很多人评论说C4 Corvette缺少了一点Corvette的魂。

但我恰好挺喜欢这款车的。

detailRows.speaker: Ed Welburn
detailRows.en:
The C6 Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 is low and wide,
with the stance and physique of a body builder.

To accommodate for wide tyres, it has been given
more width than the standard Corvette...
And features more aggressive air vents
in its front fender.
Interestingly, the black roof works to emphasise the
low-and-wide look of the design.

Also, I really like its round taillights!
detailRows.zh:
拥有低矮宽体车身的Chevrolet Corvette C6 ZR1
看上去像一位魁梧的健美运动员。

为了适配更宽的轮胎，它不得不在
标准版Corvette的基础上继续加宽车身……
并在前挡泥板上加入了造型更显凶猛的通风口。
黑色车顶形成了有趣的视觉效果，进一步强调了
低矮和宽阔的外观设计。

另外，我真的很喜欢它的圆形尾灯！

detailRows.speaker: Ed Welburn
detailRows.en:
This is my car!
Seriously, it’s actually in my garage right now.

The 1969 Camaro is a true classic
American muscle car.
The unique grille shape gives the design a wide stance...
... and the character lines on the side of the car gives
this Camaro a feeling of speed.

The most dated area of the design are the wheels.

On my '69 Camaro, I ditched the 14-inch Rally wheels
and installed 17-inch wheels.
It’s a great car to modify, enhance, and race. Trust me, I know.'
detailRows.zh:
它就是我的梦中情车！
不开玩笑，我的车库里现在就停着一辆。

这么说吧，1969 Camaro是纯正血统的美式肌肉车。
其独特的进气格栅设计赋予了它宽阔的车身姿态……
艺术化的腰线设计带来了速度感。

如果说它的设计有什么过时的地方，那就是车轮了。

比如我个人就放弃了14英寸的拉力轮毂，
换成了17英寸的。
这是一辆改装潜力巨大，甚至能
提升到赛车水准的好车。

相信我，我知道自己在说什么。

detailRows.speaker: Ed Welburn
detailRows.en:
I’m a big fan of all things Chaparral.

The Chaparral 2J was the most innovative Chaparral.

It's undoubtedly the most radical racecar
of the legendary CanAm series.
Its wedge-shaped nose, squared off body
and twin fans on the rear...

...instantly made you want to know
what mysteries lay below its skin.
Its design looks more like a scientific test bed
than an agile racecar.

But the Chaparral 2J could
outperform everything.

That's why it was eventually banned from racing
because of its incredible technical advantage.
I would have created a body shape which was more in
keeping with the front-end design...

...or at least painted the center section white.
detailRows.zh:
我是Chaparral所有车型的忠实拥簇。

Chaparral 2J是他们最具创新性的一款车型。

毋庸置疑，它是传奇的美加系列当中最激进的一款赛车。
看着它的楔形车头、方正的车身和车位的两部风扇……

让你不由得对它的性能产生好奇。
从设计上看，它更像是一件“实验品”
而不是一台“赛车”，

但Chaparral 2J的确凭实力做到了藐视所有竞争对手。

这就是为什么它最终被禁止参加比赛的原因——
它的技术优势领先到无以复加。
就个人而言，我更倾向于打造
前后端设计更加一致的车身。

至少，我会将车体中段也涂成白色。

detailRows.speaker: Ed Welburn
detailRows.en:
The C7 Corvette was inspired by the rich history
of Stingray designs.

That said, it expressed more athleticism in its execution
of those designs.
The entire body is like that of a stingray fish, with its
undulating surfaces and instantly recognizable slope.

And don't forget that piercing front end.
Its bold hood is shrink-wrapped
around a powerful V-8.
Also, its many air intakes and vents manage the flow of
air throughout its incredibly sleek design.?
detailRows.zh:
C7 Corvette的设计从Stingray过往车型的丰富历史中
获取了灵感，

并且在运动感方面取得了突破。
整台车的造型好像一条黄貂鱼，
有着棱角分明的前脸设计……

以及起伏的车身表面和令人过目不忘的倾斜线条。
在隆起的引擎盖下包裹着一台强大的V8引擎，
而无处不在的进气口和风道则巧妙地将气流
导向纤细流畅的车身四周。

detailRows.speaker: Ed Welburn
detailRows.en:
Building on Chaparral’s history of innovation, the Chaparral
2X expresses an incredible vision of futurity.

True, it’s a major departure from the Chaparral 2J...

But it’s no less radical in its mission.

With wingsuit technology serving as its inspiration,
the Chaparral 2X exhibits unique proportions...

And incorporates moving aerodynamic parts
throughout.
All of its design elements work together...

To give it a dynamic look, even when it’s standing still.

The execution of all of the surfaces and the attention
to detail are truly stunning.
detailRows.zh:
Chaparral 2X是Chaparral车系创新史的继承者，
造型设计充满未来感。

毋庸置疑，它的造型和Chaparral 2J截然不同……

但追逐极限的使命被延续了下来。

以翼装技术为灵感，Chaparral 2X的车身表现出独特的比例……

并在整个车身融入了可动空气动力学部件。
所有设计元素融合到一起后，赋予了它极富动感的外观。

即便静止不动，依然让人感到冲劲与跃动。

另外，他们对车身表面的处理
和对细节的执着都令人叹服。

detailRows.speaker: Ed Welburn
detailRows.en:
This is the legendary 1963 Corvette Sting Ray
‘Split Window’ coupe.
Regarding its name, the ‘Split Window’...

This comes from the very sleek rod in the rear window.

This rod is not only a distinguishing feature...

It also allows the profile of the car to remain
uninterrupted in its flow.
This car is so well-balanced from top to bottom,
and from end to end.

I particularly love the fender shape!

Clearly, it was inspired by the Italian streamliners
of the 1950s.
When I look at the sleek undulating lines of
the 1963 Sting Ray...

It really does remind me of its underwater
namesake!
detailRows.zh:
这是传说中的1963款科尔维特Sting Ray
“Split Window”双门跑车。
“Split Window”这个绰号的由来是指它的后车窗被一根立柱一分为二。

这根独树一帜的立柱……

……让车辆的整体轮廓更加连贯和流畅。

我还特别喜爱它的挡泥板的形状，
其灵感应该来源于1950年代意大利汽车的流线型车身。
这辆车从头到尾、从上到下都充满平衡感，

堪称永恒的经典设计。
每次看到那起伏流畅的车身外形……

……我就不由想起那条生活在水底的流线型生物。

没错，那就是这辆车名字的来源，魔鬼鱼。]

detailRows.speaker: Ed Welburn
detailRows.en:
The Toyota 2000GT is a wonderful sports car,
and a true modern-day classic.

The proportions are great.
I wouldn’t change a thing.
It looks best from a rear three-quarter angle.
Seen from that perspective...

The roofline settles far back on the body,
making the bonnet look long and sleek.

The ‘60s-era details are creative and add to
the charm of the design.
detailRows.zh:
这辆Toyota 2000GT是非常优秀的跑车，
也是现代汽车历史中的一款经典杰作。

它的比例十分出色，我甚至找不到任何改进的余地。
我个人最喜欢的欣赏角度是侧后方。
从这个角度看上去……

……车身线条从车顶向尾部缓缓滑落，显得顺滑流畅，
还有它的引擎盖，是那么的修长而利落。

在1960年代，就连细节的设计都创意无穷，
为整体设计增色不少。

detailRows.speaker: Ed Welburn
detailRows.en:
One really cool thing about the design of this car...

Is how it does not rely on gimmicks, but is rather
a pure expression of functional beauty.
The surfaces are well-sculpted into tasteful shapes.
And the body is muscular, with great proportions.
Though the wheels are the largest of their kind,
the car seems to almost hug the ground.
Indeed, the Mercedes A45 AMG has been carefully designed
To express a tough and cool attitude.

I want one in my garage!
detailRows.zh:
这辆Mercedes A45 AMG的设计十分成熟，
性能强悍而且外形帅气。

其车身轮廓充满肌肉感，而且保持了合理的比例。
车身表面经过精心塑形，弧形线条丰富而流畅。
设计师甚至考虑到了轮胎的问题，
最宽尺寸的车胎可以让这辆Mercedes牢牢扒住地面。
这辆车的优势在于不忘初心，
绝无任何花哨的设计，只用实力说话。

这样的车，连我也想买一辆！/

detailRows.speaker: Ed Welburn
detailRows.en:
The Corvette Stingray Racer had a big influence
on every Corvette that came after it.

It was not designed as a production or concept car,
but as a very serious racecar.

Its design was a radical departure from that of
previous Corvettes.
Many of its shapes, like those characterized by
its beautiful fenders, were inspired by Italian streamliners.
The strong crease that defines the car contributes to
its evocation of speed.
detailRows.zh:
Corvette Stingray Racer的诞生对后世每一台Corvette
都带来了重大影响。

自设计伊始，它的定位就不是一台量产车或概念车，
而是彻彻底底的赛车。

大刀阔斧的设计改动使其与
之前的Corvette大相径庭。
车身多处的造型设计都明显受到早期意大利流线型车身
的启发，尤其是那堪称精雕细琢的前后挡泥板。
另外，得益于围绕车身一周的“折缝线”设计，
令它多出了几分速度感。

detailRows.speaker: Ed Welburn
detailRows.en:
Tesla Model S Signature Performance has
 an absolutely wonderful stance.

 The wheels are placed well outside of the basic body shape,
with generous flairs reaching out to those tires.
The body shape is sleek, slippery, and very cool.

 It doesn’t need any tacked-on chrome or aero devices.
 I really like the front-end graphics of the Signature Performance
model much better than the base Model S.
detailRows.zh:
Tesla Model S Signature Performance的外形绝对令人惊艳。

车轮恰到好处地超出车身外廓，
宽大的轮眉向外延展，盖住车轮。
车身线条顺滑流畅，
无需任何附加的铬合金或空气动力学部件，

就已经显得未来感十足，帅气非凡。
我很喜欢Signature Performance的前脸造型，
比基础款Model S的平面耐看多了。

detailRows.speaker: Ed Welburn
detailRows.en:
I’ll never forget the first time I saw a Lamborghini
Countach on the street.

The LP400 is a very fine car indeed.

It is a modern classic and the very definition
of a supercar.
One doesn’t even need to open its scissor doors
to feel its striking presence.

It has an extremely wedge-shaped profile
with a steep windscreen and high tail.
And the bold crease that runs the length of the car
is complimented by well-executed surfaces.
detailRows.zh:
我永远忘不了第一次在街上看到Lamborghini Countach
的情景。

LP400确实是一辆非常出色的车。

它是一款现代经典车，也是超级跑车的绝佳代表。
即使不打开它的剪刀式车门，
也能感受到它令人惊叹的存在感。

它的车身像是一个压到极致的倒梯形，
挡风玻璃斜度很大，尾翼则高高耸起。
一条让人无法忽视的折痕线贯穿整个
侧面车身，夺人眼球。

这条折痕线来自于车身表面的高差——
每个表面都经过精心设计，呈现不同程度的拱起。

detailRows.speaker: Ed Welburn
detailRows.en:
The 2016 Camaro was inspired by the original Camaro
of the 1960s.

But in a very fresh, contemporary way.
This iteration of the Camaro placed a greater emphasis on its
wheels, with a wide stance and muscular fender forms.
Many of its shapes, in particular the hood, front end,
and rear were inspired by Corvette design.
detailRows.zh:
这辆2016款Camaro设计灵感来源于1960年代的初代Camaro……

但进行了大刀阔斧的现代化改动，令人耳目一新。
这个版本的Camaro设计重点强调轮毂和
肌肉感十足的挡泥板，展现类似宽体低趴的形态。
车身部位的许多形状，尤其是引擎盖、车头和车尾，
灵感其实都来源于Corvette。

detailRows.speaker: Ed Welburn
detailRows.en:
Everything about The Camaro ZL1 says speed and power.
It’s practically a weapon on wheels.
From its overall stance to its many functional splitters,
wings, and air intakes, this car is track ready!

And the ZL1 Camaro has a wider track
than other Camaros.
Its dark bonnet, grille, headlamps, and full-width splitter
give this car a wide, sinister appearance.
In two-tone colouring, it's all business. Period!
detailRows.zh:
这辆Camaro ZL1的一切设计目的都是为了速度和力量，
它简直就是一件安上了轮子的武器！
从它的整体姿态到各种功能性的定风翼、尾翼和进气口，
都在告诉你——这辆车完全是为赛道打造的！

这辆Camaro ZL1拥有比其他的Camaro型号更宽的轮距。
涂黑的引擎盖、格栅、车头灯和车身等宽定风翼，
让它显得更狰狞、更具威胁性。
它还通过这种撞色设计表明了态度——不废话，只为胜利！

detailRows.speaker: Ed Welburn
detailRows.en:
The Pontiac GTO was a king among American muscle cars,
and the GTO 'The Judge' was the ultimate GTO.
My favourite aspect of the 1969 GTO 'The Judge' was the
beautifully sculpted body side and soft fender peaks.
It’s unfortunate that the rear bumper didn’t get the
same colour treatment as that of the front bumper.

Other than that, all this car needs are much larger wheels.
They would make the design look more balanced
and athletic.\
detailRows.zh:
Pontiac GTO就是美国肌肉车之王，
而这辆GTO 'The Judge'则是终极的GTO。
我对这辆1969款GTO 'The Judge'最喜爱的一点就是
它那雕塑般硬朗的车身侧线条与柔和的挡泥板上部的交融。
这里有个小小的遗憾，它的后保险杠并没有采用
与前保险杠相同的喷漆颜色。

除此之外，这辆车唯一欠缺之处就是需要更大的轮毂。
大尺寸的轮毂可以让它整体看上去更平衡、更具运动感。

detailRows.speaker: Ed Welburn
detailRows.en:
The C7 ZR1 Corvette is the ultimate expression of a
front-engine Corvette's power and bold design.

The ZR1 is sometimes known as ‘The Widebody’.

It’s significantly wider than a standard Corvette Stingray
in order to accommodate its massive tyres.
The ZR1 has very significant air intakes and air exits.

These manage the flow of air and feed the many coolers
in the nose and tail of the car.
Most people love the rear wing.

But I prefer the smaller rear spoiler that was also
available..
detailRows.zh:
这辆C7 ZR1 Corvette是前置引擎Corvette那强大性能
和粗犷设计的终极例证。

这辆ZR1有时也被爱称为“The Widebody”（宽车身）。

为了容纳那套巨大的轮胎，它比
标准款Corvette Stingray要宽出许多。
ZR1同样还配备了巨大的进气口和出气口……

用于引导气流，为车头和车尾的散热器提供风冷降温。
许多人都很喜欢它的尾翼。

不过我个人更喜欢配备尺寸更小的后扰流板。[

detailRows.speaker: Ed Welburn
detailRows.en:
The Lexus LC500 has absolutely incredible proportions.
With a long, low bonnet, a long wheelbase...
A tight cabin, large wheels placed
at the corners...

And an absolutely juicy body shape,
which is well-sculpted.

It has very technical headlamps and taillamps,
and a fresh interpretation of the Lexus grille.
This design makes it very clear that a highly advanced
engine is under the bonnet. I absolutely love this car!
detailRows.zh:
Lexus LC500的车身比例十分惊人。
它具有修长而低矮的引擎盖，相对较长的轴距
和紧凑的驾驶舱，硕大的车轮更是占据了四角……

外加夺人眼球、线条精雕细刻的抢眼车身造型。

它的大灯和尾灯科技含量很高，前格栅
则是对Lexus经典款式的重新演绎。
整体的造型都在告诉你——我的引擎盖下面安装了一颗
非常先进的引擎。这是我非常非常喜欢的一台车！\

detailRows.speaker: Ed Welburn
detailRows.en:
I’ve always liked the design of the McLaren MP4.

It’s bold, aggressive, but not over-the-top.
Much like the McLaren 650S, all of the design elements
work in harmony, making for a very consistent design.
I love the side intakes and the graphics on the rear,
including the cool exhaust shape and location.
detailRows.zh:
我一直非常中意McLaren MP4的设计。

它大胆不羁、具有侵略性，但又不过分张扬。
就像McLaren 650S一样，所有的设计元素协调统一，
形成了和谐的风格。
我喜欢它侧进气口和车尾的效果，包括酷炫的排气管造型和布局。

detailRows.speaker: Ed Welburn
detailRows.en:
The McLaren 650S has classic mid-engine proportions,
executed in a very fresh way.
It has a very bold and distinct face,
as well as a strong rear.

All of the shapes, curves, plan views, and overall profile
work together...
Highlighted by the side scoop and side glass shape.
detailRows.zh:
McLaren 650S拥有经典的中置引擎比例，
但以一种非常新颖的方式呈现。
它的前脸大胆而独特，车尾设计也风格鲜明。

从车身造型、曲线、表面效果到整体轮廓，无不协调融洽……
侧进气口和侧窗玻璃形状更是将这一特点重点凸显出来。

detailRows.speaker: Ed Welburn
detailRows.en:
The Peugeot RCZ GT is a very creative design,
with styling much like a show car.

It’s sporty, youthful, and elegant in its execution.
The silver arched roofline-rails and double bubble-roof
panel look very much like a concept vehicle.
Also, the design of the front and rear gives you
a feeling of security.
detailRows.zh:
Peugeot RCZ GT采用了创意十足的设计方案，
造型形似展示车。

它既富有运动性、年轻气息，又展现了优雅的格调。
银色的车顶立柱弧线和双泡形车顶玻璃面板
更像是概念车的专属。
此外，车头和车尾两处的设计也给人一种安全感。

detailRows.speaker: Ed Welburn
detailRows.en:
This car probably has the most dramatic profile
of a modern front-engine sports car.
The bonnet is long and low, and the cabin is placed well back
on the chassis, right over the rear wheels.

One of my favourite design features is how the front fender
vents are linked to the shape of the door opening.
Overall, the SLR McLaren has the look of speed,
grace, and elegance.
detailRows.zh:
在现代前置引擎跑车中，这款车可能是车身比例
最吸睛的车型之一。
它的引擎盖修长而低矮，车厢后移置于底盘后部，
正好位于后轮上方。

前挡泥板通风口与车门门缝衔接的神来之笔
绝对是我最喜欢的特色设计之一。
总体而言，SLR迈凯伦展现出了速度、优雅
和风度兼具的外观。<next id=2302406 type=9

detailRows.speaker: Ed Welburn
detailRows.en:
The Dodge Challenger SRT Demon is a beast!
It's a "well-executed beast," with a bold and purposeful design
that emphasized functionality!

The SRT Demon is a very intimidating
modern day muscle car...
...with bold fender flares and hood scoops...
...as well as deep-offset wheels that say power—
lots of power!
detailRows.zh:
这辆Dodge Challenger SRT Demon绝对是最凶猛的野兽！
SRT Demon是一辆开发得当的性能机器，
采用了激进但目的明确，强调功能性的设计，

是一辆令人望而生畏的现代肌肉车。
它的挡泥板和引擎盖进气口相当粗犷……
缩小偏距使得轮毂外凸，传递出令人无法抗拒的力量感，
而它也确实拥有与外观匹配的性能！

detailRows.speaker: Ed Welburn
detailRows.en:
The Ferrari FXX K gives me the impression
of a ‘2-seater Formula 1 Ferrari’.
The overall body shape is aggressive, and every bit
of the car is designed for the purpose of speed.
The front wing/splitter, and all of the intakes
and air exits are impressive.
I am particularly intrigued by the small shape just forward
of the rear wheel which deflects air from the rear tyre.

As you walk around to the rear,
it’s all serious business.
detailRows.zh:
Ferrari FXX K给我一种“次级别F1 Ferrari赛车”的印象。
车身塑造得非常有进攻性，几乎每一个部件
都是为速度而设计的。
从前翼/定风翼，再到所有的进气口及排气口的处理
都令人印象深刻。
特别打动我的是紧靠后轮前方的这个小翼片造型，
它的作用是偏转气流，使其远离后轮。

沿着车身漫步到车后，眼中所及都是匠心独运的设计。\

detailRows.speaker: Ed Welburn
detailRows.en:
The Mercedes-Benz 300 SL Coupé is one of the most
recognisable sports cars in the history of automobiles.
Overall, it has a look of ‘refined speed,’ and deserves
all of the acclaim it receives.
The 300 SL has some great shapes...

Take, for instance, its bonnet, fender eyebrows, sloping
tail, and beautifully executed roof and windows.
One of its most distinct design elements are its gullwing
doors, which I think look even better when closed.{
detailRows.zh:
Mercedes-Benz 300 SL Coupé是汽车史上
最具辨识度的跑车车型之一。
总体上看，它便是“精致速度”的代表，
完全配得上它所获得的一切赞誉。
300 SL的轮廓中融合了一些美轮美奂的形状……

比如它的引擎盖、挡泥板上缘、下倾的车尾
以及设计精巧的车顶和车窗。
它最特别的一处设计元素就是它的
鸥翼车门，而且我觉得门关上之后甚至更好看了。

detailRows.speaker: Ed Welburn
detailRows.en:
The GT Concept Car by Citroën has a very intriguing design.

Its centre fuselage disappears behind
its very bold fender shapes.
This gives the car a sleek and aggressive look, and helps
to manage air flow and cooling in a unique way.
The windscreen and side glass are like slits, giving the
GT by Citroën a very private, sinister look.
detailRows.zh:
这辆GT by Citroën概念车带来了令人惊诧的设计。

它的车身不着痕迹地消失在极度激进的挡泥板之后。
这种特色让这辆车拥有了利落而极富侵略性的外观，
并以独特的方式辅助了气流引导和散热。
挡风玻璃和车窗玻璃就像是在同一块玻璃上开了缝一般，
让这辆GT by Citroën呈现出既注重隐私，又略带邪恶的外观。

detailRows.speaker: Ed Welburn
detailRows.en:
The 1970 Chevrolet Chevelle SS is one of the most masculine
cars of the muscle-car era.
Everything about it says 'power', from its bulging shapes
to its muscular fenders...

To its power-dome, cowl-induction bonnet.
I liken the big-block Chevelle SS
to an animal ready to pounce.
detailRows.zh:
这辆1970款Chevrolet Chevelle SS是肌肉车黄金时代
最富肌肉感的车型之一。
从它壮硕的车身轮廓到粗犷的挡泥板……

再到向上隆起、采用风帽导气设计的引擎盖，
每个细节无不散发出一种“动力澎湃”的感觉。
我会将这款大排量的Chevelle SS
比作一只蓄势待发的猛兽。

detailRows.speaker: Freeman Thomas
detailRows.en:
The 964-based RS is one of my favorite models.

Because it retains the original "Ur" 911 shape
and air-cooled flat-6!
I'm thrilled it is visually pure and doesn't have
any add-ons like a fixed rear wing.

Also, it's Porsche's first Cup Car.

A true successor to the '73 RS and the '74 RS 3.0.
You can immediately tell a 964 RS from a normal 964 by
just looking at the stance and the wheels.

The 17-inch wheels on the 964 were made from aluminum.

On the 964 RS, they were visually the same, but were wider
and made from lighter magnesium.

Today, they fall into the "unobtanium" category!
detailRows.zh:
这款964 RS版本是我最喜欢的车型之一。

为什么？因为它保留了911原汁原味的“Ur-911”型外形和风
冷水平对置六缸发动机！
它带来的纯粹感令我兴奋不已，比如说，它就没有添加
固定尾翼之类的部件。

而且，它是保时捷的第一辆“奖杯赛车”。

我认为它是73版RS和74版RS 3.0真正的继承者。
只需看一下车辆的姿态和车轮，你就能立即分辨出
964 RS和普通964的差异。

964使用的17寸车轮杯型1是铝制的，

而964 RS虽然使用了同尺寸的车轮，但显得更宽，而
且使用更轻的镁合金材料制造。

镁现在已经被归为“超导矿石”类目，价格不菲！

detailRows.speaker: Freeman Thomas
detailRows.en:
It could be ordered in standard colors, along with
Rubystone, Signal Green or Maritime Blue.

The sparse interiors came in black as standard.

Then there were the one-piece composite Recaros,
with central trimmings in two-tone leathers.
There was the "M001" Carrera Cup Version, the "M002"
RS Touring Version, or the "M003" N/GT1 Carrera RS.
This is a must-have for the 911 air-cooled purist!
detailRows.zh:
这辆车的标准车身配色包括了红宝石色，信号绿，海洋
蓝。

内饰倒是标准且朴素的黑色，

外加中间包边的Recaro运动桶椅，可选双色皮革，
还分成了“M001” Carrera Cup版本、“M002” RS Touring版
和“M003” N/GT1 Carrera RS。
对于追求纯粹的风冷引擎911爱好者来说，这是一台必须
拥有的车！

detailRows.speaker: Freeman Thomas
detailRows.en:
There are some subtle visual differences between this car
and the R8 LMS: it's cleaner, with fewer graphics.
The aggressive look of the red tail lights and flat red
bumper lines remain very much in place.

It's still a classically German look, in other words!
The front is also more visually striking, and the spoiler
is now at a reverse angle.
Some have also noted that the red winglets look a little bit
like whiskers.

This is an evolved version of the R8 LMS, hence the 'Evo'
name. It's certainly had a visual overhaul!

Truth be told, it's getting closer and close to being my
perfect car!]
detailRows.zh:
与之前2015年的R8勒芒系列赛相比，这款R8只有一些外观
上细微差别。它的车身比较干净，没有那么多繁琐的图形，
但红色的尾灯和横向的红色保险杠线条让它保留了应有
的侵略性。

换句话说，这就是经典的日耳曼风格！
它的正面也变得更引人瞩目。还有扰流板被设置成了反角。
有人还开玩笑说，红色的侧翼就像两撇胡须一样。

名称中包含的“进化”一词代表它是R8勒芒系列赛的进
化版，整体视觉效果发生了天翻地覆的变化。

说句真心话，它离我心目中的完美汽车越来越近了！

detailRows.speaker: Freeman Thomas
detailRows.en:
The design of the original Audi TT Coupe is
very close to my heart.

My intent was to be
"absolute" and "pure" in a holistic concept.
My inspirations for the TT concepts were...

...Erwin Komenda's 356 Speedster and 550 LeMans Coupe...

...along with
Ecola Spada's Giulietta SZ "round tail" Coupe.

The short round front and rear overhangs arch up geometrically...
...into the belt-line with the fender arches repeating
the motion.
The upper spear-line served to shave
the surface and light reflection...

...and connect the headlamp/taillamp graphics.

This creates an energy that also communicates
"quattro" by visually connecting the wheels!
The low, round "chopped" roof sits on top of the lower fuselage
as a separate visual element similar to the 550 LeMans Coupe.
The interior designed in collaboration with Romulus Rost
is just as absolute and pure!
I still can't believe Audi produced the TT!^
detailRows.zh:
我对初代奥迪TT轿跑的设计
仍记忆犹新！

我当时的整体设计理念是
“绝对”和“纯粹”。
TT的灵感来自于

艾尔文·柯曼达的356 Speedster和550勒芒轿跑，

以及艾可拉·斯帕达的
吉里耶塔 SZ “圆尾”轿跑。短小的圆拱形车头和车尾
，其形状一直延续至车腰，连挡泥板也沿用这一几何形状。
车体上部的线条起到了
削修表面、避免反光、

连接头灯/尾灯形状的作用。

这种将前后轮连接起来的视觉效果，
还传达出了“四驱”的能量！
低矮的圆拱形车顶直接坐落在下车身上，
创造出了一个独立的，类似550勒芒轿跑的视觉元素。
与罗穆卢斯·罗斯特合作设计的内饰
也同�绝对和纯粹！
我仍然不敢相信奥迪真的把TT生产了出来！~

detailRows.speaker: Freeman Thomas
detailRows.en:
The original 2001 996-based GT3 is one of
the best-kept Porsche secrets!

Both technically and mechanically, it is the most raw
of all the GT3s!
It featured a naturally aspirated GT1/Mezger flat-6 in a
reinforced chassis geared towards motorsports.

The success of the GT3 was unexpected, with demand
exceeding the limited production run!

It is pure magic!;
detailRows.zh:
2001款996 GT3是Porsche最大的秘密武器之一！

无论是技术方面，还是机械方面，
这款车型的凶悍程度都冠绝Porsche所推出的所有GT3！
它搭载了来自GT1/Mezger的自然进气水平对置六缸引擎
以及赛车级的强化悬挂。

GT3的成功来得如此突然，订单纷至沓来，
远超原有的限量发售数！

这辆车简直像有魔力一般！

detailRows.speaker: Sarah
detailRows.en:
That's correct! It's an engine created by Porsche's
legendary engineer Hans Mezger!

He's responsible for the 911's traditional air-cooled
engines, as well as race engines for F1 and Le Mans.

Although 911 engines became water-cooled starting with
the 996...

...the engines for the GT2, GT3 and Turbo
were still rooted in designs by Mezger.
detailRows.zh:
没错！这款引擎由Porsche的传奇工程师汉斯·梅茨格打造！

他负责设计了911的风冷引擎，以及
F1和勒芒赛事用的赛车引擎。

尽管自996之后，911的引擎都换成了水冷……

但梅茨格的设计理念依然根植于GT2，GT3以及911 Turbo之中。

detailRows.speaker: Sarah
detailRows.en:
