Hans Mezger was Porsche's legendary engineer.

He's responsible for the 911's traditional air-cooled
engines, as well as race engines for F1 and Le Mans.

Although 911 engines became water-cooled starting with
the 996...

...the engines for the GT2, GT3 and Turbo
were still rooted in designs by Mezger.
detailRows.zh:
汉斯·梅茨格是Porsche的传奇工程师！

他负责设计了911的风冷引擎，
以及F1和勒芒赛事用的赛车引擎。

尽管自996之后，911的引擎都换成了水冷……

但梅茨格的设计理念依然根植于GT2，GT3以及911 Turbo之中。

detailRows.speaker: Freeman Thomas
detailRows.en:
The BAC Mono is one gorgeous piece of engineering.

 It's a great example of exceptional industrial design.
 Every detail is beautifully executed
with functional forms and fresh graphics.

 Its inspiration comes from single-seat formula cars.

It's a serious road and track machine that is
designed to extract the maximum out of the driver and car.
The serious aerodynamics are played out visually.

 Take a look at the fuselage.

It tapers to the rear with the large side intakes
and routes the air through and over the back spoiler/wing.

I also love how the engineering is approached.

It comes equipped with push-rod front suspension shocks,
and the rear suspension arms on full display.

This car is indeed an impressive example of
how form can follow function.

 It is truly a highly technical,
clever design language that is beautifully done!
detailRows.zh:
BAC Mono是一辆工程学的奇迹、

一件出类拔萃的工业设计样本……

它的设计灵感来自于单座方程式赛车。
每一处细节都精雕细琢……
采用功能至上的部件和极致简洁的贴花，

这是一辆货真价实的公路和赛道机器，
所有设计只为让驾驶者和车辆都发挥出全部潜力。
严谨的空气动力学设计毫不掩饰地呈现在眼前。

以车身为例，

车身两侧从前向后逐渐收窄，露出硕大的侧进气口，
以便引导气流从车后部的上方通过。

它在工程上的处理方式也是我很欣赏的。

它配备了推杆式前悬挂减震……

而后悬挂臂则直接裸露在外。

detailRows.speaker: Freeman Thomas
detailRows.en:
It's hard to believe the car is nearly two decades old!

Stylistically, the Carrera GT was ahead of its time.
It became the future DNA for Porsche...

...especially for the Boxster and Cayman,
and I would say, influenced the 918.
It has a lot of innovative details,
such as the double hump mesh rear screen...

...with the stylized aero roll bars hovering above.

I also love the rear diffuser
with the integrated exhausts.

Also inspiring was the interior
with the center console bridge.
 If I were to make one criticism...

...then it would have be
the visually long bodyside.

The front fender outlet and rear fender inlet...

...connected by the horizontal lines accentuate this.
The clever details continue
with the center-lock wheels.

...and the aero supported mirrors.

 I would sa� the styling of the Carrera GT
is truly timeless...

...and a masterpiece of modern Porsche design!
detailRows.zh:
Carrera GT是永不过时的艺术品。

我认为它是保时捷现代设计中的杰作！

你甚至很难想象这辆车已经问世这么多个年头了！
从造型上，Carrera GT完全领先了它的时代……

它的设计元素影响到了后续几乎所有保时捷车型……

比如Boxster和Cayman，甚至还包括918。
它蕴含了大量的创新细节……

比如双峰式的后置透明引擎罩，
以及悬在引擎上、造型独具的空力防倾杆。

集成在保险杠上的排气管
和后扩散器也是我喜欢的设计。

同样令人耳目一新的还有内饰的中控台。
不过呢，如果要我提意见的话……

我觉得长度有些太长了。

尤其是侧面的水平线条，显得拖沓……

因为它把前挡泥板的出风口
和后挡泥板进风口连起来了……
保时捷在这台车上还加入了很多巧思……

例如中央锁止轮毂和空气动力学后视镜等等。

detailRows.speaker: Freeman Thomas
detailRows.en:
I love the 2008 FIAT 500! It's so
whimsical and fun.

Really, it does a masterful job of improving upon
its forebear.

Expressing character in automotive design
is no easy task.

But here's an example that truly inspires!
The face is friendly, with its round eyes.

You could have a parking lot full of them, all in the same
colour, and they would each look unique!
Colour plays a huge emotional role in the 500.

Given its retro design, the retro colouring suits it
very well.
detailRows.zh:
我可爱2008款FIAT 500了！这辆有趣的小车太脑洞大开了。

真的，它对前继车型的各方面优化都完成得相当漂亮。

在汽车设计中，表达个性从来都不是一件容易的事。

但这辆车绝对是一个正面例子！
睁着一双“圆眼睛”的前脸看着就很是友好。

就算在一个停车场里停满相同颜色的这台车，
你依然会感觉它们每一台都有自己的个性！
不同的颜色为FIAT 500注入了个性与情绪。

考虑到它的经典复古造型，
复古怀旧的涂装更相得益彰。

detailRows.speaker: Freeman Thomas
detailRows.en:
It is really a clever design in that it is larger
than the original but scaled up perfectly!

 If you put an original next to it, you won't
believe the difference in size.

The original car was really quite small.
The shut-lines play a key part and play an important role
in modernizing the GT40.

The larger size allows larger and taller people to fit
comfortably and allows them get in and out easily.
This is truly an iconic "daily driver" super car
with Ford reliability and parts access.

The styling inside and out has proven to be timeless.
A true collector's car for the serious enthusiast.
detailRows.zh:
他们采取了非常巧妙的设计手法：
扩大车身尺寸，然后完美复刻原车比例！

将两辆车停在一起时，你甚至很难发现它们的差别。

而实际上，GT40要小上一号。
在打造现代版GT40时，
精准化镶板的工艺发挥了重要的作用。

“大号”的新Ford GT为身材更高大的驾驶者带来了便利。
这是一款真正能满足日常驾驶的经典超级跑车，
并拥有Ford的可靠品质和零部件供应支持。

无论是内饰还是外观，
这辆车的设计都经受得起时间的考验。

这是一辆真正的车迷会选择收藏的好车。<next id=2400808 type=9׾

detailRows.speaker: Freeman Thomas
detailRows.en:
The 2005 MINI Cooper S is still stylistically and
proportionately the best one！

I loved these when they came out, and I still love them!
Minimal overhangs and simple bodysides.
Low beltline and great all-round visibility.

 All the horizontal lines were drawn in parallel
to each other.

This is when it seemed the MINI designers
had a bigger voice with great vision!
They looked amazing in a variety of colors,
liveries with optional roof colors and graphics.

The interior continued the theme with the
big round central screen.

The MINI screamed fun!
detailRows.zh:
从风格和比例上比较，2005 MINI Cooper S都应当是
MINI产品线中的佼佼者！

这款车刚刚投产时我就爱上了它。
直到今天。我觉得它依然魅力不减！
你可以重点关注极限的短前悬、简约的廓形，以及
低腰线和全方位的视野，

还有车身的每一根水平线条都保持平行。

全都来自那个MINI的设计师们还抱有远见的时代！
无论搭配什么样的涂装、车顶颜色或是贴花，
它都能让你惊艳不已。

另外我还要夸一句圆形的中控屏幕。

没错，MINI就是这样，从里到外都充满乐趣！

detailRows.speaker: Freeman Thomas
detailRows.en:
This is the car that made Henrik Fisker famous!
It’s truly a modern 507!
There's a lot I like about it.

First, I like how it pushes BMW's emotional envelope.

It almost has a handmade look...

It reflects a more human approach to design.

It’s really quite wonderful!
It’s a more emotional, artistic approach that
embraces imperfections as character!
And, if anything, the Z8 is full of character.
detailRows.zh:
这辆车让亨里克·菲斯克声名鹊起！
你可以说，它就是现代版的507了！
我喜欢它的地方有很多。

首先，我喜欢它把宝马感性的一面发挥到了极致。

它的外观给人一种手工打造的质感……

反映出一种更有人情味的设计方法。

它有着极强的表现力！
这是一种更感性、更艺术的设计方法，
接纳不完美，并把它转化为车的个性！
倒不如说，这台Z8全身上下都散发着强烈的个性！

detailRows.speaker: Freeman Thomas
detailRows.en:
The Raptor is an aggressive and capable beast.
I love this truck!
It has a solid overall design and possesses plenty of Ford’s
unique DNA.

The wide stance and large tires result in great
handling character and tremendous height.

Its capable 4WD system allows it to excel
on rough off-road terrain.
This first-generation Raptor had a V-8 that matched
its aggressive character.=
detailRows.zh:
Raptor的外形充盈着侵略性和力量感！
这就是我爱这辆卡车的原因！
它不仅拥有Ford血统的优点，还有许多独到之处！
形成了一套性能全面的设计方案。

它拥有宽大的车架和大外径尺寸的轮胎，
因此获得了出色的操控性和充分的离地间隙。

极大的上坡角增大了车架前后部分与地面的空间，
使其能够轻松搞定起伏坎坷的地形。
另外，这辆初代Raptor搭载的可是一台V8引擎，
无论是个性还是侵略性，都更上一层楼！

detailRows.speaker: Freeman Thomas
detailRows.en:
Unlike the 993 Carrera RS, the 993 RS Clubsport
was built with racing as its sole purpose.

It featured a distinctive rear wing with integrated air inlets.
The downforce generated at the rear was balanced
by an extended front spoiler.
The wheels were a three-piece design,
with staggered offsets front and rear.

A single glance at the exterior details made it clear
this was the work of Style Porsche...

...the in-house design studio at Porsche Weissach.
Inside, the cabin was defined by a spartan layout
and a reinforced roll cage.

Like other 911-based race cars of its era,
the Clubsport channeled its forebears.

I almost feel for the owner attempting to persuade
the authorities to license it for road use!
A formidable challenge, though not an impossible one![
detailRows.zh:
基于993打造的RS Clubsport版本
是比993 Carrera RS更加纯粹的赛道机器。
尾翼产生的巨大下压力需要通过狭长的前端扰流板来平衡。
轮毂采用3片式锻造设计，而且前后采用不同的偏距值。

从外观细节中不难看出，它的设计来自品牌自有的

保时捷-魏斯萨赫设计工作室——“保时捷设计”。
内饰采用赛车专用的朴素黑色，并安装了全面焊接加固的防滚架。

在这一代基于保时捷911打造的赛车上，
你仍然可以看到一些原版911的元素。

我可以想象，某些有追求的车主可能会尝试
为这辆车注册登记，获得上路许可……

……想必这位车主需要和车管部门费好大一番口舌了。
不过我“听说”还真的有人成功了！

detailRows.speaker: Freeman Thomas
detailRows.en:
The 2016 TT Cup is exciting in that it's
an extremely well-proportioned racecar...

...when compared to the production-based street version.

I like the fender forms that hint at the original TT,
but these are bolder and wider.
The graphics are pure Audi Sport
with the red, gray and silver.

I also like the black wheels brought out
to the maximum track width.
It gives the car an amazing stance that's more absolute!
detailRows.zh:
2016 TT Cup是一辆让人心生悸动的赛车，
因为和量产的街车版本相比……

……它更加的“匀称”。

我喜欢这辆车的挡泥板设计，
有点原版TT的味道，不过做得更大也更宽。
红灰银涂装是Audi Sport的官方风格。

漆黑的轮毂我也觉得不错，
而且他们将轮距加宽到了极致，
让整车造型看上去更加坚定和动态。
这台车的设计语言非常大胆，也非常引人注目！

detailRows.speaker: Freeman Thomas
detailRows.en:
Here we go!
The Daihatsu Copen makes me smile!

 It is truly a whimsical and fun design!
It says, "Don't take things so seriously!"
 Look at the front with its friendly round
headlamps and a smiling grille!
 The taillights repeat the expression with its round eyes.
And, proportionally, it has a nice stance.
This design here visually puts the wheels on the ends,
making it a look like its ready to pounce!
detailRows.zh:
每当我看到Daihatsu Copen，都会忍不住笑！

这确实算是一个异想天开的有趣设计！
它仿佛在说：“看我萌你一脸！”
前脸这里，是对你开心眨眼的圆形大灯和嘴角上翘的进气格栅！
尾灯也是两颗萌萌的圆眼睛。
它的车身比例相当不错，所以静态效果很出彩。
设计师特意把前后轮距拉远，
让它看起来像是要“猛兽”扑食一般！

detailRows.speaker: Freeman Thomas
detailRows.en:
The 918 was designed as the flagship...

...to showcase Porsche's
latest styling DNA and advanced technology for the future.

The styling forecasted Porsche's next generation of vehicles.
The dual rear exhausts exiting through...

...the rear upper cooling grille

looks like a jet pack...

...and is really exciting!
You can also see the production version of
the four element LED headlights and the rear taillamp LED frame.
Along with the form vocabulary, you can also see
these elements showing up into the next generation of Porsches
Another favorite area of mine was...

...the interior design with the high bridge center console.

This was first seen in the 2003 Carrera GT but newly imagined.
The design language and style
has worn well over the years.

A bit restrained to the eyes
compared to other competitors.

But still well received and
a popular edition to a super car collection!
detailRows.zh:
918是作为保时捷的旗舰型号来设计的……

是为了充分展现
这家公司最新的设计基因和未来将采用的先进科技。

其设计风格预示了保时捷之后几代车型的设计路线。
穿过车尾上部冷却格栅的……

两根排气管，

整体看起来就像背着一个喷气背包……

令人感觉很酷！
此车还采用了量产版的四点式LED大灯和LED框架式尾灯。
这些元素和形状设计语汇，都在下一代保时捷车型中得到了沿袭。
918还有一点是我非常钟爱的……

就是内饰设计中如引桥般高高矗立的中控台。

这项设计早在2003年的Carrera GT上就出现过，
但这次经过了重新构思。
这些设计语言和风格随着时间的打磨已经变得圆熟，p�
尽管和竞品相比可能显得有一些平静内敛。

但爱好者们对918的接受度从未减少分毫。它永远是
所有超级跑车收藏者心目中的人气之选。.

detailRows.speaker: Freeman Thomas
detailRows.en:
The '32 is the quintessential hot rod!

It was nicknamed "Deuce" because of the 2 in "32."

It was visually simple but complex in its execution.
Look closely and
you'll not find a flat line anywhere!

It possesses a powerfully aggressive package,

that's all about proportion,
balance, stance and form.
The shape tapers in every view.
 The stance is set up
 with just the right amount of rake.

The back tires taller than the fronts.
The '32 also signals the beginning of
the iconic Ford V-8!

In a '32 Hot Rod, the motor becomes
an emotional part of the whole.]
detailRows.zh:
这款'32可以被视作是改装车中的标杆！

玩家们还将“32”中的“2”变成了这辆车的昵称：“二点”。

看似平平无奇的外观下，其实内有乾坤。
仔细观察后，你会发现整个车身上找不到一条平直的线条！

它的整体设计充满了力量和冲劲……

这也是车身比例、平衡、姿态和整体轮廓巧妙结合的成果。
让它在各个角度都显得凌厉利落……
前倾角的角度设置得恰到好处，

后轮比前轮高一些，就形成了现在这攻击型的姿态。
此外，这辆'32还标志着福特首次引入其招牌V8引擎！

对于'32 而言，
这台引擎是其浑然天成的整体中的神来之笔。

detailRows.speaker: Freeman Thomas
detailRows.en:
The Type 930 911 Turbo was Porsche's first
true super car.

It appealed to a new kind of Porsche customer.

Indeed, the "Turbo" added another element.
Somewhere inside those Superman fender flares
and that big rear wing was...

...the humbleness of Clark Kent.
It was a success story from the time it made its debut
at the 1973 Frankfurt Motor Show.

The 911 truly presented the 1970s for Porsche.

But did you know it was scheduled to be replaced?

That was before the Type 930 911 Turbo breathed new life
into the model.

Of course, we know this now in hindsight.
The original 930 had a long and strong production run
from 1975 to 1989...

...with an update to the new 964/965 platform in 1990.
Also of note was the "Turbo" script that became iconic
unto itself.

In fact, this script is still being used by�Porsche today
on all subsequent Turbos.
detailRows.zh:
这辆Type 930 911 Turbo是保时捷第一款
真正意义上的超级跑车！

它还吸引来一批性格张扬的保时捷新车迷。

毫无疑问，这台“Turbo”树立起了一代传奇的形象！
这辆谦逊、简约的911就好比汽车领域的“克拉克·肯特”——

它的挡泥板和巨大的尾翼闪耀着如同超人般充满力量感的光泽。
自从在1973法兰克福车展上惊艳亮相的那一刻起，
这款车就迎来了巨大成功。

911成为了保时捷在70年代最闪耀的代言人。

不过你知道吗？如果不是Type 930 911 Turbo又为911系列
注入了全新的生命力。

这个系列原本将迎来被替换的命运。

当然，我们现在这么说也是事后诸葛亮罢了。
初代930在1975年到1989年之间持续生产了
很长的时间，产量也很庞大……

然后�3在1990年升级到了964/965平台。
另外值得一提的是，“Turbo”名称本身也成为了一代传奇。

事实上，保时捷直到今天还在沿用，
并推出了许多款后续的“Turbo”车型！

detailRows.speaker: Freeman Thomas
detailRows.en:
With more mid-engine cars from Ford and Ferrari winning
in LM-GTE, WEC and American IMSA events...

...Porsche needed to do something.
Styled by Gran Larson in 2017...

...this mid-engine 911 RSR was a bold move.

Back in 1996, Porsche tried something similar,
getting Tony Hatter to design...

...a mid-engine 911 GT1 based on the 933.
The 2017 RSR silhouette hides...

...its mid-engine architecture, making it look
like a rear-engine 991.

That said, it is wider and more aggressive.
As the saying goes in the automobile industry...

..."Win on Sunday, sell on Monday!"
detailRows.zh:
当越来越多的中置引擎福特和法拉利赛车在勒芒房车耐力赛、
世界耐力锦标赛和美国国际赛车运动协会等赛事中取得成功……

保时捷也必须要设法迎头赶上！
这辆中置引擎的911 RSR由格兰·拉尔森在2017设计……

算是保时捷相当激进的一步！

早在1996年，保时捷就已经进行过类似的尝试，
让托尼·哈特尔设计出……

一款基于933的中置引擎911 GT1。
这辆2017 RSR的外形轮廓巧妙掩饰了……

它的中置引擎架构，让它看上去像一辆引擎后置的991。

尽管如此，它的车身相对更宽，整体外形也更具侵略性！
就像是汽车行业内一句俗话说的那样……

“周日一胜，周一大卖！”

detailRows.speaker: Freeman Thomas
detailRows.en:
The ’55 Porsche Spyder Type 550/1500RS is the icon
of all Porsche Spyders.

It was a minimalist car stripped of all but what is needed.

Its organic, functional form was designed
by Erwin Komenda.

He was the body designer for all the Auto-Union "Rennwagens,"
as well as the VW Beetle and Porsche 356.

He really was the chief architect of the early Porsche
and VW design DNA.
Stylistically, the Spyder Type 550 is similar to
a 365 Speedster.

That said, it is much more capable, with its mid-engine
chassis and aluminum body.
The rag-top roof actually serves no real purpose,
except to meet the letter of the rule book.

It’s as if Porsche was saying to the regulators,
"Look, it has a roof!"
In addition to a diminutive body
and short wheelbase...

...it has an extremely low cowl/beltline
with just an aero screen.
Incidentally, the Porsche Spyder Type 550
was given the nickname "Giant Killer."

This is because, in the right hands, it was capable of
beating much more powerful and faster machines.
Indeed, it was a popular car for sportsmen or works drivers
looking to win a class victory or compete in a road rally.
detailRows.zh:
这辆1955年出品的保时捷敞篷type 550/1500RS是
所有保时捷敞篷车型中最具标志性的一款！

这辆车采用极简设计，剥离了一切非必需的元素！

它那浑然天成、功能实用的外形是由
艾尔文·柯曼达设计……

这名车身设计师也是汽车联盟所有“赛车”车型
以及大众甲壳虫和保时捷356的创造者。

可以说，他就是早期保时捷和大众设计DNA
的主要构建者！
从外观上看，敞篷type 550和365 Speedster非常相似。

不过前者采用了中置引擎布局和铝制车身，性能也更出色。
它的帆布车顶其实并不具备实际功能，
只是为了符合规则的要求而已！

就好像保时捷在对规则监管方说：“你们看，我有车顶哦！”
除了截短的车身和短轴距之外……

它还拥有极低的风罩�u腰线，
并且只采用了埃尔罗斯林风挡。
保时捷敞篷type 550获得“巨人杀手”的昵称
则是个意外之喜！

这是因为在技术高超的车手驾驭下，它可以击败
性能更强、速度更快的车型！
毋庸置疑，这是一辆人气极高的赛车，可以帮助竞技车手或
厂队车手赢得赛事胜利或加入公路拉力竞赛的争夺。

detailRows.speaker: Freeman Thomas
detailRows.en:
The 356 A/1500 GS GT Carrera Speedster takes the most
spartan model in the Porsche lineup...

...and pushes it into the level of "unobtanium."
The Speedster shape and form are an extension
of the other 356A models, but more extreme.

With its low wrap-around windshield, tall shoulder...

...and longer rear deck...

...the Speedster has attitude.

Both James Dean and Steve McQueen had Speedsters.
Unique to the Carrera GT are the deletion of
the side spears and sill deco.
The bumpers do away with the bumper horns and the deco
is replaced with aluminum trim.

You can also see the front leather tie-down straps
and GT roll bar.
The GT eventually received aluminum opening panels.

And even the normal-looking wheels are specially
constructed of steel and aluminum.
As with all Por�ches, you really need to take a close look at
each model to know all the variations.
detailRows.zh:
356 A/1500 GS GT Carrera Speedster是基于保时捷产品线中
最简约的车型开发的……

又将其推向了“无法企及”的境界！
Speedster的外形沿袭了其他356A车型的设计，
但更加的极致……

低矮的环绕式挡风玻璃、高耸的轮眉……

还有更长的后部，
无不彰显其自成一派的风范！

詹姆斯·迪恩和史蒂夫·麦奎因都曾
将Speedster作为他们的座驾。
这个Carrera GT版本的独特之处在于
取消了侧面装饰条和侧裙装饰。
前保险杠取消了撞角，用铝制饰条取代了装饰件。

你还可以看到前盖的皮革固定带和后座的GT防护杆。
GT车型最终采用了铝制板材……

甚至看起来平平无奇的轮圈也是
钢铝混合材质的特殊结构。
保]��捷的车总是需要你仔细观察才能分辨出它与
普通“推杆”车型的各种差异！这一台也不例外。

detailRows.speaker: Freeman Thomas
detailRows.en:
The 1956 GS Carrera Coupe was the most powerful
and most luxurious Porsche available in its day.

This year marked the first time we saw the improved "A" model.
It was visually similar to the "pre-A,"
except it had the 15-inch wheels...

...with larger rear-wheel openings and non-rolled rocker sills.
The GS had the same sill and bumper trim as the lower
line models, but there really wasn't a visual difference...

...except for the fact that the rear sat a bit lower due to
the heavier 4-cam Carrera engine.

The interior was the same as well, except there were two
push-pull switches above the instrumentation.

This was to control the dual coils specific
to the Carrera engine.
When you opened up the rear lid, you saw the real difference between the A and pre-A.

The 4-cam Carrera engine was an artistic masterpiece!
The fan shroud and assembly were gorgeous too!=
detailRows.zh:
‘56 ‘GS’ Carrera Coupe是保时捷史上最强劲、最豪华的一款。

名称中的56代表经过大刀阔斧改进的365A新款
问世的首个年份。
在外观上，它与之前的“pre-A”车型非常相似，
唯一不同之处在于采用了新款15英寸车轮……

后轮轮拱更大，侧裙没有滚边。
由于GS车型与低端车型都采用同款侧裙和保险杠装饰，
所所以外观上并无差异……

只是因为搭载了更重的四凸轮轴“Carrera”引擎，
车尾被压得更低。

内饰也几乎一模一样，只在
仪表板上方多了两个推拉按钮，

那是用来控制“Carrera”引擎独有的两个点火线圈的。
只有当你打开后引擎盖时，才能发现真正的差别所在！

你会发现，四凸轮轴“Carrera”引擎简直是一件美妙的艺术品！
连风扇罩和总成��打造得异常精美！

detailRows.speaker: Freeman Thomas
detailRows.en:
The 2011 Audi R18 TDI LMP1 marked a return to a fixed-roof coupe
body again for the first time since the 1999 R8C.

This, to me, was when design, engineering, and motorsports
came to the perfect intersection for Audi.
Seeing these "Star Wars" coupes in the rain at night,
with wipers and headlights, running at high speed...

Man, that was exciting to watch!
I see them as advanced concepts for the road
that I can relate to.

They were truly a tour de force of technology!
detailRows.zh:
2011款Audi R18 TDI LMP1标志着自1999年推出的R8C以来，
Audi再次引入封闭式双门跑车车身。

对我来说，这款车是Audi的设计、工程学技术
和赛车运动知识的完美结合！
在漆黑雨夜中，看到这些“星球大战”风格的跑车
顶着独特的雨刷和大灯高速奔驰的身影……

令我激动万分！
我认为这台车体现出了先进的道路交通工具理念，
引发了我的共鸣。

这样的车才是站在技术巅峰的作品！

detailRows.speaker: Freeman Thomas
detailRows.en:
The goal of J Mays and his team...

...was to make this car more of a European sports car
while not losing its American pony-car heritage.

It was truly a tough undertaking!
The resulting car is the quintessential Mustang...

...which looked like it went to finishing school in Europe.
The new side DLO with rear quarter window
was initially controversial...

...because the previous Mustangs had a B-pillar separating
a scoop, window, or a clean panel.

The new DLO made the Mustang visually more sophisticated
and provided better visibility.
The front-end looked aggressive, with its thin, angled eyes
and aggressive grille!
The rear-end took the three-bar iconic taillights
to a new level.
It had a sequential blinker inspired by the '67/'68 Shelby.

And, did it ever look �ean, especially with optional big
wheels spaced-out to the edges!
detailRows.zh:
梅斯及其团队的目标……

是使这款车更贴近一辆欧洲跑车，同时不失
其美式小马车的传统。

这确实是一个艰巨的任务！
他们最终的成果是一款典型的Mustang……

但跑去欧洲的商场采购装扮了一番。
新的后侧窗设计起初引发了不少争议……

前款Mustang的B柱非常宽厚，在后侧只隔出了一个进气口、
以及一扇小窗，或者叫它一块平整的玻璃更合适。

相比之下，新侧窗使这款Mustang在视觉上更加精致，
并提供了更好的侧后方视野。
前脸部分的设计更为激进
——细长而倾斜的大灯和狰狞的进气口极具攻击性！
经典的三道杠式尾灯设计被提升到了一个新的高度……
并采用了受到'67/'68 Shel�y启发的顺序闪灯效果。

在选配了几乎占满全部轮拱的大尺寸轮圈之后，
整车的姿态近乎完美，更显卓尔不凡！

detailRows.speaker: Freeman Thomas
detailRows.en:
The Genesis Coupé was a true sports car with RWD
and a 343ps 3.8-liter V-6.
The exterior styling was inspired by its RWD proportions.

This resulted in a long dash-to-front axle, a long hood with
a short front-overhang...

...and a cabin set rearward.
The styling lines and graphics were unique, inspired
by an East Asian ink-wash painting process.
This process started with abstract black ink-brush strokes
to find the right facial and styling expressions.

The idea of the artistic process was to create a unique
character and interest.
In a way, this was an extension of the classical theme
of sketching...

...with the added bonus of allowing the brush strokes
to create unexpected graphics.
detailRows.zh:
捷尼赛思Coupe是一款真正的后驱跑车，搭载一台
输出343ps的3.8升V6引擎。
外观设计为了着重凸显后驱车的比例，

带来长轴距的前舱（从仪表盘到车头）、修长的引擎盖
和较短的前悬挂……

以及向后移置的车厢。
其造型的线条和样式均十分独特，是从东亚水墨画的
绘制过程中汲取了灵感。
在水墨绘画中，往往会用毛笔以抽象的墨色笔触
勾勒出准确的面部和造型表达。

其内核是追求独特的个性和审美趣味。
在某种程度上，它是素描这一经典画技的延伸……

并加入了以毛笔笔触带来的、意想不到的视觉效果。

detailRows.speaker: Freeman Thomas
detailRows.en:
The VW Sambabus is truly a design icon, with a design
language that’s whimsical and endearing.

It literally makes you smile.
It’s basically a functional box with rounded
corners full of character.
This "23" Window Sambabus has a fully-opening
pull-back cloth sunroof...

...windows that go round to the back corners,
and "panorama" windows on top.
Its color palette greatly adds to its visual charm.
detailRows.zh:
VW的“Sambabus”是一款真正的设计代表作，它的设计语言
充满奇思妙想，同时又惹人喜爱！

不夸张地说，看到它你就会不由自主地露出微笑！
它的车身可以用长方体盒子来概括，再加上特征鲜明
的圆润边角。
这款“23”窗的Sambabus拥有可完全打开的
后拉式布制天窗……

以及从前一直环绕延伸到后方边角的大量侧窗，
顶上还有“全景式”的一圈边窗。
而丰富的车漆色系也为它的视觉魅力增色不少！

detailRows.speaker: Freeman Thomas
detailRows.en:
The lovable Bug continues with the 1966 VW 1200 Beetle.

This version has enlarged front and rear windows.
The first-generation Pretzel's split rear window
changed in 1953 to a larger oval rear window.

In 1958, the rear window changed again
and became even larger.
With this model...

...the demand for better visibility, lighting, power, and
safety caused the three-arch silhouette to evolve again.
But the original character and charm remained.

The last production air-cooled Beetle came in 2003.
Just think, 21,529,464 units built since 1945! That’s quite
a run, and it’s still popular!<
detailRows.zh:
1966大众1200甲壳虫延续了甲壳虫的可爱风格！

这个车型加大了前后车窗。
第一代“椒盐卷饼”的分块式后窗于1953款更换为了
更大片的椭圆形后窗。

在1958款中，后窗又经历了改进，尺寸进一步增大。
而到了这个车型中……

出于更好的可视性、轻盈感、动力和安全的需求，
引擎盖3个拱的形状轮廓又一次发生了进化，
但原先的特色和魅力得到了保留。

最后一款风冷引擎的甲壳虫一直生产到2003年。
你想象一下，从1945年起到现在，这款车一共造了21529464辆！

这是多么漫长的生命周期啊。而且直到现在，
甲壳虫都还很有人气！%

detailRows.speaker: Freeman Thomas
detailRows.en:
Inspired by the Komenda Porsche 550 Le Mans Coupé...

...the RUF CTR3’s styling has lasted well, and is still being
requested by customers.

This was RUF’s first foray into building a car with its
own all-carbon-fiber body design.

It utilized a race-engineered all-aluminum mid-engine
subframe with pushrod suspension.
The front underbody is a highly modified Porsche
lightweight steel/aluminum structure.

It was engineered to meet RUF’s performance standards.
The super low cabin allows for an extremely low front, while
the rear spoiler generates speed control and downforce.
Elsewhere, the six rear vents provide a clue to the 700ps
twin-turbo Mezger-based flat-6 underneath.
detailRows.zh:
这辆如虎CTR3的灵感来源于
柯曼达保时捷550勒芒轿跑……

它的外观设计历久弥新，至今依然能够打动消费者。

这是如虎首次使用他们自己的全碳纤维
车身设计打造一辆车……

并采用了针对比赛开发的全铝合金后中置引擎
副车框和推杆式悬挂系统。
其车头的底部结构是一套经过高度改装的保时捷
轻量化钢铝制结构……

并为了满足如虎的性能需求而经过重新加工。
其超低设置的驾驶舱也使车头高度降至极低，
同时由后扰流板提供高速下的操控性和下压力。
此外，其车身后部的六个排气管也让人得以一瞥它那基于梅茨格打造的
700ps双涡轮增压水平对置六缸引擎的恐怖动力。

detailRows.speaker: Freeman Thomas
detailRows.en:
This is the car every car designer dreams of doing!
It’s gorgeous!

Its influence is, of course, the 917!
The cabin is low and sleek, with extreme cab-forward
architecture, like that of the original 917.
The windshield shape is like a visor wrapping
around the sides...

...while the front has a bit of 918 DNA.
A slightly restrained low, narrow mouth...

...and four headlamps seem to forecast the new Porsche
headlight DNA of the 919, raced at Le Mans.
The wheels are similar to the 918.

The rear spoiler is interesting, as it connects the fender
forms and has the taillamp integrated flush below.

The paint scheme is inspired by the Le-Mans-winning
"Porsche-Salzburg" 917K...

...run by the Porsche-Piech family team in Austria.
detailRows.zh:
这是一款所有汽车设计师都梦寐以求想要打造的车型！
它简直太漂亮了！

这也是理所当然的，毕竟参照的基础车型可是917！
和原版917一样，它的驾驶舱高度较低，呈流线型设计，
并采用了驾驶舱极度前置的结构。
挡风玻璃的形状更像是一副包裹住侧面的面罩……

前脸略微透露出918的血统。
其略显克制且低窄的进气口……

和四盏大灯则预言了随后在勒芒参赛的919
所引领的保时捷大灯设计理念。
它的轮毂与918类似。

其后扰流板与挡泥板直接相连，从而将尾灯顺畅地
整合在下方，显得趣味十足。

它的涂装方案灵感来源于由奥地利的保时捷·皮耶希家族
车队经营，并在勒芒取得胜利的……

“保时捷·萨尔茨堡�&917K。

detailRows.speaker: Freeman Thomas
detailRows.en:
Now, this is one aggressive Beetle!

It's a car that proves the motorsports potential
of the good ol’ bug.
Take note of its extremely low stance, wide
motorsport fenders...

...and the exhaust pipe jutting out from its front
arch!
Its large five-spoke wheels are typical of Volkswagen’s
expert design team.

And, its body is simply brimming with confidence.
Indeed, it exudes the luxury that only a top-tier
design studio can deliver.

And the bright graphics contribute nicely to the overall
look of the car.
detailRows.zh:
哇，这可真是一辆外观凶悍的Beetle啊！

它的存在证明了平日的小可爱
也具有赛场竞速的巨大潜力！
请注意它极低的车身姿态，宽大的
赛车级挡泥板……

以及顺着前轮拱突出的排气管！
它采用了大号五轮辐轮毂，这也是
Volkswagen专业设计团队的专属。

它的车身也从头到尾彰显着一股自信。
这份自信源自它所呈现出的奢华品质
——只有顶级的设计工作室能够实现。

车身上各种鲜艳显眼的几何图案更是为
整体外观锦上添花！

detailRows.sourceName: Lancer GSR Evolution VIII MR GSR '04
detailRows.speaker: Freeman Thomas
detailRows.en:
The long-named Evo VIII MR GSR is a really special machine.
A true sports sedan with rallying pedigree.
The Evo's styling is sober and restrained, but set off
by its large functional rear wing.

The sober theme is continued on the inside.
The main difference is a thick steering wheel
and high-bolstered Recaro seats.

Did you know that the name "Recaro" is short for
"Reutter Carosserie?"
This is where Porsche handmade many of its car bodies
in the 1960s.

The body manufacturing division was sold to Porsche
and "Reutter" went off to make seats under Recaro!
A small bit of trivia!!.
detailRows.zh:
拥有长串名字的翼豪陆神VIII MR GSR车型是一款非常特别
的座驾。它是一辆具有拉力赛血统的运动型轿车。
翼豪陆神的外观设计简洁而内敛，但实用的大型尾翼
为其增添了亮点。

这种简洁风格在内饰中得以延续。
主要的区别在于厚实的方向盘和
高包裹性的Recaro赛车座椅。

你知道吗？“Recaro”这个名字其实是
“Reutter Carosserie”的缩写。
在20世纪60年代，保时捷的许多车身就是
在这里手工打造的。

后来，车身制造部门被出售给了保时捷，
而“瑞特”则以“Recaro”的名义专门生产座椅！
这是个有趣的小知识！

detailRows.speaker: Freeman Thomas
detailRows.en:
The 2015 RUF RGT 4.2 is based on the Porsche 991,
with bespoke modifications to RUF specs.
Most noteworthy is the naturally-aspirated flat-6,
punched out to 4.2 litres...

And 525hp.
Visually, it is recognizable by its aluminium wheels
and wide wheel arches.
This gives it a great stance and a menacing look!
The rear ‘ducktail’ is of RUF’s own design…

And first appeared on the Rt 35 at the 2012 Geneva
Motor Show.
detailRows.zh:
2015款RUF RGT 4.2是基于原版Porsche 991，
按照RUF规格进行定制改装的车型。
最引人注目的是其自然吸气水平对置六缸引擎，
排量增大到4.2升……

输出功率高达525马力。
在外观上，它以铝合金轮毂和加宽的轮拱为醒目特征。
这造就了车身出色的姿态和极具威慑力的外观！
后部的“鸭尾”扰流板是RUF自主设计的……

它首次亮相于2012年日内瓦车展上展出的Rt 35车型。

detailRows.speaker: Freeman Thomas
detailRows.en:
The Type R is an aggressively styled 4-door
hatchback coupe.
This segment was popularized by the original VW Golf GTI.

What sets this one apart is like an action movie with lots
of special effects!
First you notice the big rear wing...

...then the aggressive front flares.
The front is emphasized by huge side nostrils
and a NACA duct on the hood!

The great stance is set up by the tires set out to the
edges and special suspension.
You'll also spot the big red Brembo brake calipers
behind the glossy black wheels.
detailRows.zh:
Type R是一款风格激进的四门掀背轿跑车。
这一细分市场最初由VW Golf GTI炒热。

这款车的特别之处在于它就像一部充满特效的动作电影！
你会首先被巨大的尾翼吸引，

然后是战斗力十足的前轮宽体。
巨大的侧裙和引擎盖上的NACA导管映衬前脸！

外突的轮胎和特殊的悬挂让其拥有出色的车身姿态。
你还会注意到闪亮黑色轮毂后的大红色
Brembo刹车卡钳。它一点也不适合那些想低调的人！

detailRows.speaker: Kim Jones
detailRows.en:
Well it seems like you really enjoy collecting cars?

I tend to collect things I love myself,
so I know exactly how you feel.

I'm the Artistic Director of Dior Men's collections.

And, I'm always thinking about new, novel things.
Recently, I came up with an idea about a new collaboration.

The initial thought came from advertisements
involving cars and Dior from the 1960s to the 1980s.

At the time, Dior had a line of perfume that sponsored races
like the Dakar Rally and the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

And I thought to myself, what if we could combine
the elegant essence of Dior with a legendary sports car?

I was sure it would result in a phenomenal sports car
that would surprise everyone!

And, I had a particular car in mind
that would be perfect for this collaboration.
It was the iconic De Tomaso Mangusta from the 1960s.

The De Tomaso Mangusta
was designed by Giugia�o during his years at Carrozzeria Ghia.

He's a genius who entered the world of car design at 17 years
of age, before becoming the chief developer at Ghia at just 27.

I've heard that Giugiaro's father was an artist.

So, I guess the styling ability of Giugiaro
also comes from the artist's lineage in him.
Now, I realized that there's a similarity between the timeless,
classic atmosphere of the Mangusta and the tone of Dior.

Therefore, I selected a slightly conservative, cream color for the
Mangusta, accented with a modest but chic stripe...
...with the “Dior” lettering on the side.
The car number 47 was derived from the year of the
first Dior collection, in 1947...
...and all these ideas came to life in the project with
Gran Turismo, resulting in this very special car.

There's also a some special magic to this Mangusta as well.

I designed a sp2cial racing outfit for the driver of this car.

The suit is yellow, a very iconic color for sports cars.
It stands out, but it's not too flamboyant.
The logo representing Dior uses the classic "CD Diamond"
taken from the same era as the car, from the 1960s and 1970s.

The shoes are from our well known "Diorizon" series.

But the upper side is changed and newly redesigned for driving.

It would make me very happy if this becomes
one of the surprises in yo6r collection!
detailRows.zh:
嗯，看来你们很喜欢收藏汽车？

我也会收藏一些自己喜欢的东西，
所以很能明白你们的感受。

我现在担任迪奥男装系列的艺术总监，

所以我一直在思考新鲜、新奇的事物。
最近，我突然想到了关于一个新合作项目的好点子。

最初的灵感是来源于迪奥在上世纪六十到八十年代间的
汽车合作广告。

当时，迪奥有条香水产品线为达喀尔拉力赛
和勒芒24小时拉力赛等比赛提供了赞助。

于是我就在心里盘算，如果把迪奥的优雅神韵
和一辆传奇跑车相结合会是怎么样的结果？

一定可以打造出一辆划时代的跑车，让所有人惊叹！

我脑海中就浮现出一辆非常适合这个合作项目的汽车。
二十世纪六十年代的标志性名车“德托马索Mangusta”。

德托马索Mangusta Ghia工作时
设计的。

他是一个天才，17岁就进入了汽车设计的世界，
仅27岁就成为了吉亚的首席开发工程师。

我听说乔治亚罗的父亲是一位画家。

所以我猜乔治亚罗的造型设计能力
也来自于他血液中流淌的艺术家基因。
我发觉Mangusta那永恒的、经典的气质
与迪奥的格调之间存在着相似之处。

因此我为它选择了一个稍有�+保守的奶油色车身，
搭配低调而又别致的暗金条纹，
然后把“迪奥”字样放在车身的侧面。
车头的数字“47”来自于迪奥品牌首秀的年份，1947年。
我的这些理念在与跑车浪漫旅合作的项目中
成为了现实，造就了这辆非常独特的汽车。

伴随这辆Mangusta而来的还有另一个特别的魔法。

我为它的驾驶者也设���了一套特别的赛车装备。

赛车服是黄色的，对于赛车而言是一个经典的颜色。
足够鲜明，但又不过分张扬。
作为代表迪奥的标志，我们选用了经典的“CD菱形纹样”，
与这辆赛车来自同一个年代——上世纪六十和七十年代。

赛车靴来自于我们知名的“Diorizon”系列，

但在踝部以上做了调整，针对车手的需求重新进行了设计。

如果这辆车能��成为你那些令人惊艳的藏品之一，
我也会感到非常满足！

detailRows.speaker: Ikuo Maeda
detailRows.en:
In many respects this ND Roadster is a product
that I put alot of effort into.
The car I started competing in races with when I was into
motorsports as a student, was the NB Roadster.

Later I would buy an NR-A version of the ND Roadster
and compete in one-make races,
but what I focused on most as the designer of the ND roadster,
was how it looks on the move.

It had to look good racing on a track, and in order
to create the base structure that would achieves this,
I kept imagining its form exiting a corner with
the load on its rear tires,while working on its design.
Today I'm competing in Japan’s Super Endurance series
as both the team manager and driver of MAZDA SPIRIT RACING.

I actually race in a Roadster with this very livery, and we're
lucky to have many other roadsters participating in this class.
Whether it be real or virtual, I hope we can all enjoy
racing on the track, as challengers with the same goals!
And I hope you'll keep up with the latest activities
of MAZDA SPIRIT RACING, too.
detailRows.zh:
我曾经为设计这辆ND Roadster
付出了极大的精力和时间。
我从学生时代起就是狂热的赛车迷，
还驾驶着NB Roadster参加过正式比赛。

再后来，我买过一辆NR-A版本的ND Roadster
去参加马自达举办的单一车种比赛。
在设计这款ND Roadster时，我最重视的一点
就是它在运动中所表现出来的模样。

也就是说，要让它在赛道上显得特别炫酷。
为了实现这个目的……
我在设计它的外观时，始终在脑海中想象
一辆重心后置的赛车出弯的模样。
目前我正在以马自达SPIRIT RACING车手以及车队经理
的身份参加日本的超级耐久系列赛。

我驾驶的其实是一辆采用同样涂装的敞篷跑车，
能与这么多同组别的其他敞篷跑车汽车竞技真是太幸运了。
不论赛道是真实还是虚拟的，
我希望大家都可以作为志同道合的挑战者，共同享受比赛的乐趣！
我也希望你可以多多关注马自达SPIRIT RACING的最新动态。

detailRows.speaker: Ikuo Maeda
detailRows.en:
The RX-VISION is a car in which I placed
my car designer life on the line.

I worked on it from the standpoint of really making
the dream sports car I have in my mind.
And one of the most important things for a sports car
is its fundamental structure.

Historic cars that are still popular and beautiful to look at
today all have exceptionally great proportions.

So the first thing we worked on for the RX-VISION
was also the structure.
A textbook FR (Front Engine Rear Drive) with a long nose,
and the ability to place proper load on the rear wheels.

In the final stages, we extended the front nose about 150mm
from the structure we had originally designed,

the part from the front doors up to the front wheel center.
In the very end we made it a slightly unbalanced proportion...

But at that moment we got a lot of traction on the rear wheels,
I thought "This will work!"

That slight unbalance is the hook. It's the secret
to making someone go "Hmm".
The other secret is the reflection of light.

If you look at the RX-VISION as you circle it, I think you'll
notice that the light's reflection moves around like a creature.
Cars are like family or friends to those who are into them.

And it's a very rare industrial product
that runs around on its own.
That makes cars have the same type of existence as animals running
around in the wild, or an athlete running on a field.

And when you think of it that way, I also want cars to be
something that looks beautiful and truly alive in nature.

And for that you need a "sense of life."
So when thinking about what is the sense of life,
that will put cars at one with nature,

we tried to express life in the car with the light's reflections
6nd their beauty on the car's body.

And those are the type of shapes
that are instilled in the RX-VISION.<next id=2600206 type=9݇
detailRows.zh:
说到RX-VISION，那可是我赌上专业设计师的身份，
倾注全部心血的作品。

我想通过它，把我脑海中理想跑车的样子变成现实。
设计跑车，最关键的就是定好基本结构。

你看那些经典车型，哪个不是比例优美？

所以我设计RX-VISION时，第一步就是确定它的结构。
我先是采用了教科书般经典的前置引擎后轮驱动
设计——就是那种前脸很长，重心偏后的布局。

然后，在定稿前的最后一刻，我又把前鼻加长了150mm。

具体来说，就是加在了从前门到前轮中心那一段。
这么一改，车身比例看起来有点不太协调……但是这样
做能让后轮抓地力更强。

当时我就想：“嘿，没准这主意不错！”

就这样，一个小小的设计巧思成了这辆车的独特之处。
RX-VISION还有另一个让人惊喜的地方——光影效果。

只要绕着车子转一圈，你就会觉得它像个有生命的东西。
对于车迷来说，汽车就跟家人朋友一样亲密。

跟一般的工业产品不同，汽车是为了奔跑而生的。
它们有点像在野外奔驰的动物，或是在赛场上飞奔的运
动员。

当我生出这个念头时，我就W��道我不仅要让RX-VISION
美，还要让它“活”起来。

为了达到这个效果，我得给它注入“生命感”。
在思考怎么才能让它看起来更自然时……

我开始实验光线在车身上的反射效果。

就这样，RX-VISION活灵活现地呈现在了大家面前！

detailRows.speaker: Ikuo Maeda
detailRows.en:
When producing the RX-VISION, I had a long running desire to
make the RX-VISION a GT3 car and compete in the Le Mans.
I'm a car designer, but I have a soft spot for motorsports.

The first movie that I spent my own allowance on to go see in a theater,
during elementary school, was about the 24 hours of Le Mans.

I still remember being really excited to see the fantastic
battles between cars like the Porsche 917 and Ferrari 512S.

It made me want to race at the Le Mans in the future,
and it also was what got me to strive for a job involving cars.
Mazda won the Le Mans,

and that event naturally connected to that scene
of the Le Mans that I dreamed of as a child.
But I want to have everyone take interest in todays motorsports scene,
not just events of the past like the 787B.

I strongly hope to add a new page to Mazda's motorsports.

In that �espect the GT3 version of the RX-VISION
was a car that I really wanted to make happen,
and I was able to do that first in Gran Turismo virtually.

This is something I created with the strong conviction,
"that this will be a real car in the future."

And I personally want to drive the Sarthe circuit in this car.
detailRows.zh:
不瞒你说，当RX-VISION还只是张图纸的时候，我就已经
在盘算着有朝一日要让它征战勒芒了。
要知道，我不光是个汽车设计师，还是个赛车迷呢。

还记得我人生第一次自掏腰包买电影票，看的就是讲
勒芒24小时耐力赛的片子。

那会儿看到保时捷917和法拉利512S在赛道上激烈
厮杀，那个兴奋劲儿，到现在我都忘不了。

就是那时候，我萌生了自己也要去勒芒的念头，也是从
那时起，我下定决心要投身汽车行业。
1991年马自达在勒芒的那次胜利……

毫无疑问又一次点燃了我年轻时的梦想。
不过，我觉得我们不能老是躺在787B的功劳簿上。

是时候该为马自达的赛车史开启一页新的篇章。

这就是为什么我铆足了劲要打造RX-VISION的GT3版本……
虽然现在这辆车只在《跑车浪漫旅》（在此感谢游戏）里
作为一辆虚拟车首次亮相。

但我坚信，总有一天，我会亲自驾驶着它……在那条

传说中的萨森赛道上驰骋！

detailRows.speaker: Ikuo Maeda
detailRows.en:
In the Japanese Super Endurance Series,
I myself race in the MAZDA3 race car.

Lots of effort went into the MAZDA3 as a production model
of course, but it was also drawn with the racing scene in mind.
In this racing modified version as well, I tried to maintain
the original shape of the MAZDA3 as much as possible.

The modification including the livery is something that doesn't
disrupt the beauty and silhouette of the car.
Another point of focus was how good it looks when running.

Like how the rear tread sticks out like
a proper Super Endurance race car.

When you're overtaken by this car, I think you'll really notice
how good it looks from the back...
...so on the track, I'd appreciate if you would let me pass!
detailRows.zh:
我跟你讲，我在日本超级耐力系列赛中可是真开过这辆
马自达3赛车哦！

马自达3本身是款普通的量产车型，不过我们设计的时候
就已经考虑到了它未来可能会上赛道。
所以在打造赛车版本的时候，我们尽量保留了原版的帅
气造型。

不光是车身轮廓线条，连车身涂装我们都精心设计，
就是想让它保持原车的美感。
当然啦，我们也得让它在赛道上看起来够劲儿。

怎么做到的？我们给它装上了更宽的后轮轴，也是超级
耐力赛车的标配。

效果太棒了，尤其是超车的时候，那叫一个帅气！
所以呢，要是哪天你在赛道上碰到我，可得乖乖让道。
然后你就知道它的超车有多帅气了！

detailRows.speaker: Ikuo Maeda
detailRows.en:
I think the MAZDA3 is one of the top 5 cars
in my career as a car designer.

The design of the MAZDA3 also trails back to the RX-VISION.
In the RX-VISION, I created a form that expresses
a sense of life in the beauty of its reflections.
And the design of the MAZDA3 is an achievement of that form
created in the RX-VISION, in the C segment.
It's one of my personal favorites, and I think its a car
that will mark its name in history.
detailRows.zh:
MAZDA3可以说是我的职业生涯中最有代表性的五款车之一。

它的设计其实和RX-VISION挺有渊源的。
我在设计RX-VISION的时候，创造了一种通过漂亮的光
影折射效果让车身“活”过来的造型。
而MAZDA3呢，就是把这种设计应用到了C级车上。
我个人很喜欢MAZDA3。我敢打包票，这款车绝对会成为
汽车设计史上的一个亮点！

detailRows.speaker: Ikuo Maeda
detailRows.en:
In a way this Atenza is my debut work. There were a lot of
obstacles, and it brings back a lot of memories.
I was appointed the general manager of the design division
in 2009, to be the leader of Mazda design,

but I was told about my new position just 2 weeks before, so
I became general manager without any time to be ready.

And the first production car that I worked on,
was this Atenza.
Givender major role and responsibility,
this was a state of emergency for me,

but it was just as much a chance as it was a crisis.

It was a time in which the design theme for the next generation of
Mazda's were being considered from almost scratch,

and I thought to make design the major
pillar of Mazda from here and now.
And actually, the development of this car had already progressed
quite a bit under the previous design manager already,

but after th�nking that we need to create the philosophy of Mazda
for the next age, and make design itself one of the pillars,

I made the decision to completely change the design
that was already in motion.

To do this it was necessary to redesign things that normally
should not be touched in terms of the development schedules.
As a result, the final design schedule for the production car
was delayed about 10 months...

And I was really scolded badly by the managing d�rector
of development at the time. A LOT.

At the time I was working on the "SHINARI" concept car
that would be the vision model for the next era,

and I translated the design theme of SHINARI to the production car
because it was a car made alongside the SHINARI.
It's a car that I personally care for a lot, I was
even still driving it until very recently.

Its been over 10 years now, but I think
its a design that doesn't feel old.

The more you work onwstandard cars, the more you understand
the power of design.

And saloons are difficult to design, because
they are the base for all cars.

I think timeless cars of an orthodox category is where
the ability of designers are truly tested.
detailRows.zh:
阿特兹可以说是我的设计生涯的开端，说起来，这个项
目真是苦乐自知，回忆满满啊。
2009年，我突然被任命为马自达设计部门的部长。

事情非常突然，我只有两周时间来适应这个新职位。

我接手后参与的第一款量产车就是阿特兹。
说实话，那会儿真是责任重大，差点儿没把我压垮。
不过，我硬是把这个危机扭转成了成功的机遇。

当时，马自达正在为下一代车型寻找新的设计主题。

我的想法是把“设计哲学”作为马自达未来发展的支柱。
老实说，前任部长在阿特兹上已经下了不少功夫。

但为了实现我的新一代设计理念……

我决定把这个已经在顺畅推进的项目推倒重来。

也就是说，一些通常在生产后期不会再改动的部分，我
们也^��重新设计。
结果就是这款量产车设计进度整整推迟了10个月左右。

这下可把上司们气得不轻——他们当时大发雷霆。

与此同时，我还在筹备一款叫“靱”的概念赛车，它将成为
马自达下一代的前瞻性参考车型。

有意思的是，因为“靱”和阿特兹的开发是同期进行，
它们俩最后用上了同一个设计主题。
说真的，阿特兹U��我来说意义非凡。事实上，直到前不
久我还在开这车呢。

虽然这款车已经面世十多年了，但它的设计仍然经得住
时间的考验。

你知道吗？你在标准车型上花的功夫越多，就越能体会
到设计的魔力。

尤其是轿车，看起来再普通不过，设计起来反而最难。

所以，要评估一位设计师的水平，关键在于他能否为正
统车型设计出经久不衰的作品。

detailRows.speaker: Ikuo Maeda
detailRows.en:
This was a car that was produced with the concept:

"if Mazda was to compete in the top category of the Le Mans,
what would be a great design."

The LM55 name stands for "Car Number 55 of Le Mans,"
and is taken from the legendary racing car of Mazda.
I remember that we did a full aerodynamic simulation, and really
went through a thorough development process for this car.

We had engineers knowledgeable about racing cars
also become involved in the development.

There is a full scale model as well, and its on display
in the Mazda Museum.
And actually, my name is on the car as the driver.

It is from the wish that if this car appears, and it runs
on the Le Mans, that I want to be the driver.
The Le Mans hyper car class regulations allow
a fair amount of design freedom...

and if we make a car like this and compete,
that would be a huge opport�nity!
detailRows.zh:
这辆车回答了这样一个问题：“马自达要怎样设计，
才能在勒芒顶级组别的赛事中一争高下？”

LM55这个名字中，“LM”是“勒芒”的缩写，
“55”则是“55号赛车”，是向马自达的一位传奇赛车手致敬。
设计这辆车的时候，我记得我们进行了多项测试，
还包括全面的空气动力学模拟。

而且还特意请来了对赛车有深入了解的工程师支援……

我们甚至还做了个1:1的实物模型，现在就摆在
马自达博物馆里呢。
哦对了，你可能会发现车手名单里有我的名字。为什么？

因为要是有朝一日它真的能征战勒芒，我想亲自开上它！
勒芒超级跑车组别的规则给了设计师很大的发挥空间……

所以，要是我们真能造出这样一辆车去参赛，嘿，说不
定真能捧回^��军奖杯呢！

detailRows.speaker: Ikuo Maeda
detailRows.en:
In my mid 20's I was assigned to a position in the US,
and the FD was a car from that time.

It was when Matano-san was in the US studio, and the clay model
for this car was being made in the design studio.

It isn't a car that I worked on myself, but I remember
thinking that the shape of this car is really great.
The greatness of this car is in the relationship
between the tires and the body.

The body is thin vertically, and the tires have a sense of presence,
and it is a honed 3 dimensional shape with no excess anywhere.

That's why this car still doesn't look old.
Its beautiful.
The original idea came from a designer named Wu-Huang Chin.

He draws surfaces like this just with a marker. He's
a design genius who is really good at drawing.
I think you could say that the FD and NA Roadster of this era
are at the pinnacle of the Mazda design in Mazda history.

Their ability to work 3 dimensional shapes at the time
was truly world class

and this is a product from the time when the foundations of
Mazda design was formed.
detailRows.zh:
说起这款FD，那可得追溯到我20多岁的时候了，那会儿
我还在美国工作呢。

那时俣野努先生也在美国工作室任职，这辆车的黏土模
型就是在那儿做的。

虽然不是我个人参与设计的，但我记得当时就觉得这辆
车的造型很独到。
这车最棒的地方就是轮胎和车身的比例关系。

车身压低变薄，让轮胎显得特别醒目，整体看上去给人
一种精雕细琢的感觉，一点儿多余的东西都没有。

正是这种设计，让它成为了经典。美，真的太美了。
这车最初的创意图来自一位叫秦无荒的设计师。

这位老兄可是个设计天才，画功了得。你敢信吗？
他就用一支马克笔就把这车给设计出来了。
要我说，这个年代的FD和NA Roadster绝对是马自达
历史上最杰出的两个设�。

当时马自达处理三维形状的能力确实是世界一流的。

正好也赶上了马自达的设计理念刚开始成型的时候。

detailRows.speaker: Ikuo Maeda
detailRows.en:
This is a car for which I was the Chief designer.
I also owned this RX-8 for quite a while.
Actually my children were born in the year
that the RX-8 was announced.

They were twin boys, but in our house it was already decided
from the very beginning that our family car would be an RX-8.

The RX-8 was perfect for raising twins.
One reason is that the RX-8 is a 4 door, but you can't
open the rear
doors without opening the front doors.

So even when they were at a rambunctious age, I could drive
without worrying about them accidentally opening the doors
To make a silhouette that looks like a sports car with 4 doors
and with proper space for 4 people,

is actually very difficult.

There's not many cars in the world that have accomplished this.

It would be great to design something again
with this package and engine one day.
There was a Mazda Fan Festa event the other day,
at a circuit in Okayama.

There were a lot of RX-8 owners there. I really appreciate the
fact that they are taking great care of these cars even today.
detailRows.zh:
说起这款RX-8，我可是它的首席设计师。不仅如此，
我自己也有一辆RX-8，开了相当长一段时间。
实际上，我家的双胞胎恰好就出生在RX-8发布的那一年。

我生的是一对男孩，但在他们出生之前，我就打定主意
要把RX-8作为家里的家用车。

RX-8简直就是为带双胞胎量身定做的。
虽然它是一辆四门车的，但有个特别之处：前门得先打
开，后门才能开。

这可就省心了，我再也不用担心那两个调皮蛋在我开车
时不小心把门拉开了。
说实话，要设计一辆既有跑车范儿，还能舒舒服服坐四
个人的四门车……

不是件容易事。

能做到这一点的车真不多。

有朝一日要是我能再设计一款这种配置和引擎的车型
就好了。
前几天，我�'�冈山参加了个马自达车迷聚会……

我看到好多人都是开着RX-8来的。这么多年过去了，这
款车还是很有人气，真令人开心。

detailRows.speaker: Ikuo Maeda
detailRows.en:
So I was the Chief Designer for the Demio before this model,
and have a lot of memories about the car.
This model was not designed as a single car but as a series.

The three models, the Atenza, Axela, and the Demio
were designed simultaneously.
And actually I love small cars like the Demio.

I especially love Italian compact cars like the Autobianchi
and the Alfa Romeo Alfasud,

and I personally owned an old British Mini in the past.
So when I first found out that I would be designing
the Demio I was really happy about it!
detailRows.zh:
哦，没错，说到这个车型，我可是前一代DEMIO的
首席设计师呢。
不过，这次我们可不是单独设计一款车，而是一口气
设计了一整个系列。

ATENZA、AXELA和DEMIO这三款车，我们是同期设计，
同时进行，一气呵成！
说实话，我其实特别喜欢DEMIO这种小巧玲珑的车。

尤其是意大利的那些紧凑小车，比如Autobianchi和
Alfa Romeo Alfasud。

我还真有过一辆老款的英国Mini呢。
所以你能想象到，当我听说要我来设计DEMIO的时候，
我有多高兴！

detailRows.speaker: Stella
detailRows.en:
There's a lot to love about the Hyundai IONIQ 6 N.

But what I love most of all is its streamlined design.
In a fascinating nod to automotive history...

Its aerodynamic form mirrors the legendary
design trends...

That defined the industry throughout the 1930s and '40s.
Of course, bearing the iconic 'N' badge
means its performance is beyond question.
Capable of effortlessly pumping out 600 horsepower,
this is one electric sports car that doesn't disappoint![
detailRows.zh:
Hyundai IONIQ 6 N一直广受车迷的青睐。

但我最喜欢的还是它流线型的设计。
它的设计可以说是对汽车发展史的精彩致敬……

其空气动力学造型反映了二十世纪30年代到40年代……

定义整个汽车行业的那股传奇潮流。
当然还有那标志性的“N”字品牌标识
代表了它毋庸质疑的性能。
这款电动跑车能轻松输出600马力，绝对不会让你失望！

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
The Toyota Mark II is widely regarded as one of Japan’s
most iconic luxury sedans.

Produced from 1968 to 2004, it enjoyed a remarkable
36-year run spanning nine generations.
The original 1968 model was known
as the Corona Mark II.

The name suggested a larger, more luxurious
version of Toyota’s popular Corona sedan.

When the fifth-generation model arrived in 1984, the Corona
name was dropped in favor of Toyota Mark II.
This particular car is an eighth-generation Mark II.

More specifically, it is the highly sought-after Tourer V.
Under the hood is Toyota’s legendary turbocharged
1JZ-GTE inline-6.

What sets the Tourer V apart is it combines the refinement
of a luxury sedan with high performance.
detailRows.zh:
丰田Mark II作为日本最经典的豪华轿车之一，可谓久负盛名。

从1968年到2004年，这款车的生产持续了足足36年，
期间一共迭代了九代。
1968年生产的初版车型
被命名为“Corona Mark II”。

“Mark II”代表它是丰田的
日常代步轿车车型Corona的豪华版。

在该系列于1984年发布第5代车型时，
其名称不再包含“Corona”标识，而是直接命名为“丰田Mark II”。
这里的这台是第8代的Mark II。

也就是车迷圈子中炙手可热、一车难求的Tourer V。
它所搭载的，正是丰田大名鼎鼎的
1JZ-GTE直列6缸涡轮增压引擎。

这款车的独特之处，便是将精致的豪华车设计
与生猛的动力进行了无缝的融合。

detailRows.speaker: Jeremy
detailRows.en:
The Mark II, Chaser and Cresta were known as
the three brothers of Toyota’s luxury-sedan lineup.

This sixth-generation Chaser earned particular fame
through its success in Japanese touring-car racing...
...most notably during the 1998 Japanese Touring Car
Championship.

By then, Honda and Nissan had withdrawn their factory teams
from the once fiercely contested series.

Although the 1998 season largely became
an all-Toyota affair...
Masanori Sekiya drove the ESSO TOM’S Chaser
to six victories in 11 races.

And he claimed the drivers’ championship.
The JTCC came to an end following
the 1998 season.

That made the Chaser’s championship victory
a fitting conclusion to an important era.
detailRows.zh:
“Mark II”、“Chaser”和“Cresta”是丰田旗下
豪华轿车产品阵容的三兄弟。

这款第6代Chaser因其在日本房车赛中的傲人成绩而独负盛名……
特别是它在1998年日本房车锦标赛中的惊艳表现。

此前的一年，对手本田和日产
同时率旗下厂队退出了这一传奇赛事。

虽然这使得1998年赛季几乎变成了丰田的单一车种系列赛……
但关谷正德驾驶ESSO TOM'S Chaser发挥出色，
赢得了11场比赛中的6场……

并拿下了冠军。
全日本房车锦标赛组别的比赛正是在那个1998年赛季宣告终止。

因此，第6代Chaser获得的历史性胜利就更显得弥足珍贵。

detailRows.speaker: Chris
detailRows.en:
The granddaddy of lightweight sports cars,
the Seven is a legend among legends.
Its story began in 1957, when the car was
introduced by British automaker Lotus.

Lotus ended production in 1972, but the story did not end there.
Caterham acquired the rights the following year and
continues to build the Seven today.
This Superlight R500 combines a highly tuned engine
wwith a featherweight 500kg body.

Its acceleration feels almost instantaneous, demanding
complete concentration from the driver.

The engine delivers a hard-edged note that seems
to resonate through the entire car.
For anyone seeking the pure thrill of the racetrack,
few cars can match the Superlight R500.
detailRows.zh:
“Seven”作为所有轻量级跑车的鼻祖，
堪称传奇中的传奇。
这一系列的根源最早可以追溯到1957年，
由英国汽车制造商莲花打造。

虽然莲花在1972年停产了“Seven”系列车型……
但凯特汉姆在次年就接过了生产权，并一直生产到现在。
这辆Superlight R500在轻如羽毛的500kg车身中，

搭载了一台精心调校的强大引擎。

其油门几乎是瞬时响应，因此驾驶时可千万别分神。

它那高昂的引擎轰鸣声，能让你从头到脚都感到震颤。
毫无疑问，对于追求赛道刺激感的车迷来说，
这款车就是他们的终极目标。

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Oh, it refers to a truncated tail, or rear.
What we call a "Kamm Tail" in English.
The Kamm Tail is named after the German aerodynamicist
Wunibald Kamm, who theorized the design in the 1930s.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
哦，那我解释下，它指的是尾部被截短。
在英语中通常被称为“断尾”。
这一术语源自于德国空气动力学家乌尼巴尔·卡姆，
他在上世纪30年代提出了这种设计理念。!
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Sarah

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
That’s right, it refers to a truncated tail, or rear.
What we call a "Kamm Tail" in English.
The Kamm Tail is named after the German aerodynamicist
Wunibald Kamm, who theorized the design in the 1930s.q
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
没错，它指的是尾部被截短。
在英语中通常被称为“断尾”。
这一术语源自于德国空气动力学家乌尼巴尔·卡姆，
他在上世纪30年代提出了这种设计理念。E
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Sarah

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
So this is the Yangwang U9, the luxury EV from BYD Auto.
The brand’s first supercar, it delivers an
impressive 1,300 hp as standard.
Take a look at that rear wing—it looks like it came 
straight off a race car.
With four independent motors powering each wheel,
it’s built for cornering precision.
Its advanced active suspension is packed with
cutting-edge technology.
A glimpse of the future, the U9 is as exciting
as it is innovative.o
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
眼前这台车，就是来自比亚迪的豪华电动汽车
——仰望U9。
作为这家中国车企推出的首款超跑，
它标配高达1300hp的澎湃动力。
瞧瞧那个尾翼，简直就是赛车上原装移植过来的！
四台独立电机各自驱动一个车轮，
赋予了它极为出色的过弯能力。
而那套独特的主动式悬挂系统，
更是塞满了各种前沿技术。
这辆展现未来趋势的超级跑车仰望U9，
光是谈论参数规格，就足以令人心潮澎湃！
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Stella

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The long and storied history of Japanese kei cars
has seen many sporty versions of the genre.
And the Honda Beat stood out because 
it was mid-engine and a convertible!
While the NSX may be Honda’s original
mid-engine sports car...
...the Beat boasts the same front/rear
weight distribution.
No one ever imagined a kei car with a
centrally located engine and an open body...
...that is, until Honda created the Beat!
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
在日式轻型车漫长而丰富的历史上，
出现过许多这种小型跑车。
这款本田Beat因为采用敞篷设计而显得独树一帜！
本田Beat采用了与本田旗下设计出众的中置跑车NSX
近似的配重平衡，
并且在中置布局上安装了一款开放式单体车壳车身……
这也使它成为了世界上第一款采用这种设计的车型！
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Stella

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The Urus was the first SUV designed by Lamborghini.
Of course, Lamborghini is a name normally associated
with supercars, like the Countach.
But the first car it built after being founded in 1963...
...was a 2-door grand tourer that offered speed, comfort,
and class.
It was called the 350 GT, a large coupe with a V-12 engine
mounted up front.
Since the 1970s, Lamborghini has built many elegant GT
and 4-door sedan concepts, although they were not for sale.
This means that Lamborghini never forgot about its GT roots!
And the Urus was proof of that.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh: Urus是兰博基尼设计的第一款SUV。 如今，人们通常会将兰博基尼与各种超级跑车 联系在一起，如Countach…… 不过在1963年创立之初，它打造的第一款车…… 是一款强调速度、舒适性和档次的双门豪华旅行车。 它就是采用前置V12引擎的大型双门跑车——350 GT。 自从1970年代起，兰博基尼曾设计了多款优雅的豪华旅行车 和4门概念轿车，但从未正式发售。 看来兰博基尼从未忘记自己起步于豪华旅行车的根源！ 这款Urus就是确凿的证明！
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Stella

legacyUnmatchedReview.en: The Mazda RX-7 stands among the most celebrated rotary-engine sports cars ever built. This is the third-generation model from 1991, also known as the "FD." It notably carried the name and emblem of Mazda’s former luxury division, ɛ̃fini. The FD RX-7 is a lightweight yet potent machine. Press the accelerator and you immediately feel the smooth, surging power of its rotary engine. Its low, wide stance becomes unmistakable the moment you sit behind the wheel. From the outside, it remains a thing of beauty, and a legend in the story of Mazda performance.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
马自达RX-7是转子引擎跑车的代名词。
眼前这款是1991年推出的第三代车型，代号是“FD”。
其车名与徽标源自马自达旗下的前豪华车部门——
“ɛ̃fini”，可谓声名显赫。
尽管FD RX-7身轻如燕，动力却相当澎湃。
当你深踩油门，转子引擎那源源不绝的强劲动力
便会瞬间涌现。
而一旦坐进驾驶舱，其低趴、宽体的战斗姿态更是展露无遗。
从旁观赏，它堪称一件工业艺术品，
更是马自达品牌史上的一段不朽传奇。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Stella

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Along with the German Beetle and the British Mini,
this Italian FIAT 500…
...is one of the most iconic European small cars in history.
It may be the smallest of its rivals...
...but it can seat four passengers, and its feisty little engine
is capable of thrilling speeds.
Its splendid exterior is owing to the handiwork of famed
FIAT engineer Dante Giacosa. 
He also penned the underlying design.
Giacosa created many great cars for FIAT, and I'm sure
you'll come across them in time!
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
与德国的甲壳虫和英国的MINI一样，
这辆意大利的菲亚特500……
是欧洲历史上最具代表性的紧凑型车之一。
和其竞争对手相比，它可能是体型最小的……
但它可以容纳四名乘客，
而且其强劲的小引擎能够达到惊人的速度。
它华丽的外观由著名的菲亚特工程师
但特·吉奥科萨亲手打造，
他还包揽了车辆的内饰设计。
吉奥科萨为菲亚特创造了许多台伟大的汽车，
你会逐渐发现这些瑰宝的。$
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Stella

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Hans Mezger was Porsche's legendary engineer.
He's responsible for the 911's traditional air-cooled
engines, as well as race engines for F1 and Le Mans.
Although 911 engines became water-cooled starting with
the 996...
...the engines for the GT2, GT3 and Turbo
were still rooted in designs by Mezger.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
汉斯·梅茨格是保时捷的传奇工程师！
他负责设计了911的风冷引擎，
以及F1和勒芒赛事用的赛车引擎。
尽管自996之后，911的引擎都换成了水冷……
但梅茨格的设计理念依然根植于GT2，GT3以及911 Turbo之中。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Sarah

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
That's correct! It's an engine created by Porsche's
legendary engineer Hans Mezger!
He's responsible for the 911's traditional air-cooled
engines, as well as race engines for F1 and Le Mans.
Although 911 engines became water-cooled starting with
the 996...
...the engines for the GT2, GT3 and Turbo
were still rooted in designs by Mezger.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
没错！这款引擎由保时捷的传奇工程师汉斯·梅茨格打造！
他负责设计了911的风冷引擎，
以及F1和勒芒赛事用的赛车引擎。
尽管自996之后，911的引擎都换成了水冷……
但梅茨格的设计理念依然根植于GT2，GT3以及911 Turbo之中。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Sarah

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Did you know that the Kangoo was originally designed
as a commercial vehicle?
With its generous cargo space, this is a machine that, for many,
became a trusted co-worker.
But not all Kangoos were built for hard labor.
Some serve as passenger cars, offering a welcome blend of style
and comfort, and they’re every bit as popular.
Renault, after all, has a long tradition of crafting
iconic utility vehicles.
Among them was a commercial version of the Renault 4
from the 1960s.
Another was the Express, derived from
the second-generation Renault 5.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
你知道吗？Kangoo最初其实是
按商用车来设计的。
凭借宽敞的载物空间，对很多人来说，
它简直堪称得力的工作伙伴！
不过，并非所有Kangoo都是为了干活而生的。
也有一部分乘用车版本具备时尚外观
和舒适性能，人气也非常高。
多年来，雷诺推出了不少大名鼎鼎
的“工作用车”车型。
其中就包括1960年代雷诺4的商用版本。
还有一款是Express，它是基于第二代雷诺5打造的！
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Stella

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Oh great! It's a car that runs on two power sources: 
a gasoline engine and an electric motor.
Electric motors are great for accelerating, 
and they don't burn fuel.
By balancing engine and motor power, hybrid cars offer
a very efficient driving experience.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
太棒了！这是一种靠两种动力源运行的汽车——
燃烧燃料的引擎和电机。
电机的加速能力很强，并且可以实现精确控制。
通过平衡引擎和电机输出的动力，混合动力汽车可以
提供非常高效的驾驶体验。x
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Stella

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The Toyota Prius is arguably the most popular Japanese
hybrid car.
And when it comes to subcompacts, the most popular
could well be the Toyota Aqua.
Outside of Japan, the Aqua is marketed as the "Prius C."
But perhaps I'm getting ahead of myself.
Are you familiar with the term "hybrid car?"
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
丰田普锐斯是日本最著名的混合动力汽车。
而如果我们再把范围缩小到紧凑型汽车的范畴，
那最著名的要属丰田致享了。
在日本以外，致享被称为“普锐斯C”。
但是等等——也许我忽略了一点。
你熟悉“混合动力汽车”这个概念吗？
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Stella

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Well, it's a car that runs on two power sources: 
a gasoline engine and an electric motor.
Electric motors are great for accelerating, 
and they don't burn fuel.
By balancing engine and motor power, hybrid cars offer
a very efficient driving experience.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
好吧，它是一种靠两种动力源运行的汽车——
燃烧燃料的引擎和电机。
电机的加速能力很强，并且可以实现精确控制。
通过平衡引擎和电机输出的动力，混合动力汽车可以
提供非常高效的驾驶体验。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Stella

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
With its frog-eyed look and compact body, this first-generation
Renault Twingo is instantly charming.
Surprisingly spacious inside, its seats recline 
fully flat.
Do you know how it got its quirky name?
It’s a blend of three dance styles—the twist, swing, 
and tango.
The Twingo also saw limited-edition models created
with fashion brands.
This 1993 first-generation model is now a rare prize 
for collectors.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
蛙眼大灯和小巧的车身，第一代Twingo就是那么可爱！
它的内部空间出乎意料的宽裕，
座位甚至可以做到完全放平。
对了，你知道这个奇奇怪怪的名字是怎么来的吗？
它其实是三种舞蹈名称的变化组合——扭扭舞、摇摆舞与探戈。
Twingo还曾与多个时尚品牌联名推出限量特别版。
这款1993年的初代车型，
如今早已成为收藏家们竞相追捧的珍品！
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Stella

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Renault boasts a rich and storied legacy that
stretches back to the 19th century.
Introduced in 1961, this Renault 4—referred to as “the Quatrelle”
by the French—holds a cherished place in that heritage.
After all, it was the first Renault to 
feature front-wheel drive.
For a company that had built its reputation on 
front-engine, rear-wheel-drive machines...
...this marked a significant �eparture with a sizable interior
and greater ease of operation.
Thankfully, the Quatrelle was a big success!
This bestseller remained in production for more than 30 years
and amassed g�obal sales of more than 8 million units!�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
雷诺拥有悠久且丰富的历史，
可以追溯到上上个世纪。
这款于1961年推出的雷诺4，被法国人亲切地称之为
“四翼”，在这段历史中占据着举足轻重的地位。
要知道，它是第一款采用前轮驱动技术的雷诺汽车。
对于雷诺这样一家以
前置发动机、后轮驱动布局车型而闻名的公司而言……
这确实是一个重�:�转变，但这种变更带来了更大的空间
和更出色的操控性能。
值得庆幸的是，四翼取得了巨大的成功！
作为一款畅销车型，它的生产周期超过了30年，
全球销量突破了800万辆！�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Stella

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
It's where the rear of the body appears to abruptly cut off.
Much like streamline designs, they're known to have
excellent aerodynamics.
Dr. Wunibald Kamm, the person who came up with this, was a
professor at the University of Stuttgart in the 1930s.
Therein lies the reason why this particular design is called
the "Kamm Tail." 
We also refer to it as "Coda Tronca" in Italian.K
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
采用这种设计的汽车后部就像被整齐地切掉一块。
卡姆式与流线型车身设计很接近，而且都以
优秀的空气动力学效应闻名。
这一设计是由斯图加特大学的乌尼巴尔·卡姆博士
于上世纪30年代提出的，
随即以设计者的名字冠名。
在意大利语中，我们也把它叫作“断尾”。$
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Sarah

Yes! It's a design where the rear of the body appears to
abruptly cut off. 
Much like streamline designs, they're known to have
excellent aerodynamics.
Dr. Wunibald Kamm, the person who came up with this, was a

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
It looks like a really compact supercar. 
It’s sleek and looks really cool.
So, the engine is in the back? It’s a two-seater and
pretty tight inside.
Wow, but it has a decent-sized trunk—not bad!e
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这款车一眼看上去就是辆紧凑版超跑。
流线型的车身非常的酷。
所以发动机放在后面？这是部两座车，里面很紧凑。
哇喔，但是后备箱还是挺大的，不错！
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Stella

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The tuned inline-6 was much more powerful
than its rivals in its day.
And the car was quite simply sensual to drive.
This is the quintessential icon of Aston Martin, and of course,
the price is going nowhere but up!>
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
经过调校后的直列6缸发动机比当时的所有对手都要更强。
这辆车开起来也很爽。
这辆车是阿斯顿·马丁的典型代表作，当然价格也是一
路水涨船高！Q
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Chris

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This is an icon of British sports cars in the 1960s.
It was an evolution model where they took the highly 
regarded DB4 and raised its performance.
And Touring was the Carrozzeria who did the body for this car.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这是二十世纪六十年代标志性的英国跑车。
在备受推崇的DB4跑车基础上强化了性能。
这辆车的车身是由Carrozzeria Touring打造的。E
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Chris

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Ah yes, the second-generation Renault Captur.
The C-shaped motif in the front and rear lights...
...is a signature element of Renault design.
Not only does this car looks sharp, it drives with confidence.
It’s easy to see why it became a bestselling compact SUV...
...across the European market.
The original Captur outsold its compact SUV rivals in European
markets year after year.
And this second-generation model, introduced in 2019,
proved just as popular.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
没错，这正是第二代雷诺Captur。
其前后灯组采用的C形设计元素……
乃是雷诺品牌的标志性语言。
它不仅颜值出众，驾控感受同样可圈可点。
无怪乎它能成为欧洲市场最畅销的紧凑型跨界运动型多用途汽车。
初代Captur的年销量便已傲视同级，
而这台于2019年推出的第二代车型，
其热度更是丝毫未减！
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Stella

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This is a famous car—I know this one!
I always think it’s so cute when I see one.
And I love how it looks when the headlights pop open!
There are lots of Mazda Roadster fans all around the world, right?
That’s another great thing about this car.-
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这是一款很有名的汽车，我认识的！
我一直觉得这辆车非常的可爱
……而且我还喜欢它的大灯翻起来的样子！
马自达Roadster在全世界有很多粉丝对不对？
这是这款车另一个很酷的地方。[
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Stella

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Oh, I’ve seen this car before in a "Fast & Furious" film.
It’s the Toyota Supra.
As the ancestor of the GR Supra, it has a special
place in Toyota’s sports-car history.
And there’s something really neat about
its emblem, too.
It was actually inspired by the art of
Japanese calligraphy.|
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
啊，我以前见过这款车，是在《速度与激情》电影里。
这是一辆丰田Supra啊。
它是GR Supra的始祖，在丰田的跑车历史上
拥有非常特殊的地位。
而且它的车标设计也非常简洁。
这个设计的灵感好像是来源于日本的书法！
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Stella

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
I’ve seen this car in “The Fast and the Furious”!
It’s the Toyota Supra, right?
The “Supra” lettering looks like it was written with a Japanese brush.
Am I right? I thought so!
So, it really is styled after Japanese calligraphy.8
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
我在《速度与激情》里见过这款车！
这是丰田Supra，对不对？字母Supra就像是用日本的毛笔写的。
我说对了？我就说嘛。他们写得真的是日本书法。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Stella

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
A GT3 is basically like a race car, right?
Or at least just as fast? That's what I heard.
It looks like any other Porsche at first glance, but people
who know can tell the difference, right?
It’s not flashy, but it drives like a true race car.
That’s seriously cool.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
GT3其实是一辆赛车，是不是？还是说和赛车一样快？
我好像听说过它的。
在我看来这就像别的保时捷一样……
懂车的人才能分辨出来，是不是？
没有那么拉风，但开起来像真的赛车一样，非常酷！
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Stella

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The Peugeot 205 is fondly remembered as a 
best-selling compact car.
A perennial favorite, it enjoyed a 15-year production run
from 1983 to 1998...
...selling more than five million units, becoming the most
successful model in Peugeot’s history.
This GTI hot hatch is powered by a spirited engine and
delivers an exhilarating driving experience.
It shares its lineage with the iconic Turbo 16—a legendary
Group B rally homologation special.{
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
标致205作为一款畅销紧凑型车而被人们铭记。
从1983投产到1998年的15年间，这款车持续常青，
全球销量更是突破500万台，创下标致的销售记录。
这台GTI小钢炮不仅动力澎湃，
更拥有行云流水般的操控体验。
它与为B组拉力赛而生的传奇认证车型Turbo 16
更是同宗同源。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Stella

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The 296 GTB is one of Ferrari’s most iconic GT3 racers.
Its name is derived directly from the numbers associated
with its engine.
Specifically, it features a 2.9-liter displacement
and 6 cylinders.
Combine the two and you get “296."
I’ve heard that Ferrari used a similar naming convention
for several models between 1970 and 1990.
I can’t say exactly how many, but I certainly plan to find out!G
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
296 GTB是法拉利最具标志性的GT3赛车。
其命名取自引擎的核心参数。
具体而言，该车搭载2.9升排量的6缸引擎。
两者结合便构成了“296”的命名！
我听说，在1970至1990年间，法拉利
还以类似的方式命名了其他车型。
具体数量我一时说不上来，但我一定会查个明白！
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Stella

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
There’s plenty to admire about the Hyundai IONIQ 6 N.
But what impresses me most is its streamlined design.
Its sleek profile offers a fascinating nod
to automotive history...
Echoing the aerodynamic forms that helped shape
car design during the 1930s and ’40s.
Of course, the presence of Hyundai’s N badge means
serious performance is part of the package.
With more than 600 horsepower on tap, this is
one electric sports sedan that delivers!t
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
现代艾尼氪6 N一直广受车迷的青睐。
但我最喜欢的还是它流线型的设计。
它的设计可以说是对汽车发展史的精彩致敬……
其空气动力学造型反映了二十世纪30年代到40年代……
定义整个汽车行业的那股传奇潮流。
当然还有那标志性的“N”字品牌标识
代表了它毋庸质疑的性能。
这款电动跑车能轻松输出600马力，绝对不会让你失望！
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Stella

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
When I hear the name Citroën, the first thing that comes
to mind is this BX.
Who could forget those straight lines, that boxy shape?
Such a unique-looking car could only come from the Italian
design house Bertone!
From the Break station wagon to the sports-car version,
it was also a car rich in variation.
Launched in 1982, it proved to be a lasting success,
staying in production for over a decade.
All told, around 2.3 million units were produced
across the entire lineup!R
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
一听到雪铁龙，我首先想到的就是这款BX。
有谁会不记得它那笔直的线条和方方正正的造型呢？
而拥有如此独特外观的汽车，毫无疑问
只会出自意大利设计公司博通之手！
从Break旅行车到跑车，这款车的衍生车型十分丰富。
1982年问世的BX堪称车坛常青树，生产周期
横跨十余载……
全系产量约达230万台！
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Stella

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Did you know that in Europe, they have an annual contest
for the world’s most beautiful car?
Well, the Mazda RX-Vision took home the "Most Beautiful
Concept Car" award at this contest in 2016.
The event draws crowds of car enthusiasts from all over
the world to pick the most beautiful cars of the year.
The RX-Vision was the first car by an Asian manufacturer
to win this award.
Penned by Ikuo Maeda, it was a car that left its mark on not
only Mazda but Japanese sports-car design in general.j
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
你知道吗？在欧洲，每年都会举办一场评选
全球最美汽车的比赛。
2016年，马自达RX-VISION凭借其卓越设计夺得了
“最美概念赛车”的殊荣。
这项赛事汇聚了来自世界各地的汽车专家，他们负责
从众多参赛车辆中评选出年度最具魅力的汽车。
RX-VISION是赢得该奖项的汽车中，首款由亚洲制造商制造的汽车。
设计师前田育男倾注心血的成果不仅在马自达的历史上
留下了深刻印记，同时也对日本跑车设计产生了深远影响。+
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Stella

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
A viper is a type of poisonous snake, right?
It suits the image of the car.
Although I think the front end looks a bit cute in its own way.
But when you sit in the driver’s seat, it’s hard to judge
where the front of the car ends.
I suppose that’s because the engine is so large.-
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
知道吗，Viper这个词其实是一种毒蛇的名字？用来
形容这款车倒是很贴切。
尽管我觉得这款车的前脸看上去还挺可爱的。
可是当你坐进驾驶室里的时候绝对会大吃一惊，因为你
很难看到这辆车的车头究竟在哪里……
我猜这是因为它的引擎实在太大了！e
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Stella

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Audi made its Le Mans debut in 1999.
Up to 2016, it competed in the LMP1 class,
where it performed exceedingly well. 
In fact, it had podium finishes for eighteen
consecutive years!
But in its final race, Audi's R18 was stuck in 4th place 
for most of the race.
People feared that Audi would finish out of the top three,
breaking its long streak of po�ium finishes
But with ten minutes to go, the race leader, Toyota,
experienced a mechanical problem.
This allowed the R18 to move into 3rd place and establish 
its record of 18 consecutive podium finishes!
Ultimately, the streak came to an end when Audi announced
its withdrawal from Le Mans the following year.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
奥迪在1999年首次亮相勒芒。
一直到2016年，奥迪在勒芒原型车1级级别的比赛中表现得非常出色。
事实上，奥迪已经连续18年登上领奖台了！
但就在去年，R18在比赛终段时仍然是第四名。
大家都觉得奥迪今年登台无望了。
然而，距离比赛结束还有10分钟时，领头的�.田出现了机械故障！
这让R18挤进了第三位，站上了领奖台，
并达成了连续18年登上领奖台的记录。
最终，由于奥迪宣布从那年的勒芒赛事中退出，
他们的连胜纪录�v就此终结。j
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
I know this Civic very well!
It's the car known as the "Sports Civic" from the 1990s
—the fifth-generation "EG" model to be precise.
The "Sports" moniker alone should tell you that it’s fast,
but its engine design and sound are second to none.
You often see these cars tuned in all manner of ways.
What do I like best about tuning a Sports Civic, you ask?
The engine swaps, of course!
Fo� example, a Honda K-engine with a large displacement
will give you great sound, speed, and power.
But my favorite would have to be the Type R
B-engine.
It might not offer as much power as the K-engine,
but its ro�r is simply unforgettable!�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
我对这种类型的思域非常熟悉！

The man responsible for designing the MP4/4 was genius
race-car designer Gordon Murray.
In addition to having a low center of gravity, the McLaren
MP4/4 was equipped with Honda's 1.5-li�er RA168E engine.
This turbocharged engine normally produced at 685 horsepower,
but it could be boosted to a maximum 1500 horsepower!
Apparently, the car had trouble with fuel economy, 
but Honda’s brilliant engineers found a way to deal with that.
Indeed, they managed to produce the best F1 engine

McLaren’s F1 results for the 1988 season were nothing short
of astounding.
To start, they won 15 of 16 races that year!
They al�o claimed 15 pole positions, ten 1-2 finishes,

It was such a glorious win Soichiro Honda supposedly

This is the car that kick-started Honda’s near 60 years

That year happened to be the last one in which F1 machines

And let me tell you, the engine that powered this RA272

It was a V-12 with  of displacement and capable of

Surprisingly, the displacement per cylinder was a mere
, something that reflected Honda's motorcycle engines.
What’s more, weighing in at , this super compact
engine was mounted horizontally amidships!
Have you ever heard of such a thing being done
on a Formula 1 car?
But if you give it some thou�ht, you’ll see that
it actually made a lot of sense.
By mounting an engine on its side, you can shorten
the wheelbase and put less stress on the gearbox.
Compact and easy to handle, Honda’s early attempt
at an F1 machine was an amazing display of engineering.
The track on which the Mexico Grand Prix takes place
is  above sea level.
The low air pressure typically gives engines some

In designing the RA272’s powerplant,�former aircraft engineer

All these ingredients came together in Honda’s first F1 win.
And with that, a glorious history was in the making!

simply out of this world.
