The E46 also exhibited the exceptional FR handling that drivers
have come to expect in BMW cars.
Indeed, more and more people will be singing its praises
in the years to come, you'll see.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
如果你追求只有跑车引擎才能提供的刺激感，
那么选宝马M3系列肯定没错！
这款E46 M3搭载S54B直列六缸引擎……
产生的极高转速和强大的动力输出，简直让你感觉飞出天际。
这款车毫无疑问是经典中的经典。
E46也展现出了宝马跑车向来优异的
前置后驱操控性能。
可以肯定的是，
会有越来越多的人迷上这款车。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Chris

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This E92 M3 is the fourth instalment in the BMW
M3 series that began with the E30.
Its pride is in its engine.
It's the only M3 to come equipped with a menacing V-8 engine.
At the time of its development, BMW was powering its other
cars with V-10s built for F1 racing...
But the speed and torque achieved by this high-precision V-8 
was nothing to dismiss.
What’s more, you'll be surprised at how light it is
compared to its inline-6 predecessor. 
Indeed, this incredible car is worth having for
the powerplant alone.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这款E92 M3是宝马M3车系
继E30后的第四款车。
这款车最引以为傲的是其引擎……
是M3系列中唯一搭载高亢V8引擎的一代车型。
在研发这款车型时，宝马仍采用V10引擎
打造其他F1比赛的车型……
但是，这台高精度V8引擎所实现的速度和扭矩
不容小觑。
更令人惊讶的是，相比于其前代搭载的直列六缸引擎，
这具引擎是如此轻巧。
确实，单纯就冲那引擎，
这款突破想象的车型就值得拥有！
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Chris

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The Toyota Mark II is widely regarded as one of Japan’s
most iconic luxury sedans.
Produced from 1968 to 2004, it enjoyed a remarkable
36-year run spanning nine generations.
The original 1968 model was known
as the Corona Mark II.
The name suggested a larger, more luxurious
version of Toyota’s popular Corona sedan.
When the fifth-generation model arrived in 1984, the Corona
name was dropped in favor of Toyota Mar� II.
This particular car is an eighth-generation Mark II.
More specifically, it is the highly sought-after Tourer V.
Under the hood is Toyota’s legendary turbocharged
1JZ-GTE inline-6.
What sets the Tourer V apart is it combines the refinement
of a luxury sedan with high performance.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
丰田Mark II作为日本最经典的豪华轿车之一，可谓久负盛名。
从1968年到2004年，这款车的生产持续了足足36年，
期间一共迭代了九代。
1968年生产的初版车型
被命名为“Corona Mark II”。
“Mark II”代表它是丰田的
日常代步轿车车型Corona的豪华版。
在该系列于1984年发布第5代车型时，
其名称不再包含“Corona”标识，而是直x��命名为“丰田Mark II”。
这里的这台是第8代的Mark II。
也就是车迷圈子中炙手可热、一车难求的Tourer V。
它所搭载的，正是丰田大名鼎鼎的
1JZ-GTE直列6缸涡轮增压引擎。
这款车的独特之处，便是将精致的豪华车设计
与生猛的动力进行了无缝的融合。c
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Chris

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
From the moment of its birth, this Aston Martin Valkyrie
was already a legend in the making.
This is what happens when a British sports car company with
more than a century of history teams up with Red Bull Racing.
The aerodynamic elements were penned by one of the greatest
designers in F1 history, Adrian Newey.
But wait until you hear about its naturally-aspirated 6.5-liter
V-12 engine...
...whi�h is capable of producing 1000ps at !
It’s an amazing powerplant that would be at home in an F1 car.
And yet, believe it or not, this thing is completely street-legal!
It just might represent the greatest sports car to have ever
been created by a car maker and an F1 team.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
打从降生的那一刻起，这台阿斯顿马丁Valkyrie已经具备了
成为传奇的素质。
它是英国百年老牌跑车制造商和红牛车队携手合作的产物。
它的空气动力学元素由F1历史上最伟大的设计师之一
——阿德里安·纽维操刀设计。
但是别以为这就完了，听听它那6.5升自然进气V12引擎的轰鸣……
它能在下产�
�高达的动力！
你可以说这是一台跨界引擎，就算安装在F1赛车上也毫不逊色。
而且，信不信由你，这车居然还能合法上路！
它是目前与F1专业知识结合得最完�g、最棒的跑车。V
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Chris

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Now, this is one of the true icons of the industry, one that
changed the history of sports cars in the world.It has attractive styling, a top that can
be folded down easily...
...and the cockpit space is just snug. Oh, and its price
at the time of release was very affordable.
But above all, the market for convertible lightweight
sports cars...
...was quickly decreasing at the time. It was a dark time
for enthusiasts.
This was the savior that revived this entire genre of cars.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这辆车是一面真正的旗帜，你甚至可以说它改变了赛车
的历史。
还是那家喻户晓的造型，加上方便折叠的顶篷和舒适无
比的座舱，
还有在发售之初非常实惠的价格。
能让你感到人车融为一体、操控自如的敞篷轻量级跑车
的市场
在当时已几近消亡。
这款车可以说是以一己之力挽救了所有同类车型的救星。s
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Chris

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This is a sports car that made no compromises. 
It embodied the Porsche spirit.
The 997 GT3, after 2008, produced twice the downforce 
than the previous car.
Also, the engines and brakes were even more powerful.
Not only that, it utlilized an engine crankcase that was 
developed for racing since their air-cooled models.
It's definitely a precious car today.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这是一辆不折不扣，毫不妥协、绝对纯粹的保时捷跑车。
2008年之后的997 GT3的下压力提高了一倍，
引擎功率和刹车也更加强大。
不仅如此，它所使用的发动机曲轴箱是从风冷技术时代
就不断积累研发的赛车用版本。
毫无疑问，这既是一颗璀璨的宝石。:
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Chris

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
I have a soft spot for the M3. 
I was involved on the first E30 M3...
...while I was working on the beginning of the E36.
Today, the 3 Series coupe is known as the 4 Series,
and the M3 became M4. 
I still prefer the old M3 naming, however.
This car here is the most purposefully designed BMW...
...that possesses the true spirit of the M-performance package. 
It has the right amount of details like front air intakes
that cool the brakes...
...to side air-outlets with the M accent.
It has an extremely athletic look 
that exemplifies sporty and elegant design.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
我对M3情有独钟。
当我们开始开发E36系列的时候……
我还同时承担了E30 M3的开发工作。
现在，3系的双门轿跑车已经被宝马改称为“4系”，
M3也跟着变成了“M4”。
但我仍然喜欢M3。
它是目的性最明确的宝马……
其设计主旨与M性能套件的运动精神完全契合。
细节�&�的配置也相当到位，例如冷却刹车的前进气口……
以及带有“M”系凌厉风格的侧面进气风道。
仿佛一位穿上设计师品牌运动外套的运动员，
集运动和时尚优雅于一身。�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Tom Matano

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
I don't care what anyone else says, I think this is the
world's most beautiful race car!
I just can't get enough of that bodywork, especially the
wheelhouses and fenders.
It's not just a nice looking car, though.
It won the 24 Hours of Daytona on its first try in 1967.
In fact, the 330 P4 occupied
all the podium positions.
Seeing three 330 P4s cross the fi�ish line together...
well, that was enough to bring a tear to my eye.
The 330 P4 won the 1000 Kilometers
of Monza that same year as well!
Formula 1 drivers Lorenzo Bandini and Mike Parkes
piloted the Ferrari in that race.
The car was then entered in the 24 Hours of Le Mans.
But defending champion Ford still proved dominant,
and the 330 P4 came in 2nd place.
The Ford GT40 that won at Le Mans �hat year is also
a beautiful car.
But for me, nothing comes close to the 330 P4.
Viva Ferrari!*
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
我不管其他人怎么看，反正我就觉得
这辆车就是世界上最好看的赛车！
这些曲线我不管看多少遍都看不腻。
瞧瞧这轮拱罩和挡泥板！
而且这辆车不仅是好看！
它在1967年亮相时就赢得了戴通纳24小时耐力赛！
实际上，为了展现硬实力，这款车直接霸占了整座领奖台！
想�/�一下三辆330 P4一同跨过终点线的景象……
简直要让我感动到哭了！
就在同一年，330 P4还赢得了蒙扎1000km的冠军！
一级方程式车手洛伦佐·班迪尼和迈克·帕克斯
都曾代表法拉利参赛。
330 P4还参加过勒芒耐力赛……
但是福特的数量优势实在太大，所以330 P4只得了第二名。
那辆在勒芒夺冠的福特GT40�$是一辆优美的车子……
但对我而言，330 P4才是我心中永远的神。
法拉利万岁！
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This Audi takes me back to the 2011 Le Mans 24-hour race. 
Incredibly, it crossed the finish line and won
the competition...
A nail-biting 13.845 seconds before
the second-place Peugeot.
Rarely has Le Mans had such a close race!
Although Audi bested Peugeot in terms of speed,
the same couldn't be said about fuel efficiency.
Peugeot tried to use this to their advantage
by taking as few pitstops as possible.
So while Audi was making excellent time,
it couldn’t quite shake Peugeot.
But in the end, Audi’s speed won out, eking out
a victory against its competitor.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
看着这辆奥迪，我仿佛回到了2011年的勒芒24小时耐力赛。
它以非同凡俗的姿态越过终点线并赢得了冠军……
只领先了第二名的标致13.845秒，令人捏了一把汗。
在勒芒，很少能见到这样针尖对麦芒的比赛！
虽然奥迪在速度上胜过了标致一筹，但是在
燃油效率方面就一言难尽了。
标致充分利用这一优势，尽量减少了进站加油的次数。
所以，单圈时间极其优秀的奥迪始终没能将标致甩开。
但最终，还是奥迪的速度胜出，惊险击败了对手。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The Stratos, designed by Marcello Gandini...
...was created to accomplish just one goal.
And what was that, you ask? To win rally races.
Legend has it that the car was a handful to drive
owing to its short wheelbase.
In fact, only a handful of drivers could ever really
master it.
One of them was the legendary rally driver
Sandro Munari.
He controlled the Stratos like it was a part of his body.
His view on the matter was:
"If you find driving this car difficult, then your skills
just aren't good enough."
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
Stratos的设计者是马塞罗·甘迪尼……
他设计这辆车的目的只有一个。
那个目的是？在拉力赛中获胜。
传说这辆车非常难驾驭……
实际上，真正驾驭了这辆车的人也就那么几名车手。
传奇拉力车手桑德罗·穆纳利便是这些车手之一。
对他来说，操纵Stratos就像是操纵玩具车那样易如反掌！
他对此的看法是：
“如果您觉得这车难开，那只能说明你还欠火候！”i
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The Mitsubishi FTO is a sports coupe that took the racing
world by storm.
It famously competed in the All Japan GT Championship
in 1998 and 1999.
Although it retained the front-wheel-drive layout
of its road-going sibling...
...it replaced the latter’s naturally-aspirated engine with a
turbocharged version of the venerable 4G63 inline-4.
On the track, cars with rear-wheel drive are far more
co�mon contenders for power and traction.
Although the Mitsubishi FTO never captured a victory
in the All Japan GT Championship...
...it did earn a 2nd-place podium finish at the series opener�
in 1999!�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
三菱FTO是一款曾在赛坛掀起波澜的
运动型双门轿跑。
其最广为人知的战绩当属1998至1999年间
征战全日本房车锦标赛的经历。
尽管其公路版姊妹车型的
前轮驱动布局被保留下来……
但原厂自然进气引擎被替换为了
经涡轮增压强化的经典4G63直列四缸引擎。
要知道，在赛场上比拼动力优势的
往往是那些后轮驱动车型。
虽然此车未能在全日本房车锦标赛摘得桂冠……
但在1999赛季揭幕战中还是成功斩获了亚军佳绩！0
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The Espace F1 was unveiled in 1994
at the Paris Motor Show.
More than 30 years have passed since then,
yet it remains as astonishing as ever.
Based on the wildly popular family car,
the Renault Espace...
...the Espace F1 was powered by a Renault V-10 engine from the
1992 Formula 1 champion machine, the Williams FW14B.
It was transplanted amidships in true race-car fashion.
At th� time, Renault and Williams were the dominant duo
in Formula 1 racing.
But no one expected them to install an F1 engine in a
minivan! It was, indeed, a fantastical concept.
Although it never reached production, it rema�ns a brilliant star
in Renault’s history.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
Espace F1于1994年在巴黎国际车展首次亮相。
三十余年后的今天，这款车型依然令人叹为观止。
基于风靡全球的家用车型雷诺Espace打造……
Espace F1搭载的雷诺V10引擎
源自1992年一级方程式冠军战车，威廉姆斯车队的FW14B……
并依照赛车规格采用中置布局。
当时雷诺和威廉姆斯车队堪称
一级方y��式赛场的黄金组合。
但谁也未曾料想，他们竟会将一级方程式引擎
植入一台家用多用途汽车！这无疑是天马行空的创举。
虽未量产上市，此车始终是雷诺品牌史上�璀璨夺目的传奇之作。�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Chris

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The sixth-generation Camaro was a well-built machine,
especially the SS version.
It came equipped with the same 6.2-liter LT1 engine that was
introduced in the Corvette.
The handling was nothing short of exceptional, making it
feel at home on winding roads.
Honestly, for all it offers, it's really quite reasonably
priced.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
第六代科迈罗工艺精湛，
特别是这款具备SS等级的制作。
这款车搭载了6.2升LT1引擎，
这款引擎曾首次亮相于科尔维特车型上。
其操控性堪称卓越，在蜿蜒起伏之间，
驾驶体验更加刺激。
坦白说，这款车提供的这一切，
确实对得起这个价。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Chris

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Simply put, the Honda Integra Type R is one of the meanest
compact cars in the world. It is a true race car for the road.
At its release, this first-gen Integra Type R came with a
price tag that was affordable to young enthusiasts.
It served as a tool for young drivers to hone their 
skills as only a Type R could.
The Integra Type R's naturally-aspirated engine was a pumped-up
version used�in the base model...
...producing  more output.
The car also featured a strengthened chassis and boasted
more than  in weight reduction.
It serves as a true showcase of 1990s Japan�se automotive
engineering.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh: 不用多说，本田Type R提供了迅疾而流畅的驾驶体验。 完全是款名副其实的公路赛车。 第一代形格Type R发售时，由于其定价对于年轻车主来说 并非不可接受…… 因此吸引许多人将其作为入门车型， 用来体验驾驶Type R的乐趣。 其自然吸气引擎比起基础车型 更加强劲有力。 因此在功率上提升了。 形格Type R还采用了强化底盘，并减轻了以上的整体车重上。 这款车是上世纪90年代日本汽车制造业中当之无愧的代表杰作。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Chris

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The first-generation Viper was initially offered as
an open-top model.
That was the RT/10.
This GTS was introduced later as the coupe version.
The coupe’s structure improved rigidity, 
which in turn enhanced handling.
Lamborghini was also involved in the development
of the V10 engine.
Viewed in that context, it was a remarkably cost-effective
performance car.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
上市的第一代Viper首先推出的是敞篷车。
型号是“RT/10”吧。
这个GTS版本是改良后的双座跑车版本。
车身更加坚固，操纵感也更强。
兰博基尼也参与了它的V10发动机的研发。
如果从这个角度去想，这可是一辆性价比非常高的车。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Chris

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The "Romance of Minus 21 Seconds."
That was the slogan for the R33 Skyline GT-R.
In a time trial on the Nürburgring Nordschleife...
...it improved on the lap time of the previous GT-R,
the R32, by a full 21 seconds.
It was a phrase that reflected the development effort
that went into the R33 GT-R.
I think stories like that are part of the
magical nature of the R33 GT-R.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
“缩短了21秒的浪漫”。
这是R33 Skyline GT-R广告口号。
在纽博格林北侧赛道的一次计时赛中，
R33 Skyline GT-R将前辈车型R32 GT-R的单圈成绩消掉了
整整21秒。
这条口号也反映出了日产为研发R33 GT-R所做的所有
投入。
我认为正是这样的故事让R33 GT-R这款车更有价值。1
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Chris

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
One of my all-time favorite cars is an 1980s icon—
the fourth-generation Civic.
With its powerful engine, this Civic Si 
was the pride of the hatchback pack.
Civics of this era ranged from smart and chic sedans
to uniquely designed 5-door wagons like the Shuttle.
And each was beautiful
in its own way!
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
我的毕生挚爱之一诞生于80年代
——那就是第四代思域。
这台搭载强劲引擎的思域Si掀背版，堪称
家族的门面担当。
这一时期的思域车系从优雅时髦的四门轿车，
到造型独特的穿梭机五门瓦罐车，应有尽有。
每款车型都绽放着独特的美！%
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Stella

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
In Japan, where minivans enjoy tremendous popularity,
the Toyota Alphard is the one everyone has their eye on.
One reason for its popularity is its extremely luxurious nature,
in equipment and quality.
Ever since the original model was introduced in 2002, the Alphard
has remained true to its "luxury minivan" identity.
And the 2015 third-generation model took that 
premium identity to new heights.
This Executive Lounge was the third-generation Alphard’s
top-of-the-line grade.
The oversized second-row seats, unique to this version,
were the very definition of comfort!
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
在日本，厢式旅行车可是非常热门的车型。
而且更夸张的是，好像每个人都想拥有一辆丰田埃尔法。
这辆车广受欢迎的一个理由
就是借助设计和配置散发出“豪车”的风范。
自从这个型号在2002年推出第一代之后，埃尔法
就始终保持着自己“豪华厢式旅行车”的定位……
而2015年的第三代更是抓住了豪华车的精髓。
这辆行政豪华版本是第三代埃尔法的顶配，
配备有专属的超大尺寸后排座椅，
绝对是无可置疑的舒适性的天花板了！
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Stella

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
It's not big, but you just can ignore it.
Ah, I see. This GR Yaris was made for motorsports.
I guess it does look like a sports car,
and it's no slouch out on the track.
It's nice that it's also good for everyday use—I mean,
you can even sit in the back!
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这辆车虽然小巧玲珑，但实力却不可小觑。
噢，原来是这样。这辆GR雅力士是专为赛车运动而生的。
它看上去确实就是一辆跑车，在赛道上表现得也不弱。
而且日常使用也非常好开，我说真的，后排也能坐人！
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Stella

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Porsche is a mainstay of the WEC, which is short for the
World Endurance Championship.
Currently, Porsche's entry in this series is the 911 RSR.
The car competes in both the LMP1 and LM-GTE classes.

二十世纪六十年代的标志性名车“德托马索Mangusta”。
德托马索Mangusta是乔治�!罗在车身制造公司吉亚工作时
设计的。
他是一个天才，17岁就进入了汽车设计的世界，
仅27岁就成为了吉亚的首席开发工程师。
我听说乔治亚罗的父亲是一位画家。
所以我猜乔治亚罗的造型设计能力
也来自于他血液中流淌的艺术家基因。
我发觉Mangusta那永恒的、经典的气质
与迪奥的格调之间存在着相似之处。
因此我为它选择了一个稍有�+保守的奶油色车身，
搭配低调而又别致的暗金条纹，
然后把“迪奥”字样放在车身的侧面。
车头的数字“47”来自于迪奥品牌首秀的年份，1947年。
我的这些理念在与跑车浪漫旅合作的项目中
成为了现实，造就了这辆非常独特的汽车。
伴随这辆Mangusta而来的还有另一个特别的魔法。
我为它的驾驶者也设���了一套特别的赛车装备。
赛车服是黄色的，对于赛车而言是一个经典的颜色。
足够鲜明，但又不过分张扬。
作为代表迪奥的标志，我们选用了经典的“CD菱形纹样”，
与这辆赛车来自同一个年代——上世纪六十和七十年代。
赛车靴来自于我们知名的“Diorizon”系列，
但在踝部以上做了调整，针对车手的需求重新进行了设计。
如果这辆车能��成为你那些令人惊艳的藏品之一，
我也会感到非常满足！E
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Kim Jones

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This is a second-generation Subaru Impreza STi.
In Japan, the Impreza STi and the Mitsubishi Lancer Evo
were known to have an intense rivalry.
The second-generation STi featured numerous upgrades, none more 
evident than in this 2004 model.
Notice how the rear wheel arch appears to be slightly
widened?
This was done to give the car wide tires and wheels.
The suspension and engine were also improved.
This car certainly turned heads after its time trial run
at the Nürburgring in Germany.
It was the first Impreza to complete a lap
in less than eight minutes!
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这是一台二代斯巴鲁翼豹STi。
在日本，翼豹STi和三菱蓝瑟翼豪陆神是
一对有名的宿敌。
第二代STi引入了多项升级，在这台2004版的车型上
体现得淋漓尽致。
注意到后轮拱看起来更宽了一些吗？
这是通过加宽轮毂和使用宽胎来实现的，悬挂和引擎
也得到了相应升级。
此车在德国的纽博格林赛道上试测，拿到了令人侧目的结果。
毕竟，这是首台在八分钟内跑完这条赛道的翼豹！F
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Stella

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This car...it's named after a mounted knight with a lance.
And this is the fifth-generation version?
I can tell by its appearance that
it's not slow or modest.
It gained fame in the World Rally Championship
and enjoyed popularity across the globe? Impressive!
This is a really nice car, I hope you take good care of it!
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
所以说这款车是以一位手持长枪的骑士命名的……
而且这是第五代车款了？
一看外表就知道，它肯定不是一辆慢吞吞的老爷车。
哇哦，所以它在世界拉力锦标赛上一举成名，接着在
全世界都很受欢迎。
这真是一辆好车呀。希望你能好好照顾它哦。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Stella

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Did you know that the Volkswagen Beetle and the Porsche 911
have some common linkages?
The Beetle was designed by Dr. Ferdinand Porsche,
the founder of Porsche Automobiles.
It sports a horizontally-opposed engine at the back of the
car that drives the rear wheels...
Yes, precisely! It's a rear-engine, rear-wheel-drive car!
Dr. Porsche carried design elements from the Beetle over to
the�first Porsche sports car, the Porsche 356...
...and later the Porsche 911.
What started out as a small people's car
ended up as a genuine sports car.
While there may be a world of difference
between the two...
...the fact that they share a horizontally-opposed engine,
RR-layout and the same creator is truly fascinating!h
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
你知道大众甲壳虫和保时捷911之间有一些
共同的联系吗？
甲壳虫是由费迪南德·保时捷博士设计的，他同时也是
保时捷汽车的创始人。
甲壳虫的车身后部配置了一台水平对置引擎，用于驱动后轮……
这使它成为了名副其实的后置引擎、后轮驱动车型！
保时捷博士后来将甲壳虫的设计元素应用��了第一辆保时捷跑车，
保时捷356……
以及后来的保时捷911上。
可以这么说，最初的小型民用汽车设计最终却变成了真正的跑车。
虽然现在两者之间可能有天壤之别……
但它们都采用水平对置引擎、后置后驱布局，并且
发明者都是同一个人的事实确实耐人寻味！�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Stella

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Even I know this one—the Porsche 911 is famous.
I thought this would be a really expensive model.
But this RS doesn’t have much in the way of equipment.
I don’t even see a door handle.
Oh, you pull this red strap?
So it’s all to make the car lighter?
That’s pretty wild. They really went that far
to save weight.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
就连我都知道这款车，保时捷911太有名了。
我还以为这款车会非常非常贵，可是……这款RS上面
缺了好多的设备呀。
我甚至连门把手都没见着。
哦，你要拉这根红绳……所以这都是为了让车更轻？
这也太疯狂了，他们居然会为了减重做这么极端的事。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Stella

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
If you ask me, this car is less of a design study than it is
a study in aerodynamics.
The roofline runs straight across the body to the rear,
where it abruptly cuts off in a coda tronca.
This tells me that it may have been developed as a prototype
for engineering purposes.X
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
依我看，这辆车更像是一项“空气动力学研究”
而非“设计研究”。
车顶线条贯穿整车一直延伸到后部，
突然以“断尾”的形式戛然而止。
我有个大胆推测，它可能是以工程研究为目的
而开发的原型车。/
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The Lexus LC 500 has absolutely incredible proportions.
With a long, low hood, a long wheelbase...
...a tight cabin, large wheels placed 
at the corners...
...and an absolutely juicy body shape,
which is well-sculpted. 
It has very technical headlamps and taillamps,
and a fresh interpretation of the Lexus grille.
This design makes it very clear that a highly advanced
engine is under the hood. I absolutely love this car!
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
雷克萨斯LC500的车身比例十分惊人。
它具有修长而低矮的引擎盖，相对较长的轴距
和紧凑的驾驶舱，硕大的车轮更是占据了四角……
外加夺人眼球、线条精雕细刻的抢眼车身造型。
它的大灯和尾灯科技含量很高，前格栅
则是对雷克萨斯经典款式的重新演绎。
整体的造型都在告诉你——我的引擎盖下面安装了一颗
非常先进的引擎。这是我非常非常喜欢的一台车！"
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Ed Welburn

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The Ferrari FXX K gives me the impression
of a "2-seater Formula 1 Ferrari."
The overall body shape is aggressive, and every bit
of the car is designed for the purpose of speed.
The front wing/splitter, all of the intakes
and air exits are impressive.
I am particularly intrigued by the small shape just forward
of the rear wheel which deflects air from the rear tire.
As you walk around to the rear,
it’s all serious business.K
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
法拉利FXX K给我一种“双座F1法拉利赛车”的印象。
车身塑造得非常有进攻性，几乎每一个部件
都是为速度而设计的。
从前翼/定风翼，再到所有的进气口及排气口的处理
都令人印象深刻。
特别打动我的是紧靠后轮前方的这个小翼片造型，
它的作用是偏转气流，使其远离后轮。
沿着车身漫步到车后，眼中所及都是匠心独运的设计。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Ed Welburn

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
My buddy had bought one when it came out.
I was impressed with how beautiful the engine looked.
It possessed all the right components that make a sports car. 
But it was scaled proportionally to match the
body size of a kei-car...
...just like the original FIAT 500.
I loved that short stroke 5-speed shifter. 
It had a tight mechanical feel to it.
However, it became notchy often.
That’s why I wanted the Miata to have a short stroke shifter...
...without the notchiness, of course.g
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
我正好有位朋友在这部车发售时买过一辆。
我记得当时我就被这台漂亮的引擎给打动了。
它具备一台真正跑车的所有要素，
只是在设计时按照轻型车的尺寸需要被按比例缩小了。
就像原版的菲亚特500一样！
我真的太喜欢它这台短行程的5速手动变速器了。
它可以为你提供扎实、机械的手感……
虽然确实时不时会出一些小毛病。
是它帮助我下定决心为Miata配备了短行程变速箱……
当然，我们的变速箱没有那些小毛病。K
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Tom Matano

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
What a cute little car. It looks like a miniature
supercar.
There are no gimmicky surfaces or details. 
It makes me want to get in and attack a twisty road.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
真是一辆可爱的小车啊。它看上去就像是一辆微缩版超跑。
没有任何花哨的表面或细节。
它只会让我想要钻进车里，
在崎岖的道路上风驰电掣。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Tom Matano

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The 1988 24 Hours of Le Mans was one for the history books.
Jaguar fans from the UK were showed up in force, with Union Jack
flags waving all around the track.
It was a sight I'll never forget.
This is the car that brought Jaguar the victory that day.
It finally got the better of the Porsches that had
dominated Le Mans for so long.
It certainly put a smile on the legions of Brit�sh fans.
But they first had to endure a stressful race.
It wasn't until the end that Jaguar was able to put away
the Porsche that was applying pressure all race.
Just thinking of it now sends � chill down my spine.V
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
1988年的勒芒24小时耐力赛相当不平凡。
那年，大批来自英国的捷豹车迷涌入赛场，
赛道上的米字旗四处可见。
我永远也忘不了那番景象！
而那天为捷豹赢得胜利的，正是这辆车……
他们在那天终于打败了称霸勒芒已久的保时捷。
这也让英国车迷充满了自豪和喜悦。
萨森赛车场那时热闹非凡！
那场比赛非常激烈，获胜的捷豹到最后
都一直面临着身后保时捷的压力！
光是想想那场景就让我背脊发凉！0
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
You know, the R33 GT-R always reminds me of Le Mans in 1995.
At the time, regulations prevented cars from entering if
a four-door version existed in the lineup.
So, Nissan developed a special 2-door “NISMO GT-R LM."
It was registered in the U.K. to meet homologation requirements.
And Nissan succeeded in entering the car at Le Mans.
It showed just how determined team manager, Kozo Watanabe was...
...to see the GT-R compete in the race.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
说起R33 GT-R，总是让我想起
1995年的勒芒24小时耐力赛。
因为当时的勒芒规则明确规定：
若某车系拥有四门版本，则其赛车不得参赛。
为此，日产特别打造了一辆双门版的日产赛车国际GT-R LM，
在英国注册并通过了赛事认证，
这才成功将这辆车送上了勒芒的起跑线。
由此可见，这辆GT-R的研发主管渡边衡三
让其参加勒芒24小时耐力赛的意愿是何等强烈！o
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Why, this is the Garage RCR Civic, the winner of the Gran
Turismo Award at SEMA 2017!
Garage RCR refers to a body shop in Phoenix, Arizona,
and the Civic, which this car is based om, is the 1992 EG.
The custom parts are genuine JDM!
From its widebody kit to its hood, a wealth of
Japanese tuning parts have been expertly used.
Built to excel at time attacks, its cha�sis, engine and
transmission were tuned to perfection.
You’ll be blown away by its 5-speed sequential gearbox
and 400ps of turbocharged power.
I hear that Phil Robles, the owner of this car...
...built it piece-�y-piece with his son Jesse.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
哇，这就是那台Garage RCR思域，
2017年美国汽车用品改装车展览会跑车浪漫旅大奖的得主！
“Garage RCR”指的是亚利桑那州凤凰城的一家车身工厂，
“思域”则是指这辆改装车的原型车'92 EG思域。
它所有的定制部件都是纯正的JDM（为日本国内市场生产）！
从宽体套件到前引擎盖，都是从品类丰富的日本改�=�件中
专业甄选出来的。
为了在计时赛中获得出色的成绩，它的底盘、引擎
及变速箱都经过了精心调校。
五速序列变速箱和高达400马力的涡轮增压引擎
绝对震撼。
据说这辆车是由它的主人飞利浦·罗伯斯与
他的儿子杰西一起……
逐个零件亲手组装起来的！�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Did you know that there is a full-scale paper model
of this EPSON NSX?
It's true. EPSON commissioned Japanese paper artist
Hitoshi Shinozaki to build one.
It’s entirely made of cardboard, including
the tires and all of the other intricate parts.
It looks like the real thing, as if it could
drive off at a moment’s notice.
But I digress.
The real NSX competed under EPSON colors
in Jap�nese GT races from 2004 to 2009.
At the time, the All Japan Grand Touring Championship
was evolving into the Super GT Series.
The EPSON NSX competed in the latter half of the 2008
season, where it came in 2nd place in �ound 8 race.z
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
你知道吗？这款ESPON NSX居然还有一套全尺寸的纸模呢。
这是真的，是Epson委托日本纸模艺术家筱崎仁帮他们打造的。
这个纸模全部由硬纸板做成，甚至连轮胎和其他的圆形
部件也不例外。
这个纸模看上去足以以假乱真，就好像可以随时上路一般！
……咳咳，不好意思跑题了。
Epson涂装的NSX真车�加了2004年到2009年期间的
全日本GT赛事。
当时正是全日本GT锦标赛向国际Super GT系列赛转型的阶段。
这款EPSON NSX参加的是2008年系列赛的后半段赛程，并在第8
轮中跑出了第二名的好成绩。�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Did you know there was a version of this Citroën BX
built for Group B rally homologation?
They called it the BX 4TC.
Up front, a longitudinally mounted turbocharged 2.2-liter inline-4
channeled serious power to all four wheels.
The irony? By the time this beast was
finally ready to race...
...Group B was already heading toward extinction.
As a result, it saw action in only a handful of r�ces following
its 1986 debut—the final year of Group B competition.
Still, the BX 4TC, with its enlarged fenders and four auxiliary
rally lights, projected a commanding presence on the track.
It is truly a sight to behold!g
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
雪铁龙BX曾经开发过为满足B组别拉力赛规则
而打造的赛事认证车型，这你知道吗？
这台车被命名为'BX 4TC'。
它搭载的2.2升直列四缸涡轮增压引擎纵向安置在车头，
源源不断为四个车轮输送强大的动力。
然而，当这台公路猛兽终于准备好参赛时……
B组别赛事却已走向终点。
所以，在它亮相的1986{��，同时也就是B组别最后举办的那一年，
它仅参与了寥寥数场比赛。
尽管如此，这款BX 4TC凭借其加宽的挡泥板
和四盏辅助拉力灯，在赛道上依然威风凛凛。
这台车绝对值得一看！�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Ah, 1953—an unforgettable year! That was the year that gave
us the "C1," or first-gen Chevrolet Corvette.
And so began the age of mass-production sports cars
in the United States of America.
While sports cars were already stateside, they were mostly
European—and if not, they were rare and costly.
In other words, a truly "American" sports car had yet to be born.
Then General Motors released the�Chevrolet Corvette.
From 1953 on, this roofless 2-seater pretty much underwent
yearly upgrades, each time promising more and more power.
This C1 Corvette is from 1958, and is well-known
for its major design overhaul.
Two headlights became four, and the hood was given
a number of fake louvres.
By the time 1960 rolled around, GM was selling many C1s,
a sign of its enduring popularity.
To this day, the Corvette remains�synonymous with
American sports car culture...
...making it one of the most important sports cars
in automotive history.2
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
啊，1953——令人难忘的一年！
在这一年，“C1”，也就是第一代的雪佛兰科尔维特诞生了。
这也标志着美国量产跑车时代的开端。
虽然当时跑车在美国已不少见，但这些跑车大多数来自欧洲。
而非欧洲跑车车型就更加凤毛麟角，而且价格高昂了。
换句话说，真正“美国”产的跑车还没有诞生。
就在�:时，通用汽车发布了雪佛兰科尔维特。
从1953年开始，这辆无顶双座跑车几乎每年都要进行更新，
而且每次的动力都变得愈发强大。
这辆C1科尔维特来自1958年，因其设计上的重大更改而闻名。
两枚大灯增加到四枚，引擎盖上增加了几处伪百叶格栅。
到了1960年，通用汽车的C1产量仍然可观，可见该车型
经久不衰的人气。
直至今日，科尔维特仍然是美国跑车文化的代名词……
这令它成为了汽车历史上最重要的跑车之一。i
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Chris

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Here we have a seventh-generation Corvette, 
or "C7" for short.
If I'm not mistaken, the C7 made its debut in 2013,
at the North American International Auto Show.
And seeing as how the original Corvette was born in 1953…
...the timing of its release lined up nicely with the Corvette's
60th anniversary.
Even in its basic package, the C7 boasted a powerful
race car engine.
You won't find any European sports car that delivers 
so much "bang" for the buck.
If you ask me, I'd say it's a real deal for a sports car!
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这是一台第七代科尔维特——
简称“C7”。
如果我没记错的话，C7的首次露面是在2013年的底特律车展上。
1953年是初代科尔维特诞生的年份……
这辆车亮相的日子正好是那款车的60周年纪念日。
C7连基本版都搭载了一台强劲的赛车引擎。
用同样的价钱，你绝对找不到能出这么大力的欧洲产跑车。
要我说，对于一款跑车而言，这辆车绝对物超所值！
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Chris

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This is a truly historic car, and an extremely valuable one.
Érik Comas became Driver Champion behind the wheel of
a GT-R at the 1999 All Japan GT Championships.
In fact, the Pennzoil car finished in the points
in every race that season...
...and claimed four podium finishes out of seven races that year.
It was also the last GT-R powered by the RB26DETT engine
to claim the title in the GT Championships.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这可是一台历史悠久的车了……而且极其珍贵。
埃里克·科马斯就是坐在这辆GT-R赛车里夺得1999年
全日本GT锦标赛车手总冠军的。
这辆Pennzoil赛车在那个赛季的每站比赛中都获得了积分，
并在当年的7场比赛中4次登上领奖台。
这也是最后一辆搭载RB26DETT引擎获得该项赛事冠军的GT-R。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Chris

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Since its debut in 1980, this first-gen Fiat Panda went on to
become a best-seller with a 20-year-plus production run.
The basic car par excellence, it remains beloved by drivers
all over the world.
The original Panda is perhaps the car most associated
with the world-class car designer Giorgetto Giugiaro.
Fiat entrusted him with designing the next generation
of the compact car.
The ob�ective was a car combining intuitive handling
with cost-effective production.
Drawing on his deep knowledge of automotive design, Giugiaro
came up with solutions to all sorts of problems...
...such as the economical use of flat glass
for all of the car's window surfaces.
Indeed, this masterpiece is simply brimming with hallmarks
of his inimitable genius!F
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
自1980年问世以来，这款初代菲亚特Panda
以长达二十余年的生产周期成为常青车型。
作为极致简约却性能卓著的经典代表，
至今仍深受全球车迷喜爱。
初代Panda可谓是与世界级设计大师
乔盖托·乔治亚罗最具渊源的车型。
菲亚特将这款紧凑车型的换代设计全权委托于他。
设计计划书要求打造�"具直观操控体验
与亲民制造成本的车型。
凭借深厚的汽车设计造诣，
乔治亚罗采用创新方案解决了诸多难题……
诸如全车玻璃表面均采用成本更有优势的平板玻璃。
毫无疑问，这件杰作处处闪耀着
大师独一无二的设计智慧！
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Chris

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
While the standard 208 GTi was undeniably small
and light, it did offer loads of fun to the driver.
This Peugeot Sport-engineered version takes the driving
experience to a whole other level.
Its exquisite chassis is stable and responsive.
On even extremely twisty mountain roads,
the car was an absolute pleasure to drive.
In fact, its amazing chassis is reason enough to add this car
in your collection.K
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
虽然标准规格的208 GTi无疑是一款小而轻巧的车型，
驾驶起来却趣味无穷……
这款标致运动精心设计的款式，更将驾驶体验
带到了一个全新的高度。
精细的底盘设置给人以无与伦比的稳重感……
即便是行驶在最蜿蜒的山间道路上，
都能让人尽享驾驶妙趣。
老实说，仅凭其优秀的底盘，
就值得你去收藏这辆车了。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Chris

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This Demio is Mazda’s entry in the compact
car marketplace.
It was sold outside of Japan as the "Mazda2"
and it proved to be a big hit.
So the car was reintroduced to the Japanese market in 2019
with that very name.
Mazda is famous for its beautiful rear-wheel sports cars...
...and its legendary race cars that have won titles
the world over.
I'm sure that you'll run into one eventually!
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这款Demio是马自达对紧凑型汽车市场的贡献。
实际上它在日本以外被称为“马自达2”......
以至于它在2019年重新进入日本市场时，也叫回了这个名字！
马自达旗下的名车既有优雅的后轮驱动跑车......
也有在全世界范围包揽冠军头衔的传奇赛车。
我相信你以后会遇到一辆这样的车！
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Stella

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Anyone who has spent time playing Gran Turismo has likely found 
themselves behind the wheel of this legendary Porsche.
The 956 and its successor, the 962...
...dominated the global motorsport scene for years,
racking up numerous victories.
The 962C, in particular, is widely regarded as the most
successful sports-racing prototype ever created.
Its striking livery, streamlined bodywork...
...and the vertical fin-supported rear wings are as iconic today 
as when they first appeared on the track.$
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
任何玩过《跑车浪漫旅》的人想必都曾
至少驾驶过一次这款车型。
保时捷956及其后继车型962……
在国际赛场上为保时捷赢得了长达数十年的胜利。
事实上，962C被广泛认为是有史以来
“最成功的运动原型赛车”。
它鲜艳的车身涂装，简洁的车身线条……
以及由两侧垂直尾翼支撑的大尺寸后扰流板，即使在
今天仍然充满魅力，一如初上赛道时那样令人印象深刻。F
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Kunihisa Ito

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The number of cars participating in the 1991 Le Mans race
was only 38, but among those was the new Peugeot 905.
There were also perennial powerhouses like Mercedes-Benz, 
Jaguar and Porsche sharing that starting grid.
To take them all on, Mazda entered two 787B race cars. 
Of those two, the No. 55 car, which started the race in 19th
position, gradually worked its way up the running order...�
...until it found its way to the front and finished on top!
It was a dramatic first victory for Japanese manufacturers.
To this day, I haven't forgotten the green and red 
Renown livery of that race machine.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
在1991年参加勒芒耐力赛的赛车仅有寥寥38辆，
但全新的标致905也在其列。
此外，在发车格上还有各品牌常年出战的高性能赛车，
如梅赛德斯-奔驰、捷豹和保时捷等等。
马自达派出了两辆787B赛车来挑战这些强大的对手。
在这两辆车中，从第19位发车的55号赛车
步步为营，不断提升自己的排位……�
……最后终于攀升到领跑位置，并以头名完赛！
这是日本车厂的第一次获胜，过程充满了戏剧性。
时至今日，我依然无法忘怀那部比赛机器
的橙绿色涂装。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Kunihisa Ito

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The Nissan R92CP has an exquisite body design that speaks
to its enormous capacity for downforce.
And its blue paint job is dazzling to behold.
Back in 1992, Nissan pitted the R92CP against Toyota’s
TS010 in a battle for supremacy.
After winning the opening round at Suzuka, the R92CP
went on to win at Fuji and at Sugo...
...contributing to an incredible class victory for Nissan.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
日产R92CP以精致的车身设计彰显其强大的下压力性能。
此外，其炫目的蓝色涂装更是令人眼前一亮。
在1992年，日产R92CP与丰田的TS010展开激烈对决，
争夺行业的巅峰地位。
在铃鹿赛道夺得开幕战胜利后，R92CP继续在富士和
苏果运动乐园赛道再下两城……
日产最终震撼赢得该级别的冠军，此车功不可没。q
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Kunihisa Ito

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
BMW's EV brand began with the "i." 
The company offered two products, an urban commuter,
the i3, and the super high-performance i8. 
Both models utilized different power sources, and
each expressed itself with its own form language.
They're quite alluring, no?
Particularly the i3, in addition to the proportions
defined by packaging necessities...
The car is eye-catching, even when�it's driving
around town. 
The interior also uses sustainable environmental materials.
Everything about the car is thorough.
This kind of approach serves the role of making the user 
highly conscious of the environment. 
That's why this design is so important. A gold star!�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
宝马的电动车都以“i”字母起头。
其电动车品牌主打两款产品：作为都市通勤车的i3，
和拥有超强性能的i8。
这两个型号采用了不同的动力源，
而且都以独特的外形设计语言表达出自己的定位。
两辆车是不是都非常诱人？
尤其是这辆i3，在内饰布局和配置上下了不少功夫，
留足了空间……
即便是在城市里驾驶，它也能非常吸睛。
它的内饰采用了可持续环保材料。
此车的一切都透露着缜密、周全。
这样的做法有助于令用户对环保产生深刻的认识。
正因如此，这份独到的设计才显得至关重要。
值得给它颁发一颗金星勋章！�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Hideo Kodama

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
If there is a car that perfectly 
represents Ferrari’s spirit...
...it is the F40.
The progenitor of all Hypercars, 
an absolute myth for enthusiasts.
It follows typical Pininfarina design continuity.
It incorporates the cabin volume of the usual 308
with a body inspired by competition.
Low, profiled, with retractable headlights...
... and indicators that sit behind
smoked Plexigl�s. 
With the two NACAs
on the hood... 
...as well as the four lateral "gills" in GTO-style 
behind the rear wheel... 
..it integrates many functional air intakes.
Other characterstic elements are...
...the horizontal black groove...
...as well as the three round central exhausts and...
...the huge rear wing with the initials F40
in bas-relief on the right side.W
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
如果说有哪辆车能完美代表法拉利的精神……
……那么非F40莫属。
它是所有终极跑车的始祖，是车迷心目中的绝对神话。
它在设计方面延续了宾尼法利纳的经典风格，
并继承了普通版本308的驾驶舱，
但车身造型设计明显是为竞速而生的：
无论是低矮的轮廓，翻转式大灯……
……及雾面有机y��璃后的转向指示灯；
还是引擎盖上的两个NACA进气口……
……或是后轮之后的四道GTO风格竖向“鳃”状风口……
……功能性进气口的数量多得让人瞠目结舌。
当然，它的个性还不止于此：
……纯黑色水平蜂窝格栅、
三联装的中置圆形排气管以及……
……大到夸张的尾翼。
在尾翼的右侧面还有一个大大的“F40”]��雕标志。�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Fabio Filippini

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
An iconic creamy white body with the Shelby Blue stripes 
represented a genuine GT Mustang...
...one that stood out from the super popular base model.
The original Mustang came 
with great proportions. 
Its design was simple and clean.
Due to regulations, no parts 
were added to the exterior of the Shelby G.T.350.
However, it did come with a lowered suspension, 
wider tires and the iconic graphics.
 If I were to own a Mustang, 
this would be at the top of my list.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
当你看到经典的奶白色车身和Shelby蓝色条纹，
就代表这是一辆血统纯正的GT Mustang……
……当然了，G.T.350肯定要比人气超高的
基础车型更胜一筹。
原款Mustang的车身比例本就十分优秀，
设计方面也以简洁、精炼为主。
受赛事规定限制，这台Shelby G.T.350没有增加任何外部部件，
只是调低了悬挂系统，安装了宽胎
以及加入了标志性的涂装。
要是我想买一台Mustang，那么这款车绝对是我的首选。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Tom Matano

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Did you know that, along with its increased engine
displacement over the previous model...
...the Porsche 911 GT3 R (992) became the first
GT3 R to feature a swan-neck rear wing?
For me, its defining accomplishment remains those unforgettable
back-to-back victories at the Le Mans 24 Hours.
Both came in the LMGT3 Class, which replaced 
the LMGTE category in 2024.
In its debut year, it secured a superb class win under
conditions that were anything but forgiving.
Then it did it all over again the following year—a truly
remarkable achievement, wouldn’t you agree?
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
你知道吗？保时捷911 GT3 R (992)不仅
排量比其前任大……
也是第一款采用天鹅颈式尾翼的GT3 R？
就我个人而言，它最令人难忘的成就，
是在勒芒24小时耐力赛中实现了两夺冠。
它在LMGT3组别（2024年取代LMGTE组别）中
取得了这一佳绩。
在首次夺冠那一年，尽量条件艰险，它还是坚韧不拔地
拿下了该组别的辉煌胜利。
然后它就在下一年再次上演了同样的精彩戏码
——真是不容小觑，你说对吧？$
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
A Gran Turismo Championship icon
and the ultimate race car....
...inaugural series champion Igor Fraga and
2019 champion, Mikail Hizal...
...raced this machine at the 2018 GTC finals in Monaco
to a near dead heat.
I’ll never forget the electrifying energy in the venue
when the winner was announced!
The responsiveness of its 3.0-liter NA engine is incredible...
...�nd its exhaust note is like music!
Because of its sharp handling, it requires
comprehensive driving skill to master. 
But if you can tame this beast, you’re well on
your way to becoming Gran Turismo royalty!
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
它是GT锦标赛的传奇，也是终极的赛车。
首届锦标赛冠军伊戈尔·弗拉加和2019年度冠军
米迦勒·希扎尔……
驾驶着这款比赛机器在摩纳哥举行的2018年总决赛中杀得
难解难分。
我永远不会忘记最后宣布冠军那一刻赛场里迸发的热烈
气氛！
3升自然进气引擎的响应速度十分傲人……�
它的排气声响听起来也极其美妙！
灵敏的操控意味着你需要拥有全面的驾驶技术才能够驾
驭它。
如果你能够驯服这头猛兽，相信你的跑车浪漫旅比赛传奇之路
会一路畅通！4
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy
legacyUnmatchedReview.resolvedCarNameEn: Gran Turismo Red Bull X2019 Competition
legacyUnmatchedReview.resolvedCarNameZh: Gran Turismo Red Bull X2019 Competition

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Three days after its introduction at the 2019 Paris Motor Show...
...this car competed in the eighth round of the
Nürburgring Endurance Series.
It qualified 2nd and finished 5th overall in the race—
an impressive result right out of the box.
As it had not yet been commercially released,
it entered the SPX class for test cars.
The R8 LMS Evo demonstrated its potential from
the very beginning.
It went on to compete successfully in GT racing series
around the world.'
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
在2019年巴黎车展上公布后仅3天，这辆车就出现在
纽博格林耐力系列赛的第8轮比赛中！
它在排位赛中获得总成绩第二名，在决赛中获得总成绩
第五名。作为初出茅庐的新车，这个成绩还不错吧？
因为这款车还没正式上市销售，所以它作为测试车参加
SPX级的比赛。
总而言之，R8 LMS Evo从一开始就完全展示了它的肌肉。
之后也继续在世界各地的超级跑车比赛中再创佳绩。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy

legacyUnmatchedReview.en: Here's a legendary car from the early days of Japanese motorsports. I've heard all about how it used to race around the newly built Suzuka Circuit. If you were to ask me which race by this car nicknamed "Yota-Hachi" was the finest... ...I would have to say that it was the one at Funabashi Circuit in July 1965. The event was the All-Japan Club Championship, and the driver was Tojiro Ukiya. After that incident, however, he staged a stunning comeback, moving up through the field to win the race! There was something almos� divine about the performance he displayed that day.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这是一辆来自日本赛车运动早期的传奇汽车。
我听说过它是如何在新建成的铃鹿赛道上飞驰的！
如果你要问我“丰田八”有史以来最精彩的比赛是哪一场……
那一定是1965年7月在船桥赛道举行的那场比赛。
这是全日本俱乐部锦标赛的一站，车手是浮谷东次郎。
在比赛前期的一次碰撞中，浮谷撞坏z��他的挡泥板。车
辆修复后，他的位置跌到了第16位。
然而，在那之后他上演了一场惊人的反击战，在一路高
歌猛进，最终取得了第一名的好成绩
他在那天表现出的速度简直如有神助！�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The C4 Corvette ZR-1 is a famously speedy Corvette.
It set seven international and world records in the 1990s.
In fact, its speed record went unmatched for more than
two decades.
The V-8 engine developed in conjunction with Lotus
was truly impressive and high powered...
...producing over  more than the standard model. 
All in all, it's a car that's even more valuable than
its price would suggest.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这辆C4科尔维特ZR-1快如闪电的名气谁人不知，谁人不晓。
它在二十世纪九十年代总计创下了7项世界纪录。
事实上，这个无人能及的速度纪录保持了超过20年。
这款车上装载了与莲花跑车公司一同研制的V8发动机，动力强
劲、令人惊艳，
比标准版的动力提高了不止。
我要说的是，它的售价远远不能代表其真正的价值。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Chris

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
There's nothing like an M car from BMW. The first-generation M3
is mostly associated with racing.
The final model was this "Sport Evolution," which was quite
popular.
It is distinguished by its upgraded 2.5-liter engine
and rear spoilers.
At first glance, the mods may seem slight, but 
those in the know will tell you otherwise.
Oh yeah, these cars were impressive indeed.
Not too many of the original M3s were produced, so you can 
expect their prices will increase with time.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
哦，一辆宝马M系列的车……
第一代M3最适合拿来竞赛了。
这款“运动进化”是最终型号，备受欢迎。
这款车的特点是升级过的2.5升引擎以及尾部扰流板。
乍一看，好像只是些细微改动，但实则不然。
呵呵！实际上这车型深藏不露……
这款车的产量不多，所以价格
只会不断往上涨。B
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Chris

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This may look like an ordinary R34 GT-R, but I can
recognize its true identity at a glance.
This is the BNR34 N1 base, built by the legendary
Japanese tuning house, Mine’s!
Mine’s is one of the oldest and most respected tuners
of the Skyline GT-R lineage.
Its creations embody the perfect balance of power, handling,
and speed, whether on the street or the circuit!
This is a machine every collector dreams of owning.
Among Mine’s many GT-R masterpieces, the BNR34 N1
base stands out as truly exceptional!
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这看似是一台普通的R34 GT-R，
但我当即就辨认出了它的不凡来历。
它竟然是著名日本改装厂迈恩斯出品的
BNR34 GT-R N1 base！
迈恩斯是历史最悠久、最受推崇的
天际线GT-R改装厂商之一。
无论是街道驰骋还是赛道竞速，
他们的作品都展现出极致的动力、操控与速度！
这无疑是每位收藏家心驰神往的梦想座驾。
而在迈恩斯众多GT-R改装杰作中，
BNR34 GT-R N1 base堪称真正的非凡之作！
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Stella

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Do you know the history of AMG?
It started out as a company that built racing engines.
At the helm were two engineers.
They were Hans Werner Aufrecht and Erhard Melcher.
These two worked in the race-engine forge
of Daimler-Benz.
When Benz took a hiatus from motorsport...
...Aufrecht and Melcher decided to go into
business together.
They founded their engineering company out of
Aufrecht’s house in Großaspach, Germany.
Taking the initials of Aufrecht, Melcher, and Großaspach,
they christened their company "AMG."
That was in back in 1967!
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
你了解AMG的历史吗？
它起初只是一家专门打造赛车引擎的公司……
由两名工程师汉斯·维尔纳·奥夫莱西特……
和埃尔哈特·梅尔赫执掌。
二人曾经在戴姆勒-奔驰的赛车引擎铸造厂工作。
当奔驰暂时远离赛车运动后……
奥夫莱西特和梅尔赫决定共同创业。
于是他们在奥夫莱西特位于德国�>�罗萨斯帕赫
的家里创办了他们的工程公司。
他们从奥弗莱希特、梅尔赫和
格罗萨斯帕赫三个名字中
各取一个首字母，为公司起名为“AMG”。
那是在1967年！2
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Stella

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
If you’re looking for a stylish hatchback, you can’t
go wrong with the MAZDA3.
The MAZDA3 comes in two body types: a 5-door hatchback
and a 4-door sedan.
That said, the fact that they have so few shared parts
is proof of their purposeful design.
Take the smooth roof line of the hatchback—it’s so beautiful
that Mazda went and marketed it as a fastback.
What’s more, this MAZDA3 fastback comes in a
"burgundy selection" grade!
From the seats to the interior panels, everything in this
package is expressed in a most distinctive shade of red.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
如果你想要找一辆外观时尚的掀背车，选马自达3准没错！
马自达3提供两种车身版本选择：5门掀背版和4门轿车版。
尽管同属一个车型，但二者之间的通用配件却不多，
这也证明了它们的设计目标性非常明确。
以掀背版本为例，它那流畅的车顶线条非常优雅，而马自达
也特意将其宣传为“斜背车”。
另外，这款马自达3掀背版还供应“勃艮第红”版！
从座椅到内饰板材，一切配置
都采用了最特别的红色调处理。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Stella

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
A car with more than 50 years of history and over fifty-million
units sold worldwide...
Is there any other car that can make such a claim
than the Toyota Corolla?
It’s a brand that has surely made memories
for countless of people everywhere.
The GR Corolla is a sports car built by Toyota’s
GR division.
What’s more, this model was a special variant penned by
Toyota’s master driver Morizo.�p scmd="GTCafe_Conv_CarDetail03">
To reduce weight, the rear seats of the base 5-seat model

of lofty ideals held by Jagua� employees.
Once the prototype was unveiled, it attracted attention everywhere,
leading to official development and production.
Combining the beauty of Jaguar’s legendary 1960s race cars...
...with the performance of its 1990s race machines...
...built by the experts at England’s most storied luxury car builder,
the XJ220 was a car like no other.u
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
捷豹XJ220被全世界车迷誉为
二十世纪九十年代最独具魅力的超级跑车。
这款车最初只是几名捷豹工程师和设计师的私人项目……
在工作之余进行研发。
正因如此，打造XJ220的团队也后人被称为“星期六俱乐部”。
可以说，这辆车充分地代表了捷豹员工
对于自己理念的自由表达。
这台原型车甫一亮相，便立刻在全世界范围内造成了轰动，
也让公司下定决心，开启正式研发并投产。
这台车结合了品牌六十年代传奇赛车的优雅造型……
以及九十年代赛车的超强性能……
还有英格兰那历史悠久的豪华车制造专业知识，
可以称得上是绝无仅有的珍宝。�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Chris

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The Super Formula? Of course I know it. It’s a world famous
Japanese formula race series.
The beginning of genuine motorsports in Japan is said
to date back to the 1960s.
The first Japanese Grand Prix was held in 1963.
Back then, the track was dominated by modified road cars,
or "touring cars" to be precise.
Since then, Japan has also slowly crafted its own
formula race scene.
For this to happen, Japanese Grand Prix drivers
had to study abroad...
...at famous race schools in England, where they learned
the ins and outs of formula racing.
After that, they teamed up with Japanese automotive
engineers to develop Japan’s first formula cars.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
超级方程式？我当然知道啦。这是一项
全球知名的日本方程式系列赛。
据说日本真正的赛车运动始于二十世纪六十年代。
第一届日本大奖赛在1963年就举办了。
在当时，统治赛道的多是些经过改装的公路车，
或者更准确说是“房车”。
自那时起，日本就一直在逐步地搭建
属于自己的方程式�车领域。
为了实现这一目的，日本大奖赛的车手们纷纷走出国门……
在英格兰的著名赛车学校学习，并在那里
了解到了方程式赛车的方方面面。
学成归来后，他们便与日本汽车工程师们合作，
打造出了日本的第一款方程式赛车。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Stella

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The styling of this car is a continuation
of the BMW 2002 and represents
the last 3 Series with BMW's traditional design language.
It looks as if the designers employed obvious themes and
executed them in an obvious manner, but the car still looks good.
For example, one thing that makes this design effective is...
...the front overhang when viewed from the rear-quarter angle.
It's almost non-existent. 
You can har�ly see it. 
Both the engineers and designers understood 
the importance of proportions.
This design can only happen when planned from the early stages.
It may look simple, but it's not so easily accomplished
on a mass-produced vehicle.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这款车延续了2002款的风格，
在宝马的传统设计语言下竭力展现最新一代3系的风貌。
我感觉，设计师们最初就定下了张扬肆意的调子，
在呈现时更是不遗余力，最终的效果也非常出彩。
比如说，它有个非常精妙的设计……
……如果你从斜后方角度观察车头前悬部分，
你会发现几乎看不到，
仿佛它不存在一样。
�代表宝马的工程师和设计师们对车身比例研究得很透彻。
要实现这一点，必须在开发前期就将之纳入规划。
这是一件知易行难的事，在打造一款量产车时，
能实现这样的成果确实难能可�\。.
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
After Jaguar took a break from racing in 1956, it continued
to work on a successor to the D-Type.
This was during the transition from a front-engine 
layout to a mid-engine one.
While Ford gave us Eric Broadley’s Lola GT,
the base model for the GT40...
...and Ferrari gave us the LM...
...Jaguar was committed to building a car with the same
design language as the D-Type.
The result? A r�fined and aerodynamic prototype
with a V-12 mounted amidships.
The XJ13.
Designed by the famous Malcolm Sayer...
...the XJ13 never raced, but it surely served as
inspiration for the n�w legendary E-Type.u
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
在1956年短暂退出赛车运动后，捷豹继续投入D-Type
后续型号的研发。
这款车诞生于从前置引擎向中置引擎布局过渡的过程中。
在福特推出GT40的基础车型，
即埃里克·布拉德利设计的罗拉 GT……
以及法拉利推出了LM的同时……
捷豹依然致力于沿袭D-Type的设计语言。
其最终成果是一款精致纯粹、拥��优秀
空气动力学性能、采用中置V12引擎的原型车——
XJ13。
XJ13由著名的马尔科姆·塞尔所设计……
尽管从未参加过任何比赛，但它无疑
�SE-Type的开发提供了大量的思路。4
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Hideo Kodama

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The DB3S is a smaller, lighter and more competitive version
of the DB3, which lacked a fighting spirit.
Although it retired after 222 laps at Le Mans in 1953...
...it performed well at Silverstone and many other races.
See how the large front fenders stretch from the headlights
to the cockpit and on to the voluminous rear?
This is similar to the MGA and AC Ace, as well as the
Frazer Nash and Sebring.
That is, it was designed in the classic British style.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
相比于略微欠缺战斗精神的DB3，这辆DB3S可以视作是一个较小较轻、
更偏重竞技的版本。
虽然它在1953年的勒芒只跑了222圈便遗憾退赛……
但在银石和其他赛事上却有上佳的表现。
你看到了吗？它的大号前挡泥板从车头灯一直连接到驾驶舱，
又延伸到宽大的车后部。
这种设计与MGA和AC艾斯，以及弗雷泽·纳什
和赛百灵非常类似。
换句话说，就是经典的英式车身风格。/
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Hideo Kodama

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The R.S. 01 was a true mid-engine competition car
belonging to the GT category.
Designed for the track, it sat low, wide, and it was functional.
Thanks to its dynamic and muscular form, it was also
extremely aggressive.
The huge carbon rear wing always impressed, along with
the front spoiler and the rear diffuser.
That said, Renault desired to maintain a "family feeling"
in the front and rear...
...so it adopted the style of the lights and grille
of the production Mégane.c
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
R.S. 01是一款真正的中置引擎赛车，隶属于GT类别。
它专为赛道设计——底盘低、车身宽且功能强大。
充满动感和肌肉感的外形也令它显得攻击性十足。
硕大的碳纤维尾翼给人留下深刻的印象，前扰流器
和后扩散器也同样引人注目。
尽管如此，雷诺还是希望在车头和车尾的设计上
保持“家族传承”……
因此借鉴了量产版梅甘娜的车灯和进气格栅的设计风格。o
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Fabio Filippini

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
I remember very well the impact of the Honda NSX 
at the 1989 Geneva Motor Show.
It was the expression of absolute sportiness 
combined with Japanese perfection.
In fact, its clean and streamlined style...
...comes from studies previously 
made with Pininfarina. 
These were further developed later by 
in-house Japanese designers
This design is so pure and balanced that...
...it lasted 15 years without notice�ble changes.
While the front and 
side are slightly reminiscent of the Ferrari style...
...the tail is particularly original and successful.
Of note are its integrated wing and
the transversal strip of lights
The "Type R" version boasts intense technical improvement work...
...amd is virtually identical in aesthetics�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
1989年，本田NSX在日内瓦车展上造成的轰动，
我现在依然记得很清楚。
它是绝对的动感和日本的完美主义的结合。
这种简洁的流线造型……
……其实是本田与宾尼法利纳合作研究的成果。
之后又由日方的内部设计师
进一步完善和发扬光大。
这项成功的设计不仅纯粹，而且平衡……
……以至于沿用了整整15年都x��见任何显著改动。
虽然前脸和侧面会让人觉得向法拉利靠拢……
……但其车尾的原创度很高，也相当成功。
一体化的尾翼和横向全尺寸灯带都是可圈可点的创新。
后来的“Type R”版本虽然在技术上做出大幅的改进……
……但在美学方面几乎是全面照搬了原版车。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Fabio Filippini

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The Toyota 2000GT is a wonderful sports car, 
and a true modern-day classic.
The proportions are great, 
I would not change a thing.
My favorite view is rear three-quarter. 
From that view...
...the roofline settles far back on the body 
and the hood is long and sleek. 
The 1960s period design details are creative 
and add to the charm of the design.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这辆丰田2000GT是非常优秀的跑车，
也是现代汽车历史中的一款经典杰作。
它的比例十分出色，我甚至找不到任何改进的余地。
我个人最喜欢的欣赏角度是侧后方。
从这个角度看上去……
……车身线条从车顶向尾部缓缓滑落，显得顺滑流畅，
还有它的引擎盖，是那么的修长而利落。
在1960年代，就连细节的设计都创意无穷，
为整体设计增色不少。l
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Ed Welburn

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This is the first Civic that wore the Type “R” designation.
This model started the tradition that continues to this day.
When compared to the latest Type “R” model,
it was much purer and simpler.
It shows that times have changed during the past 20 years,
like an evolution of a sneaker design.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这是第一款得到“Type R”命名的思域。
也开启了延续至今的传统。
与最新的Type R车型相比，它更加纯粹和简洁。
它展示了过去20年间的车型变化。就像
运动鞋设计的演变一样。!
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Tom Matano

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Toyota has been entering hybrid racing cars into Le Mans
since 2012...
...with its first victory coming in 2018.
While its cars displayed impressive performance year after year,
they couldn't quite translate those speeds into victories.
There were some close calls, though. In 2016, one of its cars stopped
at the front of the pack, with just one lap to go!
The victorious Porsche team�couldn't believe its luck.
In any case, this just made Toyota’s 2018 victory sweeter.
I remember it clearly—I was so happy!
What's more, Toyota would go on to win five in a row,
its most recent win being in 2022!
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
自2012年以来，丰田一直致力于将混合动力赛车投入
到勒芒的比赛当中……
他们的首个胜利直到2018年才姗姗来迟。
在此之前，这些赛车每每都展现出令人惊叹的速度，
但却始终无法将这种速度转化为胜利。
不过，期间也有过几次胜利触手可及的时刻——2016年，
领跑车阵的丰田却在离终点只剩z��一圈时抛锚了！
就连捡漏的保时捷车队都不敢相信自己的好运气。
不过，这些挫败只是让2018年的胜利变得更加甘美。
我清楚记得当时的感受——我当时高兴坏了！
更激动人心的是，丰田在之后的五年里连战连捷，
其中也包括2022年新鲜出炉的一胜！�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
A second-generation Swift Sport!
Thanks to its high base specs, this car can compete
without much modification.
In fact, it was even entered as a junior rally car
at the World Rally Championship!
Having taken the title twice, Suzuki has proved...
The great potential of this machine.
Manufacturing credit goes to Monster Sport, a Japanese
company headed by Nobuhiro Tajima.
Spe�king of Tajima-san...
His impressive career includes six consecutive wins
at the Pikes Peak International Hillclimb.
Monster Sport has also built legendary hill climbers
based on the Suzuki Cultus and Escudo.4
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这是第二代的速翼特运动版啊！
因为基础规格够高，所以无需过多改装，
就能直接参加比赛。
事实上，它甚至作为青年拉力赛赛车参加了
世界拉力锦标赛！
铃木用两个冠军头衔证明了……
这辆车的巨大潜能。
这辆车的制造者是Monster Sport，一家田岛伸博创办的日本公司。
说起田岛先生……
他拥有傲人的职业生涯战绩，曾在派克峰国际爬坡赛中获得六连胜。
在他的带领下，Monster Sport也基于铃木Cultus和Escudo
生产传奇的山地爬坡赛车。�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This Lexus RC F competed in Japan's top racing series,
the Super GT.
It made its debut in 2014.
This one is the 2016 version. I have fond memories of seeing
it in action!
It lost the first four races to the Nissan GT-R, but then
made a stunning comeback after changing the engine.
By the end of the season, it had managed to claw its way up
to 5th place in the rankings.
As it happens, that season's championship was won by another
RC F, number 39.b
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这辆雷克萨斯RC F参加了日本的顶级赛事Super GT。
这款车应该是在……2014年首次亮相的。
这辆车是2016年的型号。它在赛场上驰骋的样子仍能令我心潮澎湃！
这辆车在前四场比赛中输给了日产GT-R，
但在更换引擎之后，它上演了一场惊人的反击战！
在赛季结束时，它已经成功地爬到了第五的位置。
碰巧的是，该赛季的冠军是由另一辆车号为39的RC F赢得的！
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The GR Yaris was developed by Toyota as a rare
example of a fully in-house sports car.
It featured a carbon-fiber roof and a highly rigid body
structure designed specifically for this model.
Its engine and all-wheel-drive system were also purpose-built.
The car was engineered from the ground up to compete in
the World Rally Championship (WRC).
It delivered an exceptionally engaging driving experience, with
performance that rivaled far more expensive cars.
It stands as a model likely to leave a lasting mark
in automotive history.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
经过了很长一段时间的沉寂后，GR雅力士是丰田100%
自主研发的第一辆新跑车。
碳纤维车顶和坚固的车身都是专门为这款车设计的，
引擎和四驱系统也是如此。
这辆从头打造的赛车就是冲着世界拉力锦标赛去的。
驾驶它的感觉非常美妙，不是吗？我认为在比它贵上一
倍的车也不一定具备如此高的性能水准。
我相信这是一款会在车史上留下印记的车型。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Chris
legacyUnmatchedReview.resolvedCarNameEn: Toyota GR Yaris 1st Edition RZ "High performance" '20
legacyUnmatchedReview.resolvedCarNameZh: Toyota GR Yaris 1st Edition RZ "High performance" '20

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Are you familiar with the term "muscle car?"
They were large American machines from the 1960s known for 
their large displacement and enormous power.
The first-generation Camaro Z28 was one of the more notable
models from that era.
Its V-8 engine was developed especially for the Trans Am racing
series, meaning it was highly potent.
Instead having tons of torque like other large-displacement�engines, it offered plenty of top-end power.
With awesome straight-line speed, the race version of the 
Z28 took home several victories in Trans-Am races.
Known as the last of the Z28s, this 1969 model has been
coveted�for generations.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
你熟悉“肌肉车”吗？
这类车以其大排量和强劲动力而闻名，
是60年代美国跑车文化的典型特征。
第一代科迈罗Z28就是在该文化浪潮中诞生的传奇车型之一……
但其专为泛美系列赛研发的
V8引擎，也同样令人惊叹。
不像大部分的大排量引擎那样强调扭矩，
而是主打高转速。
不但能在日常行驶中派上用场，还是让科迈罗Z28
在特兰斯·艾姆竞赛获胜的幕后功臣。
这款1969年车型是Z28最后的改款，
其每代车款都令人着迷不已。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Chris

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This sixth-generation ZL1 may be the most valuable Camaro
of all time.
Taking its engine from the Corvette Z06, 
the ZL1 produced more than .
This "1LE Package" was designed and tuned 
to shine on the race track.
And did it ever. It completed a lap of the Nürburgring
Nordschleife in 7:16:04!
That's a worthy time for a supercar, mind you.
And yet it's about a third of the price of your average super
car, so you'll be getting a lot for your money!
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这款第六代ZL1可能有史以来最有价值的科迈罗车型了。
ZL1搭载的引擎来自科尔维特Z06，能产生超过的功率。
配备了专为赛道性能需求打造的
“1LE套件”。
令人难以置信的是，它以7:16:04的成绩跑完了
纽博格林北侧单圈赛道！
要知道，这可是超跑级别的成绩！
然而，其价格仅是寻常超跑的1/3，
绝对带给你极高的性价比！
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Chris

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Yes, I can recall when this Volvo V40 debuted like it was yesterday.
It was in 2012, if I’m not mistaken.
It was a 5-door compact hatchback that exemplified
the company's dedication to practicality and safety.
What’s more, it had beautiful coupe-like styling.
I’ll have you know, this styling borrowed many design cues
from the great Volvos of the 1960s.
We're talking P1800 and 1800ES, for instance.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
没错，我还依稀记得这辆沃尔沃V40首发时的情景。
如果我没记错的话，那是在2012年。
这是一款5门紧凑型掀背车，从头到尾贯彻了沃尔沃
那久经考验的实用性哲学。
此外，它还采用了雅致的双门轿跑外形风格。
我必须要告诉你，这种设计风格从来自1960年代的
伟大沃尔沃车型身上吸取了不少的灵感。
例如P1800和1800ES之类的经典沃尔沃车型！9
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Chris

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The Nissan Skyline GT-R is the quintessential
Japanese sports car.
Among its many iterations, this R34
is particularly popular.
Not only does it sport the famed RB26DETT engine,
but it was also the final version of the model.
This limited-edition final production model...
...called the V-Spec II Nür features an extremely
balanced engine. 
It remains one of the crown jewel of all Skyline GT-Rs.q
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
日产Skyline GT-R是日本跑车的代表作。
在这个车系众多的车型中，R34型尤其受欢迎。
这辆车不仅搭载了一台备受赞誉的RB26DETT引擎，
它还是这款车的终极形态……
一辆限量版最终生产型……
这辆V·Spec II Nür不仅引擎更加平衡……
它更是被视作Skyline GT-R皇冠上的明珠。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Chris
legacyUnmatchedReview.resolvedCarNameEn: Nissan Skyline GT-R V･spec II Nür (R34) '02
legacyUnmatchedReview.resolvedCarNameZh: Nissan Skyline GT-R V･spec II Nür (R34) '02

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The BAC Mono is one gorgeous piece of engineering.
 It's a great example of exceptional industrial design.
 Every detail is beautifully executed 
with functional forms and fresh graphics.
 Its inspiration comes from single-seat formula cars.
It's a serious road and track machine that is 
designed to extract the maximum out of the driver and car.
The serious aerodynamics are played out visually�
 Take a look at the fuselage.
It tapers to the rear with the large side intakes 
and routes the air through and over the back spoiler/wing.
I also love how the engineering is approached.
It comes equipped with push-rod front suspension shocks, 
and the rear suspension arms on full display.
This car is indeed an impressive example of
how form can follow function.
 It is truly a highly technical, 
clever design language that is beautifully done!�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
BAC Mono是一辆工程学的奇迹、
一件出类拔萃的工业设计样本……
它的设计灵感来自于单座方程式赛车。
每一处细节都精雕细琢……
采用功能至上的部件和极致简洁的贴花，
这是一辆货真价实的公路和赛道机器，
所有设计只为让驾驶者和车辆都发挥出全部潜力。
严谨的空气动力学设计毫不掩饰地呈y��在眼前。
以车身为例，
车身两侧从前向后逐渐收窄，露出硕大的侧进气口，
以便引导气流从车后部的上方通过。
它在工程上的处理方式也是我很欣赏的。
它配备了推杆式前悬挂减震……
而后悬挂臂则直接裸露在外。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Freeman Thomas

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Inspired by the Komenda Porsche 550 Le Mans Coupé...
...the RUF CTR3’s styling has lasted well, and is still being
requested by customers.
This was RUF’s first foray into building a car with its
own all-carbon-fiber body design.

这辆如虎CTR3的灵感来源于

The door section without a character line, and the

The tailfin design of the rear end

...but it was an era where Italian design was also

车门的部分没有特征明显的分界线，简洁的侧面也十分
经典。
从DB5开始引入的包覆式头灯在当时蔚然成风，体现了当

legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

Ah, this is the 2017 model, after the second minor change.
This front design was actually...
...a reproduction of the GT-R Proto that we displayed

We felt that the graphic theme of the GT-R Proto might be a bit

哦，这是2017年的车型，经历了第二次“小”改款。

我们在2005年东京车展上展出的GT-R 原型概念赛车。
当时，我们觉得作为一款首次亮相的车型，

于是搁置了这个设计方案，等待时机成熟。
正如你现在所看到的，时机到了。
2017年车型的外观设计完成度很高，我自己也很满意。
我也非常喜欢现代感十足的新内饰，
我们对材质的应用很到位。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
When you mention the 917, I'm reminded by a particular episode.
Allow me to talk about something that happened in 1968.
At the Eiffel wind tunnel, which opened in Paris in the
19th century, we were in the midst of a project...
...while in the adjacent room,
another car was being tested. That was the 917.
A state-of-the-art advanced racing machine tested at a

The 917 made its debut at the 1969 Geneva Show.
It was the successor to the 908, and instead of an 8-cylinder

Depending on the race, the 917 came in different forms.
On high-speed circuits, it wore a long-tail body,
and on tricky courses like the Targa Florio, it had a short tail.

legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Fabio Filippini

The 2016 Camaro was inspired by the original Camaro

This iteration of the Camaro placed a greater emphasis on its

I thought, "Maybe it's an owner of a Roadster?"

You know, from the start, I wanted to give this Roadster

Among Alfa Romeo’s more recent contributions to motorsports

And, with all the work that NISMO put into this GT-R,

In 2022, scarcely a year after its first appearance...
