The body was made wider to incorporate the wider track. 
The tires were wider wrapped around 17-inch wheels, 
and Brembo brake calipers were standard.
It was one of the greatest 4WD sports cars of the world.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
蓝瑟翼豪陆神系列是从翼豪陆神V这一代开始大幅改善它的转弯
性能的。
车身变得更宽，以便扩大胎距，
而且换上了17英寸轮毂，全系标配了布雷博刹车卡钳。
我概括一下，它是全世界开起来最棒的车之一。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Chris

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The Volkswagen Type 1 is one little car that made
a big splash in automotive history.
Designed as a functional civilian car by none other than
Ferdinand Porsche…
...its distinctive rounded shape resulted in the nickname,
"Beetle." 
Its production run spanned more than 60 years, producing
21,529,464 units from the 1940s to the early 2000s.
Thus, the Type 1 is considered one of the most historically
significant cars ever.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这是一款在汽车史上掀起巨大波澜的小型车。这款车正是由费迪南德·保时捷所设计的
实用型民用车……
由于其独特的造型，获得了“甲壳虫”的昵称。
Type 1是久盛不衰的经典车型，
在汽车产业热销超过60年……
从20世纪40年代到21世纪初，
总共卖出了21,529,464辆……
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Chris

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The only notable difference with the standard 964 Carrera
is the  lower ride height.
You may not notice that because it's very discreet. 
At a glance you would think it was a standard 964.
But that's another element that woos the fans 
of the 964 911 Carrera RS.
It's extremely pure to say the least. There are no comfort 
items here at all.
As a result, it's  lighter, and its handling 
is razor sharp. 
I'm certain it will continue to rise in value over time. 
It's definitely one of the best of the best.?
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这款车与标准的964 Carrera唯一明显的视觉差异是
离地间隙又降低了。
如果没注意到这个差异，
你可能会错以为这是台标准版本的964。
但是，令964 911 Carrera RS的铁粉们
疯狂的要点在于
它的极致简化配置，完全摒弃了
装饰件和舒适性功能。
其结果便是高达的减重，以及如同手术刀般
犀利的操控。
这款车的价值无疑会持续攀高，
因为它绝对是一辆好车中的好车。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Chris

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The Jaguar XJR-9 was penned by British race-car
designer Tony Southgate.
In 1988, it competed at the World Sports Prototype
Championship.
Among its six victories was a legendary show at the 24 Hours
of Le Mans...
...which was Jaguar’s first Le Mans victory since 1957!
The XJR-9 also won the Teams Championship.
And driver Martin Brundle won the Drivers title.
No doubt, the XJR-9’s purple paint job is now known
to one and all!
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
捷豹XJR-9是由英国赛车设计师托尼·索斯盖特
所执笔设计的。
1988年，这款车参加了世界原型跑车锦标赛。
它一共取得过六项冠军，其中最传奇的表演
在勒芒24小时耐力赛上上演。
那也是自1957年后捷豹首次在勒芒夺魁！
XJR-9赢得了车队冠军……
而车手马丁·布伦德尔赢得了车手冠军。
毫无疑问，这款XJR-9紫的涂装现如今已经举世皆知。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Kunihisa Ito

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The prototype and final production model
of the original NSX...
...was designed by my friend and former chief
designer at Honda, Masato Nakano.
The performance target for the NSX was
to surpass the Ferrari 328 and 348...
...so you know it had plenty of fighting power. 
The GT500 class adopted a stepped-bottom rule in 2007, and that
year, this car took the title, winning five of nine races�
Because of its incredible speed, you can almost say 
that the series imposed a weight-handicap system. 
The next year, in 2008, the NSX's main highlight was a 2nd-place
finish in the eighth race of the season at Autop�lis.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这辆初代NSX的原型和最终量产型……
……都由我的朋友、前本田首席设计师中野正人所设计的。
NSX的性能目标是要超越法拉利328和348，
所以可想而知，它的战斗力极其惊人。
GT500组别的赛事在2007年采用了阶梯式淘汰规则，
在这一年里，这辆NSX不仅赢得了冠军，还拿下了
九场比赛中的五场胜�7。
因为它所向无敌的速度，甚至会让人们怀疑这项系列赛
是不是采用了一套非常不利于大重量赛车的制度。
在接下来的2008年，NSX最亮眼的表现则出现在
奥托波里斯赛道，它在赛季的第八场比赛中以第二名完赛。�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Kunihisa Ito

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Thanks to the technical know-how of aerodynamics specialist
Malcolm Sayer, this Jaguar D-Type...
...was a dramatic departure for Jaguar in that it embraced
a new dynamic form.
From the XK120 to the XK150, Jaguar had pursued a sort of 
French elegance, but the D-Type was a pure revolution.
With a little more than 70 units built, the D-Type began
competing at Le Mans in 1954.
While it came up short in its first year, it won overall
victories in 1955 and 1956, a historic feat for Jaguar.
A truly iconic car, its dynamic design would be carried over
to the XJ13 and, later, the famous E-Type.~
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
得益于空气动力学专家马尔科姆·塞尔所提供的
技术专业知识，这辆捷豹D-Type……
与过去的捷豹截然不同，采用了全新的动力学外观。
从XK120到XK150，捷豹一直追求某种法式的优雅，
而D-Type的推出带来了一场全方位的革新。
在生产了70余辆后，D-Type于1954年开始参加勒芒比赛。
虽然第一年出师不利，但�655年和56年却大获全胜，
在捷豹的历史上写下了厚重的一笔。
这是一辆真正标志性的赛车，它的动力学设置
后来在XJ13上得到沿用，并被此后著名的E-type所继承。4
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Hideo Kodama

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This is one of Toyota’s best designs in recent years.
It's been over a decade since this car
hit the streets.
Yet to see it today, you’d think it were novel.
The low height and its double-bubble roof result in a drag
coefficient of 0.28, allowing for a smooth ride.
From the significantly canted windscreen...
...to the drastically sloping rear, this car expresses
a bold, clear vision.!
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这辆车是丰田近些年来最好的设计之一。
其实它也已经出现在街头十多年了……
但今天看到它，
还是有种新鲜感。
丰田通过压低车身高度和采用双气泡型车顶
成功将阻力系数降低至0.28。这样的车开起来肯定很舒服。
无论是明显下探的挡风玻璃……
还是向后延、并在车尾收束下坠的利落侧面轮廓线，
都让人有耳目一新的良好感受。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Hideo Kodama

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Don’t let this cheerful little package fool you. 
It showcases a high level of product design.
In fact, it's so good it’s timeless.
No wonder the current Cinquecento borrows from it.
Dante Giacosa, FIAT's legendary engineer...
...rose to prominence in 1955 when he created the 600,
Italy’s answer to the post-war compact car.
He then took on the challenge of...
...creating an even better minimally-packaged�car.
The result was a rear-engine, super-compact Cinquecento.
Thanks to the intentionally flared wheel arches,
the car appears to be in constant motion.
The yawning hood lid is also q�ite appealing,
not to mention functional.4
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
千万不要小看这款娇小的车型。它表现出了极高的
产品设计水平，
甚至堪称永恒经典。
难怪最新款的500也借鉴了它的设计。
菲亚特的传奇工程师但特·吉奥科萨……
在1955年设计出了600，为意大利汽车行业拿出了
战后紧凑型汽车的标准答案，也借此声名鹊起。
然后他勇敢地接受了更大的挑战……
开始打造一款x��加优秀的低配置车型。
最终他开发出了这辆后置引擎、空间超紧凑的500。
在他的巧手勾勒下，这款车采用了外扩式轮拱，
让它呈现出一种始终处于运动状态下的观感。
它宽大的引擎盖也拥有一种慵懒闲适的吸引力，而性能
自然也不容小觑。�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Hideo Kodama

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The F430 is strongly derived from the 360 Modena,
albeit with important technical changes...
...starting with the new V-8 engine.
It is also an evolution from a "style" perspective.
While taking the body panels and glass parts from the 360,
it has a more aggressive and technical expression.
The large double-oval front air intakes...
...are inspired by the "shark nose" front
of the 1961 Ferrari 156 F1.
And the four Enzo-inspired circular taillights
add to its aggressive look.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这辆F430在设计上受到了360 Modena的强烈影响，
但也引入了一些重要的技术革新……
首先是一台全新的V8引擎。
从“风格”的角度上来看，你可以将F430视作是一种进化。
虽然采用了与360相同的车身板件和玻璃部件，
却给人以更具进攻性、更有科技感的印象。
它的大型双椭圆形前进气口……
灵感来源于1961年的法拉利156 F1上的“鲨鱼鼻”。
四个Enzo风格的环形尾灯则进一步地强化了它的进攻性。$
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Fabio Filippini

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The Mercedes A45 AMG is so well thought out,
so tough and so cool. 
The body shape is muscular and has great proportions.
The surfaces are well sculpted 
and are rich in shape.
Even the wheels are designed to maximize their size,
 and help to plant this Mercedes firmly to the ground. 
What makes this car so very cool is that it is authentic 
and does not depend on gimmicks.
I want one of these in my garage!
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这辆梅赛德斯A45 AMG的设计十分成熟，
性能强悍而且外形帅气。
其车身轮廓充满肌肉感，而且保持了合理的比例。
车身表面经过精心塑形，弧形线条丰富而流畅。
设计师甚至考虑到了轮胎的问题，
最宽尺寸的车胎可以让这辆梅赛德斯牢牢扒住地面。
这辆车的优势在于不忘初心，
绝无任何花哨的设计，只用实力说话。
这样的车，连我也想买一辆！
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Ed Welburn

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This is originally a machine meant for the track, 
so it's not street legal.
But the design has not been compromised one bit.
It conveys an expression of violent performance combined
with the classic beauty that defines Aston Martin.
Having these attributes simultaneously gives 
this car a Jekyll-and-Hyde design quality.
From a nose that looks like it's about to eat the car ahead 
to the low �kirts and the underside of the rear diffuser...
A strange power resonates from the tissues and internal
organs that make up this carbon-fiber machine.
They speak plainly about the origins and intent
of this car. 
The British-style understatement of the DB series is 
something that transcends eccentricity. 
It is the glorious madness that defines today's
Aston Martin.e
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这辆车原本是专为赛道设计的比赛机器，
所以并不能合法在城市道路上行驶。
尽管如此，它的设计并未作出丝毫的妥协。
这辆车结合了暴力的性能和经典的美感，
也是阿斯顿马丁赖以成名的品牌特点。
两者的结合让这辆车呈现出
如同化身博士般的古怪质感。
从它那看上去就像是要把前车吞掉的�8头
到两侧的侧裙，再到夸张的后扩散器……
组成这辆碳纤维怪兽的“肌肉组织”和“内部器官”
迸发出一股奇异的能量，
也开门见山地阐述了这辆车的血统和其设计意图。
DB系列那英式的低调和不动声色已经无法用另类形容。
也正是这种孤芳自赏的疯狂个性，
让今日的阿斯顿马丁依然能够屹立在汽车之林。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
One of the roles design plays in industrial products is...
...to instantly convey information and the underlying message 
in a visual way that may not be noticed at first glance.
It is to project the functional excellence of the product, its
philosophy, tradition and the creator's intent, instantly.
It's also supposed to draw the customer in 
by eliciting a "love at first sight" appeal. 
Therefore, the look of products at time� tries to appeal to
many people at once, making many of them looking similar.
Bluntly put, design is usually dictated by the market.
But in the case of the Radical, this is not the case.
Whether it's a mountain road or the race track,
all it needs to do is to go fast.
The headlight, for example, is simply required
to shine a light forward. 
Although seemingly unapproachable, this car kno�s its role.
It’s a one-of-a-kind sidekick that requires a special love.
These types of cars make life entertaining, don't you think?i
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
设计在工业产品制造中扮演的一个重要角色就是……
……要通过视觉手段即时地传递
第一眼可能看不出来的信息和潜台词。
要立刻呈现产品的功能优点、理念、传统和
创造者的想法。
还要通过营造出“一见钟情”的感受
来吸引到消费者。
因此，产品的外观设计有时会试图同时吸引和取悦不同类型的受众，
导致产品外观��趋同性。
说白了，设计大部分时候都受到市场的主导。
不过Radical却是个例外。
不论是山路还是赛道，它唯一的目的就是跑得更快。
比如说它的车头灯就只需要直直地照亮前方。
尽管这台车的声浪不够大、操控性不够友好，
但它很清楚自己的定位。
那就是成为独一无二、让你爱不释手的一_��老朋友。
这类车可以让你的人生充满乐趣，你觉得呢？�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The large air intakes placed on the side of the body are 
reminiscent of elegant French styling of the 1930s.
However, I sense it is slightly mismatched with the 
wild example of the coda tronca body style.
In the Veyron, the intakes are placed there
to improve aerodynamics.
They make the sides look a bit like a French carrosserie
or the Delage D6 of Henri Labourdette.
This is a beautiful�flamboyant French design, one where 
the function-defining form to travel at ...
Makes modern-day Bugattis so alluring, don't you think?
It's my fondest hope that they always remain
sublime and pure.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
位于车身两侧的大号进气口令人回忆起1930年代
的那些优雅法国车造型。
不过我总感觉这种风格和断尾
的设计有些不搭。
在布加迪Veryron上，在这里设计进气口是为了提升空气动力学性能。
这样的设计让侧面的外观向法式车身靠拢，
又有点类似亨利·拉布戴特的德拉奇D6。
美观到有些浮夸的法系�0�计，
外加能够达到极速的超跑定位……
让现代版本的布加迪充满了魅力，对吧？
在此致以我最美好的愿望，希望他们可以
永远保持卓越和纯粹。�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This is the original model where the Jeep culture started.
It was purely a functional design to meet military needs.
The form-follows-function process doesn’t always 
guarantee esthetic success. 
Only on very rare occasions does it work like 
magic and, in this case, it did, and the vehicle became an icon.
 Engineers who worked on this program...
...must have had a good sense of proportion 
and high design q�ality standards.
They knew where the right amounts of radii needed to be applied.
In some cases, that extra depth of the flanges helped add 
rigidity to the panel so they could use a thinner piece�
My hats off to the original creators.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这辆原版车款就是整个Jeep文化的起点。
作为服役车辆，它的设计完全强调功能性。
这种外形为功能服务的设计出发点
显然无法保证美学上的成功。
或者我应该说，成功的几率绝无仅有。
而这样的成功就落在了Jeep身上，缔造出了汽车史上的经典符号。
参与这项开发计划的工程师们……
……很好地掌握了比例的x��念，
并且对设计品质有极高的标准。
他们将外观的弧度与半径计算得分毫不差。
例如，他们会通过采用凹陷度更深的轮缘来强化板件的刚度，
以削减板材厚度，达到减重的效果。
光凭这一点，就值得我们向那些早期设计者们脱帽致敬。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Tom Matano

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The Type R has the perfect balance of cosmetic and
mechanical tuning.
Its design is simply iconic.
Equally well-balanced in its proportions, it has a great
stance that speaks to its agility on the track.
The car that set the standard for FWD racers,
it still looks great.
What’s more, it captured the spirit of JDM tuners better
than any other model that came after it.-
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
本田Type R在外观设计和机械性能调校方面
达到了完美的平衡。
它的设计堪称经典。
其车身比例同样协调，完美的车身姿态充分
展现了它在赛道上的灵活性。
这款车型为前驱性能车树立了标杆，
时至今日依然魅力不减。
更重要的是，它比后续其他车型都更好地
诠释了日本国内改装车（JDM）文化的精髓。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Tom Matano

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Both Ferrari and Pininfarina have a certain philosophy.
And that philosophy is that a Ferrari "must 
be beautiful and distinctive."
The La Ferrari was introduced as the pinnacle of 
technology, aerodynamics and styling.
Like its predecessors, it stood as an expression of 
pure functional beauty.
There are no gimmicky surfaces or details in its design.
It stood apart from the more aggressive-looking supercars of its time.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
法拉利和宾尼法利纳都秉承了同一设计理念：
每一辆法拉利都必须“美观而独特”。
这台LaFerrari就代表了技术、空气动力学和美学风格上的极致。
和其前辈们一样，它同样遵循“性能高于造型”的设计思路，
摒弃一切花哨的装饰曲面或细节，
在众多外观更加“唬人”的超级跑车中显得鹤立鸡群。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Tom Matano

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
More than anything, I associate the Volvo 240 series
with racing.
The 2-door sedan turbo model made a big splash in European
and German touring car championships.
So much so that its hallmark boxy shape earned it
the nickname "the Flying Brick."
Racing performance aside, this Estate model
is a legend among legends.
Between 1974 and 1993, the Volvo 240 series sold
about 2.7 million units.
Of those, 950,000 were the Estate model. Now, more than
thirty years after its retirement...
...it remains the classic estate car that people
all over the world love to this day!K
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
在我心目中，沃尔沃240系列都堪称非常优秀的赛车。
其中的2门轿车涡轮增压版本曾在欧洲和德国的房车
赛事中引起了巨大轰动。
由于影响力巨大，乃至于其方块状外形
为它赢得了“飞砖”的昵称。
除了比赛表现之外，这款瓦罐车型在市场上也堪称
传奇中的传奇。
在1974到1993之间，沃尔沃240系列总共售出了
大约270万台……
其中95万台都是伊斯代型号。即便在停产超过三十年的
现在……
它依然是全世界车迷所深爱的一款经典旅行车！
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This is no ordinary pickup truck. It's a super truck,
capable of dominating on dirt tracks and oval circuits.
Any mention of a Tundra makes me think of the Baja 1000
desert race.
It's an all-night race that takes place on a 1,600 km
course in the Mexican desert.
It's a challenging race, with more than half the cars entered
never seeing the finish line.
Toyota took on the Baja with this Tundra�tuned by TRD,
and the truck won in its class.
And, did you known that the Tundra TRD also
raced on oval race tracks?
In 2019, it entered a survival event in Daytona, winning a
race in which only nine out of 32 cars fi�ished.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这不是一辆普通的皮卡车。这是一辆真正的超级卡车，
在泥地赛道和椭圆赛道上都占据着统治性的地位！
一提到坦途，我就会想到巴哈1000沙漠越野赛。
这场在墨西哥沙漠举办，赛程长达的比赛
全部在夜晚举行。
这是一项艰苦卓绝的赛事，每次都有半数以上的参赛车
辆会因为各种原因退赛。�丰田公司带着这辆由丰田赛车开发中心改装过的坦途参加了比赛，
并在本级别中揽获冠军。
此外，你知道坦途丰田赛车开发中心也曾在椭圆赛道上比试过吗？
2019年，它参加了在戴通纳举行的生存赛，在一场32辆
汽车中只有9辆完赛的比赛中取得最终的胜利。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The development of the Toyota 86 started at the Nürburgring
in 2011.
The first time the test drivers got a taste of the 86,
they were somewhat underwhelmed.
One of them said after driving it, "We realized we had to
rebuild the car from scratch."
The production and race versions of the 86 were both
developed at the same time.
The race car took part in races such as the
Nürburgring 24 Hours.
The experiences from those races were used to improve the
production car, which is the car here.
In fact, the developers ended up referring to this one as
the "ultimate 86"!
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
丰田86的开发始于2011年的纽博格林赛道。
开发测试车手与86的第一次邂逅，并没有擦出火花。
其中一位车手指出，“我们意识到我们必须从头开始重新
打造这辆车”。
86的零售和比赛规格版本的开发是同期进行的……
赛车版被用于参加纽博格林24小时耐力赛等比赛。
通过比赛积累的经验又被用来改进零售版——也就是你
面前的这台86。
事实上，开发人员最终将这款车称为“终极86”！
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The W 196 R was an F1 powerhouse that took the international
racing scene by storm!
It made its debut in 1954, during the French Grand Prix,
or Race 4 of the World Championship of Drivers.
It was piloted by none other than Juan Manuel Fangio,
who had raced for Maserati up to Race 3…
...before he decided to join the newly arrived Mercedes-Benz
works team.
An Arg�ntinian, Fangio claimed his first Grand Prix
title in 1951.
At the time, he was already one of the fastest drivers
in the sport.
Behind the wheel of the Mercedes-Benz W 196 R, Fangio proved
to be near-unstoppable.
He claimed two consecutive World Drivers’ Champion titles
in 1954 and 1955!�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
W 196 R是一辆席卷了国际赛车界的F1赛车！
它于1954年在法国大奖赛，也就是世界赛车锦标赛的
第4站中首次亮相。
驾驶它的是胡安·曼努埃尔·方吉奥，他在第3场比赛为止
还在为玛莎拉蒂车队效力……
随后决定加入新成立的梅赛德斯-奔驰车队。
方吉奥是阿根廷人，他在1951年赢� �了自己的
第一个大奖赛冠军。
在当时，他已经是这项运动中最快的车手之一。
在梅赛德斯-奔驰W 196 R的加持下，
方吉奥几乎无人能挡……
在1954年和1955年连续赢得两届世界车手冠军！�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The fifth-generation Skyline GT-R went by the codename R34.
The man responsible for its development was
Kozo Watanabe.
A graduate of Tokyo University, Watanabe earned
a degree in automotive engineering.
The R34 was his follow-up to the R33.
A longtime admirer of race car development...
Watanabe wanted to go to Britain to develop Formula 1 cars.
But fate i�tervened and he began working for Nissan,
which was then racing the R380 and the R381.
When Watanabe was tasked with developing the R33
Skyline GT-R...
...he swore he'd build a car that would exceed the speed
of the R32.
It turned out, he kept his word. On a test run, the R33
set a lap time of 7:59 at the Nürburgring!
This time was 21 seconds faster than the fastest lap
set by the R32.
The R33 then led to the R34, �hich carried on the
spirit of its predecessor.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这辆R34是第五代的Skyline GT-R。
这辆车的设计者是渡边衡三。
他毕业于东大汽车工程系。
R34是R33的后继车型。
渡边早对赛车开发早就心痒不已……
他本想前往英国去设计F1赛车。
由于这个目标未能实现，他进入了
当时正在使用R380和R381竞赛的日产工作。
当渡边接到了设计Skyline GT-R R33的任务时……
他曾发誓要造一辆比R32更快的车。
您猜怎么着？在试跑时，R33在纽博格林赛道上
跑出了7:59的单圈时间！
比R32的记录快了21秒。
当然了，它的后继者R34身上也继承了这种精神。�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy
legacyUnmatchedReview.resolvedCarNameEn: Nissan Skyline GT-R V･spec II Nür (R34) '02
legacyUnmatchedReview.resolvedCarNameZh: Nissan Skyline GT-R V･spec II Nür (R34) '02

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
When designing a race car, the natural impulse
is to build something small and light.
But this M6 GT3 breaks the mold, with a total length that is
 longer than that of the production model.
The wheelbase has also been extended.
Many wondered if the extra length of the car would
diminish its handling ability.
That concern was wiped clean when racers first
drove the car.
They praised it for its precise balance and
sm�oth turning feel.
And their findings were soon backed up by results.
The M6 GT3 drove to a magnificent win on
the narrow Macao GP circuit in 2018.
At the wheel then was Japanese touring-car
ace Seiji Ara.
It was a truly incredible race to behold.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
说到赛车设计，人们很自然地会想到小而轻的竞速机器。
但是这辆M6 GT3却反其道而行之——
它的车身长度比量产车型还要长出！
它的轴距嘛，当然也很长！
这样的设计让人不由地担心起它的过弯能力来。
然而，开过它的车手却不是这么说的……
他们对车辆的精确操控和平顺过弯能力赞不绝口。
你还是不相信？
那我告诉你一个事实，日本房车赛传奇车手荒圣治驾驶着它
于2018年在狭窄的澳门大奖赛赛道上
取得了一场辉煌的胜利……
这是一场令人难以置信的比赛，精彩程度令人叹为观止！A
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Beginning in 1966, the first-generation Ford GT
claimed four consecutive wins at Le Mans.
Thirty-six years later, in 2005, a reproduction model
was released to celebrate Ford’s centennial.
About 1,500 units of this reproduction model
were sold as road cars.
But what if this car were to race at Le Mans today?
Developed for Gran Turismo, this Ford GT LM Race Car
Spec II tries to answer that question.
Just wait until you see its speed on the straights!?
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
从1966年开始，第一代福特GT在勒芒连续拿下了四冠。
在36年后的2005年，为了纪念公司的一百周年，
福特又推出了一款复刻车。
这台复刻车款是一台公路车，总共生产了约1500辆。
如果让这款车去参加当今的勒芒比赛，会有什么样的亮
眼表现呢？
为了回答这个问题，专为跑车浪漫旅开发的
福特GT LM Race Car Spec II应运而生。
你就等着见识一下它在直道上的速度吧！
legacyUnmatchedReview.resolvedCar: Ford GT LM Race Car Spec II
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy
legacyUnmatchedReview.resolvedCarNameEn: Ford GT LM Race Car Spec II
legacyUnmatchedReview.resolvedCarNameZh: Ford GT LM Race Car Spec II8

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
What happened in June 1972 was pretty unusual by anyone's
standards.
It was the second race of the popular Fuji Grand Champion
Series, which took place on the Fuji International Speedway.
And, despite being up against Gr.6 and Gr.7 race cars...
...a lower-level machine based on a production model managed
to emerge victorious!
The car was a Fairlady 240ZG, and its driver
was Japan's Ha�uhito Yanagida.
The race took place in heavy rain, and the 240ZG performed
exceptionally against its higher-ranked rivals.
And yes indeed, it beat all of the other entries.
The event became known in Japan as the "Z in the Rain" race, and
remains one of the most legendary moments in motorsports.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
在任何人看来，1972年6月发生的事情都是非比寻常的
奇迹。
当时，人气十足的富士大冠军赛的第二场比赛正在富士
高速赛道上如火如荼地举行。
面对组别6和组别7类别的对手……
一辆基于零售车型改装的低级别汽车却杀出重围、斩获
了胜利！
这辆车是一辆Fairlady 240ZG，车手是日本的柳田春人}��
在大雨滂沱的赛场上，240ZG在与高等级对手的较量中
表现得异常出色……
最终以第一名的成绩冲过终点线！
这场比赛在日本被称为“雨中的Z”，是赛车运动中最具
传奇色彩的时刻之一。�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The Yaris WRC totally dominated the World Rally Championships.
It won the Manufacturers Championship in 2018...
...and in 2019 it took the Drivers' title as well, with a
record six wins. The most for the series.
This GR Yaris was developed specifically to dominate
in the rally championship, which it did!
After developing this competition car to win at the WRC,
a production version was planned for homologation.
Whether you're a fan of racing or not, you'll find
that this car is one amazing machine!
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
雅力士世界拉力是一款彻底统治了世界拉力锦标赛的赛车。
它在2018年获得了制造商冠军，
在2019年则取得创纪录的6场胜利，摘下车手冠军的桂冠。
我们可以确定的是，这辆GR雅力士是专为统治世界拉力
锦标赛而研发的！
他们先是制造了一台能在锦标赛上夺冠的比赛机器，
然后再规划量产车型，接受赛事认证。
不管怎么说，对于一个真正的赛车迷来说，这是少数几
辆能令人兴奋到不能自己的公路车！
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy
legacyUnmatchedReview.resolvedCarNameEn: Toyota GR Yaris 1st Edition RZ "High performance" '20
legacyUnmatchedReview.resolvedCarNameZh: Toyota GR Yaris 1st Edition RZ "High performance" '20

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The Giulia Sprint is one of the most popular cars that
Alfa Romeo ever produced.
Because the Sprint also came as a 4-door sedan,
this car was also called the Giulia coupe.
It became a world-famous sports car, penned by genius car designer
Giorgetto Giugiaro.
Alfa Romeo had its start building super-fast race cars
to compete in grand prix races. 
So, they’ve long had the technical know-how 
to b�ild high-performance engines.
This Giulia Sprint may be small, but it’s powered
by a mighty inline-4 engine with a DOHC head.
Combined with a rear-wheel-drive layout, it’s an absolute
thrill to ride.
And, it served as the base for a super-lightweight
GTA model, too.I
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
朱丽叶竞速是阿尔法罗密欧旗下的最受欢迎的汽车之一。
由于竞速所属的车系下还有一台四门轿车，所以
它也被称为“朱丽叶轿跑”。
这是一辆世界闻名的跑车，由天才汽车设计师
乔盖托·乔治亚罗操刀设计。
阿尔法罗密欧从创立之初就致力于制造用于参加
大奖赛的高速赛车。
因此长期积累了制造�5�性能引擎所需的技术知识。
这辆朱丽叶竞速虽然个头不大，但它由一台强大的
直列四缸双凸轮轴引擎驱动。
加上后轮驱动的加持，绝对能够带来刺激的驾驶体验。
而且这辆车也是超轻量级GTA车型的开发基础车型之一。�
legacyUnmatchedReview.car: Alfa Romeo GIULIA TZ2 carrozzata da ZAGATO '65
legacyUnmatchedReview.resolvedCar: Alfa Romeo Giulia Sprint GT Veloce '67
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Chris
legacyUnmatchedReview.resolvedCarNameEn: Alfa Romeo Giulia Sprint GT Veloce '67
legacyUnmatchedReview.resolvedCarNameZh: Alfa Romeo Giulia Sprint GT Veloce '67

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution is an iconic turbocharged 
4-wheel-drive Japanese sports car.
It's affectionately known as the "Evo."
The early Evos have won the hearts of countless fans thanks to
their stellar performance at world rally championships.
Although Mitsubishi has not competed in a 
world rally competition since 2005...
...the Evo's popularity only continues to grow.
Historically speaking, this Evo X "Final Edition" was
the last production car to be produced of the series.
It featured a tuned-up engine capable of outputting
an astounding .
You can bet that its value on the international market
will only continue to appreciate with time.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
三菱蓝瑟翼豪陆神是标志性的日本
四轮驱动涡轮增压跑车。
车迷都称这辆车为“翼豪陆神”……
由于这一系列车型在世界拉力赛中表现出众，
赢得了无数粉丝的喜爱。
虽然自2005年以来，三菱和翼豪陆神
一直没有参加世界拉力赛……
但这款翼豪陆神的热度却不减反增。
回顾其发展史，翼豪陆神X的“终极版”车型是这系列的
最后一款量产车型。
这个版本的车型搭载更强大的引擎，
输出功率高达令人震惊的。
可以保证，这款车型将来
在国际市场上的价值只会越来越高。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Chris

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This car is one of the most legendary creations
in Alfa Romeo's storied history.
Alfa Romeo was once a purveyor of the world's foremost
race cars and premium GT vehicles.
What we have here is a modern rendition of the cars
from that period.
From its name to its styling, it conjures up memories
of the company as it was in the 1930s and 1940s.
Although it employs a� FR drive system, the transmission
has been mounted at the rear.
The transaxle assembly was meant to improve
weight distribution.
While the name and legacy are enough to give you chills,
wait until you get behind the �heel and drive it!
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这款车是阿尔法罗密欧史上最富传奇色彩的作品之一。
阿尔法罗密欧曾专注于制造赛车和高级GT车型。
这款车则是用现代手法
来演绎那段时期的代表之作。
这款车从称谓到款式，无一不唤起人们对
阿尔法罗密欧在20世纪30和40年代的记忆。
虽然采用前置后驱系统，
不过变速器却置于后方……
采用跨轴布局，目的是
改善重量分布。
不仅在称谓和外观上令人振奋，
这款车的驾驭感受也非常梦幻！
legacyUnmatchedReview.car: Alfa Romeo GIULIA TZ2 carrozzata da ZAGATO '65
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Chris

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This car looks beautiful from every angle.
It's a real work of art.
I see, it’s a special Mazda concept car.
You can tell right away it’s a sports car,
but it’s so elegant and refined.
The engine sound is a real surprise!
I didn’t know an engine could sound so crisp and clear.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
无论从哪个角度看，这辆车都是那么的漂亮迷人。
我知道了！所以这是一辆马自达的特别概念赛车！
我是说，你一眼就能看出这是一辆跑车，但它的外形是那么优雅，
那么让人目眩神迷。
可是发动机的声音真的是让人大吃一惊！
我从来不知道发动机也可以发出如此清脆的声音！%
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Stella

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
You know when you look at this car from an angle 
it looks like an Italian car, it's so beautiful.
Huh, what's with this gauge that’s mounted in
this weird position?
Ohh, so they've already got a place for the boost gauge 
for the turbo.
With the boost gauge in your face like that
It probably makes you wanna drive faster!
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
你从某个角度看这辆车的时候，它就像一台意大利车那
样美丽。
嗯？安装在这个奇怪位置的仪表是怎么回事？
哦哦，所以他们为涡轮增压表特意找了一个位置。
像这样把仪表装在你面前，大概会让你想要开得更快吧！9
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Stella

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The 2015 RUF RGT 4.2 is based on the Porsche 991,
with bespoke modifications to RUF specs.
Most noteworthy is the naturally-aspirated flat-6,
punched out to 4.2 liters...
...and 525 hp.
Visually, it is recognizable by its aluminum wheels
and wide wheel arches.
This gives it a great stance and a menacing look!
The rear "ducktail" is of RUF’s own design.
It first appeared on the RT-35 at the 2012 Geneva
Motor Show.?
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
2015款如虎RGT 4.2是基于原版保时捷991，
按照如虎规格进行定制改装的车型。
最引人注目的是其自然吸气水平对置六缸引擎，
排量增大到4.2升……
输出功率高达525马力。
在外观上，它以铝合金轮毂和加宽的轮拱为醒目特征。
这造就了车身出色的姿态和极具威慑力的外观！
后部的“鸭尾”扰流板是如虎自主设计的……
它首次亮相于2012年日内瓦车展上展出的Rt 35车型。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Freeman Thomas

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The 2016 TT Cup is exciting in that it's 
an extremely well-proportioned racecar...
...when compared to the production-based street version. 
I like the fender forms that hint at the original TT, 
but these are bolder and wider.
The graphics are pure Audi Sport 
with the red, gray and silver.
I also like the black wheels brought out 
to the maximum track width.
It gives the car an amazing stance that's more absolute!
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
2016 TT杯是一辆让人心生悸动的赛车，
因为和量产的街车版本相比……
……它更加的“匀称”。
我喜欢这辆车的挡泥板设计，
有点原版TT的味道，不过做得更大也更宽。
红灰银涂装是奥迪运动的官方风格。
漆黑的轮毂我也觉得不错，
而且他们将轮距加宽到了极致，
让整车造型看上去更加坚定和动态。
这台车的设计语言非常大胆，也非常引人注目！
legacyUnmatchedReview.car: Audi Sport quattro S1 Pikes Peak '87
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Freeman Thomas

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The Prius caused a great sensation by being
the world’s first mass-produced hybrid car.
But did you know its first-gen design was considered
to be somewhat lacking?
The second-generation model featured a one-motion profile
from its front to its coda tronca rear.
This became standard for the Prius line, as you can see in
this well-formed third-generation model.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
作为全球首款混动汽车，普锐斯曾引发轰动性的风潮。
不过你知道吗？它的第一代设计被普遍认为有所欠缺，
不够完美。
从第二代车型开始，普锐斯采用了从车头到
“断尾”车尾的一体成形轮廓……
这随后就成为了普锐斯产品系列的标准设计，
你在这款外形美观的第三代车型中也能看到。[
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Hideo Kodama

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
What's interesting about this car is that the bodywork was penned
by a young Giugiaro, who was then the chief designer at Ghia.
It seems so simple, it looks to drawn by a single brush stroke,
thus the shape consists of simple lines and surfaces.
A half century later,
the car still looks fresh and alluring.
It shares the same backbone chassis technology as 
the original Vallelunga, with a Ford V-8 housed within.
Access to the mid-mounted engine comes
via a butterfly-type rear hatch.
This detail is also particularly interesting and fun. I like it.n
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这辆车最令人着迷之处全在于它的车身，
这是由车身制造公司吉亚后来的首席设计师，
当时才初出茅庐的乔盖托·乔治亚罗执笔设计的。
它的外形如此简洁、仿佛是一笔而就，
因此其形状都为简单的线、面所构成。
在半个世纪后的今天，依然有新鲜感和吸引力。
它采用了与其原型瓦莱伦加相同的脊骨式车架技术，
搭载福特V8引擎。
掀开鸥翼式的后备箱盖，就可以看到这台中置引擎。
这个细节特别有趣味。我很喜欢。P
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Hideo Kodama

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The 308 can be considered the progenitor of all modern
8-cylinder Ferraris, and the most popular of them all.
And, perhaps it was also the longest-lasting.
 Its production run spanned from 1975 to 1989, 
including the derivative version, the 328.
Besides its technical aspects, the car's success came 
from an extremely balanced and pure design.
It's almost timeless.
It serves as a perfect example of Pininfarina’s design
philosophy applied to�the cars of the Cavallino.
In fact, it takes up some classical themes from the Dino
246, such as the progressive wave on the two-wheel arches...
...and the iconic side air intake, 
but also the dynamic rear pillars.
And, of course, the truncated tail with
four round taillights.
However, all of it was transformed into a very essential 
and modern shaping for the time.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
308不仅是所有现代8缸法拉利跑车的鼻祖，
而且无疑是所有车款当中最受欢迎的一款。
它可能也是持续量产最久的一款法拉利。
如果将328版本也算进去，
其生产时间足足从1975年延续到1989年。
这都要归功于它纯粹且经得起时代考验的设计。
在评论家口中，它的平衡性同样首屈一指……
还完美诠释了宾尼法利纳的设计理念。

legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
V12 Vantage GT3在2012年的
英国GT锦标赛上初露峥嵘。
你来猜猜它的主场表现如何？
在七个赛季的67场比赛中，它几乎每次都能登上领奖台。
更夸张的是，它在超过三成的比赛中
站上了最高领奖台！
毋庸置疑，这是一台
值得被铭记在GT3历史中的传奇赛车。
事实上，直到2019年，它才把接力棒
传给它的V8车型继任者……
这辆了不起的赛车将其漫长的职业生涯都献给了GT赛事
的最前线。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Most every rally-racing enthusiast knows about the "Evo."
The Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution is really that historic.
This is the Evo III, the third-generation model.
It's a car with a storied history.
It helped Mitsubishi ace driver Tommi Mäkinen win
his first WRC drivers title in 1996.
Mäkinen then went on to win four consecutive
drivers titles piloting different iterations of the "Evo."
He was truly a legendary rally driver.
And, the car that put him on his path to history was a rally
car based on this Mitsubishi Lancer Evo III.@
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
每一个拉力赛的车迷都对“翼豪陆神”了如指掌！
三菱蓝瑟翼豪陆神就是有这么出名。
这台是翼豪陆神III，第三代车型，有着一段传奇的历史……
当三菱的王牌车手，托米·马基宁在96年世界拉力锦标赛上
赢得首个车手冠军时，驾驶的便是这辆车。
此后，马基宁驾驶着不同迭代版本的“翼豪陆神”
拿下了车手冠军四连胜！
他是拉力赛史上的传奇车手！
而助他走上荣耀之路的正是基于这台
三菱蓝瑟翼豪陆神III开发的拉力赛车。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Remember the R34 Skyline GT-R? I was a big fan
of that car.
Sadly, it made its exit from the All Japan GT Championship in 2003.
But then, in 2004, it came back…
...when Nissan’s in-house works team, Nismo, poured all
of its racing know-how into a street-legal GT-R version.
That’s right, I’m talking about the Nismo R34 GT-R Z-tune!
Apparently, d�velopment started on this project
back in 1999.
In other words, when the R34 Skyline GT-R was at the height
of its racing prowess!
To be able to see such a special GT-R up-close like this
is really a great honor!]
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
还记得R34天际线GT-R吗？我是它的忠实粉丝。
遗憾的是，这台车在2003年退出了全日本GT锦标赛的舞台。
不过在随后的2004年，
日产自家厂队NISMO倾注其所有赛车技术打造出了
一款可以合法上路的GT-R，让它便重回大众视野……
没错，我说的就是NISMO R34 GT-R Z-tune！
不难猜�$，这一项目的开发工作早在1999年就开始了。
换句话说，开发在R34天际线GT-R还在
实力巅峰的时候就开始了！
能够如此近距离地观赏这样一台特别的GT-R，
真是莫大的荣幸！*
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This is a fifth-generation Corvette, called the C5
from 2001.
It was a truly unforgettable chapter in the Corvette's legacy.
It was when a C5-based GT racer known as the "C5-R"...
...achieved a stunning overall victory at the 24 Hours 
of Daytona.
Just a few months later, it secured a class 
win at Le Mans...
...followed by yet another triumph in 2002.
Beloved by many, the C5-R is still considered
among the fastest GT cars in the world!c
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这是一辆第五代科尔维特——
尽管是一辆2001款的C5。
对于科尔维特而言，这是载入史册的年份。
基于C5打造的超级跑车“C5-R”
不仅在戴通纳24小时耐力赛斩获全场总冠军，
数月后更在勒芒赛场摘得本组别桂冠，
并在2002年成功卫冕！
这台深受车迷爱戴的C5-R，至今仍是
全球最快的超级跑车之一。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This 1969 Camaro Race-Mod is classic on the outside
and thoroughly modern beneath the skin.
In other words, it captures the true spirit of a
properly executed restomod.
It draws inspiration from the legendary Camaro Z28, built
to compete in the Trans-Am Series of the late 1960s.
Here, the Z28 returns as a bespoke custom creation,
courtesy of Gran Turismo.
Set lower to the pavement, it wears a rev�sed bumper
and an array of aggressive aero components.
At the rear, a pronounced ducktail spoiler pairs
with a center-exit exhaust.
Under the hood sits a formidable supercharged V-8.
Now it’s time to see what it can do.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这辆科迈罗1969 Race-Mod，虽然保留了经典外观，
内里却焕然一新。
可以说，它完美诠释了修复改装车的顶尖水准。
此车的原型车是传奇的科迈罗Z28，
为了征战1960年代风靡一时的泛美房车锦标赛而生。
如今，科迈罗Z28以一款原创定制车的身份荣耀回归，
由《跑车浪漫旅》倾情呈现。
车身姿态经过精心�.�校，更为低趴，并配备了
专属前保险杠与大量全新空气动力学套件。
车尾则装有一个醒目的大型鸭尾式扰流板，
并采用中置排气布局。
至于它的心脏，则是一台动力磅礴的机械增压V8引擎！
现在，我真想一睹它在赛道上飞驰的风采！�

The Subaru Impreza? 
It was really famous in motorsports too right? And so this is the final version of the special models?'The most refined and rare…'
You really like this car huh.

斯巴鲁翼豹在赛车圈里相当有名对不对？而且这台是这款特殊车型的最终版？“最精致且最罕见的……”
那你真的很喜欢这辆车哈。

This is the car every car designer dreams of doing!
It’s gorgeous!
Its influence is, of course, the 917!
The cabin is low and sleek, with extreme cab-forward
architecture, like that of the original 917.
The windshield shape is like a visor wrapping
around the sides...
...while the front has a bit of 918 DNA.
A slightly restrained low, narrow mouth...
.�.and four headlamps seem to forecast the new Porsche
headlight DNA of the 919, raced at Le Mans.
The wheels are similar to the 918.
The rear spoiler is interesting, as it connects the fender
forms and has the taillamp integrated flush below.
The paint scheme is inspired by the Le-Mans-winning
"Porsche-Salzburg" 917K...
...run by the Porsche-Piech family team in Austria.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这是一款所有汽车设计师都梦寐以求想要打造的车型！
它简直太漂亮了！
这也是理所当然的，毕竟参照的基础车型可是917！
和原版917一样，它的驾驶舱高度较低，呈流线型设计，
并采用了驾驶舱极度前置的结构。
挡风玻璃的形状更像是一副包裹住侧面的面罩……
前脸略微透露出918的血统。
其略显克制且低窄的进气口……
和四盏大灯则预言了随后在勒芒参赛的919
所引领的保时捷大灯设计理念。
它的轮毂与918类似。
其后扰流板与挡泥板直接相连，从而将尾灯顺畅地
整合在下方，显得趣味十足。
它的涂装方案灵感来源于由奥地利的保时捷·皮耶希家族
车队经营，并在勒芒取得胜利的……
“保时捷·萨尔茨堡�&917K。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Freeman Thomas

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The 2011 Audi R18 TDI LMP1 marked a return to a fixed-roof coupe
body again for the first time since the 1999 R8C.
This, to me, was when design, engineering, and motorsports
came to the perfect intersection for Audi.
Seeing these "Star Wars" coupes in the rain at night,
with wipers and headlights, running at high speed...
Man, that was exciting to watch!
I see them as advanced concepts for the road
that I can relate to.
They were truly a tour de force of technology!
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
2011款奥迪R18 TDI勒芒原型车1级标志着自1999年推出的R8C以来，
奥迪再次引入封闭式双门跑车车身。
对我来说，这款车是奥迪的设计、工程学技术
和赛车运动知识的完美结合！
在漆黑雨夜中，看到这些“星球大战”风格的跑车
顶着独特的雨刷和大灯高速奔驰的身影……
令我激动万分！
我认为这台车体现出了先进的道路交通工具理念，
引发了我的共鸣。
这样的车才是站在技术巅峰的作品！O
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Freeman Thomas

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
It is really a clever design in that it is larger 
than the original but scaled up perfectly! 
 If you put an original next to it, you won't 
believe the difference in size.
The original car was really quite small.
The shut-lines play a key part and play an important role 
in modernizing the GT40.
The larger size allows larger and taller people to fit
comfortably and allows them get in and out easily. 
This is truly an iconic "daily driver" super car 
with Ford reliability and parts access. 
The styling inside and out has proven to be timeless.
A true collector's car for the serious enthusiast.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
他们采取了非常巧妙的设计手法：
扩大车身尺寸，然后完美复刻原车比例！
将两辆车停在一起时，你甚至很难发现它们的差别。
而实际上，GT40要小上一号。
在打造现代版GT40时，
精准化镶板的工艺发挥了重要的作用。
“大号”的新福特GT为身材更高大的驾驶者带来了便利。
这是一款真正能满足日常驾驶的经典超级跑车，
并拥有福特的可靠品质和零部件供应支持。
无论是内饰还是外观，
这辆车的设计都经受得起时间的考验。
这是一辆真正的车迷会选择收藏的好车。<next id=2400808 typ�=9�A
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Freeman Thomas

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The RX-VISION is a car in which I placed
my car designer life on the line.
I worked on it from the standpoint of really making 
the dream sports car I have in my mind.
And one of the most important things for a sports car 
is its fundamental structure.
Historic cars that are still popular and beautiful to look at
today all have exceptionally great proportions.
So the first thing we worked on for the RX-VISION 
was also the s�ructure.
A textbook FR (Front Engine Rear Drive) with a long nose, 
and the ability to place proper load on the rear wheels.
In the final stages, we extended the front nose about 150mm 
from the structure we had originally designed,
the part from the front doors up to the front wheel center.
In the very end we made it a slightly unbalanced proportion...
But at that moment we got a lot of traction on the rear wheels,
and�thought "This will work!"
That slight unbalance is the hook. It's the secret
to making someone go "Hmm".
The other secret is the reflection of light.
If you look at the RX-VISION as you circle it, I think you'll
notice that the light's reflection moves around like a creature.
Cars are like family or friends to those who are into them.
And it's a very rare industrial product 
that runs around on its own.
That makes cars have the same type of existence as animals running
around in the wild, or an athlete running on a field.
And when you think of it that way, I also want cars to be
something that looks beautiful and truly alive in nature.
And for that you need a "sense of life."
So when thinking about what is the sense of life, 
that will put cars at one with nature,
we tried to express life in the car with the light's reflections
6nd their beauty on the car's body.
And those are the type of shapes 
that are instilled in the RX-VISION.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
说到RX-VISION，那可是我赌上专业设计师的身份，
倾注全部心血的作品。
我想通过它，把我脑海中理想跑车的样子变成现实。
设计跑车，最关键的就是定好基本结构。
你看那些经典车型，哪个不是比例优美？
所以我设计RX-VISION时，第一步就是确定它的结构。
我先是采用了教科书般经典的前置引擎后�#�驱动
设计——就是那种前脸很长，重心偏后的布局。
然后，在定稿前的最后一刻，我又把前鼻加长了150mm。

具体来说，就是加在了从前门到前轮中心那一段。
这么一改，车身比例看起来有点不太协调……但是这样
做能让后轮抓地力更强。
当时我就想：“嘿，没准这主意不错！”
就这样，一个小小的设计巧思成了这辆车的独特之处。
RX-VISION还有另一个让人惊喜的地方——光影效果。
只要绕着车子转一圈，你就会觉得它像个有生命的东西。
对于车迷来说，汽车就跟家人朋友一样亲密。
跟一般的工业产品不同，汽车是为了奔跑而生的。
它们有点像在野外奔驰的动物，或是在赛场上飞奔的运
动员。
当我生出这个念头时，我就W��道我不仅要让RX-VISION
美，还要让它“活”起来。
为了达到这个效果，我得给它注入“生命感”。
在思考怎么才能让它看起来更自然时……
我开始实验光线在车身上的反射效果。
就这样，RX-VISION活灵活现地呈现在了大家面前！X
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Ikuo Maeda

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The Porsche 919 Hybrid first competed at the WEC in 2014,
if I’m not mistaken.
This is the 2016 model. The 2014 car had a white
paint job and stylish gray stripes across its body.
Viewed from above, the stripes spelled out the phrase
"PORSCHE INTELLIGENT PERFORMANCE."
Among its many design features was its multi-LED headlight
system, meant to improve night driving.
To implement it, the front wheel arches were
raised, along with the driver’s seat.
The 919’s historic 2016 battle against Toyota’s TS050 was one
that will not soon be forgotten at Le Mans.
Indeed, it marked the beginning of the car’s three-year
winning streak at the famous racing event.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
如果我没记错的话，这台保时捷919 Hybrid
在2014年首次参加了世界耐力锦标赛。
这一台是2016款。因为2014年款采用了白色涂装以及
时尚感十足的灰色条纹，交叉纵横于其车身。
从上方看，这些条纹拼出了标语
“保时捷智慧性能”。
在其众多设计特色中，值得一提的是多LED车头灯系统，
该系统旨在x��高夜间驾驶的性能。
为了实现这一设计，前轮拱罩被特意提高，
驾驶员座椅也跟着被抬高。
919 Hybrid与丰田的TS050之间激烈的2016年勒芒之战
是一个让人难以忘怀的经典时刻……
实际上，正是在这一战尘埃落定之后，该车
在这一著名赛事上开始了为期三年的连庄。�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Kunihisa Ito

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Designed and built by Chrysler's Advanced Design Studios
over the course of 1988 and 1989...
...the Viper was dubbed the "second-coming"
of the Shelby Cobra.
It was co-produced by then-president Bob Lutz
and designer Tom Gale.
Heralding a new era at the New York Auto Show in 2012,
the SRT GTS-R marked the series’ return to racing.
Distinguished by a long nose and short deck body...
...its flat bottom and wing addition dramatically
improved aerodynamics.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这台由克莱斯勒的高级设计工作室于1988年至1989年
设计和制造的Viper又被称作Shelby Cobra的“再现”。
它是由品牌当时的总裁鲍勃·卢茨和设计师汤姆·盖尔协手打造。
2012年纽约车展上，克莱斯勒带着Viper重出江湖，
而SRT GTS-R的命名则代表系列车型回归竞速比赛。
该车具有标志性的长车头和短小平坦的车身……
扁平的底盘和额外的风翼也使得空气动力学效应得到了长足的改进。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Kunihisa Ito

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The plexiglass headlights on the early models and...
...design elements such as the orange indicator lights that
extend on the side...
...are defining symbols of this car.
Also, the grooves that flow in a straight line on the side
of the car are...
...implemented on most Ferraris that followed this car. 
The star-shaped 5-spoke aluminum wheels are also important
symbols of Ferrari's design.
Yes, yes. This wheel originated from a sports prototype car
from the 1960s...
...and was first used on the Daytona.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
早期车型上的有机玻璃大灯和……
侧面的橙色指示灯
之类的设计元素……
都是这款车的主要特征之一。
此外，请注意那些直线形的凹槽……
在此之后被应用到了大多数法拉利上。
星形的五辐铝制车轮也是法拉利设计的重要标志。
事实上，这种轮毂样式源于20世纪60年代设计……
并在戴通纳比赛中投入使用的一台原型跑车。9
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Fabio Filippini

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Unveiled at the Tokyo Motor Show in 2015...
...the MAZDA RX-VISION immediately thrilled design specialists 
with the masterful beauty of its sinuous and complex forms.
The "Kodo" design philosophy of applying emotional shapes
to evoke fluid and natural movement…
...is perfectly expressed in this spectacular concept car.
Consider its low and wide body, large bonnet,
and set-back cockpit.
The side profile is particularly stunning.
This is owing to a controlled use of soft textures
and light reflection.
Almost evoking a kind of Japanese lacquer, 
the flaming red livery...
...helps to amplify the liquid appearance of the RX-VISION’s
beautiful sheet metal surfaces.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
2015年东京车展上首次亮相的……
马自达RX-VISION概念赛车，凭借其复杂而流畅的整体
造型美学立即引起了设计专家们的热烈反响。
马自达“魂动”设计理念旨在通过饱含情感的动态造型呈现
流畅自然的动感……
这款令人惊叹的概念赛车完美诠释了该设计哲学。
它拥有低矮而宽阔的车身、
修长的引��舱盖和靠后的驾驶舱位置。
车身侧面轮廓尤为出众。
这得益于对柔和曲面和光线反射的巧妙运用。
其火焰般的红色车身涂装让人瞬间联想到
日本传统漆器的质感……
进一步强化了RX-VISION车身金属表面的流动美感。4
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Fabio Filippini

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The C6 Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 is wide, low, 
and has the stance and muscle tone of a body builder.
The ZR1 is wider than the standard Corvette
to accommodate the wider tires... 
...and has more aggressive air exits 
in the front fender.
In addition to the wide body, the black roof 
adds to the low, wide look of the design.
I really like the round taillamps!
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
拥有低矮宽体车身的雪佛兰科尔维特C6 ZR1
看上去像一位魁梧的健美运动员。
为了适配更宽的轮胎，它不得不在
标准版科尔维特的基础上继续加宽车身……
并在前挡泥板上加入了造型更显凶猛的通风口。
黑色车顶形成了有趣的视觉效果，进一步强调了
低矮和宽阔的外观设计。
另外，我真的很喜欢它的圆形尾灯！
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Ed Welburn

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The C4 Corvette had plenty of innovation, both on
the inside and outside.
Its design was a marked departure from the curvier C3,
being more angular and wedged-shaped.
This was evident in the clamshell hood
and in the headlamp construction.
Under the hood was a powerful 4-valve DOHC engine.
The ZR-1 also came equipped with wider rear tires and fenders.
The interior was inspired by aircraft design.
Some people say that the C4 lacked
the "soul" of a Corvette.
But I happen to like it plenty.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
C4科尔维特在内部和外部加入了很多创新点。
它有着楔型的车身，更加有棱有角，与C3科尔维特的
波浪状线条相去甚远。
其掀盖式的引擎盖和头灯的结构就是最好的证明。
ZR-1配备了更宽的后胎和后挡泥板……
以便驯服动力强劲的双顶置凸轮轴 4气门引擎。
其内饰的灵感很大程度来源于飞机。
很多人评论说C4科尔维特缺少了一点科尔维特的魂。
但我恰好挺喜欢这款车的。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Ed Welburn

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The Mercedes-Benz 300 SL Coupé is one of the most
recognizable sports cars in the history of automobiles.
Overall, it has a look of "refined speed," and deserves
all of the acclaim it receives.
The 300 SL has some great shapes.
Take, for instance, its hood, fender eyebrows, sloping
tail, and beautifully executed roof and windows.
One of its most distinct design elements are its gullwing
doors, which I think look even better when closed.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
梅赛德斯-奔驰300 SL轿跑是汽车史上
最具辨识度的跑车车型之一。
总体上看，它便是“精致速度”的代表，
完全配得上它所获得的一切赞誉。
300 SL的轮廓中融合了一些美轮美奂的形状……
比如它的引擎盖、挡泥板上缘、下倾的车尾
以及设计精巧的车顶和车窗。
它最特别的一处设计元素就是它的
鸥翼车门，而且我觉得门关上之后甚至更好看了。o
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Ed Welburn

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
In the 1980s, in the midst of a bubble economy, Japan became
the biggest auto producer in the world.
Becoming the leader in the automotive industry requires a lot
of thought about what kind of products should be offered.
It was a time of ambition and decision.
There were lots of discussion of what made
Japanese automotive design distinctive.
Japanese cars from around this time were
embraced by people around the �orld.
When I first saw the white flowing lines of the Celica, or
the A80 Supra, on the cobblestoned streets of Europe,
it was as a mind-blowing experience, reminding me when I first�saw giant tail fins of a Chrysler in Azabu in Tokyo.<next id=2000206 type=9�p
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
日本在20世纪80年代经济蓬勃发展时期，曾短暂地为了世
界上最大的汽车生产国。
在汽车行业的领导地位使其自然而然地产生了许多想法，
希望决定汽车发展的方向……
你可以把它视作一种野心或反思。
在那一时期产生了大量的讨论，探讨日本汽车设计独树
一帜的缘由。
撇开理念不谈，这一时期的日本车确实受{��了全球车迷
的喜爱。
当我真正遇到白色流线造型的赛利卡，或是在欧洲古城的
鹅卵石街道邂逅A80 Supra时，
那种心灵的震撼和耳目一新的感觉就和我小时候在东京
麻布区看到一辆有巨大尾鳍的克莱斯勒时几乎一模一样。�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The Porsche Carrera GTS is hailed as one of the most
beautiful cars of the 1960s.
It is also known as the Porsche 904.
A mass-produced sports car, its design and mid-engine chassis
were clearly built to win races.
As soon as it rolled off the production line in 1964, it set
out to dominate in every race it entered.
Its performance at the famous Targa Florio in Italy
is well known.
The Targa Florio was a road endurance race in Sicily
consisting of a 72km track that was lapped ten times.
Competing in the Targa Florio’s GT2 class in April 1964,
the Carrera GTS...
...bested its rivals Ferrari, Alfa Romeo and Ford, claiming
an impressive overall victory.
The drivers who piloted the Carrera GTS were Antonio Pucci
from Italy, and Colin Davis from England.
In the same year, the Carrera GTS also won class victories�
at Sebring and Le Mans.
A year later, in 1965, it won again at the
Targa Florio and elsewhere.*
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
保时捷Carrera GTS被誉为二十世纪六十年代
最美的汽车之一。
它还有另一个名字——保时捷904。
作为一款量产跑车，它的设计和中置引擎底盘
很明显是为了赢得比赛而设计的。
当这款车在1964年开下生产线后，它立刻
就向全世界证明了自己的实力。
这辆车在意大利的塔格·佛罗热大赛上的杰出�?�现举世闻名。
塔格·佛罗热大赛是一项在意大利西西里举行的公路耐力赛，
需要跑完十圈共计72公里。
这辆Carrera GTS于1964年4月参加了
塔格·佛罗热大赛的GT2组别……
击败了法拉利、阿尔法罗密欧和福特等对手，光荣地赢得了总冠军！
完成这一伟大成就的车手是来自意大利的安东尼奥·普基
和来自英格兰的科林·戴维斯。
在�+�一年，Carrera GTS还赢得了赛百灵12小时耐力赛
和勒芒24小时耐力赛的冠军。
一年之后的1965年，它又气势汹汹地杀回塔格·佛罗热大赛
和多项其他比赛，并再度夺魁！�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The Peugeot 205 T16 made its WRC debut in Race 5 of the 1984
season, at the Tour de Corse.
Although it managed only a 4th-place finish, it dominated the
latter half of the season, winning Rounds 9, 10, and 12.
From the very beginning, the car showed amazing potential!
The secret to the 205 T16’s exceptional speed lies
in its innovative engineering.
It was the first Group B rally car to feature a�l-wheel drive
and a mid-mounted engine.
This machine was a true gamechanger!
In the blink of an eye, it took the crown from the Audi Quattro,
the reigning front-engine 4x4 champion.
It then went on to claim consecutive WRC titles
in 1985 and 1986!�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
标致205 T16在1984赛季的第5场比赛——
科西嘉岛拉力赛中首次亮相世界拉力锦标赛，
只获得了第4名。
但在赛季的后半段，它主宰了比赛，
赢得了第9、10和12站的冠军。
从亮相的那一年起，这款车一直在飞驰不息！
205 T16的卓越速度的秘密在于其精湛的工程技术。
它也是B组中第一款采用中置引擎和全v��驱动的拉力赛车。
是汽车革命的全方位体现！
它以迅雷不及掩耳之势取代了先前
由奥迪quattro（一款前置四驱赛车）占据的冠军地位……
并在1985年和1986年连续两年赢得
世界拉力锦标赛的总冠军！�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The Tour de Corse?
It's a famous rally event that takes place on the
French island of Corsica.
The 1964 Tour de Corse was particularly a classic.
Only eight cars out of 79 managed to complete the race!
What's more, Renault's R8 Gordini claimed 1st, 3rd,
4th and 5th place!
It was quite the remarkable achievement.
Gordini was an engine manufacturer, originally established
by the Italian driver and engineer Amedeo Gordini.
The R8 Gordini came about through a collaboration with
Renault.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
科西嘉岛拉力赛？
嗯，这是一项著名的拉力赛事，在法国的科西嘉岛上
举行。
1964年的科西嘉岛拉力赛特别经典。
79辆参赛汽车中只有8辆成功完成了比赛！
而雷诺的R8 Gordini就囊括了第一、第三、第四和第五名！
这是相当了不起的成就。
戈迪尼是一家引擎制造商，由意大利车手和工程师阿
梅戴·戈迪尼一手创办。
R8 Gordini就是其与雷诺合作的产物。;
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This is one of my favorite Skylines—the R31, and a Group A
homologation GTS-R!
Who could forget its performance at the Japanese Touring Car
Championship, Japan’s top touring car series in the 1980s?
It's no doubt best known for its performance
in the 1989 JTC season.
That year saw three Skyline GTS-Rs competing on the track.
Masahiro Hasemi and Anders Olofsson’s
No. 50 car won three of six races!
What a way to clinch the series title!
And the way it stood up to those mighty European cars...it was a sight to behold!
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh: 这是我最爱的一辆Skyline——R31，而且这辆GTS-R 还获得了A组别认证！ 它在1980年代日本顶级房车赛事——日本房车锦标赛上 的优异表现实在让人过目难忘！ 它最亮眼的一次表现无疑是在1989年日本房车锦标赛系列赛上。 就在这一年，三辆Skyline GTS-R在比赛中同台竞技…… 其中长谷见昌弘和安德斯·奥洛夫松驾驶的50号赛车 赢下了六场比赛中的半数！ 这是多么震撼人心的夺冠过程啊！ 更不必说它勇敢挑战那些强大欧洲赛车的英姿—— 真是太酷了！
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
When it comes to R35 GT-R race cars, the Nissan MOTUL
AUTECH GT-R is perhaps the best of them all!
It won two consecutive Super GT championships in the GT500
class, starting in 2014.
It also began the 2016 season in unbelievable
form.
It took the first two races, at Okayama and the
Fuji International Speedway, respectively.
These victories made it the odds-on favorite to win its
t�ird series champion in a row.
The car was atop the rankings going into the final race...
However, because of the ballast it was required to carry,
it could only manage a 7th-place finish in the race.
This meant that it ended the season in
3rd place for the series.
The MOTUL Autech team did give it all it had,
but just came up a little short.
The drivers were Tsugio Matsuda and Ronnie �uintarelli.
They showed amazing speed all season long, and today,
they're still at it and still winning races!�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
说起R35 GT-R赛车的话，
日产MOTUL AUTECH GT-R绝对是其中的王者。
从2014年开始，这辆车已经在GT500级别的
Super GT锦标赛中连续获胜了两次。
它在2016赛季中的开局也是势不可挡……
在冈山的第一场和富士赛道的第二场中接连获胜！
在当时看来，这辆车拿下第三个锦标赛冠军已经是板上钉钉的事了��
在赛事进行到最后一场时，它在排名中依然名列前茅……
但是沉重的压舱物使它在这场比赛中惜败，只获得了第七名。
这意味着，这辆车在这个季度中仅以第三名完赛。
他们没能上演帽子戏法，真是太可惜了！
不过，松田次生和罗尼·昆塔雷利的老司机团队无疑是非常快的！
他们俩现在�8�已步入四十，但却依然没有一丝慢下来的迹象！ �
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Can you name for me the world’s highest hill climb,
held annually in the state of Colorado?
That’s right! The Pikes Peak International Hill Climb,
a race with more than a century of history.
Built to dominate the competition at Pikes Peak was
the Suzuki V6 Escudo, a 900kg beast.
It was a machine that required a monster talent to tame.
So, it was fitting that piloting the Escudo was�a driver named
Nobuhiro "Monster" Tajima.
A veritable dirt veteran, Tajima-san claimed seven
straight wins at the All-Japan Dirt Trial Championship.
In 1995, he became the first Japanese driver to win
the overall cha�pionship at Pikes Peak.<
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
你知道在美国科罗拉多州每年举办的
世界海拔最高的登山赛吗？
正是拥有百年历史的派克峰国际爬坡赛！
铃木V6 Escudo这台仅有900公斤重的机械猛兽，
正是为赢得派克峰爬坡赛而生。
想要驯服这头狂暴怪兽，就需要一名怪兽级车手……
他便是有着“怪兽田岛”名号的田岛伸博。
这位砂石路面的绝对统治者，曾七度蝉联
全日本砂道锦标赛冠军。
1995年，他更是成为首位在派克峰赛事中
斩获全场总冠军的日本车手。
