legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Have you ever heard of the German ADAC GT Masters?
It's a race where each car has a pair of drivers, 
one amateur and one pro.
For the 2016 ADAC Masters, Chevrolet entered a 
Corvette C7 FIA-GT3.
The following year, they claimed both driver and
team championships.
This is a car that an amateur can handle, but which can
also withstand any punishment a pro can throw at it.
Yep, in terms of performance, this Corvette C7 Gr.3
machine is quite something.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
你听说过全德汽车协会超跑大师赛？
这是一场需要两位车手：一位新人车手、一位资深车手
交替参赛的比赛。
在2016年的全德汽车协会大师赛中，雪佛兰派出了科尔维特C7 国际汽联-GT3。
在之后一年，他们同时拿下了车手和车队总冠军。
这台车不仅操控平易近人，适合新手，又能经受住专业
选手的“折磨”。
可以肯定，科尔维特C7组别3在性能方面很有一套。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This is the 1997 winner of the All Japan GT Championships.
It's a truly valuable race car indeed.
It's also famed for being the first car to take the title from the
Nissan teams, which were dominating the GT Championships.
The Tom's Supra first appeared in 1994, which means
it took four years for them to reach this point.
With a glorious race history and historical value,
this is a treasure for sure.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这款赛车是1997年全日本房车锦标赛的冠军车，是一辆
真正有价值的赛车。
它也是第一辆从一直统治该项锦标赛的
日产手中夺走冠军头衔的赛车。
这款TOM's Supra于1994年亮相，花费了整整四年时间
才取得了如此殊荣。
兼具辉煌的赛史和极高的历史价值，这辆车必定是一笔
珍贵财富。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Chris

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The Toyota Land Cruiser is the vehicle that effectively wrote
the first chapter of Japanese off-road history.
Released in 1960, the “40” marked the third-generation model.
In Japan, fans affectionately call it the “Yonmaru,” a nickname
drawn from the Japanese pronunciation of its model number.
A commercial vehicle built to haul goods in agriculture and
farming, it also served first-responders in times of emergency.
Above all else, it was created with one purpose in mind—
to be a true “working vehicle."
From its ladder-frame chassis to its suspension, every component
was engineered with durability in mind.
Well-built and dependable, it embodied all the qualities
that made the Land Cruiser a legend.
With an impressive production run that has lasted 24 years...
...this best-selling SUV has made the Land Cruiser a household name
al� over the world.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
丰田Land Cruiser是真正开创
日本越野历史的车型。
这款1960年发布的“40系”是第三代车型。
它被日本车迷亲切地称为“四丸”，
这个昵称源自其车型编号的日语发音。
作为旨在运输农业物资和进行紧急救援的商用车辆……
它的首要且最重要的设计目的是成为一款“工具车”。
从梯形车架底盘{��悬挂系统，
每个部件都可谓为经久耐用而打造。
制造精良且可靠耐用，它完美体现了
Land Cruiser的所有优秀特质。
凭借长达24年的辉煌生产周期……
这款畅销车型让Land Cruiser之名
享誉全球，家喻户晓。A
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Chris

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Now, there's a beauty! This isn’t just any Supra, you know.
It's known as a "homologation model," meaning 
it was developed primarily as a race car.
Toyota's reason for creating it was to win the Group A
title in the Japanese Touring Car Championship.
To ensure it was battle-ready, the engineers performed 
various mechanical upgrades.
These included a turbine and intercooler, as well as parts 
�or naturally-aspirated and turbocharged engines.
As a result, the Turbo A produced  more
than the base model.
With production capped at 500 units, this homologation model
sold out in the blink of an eye.
Aside from the wheel color and bumper shape, it doesn’t
look too different from its forebear.
However, those in the know will instantly
recognize its worth.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
天啊！这可不是一辆普通的Supra……
这是一辆为竞赛而生的“赛事认证”型。
丰田当时想用这辆车夺得日本房车锦标赛的A组别桂冠。
为了准备这项赛事，这辆车得到了多处机械升级。
这些升级包括一台涡轮机和中冷器，以及
自然吸气和涡轮增压发动机的部件。
这些升级使v��辆车的马力比基础车型提高了。
由于生产上限是500辆，“赛事认证”型转眼间就卖光了。
除了轮毂颜色和保险杠形状之外，
它的外形与基本型完全一样。
然而，有眼光的人
肯定一眼就能看出它的价值！�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Chris

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The original 2001 996 based GT3 is 
one of the best kept "insider" Porsche secrets!
Technically and mechanically,
it's the most raw of all the GT3s!
It featured a naturally aspirated GT1/Mezger flat-6 in a 
reinforced chassis geared towards motorsports.
The success of the GT3 was unexpected with 
demand exceeding the limited production runs!
Pure magic!;
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
2001款996 GT3是保时捷最大的秘密武器之一！
无论是技术方面，还是机械方面，
这款车型的凶悍程度都冠绝保时捷所推出的所有GT3！
它搭载了来自GT1/梅茨格的自然进气水平对置六缸引擎
以及赛车级的强化悬挂。
GT3的成功来得如此突然，订单纷至沓来，
远超原有的限量发售数！
这辆车简直像有魔力一般！>
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Freeman Thomas

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
With more mid-engine cars from Ford and Ferrari winning
in LM-GTE, WEC and American IMSA events...
...Porsche needed to do something.
Styled by Gran Larson in 2017...
...this mid-engine 911 RSR was a bold move.
Back in 1996, Porsche tried something similar,
getting Tony Hatter to design...
...a mid-engine 911 GT1 based on the 933.
The 2017 RSR silhouette hides...
...its mid-engine architecture, making it look
like a rear-engine 991.
That said, it is wider and more aggressive.
As the saying goes in the automobile industry...
..."Win on Sunday, sell on Monday!"
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
当越来越多的中置引擎福特和法拉利赛车在勒芒房车耐力赛、
世界耐力锦标赛和美国国际赛车运动协会等赛事中取得成功……
保时捷也必须要设法迎头赶上！
这辆中置引擎的911 RSR由格兰·拉尔森在2017设计……
算是保时捷相当激进的一步！
早在1996年，保时捷就已经进行过类似的尝试，
让托尼·哈特尔设计出……
一款基�$�933的中置引擎911 GT1。
这辆2017 RSR的外形轮廓巧妙掩饰了……
它的中置引擎架构，让它看上去像一辆引擎后置的991。
尽管如此，它的车身相对更宽，整体外形也更具侵略性！
就像是汽车行业内一句俗话说的那样……
“周日一胜，周一大卖！”
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Freeman Thomas

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
There is simply no pure racecar 
more stylish and appealing than the 250 P.
There hasn't been one before it or after it.
Even if this car was designed strictly for racing, 
it doesn't feel that the priority was placed on winning races. 
You can say that the 250 P is the ultimate expression of 
Ferrari's 1960s-era mid-engine racecar styling. 
In terms of design, the fender lines and surfaces 
�nflect strong emotional expressions...
... and that's what gives this car its Italian flavor.
After this car, even Ferrari's racecars became a bit visually dry, 
with the priorities placed on performance and function. 
This masterpiece symbolizes an era when racecars were beautiful.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
我的观点是，330 P4是最时尚、最具魅力的纯血赛车，
前无古人，后无来者。
尽管这辆车是严格按照竞赛标准设计的，
但如果你只看外观，赢得比赛似乎并不是它的最高设计准则。
可以说330 P4就是法拉利在1960年代
中置引擎赛车设计的终极体现。
从设计美学的角度分析，它的侧面线条和轮廓
既流畅�"�又充满力量感……
……呈现出独有的意大利风貌。
在它之后，就连法拉利的赛车都开始变得
不那么重视美感，而是将优先级放在性能和功能上。
这款杰作代表了那个赛车也可以很美的时代。�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
In America, the De Tomaso Pantera is still quite popular. 
The Pantera is a model originally developed by Ford, but
it strongly possesses Italian supercar qualities.
It was an affordable super car...
So instead of keeping it tucked away for safe keeping, many
owners enjoyed tuning their car to their own tastes.u
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
德托马索Pantera在美国依然非常受欢迎。
Pantera车型最初由福特开发，却拥有多处
强烈的意大利超级跑车特质。
而且是一辆价格相对较为实惠的超跑……
所以许多车主并没有将他们的爱车束之高阁，
而是按照自己的喜好进行改装。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The TS050 Hybrid is the pride of Japan, and one car that 
I’d really like to take to the track!
The year 2016 was when Toyota introduced the bright white,
red, and black color scheme for its GAZOO Racing cars.
It was also the year that two TS050s faced off against
the Porsche 919 at Le Mans.
Tragically, a mere six minutes from the finish line, the lead
Toyota car suffered engine trouble and lost the race.
However, in 2018, 33 years after its first Le Mans appearance,
Toyota took home an incredible overall victory.
It was the first Japanese car to do so since the Mazda
787B’s win in 1991.<next id=1901006 typ�=9�A
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
TS050 Hybrid是日本的骄傲，同时也是我
非常渴望在赛道上驾驶的一款车！
2016年，丰田为旗下所属的Gazoo Racing车队引入了
鲜艳的白色、红色和黑色配色方案。
这一年也是两辆TS050与保时捷919在勒芒
展开激烈对决的一年。
不幸的是，距离终点仅有6分钟时，领先的丰田赛车却遭遇
引擎故障，输掉了比赛。
不过，在2018年，在距离首次亮相勒芒已经
过去33年之际，丰田却取得了令人难以置信的全面胜利。
这是继1991年马自达787B赢得比赛后，日本车队首次在勒芒夺冠。]
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Kunihisa Ito

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The Testarossa recalls the exuberance of the 1980s—
teen posters and American TV.
In fact, its design was spectacular and ostentatious,
totally the opposite of the 512 BB it replaced.
First of all, the Testarossa impressed with its size.
Note the imposing S-shaped volume of its tail 
and huge, iconic air inlets.
This was copied by tuners and coachbuilders the world over
and was refl�cted in modified, banal city cars.
That’s how innovative it was!
Of particular note was the black grille, which hid
the rectangular rear lights...
...that replaced, for the first time, the signature round
taillights of previous Ferraris.
Another memorable oddity...
...was the single side-mirror suspended in the middle of the
pillar, which was present in the very first versions.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
Testarossa令人回想起80年代的狂热——
就好像当时的青少年海报和美国电视剧的张扬风格。
它的设计与前辈512 BB迥然不同，抢眼而张扬。
首先，Testarossa以其庞大的尺寸给人留下深刻的印象。
其巨大的楔形车尾和侧面巨大的标志性进气口也同样令人瞩目。
这一设计引得世界各地的改装者和车身制w��商纷纷效仿
——许多普通的城市车辆都被改装成这个样子，
成为了开创一代潮流的鼻祖！
特别值得一提的是，黑色的进气格栅内其实
隐藏了矩形尾灯……
这是法拉利首次摒弃之前车型经典的圆形尾灯。
另一个令人过目不忘的奇特设计……
是最早期版本中悬挂在A柱中央的单个侧后视镜。�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Fabio Filippini

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The sixth-generation of the Toyota Celica has the most
character of all the models in its long lineage.
What we have here is the rally version.
Aesthetically, it’s nearly identical to the production car,
apart from the raised rear wing and a few aero features.
An example of modern Japanese "bio-design," it is notably
distinguished by its four rounded headlights.
Meanwhile, in other places...
...the Celica draws inspiration from other Toyota sports coupes
of its day, such as the Supra and the Soarer.R
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
第六代丰田赛利卡在其悠久的族系历史上拥有
最独特的个性。
我们眼前的是一辆拉力赛版本车型。
从外观上看，除了抬高的尾翼和安装了几项
空气动力学套件，它和量产版车型几乎别无二致。
这款车是现代日本“仿生设计”的完美示例，
其四盏圆形大灯尤其彰显了这一特色。
与此同时，你可以在多处设计上看到……
赛利卡从当时的其他丰田运动型双门跑车，
例如Supra和Soarer身上汲取了不少灵感。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Fabio Filippini

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The design is modified with larger grilles and sporty bumpers,
side skirts and 17-inch alloy wheels.
It also reflects the original vintage livery with red stripes and
other colored elements like the mirrors and brake calipers.
And the two large, enameled badges on the front and rear
show the original colors of the famous Scorpio logo.
But the most exciting thing...
...is the fantastic “sound design” coming from the
rear dual exhausts!
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
在升级方面，阿巴斯500的设计采用了更大的格栅、运动型保
险杠、侧裙和17英寸铝合金轮毂。
而且还引入了象征原版复古涂装的红色条纹以及应用于
后视镜和刹车卡钳的其他色彩元素。
车前和车后两个精美无比的大型珐琅徽章展示了品牌原
版配色的著名天蝎座标志。
但最激动人心的……
当属来自后段双出排气管的美妙的“声音设计”！?
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Fabio Filippini

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
GTA is an acronym for "Gran Turismo Alleggerita," the legendary 
race version of the 1965 Alfa Romeo Giulia Sprint.
It dominated the Touring Car championships 
in Italy and Europe.
This limited, "mean" version of the new Giulia sedan fully
captures its original spirit and exuberant performance.
The design also shows its sportiness with a big front grille, 
wide fenders and carbon-fiber aerodynamic elements.
Even the Alfa shield is made of carbon-fiber!
And the huge 20-inch alloy wheels have a single central nut, 
like on real race cars.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
GTA是“轻量版超级跑车”的缩写，
它是传奇的1965 Alfa Romeo Giulia Sprint的公路赛车版本。
后者曾主宰了意大利乃至全欧洲的房车锦标赛。
这款“用料节省”的全新限量版Giulia轿车完全把握住了
原车型的精髓和卓越的性能。
在外观设计上，更是以巨大的前格栅、宽挡泥板和一大堆
美观的碳纤维空气动力学组件忠实再现了Sprin�的运动感
——甚至连阿尔法·罗密欧车标的盾徽也是由碳纤维制成的！
硕大的20英寸合金轮毂中央还参照真正的赛车
单独增加了中心螺栓。�next id=2201209 type=9>�
legacyUnmatchedReview.car: Alfa Romeo GIULIA TZ2 carrozzata da ZAGATO '65
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Fabio Filippini

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The DS brand was created by the PSA Group to renew
the unconventional spirit of the legendary Citroën DS19.
And this DS3 was the first car of the brand.
However, there is no similarity or stylistic reference
to the original DS from 1955.
Aiming instead at a French "chic" imaginary, its shapes
are a little complex, with showy decorations.
On the whole, I find the extremely compact and energetic
proportions to be very pleasant.
And the "shark fin" of the central pillar represents,
I think, its most characteristic design element.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
“DS”是由标致雪铁龙集团创建的新品牌，旨在为传奇的雪铁龙DS19
打破常规的精神注入新鲜的血液。
这辆DS3是该品牌的第一款车。
然而，该车与1955年的原版DS在风格和设计上毫无传承。
专注于营造一种法式的“别致”印象，因而选择了稍显复杂，
而且外向的华丽装饰。
整体上，我觉得它的车身比例给人以一种
非常紧凑而活力动感的印象，看起来赏心悦目。
我个人认为中柱处的“鲨鱼鳍”是此车最具特色的设计元素。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Fabio Filippini

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
In the transition of automotive design, fenders were originally
just mud flaps that attached to the tires.
Just before and after World War II, fenders started to be
integrated into the bodies.
And eventually the body sides came to be
cut out in the shape of the tires.
In relation to this, the rear fenders of the Viper...
...is structured as a large volume that completely
integrates the fender and doors.
And �t shows the enormous traction to accommodate
the 8.0-liter V-10 engine.
It changed the flow and direction of car design, which was
moving towards abstract, multiple surfaces in the 1980s.
The soul of the American car guy is jam packed in these
glamorous fenders.
This is how an American Sports car should be!�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
在汽车设计的漫长历史中，
挡泥板最初只是用于阻挡掀起的泥土的轮胎挡板。
但到了二战前后，设计师开始将挡泥板与车身融为一体。
为此，车身的侧面被切割出了轮胎的形状。
不过拿那种设计对照一下Viper的后挡泥板！
它们变成了车门的一部分，
更加突出了它相当大的体积……
以此展示出8升V10引擎无比强�:�的牵引力。
这项设计给80年代原本抽象、几何形的车身设计带来了
新的变化。
Viper在这些迷人的巨型挡泥板里灌注了美国汽车人的灵魂�e
这才是美国跑车应该有的样子！�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Usually, when using the elements of 
an existing car to create a variant...
...you usually hit it with a completely design to differentiate
it from the original, so they don't occupy the same market.
This is done to avoid cannibalism.
That's why, from the designer's point of view, although in
theory it may be possible, you dare not just carry over a design.
It's like you're not doing your job.
But considering the playful spirit and freedom of will of
car guys, this act can't be ignored.
Nope. These days, just about anything goes!
In North America, when the merging of auto makers and their
brands happened early on, this sort of thing was very common.
Things like customization and the diversification 
and maturity of the autotmotive culture...
...it all comes down to the passion of the customers.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
通常情况下，在设计一款当前车款的衍生车型时……
你会想应用一些新的设计，使其与基础车型作出区分。
换句话说，你会希望避免与原车型发生直接竞争。
所以对于设计师而言，借鉴设计元素通常是业界大忌，
会让人觉得设计师根本没有尽职尽责地去设计。
但是对于追求玩趣、想象力z��富的怪咖设计师来说，
这种手法却是不可或缺的。
事实上，现在的汽车设计已经是百无禁忌！
在北美，随着汽车厂商及其品牌的并购，
这种做法已经变得司空见惯。
这种风潮代表了定制和汽车文化的多样性和成熟化……
它是以消费者的热情为第一驱动力的。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The Skyline GT-R is an icon of the
Japanese automotive industry.
But there may be no other car in Japan
where its history and tradition...
...weighs so heavily on a designer.
In that respect, designing a GT-R today is not so different
than designing a Porsche or a Ferrari.
Back when this R33 was built, a normal mid-size sporty sedan
was the base.
So there was probably a lot of difficulties in its design.
Based on a three-box shape, the 4-seat production car...
...strictly adhered to its underlying philosophy 
as a "Wolf in Sheep's Clothing." 
Also, because the beginning of the R33 development overlapped 
with the tail end of the economic bubble in Japan...
...the body of the R33 was large, heavy, and its style 
was stocky, but it was elegant in overall style.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
Skyline GT-R品牌是日本汽车工业的一个标志。
但也没有哪辆日本汽车的历史和传统会像这辆车一般……
对设计师产生如此大的压力。
有鉴于此，设计一辆GT-R的压力其实无异于设计一辆
保时捷或法拉利。
这辆R33在设计时以普通的中型运动型轿车为基础……
遇到很多设计上的难题也就无可避免。
在对这台四座三厢量产车进行改造时，
基本的理念是打造出了一匹“披着羊皮的狼”。
而且，由于R33的开发初期正好撞上了日本经济泡沫的
尾声，
因此，R33的车身既大且重，但气度优雅，与当时的时代
背景相吻合。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
I was also involved with the design of the “FD."
I thought that this FR layout sports car at $30K range above 
the MX-5 would be the last model as the RX-7 as we knew it. 
If Mazda were to develop a next-generation
RX model...
...I expected that it would have to have a mid-engine layout 
at a much higher price point.
Then, when the FD replacement project started. 
 I was torn because we were going to replace the
timeless design of the FD...
...with a completely new one.
Luckily, it became 4-seater and a totally different concept.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
我确实参与了“FD”的一部分工作。
当时，我们都以为它会是我们挚爱的RX-7系车型
的最后一款……
而且，如果要开发下一代的话……
应该会采用中置引擎布局，还要调高售价。
再后来，FD的替换项目启动了。
一开始我有点纠结，因为我们不得不把我心目中
永不过时的设计……
替换成一个全新的设计。
幸好，最终的4座车车型
成功展现出了完全不同的概念。'
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Tom Matano

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This car was introduced as a baby Aston to make it affordable 
and attract a broader audience. 
The design of this car was unmistakably “Aston Martin."
In fact, it looked much more trim and agile than other Astons. 
In my opinion, I prefer the Vantage V8...
...more than its much heavier 
and larger siblings.
 Later, the company put a V-12 into this tight package.
With that, this Aston made my list of ideal cars.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
为了宣传这款车的亲民价格，吸引更多的受众，
官方给它起了一个绰号，“阿斯顿宝宝”。
它的设计充分地彰显了“阿斯顿马丁”的特色。
与其他车型对比，它看上去更苗条，也更敏捷。
相比于那些体积更大、重量更重的姊妹车型……
……我个人更偏爱这款Vantage V8。
后来，设计师们还将一部V12引擎
塞进了它紧凑的引擎盖下。
有了这项升级，这款阿斯顿马丁也
顺理成章变成了我的理想车型之一。.
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Tom Matano

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
For drift fans, this car is instantly recognizeable as Dai's car.
Daijiro Yoshihara is a Japanese race driver who
specializes in drifting.
He was the series champion of the 2011 Formula DRIFT
Championship Series.
For the 2018 season, his car was this one,
based on the Subaru BRZ.
It packed a turbocharged 7.8-liter V-8 under the hood.
The engine produced a massive  of power!
Unfortunately, it didn't carry him to the
championship that year.
Still, the BRZ was impressive nontheless.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
提到这辆车，人们就会联想起吉原大！
吉原大二郎是一位日本赛车手，专业从事漂移运动。
他是2011年漂移方程式锦标赛系列赛的冠军。
后来，他驾驶一辆基于斯巴鲁BRZ的赛车继
续参加了2018年的系列赛。
在车辆的引擎盖下安装的是一台7.8升V8涡轮增压引擎。
能够产生的巨大动力！
虽然这台引擎并不足以让他赢得冠军，
但是，BRZ+V8仍然是一个令人振奋不已的组合！e
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
So, this is the GR Supra that entered the Nürburgring 24 Hour
race just a month after it went on sale? 
Did you know that the President of Toyota Motor Company himself,
Akio "Morizo" Toyoda drove the first stint in the final race?
He was the guy who brought this GR Supra to life! 
The car was basically stock, with just minimal
safety equipment necessary to race.
But it still managed to place 41st overall and 3rd in class.
It showcased the solid reliability and performance
of the GR Supra.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
所以这就是刚刚上市一个月就去参加了纽博格林24小时耐力赛
的GR Supra……
你知道在决赛中驾驶第一赛段的车手不是别人，
正是丰田的总裁丰田章男吗？
事实上，就是他让这辆GR Supra复活的！
这辆参赛的Supra基本上就是一台零售车型，只配备了
比赛所需的最低限度安全设备，
但它还是获得了第41名的总成绩，并在同级车中排名第3。
这样的成绩完全显示出了
GR Supra的卓越性能。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Are you familiar with the WRC?
It stands for "World Rally Championship," and features rally
races that take place on a variety of road surfaces.
It was formed in 1973 when rally championships held in
various countries were unified.
The new international race series was christened the
World Rally Championship, and the rest is history.
This is the Alpine A110, the winner of the very first
WRC series.
Its compact body came with an  engine mounted
at the rear, ensuring excellent traction.
The A110 won the first race of the 1973 season, held in
Monte Carlo.
In fact, Alpine A110s took all three podium places,
defeating entries form Porsche and Lancia.
The car now occupies a page in the history books as the car
that won the first WRC race and series.]
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
你对世界拉力锦标赛熟悉吗？
在公共道路上举行拉力
赛是其独有的特色。
它设立于1973年，将在不同国家举行的拉力锦标赛整合
到了一起。
这就是世界拉力锦标赛的开端，并延续至今。
这一辆阿尔派A110正是第一届世界拉力锦标赛的冠军。
它的车身紧凑，后置发动机确保
后轮产生足够的牵引力}��
它在蒙特卡洛赢下了1973年赛季的第一场比赛。
事实上，阿尔派A110一路上击败了保时捷和蓝旗亚，
包揽了领奖台！
A110就此踏上了赢得世界拉力锦标赛首季比赛的道路，并通过比
赛造成巨大的轰动效应！
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Trust me, you’re not likely to forget a car like this.
This is the Chaparral 2J, which was built for
the 1970 Can-Am Series.
What makes it original is found at the rear of the car.
There, you'll find two fans powered by a  engine.
These fans suck the car to the ground
to generate downforce.
They expel the air between the underbody and the road, 
creating a suction effect.
For this reason, the 2J i� sometimes referred to as
the "fan car.".
Thanks to this ingenious piece of engineering, the car can
take corners at speeds that defy all logic.
The Chaparral 2J set incredible lap times
in all four of the races it entered.
In fact, it even took pole position.
Its Achilles Heel was reliability.
But before it could run a full race, the FIA 
changed the rules on aerodynamics...
...deeming the fan system illegal.
One can only imagine what this car could have achieved,
had it been given time to develop.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这是一台让人过目难忘的车！
这辆Chaparral 2J是专为1970年加拿大-美国挑战杯系列赛制造的。
在它的身后，你会发现……
两台通过单缸发动机驱动的风扇。
这些风扇将空气从车身下方排出，以产生下压力……
这使它看起来好像直接吸在地面上一样。
也因此，它常被人称为“风扇车”。
{��甚至能够以违反物理常识的高速过弯……
在它参加的所有四场比赛中，
Chaparral 2J都创下了令人难以置信的单圈记录！
确切地说，它包揽了所有四场比赛的杆位。
当然了，它的稳定性另当别论……
在创下纪录后，它未能获准参加后续的比赛。
因为国际汽联针对性地更改了关于空气动力学的规则……
直接将“风扇车”排除在比赛之外。
这样的遗憾也引来了人们的不断遐想。
如果在当时有机会继续改进这辆车，它可以取得什么样的成就！`
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Renault is famous for its minivans, especially the Espace.
This Avantime may resemble a minivan, but it
was really intended to be a two-door coupe.
A truly unique car, if I may say so.
It was designed by none other than Patrick le Quément,
chief designer at Renault from the 1980s to the 2000s.
Released in 2001, it had a remarkably brief production run
of �wo short years.
A shame, really, as it’s a car overflowing with character,
inside and out. Indeed, I feel there’s nothing quite like it.
No wonder it continues to attract fans all over the world.
It’s another shi�ing achievement in Renault’s long history.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
雷诺以其打造的多功能乘用车而闻名，特别是Espace。
虽然这款Avantime看起来像多功能乘用车，但实际上
它是按照双门轿跑车的标准打造的。
实话实说，这确实是一款独一无二的车。
它的设计师正是帕特里克·勒·奎芒，
他在1980年代至2000年代期间担任雷诺的首席设计师。
v��车于2001年发布，生产周期却异常短暂，
仅仅持续了两年时间。
这实在令人惋惜，因为这是一款由内到外都充满个性
的汽车。说真的，我觉得再也找不到如此特立独行的车型了。
难怪它至今仍吸引着世界各地的车迷。
这又是雷诺悠久历史中的一项辉煌成就。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Chris

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This is the successor to the legendary original Skyline GT-R,
or "Hakosuka," as it was affectionately known in Japan.
This car earned its nickname from an ad campaign featuring a
charming young couple known as “Ken” and “Mary.”
Among Skyline fans, it has forever been remembered by that name
—the “Kenmeri GT-R.”
The Hakosuka rose to prominence in Japanese touring car racing,
earning a fearsome reputation for bein� nearly unstoppable.
Naturally, the Kenmeri was expected to carry the torch passed
down by its proud predecessor. But fate had other plans.
The 1970s ushered in a new era of strict emissions regulations,
cutting short the Kenmeri’s racing legacy before it began.
Because of these regulations, building cars with high-performance
engines like the GT-R became impossible.
And so, just four months after the Kenmeri went on sale,�
production ended, leaving behind only 197 units ever built.
Although it never had a chance to compete in any races...
...its tragic fate and small production run have made
it—in the eyes of enthusiasts—a legend all its own.,
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
此车是传奇初代天际线GT-R的继承者，
后者在日本被亲切地称为“箱型”……
而本车的昵称则源自一则流行广告，在广告中出现了
一对名为“肯”与“玛丽”的可爱年轻情侣。
因此，在天际线车迷圈中，如今人们都称这款车为
“肯·玛丽GT-R”。
前辈“箱型”在日本房车赛事中声名鹊起，
赢得了不可战胜的美誉。
按理�1�，“肯·玛丽”本应延续其前辈铸就的辉煌……
然而时运不济，1970年代恰逢严格的排放法规
开始实施的时代。
这些法规导致GT-R这类搭载高性能引擎的车型
无法继续生产。
因此，“肯·玛丽”在上市仅四个月后便宣告停产，
最终产量定格在197台。
虽然它从未有机会踏上赛场……
但悲情的命运与��有的产量，反而成就了
其独特的传奇地位。�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Chris

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
When the Mini was born in 1959, it revolutionized the world
of compact front-wheel-drive cars.
Designed by the English engineer Alec Issigonis...
...it sported a uniquely positioned engine and gearbox.
This maximized the space-saving potential of its
front-wheel-drive layout.
The result was a small and fast car with a roomy interior.
The Mini's historic front-wheel drive layout is now
widely referred to as an "Issigonis" layout.
And why shouldn't it be? It was designed by the
brilliant engineer after all.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
当MINI于1959年诞生时，它彻底改变了小型前轮驱动汽车的世界。
此车由英国工程师亚历克·伊斯戈尼斯设计……
它的引擎和变速箱安装的位置非常独特，
最大限度地发挥了前轮驱动布局节省空间的潜力。
因此造就了一辆小而快的汽车，具有宽敞的内部空间。
MINI的历史性前轮驱动布局现在被广泛称为“伊斯戈尼斯”布局。
这并不奇怪。毕竟它就是由这位杰出的工程师设计的！
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Stella

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
In the Japanese Super Endurance Series, 
I myself race in the MAZDA3 race car. 
Lots of effort went into the MAZDA3 as a production model
of course, but it was also drawn with the racing scene in mind.
In this racing modified version as well, I tried to maintain 
the original shape of the MAZDA3 as much as possible.
The modification including the livery is something that doesn't
disrupt the beauty and silhouette of the car.
Another point of focus was how good it looks when running.
Like how the rear tread sticks out like
a proper Super Endurance race car.
When you're overtaken by this car, I think you'll really notice
how good it looks from the back...
...so on the track, I'd appreciate if you would let me pass!y
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
我跟你讲，我在日本超级耐力系列赛中可是真开过这辆
马自达3赛车哦！
马自达3本身是款普通的量产车型，不过我们设计的时候
就已经考虑到了它未来可能会上赛道。
所以在打造赛车版本的时候，我们尽量保留了原版的帅
气造型。
不光是车身轮廓线条，连车身涂装我们都精心设计，
就是想让它保持原车的美感。
当然啦，我们也得让它在赛道上看起来够劲儿。
怎么做到的？我们给它装上了更宽的后轮轴，也是超级
耐力赛车的标配。
效果太棒了，尤其是超车的时候，那叫一个帅气！
所以呢，要是哪天你在赛道上碰到我，可得乖乖让道。
然后你就知道它的超车有多帅气了！
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Ikuo Maeda

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
When comparing it to the classic design of its predecessor...
...the 250 GTO adopted a longer nose, lower stance,
 and a "coda tronca" rear.
Thus, it was designed with aerodynamics strongly in mind.
The front and rear fenders give the car a great sense
of energy and vigor.
The view from the rear-quarter angle is just exquisite.
The car's distinguishing features include...
...t�e three air intakes on the hood and air outlets
on the fenders.
In staying true to Ferrari’s established design language,
while adapting to the rigors of racing...
...the 250 GTO achieved a rare and remarkable equilibrium.
It is precisely this harmony that has made it one of
the more popular Ferrari cars ever created.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
与之前的经典短轴距车型相比……
250 GTO不仅采用了更长的车鼻，压低了车身高度，还引入了
被称为断尾的后部设计。
在设计时，空气动力学性能也是其重点考量。
宽大的前后挡泥板营造出了
无与伦比的动感氛围。
从侧后方角度看过去，特别华贵高雅。
无论是引擎盖正前方的三个进气口�"�
还是后保险杠上突出的排气管，
都让人记忆犹新。
可以说，250 GTO的设计既保留了法拉利的底蕴，
又满足了赛车运动的需求……
实现了难能可贵的平衡。
也正是这份平衡感让这款经典法拉利车型充满魅力，
人气爆棚。�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This car really shows off its proportional balance.
Aside from the retrofitted detail parts, 
I feel that it is an elegant looking car.
Design elements such as the retractable headlamps...
...the area around the rear where the glass hatch blacks out the
B-pillar...
...they seem to be a response to cars in the American market
at the time.
Looking at it now, it lacks boldness,
but it's a look that exudes positive emotions.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这辆车淋漓尽致地展现了设计师对车身比例均衡的把握。
这辆车的车身细节部件进行了全面的翻新升级，
给人以优雅的印象。
其他的一些设计元素，例如上翻式车头灯……
……玻璃后背和B柱的衔接……
……似乎都是为了响应当时美国市场的需求。
现在看来，这种设计欠缺些魄力，
不过的确传达出积极求变的信息。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
I'm totally taken with the wraparound cabin
and the flawless balance of the low body.
From just its presence,
you can almost hear the car's exhaust note, right?
I've seen Gandini's original sketch of the car...
...while the design theme is the same,
I was surprised in the difference of the ambience.
In fact, "car design" is something that can't 
be accomplished by just one pers�n.
The collaboration of engineers, who are themselves
craftsmen, and modelers is essential.
In those terms...
...I think it's correct in saying that 
the Stratos is "Bertone designed."
I would seriously love to add this car to my collection,
but it has become too expensive.G
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
我完全被这辆车的环绕式座舱和其低矮车身的
完美平衡给折服了。
你仔细听，是不是几乎听不到它的排气声？
我看过甘迪尼为这辆车创作的设计草图原稿。
虽然设计主题相同，但传达的情绪感受却明显不同。
事实上，“汽车设计”并不是一个人就能完成的作品。
它需要工程技师和模{��师之间的通力合作。
因此……
我觉得更准确的说法应该是——
Stratos由“博通设计打造”。
我是真的很想把这辆车纳入我的收藏，
不过恐怕它现在已经是我负担不起的天价了。<
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This is a car that tried to break away from
the previous design language of BMW.
The shapes created by my former classmate 
Chris Bangle when he was at BMW...
...were interesting and exciting in the eyes of a designer.
This M3 also began moving away from the authentic
proportions of an FR vehicle.
However, the surface treatment is fresh and interesting. 
Even seeing it now, it's not bad at all.
This is one of the cars that represented
the change in flow of BMW design.j
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这辆车的设计在尝试摆脱宝马之前的设计语言，带来革新。
它是由我从前的同学
克里斯·班戈在宝马工作时所设计的……
在设计师眼中，这些设计元素非常有趣，非常激动人心。
此外，这辆M3开始从车身配比上与传统前置后驱车分道扬镳。
其车身外观的处理也非常新颖有趣。
即便从现在的眼光来看也丝毫不过时。
可以说，这是一台反映了宝马设计思路演变的车。p
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
I love this car, and it's easily one of my top three all time.
Based on sketches by Ford designers...
...you get the feeling that its appearance was brought together
by British designers...
...who knew how racecars should look and perform.
When compared to the Ferrari 330P4 of the same year...
...the overall shape of the GT40 is emotionally modest,
while characterized by a more modern silhouette.
They're both �ice, but I think I prefer the GT40.
The face created by the square headlamps and air intakes,
which are rare in racecars...
...is aggressive and stylish.
But there's a rather elegant, feminine quality within the car's
overall muscular nature... 
...expressed by the line that runs from the cabin to
the rear end.
Although it hasn't been mentioned much before, but there's
a quality not unlike that of the Lamborghini Miura her�.
The Mark II added air intakes, which gave the car 
even more racecar intensity.
It's this part of the car that I find very alluring.z
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
我喜欢这辆车。
如果要排名的话，它能轻松跻身我个人喜好排行榜的前三。
此车是由一支来自英国的团队
基于福特设计师的草图打造的……
看得出来，他们对赛车的外观和性能胸有成竹。
与同年的法拉利330 P4相比……
GT40可能欠缺一些激情，但有着更具现代感的轮廓。
当然了，这两部车都很棒，只是我个人更��爱GT40。
请注意方形大灯和进气口所构成的前脸，
这在赛车上是很少见的。
我会觉得它既有侵略性，又有时尚感。
尽管总体上“孔武有力”，但还是可以让人感受到
一丝优雅气质，
主要体现在从车厢延伸到尾部的线条中。
虽然之前很少被提及，但其实
兰博基尼Miura与此车师出同门。
在Mark II版�'�中增加的多个进气口使它看起来更有张力。
事实上，我觉得最有魅力的就是这部分。p
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This car has the reputation of having a cute design.
But its creators didn't mean for it to be cute. Rather, they 
strived to make the design extremely functional.
The end result is effective and quite pleasant.
Based on national automotive standards at the time, Toyota
introduced the  4-passenger Publica in 1962.
Using that car as a base, the company produced 
this sporty model called the Toyota Sports 800.�
It's also known as the "Yota Hachi."
Despite having a small engine, the car's look suggests
it drives in a spritely manner...
...with emphasis placed on aerodynamics and lightness.
Shozo Saito, a designer who worked at Kanto Jidosha,
a Toyota subsidiary company...
...played a central role in this design.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这辆车因其可爱的设计而举世闻名……
不过这并非设计师的本意，
在设计时，他们致力于最大化突出功能性。好在结果非常成功、非常令人满意。
基于当时的国家汽车标准，丰田在1962年
推出了排量的4座汽车帕布利卡。
该公司随后又基于该车型推出了
跑车型号丰田Sports 800，
也就是大家口中的“丰田8”。
尽管排量较小，但得益于设计师将外观设计的重点放在了
空气动力学和轻量化，
让人觉得它拥有活力和动感的操控感。
为丰田子公司“关东自动车工业株式会社”工作的设计师佐藤章蔵
在这辆车的设计工作中担任了举足轻重的角色。�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Hideo Kodama

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
These days, it's rare to see one person's vision result in a
product that reflects his intent to the smallest details. 
Setting out to create a fresh car, the genius Gordon Murray 
came up with the concept.
He then handed the reins to designer Peter Stevens. 
The result is the F1 you see here.
The concept, which became the base for the F1, was for it to
be "a super sports car that could be driven every day."
Some say �hat the first-generation 
Honda NSX served as the benchmark.
The center-forward driving position in a three-seat
configuration helped to balance the car.
...and also keeping the car's height to a low . 
But the design is well-executed, 
without any strangeness to it at all. I do like it.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
近几十年来，我们鲜少能看到将设计师的意图
贯彻到每一处细节的作品。
天才设计师戈登·穆雷曾提出过一辆新车的概念构想，
然后将接力棒交到了彼得·史蒂文斯手中。
两人的合作成果就是你眼前的这台F1。
F1的设计初衷，就是创造一辆
“可以日常驾驶的超级跑车”。
还有人说它的设计对标参照物是第一代本田NSX�
这辆车有许多独到之处。例如在三座布局中，
将驾驶员座椅放在前排居中位置，以使重量分配达到最优，
……亦或是将车身高度降到只有。
迈凯伦在实现设计时做的非常到位，没有一丝不协调感。
我很欣赏这一点。�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Hideo Kodama

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
And the high-performance version of that Golf I is the GTI.
Considered wide at the time, its 175/70R13 tires were covered
 by a special black plastic lip.
Red molding inside the front grille, the GTI had subtle hints 
identifying its true nature...
...which made it all the more stylish.
When it comes to hot hatches, 
this is a car that I still would like to own.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
而高尔夫I的高性能版本就是这款GTi，
高尔夫I GTi采用的175/70 R13轮胎在当时被视作宽胎。
设计师特意在轮胎上方增加了一道别致的黑色塑料轮眉，
配合环绕前格栅一周的红色条纹设计，
隐约透露着GTi的本质……
令其更显风采卓然。
在高性能掀背车中，
这是我一直想要收藏的一辆车。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Hideo Kodama

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The 458 Italia is one of Pininfarina's 
recent masterpieces for the Cavallino.
It is probably the most beautiful mid-engine
Ferrari since the 308...
Inheriting the sportiness, purity and elegance
of the 308...
It would influence the design language and proportions 
of all subsequent models.
Its style is characterized by...
...sinuous yet extremely pure and fluid lines, 
with no visible air inlets on the sides.
The front is sharp, with the new "scimitar" headlights.
The rear can be recognized by single round lights...
...embedded in the bodywork...
...and by the three round central exhausts inspired by the F40.
 If perfection in design is achieved when nothing 
can be removed from a shape without ruining it...
...then the 458 it comes really close.&
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
458 Italia是宾尼法利纳最近为跃马品牌设计的杰作之一。
它可能是自308以来外型最优美的中置引擎法拉利……
……同时也继承了308的运动性、纯粹性和优雅……
……并影响到了后续多款车型的设计语言和比例。
其风格特点可以用几点归纳：
极致纯粹、流动的连续车身线条，侧面没有任何明显的进气口。
犀利的前脸采用了新的“弯刀”头灯。显得杀气腾腾。
车尾的辨识度也很高……
……嵌入车身框架的单个圆形后灯……
……以及与F40师出同门的三联中置圆形排气管。
如果完美的设计是增之则长，减之则短……
……那么458已经非常接近于这个境界了。�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Fabio Filippini

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This is the legendary 1963 Corvette 
Sting Ray “Split Window” coupe.
Split Window comes from the
very cool division post in the rear window.
This post is not only distinct...
...it allows the profile of the car
to remain uninterrupted in its flow.
I also love the fender shapes, 
which were inspired by Italian streamliner cars of the 1950s.
This car is so well balanced from top to�bottom, 
and from end to end.
It is indeed a timeless design.
When I look at the sleek undulating shapes of
the 1963 Sting Ray...
...it really does remind me of a sleek creature
that lives underwater.
Yes, that's right. I'm referring to the
the car's namesake, the stingray.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这是传说中的1963款科尔维特Sting Ray 
“Split Window”双门跑车。
“Split Window”这个绰号的由来是指它的后车窗被一根立柱一分为二。
这根独树一帜的立柱……
……让车辆的整体轮廓更加连贯和流畅。
我还特别喜爱它的挡泥板的形状，
其灵感应该来源于1950年代意大利汽车的流线型车身。
这辆车z��头到尾、从上到下都充满平衡感，
堪称永恒的经典设计。
每次看到那起伏流畅的车身外形……
……我就不由想起那条生活在水底的流线型生物。
没错，那就是这辆车名字的来源，魔鬼鱼。�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Ed Welburn
legacyUnmatchedReview.resolvedCarNameEn: Chevrolet Corvette Sting Ray Sport Coupe (C2) '63
legacyUnmatchedReview.resolvedCarNameZh: Chevrolet Corvette Sting Ray Sport Coupe (C2) '63

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
I’ll never forget the first time I saw a Lamborghini
Countach on the street.
The LP400 is a very fine car indeed.
It is a modern classic and the very definition
of a supercar.
One doesn’t even need to open its scissor doors
to feel its striking presence.
It has an extremely wedge-shaped profile 
with a steep windscreen and high tail.
And the bold crease that runs the length of the car
is complimented by well-executed surfaces.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
我永远忘不了第一次在街上看到兰博基尼Countach
的情景。
LP400确实是一辆非常出色的车。
它是一款现代经典车，也是超级跑车的绝佳代表。
即使不打开它的剪刀式车门，
也能感受到它令人惊叹的存在感。
它的车身像是一个压到极致的倒梯形，
挡风玻璃斜度很大，尾翼则高高耸起。
一条让人无法忽视的折痕线贯穿整个
侧面车身，夺人眼球。
这条折痕线来自于车身表面的高差——
每个表面都经过精心设计，呈现不同程度的拱起。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Ed Welburn

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The Camaro ZL1 is a weapon on wheels. 
Everything about its design says speed and power.
From its overall stance to its many functional splitters, 
wings, and air intakes, this car is track ready!
And, the ZL1 Camaro has a wider track 
than other Camaros.
Its dark hood, grille, headlamps, and full-width splitter
give this car a wide, sinister appearance.
With two-tone colors, it's all business. Period!R
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这辆科迈罗ZL1的一切设计目的都是为了速度和力量，
它简直就是一件安上了轮子的武器！
从它的整体姿态到各种功能性的定风翼、尾翼和进气口，
都在告诉你——这辆车完全是为赛道打造的！
这辆科迈罗ZL1拥有比其他的科迈罗型号更宽的轮距。
涂黑的引擎盖、格栅、车头灯和车身等宽定风翼，
让它显得更狰狞、更具威胁性。
它还通过这种撞色设计表明了态度——不废话，只为胜利！
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Ed Welburn

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This is my car! 
Seriously, it’s actually in my garage right now.
The 1969 Camaro is a true classic 
American muscle car. 
The unique grille shape gives the design a wide stance... 
... and the character lines on the side of the car gives
this Camaro a feeling of speed.
The most dated area of the design are the wheels. 
On my '69 Camaro, I ditched the 14-inch Rally wheels 
and installed 17-inch wheels.
It’s a great car to modify, enhance, and race. Trust me, I know.'
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
它就是我的梦中情车！
不开玩笑，我的车库里现在就停着一辆。
这么说吧，1969科迈罗是纯正血统的美式肌肉车。
其独特的进气格栅设计赋予了它宽阔的车身姿态……
艺术化的腰线设计带来了速度感。
如果说它的设计有什么过时的地方，那就是车轮了。
比如我个人就放弃了14英寸的拉力轮毂，
换成了17英寸的。
这是一辆改装潜力巨大，甚至能
提升到赛车水准的好车。
相信我，我知道自己在说什么。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Ed Welburn

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Now, this is what I call a British sports car!
The hardcore radical quality here is expressed throughout, 
from the interior to its exterior appearance.
The car's spirit is hardly diplomatic.
It's as if this vehicle is saying,
"I have no desire to be a star to the public."
And, at the same time, it exemplifies the pure and naive love 
that we feel for sports cars.
On the sexy body, which �its extremely low for a front-engine
car, there's a cold round detail that totally lacks emotion.
The hood, sculpted and low other than around the engine, 
and the corresponding trunk lid...
...express a powerful driving force.
In this regard, the styling goes well beyond what 
many would accept, for love sees no fault.
This design generates indifferent feelings, 
captivating only those who understand it.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
看啊，这才是我眼中真正的英国跑车！
从内饰到外观，这辆车浑身都散发着不羁和激进。
摒弃圆滑和世故，展现永不妥协的精神。
实际上，它似乎完全无意迎合大众口味。
与此同时，它也向我们表达了对一款纯血、直击本质的
跑车的热爱。
对于一辆前置引擎车来说，它的车身异常低矮流畅，
��弧的车身细节也显得极度冷漠，不带一丝感情。
引擎盖深深下凹，只有引擎位置高高隆起，
行李箱盖处也采用了同样的设计……
……露出一副动力充盈、跃跃欲试的模样。
其外观设计已经远超大众能够接受的审美范围，
唯有真正的爱好者方能欣赏。
这是一款必然引发争议的设计，只对那些懂它的人
散发无穷魅力。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
It all goes back some 90 years,
to the Eifel race of 1934.
Back then, the all-white Mercedes F1 was deemed
 too heavy for competition.
To reduce its weight, a mechanic scraped off the car's
paint, exposing its aluminum body.
It was this silver-colored car
that ended up winning the race.
This car was dubbed the "Silver Arrow," instantly becoming 
a symbol for racing excellence.
Sinc� then, silver has been Germany’s national
racing color.
Of course, sponsorship liveries are much
more common today.
And race cars painted in their national colors
are very much a thing of the past.
But if you’re interested in racing history, you should
look into the national race colors of other countries.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这个故事要说回到90多年前，那是1934年的埃菲尔比赛……
当时的那辆全白色梅赛德斯F1赛车因为超重，无法参加比赛。
为了减重，一名机械师直接刮掉了喷漆，露出了铝制的
赛车车身。
最终，这辆原色梅赛德斯赛车还赢下了比赛！
于是赛车运动历史上最传奇的名称之一“银箭”便诞生了！
�4那之后，银色就成为了德国的赛车运动主色调！
当然，今天的赛车运动中赞助商涂装已经非常普及。
采用国家官方配色的赛车已经成为了历史。
不过，如果你对F1的历史感兴趣，
不妨多了解一下其他国家的官方配色！
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
When I hear the name Skyline GT-R, I immediately think of
racing champions!
So, it probably goes without saying that I’m also a big fan
of the Prince-era Skyline GT, the forefather of the GT-R.
This Nissan Skyline GT-R, affectionately known as the "Hakosuka,"
carried the torch passed down from the formidable Skyline GT.
It made its debut at the 1969 JAF Grand Prix, 
held at the legendary Fuji Speedway...
...where it didn’t just win,
it made a statement.
From that first race, it racked up 49 consecutive victories
through to December 1971!T
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
当我听到“天际线GT-R”这个名字，我条件反射般地
想到了这四个字：赛车冠军！
理所当然，我也是GT-R的前身，Prince时代
的天际线GT的狂热车迷。
这辆“日产天际线GT-R”，也被称作“箱型”，
继承了所向披靡的天际线GT的衣钵。
它于1969年在传奇的富士赛道上举办的
日本汽车联合会大奖赛上首次亮相。
它不只在这条赛道上初战告捷，此后还连战连胜……
最终到1971年12月为止，取得了
举世闻名的49连胜的战绩！T
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This SF19 was built for Japan’s top formula racing series,
the Super Formula Championship.
The Super Formula is the preeminent formula racing event
in all of Asia…
And is considered the quickest motorsport after F1.
In Super Formula races, drivers tend to show their skill
through overtaking manoeuvres.
By the way, are you familiar with overtaking systems?
It is a system that allows a driver momentarily increas�s
the flow of fuel to the engine for increased speed!
It requires plenty of control and the utmost technique!
This Honda-powered SF19 conjures up memories
of Alex Palou’s record victory.
Palou later went on to compete in the IndyCar series,
a formula racing series held in the USA.2
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这辆SF19是为日本顶尖的方程式系列赛
——超级方程式锦标赛而开发的。
放眼整个亚洲，超级方程式都是最卓越的方程式比赛……
也被视为是仅次于F1的最快汽车赛事。
在超级方程式比赛中，车手们倾向于
通过超车来展现个人技巧。
顺带问一句，你对超级方程式的超车系统有了解吗？
它可以通过短暂提高注入引擎y��燃料量，以提升车速！
同时也需要车手大量的操控和纯熟的技巧才能驾驭！
这辆本田出品的SF19见证了亚历克斯·帕卢
创下纪录的胜利。
在那之后，帕卢又转战印地系列赛，
那是在美国举办的另一项方程式赛车系列赛。�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Japan's GT Championship in the late 1990s was a three-way battle
between the Nissan Skyline, Honda NSX and the Toyota Supra.
The battles amongst Japan's three major car manufacturers
was one for the ages!
By the final round, which was run in the pouring rain,
all three teams were still in contention for the title.
Even after the checkered flag was waved, it wasn't
certain who had wo� the series.
That's because two teams were tied for the top spot, and
their 2nd-place finishes were also even.
This meant the tiebreaker came down to the number of 3rd-place
finishes they had recorded over the season...
In the end, the Tom's Supra Number 36 came out
on top in the historic 1997 season.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
二十世纪九十年代末，日本房车锦标赛呈现的是三足鼎立
的态势：日产天际线、本田NSX和丰田Supra。
这辆Tom's Supra在1997年夺冠的那一役，
堪称一场真正的悬念大戏！
战至大雨滂沱的最后一轮比赛中，
竟仍有4支车队保有夺冠可能！
甚至在方格旗落下之后，冠军归属仍然扑朔迷离。
因为有两支车队积分持平、并列第一，就连他们在赛季中获得亚军
的次数也完全相同。
最后为了决定胜负，竟要追溯这两支车队
在整个赛季中获得季军的次数！
而这辆36号Tom's Supra正是从那场扣人心弦的
1997年冠军决战中脱颖而出的最终王者！�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This here’s a legend of American stock car racing.
In stock car racing, production-model cars are raced
pretty much as-is.
The Superbird’s large rear wing and long front nose
were essential tools...
...for winning NASCAR races, the top tier of stock
car racing in the United States.
Basically, they were special racing parts
for a production car.
In its effort to meet NASCAR ho�ologation, 
the Superbird was sold for but one year...
...and few were ever produced.
Afterwards, stock car races began to feature more
and more pure race cars.
Indeed, this car is from an age when street cars
an� race cars greatly resembled each other.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这一辆是美国改装赛车比赛中的传奇。
在改装赛车比赛中，量产型的车辆通常是以原始的出厂配置的状态直接参与竞速。
这辆Superbird的大号后翼和长车鼻都是竞速利器……
能够帮助它赢得美国的顶级改装赛车赛事——纳斯卡赛车。
事实上，这些车身部件都是专门服务于量产型车辆的特殊竞速部件。
为了满足纳斯卡赛车的赛事资格认证条件，
Superbird仅对外销售一年……
总产量也不多。
在那之后，改装赛车比赛开始涌入越来越多种类的赛车。
的确，这款车来自于那个公路车和赛车
相似度极高的时代。�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Chris

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The Type 930 911 Turbo was Porsche's first
true super car.
It appealed to a new kind of Porsche customer.
Indeed, the "Turbo" added another element. 
Somewhere inside those Superman fender flares
and that big rear wing was...
...the humbleness of Clark Kent.
It was a success story from the time it made its debut
at the 1973 Frankfurt Motor Show.
The 911 truly presented the 19�0s for Porsche.
But did you know it was scheduled to be replaced?
That was before the Type 930 911 Turbo breathed new life
into the model.
Of course, we know this now in hindsight.
The original 930 had a long and strong production run
from 1975 to 1989...
...with an update to the new 964/965 platform in 1990.
Also of note was the "Turbo" script that became iconic
unto itself.
In fact, this script is still being used by�Porsche today
on all subsequent Turbos.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这辆Type 930 911 Turbo是保时捷第一款
真正意义上的超级跑车！
它还吸引来一批性格张扬的保时捷新车迷。
毫无疑问，这台“Turbo”树立起了一代传奇的形象！
这辆谦逊、简约的911就好比汽车领域的“克拉克·肯特”——
它的挡泥板和巨大的尾翼闪耀着如同超人般充满力量感的光泽。
自从在197�法兰克福车展上惊艳亮相的那一刻起，
这款车就迎来了巨大成功。
911成为了保时捷在70年代最闪耀的代言人。
不过你知道吗？如果不是Type 930 911 Turbo又为911系列
注入了全新的生命力。
这个系列原本将迎来被替换的命运。
当然，我们现在这么说也是事后诸葛亮罢了。
初代930在1975年到1989年之间持续生产了
很长的时间，产量也很庞大……
然后�3在1990年升级到了964/965平台。
另外值得一提的是，“Turbo”名称本身也成为了一代传奇。
事实上，保时捷直到今天还在沿用，
并推出了许多款后续的“Turbo”车型！�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Freeman Thomas

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
There are some subtle visual differences between this car
and the R8 LMS: It's cleaner, with fewer graphics.
The aggressive look of the red taillights and flat red
bumper lines remain very much in place.
It's still a classically German look, in other words.
The front is also more visually striking, and the spoiler
is now at a reverse angle.
Some ha�e also noted that the red winglets look a little bit
like whiskers.
This is an evolved version of the R8 LMS, hence the "Evo"
name. It's certainly had a visual overhaul!
Truth be told, it's getting closer and close to being my
perfect car!�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
与之前2015年的R8勒芒系列赛相比，这款R8只有一些外观
上细微差别。它的车身比较干净，没有那么多繁琐的图形，
但红色的尾灯和横向的红色保险杠线条让它保留了应有
的侵略性。
换句话说，这就是经典的日耳曼风格！
它的正面也变得更引人瞩目。还有扰流板被设置成了反角。
有人还开玩笑说，红色的侧翼就像两撇胡须一样。
名称中包含的“进化”一词代表它是R8勒芒系列赛的进
化版，整体视觉效果发生了天翻地覆的变化。
说句真心话，它离我�j目中的完美汽车越来越近了！�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Freeman Thomas

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
It's hard to believe the car is nearly two decades old!
Stylistically, the Carrera GT was ahead of its time.
It became the future DNA for Porsche...
...especially for the Boxster and Cayman, 
and I would say, influenced the 918.
It has a lot of innovative details, 
such as the double hump mesh rear screen...
...with the stylized aero roll bars hovering above.
I also love the r�ar diffuser 
with the integrated exhausts. 
Also inspiring was the interior 
with the center console bridge. 
 If I were to make one criticism...
...then it would have be 
the visually long bodyside. 
The front fender outlet and rear fender inlet...
...connected by the horizontal lines accentuate this.
The clever details continue 
with the center-lock wheels.
...and the aero supported mirrors.
 I would sa� the styling of the Carrera GT 
is truly timeless...
...and a masterpiece of modern Porsche design!L
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
Carrera GT是永不过时的艺术品。
我认为它是保时捷现代设计中的杰作！
你甚至很难想象这辆车已经问世这么多个年头了！
从造型上，Carrera GT完全领先了它的时代……
它的设计元素影响到了后续几乎所有保时捷车型……
比如Boxster和Cayman，甚至还包括918。
它蕴含了大量的创新细节……
x��如双峰式的后置透明引擎罩，
以及悬在引擎上、造型独具的空力防倾杆。
集成在保险杠上的排气管
和后扩散器也是我喜欢的设计。
同样令人耳目一新的还有内饰的中控台。
不过呢，如果要我提意见的话……
我觉得长度有些太长了。
尤其是侧面的水平线条，显得拖沓……
因为它把前挡泥板的出风口
和后挡泥板进风口连起来了……
保时捷在这台车上还加入了很多巧思……
例如中央锁止轮毂和空气动力学后视镜等等。�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Freeman Thomas

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Now, this is one aggressive Beetle!
It's a car that proves the motorsports potential
of the good ol’ bug.
Take note of its extremely low stance, wide
motorsport fenders...
...and the exhaust pipe jutting out from its front
arch!
Its large five-spoke wheels are typical of Volkswagen’s
expert design team.
And, its body is simply brimming with confidence.
Indeed, it exudes the luxury that only a top-tier
design studio can deliver.
And the bright graphics contribute nicely to the overall
look of the car.i
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
哇，这可真是一辆外观凶悍的甲壳虫啊！
它的存在证明了平日的小可爱
也具有赛场竞速的巨大潜力！
请注意它极低的车身姿态，宽大的
赛车级挡泥板……
以及顺着前轮拱突出的排气管！
它采用了大号五轮辐轮毂，这也是
大众专业设计团队的专属。
它的车身也从头到尾彰显着一股自信。
这份自信源自它所呈现出的奢华品质
——只有顶级的设计工作室能够实现。
车身上各种鲜艳显眼的几何图案更是为
整体外观锦上添花！
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Freeman Thomas

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This is a car for which I was the Chief designer.
I also owned this RX-8 for quite a while.
Actually my children were born in the year 
that the RX-8 was announced.
They were twin boys, but in our house it was already decided 
from the very beginning that our family car would be an RX-8.
The RX-8 was perfect for raising twins.
One reason is that the RX-8 is a 4 door, but you can't 
open the rear �oors without opening the front doors.
So even when they were at a rambunctious age, I could drive 
without worrying about them accidentally opening the doors
To make a silhouette that looks like a sports car with 4 doors 
and with proper space for 4 people,
is actually very difficult.
There's not many cars in the world that have accomplished this.
It would be great to design something again 
with this package and engine one day.
There was a Mazda Fan Festa event the other day,
at a circuit in Okayama.
There were a lot of RX-8 owners there. I really appreciate the
fact that they are taking great care of these cars even today.U
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
说起这款RX-8，我可是它的首席设计师。不仅如此，
我自己也有一辆RX-8，开了相当长一段时间。
实际上，我家的双胞胎恰好就出生在RX-8发布的那一年。
我生的是一对男孩，但在他们出生之前，我就打定主意
要把RX-8作为家里的家用车。
RX-8简直就是为带双胞胎量身定做的。
虽然它是一辆四门车的，但有z��特别之处：前门得先打
开，后门才能开。
这可就省心了，我再也不用担心那两个调皮蛋在我开车
时不小心把门拉开了。
说实话，要设计一辆既有跑车范儿，还能舒舒服服坐四
个人的四门车……
不是件容易事。
能做到这一点的车真不多。
有朝一日要是我能再设计一款这种配置和引擎的车型
就好了。
前几天，我�'�冈山参加了个马自达车迷聚会……
我看到好多人都是开着RX-8来的。这么多年过去了，这
款车还是很有人气，真令人开心。C
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Ikuo Maeda

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
In many respects this ND Roadster is a product 
that I put alot of effort into.
The car I started competing in races with when I was into 
motorsports as a student, was the NB Roadster.
Later I would buy an NR-A version of the ND Roadster
and compete in one-make races,
but what I focused on most as the designer of the ND roadster,
was how it looks on the move.
It had to look good raci�g on a track, and in order
to create the base structure that would achieves this,
I kept imagining its form exiting a corner with 
the load on its rear tires,while working on its design.
Today I'm competing in Japan’s Super Endurance series
as both the team manager and driver of MAZDA SPIRIT RACING.
I actually race in a Roadster with this very livery, and we're
lucky to have many other roadsters participating in this class.
Whether it be real or virtual, I hope we can all enjoy 
racing on the track, as challengers with the same goals!
And I hope you'll keep up with the latest activities
of MAZDA SPIRIT RACING, too.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
我曾经为设计这辆ND Roadster
付出了极大的精力和时间。
我从学生时代起就是狂热的赛车迷，
还驾驶着NB Roadster参加过正式比赛。
再后来，我买过一辆NR-A版本的ND Roadster
去参加马自达举办的单一车种比赛。
在设计这款ND Roadster时，我最重视的一点
就是它在运动中所表现出来的模样。
也就是说�"�要让它在赛道上显得特别炫酷。
为了实现这个目的……
我在设计它的外观时，始终在脑海中想象
一辆重心后置的赛车出弯的模样。
目前我正在以马自达SPIRIT RACING车手以及车队经理
的身份参加日本的超级耐久系列赛。
我驾驶的其实是一辆采用同样涂装的敞篷跑车，
能与这么多同组别的其他敞篷跑车汽车竞技真是太幸运了。
不论赛道是真实还是虚拟的，
我希望大家都可以作为志同道合的挑战者，共同享受比赛的乐趣！
我也希望你可以多多关注马自达SPIRIT RACING的最新动态。r
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Ikuo Maeda

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This 400R is the complete car, not the GT-R that was based
on the R33.
It’s a car for connoisseurs.
With new bumpers, air outlets,
and overfenders...
...it’s practically a different car, and yet it’s
incredibly sleek all the same.x
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这辆400R是一辆“完全体”的车，而不仅仅是脱胎于R33的GT-R。
这是一辆为鉴赏家们设计的车。
它采用了新的保险杠、出气口和轮眉……
实际上可以算成一辆完全不同的车了。
尽管如此，它的外观依然是那么的流畅和优美。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The McLaren P1 is a special edition plug-in hybrid
from British automaker McLaren Automotive.
It features a carbon-fiber monocoque with a roof
structure called "MonoCage."
It’s the successor to McLaren’s legendary F1.
But the P1 carves out its own identity with a fresh,
organic design language.
And, to enhance aerodynamics 
on the track...
...This GTR features a large front splitter, aggressive
side skirts, and an imposing rear wing.Q
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
迈凯伦P1是英国汽车制造商迈凯伦汽车推出的
一款特别版插电式混合动力车。
其车身采用了碳纤维单体车壳和
名为“单笼”的车顶结构。
尽管设计灵感来源于迈凯伦的传奇F1赛车……
但P1的设计语言更新颖，更具有活力。
此外，为了提高赛道上的空气动力学性能……
这款GTR配备了大型前分流器、侧裙
以及一个引人注目的尾翼。t
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Kunihisa Ito

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
When I think of Renault-Alpine race cars, two that come
to mind are the rally-bred A110...
...and the long-tailed M Series
of Le Mans fame.
The Alpine A220 was built to comply
with Group 6 regulations...
...introduced by FIA in 1968.
However, because the car was unable to produce satisfactory
results at Le Mans, it was withdrawn from competition.

There seems to be a reason behind every detail of this design,

Well, if it isn’t an SF19, built for Japan’s top formula

This is the SF23, a car developed for the Super Formula series,

到了今年，这款SF23又将这一理^��拔高到了全新高度，

车的造型很独到。
这车最棒的地方就是轮胎和车身的比例关系。
车身压低变薄，让轮胎显得特别醒目，整体看上{��给人
一种精雕细琢的感觉，一点儿多余的东西都没有。
正是这种设计，让它成为了经典。美，真的太美了。
这车最初的创意图来自一位叫秦无荒的设计师。
这位老兄可是个设计天才，画功了得。你敢信吗？
他就用一支马克笔就把这车给设计出来了。
要我说，这个年代的FD和NA Roadster绝对是马自达
历史上最杰出的两个设�。
当时马自达处理三维形状的能力确实是世界一流的。
正好也赶上了马自达的设计理念刚开始成型的时候。C
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Ikuo Maeda
legacyUnmatchedReview.resolvedCarNameEn: Mazda RX-7 Spirit R Type A (FD) '02
legacyUnmatchedReview.resolvedCarNameZh: Mazda RX-7 Spirit R Type A (FD) '02

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
A company that’s known to pivot hard, Suzuki sometimes
offers products that really take you by surprise.
The Wagon R was one such example. And so
 was this Swift Sport.
The four corners of its chunky body are fit with relatively
large wheels that speak to its excellent maneuverability.
A small car, it’s equipped with everything it needs
and nothing else.
If you were to see it driving down an Italian street, you’d 
think the car was designed by Italians.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
铃木是一家出了名的“推陈出新”的公司，有时会拿出一些
出人意料的产品。
比如瓦罐R轻型车，又比如这款速翼特运动版。
这款车的外形方正，在四个轮位安装了大一号的轮毂，
体现出它优异的操控性。
这是一辆麻雀虽小，五脏俱全的小型车，
不少一分，也不多一分。
如果在狭窄的意大利街道看到它驶过，你可能
会觉得它和当地的环境浑然一体。\
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Hideo Kodama

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
In the Japanese automobile world, executing a model change 
without dramatically altering the car's design is rare.
But it is carried out quite well here.
The way the windshield blends into the side glass 
gives the impression of a full-face helmet.
This car possesses the same basic design theme
as its predecessor.
What has noticeably changed is...
...a more powerful looking one-frame front end 
and air intakes on either side.
However, these aren't exaggerated changes,
just effective._
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
在日本汽车界，在车辆改款时不对原设计进行大幅更新
是非常少见的情况。
不过这款新车的整体感觉非常不错。
它的挡风玻璃与侧面车窗融为一体，
给人一种全罩式头盔的感觉。
新车采用了与前代车型相同的基础设计主题。
最明显的改变在于……
更凸显力量感的单条前格栅
以及车头两侧的进气口。
这些改动不追求夸张的造型变化，只追求效率。.
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Hideo Kodama

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Aspiring to tone down the D-Type racer somewhat,
car designer Malcolm Sayer...
...gave Jaguar something that was aerodynamic, modern,
and dynamic.
That was this E-Type.
Although its engine was from a XK150 of the previous decade,
this monocoque racer was thoroughly modern.
It’s truly a thing of beauty!
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
为了推出一辆能与D-Type赛车争辉的新赛车，
汽车设计师马尔科姆·塞尔……
为捷豹带来了极其富有空气动力学、现代感
和动态感的设计理念。
促成了E-type的诞生。
虽然搭载了一台十多年前的XK150的引擎，这台单体车壳赛车
仍然是一台彻头彻尾的现代赛车。
它真是一件无与伦比美丽的造物！`
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Hideo Kodama

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Very Italian in improvisation,
I'm quite taken by...
....the high degree of precision displayed here.
One of the things the Maserati brothers, who sold Maserati
and started OSCA, left behind was...
...the sohc 6-cylinder engine.
The car that used this engine was their grand prix machine.
With that at the foundation, the A6GCS was born. 
The car's four driven wheels and various other mecha�ical parts 
are covered by a body that seems to be made of soft cloth.
The volume here is minimal.
This body was the work of the famous 
Modena craftsman Fantuzzi.
You can feel the presence of the design language 
of the Type 61 Birdcage in this car.
It really excites the soul, this design.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这是非常有意大利风格的即兴演绎，
尤其令我着迷的是……
整台车体现出的高精细度。
当玛莎拉蒂兄弟最终离开公司，创建奥斯卡时，
他们为玛莎拉蒂留下了一件宝藏，
就是这台直列六缸单顶置凸轮轴引擎。
使用这台引擎的是他们的一款大奖赛赛车。
在此基础上，他们开发了A6GCS。
宛若薄绸v��轻盈的车身用顺滑的曲线
包覆车轮和其他机械部件……
同时也将车身体积控制在了最低限度。
这正是莫德纳的著名车身制造商凡图奇的手笔。
你可以明显看到它的设计语言和Type 61鸟笼一脉相承。
看到这样的设计，让人从内心深处受到震撼！�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Hideo Kodama

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This is the high-performance version of the F430, developed
with the help of Michael Schumacher.
Stylistically, it is distinguished by a sharp front, large
air intakes, and enhanced brake cooling ducts.
However, the biggest difference is in the rear.
Here we have a large engine grille...
...and a big diffuser framed by a band with two large, round
exhausts on either side of the license plate.
To emphasize its sportiness, the side mirrors have been done
in carbon fiber...
And a two-tone livery is available as an option.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这是在迈克尔·舒马赫的协助下开发的F430高性能版本。
在外观设计上，它以更锐利的前脸线条、更大的进气口
和优化后的刹车冷却导风口与其他版本区分开来。
然而，最显著的区别在于车尾设计。
这里我们可以看到一个大尺寸的引擎舱散热格栅……
以及一个大型的底部扩散器，由一条装饰带��围，
两个大型圆形排气管则位于车牌的两侧。
为了突出其赛车基因，后视镜采用了碳纤维材质……
此外，还提供了双色条纹涂装作为可选项�k�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Fabio Filippini

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The fifth-generation Nissan Silvia was one of
my favorite Japanese cars of the early '90s.
A coupe of classic beauty—its lines were
remarkably clean and elegant!
It almost looked Italian in design.
That low front, transverse light strip, 
bright cabin and slender tail...
Everything in this car comes together
in a perfect harmony of proportions.m
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
第五代日产Silvia是我最爱的
九十年代初期日式车之一。
这辆呈现出经典美感的双门跑车
拥有令人眼前一亮的简洁优雅线条！
看上去非常像是意大利的设计风格。
低矮的车头、横断式条状车灯、
亮色的驾驶舱和纤细的车尾……
一切都完美地融合在一起，呈现出非常和谐的比例。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Fabio Filippini

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Imagine transforming a little French city car
into a mid-engine racer!
Ah, but such is the transgressive spirit of the R5 Turbo's
direct descendant.
Its sportiness is dynamically expressed through
widened flanks and central dual exhausts.
Interestingly, these aggressive elements are balanced
with those typical of Renault cars from the '90s.
This is most evident in the way the side edge line
"rolls" around the rear wheel...
...and in the use of a geometric design
for the front and rear grilles.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
你能想象将一辆小型法式城市用车改造成
一辆中置引擎赛车是什么样子吗？
这辆R5 Turbo的后继车型就承载了这样叛逆不羁的精神。
它的运动形态通过加宽的侧面裙边
和居中的双排气管得到了动态的展现。
有趣的是，这些激进的设计元素却通过90年代经典雷诺风格
的中和，取得了完美的平衡。
后轮的“管装”风道线条……
和前后格栅采用的几何分割设计就是最显而易见的证明！
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Fabio Filippini

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The same goes for the red stripes, scorpio badges, and the
light wheels, transforming it into a race car.
But above all, some details are striking, such as the
rubber locks for the hoods.
The rear-hood was raised to improve cooling,
and "Record Monza" chromed double exhausts were added.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
再加上红色条幅、天蝎徽标和轻量化车轮，
这些改动令其摇身一变，成为了一辆赛车。
那些令人尤为印象深刻的细节也十分吸引眼球，
比如引擎盖上的橡胶锁……
为了改善散热而抬高的后引擎盖，
以及“雷科德蒙扎”镀铬双排气管。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Fabio Filippini

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
I think the little FIAT Abarth 595 Esseesse is the perfect
expression of the "Italian spirit."
Particularly the spirit of the 1950 and 1960s, when the zeal
and passion of Italian people were expressed without restraint.
The tuned-up version by Carlo Abarth...
...is known for its lowered stance
and various mechanical changes.+
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
我认为这辆小巧的菲亚特阿巴斯595 Esseesse
是对“意大利精神”的完美诠释。
特别是在50至60年代，意大利人民即使能力受到客观限制，
热情和激情仍然无比高昂的那股劲儿。
这是由卡洛·阿巴斯改装的版本……
特点是降低了车身的高度，并在机械结构方面进行了调整。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Fabio Filippini

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
In the 1980s, there was a very unique phenomenon in the history
of automotive design. It was a time when the "boxy" style...
...was surely at its peak.
Blister fenders were the result of an attempt to marry
round tires to a square body design.
This style is one of the defining symbols of this era.
The polyhedron body of the car here is minimalistic.
But despite its abstract form, its intonation is limited,
and the exterior styling exudes extreme passion and excitement.
And because the car is seemingly pressed into an inorganic shape, 
the end effect is one that's relatively prominent.<next id=2001706 type
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
在1980年代，汽车设计的历史上掀起了一股非常独特的浪潮。
“四四方方”的设计理念在当时大行其道。
这部分微微鼓起的挡泥板就是这种思路的产物
——设计师们试图将轮胎的圆形和车身的方形轮廓融合起来。
这样的造型代表了那个年代的显著象征之一。
多边形车身非常抽象、简约。
虽然发出的音浪不大，
但成功通过外立面表达出了强烈的热情和兴奋感。
粗看下，这台车像是一团被捏合而成的无机物，
呈现出相对抢眼的最终效果。~
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The soul of a creator reaches out to unknown horizons.
At the point of arrival, new footprints
erase what was there before.
This creative passion will forever be engraved into
people's hearts and never disappear. 
These extraordinary creators...their visions have 
profoundly shaped the automotive world. 
They grab hold of the distant future and pull it in. 
They fly in the skies where technology and design are�free,
then safely land where their completed car becomes legend.
And the creator becomes a hero.
The designer of the 1955 DS was the Italian, 
 Flaminio Bertoni.
Unfortunately, his existence �ecame 
widely known only after his passing.]
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这是创作者的灵魂在向着未知的边界进行探索。
在抵达之时，新的足迹便抹去了原先的痕迹。
然而，这份创作的激情将永远铭刻在人们心中，
永远不会消失。
这些非凡的创作者，他们的愿景深刻地塑造了汽车世界。
他们抓住遥远的未来，将其带到人们的眼前。
他们自由飞翔在技术和设计的天空中，随着他们安��落下，
因之而生的汽车便成为了传奇。
而创作者则成为了英雄。
1955 DS的设计师是一位意大利人，弗拉米尼奥·贝托尼。
令人扼腕的是，他的声名在故去之后才广泛地为人所知。�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This 300 SEL may have been big for a sedan, but
I consider it a sports sedan all the same.
The best image of this car that I can recall is a head-on
shot of it coming out of a corner at speed.
It must have been intimidating for other drivers
to see this machine in their rear-view mirrors.
This car is a great example of good visual weight balance.
It also showcases great dynamic weight distribution
in full racing trim.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
作为一辆轿车，这辆300 SEL也许有点尺寸过大，
不过我依然认为它是一辆很棒的运动型轿车。
我印象中这辆车最美的姿态就是
站在正前方看着它以高速驶出弯道。
其他车手从后视镜里看着这辆猛兽步步逼近时
心里一定非常紧张。
它拥有恰到好处的车身比例。
全套赛车饰条与配件加身后，更显动态十足。:
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Tom Matano

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The base V12 Vantage S was a more potent version
of the elegant V8 Vantage...
...with a V12 engine and pronounced athleticism.
While this GT3 version may have swapped elegance
for a full-blown performance look...
...it maintains those unmistakable Aston Martin proportions.w
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这款车型的基础版本就是一台V12 Vantage S，
相当于V8 Vantage的动力强化版……
搭载了V12引擎，和更为显著的运动特征。
而到了GT3版本，则基本舍弃了优雅，
取而代之的是全方位的“高性能”外观……
但仍保留了阿斯顿马丁独特的车身比例。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Tom Matano

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The Pikes Peak Hill Climb is a race held in
Colorado, USA.
It is a race in which drivers compete for the fastest time
up a long and treacherous mountain road.
The course measures , climbing  to the finish
at —higher than Mount Fuji in Japan!
This Audi S1 shattered records with its victory at
the storied event.
Based on a WRC ma�hine, it featured large wings at the
front and rear, ensuring maximum downforce.
But who was the driver behind the wheel on that winding
“Race to the Clouds?"
Why, it was none other than WRC champion
Walter Röhrl!�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
派克峰爬坡赛是在美国科罗拉多州举办的比赛。
这是一场车手们需要在漫长而险峻的山路上
达成最快时间记录的赛事。
这条赛道长达，海拔始于，终于——比日本的富士山还要高！
这辆奥迪S1以破纪录的成绩在这场著名赛事中获得了胜利。
基于一辆世y��拉力锦标赛赛车，这辆车前后
都配备了巨大的定风翼，以获得最大的下压力。
那么驾驶这辆车，沿着蜿蜒的山路，
勇敢地“冲上云霄”的人是谁呢？
这个人正是�界拉力锦标赛的冠军沃尔特·罗尔！�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy
legacyUnmatchedReview.resolvedCarNameEn: Audi Sport quattro S1 Pikes Peak '87
legacyUnmatchedReview.resolvedCarNameZh: Audi Sport quattro S1 Pikes Peak '87

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Ever since it was introduced, the Mercedes AMG GT3
has been hailed as one of the fastest and fiercest GT3 race cars.
The original AMG GT3 made its debut in 2016.
At its first Nürburgring 24 Hours race, it did the
unthinkable, achieving an amazing 1-2-3 finish!
This machine is the updated AMG GT3,
which was introduced in 2019.
It featured aerodynamic improvements that generated
greater downfo�ce than before.
Also, an all-new braking system placed less stress
on the tires.
While these performance upgrades resulted in 
faster lap times...
...a more durable engine gave the AMG GT3 increased reliability.
And, a vastly improved parts management system...
...as well as several other tweaks made setting up and servicing the car easier for race mechanics.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
自初代型号发布以来，梅赛德斯AMG GT3一直被誉为
最强最速GT3赛车。
初代AMG GT3在2016年首次登上赛车舞台。
在参加的第一场纽博格林24小时耐力赛里，
它令人震惊地包揽了前三名，创下了永垂史册的壮举！
我们面前的这款赛车是升级后的AMG GT3，
于2019年首次亮相。
经过全面强化的空气动力性能
确�可以提供超强的下压力！
而全新的刹车技术则有效降低了轮胎磨损的压力。
除了这些性能升级带来的更出色的单圈时间外……
这辆AMG GT3还配备了更耐用的引擎、
一套大幅升级的零部件管理系统……
以及多项精细调整，从而帮助车队在赛道上更加风驰电掣。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
On the centennial running of the 24 Hours of Le Mans in 2023...
...a mid-engine race car claimed a brilliant victory
in the GT AM class...
...an achievement that forever redefined the legacy of
America’s sports car, the Chevrolet Corvette.
Its name—the C8—marked it as the eighth generation of
the storied Corvette.
It was also the first production model to break from tradition,
abandoning the front-engine/rear-wheel-dri�e layout...
...in favor of a mid-engine design transforming the
character of the car.
It proved to be a wise move, as the mid-engine Corvette has since
become a formidable presence in GT racing worldwide.t
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
在2023年勒芒24小时耐力赛百年庆典之际……
这款中置引擎赛车在GT AM组别
取得了辉煌胜利……
极大地改变了“美国跑车”——
雪佛兰Corvette的历史进程。
“C8”彰显了它作为这款标志性车型
第八代产品的身份。
这是首款摒弃传统前置引擎后轮驱动布局
的量产Corvette……
它转而将引擎置于车身中部！
这一明智之举显然取得了成功，因为中置引擎的Corvette
自此成为无数超级跑车赛事中不可小觑的力量。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Lancia of Italy had long been a dominant force 
in the World Rally Championship.
This Group A rally version of the Delta stands
as a testament to Lancia’s many triumphs.
From 1987 to 1992, the marque secured six
consecutive manufacturers’ championships.
It was a legendary achievement—one that remains unmatched
in the history of the world’s premier rally series.
This Group A Delta rally car stands as an undeniable testament
to Lancia’s dominance in the sport.
Even the production car version, built for Group B
homologation...
...is the envy of car collectors everywhere!~
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
意大利蓝旗亚作为第一个赢得
世界拉力锦标赛年度冠军的车厂被人们铭记。
这款Delta Group A拉力赛版本正是其众多杰作中的瑰宝。
从1987年到1992年，蓝旗亚豪取六连车厂冠军头衔……
这项传奇成就在世界顶级拉力赛事中至今无人能复刻。
这台Delta Group A拉力赛车无疑是蓝旗亚成功的见证。
即便只是作为为了满足B组别认证而打造的
量产版车型……
也令全球汽车藏家艳羡不已！
legacyUnmatchedReview.resolvedCar: DELTA HF Integrale WRC Group A (1992)
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Chris
legacyUnmatchedReview.resolvedCarNameEn: Lancia Delta HF Integrale Rally Car '92
legacyUnmatchedReview.resolvedCarNameZh: Lancia Delta HF Integrale Rally Car '92

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The granddaddy of lightweight sports cars,
the Seven is a legend among legends.
Its story began in 1957, when the car was
introduced by British automaker Lotus.
Lotus ended production in 1972, but the story did not end there.
Caterham acquired the rights the following year and
continues to build the Seven today.
This Superlight R500 combines a highly tuned engine�with a featherweight  body.
Its acceleration feels almost instantaneous, demanding
complete concentration from the driver.
The engine delivers a hard-edged note that seems
to resonate through the entire car.
For anyone seeking the pure thrill of the racetrack,
few cars can match the Superlight R500.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
“Seven”作为所有轻量级跑车的鼻祖，
堪称传奇中的传奇。
这一系列的根源最早可以追溯到1957年，
由英国汽车制造商莲花打造。
虽然莲花在1972年停产了“Seven”系列车型……
但凯特汉姆在次年就接过了生产权，并一直生产到现在。
这辆Superlight R500在轻如羽毛的车身中，�
搭载了一台精心调校的强大引擎。
其油门几乎是瞬时响应，因此驾驶时可千万别分神。
它那高昂的引擎轰鸣声，能让你从头到脚都感到震颤。
毫无疑问，对于追求赛道刺激感的车迷来说，
这款车就是他们的终极目标。2
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Chris

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This is a great-looking car. It remains one of the
more popular models in Gran Turismo.
The R34 Skyline.
It was developed with a clear intent—to create a sports
sedan that could serve as the foundation for the GT-R.
In the late 1990s, building a 4-door sedan with limited rear
cabin space was far from conventional.
Yet that very approach helped define the R34’s character, and it
went on to become one of the most iconic GT-R-based models.
It was fast and strikingly designed.
Even in race-prepared form, it still exudes that unmistakable
R34 presence.0
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这辆车的外形很不错。
我认为它是《跑车浪漫旅》当中比较受欢迎的一款R34天际线……
我认为这是一款由开发者创造的、开发意图十分明确的汽车，
目的是制造出一款作为GT-R基础的运动型轿车。
在20世纪90年代末，
考虑制造一辆后座空间有限的四门轿车显然不是正常的思路。
但最终，R34成为了即使在GT-R历史上也最为耀眼的明星。
这也是它甚至到了现在也备受众人欢迎的原因。
即使变成了如今的赛车模样，
它仍然非常有R34的感觉。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This car is a masterpiece of 
American race-car design.
Because of the era, I think its design was undoubtedly
influenced by the Ferrari GTO...
But this massive Daytona Coupe possesses an exclusively 
bold American flair, which I think is fantastic.
From the fully pushed back cabin to the squeezed out rear, 
the proportions of this car have been taken to the limit.
But that balance is what makes the car so alluring.
I feel this was from using the open-top AC Cobra as a base
and getting the most aerodynamic performance possible.
The design sense of Pete Brock, who effectively 
put this car together, really comes through.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这辆车是美国赛车设计史上的杰作。
由于所属时代的原因，我认为它的设计毫无疑问
深受法拉利GTO的影响……
不过这辆体型庞大的Daytona Coupe依然拥有独一无二的
粗犷美国风味，我觉得这一点非常美妙。
从大幅后移的座舱，到高度压缩的翘车尾，
这辆车的比例被推向了极限。
不过，这种奇妙的平衡恰恰是这辆车最迷z��的地方。
我认为这是因为它采用了敞篷的AC Cobra作为基础车型，
并尽可能地提升了空气动力学性能。
皮特·布洛克贯彻他的设计理念，成功打造了这款经典车。2
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This Daytona Cobra is no doubt Pete's signature creation.
It looks like a complicated design...
But the surface areas are clean, making it simpler and more
sophisticated than you might think.
That's why the more time passes, the better it looks.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这辆Daytona Cobra毫无疑问是皮特最具代表性的作品。
它的设计看上去有些复杂……
车身表面却异常简洁。要同时保证这样的简约与繁复，
需要花费超乎你想象的设计流程。
正因如此，它的外观才能够随着岁月的推移而常看常新，
令人回味。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The FD3S Mazda RX-7 was released in 1991. Even now,
there are many young fans of this car in the U.S.
It possesses a simple design without any faults.
The styling of this car was born at Mazda's California
design studio, led at the time by Tom Matano.
This particular street machine was created by RE Amemiya, 
which specializes in tuning rotary-powered machines.
Although it's not exactly a "hashiriya," or street racer,
it's nevertheless captivating.
It's a car you should drive at least once in Gran Turismo.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这辆FD3S 马自达RX-7虽然推出于1991年，但即便
到了今天，它依然在美国年轻人当中拥有不少粉丝。
它拥有简单而无懈可击的设计。
这辆公路车的外观设计诞生在马自达的加利福尼亚州
设计工作室，由俣野努主导完成。
眼前的这一台则是由专攻转子引擎调校的公司
RE雨宫改装后的版本。
尽管严格来讲它并不是一辆“街头赛车”，
但依然非常迷人。
至少，你在《跑车浪漫旅》中应该试驾一下它。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Kunihisa Ito

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
At first glance, it appears to be a normal sedan, but look
inside, and you'll realize that this car was created for speed.
This is the category that's referred to as "muscle cars."
This Challenger R/T is like the Barracuda
because it's smaller in size.
However, the large front opening 
and the kicked-up rear quarter...
...are aggressive design cues that match the car's character. 
Power is provided by a HEMI engin�.
On the hood is a protruding air scoop
called the "Shaker." 
When it shakes, it declares the enormous power it possesses.
If you include the optional rear spoiler, the Challenger R/T
is a muscle car that's sure to catch anyone's eye.A
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
如果不仔细看，你会以为它是一辆普通的轿车。
但坐进驾驶舱之后，你就会明白这是一台速度机器。
这个类别的车通常归类为“肌肉车”。
这辆Challenger R/T很像梭鱼，只是尺寸小一号。
不过它那宽大的前脸开口和
拱起的后侧围板……
无不在体现该车极富侵略性的特征。
此车的动力来自一台HEMI引擎。
引擎盖上的进气口又被车迷们戏称为“抖动器”
这个称号来源于它工作时的抖动噪声，
就像在宣告自己的澎湃动力。
如果再装配上车尾扰流板，
Chal�enger R/T必定会吸引所有人的目光。�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Hideo Kodama

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The Volvo V40 is a pleasant 5-door hatchback
with a sporty demeanor...
...most notably the T5 R-Design version.
Its exterior design conveys an excellent balance
of Latin fluidity and Scandinavian rigor.
In fact, it borrows styling cues from
the historic Shooting Brake P1800 E...
...a car that possessed an Italian flavor, thanks to the
contribution of Sergio Coggiola and Pietro Frua.
What a source of inspiration!
Note the small hollow on the side shoulder
and the rounded glass rear window.
These elements recall one of the most iconic cars
of the Swedish brand.e
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
沃尔沃V40是一款舒适惬意、带有跑车元素的5门掀背车……
尤其是产品阵容中的T5 R-Design。
它的车身外形在拉丁风格的流畅唯美和北欧风格
的严谨坚毅之间取得了傲人的平衡。
它的外形设计借鉴了独具历史意义的猎装P1800 E……
而科焦拉和弗鲁阿贡献的设计为这款经典车型
赋予了浓厚的意大利风格底蕴。
真是非常了不起的灵感来源。
注意它车身侧面车肩部分的小凹陷和后车窗的
圆弧形玻璃。
这些设计元素带领我们重新领略了这家瑞典品牌
历史上标志性车型的风采。<next id=2203009 typ�=9�A
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Fabio Filippini

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This is the new "electric" expression of Porsche design.
The design of this eco-sustainable evolution adopts
the soft and clean language of the Stuttgart house.
The proportions, while similar to those of the Panamera,
are more compact and lower to the ground...
...with a typical fast-back tail and a traversing strip
of LED rear lights.
However, the front expresses its new identity with
the headlights "slashed" directly onto the surface...
...with the four daytime running lights, but also with the
aerodynamic outlet behind the front wheel.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这款车是对保时捷设计的全新“电气化”表达。
这辆可持续环保升级车型的设计采用
斯图加特品牌那柔和又利落的设计语言。
Taycan的车身比与Panamera类似，
但要比后者更加紧凑、更贴近地面……
还采用了典型的斜背车尾和
由LED灯带构成的横条车尾灯。
不过它的前脸充分体现了全新个性，
两盏大灯和四盏日间行车灯连在一起，直接“下切”向路面……
此外，前轮后方还设计了空气动力学排气口。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Fabio Filippini

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The Maserati Gran Turismo...
...was a classic interpretation of Italian style and sportiness
by Pininfarina.
The long hood, set-back cabin...
...and compact tail were immediately recognizable.
These extremely distinctive proportions were a synthesis
of the typical dynamic balance of the GT category.
That said, there were elements that renewed the
historic identity of Maserati’s design.
Among them were the three little vents behind the front wheel.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
玛莎拉蒂伟大旅行……
是宾尼法利纳对意大利风格和运动性的经典诠释。
修长的引擎盖、后移的车厢……
和紧凑的车尾都是一眼就能认出的特征。
极具辨识度的车身各部位比例是GT系列
典型的动态平衡的综合体现。
尽管如此，车上还添加了一些非常有玛莎拉蒂风格的元素……
比如前轮后方的三个小小的通风口。W
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Fabio Filippini

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Designed by Pininfarina together with Ferrari Design,
the F12 was awarded the Compasso d'Oro 2014.
As you can see, it represents a huge change in
design from the previous 599.
Its sculptural forms are extremely compact and "dense."
The front is very aggressive, with the large central grille
and two active air intakes for brake cooling...
...while the back is recog�ized by the "T" theme, visually
separating the extractor into two parts.
But the most characteristic elements
are the Aero Bridges...
Channelling the air from the hood towards the flanks,
improving the overall aerody�amic efficiency.3
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这辆F12是由宾尼法利纳和法拉利设计合作设计的，
荣获了2014年度的金圆规工业设计奖。
如你所见，相比之前的599，它的设计发生了巨大的变化。
它那雕塑般的形状非常的紧凑和“凝实”。
前脸配备了庞大的中央格栅和两侧冷却刹车用的主动进风口……
攻击性十足，
而后部则v��清晰辨认出“T”型元素，在视觉上将排气管
分为左右两组。
但最具特征的元素还是“气动桥”……
它将引擎盖上的空气引导到车身侧面，从而提高了
整体的空气动力学效率。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Fabio Filippini

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
I’m a big fan of all things Chaparral.
The Chaparral 2J was the most innovative Chaparral.
It's undoubtedly the most radical racecar 
of the legendary CanAm series.
Its wedge-shaped nose, squared off body 
and twin fans on the rear...
...instantly made you want to know 
what mysteries lay below its skin.
Its design looks more like a scientific test bed 
than an agile racecar.
But the Chaparral 2J could 
outperform everything.
That's why it was eventually banned from racing 
because of its incredible technical advantage. 
I would have created a body shape which was more in 
keeping with the front-end design...
...or at least painted the center section white.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
我是Chaparral所有车型的忠实拥簇。
Chaparral 2J是他们最具创新性的一款车型。
毋庸置疑，它是传奇的美加系列当中最激进的一款赛车。
看着它的楔形车头、方正的车身和车位的两部风扇……
让你不由得对它的性能产生好奇。
从设计上看，它更像是一件“实验品”
而不是一台“赛车”，
�#�Chaparral 2J的确凭实力做到了藐视所有竞争对手。
这就是为什么它最终被禁止参加比赛的原因——
它的技术优势领先到无以复加。
就个人而言，我更倾向于打造
前后端设计更加一致的车身。
至少，我会将车体中段也涂成白色。s
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Ed Welburn

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The Pontiac GTO was a king among American muscle cars,
and the GTO 'The Judge' was the ultimate GTO.
My favorite aspect of the 1969 GTO 'The Judge' was 
the beautifully sculpted body side and soft fender peaks.
It’s unfortunate that the rear bumper didn’t get 
the same color treatment as that of the front bumper. 
Other than that, all this car needs are much larger wheels.
They would make the design look more balanced
and athletic.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
庞蒂亚克GTO就是美国肌肉车之王，
而这辆GTO 'The Judge'则是终极的GTO。
我对这辆1969款GTO 'The Judge'最喜爱的一点就是
它那雕塑般硬朗的车身侧线条与柔和的挡泥板上部的交融。
这里有个小小的遗憾，它的后保险杠并没有采用
与前保险杠相同的喷漆颜色。
除此之外，这辆车唯一欠缺之处就是需要更大的轮毂。
大尺寸的轮毂可以让它整体看上去更平衡、更具运动感。p
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Ed Welburn

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The Baby Lambo was added to broaden the market reach
of Lamborghini as a brand.
Unlike its super-car counterparts, the "Babies"...
...are known for their sharper surfaces, tighter dimensions,
and overall efficiency.
The Gallardo is a great example, exhibiting no excess
from any angle.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
“宝贝兰博”系列的推出旨在拓宽兰博基尼品牌
的市场。
与其超级跑车的兄弟相比，这些“小型”车型……
以更锐利的车身线条、更紧凑的车身尺寸
和整体上的高效设计而著称。
Gallard就是一个很好的例子，从任何角度看都能展现
出简洁而精致的设计，没有任何多余的元素。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Tom Matano

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This car reminds me of a happy little rabbit in the way
it sits slightly inclined towards the front.
It looks more like a fun runabout than a typical
commuter econobox.
Unlike retro-modern cars, such as the current Mini
and FIAT 500...
...this car is a modern interpretation of the original
FIAT 500 with Topolino character.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这辆车的车头弧度略微下滑，看上去
就像是一只快乐的小兔子。
与其说它是一款典型的经济型通勤车，
不如说更像一辆提供愉悦驾乘体验的轻便汽车。
和其他的复古现代风格汽车，
例如当前版本的MINI和菲亚特500不同……
这辆车就好比是以“米老鼠”角色特点对
初代菲亚特500的现代化演绎。`
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Tom Matano

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
