This is a McLaren F1 that has seen some track action.
Many consider this car to be the perfect sport car.
This race spec version first made an appearance in 1994.
And in 1995, it made its Le Mans debut,
going on to grab the overall title!
Incidentally, the victorious McLaren F1 GTR was once driven
by former Formula 1 driver JJ Lehto...
...and Japanese driver Masanori Sekiya.
It was the first time that a Japanese driver had won at
Le Mans.
He was also the fastest driver on the team, even when rain
fell during the night at the Circuit de la Sarthe.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
一辆久经战阵的迈凯伦F1！这可能是
有史以来最接近“完美”的车子了……
这辆车的赛车版本在1994年首次出现……
并于1995年首次在勒芒参赛，然后赢得了比赛！
顺便一说，那辆获胜的迈凯伦F1 GTR是由前一级方程式车手J.J.莱赫托和……
日本车手关谷正德驾驶的。
那是日本车手首次在勒芒夺冠！
而且，在那个萨森赛车场的雨夜里，他是车队里最快的车手！
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The 2005 MINI Cooper S is still stylistically and 
proportionately the best one！
I loved these when they came out, and I still love them!
Minimal overhangs and simple bodysides. 
Low beltline and great all-round visibility.
 All the horizontal lines were drawn in parallel
to each other.
This is when it seemed the MINI designers 
had a bigger voice with great vision!
They looked amazing in a variety of colors, 
liveries with optional roof colors and graphics.
The interior continued the theme with the
big round central screen.
The MINI screamed fun!
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
从风格和比例上比较，2005 MINI Cooper S都应当是
MINI产品线中的佼佼者！
这款车刚刚投产时我就爱上了它。
直到今天。我觉得它依然魅力不减！
你可以重点关注极限的短前悬、简约的廓形，以及
低腰线和全方位的视野，
还有车身的每一根水平线条都保持平行。
全都来自那个MINI的设计师们还抱有远见的时代！
无论搭配什么样的涂装、车顶颜色或是贴花，
它都能让你惊艳不已。
另外我还要夸一句圆形的中控屏幕。
没错，MINI就是这样，从里到外都充满乐趣！
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Freeman Thomas

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Do you remember the DeltaWing that raced in the
2014 24 Hours of Le Mans?
This car inherits the spirit of that machine.
It was developed with a truly original idea,
one that sort of went over the heads of normal folks. 
This front-engine/front-drive car gave designer and engineer Ben
Bowlby the freedom to realize his vision without compromise.
And it ended up taking this honest shape. I like it.
The proportions are uniqiue and the overall design is well-executed,
espeically the rear-quarter.
This wasn't exactly a race version of the GT-R, but 
after talking things over with Ben...
...he gave it a Vmotion grille and four round taillights, 
details that gave the DeltaWing some Nissan GT-R flavor.
Unfortunately, the car failed to produce any results at Le Mans, 
and it was discontinued after a year.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
你们记得三角翼吗？
参加过2014年勒芒24小时耐力赛的三角翼？
这辆车就是它的精神继承者。
它运用了完全原创的设计思路，
而且可能有些超出普通人的理解范畴。
我的意思是，这是一辆前置前驱车。设计师兼工程师
本·鲍尔比在打造它的过程中获得了充分的自由。
其结果就是这种朴实无华的外形。
我个人觉得�喜欢。
它的比例非常特殊。但效果非常棒，你不觉得呢？
它从侧后方的观赏角度看上去特别震撼。
严格意义上说，它不能算是GT-R的赛车版本，
不过在本和我的通力合作下，
为这款车安装了V动感前格栅，而在其后部，
我们也安装了四盏圆形尾灯。这些细节为它增加了日产GT-R的风味。
遗憾的是，这辆车在勒芒未能有所斩� ，在一年后便停产了。G
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The main role of the Z33, introduced in 2001, was to resurrect
the Z, and serve as a symbol of the revival of Nissan itself.
Therefore, it was a car that had to succeed.
Because the Z has been a defining symbol for Nissan through the
years, it naturally embraced the design heritage of the company.
That said, we couldn't give it a retro look.
We needed to retain the essence and spirit 
of notab�e Nissans of the past...
...while giving it a thoroughly modern character.
The inspiration for the car's design language was
the S30 and the CSP first-generation Silvia.
And, it may be difficult to notice, but there are hints
of the SP Fairlady in the body section. 
All of this made the Z33 more modern 
and possess different proportions than the S30... 
...but I feel it's still instantly
recognizable as a Z from any angle.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
Z33于2001年首次亮相，
它的使命是复活Z系列，并成为日产复兴的象征。
因此，这是一款不许失败的汽车。
作为日产的代表车型，Z33必须体现出公司的设计传统……
但又不能太“复古”。
因此，我们必须保留过去成就的精髓和精神……
再以完善的现代特征进行展现。
它的设计v��言可以追溯到S30和第一代Silvia CSP。
而且，容易被人忽略的一个点是
——其车身部分还有些Fairlady SP的影子。
这些设计元素都使得Z33在比例和主题方面较S30更加现代。
但你还是一眼就能看出，这是一辆Z系车。�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This rare S model was built by British coachbuilder Barker,
best known for its work with Rolls-Royce cars.
In fact, you’ll notice that its body greatly resembles
that of a Rolls-Royce.
Designed by Dr. Ferdinand Porsche during his stint as
chief engineer at Daimler-Benz...
...the S-type showed its potential when it won the opening race
at the Nürburgring in 1927.
Powered by an inline-6 mounted �id-wheelbase,
it is distinguished by its massive hood.
This feature gives the car very sporty proportions.
In addition to a factory body by Mercedes-Benz, the "S" also had bodies
by French and Italian coachbuilders.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这款极其罕见的S系列是由因为与劳斯莱斯合作而闻名的
英国车身制造厂巴克所打造的。
其实你可以看出，它的车身与劳斯莱斯非常相似。

这辆S型的设计者是当时仍在戴姆勒-奔驰担任
首席工程师的斐迪南·保时捷博士……
并在1927年纽博格林赛道的开幕赛事上获胜，
向世人展现出了巨大的潜力。
它�
�一部中置直列六缸引擎提供动力，
其巨大的引擎盖尤为吸睛，
也赋予了这辆车极具运动感的比例。
除了由梅赛德斯-奔驰打造的原厂车身外，这辆S型还可以采用
法国和意大利车身制造厂推出的车身。�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Hideo Kodama

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This car represents the baby of 
the Alfa Romeo range.
Its design recalls the stylistic features of 
the extreme 8C Competizione.
This includes with his curved sensual surfaces..
....not to mention its drop-shaped headlights and
round rear lights.
There are also the “five-circles” theme of the alloy wheels...
These elements are all 
typical of the Alfa brand.
The car is �nfused with an air of 
condensed energy that seems “ready to explode."
Even the window areas are extremely reduced, 
and the rear window is very slanted.
And the hatch here is small and, I must say, 
quite inconvenient.
But you know...
...when it comes to practicality...
Well, let's just say it certainly isn't  
the main objective of an Alfa Romeo's design.e
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
MiTo是阿尔法罗密欧旗下车型中的“大宝贝”。
它的设计特征让人想起剑走偏锋的8C Competizione：
包括那性感的弧度……
……“五环”造型的铝合金轮毂，
更不必提那为人熟知的水滴形头灯和圆形尾灯……
……全都是典型的阿尔法元素。
这辆车看上去仿佛被注入了一股浓缩压实过的能量�
像是“随时会爆炸”一样。
甚至连窗户的面积也遭到极限压缩，后窗陡然倾斜，
继而导致行李箱门开口变小，非常不便。
但是吧……
……每每谈到实用性的时候……
大家都会心领神会地说，
这方面肯定不是阿尔法罗密欧的主要设计目标。�
legacyUnmatchedReview.car: Alfa Romeo GIULIA TZ2 carrozzata da ZAGATO '65
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Fabio Filippini

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The GT Concept Car by Citroën has a very intriguing design.
Its center fuselage disappears behind
its very bold fender shapes.
This gives the car a sleek and aggressive look and helps
to manage air flow and cooling in a unique way.
The windshield and side glass are like slits, giving the
GT by Citroën a very private, sinister look.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这辆GT by 雪铁龙概念赛车带来了令人惊诧的设计。
它的车身不着痕迹地消失在极度激进的挡泥板之后。
这种特色让这辆车拥有了利落而极富侵略性的外观，
并以独特的方式辅助了气流引导和散热。
挡风玻璃和车窗玻璃就像是在同一块玻璃上开了缝一般，
让这辆GT by 雪铁龙呈现出既注重隐私，又略带邪恶的外观。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Ed Welburn

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Notice how the tires are positioned far out at the corners,
while the cabin tapers gracefully toward the rear.
It’s a winning combination, wouldn’t you agree?
The design conveys a remarkable sense of genuine agility,
no matter the vehicle’s height.
It's a type of beauty that is common with cars like 
the Honda CR-Z.
Front-end designs of recent Toyotas are fairly aggressive
looking even unmodified.
In �his case, they've taken that and run with it, for the
kind of car a real gearhead would appreciate.
The expression of the fascia isn't bad, but it's disappointing 
that it reminds you of an older Peugeot from afar.
The car is packed with good things so it would be nice if the
model sticks and is loved on the streets for a long time.
It makes you want to see a different model like the Renault R5
Turbo where an adult could dress up and drive it in style.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
你看，轮胎被远远地放在四角，座舱自然向后收窄，
这就叫强强联合，你说对不对？
即便车身高度很高，依然给人以灵活的感觉。
这种美感在诸如本田CR-Z等车型中相当常见。
最近几年的丰田在车身前部设计方面相当具有侵略性。
在这一台上也是如此，而且绝对能让真正的爱车人
满心欢喜。
前饰板的设计�&�算太坏，但还是有点令人失望。
从远处看，它会让你想起标致的老爷车。
丰田在这款车里塞进了很多不错的特性，
希望普罗大众会喜欢它吧，让它证明自己……
我很高兴能看到一台跟雷诺R5涡轮增压版同类型的其他车型
出现在市场上，成为成熟车手的心头好。�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
legacyUnmatchedReview.resolvedCarNameEn: Toyota GR Yaris 1st Edition RZ "High performance" '20
legacyUnmatchedReview.resolvedCarNameZh: Toyota GR Yaris 1st Edition RZ "High performance" '20

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This second-generation NSX-GT race car appeared in 2014.
Does that sound odd to you?
It should, because the second-generation NSX production
car was released two years later in 2016.
There's simple explanation to this.
The race NSX wasn't based on the production NSX, but on
the NSX Concept...
...which was unveiled ahead of the production version
in 2014.�And, it was this concept car that took
the GT name.
In mid-2016, the second-generation NSX production car
was officially released.
Because of this, the competition car was also called
the NSX-GT.
This car came in 3rd place in Round Five of the
Super GT in Japan.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这台第二代NSX-GT于2014年首次亮相。
听起来不觉得有些奇怪吗？
毕竟，它的基本车型，第二代NSX，在2016年才开始销售。
实际上，这辆车既是NSX，也不是NSX。
这是因为，它的原型车是一辆叫做NSX Concept的车……
那辆车是在本田于2014年，在其生产型出现前公布的。
然而，继x��GT名号的依然是一辆赛车！
2016年中，第二代NSX正式发布。
因此，这款赛车也被称为NSX-GT。
作为概念时代的最后一款特规车型，
这款车在日本Super GT第五轮比赛中获得了第三名。�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Why, this is the Group A rally version of the Lancia Delta!
A real fan favorite!
Its legend dates back to 1987, the first year in which
the WRC title was contested under Group A regulations.
That inaugural season, the Lancia Delta HF won the opening
race at Monte Carlo.
And it went on to claim the manufacturers’ and drivers’ titles
in a spectacular double victory!
What’s more, it went o� winning manufacturers’ titles until
1992—a six-year streak!
That year may have marked the final appearance of a Lancia works
team in the WRC.
But it also saw the introduction of the Delta HF Integrale,
which dominated the competition in speed and durability.
Starting at Monte Carlo, it won eight races that year
and proudly clinched Lancia its sixth consecutive title.L
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
哇，这可是蓝旗亚Delta的A组别拉力赛版本！
车迷们的心头好！
这台车的传奇始于1987年，世界拉力锦标赛在那年
首次设立A组别。
首个赛季，蓝旗亚Delta HF便在蒙特卡洛揭幕战
旗开得胜……
并一路狂飙，达成斩获车厂和车手
双料冠军的壮举！
不仅如此，它更将车厂冠军头衔一直保持到了1992年
—�
成就六连冠伟业！
1992年是蓝旗亚车厂车队最后一次亮相
世界拉力锦标赛……
但同年问世的Delta HF Integrale依然在速度
和力量上力压群雄。.
从蒙特卡洛开始，它在那年赢得了八场比赛，
更荣耀地为蓝旗亚捧起六连冠奖杯。�
legacyUnmatchedReview.resolvedCar: DELTA HF Integrale WRC Group A (1992)
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy
legacyUnmatchedReview.resolvedCarNameEn: Lancia Delta HF Integrale Rally Car '92
legacyUnmatchedReview.resolvedCarNameZh: Lancia Delta HF Integrale Rally Car '92

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
When it comes to speedy little road rockets,
the first thing that comes to mind is this Mini.
Although the original Mini was built as a compact car for the
masses, it possessed a high level of performance.
The first to notice the Mini’s potential was the car
constructor Cooper, of Formula 1 fame.
That was the company that created this sporty Mini Cooper S.
The car shined in in races and rallies of the day,
leaving behind a lasting legacy.
This model, with an improved engine displacement of ,
is especially prized within the series.e
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
说到小而快的车型，首先想到的就是这款MINI。
尽管最初的英国MINI可能是定位于紧凑型民用车，
但其性能仍然不可小觑。
首先注意到MINI潜力的是天才汽车工程师库珀，
对，就是以F1闻名的传奇人物。
他的团队是这款运动型MINI Cooper S的
幕后推手。
这款车在竞赛和拉力赛中取得的光辉战绩，
成就了一代传奇。
这款车型引擎排量提升高达，
是该系列中弥足珍惜的一款。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Chris

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
I love the 2008 FIAT 500! It's so 
whimsical and fun.
It does a masterful job of improving upon
an automotive icon.
Expressing character in automotive design
is no easy task.
But here's an example that truly inspires!
The face is friendly, with its round eyes.
There could be a parking lot full of them, all the same
color, and they would each look unique!
Color plays a huge emotional role in the 500.
Given its retro design, the traditional colors suits it
quite well.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
我可爱2008款菲亚特500了！这辆有趣的小车太脑洞大开了。
真的，它对前继车型的各方面优化都完成得相当漂亮。
在汽车设计中，表达个性从来都不是一件容易的事。
但这辆车绝对是一个正面例子！
睁着一双“圆眼睛”的前脸看着就很是友好。
就算在一个停车场里停满相同颜色的这台车，
你依然会感觉它们每一台都有自己的个性！
不同的颜色为菲亚特500注入了个性与情绪。
考虑到它的经典复古造型，
复古怀旧的涂装更相得益彰。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Freeman Thomas

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
So I was the Chief Designer for the Demio before this model,
and have a lot of memories about the car.
This model was not designed as a single car but as a series.
The three models, the Atenza, Axela, and the Demio 
were designed simultaneously.
And actually I love small cars like the Demio.
I especially love Italian compact cars like the Autobianchi
and the Alfa Romeo Alfasud, 
and I personally owned an old British Mini in the past.
So when I first found out that I would be designing 
the Demio I was really happy about it!P
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
哦，没错，说到这个车型，我可是前一代DEMIO的
首席设计师呢。
不过，这次我们可不是单独设计一款车，而是一口气
设计了一整个系列。
ATENZA、昂克赛拉和DEMIO这三款车，我们是同期设计，
同时进行，一气呵成！
说实话，我其实特别喜欢DEMIO这种小巧玲珑的车。
尤其是意大利的那些紧凑小车，比如奥托比安希和
阿尔法罗密欧Alfasud。
我还真有过一辆老款的英国迷你呢。
所以你能想象到，当我听说要我来设计DEMIO的时候，
我有多高兴！
legacyUnmatchedReview.car: Alfa Romeo GIULIA TZ2 carrozzata da ZAGATO '65
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Ikuo Maeda

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
In terms of design, the Mark IV was a complete departure
from the Ford GTs that came before it.
Its body and side profile alone evidence a prioritization
of pure aerodynamic performance.
From this point on, Ford showed its commitment to
breaking the GT mold...
...its mission to create completely pure race cars.*
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
在设计上，Mark IV与过去的福特GT截然不同。
光从车身和侧面剖视图来看，就能充分体现其纯粹为空气动力学性能
而作出的优化。
从此刻开始，福特展现了突破GT风格桎梏的决心……
目标是创造出完全不同的纯粹赛车。D
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This is a masterpiece of Japanese car design.
To be honest, the S30 was developed as a hatchback coupe,
rather than a sports car.
There's plenty of cabin space.
Overall headroom is generous for a pure sports car. 
Still, it looks very sporty,
meaning it is a very special design.
Take the proportion, line, and surface...
...in many ways, the design of this car says 
"it can only be done this way.� 
But what is most impressive is...
...is its purity.
It exudes a high sense of Japanese beauty.
The look of the nose is modern.
It's a design that's distinctly Japanese,
unlike any other car from the U.S. or Europe.
The S30 is unmistakably a design that represents Japan.
From the latter half of the 1960s and on,
more than a few amazing sports-car designs were created in Japan. 
In that day, there were man� motivated 
and talented young designers inside Japanese car companies.
They borrowed the best parts of Western design elements,
while keeping their own unique character.
I pay respect to the achievements of all of them, especially
Yoshihiko Matsuo-san, who recently passed away.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这辆车可是日本汽车设计的杰作之一！
严格来讲，S30是作为一款掀背式双门轿跑车开发的，
而不是一款跑车。
如你所见，这辆车的车厢空间很大……
而且与纯粹的跑车相比，头顶空间更富裕。
不过，得益于其卓越的设计，它看起来还是动力十足。
此车的一切——车身比例、线条和外观表面……
无不{��显着“纯正”二字。
但最为出众的……
还是其体现着日式设计美学的优雅和精致。
以其现代化的车头设计为例。
与美式或欧洲的设计都不相同，极具日本车特色。
S30就是一台纯粹的日系车。
从六十年代晚期开始，日本设计出了无数台跑车杰作。
当时的日本汽车公司汇聚了许多位
热忱且有才华的年轻设计�3。
他们从西方设计中汲取精华，
但又保留了自己独特的感受力。
这些设计师都值得我们尊敬。
尤其值得一提的一位，便是最近去世的松尾良彦。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
In some ways, the Z34 is more classic in overall styling
than the Z33.
The wheelbase has been shortened by ...
...giving it long-nose proportions.
The shape of the roof,
and the window graphics with the peak at the very front...
...also adopt the S30's design basic theme.
In contrast, the massive rear fender that squeezes the shape
of the body from front to rear...
...aims to g�ve this car a level of aggressiveness never
before seen on a Z.
There were challenges on how to evolve the Z33's styling.
If the Z33 represented a modern and more
elegant design theme...
...then the Z34's look is one that's a more authentic of an
FR sports car with added aggressiveness.2
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
从设计上看，Z34比Z33的外观更回归经典。
首先，轴距缩短了……
显得车头相对更长。
其车顶的形状以及最前面的车窗贴花……
则特意延续了S30的设计风格。
相比之下，巨大的后挡泥板让车身的重心从前向后挪……
令它看上去更具有攻击性。
这是之前的Z系列中所罕见的。
当然了，对Z33的外型进行迭代并非易事。
简而言之，如果Z33给人以现代的优雅感……
Z34则更像是一款地道的前置后驱跑车，
而且更具攻击性。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
When the Sauber Mercedes C9 was introduced, it was already
somewhat aged...
...having arrived just as Group C regulations ushered 
in a new era of automotive technology.
It was the era of carbon-fiber monocoque chassis, showcased
by TWR-Jaguar machines...
...along with entries from Nissan, Toyota, and Aston Martin.
Meanwhile, the Sauber C9 stuck with an all-aluminum construction.
But tha� didn’t stop it from dominating Le Mans in 1989 with a
stunning 1-2 finish.
How did it achieve such an incredible feat?
The answer lies in the power of Mercedes' advanced
computer systems and rock-solid engineering.
It was the kind of victory that only cutting-edge technology
could deliver!�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
从1987年首次亮相的那一刻起，索伯梅赛德斯C9
就已经有些过时了。
毕竟，它诞生于C组别规则推出和汽车技术
新时代来临之前的黎明。
这是碳纤维单体壳底盘闪亮登场的年代，以汤姆·沃金肖赛车-捷豹……
日产、丰田和阿斯顿马丁为代表的车型就是例证。
而索伯C9仍然坚持全铝结构。
但这并没x��阻止它在1989年的勒芒取得
一二带回的成绩。
它是如何取得这一惊人壮举的呢？
这都要归功于梅赛德斯自己的计算机系统
和可靠的制造工艺！
确实，这是一场只有计算机才能实现的胜利！
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Kunihisa Ito

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
You might say that Porsche is Volkswagen-inspired not only
in the architecture of its cars but also in overall design…
...which some attribute to the genius of Erwin Komenda,
Ferry Porsche’s main engineer.
Yet it was Ferry’s son Butzi who would work this theme
into the modern 911.
With headlamps set at the end of its elongated front wings...
...a sloping rear, and elliptical side windows...
...it's a basic example of the "Jaray-style."
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
很多人认为保时捷不仅在其汽车的架构上
受到大众的启发，整体设计理念方面也是如此……
并将之归功于艾尔文·柯曼达的天才头脑，
这位工程师同时也是费利·保时捷的得力助手。
但将这一设计理念真正融入到现代911车型中的
其实是费利的儿子（绰号“布奇”）。
在前翼子板顶端设置的头灯……
后溜背的车尾和椭圆形侧窗……
这些都是典型的“贾雷式气动设计”风格的体现。_
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Hideo Kodama

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Building on Chaparral’s history of innovation, 
the Chaparral 2X is an incredible vision of the future.
It’s much different from the Chaparral 2J...
 but just as radical in its mission. 
With a flying wing suit as its inspiration, 
Chaparral 2X takes on a very different proportion.
 And it incorporates moving 
aero devices throughout. 
All of its design elements work in harmony...
...to make it look like it’s in motion, 
even when it’s standing still.
The execution of all of the surfaces 
and attention to detail are stunning.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
Chaparral 2X是Chaparral车系创新史的继承者，
造型设计充满未来感。
毋庸置疑，它的造型和Chaparral 2J截然不同……
但追逐极限的使命被延续了下来。
以翼装技术为灵感，Chaparral 2X的车身表现出独特的比例……
并在整个车身融入了可动空气动力学部件。
所有设计元素融合到一起后，赋予了它极富动感的外观。
即便静止不动，依然让人感到冲劲与跃动。
另外，他们对车身表面的处理
和对细节的执着都令人叹服。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Ed Welburn

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The 1970 Chevrolet Chevelle SS is one of the most masculine
cars of the muscle-car era.
Everything about it says "power," from its bulging shapes
and its muscular fenders...
...to its power-dome, cowl-induction hood.
I liken the big-block Chevelle SS
to an animal ready to pounce.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这辆1970款雪佛兰羚羊SS是肌肉车黄金时代
最富肌肉感的车型之一。
从它壮硕的车身轮廓到粗犷的挡泥板……
再到向上隆起、采用风帽导气设计的引擎盖，
每个细节无不散发出一种“动力澎湃”的感觉。
我会将这款大排量的羚羊SS
比作一只蓄势待发的猛兽。E
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Ed Welburn

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This car probably has the most dramatic profile
of a modern front-engine sports car.
The hood is long and low, and the cabin is placed well back
on the chassis, right over the rear wheels.
One of my favorite design features is how the front fender
vents are linked to the shape of the door opening.
Overall, the SLR McLaren has the look of speed,
grace, and elegance.x
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
在现代前置引擎跑车中，这款车可能是车身比例
最吸睛的车型之一。
它的引擎盖修长而低矮，车厢后移置于底盘后部，
正好位于后轮上方。
前挡泥板通风口与车门门缝衔接的神来之笔
绝对是我最喜欢的特色设计之一。
总体而言，SLR迈凯伦展现出了速度、优雅
和风度兼具的外观。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Ed Welburn

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Historically, many road cars that served as the basis
for rally machines have been especially appealing.
Cars like the Mini Cooper S, Audi quattro
and Lancia Delta...
...all began as practical, utility-focused family cars.
Yet beneath that everyday form, they carried
serious performance potential.
Of course, a true rally car could not be driven on public roads.
From a design standpoint, the challenge was to �xpress that
expanded capability within the framework of a road car.
The Evo V introduced larger wheels with pronounced overfenders.
It gave the traditional three-box sedan 
the stance of a performance machine.
Combined with signature rally elements such as large
fog lights and a prominent rear wing...
...it completed the purposeful yet refined design of the
second-generation Lancer Evolution.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
从历史上看，许多被用作拉力赛车改装原型的公路车都
非常有吸引力。
我指的是像迷你Cooper S、奥迪quattro和
蓝旗亚Delta这样的车……
这些都是以家庭用车为目的，讲究实用性的车型。
它们就仿佛是栖息在城市中的动物。
当然了，真正的拉力赛车都是禁止在街道上驾驶的。
因此在设计方面，重点在于如何在公�)�车的框架内表达扩展的远景。
Evo V采用了人们期待已久的大车轮，
为了搭配车轮，挡泥板的尺寸也相应拓展，
这台三厢轿车的底盘也由此换成了赛车底盘。
拉力赛车标志性的巨大雾灯和尾翼自然更不用提。
你可以认为，它就代表了第二代Lancer Evo的完整形态。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Today, the WRX STI has grown into a model
with its own distinct identity...
...representing Subaru’s engineering capability, technical
efficiency and focus on high performance.
But the second-generation WRX STI remained closely
tied to the Impreza.
And that connection gave its character a unique appeal.
It effectively reflected the idea of an everyday sedan
transformed into a serious performance machine.
With the newer WRX, however, the base model already carried a more
aggressive character, making the contrast less pronounced.
If you’re drawn to that sense of transformation—like
Peter Parker becoming Spider-Man...
...then this second-generation model, with its clean, understated
cabin and simpler window design, may be just right for you.~
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
时至今日，WRX STi已经……
拥有了自己独立的品牌价值和存在意义，它代表着
斯巴鲁的技术实力与热情。
有鉴于第二代WRX STi是翼豹的改款版本之一……
使得它的设计完美体现了我们常用来打趣的那句俗语……
“文能出门买菜，武可拉力比赛。”
相比之下，新一代WRX的出厂版本就已经颇具�攻性，
所以新型号上的文武之分就没有那么鲜明了。
因此，如果你想看到的是彼得·帕克
变身成为蜘蛛侠那种迥然相异的反差……
那么内饰朴实简洁，且没有配备�`角形后车窗的
第二代WRX将是你的不二选择。�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This car brings back the spirit of the original Skyline GT-R.
When you compare this car to the R33, the overall design has
become compact and solid. 
Looking at the abruptly cut-off front end, you get a sense of 
a modernized version of the C10 "Hakosuka."
The side glass graphics at the C-pillar 
are also reminiscent of the C10.
You can say that the different front and rear overfenders 
are t�ose from the Hakosuka, too.
And while the enlarged round taillights are an homage to the
C110, dubbed the "Ken-Meri..."
...this car is characterized by an uncommon Japanese design
that's simple and powerful. 
It's undeniable that the Nissan designers wanted to express 
the story of the Skyline GT-R through this car.

After all, the growth of a brand stems from love.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这辆车再现了原版Skyline GT-R的风采。
与R33相比，它显得紧凑而又结实。
修整过的车头仿佛是C10 “Hakosuka”的
现代版诠释……
C柱处的侧窗玻璃贴花是如此，
甚至连前后不同尺寸的挡泥板也与C10有着深厚的渊源。
那对又大又圆的尾灯
则是对绰号“Ken-Meri”的C110的致敬……�p/>
其简约而有力的设计是在日本车中十分罕见的。
毫无疑问，日产的设计师希望通过这款车
展现出Skyline GT-R的背景故事。
我只能说，这绝对是真爱了。@
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
legacyUnmatchedReview.resolvedCarNameEn: Nissan Skyline GT-R V･spec II Nür (R34) '02
legacyUnmatchedReview.resolvedCarNameZh: Nissan Skyline GT-R V･spec II Nür (R34) '02

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This was a very unique car in the sense that Toyota’s
designers had to create an original design style for it.
It feels expertly sculpted.
In order to fit a 6-cylinder engine, the Supra’s nose
had to be extended, both physically and visually.
As a result, it looks like a powerful grand tourer.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这是一款非常独特的车型，丰田的设计师们
注入了完全原创的设计风格。
它的车身给人以精雕细琢的感觉。
为了塞入一台6缸引擎，这辆Supra的车头不得不
横向加宽，也呈现出更豪迈的视觉风格。
最终的造型也更接近一辆性能强大的豪华旅行车。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Tom Matano

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
I love compact sports models from Germany. 
They all have wide tires, twice as wide as
Japanese compact cars. 
Those wide tires are among the most significant
components of this car. 
They give the car its personality.
And the resulting wide stance makes the car look stable,
as well as possessing performance. 
They distinguish the base C coupe from the AMG version
for those who have keen eyes.X
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
我非常喜爱德国产的紧凑型跑车。
这些车型都采用了宽胎，
其宽度足有日本紧凑型车的两倍。
宽胎正是这辆车最重要的组成部分之一。
赋予了这辆车鲜明的个性。
而这种设计让车身显得又宽又低，看上去非常稳定，
性能也同样卓越。
在懂行的人眼里，这些特点让AMG版本与
基础的C级双门跑车有了明显的区分。s
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Tom Matano

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The GR Supra Racing Concept was revealed at the
Geneva Motor Show in March 2018.
When I saw it, I immediately thought to myself, 
"The Supra is back at the track!"
Truly, Toyota is an incredible company!
Prior to the GR Supra’s release in 2019...
They had developed models built to LMGTE and
FIA GT-4 specifications.
Its debut race on Japanese soil was the first round
of the 2020 Super GT, at Fuji Speedway.
And of the six Supras that apparently competed,
five swept the top finishing positions!
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
GR Supra Racing Concept是于2018年3月在日内瓦车展上亮相的。
当我看到它的时候，
我就在心里对自己说，“Supra又回来比赛了！”
丰田真的是一家让人惊艳的公司！
在2019年，GR Supra还没推出之前……
他们就开发过LMGTE和国际汽联GT-4级别规格的Supra。
此车在日本本土的出道首战是在富士赛车场
举行的2020 Super GT第一轮。
六辆参赛的Supra中，就有五辆车包揽了完赛前五名的名次！
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The 964-based RS is one of my favorite models.
Because it retains the original "Ur" 911 shape 
and air-cooled flat-6!
I'm thrilled it is visually pure and doesn't have 
any add-ons like a fixed rear wing. 
Also, it's Porsche's first Cup Car.
A true successor to the '73 RS and the '74 RS 3.0. 
You can immediately tell a 964 RS from a normal 964 by 
just looking at the stance and the wheels.
The 17-inch wheels on the 964 were made from aluminum. 
On the 964 RS, they were visually the same, but were wider 
and made from lighter magnesium.
Today, they fall into the "unobtanium" category!Z
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这款964 RS版本是我最喜欢的车型之一。
为什么？因为它保留了911原汁原味的“Ur-911”型外形和风
冷水平对置六缸发动机！
它带来的纯粹感令我兴奋不已，比如说，它就没有添加
固定尾翼之类的部件。
而且，它是保时捷的第一辆“奖杯赛车”。
我认为它是73版RS和74版RS 3.0真正的继承者。
只需看一下车辆的姿态和车轮，你就能立即分辨出
964 RS和普通964的差异。
964使用的17寸车轮杯型1是铝制的，
而964 RS虽然使用了同尺寸的车轮，但显得更宽，而
且使用更轻的镁合金材料制造。
镁现在已经被归为“超导矿石”类目，价格不菲！�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Freeman Thomas

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
It could be ordered in standard colors, along with
Rubystone, Signal Green or Maritime Blue. 
The sparse interiors came in black as standard.
Then there were the one-piece composite Recaros,
with central trimmings in two-tone leathers.
There was the "M001" Carrera Cup Version, the "M002"
RS Touring Version, or the "M003" N/GT1 Carrera RS.
This is a must-have for the 911 air-cooled purist!
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这辆车的标准车身配色包括了红宝石色，信号绿，海洋
蓝。
内饰倒是标准且朴素的黑色，
外加中间包边的Recaro运动桶椅，可选双色皮革，
还分成了“M001”Carrera杯版本、“M002” RS Touring版本
和“M003” N/GT1 Carrera RS。
对于追求纯粹的风冷引擎911爱好者来说，这是一台必须
拥有的车！
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Freeman Thomas

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The lovable Bug continues with the 1966 VW 1200 Beetle.
This version has enlarged front and rear windows.
The first-generation Pretzel's split rear window
changed in 1953 to a larger oval rear window.
In 1958, the rear window changed again
and became even larger.
With this model...
...the demand for better visibility, lighting, power, and
safety caused the three-arch silhouette to evo�ve again.
But the original character and charm remained.
The last production air-cooled Beetle came in 2003.
Just think, 21,529,464 units built since 1945! That’s quite
a run, an� it’s still popular!<
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
1966大众1200甲壳虫延续了甲壳虫的可爱风格！
这个车型加大了前后车窗。
第一代“椒盐卷饼”的分块式后窗于1953款更换为了
更大片的椭圆形后窗。
在1958款中，后窗又经历了改进，尺寸进一步增大。
而到了这个车型中……
出于更好的可视性、轻盈感、动力和安全的需求，
引擎盖3个拱的形状�#�廓又一次发生了进化，
但原先的特色和魅力得到了保留。
最后一款风冷引擎的甲壳虫一直生产到2003年。
你想象一下，从1945年起到现在，这款车一共造了21529464辆！
这是多么漫长的生命周期啊。而且直到现在，
甲壳虫都还很有人气！%
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Freeman Thomas

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Here we go!
The Daihatsu Copen makes me smile! 
 It is truly a whimsical and fun design!
It says, "Don't take things so seriously!"
 Look at the front with its friendly round 
headlamps and a smiling grille!
 The taillights repeat the expression with its round eyes.
And, proportionally, it has a nice stance.
This design here visually puts the wheels on the ends, 
making it a look like its ready to pounce!
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
每当我看到大发Copen，都会忍不住笑！
这确实算是一个异想天开的有趣设计！
它仿佛在说：“看我萌你一脸！”
前脸这里，是对你开心眨眼的圆形大灯和嘴角上翘的进气格栅！
尾灯也是两颗萌萌的圆眼睛。
它的车身比例相当不错，所以静态效果很出彩。
设计师特意把前后轮距拉远，
让它看起来像是要“猛兽”扑食一般！
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Freeman Thomas

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The Raptor is an aggressive and capable beast.
I love this truck!
It has a solid overall design and possesses plenty of Ford’s
unique DNA.
The wide stance and large tires result in great
handling character and tremendous height.
Its capable 4WD system allows it to excel
on rough off-road terrain.
This first-generation Raptor had a V-8 that matched 
its aggressive character.=
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
猛禽的外形充盈着侵略性和力量感！
这就是我爱这辆卡车的原因！
它不仅拥有福特血统的优点，还有许多独到之处！
形成了一套性能全面的设计方案。
它拥有宽大的车架和大外径尺寸的轮胎，
因此获得了出色的操控性和充分的离地间隙。
极大的上坡角增大了车架前后部分与地面的空间，
使其能够轻松搞定起伏坎坷的地形。
另外，这辆初代猛禽搭载的可是一台V8引擎，
无论是个性还是侵略性，都更上一层楼！L
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Freeman Thomas

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
In a way this Atenza is my debut work. There were a lot of
obstacles, and it brings back a lot of memories.
I was appointed the general manager of the design division
in 2009, to be the leader of Mazda design,
but I was told about my new position just 2 weeks before, so
I became general manager without any time to be ready.
And the first production car that I worked on,
was this Atenza.
Given�this major role and responsibility,
this was a state of emergency for me, 
but it was just as much a chance as it was a crisis.
It was a time in which the design theme for the next generation of
Mazda's were being considered from almost scratch,
and I thought to make design the major
pillar of Mazda from here and now.
And actually, the development of this car had already progressed
quite a bit under the previous design manager already,
but after th�nking that we need to create the philosophy of Mazda
for the next age, and make design itself one of the pillars,
I made the decision to completely change the design
that was already in motion.
To do this it was necessary to redesign things that normally
should not be touched in terms of the development schedules.
As a result, the final design schedule for the production car
was delayed about 10 months...
And I was really scolded badly by the managing d�rector
of development at the time. A LOT.
At the time I was working on the "SHINARI" concept car
that would be the vision model for the next era,
and I translated the design theme of SHINARI to the production car
because it was a car made alongside the SHINARI.
It's a car that I personally care for a lot, I was
even still driving it until very recently.
Its been over 10 years now, but I think
its a design that doesn't feel old.
The more you work onwstandard cars, the more you understand
the power of design. 
And saloons are difficult to design, because
they are the base for all cars.
I think timeless cars of an orthodox category is where
the ability of designers are truly tested.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
阿特兹可以说是我的设计生涯的开端，说起来，这个项
目真是苦乐自知，回忆满满啊。
2009年，我突然被任命为马自达设计部门的部长。
事情非常突然，我只有两周时间来适应这个新职位。
我接手后参与的第一款量产车就是阿特兹。
说实话，那会儿真是责任重大，差点儿没把我压垮。
不过，我硬是x��这个危机扭转成了成功的机遇。
当时，马自达正在为下一代车型寻找新的设计主题。
我的想法是把“设计哲学”作为马自达未来发展的支柱。
老实说，前任部长在阿特兹上已经下了不少功夫。
但为了实现我的新一代设计理念……
我决定把这个已经在顺畅推进的项目推倒重来。
也就是说，一些通常在生产后期不会再改动的部分，我
们也^��重新设计。
结果就是这款量产车设计进度整整推迟了10个月左右。
这下可把上司们气得不轻——他们当时大发雷霆。
与此同时，我还在筹备一款叫“靱”的概念赛车，它将成为
马自达下一代的前瞻性参考车型。
有意思的是，因为“靱”和阿特兹的开发是同期进行，
它们俩最后用上了同一个设计主题。
说真的，阿特兹U��我来说意义非凡。事实上，直到前不
久我还在开这车呢。
虽然这款车已经面世十多年了，但它的设计仍然经得住
时间的考验。
你知道吗？你在标准车型上花的功夫越多，就越能体会
到设计的魔力。
尤其是轿车，看起来再普通不过，设计起来反而最难。
所以，要评估一位设计师的水平，关键在于他能否为正
统车型设计出经久不衰的作品。P
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Ikuo Maeda
legacyUnmatchedReview.resolvedCarNameEn: Mazda Atenza Sedan XD L Package '15
legacyUnmatchedReview.resolvedCarNameZh: Mazda Atenza Sedan XD L Package '15

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
I think the MAZDA3 is one of the top 5 cars
in my career as a car designer.
The design of the MAZDA3 also trails back to the RX-VISION.
In the RX-VISION, I created a form that expresses
a sense of life in the beauty of its reflections.
And the design of the MAZDA3 is an achievement of that form
created in the RX-VISION, in the C segment.
It's one of my personal favorites, and I think its a car
that will mark its name in history.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
马自达3可以说是我的职业生涯中最有代表性的五款车之一。
它的设计其实和RX-VISION挺有渊源的。
我在设计RX-VISION的时候，创造了一种通过漂亮的光
影折射效果让车身“活”过来的造型。
而马自达3呢，就是把这种设计应用到了C级车上。
我个人很喜欢马自达3。我敢打包票，这款车绝对会成为
汽车设计史上的一个亮点！
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Ikuo Maeda

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
No doubt about it, the S30 has a sports-car design
that is quintessentially Japanese.
I might even go so far as to say that its proportions and
lines are just about perfect.
The over-fenders and long nose, which were added
to the ZG variant...
...actually balance the car quite nicely, giving it a more
"aggressive" charm, so to speak.
Just remember to give it some wide-rim wheels!
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
毫无疑问，日产S30的跑车设计带有典型的日本风格。
我甚至可以毫不夸张地说，它的比例和线条都堪称完美。
它在ZG车型的基础上增加了宽挡泥板和长车头……
在外形上实现了平衡的观感，更为它赋予了
一种更具“攻击性”的魅力，
同时也没有忘记为它配上一套更宽的车轮！
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The Lexus SC is a grand tourer series.
The second-generation model, the SC430, was a hardtop convertible
powered by a mighty V-8 engine.
You see them quite often in the U.S.
The first-generation model was designed at Calty, a Toyota design
studio located in California.
However, this SC430 was mainly conceived
at design studios in Europe.
A competitor at Japanese GT races, it received aerodynamic
upgrades for the 2008 season...
...during which it tore up the high-speed tracks.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
雷克萨斯SC属于品牌的豪华旅行车系列车型。
其二代车型SC430是由一台强力的V8引擎所驱动的硬顶敞篷车。
在美国，这辆车相对比较常见。
该系列的第一代车型由位于加利福尼亚的
丰田设计工作室Calty所设计。
然而，这一辆SC430主要是在欧洲的设计工作室中构思完成。
作为日本超跑比赛的参赛车辆之一，
其在2008赛季得到了空气动力学升级……
也因此，它在高速赛道上交出了极其出色的答卷。|
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Kunihisa Ito

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Following a trend set by the 4CV, the Renault R8 represented the
third generation of the marque’s rear-engine sedans.
Yet the addition of 4-wheel disc brakes made it
uniquely modern.
The R8 Gordini is an upgraded version, complete with
the magic touch of the great Amédée Gordini.
Affectionately called the "Lunchbox," it has blunt lines
and an overall spartan design.
The year 1966 saw the addition of twin headlights.
Dressed in French racing blue, with two white stripes,
the Gordini truly has a charm that differentiates it from the pack.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
雷诺R8继承4CV的传统，成为该知名品牌的
第三代后置引擎轿车。
四轮碟刹的加入为该系列增添了一抹独特的现代气息。
R8 Gordini是系列中的一款升级版车型，在伟大的设计师
阿梅德·戈迪尼的神奇手笔下，该车的速度进一步提升。
此车因其简洁的线条和整体简约设计
而被亲切地称为“饭盒”。
1966年，该车增加了双前大灯版本。
Gordini车身喷涂法国赛车蓝，配以两条白色条纹，
有一种浑然天成的魅力。R
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Hideo Kodama

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The Miura is quite controversial among us designers.
The debate surrounding this car is about the 
identity of its true designer.
Some say that the Miura was the creation of
Bertone's Giorgetto Guigiaro...
...while others contend it was his successor,
Marcello Gandini's work.
The overall look of the car is quite advanced for its time,
comparable to that of the Ford GT40, in fact. 
Howev�r, what sticks out to me is the detail
of the headlights that stare upward. 
This detail can be found on another one of 
Guigiaro's products, the FIAT 850 Spider.
Does this make the Miura's true designer, Guigiaro?
I think so.
Regardless, we should all be happy that...
...the first-ever mid-engine Lamborghini
was a car that looked this amazing.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
Miura在我们这些设计师当中是个颇具争议的话题。
不过，大家的争论焦点是它的真正设计者究竟是谁。
有的人说是博通的乔盖托·乔治亚罗……
……而另一些人则认为它是博通的后辈马塞罗·甘迪尼的作品。
这辆车的整体外观在当时相当超前，
甚至可以与福特GT40的横空出世相提并论。
然而，最�%�我印象深刻的是那副朝上的头灯。
在乔治亚罗的另一款作品菲亚特850敞篷上，
也能找到类似的细节。
这是否说明Miura的真正设计师是乔治亚罗？我是这么认为的。
无论如何……
……有史以来的第一辆中置引擎兰博基尼的外观是如此超凡脱俗，
总算没有令人失望。W
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Hideo Kodama

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This car was introduced at the 2003 Frankfurt Motor Show.
I know because I was there.
Even if somebody were to cover its distinctive shield,
I would still know it from its voluminous design. 
The round taillights on its short rear overhang
are reminiscent of the TZ.
And, well, it simply feels like an Alfa Romeo!
While Alfa Romeo sports models are usually designed
by Italian carrozzerie and stylists...
...this 8C was different.
It was penned by Wolfgang Egger’s own design department,
Centro Stile Alfa Romeo.'
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这辆车在2003法兰克福车展上首次亮相。
我之所以知道，是因为当时我也在场！
即便把它特点鲜明的盾形车标挡住，我也能
从它宽大的车身设计分辨出来。
其短车尾凸出部分的圆形车尾灯让人回想起了经典车型TZ……
不过说实话……这才是纯正的阿尔法罗密欧！
阿尔法罗密欧的跑车车型多由意大利的
车身制造商和外观设计师操刀……
但这辆8C却并非如此。
它是由沃尔夫冈·埃格尔自己的设计部门——
设计中心 阿尔法罗密欧所执笔设计。
legacyUnmatchedReview.car: Alfa Romeo GIULIA TZ2 carrozzata da ZAGATO '65
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Hideo Kodama

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The fifth-generation Nissan Silvia was one of
my favorite Japanese cars of the early '90s.
One thing that has always impressed me about it
is the quality of its shape.
Specifically, the slight "S" curve in the side profile,
above the wheel of the front fender...
...gives a very delicate and sensitive finish
to the surface modelling and reflections.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
第五代日产Silvia是我最爱的
九十年代初期日式车之一。
它最让我印象深刻的一点就是外观风格。
具体来说就是它车身侧面轮廓中，前挡泥板轮圈上方
略微呈现出的“S”弧线。
这一细节为车身的立体造型和光线反射添加了
精妙而感性的一笔，起到了画龙点睛的作用。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Fabio Filippini

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This car has a dynamic and elegant design.
Called the Atenza, it incorporates the 4-door sedan-coupe layout,
and the style inspired by Mazda Design's "Kodo" philosophy.
In my eyes this design reinterprets the classic sensuality
of Italian sports cars from the 1960s...
...with a typically Japanese sensitivity of surfaces and details.
Soft and fluid shapes with evolving �urfaces are enhanced
by specially developed metallic colors.
It is not by chance that in Mazda’s communication campaigns,
the cars are often shown in red...
...thus reviving a somewhat "Latin" sporting imagery,
made up of emotions and movement.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
阿特兹兼具动感和优雅的设计。
它重新诠释了20世纪60年代意大利跑车的经典性感……
又同时具备日本车典型的对于表面和细节的敏感。
这款车采用四门轿跑车的布局，
并融入了马自达设计部提出的“魂动”设计理念。
柔和的流畅线条与不断演变的表面
被专门开发的金属色车x��进一步增强。
在马自达的不同广告宣传中，经常以红车示人。>
这并非偶然，红色唤起了某种充满情绪和动感的极致激情意象。@
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Fabio Filippini
legacyUnmatchedReview.resolvedCarNameEn: Mazda Atenza Sedan XD L Package '15
legacyUnmatchedReview.resolvedCarNameZh: Mazda Atenza Sedan XD L Package '15

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The Dodge Challenger SRT Demon is a beast!
It's a "well-executed beast," with a bold and purposeful design
that emphasized functionality!
The SRT Demon is a very intimidating
modern day muscle car...
...with bold fender flares and hood scoops...
...as well as deep-offset wheels that say power—
lots of power!
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这辆道奇Challenger SRT Demon绝对是最凶猛的野兽！
SRT Demon是一辆开发得当的性能机器，
采用了激进但目的明确，强调功能性的设计，
是一辆令人望而生畏的现代肌肉车。
它的挡泥板和引擎盖进气口相当粗犷……
缩小偏距使得轮毂外凸，传递出令人无法抗拒的力量感，
而它也确实拥有与外观匹配的性能！
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Ed Welburn

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This vehicle was created for Vision Gran Turismo by Zagato,
an Italian carrozzeria that was founded in 1919.
It's said to be styled after a sketch by Harada, the car's
designer, while he studied at ArtCenter College of Design.
Although the three-dimensional composition looks complicated
at first glance, each element is a very simple form.
Every module, one after another, intersects 
to complete the entire design.
Its traditio�al beauty as an FR sports car...
...exudes the feel from a traditional carrozzeria.
The power bulge on the hood
pays homage to the 7.0-liter engine of the Iso Grifo.
And, the taillights were inspired by the Red Torii Gate 
at Miyajima of Aki in Japan.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这台性能怪兽是由1919年成立于意大利的车身制造商扎加托
专为跑车浪漫旅愿景项目量身打造的。
此车的原型来自于公司设计师原田则彦
在艺术中心设计学院时期绘制的一张草图。
尽管它具有令人望而生畏的复杂三维结构，
但其实每个构成元素的形状都很简单。
通过各个简单模块的交错形成完整的车体。
此外，它还体现�$了作为一辆前置后驱跑车的传统美感……
充分展现以手工打造闻名的老牌车身制造商的底蕴。
注意引擎盖上的凸起，这是对伊索狮鹫的7L引擎的致敬。
另一方面，尾灯的灵感则来自日本宫岛的红色鸟居。R
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This is a genuine American muscle car that cuts
a distinctive figure on the track.
A mid-size sedan with a super-high horsepower engine...
...it’s more European in its aero parts and suspension
than the first-gen model.
This car is a celebration of American "inclusive design."
It offers supercar-level performance
at an affordable price.
I once drove a Chrysler 300 SRT at Laguna Seca Raceway.
A dream to drive, its wide torque range allowed me to take
the course without frequent gear shifts.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这辆车是一款真正的美式肌肉车，在赛道上
展现出独特的魅力。
作为一辆中型轿车，它搭载着一颗超高马力的引擎……
在空气动力学和悬挂方面比第一代车型融入了
更多欧洲风格，
从而体现了美国“包容性设计”的理念……
以实惠的价格提供了超级跑车级别的性能体验。
我曾在拉古纳-塞卡赛道上驾驶过一辆克莱斯勒300 SRT。
宽广的扭矩范围让我能够在赛道上畅快驾驶而无需频繁换挡。
那种驾驶体验如同梦幻。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Tom Matano

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The VW Sambabus is truly a design icon, with a design
language that’s whimsical and endearing.
It literally makes you smile.
It’s basically a functional box with rounded
corners full of character.
This "23" Window Sambabus has a fully-opening
pull-back cloth sunroof...
...windows that go round to the back corners, 
and "panorama" windows on top.
Its color palette greatly adds to its visual charm.R
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
大众的“Sambabus”是一款真正的设计代表作，它的设计语言
充满奇思妙想，同时又惹人喜爱！
不夸张地说，看到它你就会不由自主地露出微笑！
它的车身可以用长方体盒子来概括，再加上特征鲜明
的圆润边角。
这款“23”窗的Sambabus拥有可完全打开的
后拉式布制天窗……
以及从前一直环绕延伸到后方边角的大量侧窗，
顶上还有“全景式”的一圈边窗。
而丰富的车漆色系也为它的视觉魅力增色不少！
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Freeman Thomas

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
If I’m not mistaken, this car was preceded by
the more radical Gallardo.
And yet the Huracán represented an evolution
in Lamborghini’s identity and design language.
Its use of hexagonal forms continues to be seen
in today’s Lamborghinis.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
如果我没记错的话，这辆车的前款应该是
更加激进的“Gallard”。
然而，Huracán很好地展现了兰博基尼在品牌认同
和设计语言上的革命。
它采用的六角形元素至今可以在现款兰博基尼上看到。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The Audi Quattro was a landmark achievement
in the history of automotive design.
Introduced in 1981, it revolutionized the world
of rally racing.
And, it has remained a benchmark for production-car
technology ever since.
Most of its outer panels are crafted from a blend of
resin and Kevlar.
And its steeply raked windshield provides better visibility
than many of its peers.
With wide fenders, a short wheelbase, and somewhat awkward
proportions, it may not have been the prettiest machine.
But as a purpose-built competition car,
it delivered outstanding results.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
奥迪quattro是汽车设计史上的一个里程碑。
它于1981年首次亮相，便彻底改变了拉力赛的世界……
并从此成为赛车技术下放量产车的典范。
其大部分外部面板是由树脂和凯夫拉混合材料制成……
挡风玻璃的角度经过调整，相比原型车
可提供更大的可视范围。
它的挡泥板宽大，轴距短，显得比例很不协调。
然而，作为一款专为比赛设计的汽车，
它以极其出色的成绩做出了回应。R
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Kunihisa Ito
legacyUnmatchedReview.resolvedCarNameEn: Audi Sport quattro S1 Pikes Peak '87
legacyUnmatchedReview.resolvedCarNameZh: Audi Sport quattro S1 Pikes Peak '87

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Virgil Exner is a designer that I'm quite fond of.
After working with Raymond Loewy, he served as the first
design director for Chrysler from 1953 to 1961. 
With designs overflowing with personality, he was the
leading figure in the golden age of Chrysler design. 
From all of those creations, the one that stands out to me
is the XNR.
This concept car can be regarded as an answer to sports cars�
like the Chevrolet Corvette and Ford Thunderbird.
It features a unique asymmetrical design, with an air scoop,
interior panel and tailfin serving as accents. 
One might call the styling of this car outrageous,
but i� was very fresh. 
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
维吉尔·埃克斯纳是我非常欣赏的设计师。
在与雷蒙德·洛威展开合作后，他在1953到1961年之间
担任克莱斯勒的首位设计总监。
他的设计洋溢着个人风格，
也是克莱斯勒设计黄金时代的领导人物。
在他所有的创作中，我觉得最杰出的就是这辆XNR。
这款概念赛车可以称得上是克莱斯勒对雪佛兰科尔维��和
福特雷鸟等跑车的回应。
它采用了独特的非对称设计，并通过进气口、
内衬板和尾翼等元素加以强调。
也许有人会认为这样的风格十分离经叛道，
但确实做到了让所有人耳目一新。�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Hideo Kodama

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The Nissan Silvia Spec-R is a small coupe with great proportions.
But it is a great opportunity 
for you to express your own creativity. 
It would make a great custom project car, 
with large wheels and flaired fenders as a starting point. 
Then paint it black, with a splash of color for graphics, or... ...just use your own creative magic!
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
日产Silvia Spec-R是一款车身比例非常好的小型双门跑车，
也是你表达自己的创造力的绝好机会。
它非常适合改装。如果是我的话，会先从大车轮和拓宽
挡泥板入手。
然后把它涂成黑色底色，再添加更多色彩……
不过，可能还是你自己发挥创造力比较好！
legacyUnmatchedReview.car: Nissan Silvia spec-R Aero (S15) Touring Car}
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Ed Welburn

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
A true sports car of Toyota making a 17-year comeback
was this Supra.
In the model changes for the Celica, Toyota never tried
to build a design identity for itself.
As if to keep denying its past, the company 
continued to be the innovator.
And that in itself commands respect,
but the Celica is no more.
And the Supra for sure appeared on a blank canvas, without
looking to the past, making a dazzling first appea�ance.
It shares a few components with the BMW Z4, but a different
design direction successfully differentiated them.
The only thing that is a little disappointing...
...is that to effectively show the design of its body sides,
you want a little more width.
You just can't help your eyes wandering towards the FT-1.W
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这辆Supra是丰田17年后卷土重来的真正跑车杰作。
从赛利卡变到Supra后，丰田并未尝试为它建立一个真正
的设计标识。
他们一直在追逐创新，仿佛是为了不断否定自己的过去。
赛利卡的确值得尊敬，但在Supra身上，你感受不到它的
一丝影子。
Supra无疑是在一块空白的画布上绘制的，在众人眼前
闪亮登场的它与过去y��成就毫无牵连。
虽然和宝马Z4共享了相当多的部件，但两者的设计截
然不同，成功地将彼此区分开来。
唯一的小遗憾就是……
如果能加宽车体，就能更好地展示出车身两侧的设计。
我必须承认，它会让你不由自主地联想到那台永远停留
在概念里的丰田FT-1。�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The Cayman has gone through a few cycles now.
The mid-engine layout here has made it sleeker
in both its roof line and overall proportions.
Indeed, the Cayman has taken on a more serious look
with each evolution.
With the GT4 trim, it is no longer positioned beneath
the 911.
Holding its own with great presence, tough looks and
beefy footwork...
...it has graduated from a casual racer to one that can
take on much bigger competition.\
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
迄今为止，Cayman已经历了数次更新换代。
中置引擎的布局强化了车顶线条和整体比例的流线感。
事实上，Cayman的每次进化都让其更加凌厉。
升级到GT4版本后，它不再被定位在911之下。
凭借其强大的气场、富有侵略性的外观
和稳健的操控性能……
它已经从一款休闲性能车升级为能够与更高级别对手
竞争的真正赛道利器。k
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Tom Matano

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
At the 1966 Le Mans, the first-generation Ford GT
beat its archnemesis, Ferrari.
This victory made the Ford GT the first American car to win
the 24-hour race.
Fast-forward 50 years to 2016.
The Ford GT returned to beat Ferrari
once again at Le Mans.
It was an amazing feat 50 years in the making.
It’s what makes racing so much fun!
Indeed, the long history of motorsports is filled
with such iconic battles.S
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
在1966年的勒芒，第一代福特GT击败了它的宿敌法拉利……
成为了第一辆赢得这项24小时耐力赛的美国车。
我们将时针快拨50年，来到2016年……
福特GT又回到了勒芒的赛场上，再次将法拉利斩落马下！
这是一场跨越半个世纪的伟大胜利！也再次展现了赛车
运动的精彩与乐趣！
在赛车运动漫长的历史中，永远不缺乏这样的经典之战。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The Ford Mustang has been celebrated as a legendary American
sports car ever since it hit the market in 1964.
One look at this exceptional seventh-generation model 
just might entice you to shout "Mustangs rule!"
Incorporating the essence of its predecessors...
...it boasts a proud lineage without relying too heavily
on retro design cues.
The star of the show is undoubtedly the
the V-8 engine found in this GT.
For a car with so much power, it came with an
astonishingly reasonable price tag.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
自1964年上市以来，福特野马一直被誉为是
美国跑车的一代传奇。
只要你看到这款卓尔不群的第七代车型，
你一定会欢呼“野马！”
凝聚了之前历代车型中的精髓……
从骨子里就流淌着厚重的历史底蕴，
不需要刻意攀附浮夸的复古风。
毋庸置疑，这款GT车继续搭载最优良的
V8引擎。
对于一款充满肌肉感的跑车而言，
其价格确实相当公道。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Chris

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The ’55 Porsche Spyder Type 550/1500RS is the icon
of all Porsche Spyders.
It was a minimalist car stripped of all but what is needed.
Its organic, functional form was designed
by Erwin Komenda.
He was the body designer for all the Auto-Union "Rennwagens,"
as well as the VW Beetle and Porsche 356.
He really was the chief architect of the early Porsche
and VW design DNA.
Stylistically, the Spyder Type 550 is sim�lar to
a 365 Speedster.
That said, it is much more capable, with its mid-engine
chassis and aluminum body.
The rag-top roof actually serves no real purpose,
except to meet the letter of the rule book.
It’s as if Porsche was saying to the regulators,
"Look, it has a roof!"
In addition to a diminutive body
and short wheelbase...
...it has an extremely low cowl/beltline
with just an aero screen.
Incidentally, the Porsche Spyder Type 550
was given the nickname "Giant Killer."
This is because, in the right hands, it was capable of
beating much more powerful and faster machines.
Indeed, it was a popular car for sportsmen or works drivers
looking to win a class victory or compete in a road rally.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这辆1955年出品的保时捷敞篷type 550/1500RS是
所有保时捷敞篷车型中最具标志性的一款！
这辆车采用极简设计，剥离了一切非必需的元素！
它那浑然天成、功能实用的外形是由
艾尔文·柯曼达设计……
这名车身设计师也是汽车联盟所有“赛车”车型
以及大众甲壳虫和保时捷356的创造者。
可以说，他就是早期保时捷和大众设计DNA
的主要构建�！
从外观上看，敞篷type 550和365 Speedster非常相似。
不过前者采用了中置引擎布局和铝制车身，性能也更出色。
它的帆布车顶其实并不具备实际功能，
只是为了符合规则的要求而已！
就好像保时捷在对规则监管方说：“你们看，我有车顶哦！”
除了截短的车身和短轴距之外……
它还拥有极低的风罩�)�腰线，
并且只采用了埃尔罗斯林风挡。
保时捷敞篷type 550获得“巨人杀手”的昵称
则是个意外之喜！
这是因为在技术高超的车手驾驭下，它可以击败
性能更强、速度更快的车型！
毋庸置疑，这是一辆人气极高的赛车，可以帮助竞技车手或
厂队车手赢得赛事胜利或加入公路拉力竞赛的争夺。�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Freeman Thomas

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
At the risk of sounding crass by compliment our own designs...
...I always felt that the GT-R in the Super GT Series was
"oh so cool" when watching it in races. 
The racecar is modified by NISMO every year...
...and the original image of the GT-R is carefully retained in 
the grille and the shape of the lights.
When watching a race, it's important to be able to 
recognize a car when seeing it from a distance. 
For that to happen, the front and rear of 
the base production car must be distinctive. 
Also, while race cars may be modified for aerodynamics,
GT regulations prohibit changes to the cabin.
In fact, when I was watching a GT race at Suzuka...
...I said to myself, "The racecars painted in their 
sponsor colors all look the same."　
That's when I decided that the shape of 
the R35 GT-R's cabin must ab�olutely remain distinctive!n
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
虽然这样说感觉像是在自卖自夸……
……不过我坚信当你在Super GT系列赛中
看到这辆GT-R时，你一定会觉得“哇，太酷了”。
每年，我们都会将赛车交由NISMO进行改装……
……而GT-R原本的外观，如格栅和车灯形状等
都精心地保留了下来。
我认为在观看比赛时，能让观众远远地
就把赛车辨认出来很有必要。
要达到这个目标，
基础量产车的前后外观必须要有独到之处。
为了增强空气动力学性能，赛车的车身通常会接受
大量的改装，但GT系列赛又规定
驾驶舱必须与原版量产车保持一致。
我过去在铃鹿赛道观看超跑比赛的时候……
……就觉得“除了赞助商的涂装，这些赛车
看上去都一个样。”
所以，我才会在S��计R35 GT-R的时候赋予驾驶舱独特的风格！�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This is a car that I had a hand in 
styling when I was with Renault Design!
When I designed 
the Mégane III series with my team...
...we decided right from the start to make 
the coupe version with the RS variant in mind.
Thus, the original design is already very compact...
...and extreme for a 3-door hatchback, with a sloping rear
window and a bold and dynamic rear pillar.
Obviously, the large alloy wheels, mod�fied bumpers...
...and the big rear central exhaust
contribute to making it even more aggressive.
But the most successful detail is...
...undoubtedly the F1-inspired suspended wing in the
front grille, which integ�ates the daytime running lights.*
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这辆车的造型还是我在雷诺设计工作时经手设计的！
当我和我的团队一起设计梅甘娜III系列时……
从一开始就决定追加设计一个RS版本。
这是一辆紧凑到极致的三门小钢炮，有着大坡度后窗
和动态十足的C柱，
以及显著改造过的后保险杠……
还有汇集到尾部正中的大号排气管，让它更显侵略性。
但最成功的细节……
无疑是前格栅里受F1赛车启发的悬浮翼片，
我们将它直接与日间行车灯整合到了一起。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Fabio Filippini

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The Corvette Stingray Racer had a big influence
on every Corvette that came after it.
It was not designed as a production or concept car,
but as a very serious racecar.
Its design was a radical departure from that of
previous Corvettes.
Many of its shapes, like those characterized by
its beautiful fenders, were inspired by Italian streamliners.
The strong crease that defines the car contributes to
its evocation of speed.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
科尔维特Stingray Racer的诞生对后世每一台科尔维特
都带来了重大影响。
自设计伊始，它的定位就不是一台量产车或概念赛车，
而是彻彻底底的赛车。
大刀阔斧的设计改动使其与
之前的科尔维特大相径庭。
车身多处的造型设计都明显受到早期意大利流线型车身
的启发，尤其是那堪称精雕细琢的前后挡泥板。
另外，得益于围绕车身一周的“折缝线”设计，
令它多出了几分速度感。.
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Ed Welburn

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Tesla Model S Signature Performance has
 an absolutely wonderful stance.
 The wheels are placed well outside of the basic body shape, 
with generous flairs reaching out to those tires.
The body shape is sleek, slippery, and very cool.
 It doesn’t need any tacked-on chrome or aero devices.
 I really like the front-end graphics of the Signature Performance
model much better than the base Model S.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
特斯拉Model S高性能签名版的外形绝对令人惊艳。
车轮恰到好处地超出车身外廓，
宽大的轮眉向外延展，盖住车轮。
车身线条顺滑流畅，
无需任何附加的铬合金或空气动力学部件，
就已经显得未来感十足，帅气非凡。
我很喜欢高性能签名版的前脸造型，
比基础款Model S的平面耐看多了。i
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Ed Welburn

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The Evo’s history is marked by constant improvements
and functional expansions.
This MR version was the final model of the third-gen Evo IX,
and is said to be one of the best Evos ever.The third-generation car was based on the Lancer Cedia,
which, in turn, was a serious and practical family sedan.
Compared to the second-generation model, it was larger overall.
The nose took on a rounded s�ape, while blister fenders were adopted.
Not quite the battle machine it used to be...
...the large iconic fog lights, reminiscent of rally cars,
were done away with.
It was a sign that the Evo was expanding its sphere of competition
to include endurance races and the like.
At the same time, the car's upscale nature grew.
Multi-purpose cars like the Evo tend to adapt
to their surroundings.
In this sense, they evolve like living things.
And �hat is just one of the many reasons that
fans continue to love the Evo.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
在翼豪陆神的发展史上，充斥着持续不断的改进和功能拓展。
这款MR版本是第三代翼豪陆神IX的终极车型，
也被公认为最卓越的翼豪陆神之一。
第三代翼豪陆神的开发基于蓝瑟西迪亚，
一款普通而实用的家庭轿车。
相较于第二代，它的车身整体更大，车头被重新设计得
更加圆润，同时加入了引�$注目的凸起轮拱。
它不再保持曾经的战斗机器风格……
标志性的硕大雾灯，以及那些让人联想到
拉力赛车的元素，也不复存在……
这暗示着翼豪陆神正在将其竞争领域从耐力赛扩大到
更多不同领域。
与此同时，车辆的高端进阶属性也更为凸显。
像翼豪陆神这样的多功能车型往往能够灵活
适应不同的环境。
从这个意义上说，它们就像�生物一样在不断演变进化。
这正是车迷们一直对翼豪陆神怀有深厚感情的众多原因之一。�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
legacyUnmatchedReview.resolvedCarNameEn: Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution IX MR GSR '06
legacyUnmatchedReview.resolvedCarNameZh: Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution IX    MR GSR '06

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
I think that the Fugu Z is a very appealing car. 
The interior is especially cool because it's so carefully
stripped down. 
Only the bare minimum parts have been added, 
which match the car's power output that has nearly doubled. 
The original 240Z was straightforward and had
beautiful proportions...
...and this car is respectful of that with its
minimal customization. 
Look at t�e original fender mirrors, they're in the 
original Kilimanjaro White color.
It was as if a young person from California came upon
a Z that was a bit rough around the edges...
...and polished it with the admiration he had of the car
in the past. 
And now...
...the raw pureness of the spirit of the 
1973 Z shines brightly in the Fugu Z. 
Thank you, Sung Kang!c
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
我觉得Fugu Z是一辆充满魅力的车。
内饰经过了非常细致的精简，显得尤其炫酷。
这款车只最低限度地安装了必要的改装件，
与之相对的是几乎翻倍的动力输出。
原始车型240Z的设计本身就很简约，
但有着优美的车身比例……
……这台车很好地延续了这一风格，只进行了极少量的改装。
你���瞧这原版的挡泥板上装后视镜，
连油漆都是原版的乞力马扎罗白。
就好像是有个加州的年轻人遇上了一辆老爷车Z，
感怀它的破旧不堪……
……就抱着自己对这辆车的情怀对它进行了打磨。
而现在……
……1973 Z那最纯粹、最原始的精神
在Fugu Z的身上得到了灿烂重现。
姜成镐，谢谢你的付出！)
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The A80 Supra...
...is a coupe with very traditional sports-car proportions
that's kind of rare in Japanese cars.
With a windshield that wraps all around the cabin, 
it has a proper greenhouse.
And this car takes the classic, beautiful coupe and drops the
ride height further and widens the track...
...turning it into a race car that looks like it could really
deliver on the track!
The car's shape is simple, so the Castrol livery suits it well.
The lights, which look too close together in the original model,
are camouflaged and don't get in the way of the design.
The A80 Supra had lots of tuning parts available for it, so
it's no wonder it was so popular with the younger crowd.K
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
该怎么描述A80 Supra呢……
这是一款采用传统跑车比例的双门跑车，在日本车当中
相当罕见。
环绕式的挡风玻璃仿若一个倒置的温室。
这辆经典、优美的双门跑车进一步降低了离地间隙，加
宽了胎面，
变成了一辆仿佛随时可以一飞冲天的赛车。
简洁的车型与嘉实多的涂装相得益彰。
原版车中看起来相距太近的头灯经过涂装的遮掩后也不
那么碍眼了。
再加上A80 Supra有很多可供选择的调校件，难怪它在年
轻人中有如此大的魅力了！�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
There were a few Lamborghini models that succeeded
the Countach.
However, none of them defined the Lamborghini style
since that car made its debut in 1970.
In my opinion, the Aventador finally achieved it.
Or perhaps it even surpassed it.
It took key design cues of the Countach and added
new surface and detail languages. 
And it carried the quintessential Lamborghini style
into the next generation.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
在1970年发布Countach之后，
兰博基尼推出过若干款后续车型。
但没有哪一款能像它那样定义兰博基尼的风格。
在我看来，Aventador终于做到了再造经典，
甚至可以说全面超越了前者。
它继承了Countach的关键设计要素，
并加入了全新的外观和细节设计语言……
将鲜明的兰博基尼风格带入了全新的时代。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Tom Matano

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
This Peugeot 908 HDi FAP really shot past the competition
at the 2010 Le Mans 24 Hours!
After taking down reigning champ Audi
at the 2009 race...
Peugeot approached the 2010 race eager for another win,
and set to improving their 908.
And of the four 908s that competed, all four placed
in the top qualifying positions!
What’s more, the fourth-place Peugeot beat
the fifth-place Audi by over two seconds.
But you know, it’s no easy feat to win a 24-hour
endurance race.
All of the Peugeot’s 908s experienced trouble on the track,
and were forced to retire.
Which goes to show that endurance races are really not
just about speed but also the strength to carry on.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
在2010年度的勒芒24小时耐力赛上，
标致908 HDi FAP宛如一支离弦之箭，速度快到惊人！
在2009年的勒芒比赛中击败卫冕冠军奥迪后……
标致继续精益求精，改良他们的908。
他们已经迫不及待地想要在2010年的赛场再度蝉联冠军。
后来，参赛的四辆908直接包揽了排位赛的前四！
而且就连第四名的标致都领先第五名的奥迪整�*两秒以上。
然而，要赢得24小时耐力赛并不是那么轻而易举的事。
事与愿违，标致的所有参赛车都在赛道上
遭遇了困难，最终被迫退赛。
这也表明了一点——在耐力赛中，重要的不仅仅是速度，
坚持到底的耐久力也非常重要。�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Jeremy

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Unlike the 993 Carrera RS, the 993 RS Clubsport 
was built with racing as its sole purpose.
It featured a distinctive rear wing with integrated air inlets.
The downforce generated at the rear was balanced
by an extended front spoiler.
The wheels were a three-piece design,
with staggered offsets front and rear.
A single glance at the exterior details made it clear
this was the work of Styl� Porsche...
...the in-house design studio at Porsche Weissach.
Inside, the cabin was defined by a spartan layout
and a reinforced roll cage.
Like other 911-based race cars of its era,
the Clubsport channeled its forebears.
I almost feel for the owner attempting to persuade
the authorities to license it for road use!
A formidable challenge, though not an impossible one![
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
基于993打造的RS Clubsport版本
是比993 Carrera RS更加纯粹的赛道机器。
尾翼产生的巨大下压力需要通过狭长的前端扰流板来平衡。
轮毂采用3片式锻造设计，而且前后采用不同的偏距值。
从外观细节中不难看出，它的设计来自品牌自有的
保时捷-魏斯萨赫设计工作室——“保时捷设计”。
内饰采用赛车专用的朴素黑色，并安装了全面焊接加固的防滚架。
在这一代基于保时捷911打造的赛车上，
你仍然可以看到一些原版911的元素。
我可以想象，某些有追求的车主可能会尝试
为这辆车注册登记，获得上路许可……
……想必这位车主需要和车管部门费好大一番口舌了。
不过我“听说”还真的有人成功了！�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Freeman Thomas

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The long-named Evo VIII MR GSR is a really special machine.
A true sports sedan with rallying pedigree.
The Evo's styling is sober and restrained, but set off
by its large functional rear wing.
The sober theme is continued on the inside.
The main difference is a thick steering wheel
and high-bolstered Recaro seats.
Did you know that the name "Recaro" is short for 
"Reutter Carosserie?"
This is where Porsche handmade many of its car bodies
in the 1960s.
The body manufacturing division was sold to Porsche
and "Reutter" went off to make seats under Recaro!
A small bit of triv�a!!.
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
拥有长串名字的翼豪陆神VIII MR GSR车型是一款非常特别
的座驾。它是一辆具有拉力赛血统的运动型轿车。
翼豪陆神的外观设计简洁而内敛，但实用的大型尾翼
为其增添了亮点。
这种简洁风格在内饰中得以延续。
主要的区别在于厚实的方向盘和
高包裹性的Recaro赛车座椅。
你知道吗？“Recaro”这个名字��实是
“Reutter Carosserie”的缩写。
在20世纪60年代，保时捷的许多车身就是
在这里手工打造的。
后来，车身制造部门被出售给了保时捷，
而“瑞特”则以“Recaro”的名义专门生产座椅！
这是个有趣的小知识！�
legacyUnmatchedReview.resolvedCar: Lancer GSR Evolution VIII MR GSR '04
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Freeman Thomas
legacyUnmatchedReview.resolvedCarNameEn: Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution VIII MR GSR '04
legacyUnmatchedReview.resolvedCarNameZh: Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution VIII MR GSR '04

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The '32 is the quintessential hot rod!
It was nicknamed "Deuce" because of the 2 in "32."
It was visually simple but complex in its execution. 
Look closely and
you'll not find a flat line anywhere!
It possesses a powerfully aggressive package,
that's all about proportion,
balance, stance and form.
The shape tapers in every view.
 The stance is set up
 �ith just the right amount of rake.
The back tires taller than the fronts.
The '32 also signals the beginning of 
the iconic Ford V-8!
In a '32 Hot Rod, the motor becomes 
an emotional part of the whole.]
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这款'32可以被视作是改装车中的标杆！
玩家们还将“32”中的“2”变成了这辆车的昵称：“二点”。
看似平平无奇的外观下，其实内有乾坤。
仔细观察后，你会发现整个车身上找不到一条平直的线条！
它的整体设计充满了力量和冲劲……
这也是车身比例、平衡、姿态和整体轮廓巧妙结合的成果。
前倾角的角度设置得恰到好处，
后轮比前轮高一些，就形成了现在这攻击型的姿态。
此外，这辆'32还标志着福特首次引入其招牌V8引擎！
对于'32 而言，
这台引擎是其浑然天成的整体中的神来之笔。
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Freeman Thomas

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
Look at the tight cabin and the position of the rear engine.
It's stunning.
The front fascia is particularly eye-catching.
The ridge that runs down the hood...
...really provides the vehicle with a unique feel. 
It's so very French.
But then, it has large fog lamps for rallying...
...and air scoops at the rear have been flawlessly incorporated.
These details that sugges� it's a competition vehicle
give it its exquisite character.
In terms of design, there are places where the balance is not
good, but when seeing the car up close, you don't mind at all.
In fact, it's those things that give this car visual impact.
This type of visual allure, 
you can't achieve in today's cars.
This car is a true masterpiece, one that I would love to
add to my collection.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
这辆车确实令人叹为观止，请关注紧凑的车厢和
后置引擎的位置。
从正前方看时尤其如此，
因为沿着引擎盖向下延伸的中脊线很有时尚感。
我觉得它非常有“法式风情”。
不过，它同时还配备了用于拉力赛的大雾灯……
以及精心布置的进气口。
这些赛车的美学设计都为它赋予了精��的特征。
从设计角度来看，有些部件似乎不那么平衡，
但凑近看时不仅不会让人这么觉得，
甚至是为这辆车带来了某种视觉冲击感。
它的许多设计在现今的汽车中确实已经不多见了。
这是一项真正的大师之作，我很想把它纳入我的收藏。�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
When producing the RX-VISION, I had a long running desire to
make the RX-VISION a GT3 car and compete in the Le Mans.
I'm a car designer, but I have a soft spot for motorsports.
The first movie that I spent my own allowance on to go see in a theater, 
during elementary school, was about the 24 hours of Le Mans.
I still remember being really excited to see the fantastic 
battles between cars like the Porsche 917 and Ferrari �12S.
It made me want to race at the Le Mans in the future,
and it also was what got me to strive for a job involving cars. 
Mazda won the Le Mans,
and that event naturally connected to that scene 
of the Le Mans that I dreamed of as a child.
But I want to have everyone take interest in todays motorsports scene,
not just events of the past like the 787B.
I strongly hope to add a new page to Mazda's motorsports.
In that �espect the GT3 version of the RX-VISION
was a car that I really wanted to make happen,
and I was able to do that first in Gran Turismo virtually.
This is something I created with the strong conviction, 
"that this will be a real car in the future." 
And I personally want to drive the Sarthe circuit in this car.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
不瞒你说，当RX-VISION还只是张图纸的时候，我就已经
在盘算着有朝一日要让它征战勒芒了。
要知道，我不光是个汽车设计师，还是个赛车迷呢。
还记得我人生第一次自掏腰包买电影票，看的就是讲
勒芒24小时耐力赛的片子。
那会儿看到保时捷917和法拉利512S在赛道上激烈
厮杀，那个兴奋劲儿，到现在我都忘不了。
就��那时候，我萌生了自己也要去勒芒的念头，也是从
那时起，我下定决心要投身汽车行业。
1991年马自达在勒芒的那次胜利……
毫无疑问又一次点燃了我年轻时的梦想。
不过，我觉得我们不能老是躺在787B的功劳簿上。
是时候该为马自达的赛车史开启一页新的篇章。
这就是为什么我铆足了劲要打造RX-VISION的GT3版本……
虽然现在这辆车只在《跑车浪漫旅》（在此感谢游戏）里
作为一辆虚拟车首次亮相。
但我坚信，总有一天，我会亲自驾驶着它……在那条
传说中的萨森赛道上驰骋！a
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Ikuo Maeda

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
For a car that came two generations 
after the S30, this one has rediscovered its "Z-ness." 
Three-dimensional undulations of the body are restrained,
and the design theme is simple yet bold.
The flush surface of the side glass and body around 
the door section was an American design trend at the time. 
You coud say that the Z32 
is more of a coupe in design than a sport car,
but �he super wide-and-low body proportion 
makes the overall look amazingly sporty.
If you look at the design flow it does deviate 
from the "Z story",
but the level of refinement of its design 
is truly outstanding. 
That's why the car is still so popular. 
And here's an interesting fact: 
The area around the opening line of the rear hatch,
 was carried over to the Z33. u
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
自S30推出又过了两代之后，
这款新车终于重新找回了“Z”系列的特色。
车身的起伏曲线十分克制，
用于展现简洁而又大胆的设计主旨。
侧面车窗底部与车门周围的车身齐平于同一平面……
体现了当时美国汽车设计领域的主流趋势。
与其说Z32是跑车，它更像是一台双门轿跑……
但那宽体低趴的姿态像是匍匐在地，
使整体外观充满了动感。
如果从设计流线上看，确实有些偏离Z系列的传统要素，
但其设计的精致程度无疑令人赞许。
这也解释了它为何至今仍然受到车迷们的追捧。
另外，后备箱盖开合线附近区域的设计在
后续车型Z33中也得到了沿用。�
legacyUnmatchedReview.speaker: Shiro Nakamura

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
When Mr. Yamauchi approached me about 
the Vision Gran Turismo project...
...it was when we were exploring the design strategy
of next-gen Infiniti models. 
This design came from Infiniti's Beijing studio,
which had just been established.
One of our young designers took the initiative
and completed this in a short time.
There's some simplicity in the details of the design,

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The Nissan Concept 2020 VGT gave us the great opportunity...
...to freely express the design vision of the Nissan brand. 
This styling theme here was created by our London studio
in a short time. It's overflowing with energy, don't you think?
This car wasn't particularly based on a specific model, but we
gave our young designers complete freedom to shape this car.
And yes, it seems that they all had the future GT-R in m�nd. 
Most anyone can tell that the design was inspired by the GT-R
by simply looking at the greenhouse and taillights, right? 
The balance of the proportions suggests
not a mid-engine car or a long-nose FR machine,
but that of a front mid-engine 4WD car.
While this car is purely a design study...
...the front bumper and details of the rear end 
are related to that of the 2017 GT-R.�
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
日产Concept 2020 Vision Gran Turismo给了我们一个前所未有的机会……
……让我们可以无拘无束地展现我们对于日产品牌的愿景。

这款车并不是基于某款GT-R车型设计的命题作文，我们

而从结果看，他们心中都有各自对于GT-R未来的畅想。
如果单看车身侧面和车尾灯，
很容易就能辨认出其中的GT-R元素，对吧？
还有从车身比例就能看出，它不是什么中置引擎
，也不是长车鼻的前置后驱车，
而是一款前中置引擎四驱车款。
尽管这款车只是一项设计课题……
……但前保险杠^��后部的部分细节
与2017款GT-R有着密切的联系。�

I never knew that the Abarth 1500 Biposto Bertone was also
called the B.A.T. 1.

The gentle tail fins and thin dorsal fin that run down

Franco Scaglione, the man who designed this car,

This car was the product of his wonderfully eccentric
design mind.
As the first B.A.T. (Berlinetta Aerodinamica Tecnica), it has
an important place in the history of automotive design.�

我之前不知道阿巴斯1500 Biposto博通
也被称为“B.A.T.1”，

柔和的尾翼和纵贯车身的中央长背翼

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The goal of J Mays and his team...
...was to make this car more of a European sports car
while not losing its American pony-car heritage.
It was truly a tough undertaking!
The resulting car is the quintessential Mustang...
...which looked like it went to finishing school in Europe.
The new side DLO with rear quarter window
was initially controversial...
...because the previous Mus�angs had a B-pillar separating
a scoop, window, or a clean panel.
The new DLO made the Mustang visually more sophisticated
and provided better visibility.
The front-end looked aggressive, with its thin, angled eyes
and aggressive grille!
The rear-end took the three-bar iconic taillights
to a new level.
It had a sequential blinker inspired by the '67/'68 Shelby.
And, did it ever look �ean, especially with optional big
wheels spaced-out to the edges!x
legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
J·梅斯及其团队的目标……
是使这款车更贴近一辆欧洲跑车，同时不失
其美式小马车的传统。
这确实是一个艰巨的任务！
他们最终的成果是一款典型的Mustang……
但跑去欧洲的商场采购装扮了一番。
新的后侧窗设计起初引发了不少争议……
前款Mustang的B柱非常宽厚，在后侧只隔出了一个�气口、

相比之下，新侧窗使这款Mustang在视觉上更加精致，
并提供了更好的侧后方视野。
前脸部分的设计更为激进
——细长而倾斜的大灯和狰狞的进气口极具攻击性！
经典的三道杠式尾灯设计被提升到了一个新的高度……
并采用了受到'67/'68 Shel�y启发的顺序闪灯效果。
在选配了几乎占满全部轮拱的大尺寸轮圈之后，
整车的姿态近乎完美，更显卓尔不凡！C

Classical yet elegantly refined, 
this car is truly a stunning work of art.
Carrozzeria Touring, were experimenting with an 
advanced design called the "pontoon,"
where the front and rear fenders were connected.
However, this 8C 2900 has...
...a classic design where 
the large fenders are enhanced.
Of course, other Alfa Romeos had this design element.
Undoubtedly a very beautiful car that caught people's

legacyUnmatchedReview.zh:
抛开经典复古的内核不谈，这款车在设计中
将优雅与犀利融为一体，造就了一件毋庸置疑的美妙作品。
Carrozzeria Touring在打造此车身时，
正在实验当时被称作“浮船”的先进设计：
即车身的前后挡泥板连贯为一个整体。
然而，这辆8C 2900还呈现了……
另一种经典设计：上拱的巨大挡泥板。
当然，这一设计元素也被其他阿尔法罗密欧车型所采用。
毫无疑问这是一辆非常优美的汽车，
甚至比当今的许多法拉利还要吸睛。

legacyUnmatchedReview.en:
The 356 A/1500 GS GT Carrera Speedster takes the most
spartan model in the Porsche lineup...
...and pushes it into the level of "unobtanium."
The Speedster shape and form are an extension
of the other 356A models, but more extreme.
With its low wrap-around windshield, tall shoulder...
...and longer rear deck...
...the Speedster has attitude.
Both James Dean and Steve McQueen had Speedsters.
Unique to the Carrera GT are the deletion of
the side spears and sill deco.
The bumpers do away with the bumper horns and the deco
is replaced with aluminum trim.
You can also see the front leather tie-down straps
and GT roll bar.
The GT eventually received aluminum opening panels.
And even the normal-looking wheels are specially
constructed of steel and aluminum.
As with all Por�ches, you really need to take a close look at
each model to know all the variations.S
